title: Discovering Global False Negatives On the Fly for Self-supervised Contrastive Learning
summary: In self-supervised contrastive learning, negative pairs are typically constructed using an anchor image and a sample drawn from the entire dataset, excluding the anchor. However, this approach can result in the creation of negative pairs with similar semantics, referred to as "false negatives", leading to their embeddings being falsely pushed apart. To address this issue, we introduce GloFND, an optimization-based approach that automatically learns on the fly the threshold for each anchor data to identify its false negatives during training. In contrast to previous methods for false negative discovery, our approach globally detects false negatives across the entire dataset rather than locally within the mini-batch. Moreover, its per-iteration computation cost remains independent of the dataset size. Experimental results on image and image-text data demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Our implementation is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出GloFND（Global False Negative Discovery），一种基于优化的方法，用于在自监督对比学习中自动学习每个锚点的全局阈值，以在训练过程中动态识别整个数据集中的假负样本。该方法克服了现有局部（批内）方法在小批量下不可靠，以及全局聚类方法（如IFND）在大规模数据集上计算昂贵的问题，每次迭代的计算开销与数据集大小无关，且仅为O(B²)。GloFND可集成到多种对比学习框架中（单模态如SogCLR/SimCLR，双模态如CLIP/FastCLIP），通过简单地过滤识别出的假负样本即可提升表征质量。在ImageNet100和CC3M上的实验表明，GloFND在错误负样本识别精度/召回率、半监督线性评估、迁移学习及零样本双模态任务上均优于FNC等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 在自监督对比学习中，基于实例判别的负样本构造方式会将语义相似的样本错误地视为负样本（假负样本），导致其嵌入被推向不同方向，损害表征学习质量。在大规模数据集上这一问题尤为突出（例如ImageNet100上约1%的负样本对为假负样本，批量大小1024时每批约20,000个假负样本，可导致半监督线性分类器精度下降达10%）。现有解决方案分两类：局部（批内）方法在小批量下不可靠；全局方法（如IFND）通过周期性对整个数据集做k-means聚类发现假负样本，计算成本高。本文旨在解决上述局限性：设计一种能够在整个数据集范围内全局发现假负样本、同时保持每次迭代计算与数据集大小无关的方法。
AI.method: 核心思想：将识别每个锚点的top-α%最相似负样本（即(1-α)-分位数以上者）转化为一个凸优化问题 να + (1/|R|)∑(r−ν)₊，然后通过SGD对该问题求解每个锚点xᵢ对应的全局阈值λᵢ。具体算法GloFND在每个训练迭代中交替执行两步：(1) 使用随机次梯度更新批次内锚点对应的阈值λᵢ；(2) 利用更新后的λᵢ从对比损失中过滤掉识别出的假负样本，并通过移动平均估计量uᵢ降低对大批量的依赖，再更新编码器参数。阈值更新只需基本矩阵运算，复杂度为O(B²)，与数据集大小无关。算法被框架化为双层优化问题，但因下层问题非光滑非强凸、上层对λ不可微，故忽略λ对w的超梯度（借鉴MAML思路）。方法还扩展到双模态对比学习（如CLIP），为图像和文本分别学习独立阈值。文中给出Lemma 3.1证明所求阈值λᵢ等价于相似度集合中的第k大值。
AI.result: 在ImageNet100（ResNet-50，200个epoch，批量大小128）上：假负样本识别方面，GloFND的F1得分达53.10%，较FNC（36.42%）提升16.68%；半监督线性评估平均精度63.36%，较SogCLR基线提升+1.70%（4种标签比例下均提升，p<0.018）；迁移学习在8个数据集上平均提升+1.64%（6/8数据集统计显著）；每epoch训练时间仅增加2%（435s vs 427s）。在CC3M双模态实验中（37 epoch，批大小1024）：GloFND使SogCLR和FastCLIP在Datacomp 38任务均值上分别提升至25.37（高于FastCLIP基线24.76）。消融实验验证：每锚点独立阈值优于单一全局阈值；GloFND所学阈值分布更接近数据集全局最优阈值（MAE 0.10，约为FNC的0.21的一半）；启动epoch在70时性能最优。还展示了GloFND与SimCLR的兼容性，以及用于微调OpenAI CLIP可显著提升检索性能（IR平均从44.43→54.66）。
AI.conclusion: GloFND是一种基于优化的假负样本全局发现方法，通过为每个锚点自动学习动态阈值来识别整个数据集中的假负样本，弥补了现有局部和全局方法的不足。该方法以与数据集大小无关的计算开销（O(B²)）实现了更准确的假负样本识别，并可无缝集成到多种单模态和双模态对比学习方法中，仅通过简单的过滤策略即可在假负样本识别精度、半监督学习、迁移学习及零样本任务中带来一致且统计显著的性能提升。论文指出的开放性问题包括：将GloFND扩展至非对比学习方法，以及实现α参数（假负样本比例）的样本级自适应。局限性：当前仅采用过滤策略处理假负样本，更精细的处理方式（如吸引力）可能在未来进一步提高性能。

title: SpectralCache: Accelerating Diffusion-Based World Models via Spectral Feature Caching
summary: Diffusion-based world models enable high-quality interactive environment generation but suffer from substantial inference overhead due to repeated Transformer evaluations during denoising. Existing caching methods mainly exploit temporal redundancy at the feature or token level, leaving the underlying mathematical structure of diffusion features largely unexplored. In this work, we reveal that world-model features exhibit highly stable singular subspaces across nearby denoising steps, while their singular values follow predictable evolution patterns. Building on this observation, we propose SpectralCache, a training-free spectral caching framework that reuses stable singular subspaces and estimates only low-dimensional singular values through linear extrapolation. We further exploit the spectral consistency between neighboring full-computation features to skip selected expensive backbone evaluations via singular value scaling. Extensive experiments on representative world models demonstrate that SpectralCache consistently improves inference efficiency while preserving generation quality. On HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B, SpectralCache achieves 5.22x acceleration while maintaining a WorldScore of 65.90 for static scenes, substantially outperforming existing training-free caching methods in inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: SpectralCache是一个用于加速基于扩散的世界模型（diffusion-based world models）的免训练（training-free）频谱特征缓存框架。其核心思想是利用SVD分析扩散中间特征的数学结构，发现其奇异子空间在邻近去噪步骤间高度稳定，而奇异值呈现可预测的线性演化规律，从而通过重用奇异子空间并仅对低维奇异值进行外推/缩放估计，跳过昂贵的Transformer主干计算，在保持生成质量的同时实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散的世界模型在交互式环境生成中面临严重的推理开销问题，主要源于去噪过程中重复的Transformer计算。现有缓存方法主要利用token或特征级的时间冗余，但未探索扩散特征底层数学结构中的冗余。直接将传统图像/视频扩散缓存方法应用于世界模型会导致显著的质量退化。此外，即使是世界模型专用缓存方法（如WorldCache、HERO），也存在加速与质量难以兼顾的问题。
AI.method: 通过对DiT最终层视觉特征进行SVD分析，发现三个关键观察：（1）视觉特征具有强低秩结构，前128个奇异值平均捕获96%特征能量；（2）邻近去噪步骤间的奇异子空间高度稳定（余弦相似度>0.95）；（3）奇异值呈线性外推规律，且相邻全计算步骤间的奇异值幅度近似恒定比例。基于此提出SpectralCache框架：定义全计算步（执行完整DiT计算并进行秩r=128的SVD分解，缓存奇异子空间、奇异值和残差）和近似步（重用最近全计算步的稳定奇异子空间和残差，仅估计奇异值）。近似步采用两种策略：连续近似步使用线性外推估计奇异值；当累积误差触发全计算时，替代性地在"真实全计算"与"缩放近似（γ=1.1）"之间交替执行，进一步跳过更多的主干评估。使用混沌令牌（chaotic token）的曲率加权累积误差控制全计算触发。
AI.result: 在HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B和Aether-5B两个代表性世界模型上的实验表明：SpectralCache始终优于现有免训练缓存方法。在HunyuanWorld-Voyager-13B上实现5.22×加速（WorldCache为3.65×），静态场景WorldScore为65.90（vs WorldCache 64.89），动态场景为46.13（vs 45.43），PSNR从23.49提升至25.06。在Aether-5B上实现2.20×加速（WorldCache为1.68×），WorldScore静态65.44（vs 63.68）、动态45.82（vs 44.72）。3D重建任务上，Aether-5B实现3.45×加速（WorldCache为2.61×），深度估计Abs Rel从0.341降至0.331，相机位姿ATE从0.184降至0.179。GPU显存开销几乎不变（~50GB vs ~50.44GB）。消融实验验证了秩r=128、最大缓存间隔N=4、缩放因子γ=1.1和误差阈值τ=1.0为最优设置，方法对超参数具有较好鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SpectralCache通过挖掘扩散特征底层频谱结构的时间冗余，为加速扩散型世界模型提供了一种新视角。其免训练特性、低额外开销（约0.1GB缓存，仅占模型0.2%；SVD分解仅82ms vs 全DiT计算的17942ms）使其易于实际部署。该工作揭示了世界模型特征的强低秩性、子空间稳定性以及奇异值可预测演化等有趣性质，为理解和利用扩散模型中的时间冗余开辟了新的研究方向。

title: An Explainable Header-Centric Framework for Large-Scale Semantic Table Interpretation and Data Quality Assessment
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, Workshop on Quality of Knowledge Graphs at ESWC 2026, May 11, 2026, Dubrovnik, Croatia
summary: Knowledge Graph (KG) quality depends not only on downstream graph validation, but also on the quality of tabular metadata used before integration. In metadata-only Semantic Table Interpretation (STI), where cell values are unavailable, noisy, or unsuitable, column headers become a critical source of semantic evidence for traceable KG preparation. We present an explainable, header-centric framework for metadata-only Column Type Annotation (CTA) and Data Quality Assessment (DQA). The framework maps headers to 39 interpretable FinalFormat types using curated lexical resources and preserves token-level traceability through SourceKeywords. Each assigned type activates validation rules based on a taxonomy of Data Quality Issues (DQIs), producing detections such as missing data, duplicates, domain violations, wrong data type, and temporal mismatch. These detections are aggregated into HeadersIQ, a lightweight, unweighted data source-level quality metric. The framework was evaluated across heterogeneous benchmarks, including UCI, Prague, Kaggle, VizNet/Sato, SOTAB, T2Dv2, and the SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG track, comprising around 120,000 header columns. The results show broad practical coverage across noisy real-world metadata, while a parallel KG-mapping pathway supports alignment to DBpedia and this http URL . On the SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG track, the official GT-strict evaluation was modest. However, a blinded diagnostic audit indicates that many mismatches reflect benchmark granularity, aliasing, and ontology-selection effects rather than wholly implausible header-centric predictions. We report this audit as diagnostic evidence on disagreement patterns, not as revised benchmark performance. Overall, the paper presents a reusable workflow for metadata-driven semantic annotation, data source-level quality monitoring, and KG-oriented benchmark diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可解释的、基于表头的框架，用于仅依赖元数据的语义表解释(STI)与数据质量评估(DQA)。该框架通过规范化、缩写扩展和策划词典将列头映射到39种FinalFormat类型，并通过SourceKeyword保留token级可追溯性。每种类型激活基于DQI分类法的验证规则，检测结果聚合成轻量级的数据源级质量指标HeadersIQ。在约12万个表头列上的大规模评估显示，该框架在嘈杂的真实世界元数据中具有广泛的覆盖能力，并支持与DBpedia和Schema.org的知识图谱对齐。在SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG轨道上，官方GT-strict评估结果中等，但盲法诊断审计表明许多不匹配反映的是基准粒度、别名和本体选择效应，而非完全不可信的预测。总体而言，该框架为元数据驱动的语义注释、数据源级质量监控和KG导向的基准诊断提供了可重用工作流。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱质量不仅取决于下游图谱验证，还取决于集成前使用的表格元数据质量。在仅元数据的语义表解释场景中（单元格值不可用、嘈杂或不适合使用），列头成为可追溯KG准备的关键语义证据来源。Sherlock(2019)等早期研究曾对基于表头的方法提出质疑，认为其类型覆盖有限且对嘈杂数据缺乏鲁棒性。然而，近期的SemTab挑战赛和Liu等人(2023)的综述表明表头信号在现代CTA系统中正被越来越多地利用，特别是在SemTab 2024引入的Metadata-to-KG赛道中，单元格值不可用，这凸显了元数据驱动方法的重要性。
AI.method: 该框架采用以表头为中心的工作流：(1)通过策划的词典和缩写词典对表头进行规范化和扩展；(2)通过确定性基于规则的匹配将表头映射到39种FinalFormat类型，记录SourceKeyword以保持可追溯性；(3)每个分配的FinalFormat类型激活基于DQI分类法（22种数据质量问题）的预定义验证规则；(4)检测结果聚合成HeadersIQ，一个轻量级的0-100分数据源级质量指标；(5)并行KG映射路径将预处理后的表头与DBpedia和Schema.org对齐。词典通过NIL分析反馈循环持续增长。
AI.result: 在约12万表头列（包括UCI、Prague、Kaggle、VizNet/Sato、SOTAB、T2Dv2和SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG）的评估中，FinalFormat在Sato上达到100%有效覆盖率，在VizNet和Kaggle上达到85-87%。在SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG轨道上，Hit@1=0.45，Hit@5=0.48，但盲法诊断审计显示考虑基准粒度问题后，支持率可达0.79。NIL分析显示约13%的表头无法匹配，其中大部分为无语义信息短代码。案例研究表明，标识符语义同时触发完整性和唯一性约束，有界数值格式暴露域违规。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的可解释表头中心框架为仅元数据语义类型注释、数据源级质量监控和KG导向基准诊断提供了可重用且可审计的工作流。该框架在大规模嘈杂元数据条件下展示了广泛的实际覆盖能力，挑战了Sherlock关于表头方法不可靠的观点。诊断审计揭示了SemTab 2024基准的局限性，支持未来CTA基准采用多标签或分级评估以及人机协同验证。该框架定位为元数据驱动语义注释、质量感知表格准备和可信知识图谱生态系统建设的实用贡献。未来工作包括统计审计、多语言模型集成和基于LLM的歧义消解。

title: Omnisolver: An extensible interface to Ising spin-glass and QUBO solvers: adding a distributed GPU brute-force plugin
summary: This software update extends Omnisolver with \texttt{omnisolver-bruteforce}, a first-class plugin for exact exhaustive search of QUBO and Ising instances on CUDA-enabled GPUs. The update contributes three components: packaging of the single-GPU brute-force kernel of [Computer Physics Communications 260, 107728, 2021] as a first-class Omnisolver plugin with a uniform Python and CLI interface, a Ray-based distributed framework that splits the search into $2^{k}$ fixed-variable subproblems and dispatches them across multiple GPUs and hosts, with a controller that gathers and merges partial results, and numerical stabilization of the fast \texttt{float32} ground-state path through compensated incremental updates, periodic exact energy re-anchoring, and best-buffer refresh. Stabilization activates automatically for $N \geq 40$ leaving the public sampler API is unchanged. On dense random Ising instances we measure exhaustive solve times up to $N=60$ on $8\times$ NVIDIA H100 (96 GB) GPUs, reaching $\approx\!3.15$ days at $N=60$ in close agreement with the empirical $t_{N+1}=2\,t_N$ doubling rule, with the distributed sampler reaching the full $\approx\!8\times$ speedup over a single H100 from $N\!\gtrsim\!44$ onwards. The plugin thereby serves as a practical ground-truth oracle for state-of-the-art classical heuristics such as the Simulated Bifurcation Machine.

AI.tldr: 该论文是 Omnisolver 框架的软件更新，新增 omnisolver-bruteforce 插件，将单 GPU 暴力求解器包装为标准插件，并扩展为基于 Ray 的多 GPU/多节点分布式版本，同时修复了 float32 快速路径在 N≥40 时的数值漂移问题。在 8 块 H100 GPU 上实现了 N=60 稠密随机 Ising 实例的穷举求解（约 3.15 天），验证了 t_{N+1}=2 t_N 的指数倍增规律，并从 N≳44 起获得 ≈8 倍的近线性加速。该插件主要作为启发式方法（如模拟分岔机 SBM）的真值基准验证工具。
AI.motivation: QUBO/Ising 问题的基态能量是评估启发式算法（如模拟分岔机 SBM）和声称量子优势工作的关键基准。现有单 GPU 暴力求解器在 N≥40 时出现 float32 数值漂移且无法扩展到多 GPU，因此需要一个稳定、可扩展且符合 Omnisolver 统一接口的穷举验证后端，为经典启发式方法和 NISQ 量子算法提供认证基态真值。
AI.method: 1）将既有单 GPU CUDA 暴力核（Computer Physics Communications 260, 107728, 2021）包装为 omnisolver-bruteforce 插件，提供统一 Python/CLI 接口并返回 dimod.SampleSet；2）基于 Ray 构建分布式控制器，将搜索空间按 k 个固定变量分解为 2^k 个独立子问题分派到多 GPU/多主机上的工作节点，由控制器汇总合并部分结果；3）对 float32 快速基态路径引入补偿式增量更新、定期精确能量重新锚定和最优解缓冲刷新，自动在 N≥40 时启动以消除累积舍入误差；4）使用全连接随机 Ising 实例 (J_ij, h_i ~ U[-1,1]) 在 8×H100(96GB) 上基准测试。
AI.result: 单 GPU 采样器实测至 N=54，分布式采样器实测至 N=60。N=60 在 8×H100 上耗时约 272,300 秒（≈3.15 天），与从 N=58 按 t_{N+1}=2 t_N 倍增规则外推的 271,600 秒相差仅 0.3%。分布式采样器在 N≈44 之后达到相对于单卡的 ≈8 倍完全加速，比单卡在 N=40–42 区间出现交叉；外推显示 N=64 约需 50 天、SBM 在 N=56/58/60 上返回的能量与穷举真值在 6×10^{-6} 内一致且自旋构型比特相同。
AI.conclusion: 该更新在不改变公共 API 的前提下，将单 GPU 暴力核提升为具有分布式多 GPU 能力和数值稳定性的 Omnisolver 一级插件，实测 N=60 随机 Ising 实例的穷举基态认证，并经验性地确立了 t_{N+1}=2 t_N 倍增律；该工具适合作为启发式/NISQ 算法的真值基准而非生产级求解器。后续工作包括暴露锚定策略为可调参数、引入分层归约以扩展到 2^k 工作节点、以及发布可复现性封装。

title: A Modular Event-Driven Software Architecture for Open-Source Industrial IoT Edge Gateways
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures, 1 table, 1 function, accepted paper on the 24th IEEE International Conference on Industrial Informatics (INDIN), 26-29 July, 2026, Melbourne, Australia
summary: Integrating legacy industrial machinery into modern cloud infrastructures poses a significant software engineering challenge. Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) deployments frequently rely on rigid and proprietary edge controllers that require extensive manual configuration. Open-source single-board computers (SBCs) offer a highly adaptable hardware alternative, but they still lack standardized software deployment frameworks capable of bridging localized serial protocols with global cloud environments. In this paper, we present a modular event-driven software architecture designed specifically for open-source IIoT edge gateways. We built a containerized web stack to provide a unified architecture that abstracts the complexities of Modbus-to-MQTT protocol translation, enabling rapid configuration of telemetry streams to cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) IoT. Furthermore, we designed a localized event engine that processes conditional logic directly at the edge layer, which significantly reducing network latency. The proposed architecture is preliminarily deployed and validated on an industrial-grade Raspberry Pi Compute Module 4 (CM4) to investigate its robustness, scalability and user-friendliness. Experimental results demonstrate a substantial reduction in system integration time and high operational stability, thus establishing a robust software foundation for real-time edge-based industrial automation. This paper contributes to extending the lifespan of legacy machinery by enabling seamless integration with modern industrial infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向开源工业物联网（IIoT）边缘网关的模块化、事件驱动软件架构，通过容器化Web技术栈抽象Modbus-to-MQTT协议转换，并在边缘层实现本地化阈值判定，显著降低集成延迟与部署复杂度。
AI.motivation: 传统工业边缘控制器多为闭源专有方案，成本高、灵活性差，且依赖大量手工脚本配置，阻碍了中小企业（SMB）的数字化转型。开源单板计算机（SBC）虽提供了硬件替代方案，但缺乏标准化的软件部署框架，难以桥接传统串行协议（Modbus）与云端协议（MQTT），同时简单的云端阈值判断会引入不必要延迟。
AI.method: 1. **硬件基础**：采用集成Raspberry Pi CM4的工业级IRIV PiControl控制器，具备隔离RS-485、双千兆以太网及NVMe存储。2. **软件架构**：分为边缘硬件接口、应用中间件（Node.js + Express + MongoDB + React.js）、云编排层（MQTT/AWS IoT）三层。3. **协议转换**：Node.js轮询引擎通过Modbus RTU读取寄存器，解码后封装为JSON经MQTT上行发布；云端指令经MQTT订阅后转化为Modbus写命令下行。4. **本地事件引擎**：定义分段阈值函数 $A(S_t)$，边缘端实时评估上下限并直接触发GPIO数字输出。5. **Web GUI配置**：通过响应式Web仪表盘完成IP、寄存器映射、TLS 1.2安全连接的可视化配置。
AI.result: 在IRIV PiControl上验证：Node.js异步后端维持连续Modbus轮询与AWS IoT JSON发布无丢包；ARM Cortex-A72 CPU负载低，预留充足算力；传统命令行配置需数小时专家工时，而统一RESTful API与图形界面可将裸金属到云遥测的整条数据流水线配置时间大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: 该架构为实时边缘工业自动化奠定了坚实的软件基础，有效延长了传统设备生命周期。但仍存在两方面局限：依赖RS-485限制远程分布式部署的可扩展性；仅支持Modbus-MQTT转换，协议互操作性不足。未来工作包括扩展LoRa/4G/5G无线模块、强化容器化安全机制，并结合大语言模型代理自动化协议实现分布式边缘网关的水平扩展与协同决策。

title: Interpretable Memory Models for Spaced Repetition
comment: Also available on Zenodo: doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22727106
summary: Spaced repetition software schedules reviews with a memory model fit to review logs. Accuracy on a test set is not sufficient evidence of quality since available data are produced by existing schedulers, and new solutions must extrapolate beyond them. A model also needs a simple mechanistic interpretation. We present SBD, a model that is more interpretable and 80% smaller than the current state of the art at nearly the same accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 SBD 记忆模型，用于间隔重复软件。该模型仅含 7 个参数（较 FSRS-7 减少 80%），具备清晰的机制可解释性，预测精度接近当前最优模型 FSRS-7，并可直接用于解析式规划求解调度问题。
AI.motivation: 间隔重复领域的当前最优模型（如 FSRS-7，含 34 个参数）虽精度高，但参数量大、缺乏机制层面的可解释性，且由于训练数据受限于既有调度器所选区间（Lucas 批判），测试集精度不足以证明模型的真实泛化能力。因此需要一种兼顾简洁性与可解释性、且便于规划优化的记忆模型。
AI.method: 提出 SBD（Stability-Brittleness-Difficulty）三状态变量记忆模型，含 7 个权重。模型基于 Gamma frailty 框架推导遗忘曲线（公式 3），其中年龄 a 受幂律压缩（公式 1）并含虚拟年龄修复项；评分更新稳定性（公式 4）、脆性（公式 6）和难度（公式 7）。其二元版本（SBD Binary）使状态更新自包含，可直接用于规划。在调度层面，推导出无限视野折扣 Bellman 方程的闭式解，以及基于 Whittle 松弛的索引策略以应对每日预算约束。
AI.result: 在 anki-revlogs-10k 数据集上：微调后，SBD 的 BCE 和 AUC 比 FSRS-7 低约 1%，RMSE(bins) 低约 3%；仅预训练时，BCE/AUC 差距更小，且 SBD 的 RMSE(bins) 反超 FSRS-7 约 2%。SBD 参数量仅为 FSRS-7 的 20%。规划实验表明，在该模型下 Bellman 方程可通过值迭代直接求解，索引策略在 restless bandit 框架下近乎最优。
AI.conclusion: SBD 在精度损失极小的前提下大幅提升了可解释性与简洁性，其结构与机制直接对应心理学概念（遗忘、修复、难度），每个权重都有明确含义；同时支持高效的解析规划，有助于突破 Lucas 批判带来的泛化瓶颈。未来工作应通过在线 A/B 测试进一步验证，但该测试在间隔重复文献中尚属空白。

title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Coherent Enterprise Data via Scalable Agent-System Interaction
summary: Tool-calling agents have become central to enterprise AI, yet training and evaluating them at scale remains severely constrained due to business and legal restrictions on enterprise systems, data, and database schemas. Tabular data synthesis offers a natural alternative, but its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by structural validity and schema availability, while procedure-based approaches yield the opposite weakness, typically lacking distributional fidelity without per-domain authoring. We introduce **Synthesis Through Simulation** (STS), a **schema--free** data synthesis paradigm in which an LLM agent generates data by executing operations against policy-enforcing APIs within simulated enterprise environments. Because data is generated through the same environment that defines what is valid, STS guarantees structural validity by construction while decoupling validity enforcement from distribution modeling, allowing each to be addressed independently. The **Generalist Populator** (GP), STS's domain-agnostic agent, addresses the remaining challenges of distributional fidelity and synthesis scalability: GP achieves **0.88** average marginal fidelity and **100\% constraint satisfaction** across all ten environments *without access to DB schemas*, while statistical synthesizers are inapplicable to seven due to necessary seed data requirements, and schema-privileged agents fail 82\% of trajectories on airline environment's tightly coupled workflows due to brittle task composition. We open-source the full framework, all ten environments, and generated datasets at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出合成通过模拟（STS）范式与通用填充器（GP），通过让LLM智能体在模拟企业环境中调用API来生成企业数据，从而在构造上保证结构有效性。GP无需数据库schema或领域专属配置，在十个企业环境中实现VPR=1.0和0.88的平均边缘保真度，显著优于统计合成器与schema特权基线。
AI.motivation: 企业级工具调用智能体的训练与评估受限于隐私法规、专有schema和真实数据库访问困难。现有表格数据合成方法（CTGAN/TVAE/HMA/REaLTabFormer）缺乏冷启动能力、无法强制关系约束；过程式方法分布保真度差且需逐域手工编写。亟需一种无需种子数据或schema、即可同时保证结构有效性与分布保真度的合成范式。
AI.method: 1）形式化问题：将企业数据合成分解为结构有效性、分布保真度、可扩展性三轴。2）提出STS范式：让LLM智能体通过策略执行API生成数据，由API层保证结构有效性（命题1证明VPR=1）。3）实现GP（Generalist Populator）：仅依赖工具注册表的零配置智能体，外层循环N条轨迹，每条轨迹经历Explore（构建实体依赖图与操作权重，K次后停止）、Plan（基于manifest生成目标属性任务描述）、Execute（执行任务并提取启发式策略）三阶段，使用持久化ExplorationManifest作为长期记忆。4）评估指标：基于JSD的边缘（MDF）、配对（PDF）、跨表（CDF）分布保真度，加VPR与WO。
AI.result: 1）在全部10个企业环境中实现VPR=1.0，平均MDF=0.88。2）5个环境MDF>0.93，Airline/IT Mgmt最高（MDF≈0.97，PDF≈0.90，CDF≈0.95）。3）统计合成器因无种子数据在7/10环境不可用；EnvScaler在Airline上82%轨迹零写入。4）Plan阶段消融：去plan后MDF/PDF/CDF各降~0.06-0.07，round-trip比例从52.5%跌至7.9%。5）启发式提取消融：Banking WO降33%，Airline Calls/WO+96%。6）K=3为探索预算最优。7）下游：在STS填充环境上做SFT的Qwen2.5-7B在τ²-bench airline上pass@k提升0.214（相对基线）、0.125（相对种子数据SFT）。8）混淆语义变量后MDF/PDF/CDF几乎不变（GED_norm=0.154）。
AI.conclusion: STS通过将结构有效性解耦并交由API执行层保证，GP在零配置条件下实现了可与schema特权基线匹敌的分布保真度，并有效支持下游智能体训练。局限性包括：依赖LLM世界知识估计任务类型先验、需API完整编码业务规则、不适用于非结构化内容与概率性执行。开源了全部框架、十个环境与生成数据集。

title: Diffu-LoRA: A Novel Low-Rank Adaptation for Personalized Diffusion Models
summary: Personalizing text-to-image diffusion models from a few reference images requires preserving subject identity while following prompts that describe new contexts. Full-model fine-tuning is parameter-intensive, whereas low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces the number of trainable parameters but leaves open how adaptation capacity should be distributed across layers. We introduce Diffu-LoRA, a parameter-efficient method that learns this allocation through gated low-rank adaptation. Diffu-LoRA inserts trainable low-rank components into the linear layers of Transformer blocks and assigns a learnable gate to each component. Bilevel optimization updates the adaptation weights and gate parameters on separate data splits, while progressive pruning removes components with the lowest gate values to meet a prescribed rank budget. This procedure allocates adaptation capacity nonuniformly across layers while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen. Experiments with Stable Diffusion on subjects from DreamBooth and additional collected datasets show improved overall subject fidelity and prompt alignment relative to the evaluated fine-tuning baselines. Ablation studies examine the contributions of bilevel optimization, progressive pruning, and adapter placement. These results support learned rank allocation as a practical approach to parameter-efficient diffusion model personalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Diffu-LoRA，一种用于文本到图像扩散模型个性化的高参数效率微调方法，通过带门控的低秩适配学习在Transformer各层间非均匀分配适配容量（结合双层优化和渐进剪枝），在保持预训练骨干冻结的同时提升主体保真度和提示对齐。
AI.motivation: 基于少量参考图像对扩散模型进行个性化时，面临在保持主体身份和遵循新场景提示之间的权衡。全模型微调参数开销大，而标准LoRA虽减少可训练参数但未解决适配容量在层间应如何分配的问题，因此需要一种能自动学习层级秩分配的高效个性化方法。
AI.method: Diffu-LoRA方法核心：1）在Transformer块的线性层中插入可训练低秩分量；2）为每个低秩分量分配可学习门控值；3）采用双层优化（bilevel optimization）在不同数据划分上分别更新适配权重和门控参数；4）通过渐进剪枝（progressive pruning）依据门控值移除不重要的分量以满足预设的秩预算；5）全程冻结预训练骨干网络。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion上针对DreamBooth数据集及额外收集数据集的实验表明，Diffu-LoRA在主体保真度（subject fidelity）和提示对齐（prompt alignment）整体上优于所对比的微调基线方法；消融实验验证了双层优化、渐进剪枝和适配器放置位置各自对性能的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持将"学习式秩分配"（learned rank allocation）作为扩散模型参数高效个性化的一种实用方法，Diffu-LoRA通过门控机制、双层优化与渐进剪枝的结合实现层级适配容量的非均匀分配。

title: Freeze the Decoder, Heal the Encoder: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for SVD-Based KV-Cache Compression
summary: Comparing parameter-efficient fine-tuning recipes under a single, shared learning rate is a common but flawed practice: when the arms being compared have very different trainable-parameter counts, a shared rate can simultaneously depress the larger arms' means and inflate their variance, manufacturing a large, seemingly multi-seed-significant advantage for the smallest arm that is not a real effect. We document this confound in a concrete setting: post-hoc SVD-based KV-cache compression, where an already-pretrained model is converted to a low-rank (multi-head-latent-attention-style) cache by factorizing its key/value weights into a down-projection ("encoder") and an up-projection ("decoder"), after which a short fine-tune ("healing") recovers the accuracy lost to truncation. Under a shared learning rate, freezing the decoder and healing only the encoder looks like a clear win over healing the decoder or both factors; once every arm is given its own tuned learning rate, that apparent advantage disappears, and encoder-only healing instead reaches parity with the alternatives, at a real, measured saving of 3x fewer trainable parameters and 3x less optimizer-state memory. We verify this parity with per-arm learning-rate tuning and three seeds per configuration on a vision-language model (Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct), at the one compression ratio this protocol covers, and replicate it on a text-only testbed across two backbones. Encoder-only healing is therefore a lower-memory drop-in recipe for retrofitting low-rank KV-cache compression at training time, and the shared-learning-rate pitfall we document and correct is a cautionary result for comparing any fine-tuning recipes whose arms differ in trainable-parameter count.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出在比较参数高效微调方法时使用共享学习率是一种常见但有缺陷的做法,并在SVD-based KV-cache压缩场景下具体展示了这种缺陷。文章发现encoder-only healing(冻结解码器,只微调编码器)在恰当的per-arm学习率调优下,能达到与decoder-only或full healing相当的准确率,同时减少3倍的训练参数和优化器状态内存。
AI.motivation: 长上下文场景下KV cache占用主导内存,尤其对多模态模型更为严重。现有后置SVD-based低秩KV cache压缩方法(如TransMLA、MHA2MLA、CARE)在SVD分解后同时微调解码器和编码器两种因子,但没有回答哪个因子真正需要微调。此外,作者指出在参数数量差异显著的微调方法间使用共享学习率进行比较是一种有缺陷的方法论实践,会人为制造偏差。
AI.method: 1. SVD分解方法:将预训练模型的K/V权重堆叠后做SVD,截断到秩r=d_c,获得编码器W_dkv和上采样解码器W_uk, W_uv。2. 三种healing模式比较:encoder-only(冻结解码器,只训练编码器,1/3参数)、decoder-only(冻结编码器,只训练解码器,2/3参数)、full(同时训练两者,基线)。3. 关键方法论:对每个arm分别进行per-arm学习率调优,使用3 seeds每配置,在Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct多模态模型上评估MME和TextVQA,在OpenLLaMA-7B和Qwen2.5-7B文本模型上评估6个零样本任务。4. 还在encoder-only框架内测试了plain SVD初始化与activation-whitened SVD初始化的对比。
AI.result: 1. 核心方法论发现:共享学习率下encoder-only看似显著优于其他两种(decoder-only MME Cognition标准差从±97.8降至调优后的±13.8,几乎30倍减少),但这完全是共享学习率人为制造的偏差,真实差异不显著。2. Encoder-only healing在per-arm调优后在多模态上达到uncompressed baseline的98-100%,与full/decoder-only healing相当,但训练参数减少3倍(优化器状态从1.72 GiB降至0.57 GiB)。3. 文本测试中同样验证parity结果(Qwen2.5-7B三个arm间差距仅0.33分,最大|t|=1.67 vs 临界值2.78)。4. Whitened SVD初始化在encoder-only框架下表现不如plain init(差距7-20点)。5. d_c=1024(2×压缩)下encoder-only仍保持唯一最佳,差距8-33%。6. 每轮训练时间差异仅约3.5%,因为frozen decoder仍需反向传播传递梯度。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出两个层面的结论:(1) 实践层面,encoder-only healing是后置SVD-based低秩KV cache压缩的参数高效替代方案,在3倍参数和优化器状态内存节省下保持精度一致。(2) 方法论层面,在参数数量不同的微调方法间使用共享学习率会造成系统性偏差——既压低大arm的均值又扩大其方差,即使多seed重复实验也不能防御这种confound。作者认为这对于任何参数高效微调方法的比较都是警示性结论。未来工作包括在更激进压缩比下重复多模态对比、结合GQA头分组压缩、以及对encoder本身再做低秩参数化。

title: GaussianBench: Physics-Fidelity Evaluation for Gaussian Scene Representations
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting has evolved from static reconstruction toward physics-integrated representations meant to predict how scenes change under interaction. This creates an evaluation problem: a rollout can look plausible while relying on incorrect internal mechanics, and visual agreement with observed motion does not establish a correct response to a new force, material edit, contact, or thermal intervention. We introduce GaussianBench, a physics-fidelity evaluation suite for physics-integrated Gaussian scene representations. It uses frozen file-based scenes, simulator-independent scorers, and analytical or measured references. The benchmark tests conservation, continuum response, heterogeneous-material coupling, Gaussian covariance transport and rendering, thermal phase change, and counterfactual response. Each reference declares its regime of validity, and outcomes distinguish PASS, FAIL, NA, and INVALID, separating physical failures from unsupported capabilities and invalid comparisons. We also provide GaussianFlesh, a thermomechanical reference entrant in which persistent 3D Gaussians act as both rendering primitives and continuum material points, advanced by a shared-grid MPM solver with per-particle constitutive dispatch and persistent thermal and phase state. We evaluate six released external systems: PhysGaussian, GaussianFluent, OmniPhysGS, PhysDreamer, Physics3D, and GASP. Testing every system the same way reveals failures that their original evaluations missed: a system can simulate a single material correctly but fail where two materials meet, or update its Gaussians correctly for a deformation it never produced. Matched faults and tolerance audits confirm these distinctions arise from the intended tests. Physics-integrated Gaussian systems must therefore be tested on their internal physical state, not just on whether their rollouts look plausible.

AI.tldr: GaussianBench是一个针对物理集成3D高斯溅射系统的物理保真度评估基准，包含冻结场景、与模拟器无关的评分器和分析/测量参考，通过四个协议（A/B/C/M）分别测试守恒、连续介质响应、异质材料耦合、高斯协方差传输与渲染、热相变和反事实响应。配套的GaussianFlesh参考实现使用共享网格UL-MLS-MPM求解器，验证了6个外部系统在双材料耦合、动量守恒和协方差传输等方面存在的物理保真度缺陷。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯溅射技术正从静态重建向物理集成表示发展，但现有评估主要基于视觉相似性，无法验证系统是否真正满足物理契约——视觉上合理的滚动可能基于错误的内部力学。论文指出当这些系统被用于反事实场景模拟时，需要类似物理仿真那样的严格评估。
AI.method: GaussianBench采用四协议评估框架：协议A（基础物理：动量守恒、欧拉-伯努梁频率、应力波速、泊松收缩、自由落体、熔融锋面）；协议B（关系与干预：双材料棒的应变与界面牵引反事实测试）；协议C（高斯表示状态：协方差传输Σ' = FΣ₀F⊤、渲染往返、状态健康）；协议M（ASTM D412橡胶材料验证）。每场景使用冻结JSON清单、纯函数评分器，分析参考、声明的适用范围以及pass/fail/na/invalid四态输出。参考实现GaussianFlesh使用共享网格APIC UL-MLS-MPM求解器，每粒子根据材料ID调度固定相关弹性/Hencky J2金属/Drucker-Prager粘土/弱弹性压缩熔融等本构分支，协方差通过变形梯度前推更新。
AI.result: 对PhysGaussian、GaussianFluent、OmniPhysGS、PhysDreamer、Physics3D和GASP六个外部系统（broad profiles）进行47个场景评估，发现：四个系统存在至少一项非精度物理契约失败；OmniPhysGS和PhysDreamer在双材料B1测试中区域应变误差达105%，界面牵引差异达55%；GaussianFluent通过泊松测试但守恒/梁/波测试均失败；所有MPM系统均未通过A1a严格单精度守恒阈值（视为数值诊断）。对抗性评分器审计验证了协方差冻结故障将transport从pass转为fail而kinematics不变；容差敏感性分析显示在2×容差下零判决改变。GaussianFlesh通过B1双材料测试（9.1%/7.8%区域应变误差，1.43%界面牵引误差）和热干预测试（400K→370K熔融速率预测误差0.24%），M1 ASTM D412橡胶验证中位数误差5.4%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉可信的渲染运动不等同于物理正确性，物理集成高斯系统需要在状态级别进行诊断而非仅靠视觉保真度。GaussianBench的四大贡献——诊断能力（区分运动错误vs本构错误vs协方差错误vs数值问题）、可审计协议、对照故障验证和容忍度鲁棒性——使其成为评估此类系统物理行为的标准方法，代码、冻结场景、适配器和评估报告均已开源。

title: LIFT: A Lifecycle-aware Interaction Factorization Transformer for Unified Retrieval and Ranking
summary: Cascaded recommender systems use the same user history for retrieval and ranking, while the two stages have access to different information at different points of an interaction. We propose the Lifecycle-aware Interaction Factorization Transformer (LIFT), which decomposes each interaction into ordered Request, Item, Context, and Action states and models them as a causal sequence. Retrieval reads the Request state, while ranking reads the Context state, allowing both tasks to share history modeling while preserving stage-specific information. LIFT instantiates this representation with Role-Conditioned Attention and a lightweight Pre-LN Bias. On ML-20M and Taobao, LIFT achieves the highest Joint Score among the evaluated joint models, improving over the strongest baselines by 4.9% and 3.6%, respectively. Loss-weight sweeps show favorable retrieval--ranking trade-offs, while ablations and scaling analyses further examine lifecycle sequence construction, model components, and capacity settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LIFT（Lifecycle-aware Interaction Factorization Transformer），将推荐级联中的每次交互分解为Request、Item、Context、Action四个有序状态并建模为因果序列，使检索阶段读取Request状态、排序阶段读取Context状态，从而在共享历史编码的同时保留阶段特定信息。在ML-20M和淘宝数据集上，LIFT的联合分数（Joint Score）相比最强基线分别提升4.9%和3.6%。
AI.motivation: 在级联推荐系统中，检索和排序阶段使用相同的用户历史，但在一个交互内部可用的信息不同（排序时已有候选Item及其上下文）。现有统一模型通常将整个交互表示为单一状态，掩盖了交互内部的信息可用性边界，因此无法在共享历史建模的同时区分两阶段所需的不同表征。
AI.method: LIFT将每个交互分解为有序的Request→Item→Context→Action四种角色token，序列化为因果序列。共享因果Transformer中：1)Role-Conditioned Attention（Query/Key投影共享、Value和Output投影按源/接收角色条件化）；2)轻量级Pre-LN Bias对FFN路径按角色加偏置。检索读Request状态、排序读Context状态；在线服务通过一次性prefill和KV缓存复用历史编码。
AI.result: 在ML-20M上LIFT的Joint Score达0.2724（较HSTU提升4.9%，R@100=0.3361、N@100=0.0981、AUC=0.8496、GAUC=0.7565），在淘宝上达0.2239（较UniPinRec提升3.6%，R@100=0.1885、N@100=0.0582、AUC=0.9127、GAUC=0.8612）。损失权重扫描显示LIFT在所有帕累托前沿上占优；消融实验表明4种token粒度全分解的[R][I][C][A]序列优于合并的[RICA]及插入空白token的方案；容量扩展上LIFT（d=64）即超过UniPinRec（d=256），且训练时间减少32.1%、显存从7.16GB降至5.50GB。
AI.conclusion: 通过在交互内部沿信息可用性边界进行因子分解，LIFT能以统一的因果历史编码同时支持检索和排序的阶段特定读出。Role-Conditioned Attention与Pre-LN Bias组件互补，token边界与信息可用阶段对齐对性能至关重要；该框架在共享历史建模与阶段表征保持之间取得了有效平衡。

title: Strategic Governance of AI Models in Earth Science
summary: AI foundation models pretrained on weather and climate data are increasingly fine-tuned to Earth science tasks well beyond weather forecasting. Their development and adoption are outpacing the scientific community's ability to evaluate them. These models are judged almost entirely by benchmark skill metrics, which measure how closely a forecast reproduces a reference product but not whether a model represents the physical processes governing the system it predicts. Forecast skill and physical reliability are therefore distinct properties. The distinction is most consequential under the nonstationary conditions of a changing climate for which these models were never trained. We identify five priorities for the physical evaluation of AI models in Earth science from task-specific emulators to foundation models, spanning training data, fine-tuning, behavioral testing, mechanistic interpretability, and output validation. We recommend three activities for the coming decade: 1) open AI-ready evaluation datasets, 2) a shared reporting standard for physics-based evaluation, and 3) a dedicated research program on the safety of these models.

AI.tldr: 本文指出AI基础模型在地球科学中快速发展，但现有评估主要依赖基准技能指标，忽略了物理可靠性。作者区分了预测技能与物理可靠性，并提出五项物理评估优先事项和三项十年活动建议。
AI.motivation: AI模型在天气和气候预测中的应用日益广泛，但在气候变化引起的非平稳条件下，现有基于基准技能的评估方法不足以衡量模型对物理过程的真实表征能力，存在可靠性与安全性隐患。
AI.method: 论文提出一个系统性框架，涵盖五个物理评估优先事项：（1）训练数据、（3）经过训练的迭代/微调、（4）行为测试、（5）机械可解释性、（6）输出验证（原文标注序号）。并提出三项十年行动计划：开放AI就绪评估数据集、共享物理评估报告标准、专门的模型安全研究计划。
AI.result: 本文为观点/综述类论文，未呈现具体实验结果。其核心贡献在于明确区分"预测技能"与"物理可靠性"，并为AI Earth science模型提出从训练到输出的全链条物理评估路线图。
AI.conclusion: 在气候变化带来的非平稳条件下，AI Earth science模型必须接受超越基准技能的物理可靠性评估；社区应优先建设开放数据集、统一报告标准和专项安全研究，以确保模型在真实地球系统中的可信应用。

title: SLVR: Structured Latent Visual Reasoning via Human-like Reasoning Flows
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS this http URL page \href{ this https URL }
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often answer visual reasoning questions by relying on linguistic priors rather than task-relevant visual evidence. Textual chain-of-thought reasoning can partially mitigate this issue by encouraging models to decompose visual questions into intermediate evidence-seeking steps, but generating these steps autoregressively increases inference cost. Latent reasoning avoids explicit rationale generation, but existing approaches provide limited control over what intermediate states encode, making it difficult to impose separate supervision for planning, grounding, and evidence selection. We propose Structured Latent Visual Reasoning (SLVR), a training framework that bridges explicit chain-of-thought and latent reasoning by organizing multimodal reasoning into typed latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and reasoning integration. SLVR first trains the model to rely on the image by masking answer-revealing text and contrasting the correct answer with visually plausible distractors. It then organizes reasoning into latent stages for planning, grounding, evidence selection, and integration, supervising each stage with the corresponding signal: plans, boxes, visual evidence, and final rationales. This gives latent reasoning an explicit functional structure while avoiding generated textual chains at inference time. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, SLVR improves consistently across multimodal reasoning benchmarks, with absolute gains of +9.4 on MMVP and +14.2 on BLINK Relation, as well as improvements on V*, MathVista, and ChartQA. These results suggest that structured latent supervision can improve fine-grained visual reasoning without the decoding overhead of textual CoT. Project page is available \href{ this https URL }{here}.

AI.tldr: SLVR提出了一种结构化潜在视觉推理框架，通过将多模态推理组织为规划、定位、证据选择和推理整合四个类型化潜在阶段，结合视觉依赖诱导训练，有效提升多模态大模型的细粒度视觉推理能力，同时避免了显式思维链的解码开销。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉推理中常依赖语言先验而非任务相关视觉证据。显式思维链（CoT）虽能部分缓解此问题，但存在表征瓶颈（多模态信息离散化损失）和计算开销（自回归生成）两大局限。现有潜在推理方法虽然避免了显式推理生成，但对中间潜在状态的编码内容缺乏控制，难以对规划、定位和证据选择等不同功能阶段施加独立监督。
AI.method: SLVR包含两个互补组件：(1) 视觉依赖诱导（VDI）：通过遮蔽答案揭示文本并引入图像基础干扰项，采用对比训练迫使模型依赖视觉证据；(2) 结构化潜在视觉推理：使用特殊分隔符令牌将潜在空间划分为规划（<plan>）、定位（<box>）、证据选择（<evidence>）和推理整合（<reason>）四个类型化阶段，每个阶段通过状态特定对齐损失进行监督，对应目标分别为动作计划嵌入、边界框坐标、视觉补丁特征和完整推理嵌入。推理时无需生成文本链。
AI.result: 基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B的SLVR在多个多模态推理基准上表现一致提升：MMVP绝对增益+9.4，BLINK Relation +14.2，V* Overall +6.7，MathVista +9.7，ChartQA +3.4。在误导性文本上下文诊断测试中，SLVR达到70.7%的误导准确率（vs基线41.7%）和14.7%的标题跟随错误率（vs基线46.0%），展现出对文本捷径的强鲁棒性。消融实验验证了各组件的互补性和非对称潜在令牌分配（规划64，证据16，整合16）的最优性。
AI.conclusion: SLVR证明结构化潜在监督能够在不产生文本CoT解码开销的前提下，有效提升细粒度视觉推理能力，为更可靠的多模态推理提供了有前景的方向。该方法将显式CoT的结构化优势与潜在推理的效率优势相结合，通过功能化的潜在阶段设计解决了现有潜在推理方法缺乏结构的问题。

title: SPERA: Spherical Prior EEG Foundation Model with Geometry- and Frequency-Aware Latent Prediction
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive measure of ongoing neural activity, but building general-purpose EEG models remains challenging due to the heterogeneity of subjects, devices, and electrode montages. Existing EEG foundation models predominantly rely on reconstruction-based objectives defined on the observed signal, which contains both neural and non-neural components. We introduce SPERA (Spherical Prior EEG Representation Architecture), an EEG foundation model that adopts the joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) to predict in latent space. SPERA introduces a Legendre-polynomial spatial prior, incorporated into attention to encode varying scalp electrode geometries. Two further components adapt the model to EEG: factorized temporal and spatial attention interleaved with periodic full-attention blocks, and a relational spectral regularizer aligning latent similarity structure with spectral views. Pretrained on approximately 80,000 hours of EEG from 29,048 subjects across 106 datasets, SPERA achieves the highest average balanced accuracy across nine downstream tasks spanning clinical, cognitive, and BCI applications. SPERA further exhibits strong parameter efficiency under linear probing and robustness across varying recording conditions, suggesting its potential as a general-purpose backbone for diverse EEG analyses.

AI.tldr: SPERA is a general-purpose EEG foundation model pretrained on ~80,000 hours from 29,048 subjects across 106 datasets using JEPA latent-space prediction, achieving highest average balanced accuracy on nine downstream tasks via a Legendre-polynomial spherical geometry prior, hybrid factorized/full attention, and a relational spectral regularizer.
AI.motivation: EEG foundation models face three core challenges: (1) heterogeneity across subjects, devices, and electrode montages; (2) reliance on reconstruction-based objectives that entangle neural and non-neural (artifact) components; and (3) the need for geometry- and frequency-aware representations to handle arbitrary electrode configurations and exploit spectral structure. SPERA addresses these by adopting latent prediction rather than signal reconstruction, and by explicitly encoding spherical scalp geometry and spectral relational structure.
AI.method: SPERA is built on the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA). EEG recordings are tokenized into 1-second patches along time per channel; spatial and temporal masking are applied independently (semantic subsequence preserving for time, k-nearest-neighbor neighborhoods for space). The backbone is a hybrid of factorized (temporal-then-spatial) attention blocks interleaved with periodic full-attention blocks, with RoPE along time. A Legendre-polynomial spherical prior encodes pairwise electrode geometry as a learnable additive bias (used in factorized blocks) or as anchor-based geometry features injected into Q/K (used in full-attention blocks). A relational spectral regularizer (RSReg) aligns pairwise similarity of latent representations with that of log-power spectra via KL divergence, supervising relational—not absolute—spectral structure. Training uses AdamW with EMA teacher, cosine LR, and joint JEPA + RSReg loss.
AI.result: Across nine downstream tasks (clinical, cognitive, BCI), SPERA-Base (194M) achieves the highest average balanced accuracy (0.7502 under LPFT) versus the strongest baseline REVE-Base (0.7150), with significant gains on BCIC2020-3, TUEV, BCIC-IV-2a, ISRUC, and TUAB. Under LP, SPERA-Base (0.661) exceeds REVE-Large (0.648) at less than half the parameters, and SPERA-Large reaches 0.684. Ablations confirm the contribution of each component: Legendre prior outperforms coordinate embeddings, REVE's spatial encoding, and Gaussian geodesic bias (+0.024 avg); RSReg contributes +0.012 avg; periodic hybrid attention beats pure full or pure factorized variants. SPERA also exhibits superior data efficiency (surpassing REVE under few-shot LP) and better robustness to additive Gaussian noise and ocular artifacts than CBraMod and REVE-Base.
AI.conclusion: SPERA demonstrates that latent-space prediction (JEPA) combined with structure-aware inductive biases—a learnable Legendre spherical geometry prior, hybrid spatio-temporal attention, and a relational spectral regularizer—produces transferable EEG representations across heterogeneous montages, datasets, and tasks. The model achieves state-of-the-art average performance on nine downstream benchmarks with strong parameter efficiency, data efficiency, and noise robustness, supporting the combination of latent prediction, geometry-aware spatial modeling, and frequency-aware supervision as complementary components for general-purpose EEG representation learning. Limitations include scaling only to 396M parameters, surface-only spherical priors (i.e., not yet intracranial), evaluation restricted to fixed-length classification, and incomplete demographic metadata for fairness analysis.

title: A Survey on LLM-Integrated Hardware Design Verification
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being integrated into hardware verification to automate specification interpretation, verification-artifact generation, debugging, formal reasoning, and tool orchestration. This survey provides a systematic review of LLM-assisted hardware functional verification across SystemVerilog assertion generation, stimulus and testbench generation, bug localization and design repair, model checking and equivalence checking, SAT/SMT optimization, and emerging agentic verification workflows. We organize the literature by methodology, verification objective, tool interaction, benchmark, and evaluation criterion, and examine both inference-time techniques--including prompting, retrieval, structured reasoning, and agentic workflows--and training-time adaptation. Across these areas, a common pattern emerges: LLMs are most effective as semantic reasoning, search, and orchestration components embedded within verification-aware workflows, while simulators, formal engines, coverage tools, and solvers provide executable feedback and correctness evidence. However, tool acceptance alone does not establish verification correctness, since assertions, tests, repairs, or proofs may satisfy available checks without faithfully capturing the complete design intent. We therefore identify semantic alignment between specifications and verification evidence, scalable integration with deterministic tools, generalization to unseen designs, and rigorous evaluation of correctness, cost, robustness, and human effort as key challenges. Finally, we discuss emerging directions toward specification-centered, neuro-symbolic, and persistent agentic verification systems that combine LLM flexibility with independently checkable verification evidence.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇系统综述论文，全面回顾了大型语言模型（LLM）在硬件功能验证中的最新应用进展。论文从SystemVerilog断言生成、激励与测试平台生成、缺陷定位与设计修复、形式化验证（包括模型检查、等价性检查和SAT/SMT优化）以及智能体化验证工作流等多个维度组织现有文献，并按方法学、验证目标、工具交互、基准和评估标准进行分类比较。论文指出LLM最适合作为验证感知工作流中的语义推理、搜索和编排组件，而确定性工具（仿真器、形式引擎、覆盖率工具、SAT/SMT求解器）提供可执行反馈与正确性证据。未来方向包括以规范为中心、神经-符号融合、具有持久记忆的智能体验证系统。
AI.motivation: 硬件验证是IC设计过程中最昂贵、最耗资源的环节之一（占开发成本的60-70%），随着SoC设计复杂度持续提升，传统验证方法难以扩展。LLM因其能够解释规范、生成多样化硬件工件、并通过检索增强和智能体工作流与EDA工具交互的灵活性，为解决这一挑战提供了新途径。然而现有的EDA范围综述对验证部分覆盖不足，亟需一个针对LLM-硬件功能验证的系统性综述来整合该领域自2024年以来的快速发展。
AI.method: 该综述采用结构化文献分析方法：（1）将验证任务分为SVA生成、激励/测试平台生成、调试/修复、形式化验证（证明生成、模型检查、等价性检查、SAT/SMT优化）四大支柱；（2）按推理时方法（提示工程、检索增强、结构化推理、智能体工作流）和训练时方法（监督微调、偏好优化、领域适应）对技术分类；（3）通过多张对比表（Table I-VIII）系统比较代表性工作的方法、反馈机制、基准与关键局限；（4）按"提示与工具反馈"、"检索增强"、"模型适配"、"结构化与智能体推理"四个互补类别组织调试文献；（5）从正交维度分析评估方法，包括语法正确性、形式证明验证、覆盖率、突变测试和规范对齐。
AI.result: 该综述系统梳理了25篇以上的调试论文及SVA生成、测试平台生成、形式化验证等多领域代表性工作。关键发现包括：（1）从直接NL到SVA翻译向规范理解、设计接地、候选生成、验证与迭代优化方向演进；（2）测试平台生成从单次提示转向验证感知自动化，确定性结构（模板、IR、DSL）显著提升可信度；（3）形式化验证形成神经-符号融合范式——LLM负责语义推理，确定性引擎提供正确性反馈；（4）IC3-Evolve等方法可离线优化模型检查器启发式；（5）DeepRTL2在RTL等价性分类上达到68.1%准确率和72.3% F1分数；（6）多数评估指标（FPV、覆盖率、突变测试）仅证明与RTL的一致性，而非规范对齐。论文识别出语义对齐、可扩展集成、泛化能力、严格评估作为核心挑战，并提出自演进调试、规格-居中验证智能、可信基准等未来方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述得出四个跨领域结论：（1）LLM在硬件验证中的最佳定位是作为连接规范、设计工件、验证证据和确定性EDA工具的语义推理与编排层，而非替代验证算法；（2）闭合环路、验证接地的工作流日益重要，工具输出从验收信号演变为反馈信号；（3）通过工具有效≠完整验证，核心挑战是保持设计意图与验证证据的对齐；（4）未来方向是从一次性工件生成转向"以规范为中心的验证智能"，包括持久智能体、显式规范-工件可追溯性、跨设计经验积累和分级神经-符号工作流。最终目标是建立可信赖的人机协作，使LLM提供灵活推理与自动化的同时，由成熟EDA工具和工程判断保留正确性保证。

title: Agent-Controlled Forgetting for Tool-Using Agents: Reversible Context Curation in Practice
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure. Code and research artifacts: this https URL
summary: Tool-using agents repeatedly carry observations whose useful content can be much smaller than their original payload. We study agent-controlled forgetting: the acting model selects previously observed tool results, replaces each with a short note at its original position, and retains the exact original in a recoverable archive. A Python harness exposes batch archival and explicit recovery without task-specific model training, while protecting user instructions and assistant messages from these operations. In an exploratory OpenTelemetry debugging case followed by an unrelated implementation task, the method ended with 231,951 provider-reported prompt tokens versus 912,492 under retained history, used 50% fewer cumulative input tokens, and had an estimated API cost of USD 1.28-1.44 versus approximately USD 4.38. Both arms passed the two-case primary behavioral oracle; neither fully satisfied the follow-up evaluation. The method made more requests and took 17% longer. A contrasting application-development pair produced no context or cost saving, and an earlier continuation exhibited lower manually assessed quality despite reduced context. These observations demonstrate substantial resource savings in noisy tool-use trajectories and identify workload dependence as a central consideration for reversible context management.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了"智能体控制的遗忘"机制：让使用工具的智能体主动将已观察的工具结果替换为简短笔记，原文存档至可恢复的外部归档。中心案例显示75%的活跃上下文缩减和50%的累计输入降低，但存在工作负载依赖性。
AI.motivation: 工具调用智能体在处理观测结果时，许多原始负载远大于其有用信息量。研究者关注一个核心问题：哪些已检视的信息应继续占用智能体的活跃上下文，而非仅关注智能体能接收多少信息。当智能体无法更改产生观测的工具时，事后策展（post-exposure curation）成为减少重复输入和过时信息的关键。
AI.method: 设计了一个Python框架，提供两个核心操作：(1) `context_apply`：批量将选定的工具结果替换为笔记，原文连同稳定标识符存档至外部归档；(2) `context_recover`：按归档引用恢复原文作为新的工具结果附加到对话末尾。框架对批次进行原子性验证，保护用户/系统/助手消息不被编辑。当活跃请求文本达约40,000 token时注入临时运行提醒。通过提示工程引导模型主动策展，不需要任务特定训练。使用z-ai/glm-5.3-flash模型，进行了OpenTelemetry调试与任务切换、Planroom应用开发、Sphinx出版清单三组实验。
AI.result: OpenTelemetry中心案例中：方法组最终prompt为231,951 token（对照912,492，降75%），累计输入降低50%，估计API成本$1.28–1.44（对照约$4.38，降67–71%），但请求数增加且耗时延长17%。两组均通过两项主行为测试。Planroom对比组未产生上下文或成本节省（方法组最终prompt甚至多6%）。Sphinx试点中三个方法组session最终prompt均小于三个保留组session。一个早期浏览器延续任务中方法组节省63% token但人工评分从6/12降至4/12。
AI.conclusion: 可逆策展在高噪声工具调用轨迹中显著节省资源，但收益强烈依赖工作负载特性：当大部分观测结果保持相关，或后续工作较短时，额外提示与笔记开销可能抵消节省。精确归档保证了信息完整性，但笔记的语义充分性和质量保障仍有限制。论文明确指出：上下文缩减并不等于更强的推理能力，下一步需要与阈值触发的自动清理及学习型上下文管理器进行对照实验。

title: Wieszcz-XIX: A 3.1-Billion-Word Corpus of Pre-1918 Polish and Temporally Bounded Language Models Trained From Scratch
comment: 35 pages, 2 figures, 11 tables. Corpus: this https URL ; code: this https URL ; weights: this https URL
summary: Historical Polish is well documented as a language but annotated in machine-readable form only to about a million words for the period this paper covers; the rest sits behind optical character recognition of variable quality. We present Wieszcz-XIX, a corpus of 6.75 billion tokens (about 3.1 billion words) in 294,369 documents, most of them periodical issues, of Polish published from 1800 to 1918, assembled from Wolne Lektury and the Internet Archive by a pipeline that filters, deduplicates, audits for post-1918 leakage and splits at the document level. It is over three orders of magnitude larger than the annotated corpus of the same period, and we quantify its defects: recognition corruption against a false-positive floor, near-identical duplication, which is removed, and post-1918 leakage, which is excluded from the training corpus itself down to a known residue of 0.04 to 0.38% of its bytes, found in the transcribed source, so the published corpus is the trained one document for document. On a hand-corrected sample the character error rate is 0.68% where the text is legible, and 45% of the sampled passages cannot be corrected. On it we train a ladder of decoder-only models from 47M to 349M parameters from scratch, and measure their temporal boundedness. Against two modern Polish base models, one far larger, the 349M shows a crossover, as does the 107M against the comparator of its size: post-1918 vocabulary costs them about 3.1 bits per byte more than period vocabulary, a gap the comparators do not show, and period vocabulary costs them fewer bits than it costs the comparators. Shown period text, the models keep its spelling and the comparators only partly. Adding parameters gains about twice as much as a second pass over the data. We release the corpus, code and weights. Content warning: the models reproduce period prejudice, including antisemitic statements.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 Wieszcz-XIX，一个包含约67.5亿token（约31亿词）的19世纪及20世纪初波兰语历史语料库（1800-1918），以及在该语料上从零训练的一系列解码器语言模型（参数量从47M到349M）。该语料库主要来源于 Wolne Lektury 和 Internet Archive，覆盖294,369篇文献，其中大部分为期刊文章。作者对语料库进行了清洗、去重、审计1918年后内容泄露等处理，并量化了OCR错误、数据重复和时代内容残留等问题。在该语料库上训练的模型展现了对时代语言的有效绑定，体现在对现代词汇的困惑度较高而对历史词汇的困惑度较低。模型在保持历史拼写（如-cya形式）方面优于现代波兰语基线模型。训练总共花费约104美元。
AI.motivation: 已标注的历史波兰语机器可读资源极其有限（仅约一百万词），不足以支撑从零训练语言模型。然而，要构建一个真正的"时间胶囊"式语言模型（其词汇、事实和空白都严格限定在特定历史时期），就必须有与该时期匹配的大量语料。本文的动机正是填补这一空白——为历史波兰语（1800-1918）创建一个前所未有规模的语料库，并在其上训练展现"时代绑定性"的语言模型。
AI.method: 语料库构建：从 Wolne Lektury 和 Internet Archive 收集文本，通过四道内容门槛（字母比率≥0.60、停用词比率≥0.03、变音符号比率≥0.04、西里尔字母比率<0.005）进行过滤；使用 MinHash（5词 shingle，64个排列，LSH带8×8，Jaccard≥0.8）去重；通过强标记词（如hitler、gestapo、NKWD）、出版商版权声明、带"-cja"拼写比率的辅助信号、出版日期短语等多维度审计，排除1918年后的内容泄露；按来源分层、按文档级别划分训练/验证集，并通过5词 shingle 的包含度测试迭代消除数据集之间的泄露。模型训练：使用字节级BPE分词器（vocab=8000），从零训练三个规模的解码器-Only Transformer模型（47M/107M/349M参数），均采用Muon优化器（嵌入和归一化增益用AdamW）、warmup-stable-decay学习率调度，在单一RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell显卡上固定数据、步数、批次和种子进行训练（各阶段恰好两个epoch）。
AI.result: 语料库成果：最终构建语料库含6,745,956,943 token（294,369文档），相比同时期已标注语料库大三个数量级以上；通过审计排除了2.47%的字节（约171M token），强标记词计数全部归零，1918年后文本残留控制在0.04%-0.38%之间。OCR质量：在手工校正的样本上，字符错误率（CER）为0.68%（条件于文本可读的情况下），但45%的采样段落因版面错乱而根本无法校正。模型性能：47M、107M、349M模型在验证集上的交叉熵分别为3.1009、2.9046、2.6726 nats/token；时代对比实验中，349M模型对1918年后词汇比现代基线多消耗约3.1 bits/byte，而对历史词汇消耗更少；拼写保真度方面，349M模型保持的-cya拼写比例（0.030）与语料库（0.328）远低于现代基线（Bielik 0.445、papuGaPT2 0.773）。参数对比数据显示，增加参数的收益约为重复训练数据的2倍。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功发布了一个前所未有的历史波兰语大规模语料库及在其上从零训练的语言模型。模型展现了对时代语言的有效绑定，能够保持历史拼写、拒绝后时代词汇，并以约104美元的总成本完成训练。局限性包括：模型为单一种子单次训练、无运行间方差估计；OCR错误率基于重建而非原图；时间边界虽经审计但仍存在残留风险；数据来源高度集中于雅盖隆数字图书馆（占4/5）。作者明确警告模型会复现时代偏见（包括反犹言论），并建议在公开交互部署时需配置过滤层和显式语境框架。所有代码、语料库和模型权重均已公开。

title: Coverage, Not Difficulty, Sets How Much Synthetic Data an Activation Probe Needs
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: this https URL
summary: Activation probes that monitor deployed language models are trained on synthetic conversations, and how many a probe needs is open. We trace learning curves over 10-590 synthetic samples for three monitoring concepts, high-stakes situations, replies harmful to a person, and replies that do not follow the user's instruction, on fourteen held-out evaluation distributions and four probe models, varying the generator LLM and the prompt's detail. The need is set by what is monitored: probes for high-stakes and harmful are within a few hundredths of their plateau from 80 samples on Gemma-3-27B-IT, instruction probes need several times as many, and the ordering holds on three smaller probe models and on real samples (from dev set). Prior work advises spending a generation budget on breadth, more kinds of data, over depth, more of each kind. We read the depth a concept needs as the half-gain size of a fitted curve, the number of samples at which half the gain is in hand. Concept and distribution account for 42-45% of its variance, the generator, probe model, and prompt detail for under 10%. What sets the value of the half-gain size is coverage, not per-kind difficulty: the number of samples of its own kind a distribution needs to saturate. Every kind, one per evaluation distribution, has a median half-gain size of 7-11 own-kind synthetic samples under all three concepts alike. What differs is how far samples of one kind transfer to the concept's other kinds, almost fully under high-stakes, less under harmful, and least under instruction, which accounts for most of the gap between concepts on generated and real samples. Breadth therefore pays differently by concept: many kinds are necessary under instruction, where no kind covers another, and nearly redundant under high-stakes, where one kind covers the rest. We release the evaluation suites, dev sets, and generated sets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了激活探针（activation probes）训练所需合成数据的数量问题。通过对三种监控概念（高风险情境、回复有害于人、回复不遵循指令）的学习曲线进行系统实验，发现在14个评估分布、4个探针模型、不同生成器和提示详细度条件下，数据需求量主要由被监控的概念决定，而生成器、提示细节等影响较小。具体而言，高风险和有害概念在约80个样本即接近平台期，而指令遵循概念需要数倍于此的样本。这一差异的根源在于"覆盖度"而非"难度"——不同分布的样本之间能否相互替代，构成了概念间的核心差别。
AI.motivation: 激活探针作为部署语言模型的运行时监控工具日益普及，但其所需合成训练数据的数量在文献中尚未得到系统性研究。以往工作建议将生成预算优先用于"广度"（更多种类的数据）而非"深度"（每种更多样本），但缺乏关于何种概念需要多少深度的明确指导。本研究旨在探究：(a)一个探针究竟需要多少合成样本；(b)数据需求的决定因素是什么；(c)如何预先估计预算。
AI.method: 实验在Gemma-3-27B-IT（另加三个较小模型）上使用线性探针进行，针对三种监控概念（高风险、有害、指令遵循）共14个评估分布。使用4个生成器（Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct、GPT-OSS-120B、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B）在两种提示详细度（一般提示和详细提示）下生成样本，训练样本量从10到590不等，每个规模8次重采样。拟合log-logistic学习曲线以分离"水平"（level）和"半增益大小"（half-gain size）。通过将样本按"分裂种类"（split-kind）进行切割（自身种类、混合、集合减去自身种类），构建了覆盖度检验（coverage test），引入三个统计量R（混合半增益大小与自身种类半增益大小之比）、G（去除自身种类后保留的增益比例）和T（迁移AUROC）。还测试了红队框架（attacker-judge-summariser）和其他生成策略。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1)数据需求由被监控概念决定：高风险探针在Gemma-3-27B-IT上于110-170个样本饱和，有害探针于110-350样本饱和，指令遵循探针在350个后仍未饱和（部分仍在上升）；此顺序在四个探针模型上均成立，在真实样本（开发集）上也成立。(2)方差分解显示，概念和分布共同解释了半增益大小对数方差的42-45%，而生成器、探针模型和提示细节合计仅占不到10%。(3)覆盖度而非难度决定数据需求：每个种类本身在所有概念下中位数半增益大小为7-11个样本，差异在于不同种类的样本之间的迁移程度——高风险下几乎完全迁移（迁移AUROC 0.98），有害下中等（0.86），指令遵循下最弱（0.80）。(4)在指令遵循概念中，覆盖度解释了79%（生成样本）至66%（真实样本）的概念间数据需求差异。(5)其他生成策略（更详细提示、单一分布提示、LLM编写提示、红队攻击）仅移动探针达到的水平，不改变概念间的顺序。(6)实践建议：可从生成集合本身计算迁移AUROC T，并使用经验公式R̂=1+2(K-1)(1-T)估计R，该估计在大多数分裂上与真实R在两倍因子内吻合。
AI.conclusion: 激活探针的合成数据需求是被监控概念的内在属性，而非生成方式的产物。高风险和有害概念在约80个样本即接近性能平台，而指令遵循概念需要数倍于此的样本，原因在于不同种类的对话样本之间在该概念下迁移性较差。广度（更多种类）始终值得投入，但深度（每种样本数）应根据种类间的迁移性来预算——迁移完全时（如高风险），少量样本即可；迁移不足时（如指令遵循），每种都需要充分的样本数。可通过将生成集合切割为种类、测量迁移AUROC，在无需了解部署流量的情况下预先估计数据需求，精度可达2-3倍因子。

title: Certified Corruption Budgets: Anytime-Valid Leaderboard Claims under Adaptive Rigging
summary: Public leaderboards for AI models are read continuously, and attackers can see every published standing. Vote rigging, selective disclosure of private variants, and benchmark contamination can each move a ranking. Existing guarantees assume genuine records or bound the corruption per step, which an attacker who corrupts in bursts evades. We introduce the certified corruption budget, a tolerance $\widehat{B}_t$ computed after $t$ records and published with each pairwise claim. With probability at least $1-\alpha$, simultaneously at all times, the claim is correct or more than $\widehat{B}_t$ records were corrupted. It holds against attackers who watch every certificate, with no bound on their budget. Forged records and records altered once seen require different certificates: the certificate for forgeries fails, with probability approaching one, against an attacker who flips votes it has seen, while one that charges roughly twice as much per record remains valid, with constant bets even against attackers who see the future, and no smaller charge is valid at every level. The certified budget grows nearly as fast as any valid method allows: with a win fraction $\frac{1}{2}+\delta$, each new record adds close to $2\delta$ to the number of forged records the claim can withstand ($\delta$ flipped). Publishing the best of $V$ private variants costs only an amount growing like $\log V$. In replays on 1.8 million Chatbot Arena votes, a few hundred rigged votes make standard confidence intervals certify false orderings, while ours stays valid. On real votes, our certificate shows that clearly separated models withstand about 2,000 forged votes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"认证腐败预算"（certified corruption budget），一种为AI模型公开排行榜中成对比较声明提供的随时有效（anytime-valid）统计保证。该方法针对自适应攻击者——可观察每个已发布证书并集中突击注入伪造记录的恶意方——计算声明所能承受的腐败记录数 $\widehat{B}_t$。在同时针对三种攻击者类别的分析中，通过上限投注财富方法（deflated capped betting）区分伪造与替换攻击，并在180万条Chatbot Arena投票的实测验证中优于Wald区间、稳健逐步检验和非通缩投注等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 公共AI排行榜在持续更新中被读取，攻击者可观察每个已发布排名并伺机集中操纵（突发式投票造假、选择性披露私有变体、基准污染）。现有的统计保证假设数据真实或限定每步腐败率，无法应对观察完整证书后以突发方式集中腐败的自适应攻击者。排行榜读者需要的是一种"除非超过特定数量的记录被腐败，否则该声明成立"的形式化保证。
AI.method: 核心方法为"通缩上限投注"（Deflated Capped Betting）。(1) 构造 $m$ 个并行赌徒，每个使用不同上限 $\bar{\lambda}_k \in (0,2)$ 的恒定赌注对模型 $i$ 的胜率进行投注，财富 $K_t^{(k)} = \prod_{s \leq t}(1 + \bar{\lambda}_k(W_s - 1/2))$。(2) 引入两种成本：插入成本 $c_{\rm ins} = \log(1+\bar{\lambda}/2)$（针对预测型攻击者 $\mathsf{P}$）和替换成本 $c_{\rm rep} = \log\frac{2+\bar{\lambda}}{2-\bar{\lambda}}$（针对值依赖型 $\mathsf{V}$ 和离线型 $\mathsf{O}$ 攻击者），后者约为前者的两倍。(3) 计算通缩平均 $\Phi_t(b) = \sum_k w_k K_t^{(k)} e^{-b c(\bar{\lambda}_k)}$，腐败容忍度为 $\widehat{B}_t = \max\{b : \Phi_t(b) \geq 1/\alpha\}$。(4) 引入针对"领先声明"（lead claim）的指数财富 $Z_t(\gamma)$。(5) 通过闭检验（closed testing）扩展至整个排行榜的联合声明。
AI.result: 理论方面：在三类攻击者下证明 $\alpha$-有效性（定理5.1），证明两种成本均不可降低（定理5.2尖锐性），并证明 i.i.d. 无平局记录下容忍度增长率 $\rho$ 趋近最优上限 $2\delta$（插入）或 $\delta$（替换）（定理5.3-5.4）。从 $V$ 个私有变体中选择最优仅需 $\log V$ 的代价（命题5.5）。实验方面：在 5000 条零假设记录上，$B=20$ 时通缩方法保持错误率 $\leq 0.05$，而Wald和未通缩投注在 $B=40$ 时均达1.0。在 180万条 Chatbot Arena 投票上，分离良好的模型可承受约 2,000 条伪造投票和 1,000 条翻转投票。基线方法在 100-400 条伪造/翻转投票下错误率迅速达 1.0，而本文方法在所有攻击下保持 $\leq 0.05$。在五个前沿基准上，同时声称所有对时无任何 top-2 排序获得认证。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的认证腐败预算为公共排行榜提供了针对自适应、突发式攻击者的随时有效统计保证。其核心洞见在于：(1) 将腐败计数作为鲁棒性单位（与实际攻击测量方式一致），(2) 区分伪造与替换攻击并证明两种成本尖锐不可降低，(3) 容忍度增长率接近信息论最优。在实际 Chatbot Arena 数据上，该方法在攻击下保持有效，而所有基线方法在数百条操纵投票下即崩溃。同时声称所有对的代价使得 GPT-4o 等顶级模型间差异无法获得认证，揭示了多对同时声明的根本局限。方法也扩展至私有变体选择、领先声明和基准测试污染检测。

title: The optimal information complexity of VC learning
summary: Steinke and Zakynthinou(2020) introduces the Conditional Mutual Information (CMI) framework of analyzing the information complexity of learning algorithms based on algorithm-dependent information-theoretic quantities. We study one of these quantities, the evaluated Conditional Mutual Information (eCMI). It has been an interesting question whether the optimal PAC guarantee for VC classes can be recovered from the algorithm-dependent analyses via CMI. And we show that it is possible to recover this guarantee by constructing a learning algorithm whose eCMI is of order O(d) in the realizable case, where d is the VC-dimension of the concept class. Specially, our algorithm is a randomized Majority-of-5 base learners with optimal in-expectation generalization guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了VC学习的最优信息复杂度，证明可以通过构建一个随机化的5-多数投票（Majority-of-5）学习算法，在可实现PAC学习情形下实现评估条件互信息（eCMI）为O(d)（d为VC维），从而恢复了最优PAC泛化保证。
AI.motivation: PAC学习的最优保证为O(d/n)（期望泛化误差），但Steinke和Zakynthinou（2020）提出的条件互信息（CMI）框架中，对于VC类，是否存在学习算法能通过算法相关分析恢复此最优保证（即使CMI为O(d)而非O(d log n)）仍是开放问题。本文旨在通过对eCMI的研究来解决这个问题。
AI.method: 构造一个随机化的5-多数投票学习算法（Majority-of-5）：对n个训练点进行均匀随机置换，分为5个不相交的子集，每个子集大小为n/5，在每个子集上调用基础学习器，并通过"重复调整"（DuplicatesAdjustment）程序模拟i.i.d.采样，最后对5个输出分类器进行多数投票。利用5个基础分类器在给定算法随机性β条件下的条件独立性，将多数投票的误差概率限制为其他4个分类器中至少2个同时出错的概率（通过平方条件概率来补偿），从而将eCMI限制为条件熵之和。
AI.result: 主要结果：1）构造的随机化Majority-of-5算法对任何基础学习器的最坏情形eCMI为O(nR(n/5))，期望训练误差率至多为5R(n/5)；2）当基础学习器具有最优期望误差率O(d/n)（如采用Majority-of-3作为基础学习器）时，最坏情形eCMI为O(d)，期望训练误差率为O(d/n)，恢复了可实现情形下VC类的最优PAC泛化保证；3）对于分布性eCMI，3-多数投票算法即可实现O(d)的保证，常数更小（192 vs 1920）。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次证明存在学习算法在可实现PAC学习中可达到eCMI为O(d)的保证，结合eCMI到泛化的界（Theorem 2.1），恢复了VC类的最优泛化保证。所有结果可推广到多类学习（DS维）。但对于CMI本身是否可达到O(d)仍为开放问题。

title: Beyond Type-checking: Towards Holistic Evaluation of Formal Specification Generation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Verifiable Coding (20 pages, 7 figures)
summary: When generating verifiable code, natural language requirements are mapped to machine checked code using LLMs and agentic workflows. A crucial component of this pipeline is specification generation (SpecGen), which produces a formal contract against which an agent can prove implementation correctness. Proof generation can obtain deterministic feedback from a theorem prover, but SpecGen lacks a definitive check that a generated specification captures the user's intent. A checked proof can therefore establish correctness against a specification that misrepresents the intended behaviour. We take a step towards holistic SpecGen evaluation with a unified dataset assembled from $350$ existing Lean tasks, including $189$ from VERINA and $161$ from CLEVER, and a framework covering formal validity, reference similarity and equivalence, and behavioural adequacy. We distinguish acceptance of required inputs from acceptance of valid outputs and rejection of invalid outputs, while making each metric's evidence scope explicit. Across four SpecGen configurations, restricting the generalized tree edit distance (GTED) comparison, a reference similarity measure, to $32$ jointly measurable VERINA tasks changes the VERINA configuration's position from second to fourth in mean similarity, showing the importance of measurement coverage. In an authored control, a specification achieves $100\%$ positive test recall and negative test rejection while accepting $0\%$ of required inputs. This demonstrates that perfect postcondition scores can miss an unusable input contract, motivating separate feedback on input coverage and output constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文针对可验证代码生成（VCG）流水线中的关键但缺乏确定性反馈的环节——形式化规约生成（SpecGen），提出了一个综合评估框架。核心贡献是构建了一个统一数据集（350个Lean任务，含189个VERINA和161个CLEVER任务）和评估框架，将形式有效性、参考相似度、参考等价性与行为充分性四类互补信号统一起来，并明确区分输入域接受度与输出条件约束。研究通过四项关键发现揭示了现有评估方法的盲区：测量覆盖率可改变配置排名（GTED分析中VERINA配置从第二降至第四）；归一化失败可使高结构相似度得分失效；评测器错误可伪装为规约缺陷；最引人注目的是，完美的后置条件得分可以与零必需输入接受度共存，证明了仅靠后置条件反馈存在根本盲区。
AI.motivation: 在基于LLM的VCG流水线中，SpecGen是决定下游证明有效性的关键环节——错误规约可导致"正确"实现实际上违背用户意图。虽然类型检查和定理证明器能为证明提供确定性反馈，但SpecGen本身就缺乏形式正确性保证机制。现有评估信号分散且回答不同问题：类型检查仅捕捉语法错误，参考相似度无法建立语义等价，行为测试仅在有限样本上有效。这种评估盲区对于安全关键系统（航空、防御、空间应用等）尤其危险。论文的核心动机是区分"针对错误规约的已验证证明"与"满足用户意图的正确证明"，并解决现有评估信号孤立使用时的局限。
AI.method: 评估系统采用四族互补度量：（1）形式有效性——依赖Lean定理证明器的类型检查作为二值信号；（2）参考相似度——包含归一化精确匹配（NEM）、签名F1（基于特征多重集）、逻辑原子F1和广义树编辑距离（GTED，基于Lean LSP悬停信息构建算子树）；（3）参考等价性——使用BEq+尝试双向蕴含的形式证明；（4）行为充分性——对VERINA任务计算正例通过率、负例拒效率、行为平衡准确率、VERINA pass@1和必需输入接受率。系统使用GPT-5.6（Sol）作为基础LLM评估四种配置：直接提示基线、VERINA流水线、CLEVER少样本流水线和LeanAide适配器。关键工程特性包括：每个度量独立记录作用域、分母、运行时间和证据状态，使不可用证据与度量失败明确区分；统一数据集保留来源溯源；行为路径拒绝`sorry`和`axiom`等不完备命令。
AI.result: 四族度量均产生重要发现。形式有效性方面，LeanAide条件类型检查率达100%但候选生成率仅83.9%，揭示了完美类型检查可能掩盖候选缺失。参考相似度方面，原始GTED均值的VERINA排名与限制到32个共同可测量任务后的排名相反：VERINA配置从第二降至第四，提示基线与CLEVER/LeanAide在0.349、0.232、0.243的"胜利"实际源于测量覆盖率差异。结构性得分的归一化失败使记录GTED=1的值仅比较片段而非完整规约。逻辑原子F1与GTED的Pearson相关性范围为-0.238至0.219，表明二者提供弱独立信息。BEq+普遍较低，VERINA为0.000-0.021，CLEVER上所有配置为0.000。行为评估方面，VERINA配置的165个非通过全部携带执行器错误，67个LEVER SCORES具有0正例通过和0负例拒效率，但176个有显式错误标志。关键的受控对照实验中，作者构造的"假前置条件+完美后置条件"规格在正例召回率和负例拒效率上均为1.0，但对必需输入的接受率为0%，直接证明仅依靠后置条件得分可使规约完全无法使用。常数真控制未产生后置条件测量，暴露了校准的不完整性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了SpecGen评估必须将形式有效性、参考相似度、参考等价性和行为充分性作为互补维度分别解读，否则可能得出错误结论。每种度量回答不同问题，其失效模式也各异；测量覆盖率差异可显著改变配置排序；评估错误易被误读为规约缺陷。最重要的原则性贡献是通过受控实验证明：完美后置条件得分可与零必需输入覆盖共存，这从根本上要求SpecGen反馈须显式分离输入域接受与输出条件约束。当前框架的局限在于：仅覆盖一种模型和两个Lean数据集、不同配置在预算和修复步骤上不对等、无法估计模型生成中限制性前置条件的发生频率。未来工作应改进跨评估器的完整规约保持性、扩展到更多模型和形式化框架（Dafny、Verus），并研究将这些信号作为反馈是否能改善规约对用户意图的忠实度。

title: From Investigation Failures to Reliable SOC Agents: Understanding and Improving LLM-Based Alert Triage
summary: Security operations centers (SOCs) must triage large volumes of alerts, most of which are benign, while missed attacks can remain uninvestigated. Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents can retrieve evidence during triage, but it remains unclear how reasoning strategies determine what to gather and when an investigation is sufficient to close an alert. We study five representative approaches spanning single-pass tool use, iterative retrieval, sampled investigations, self-review, and explicit verification. To support this study, we build ALERT-BENCH, an interactive benchmark that replays enterprise telemetry through a live SIEM and requires each system to retrieve evidence. Across 1,247 alerts from a multi-stage attack scenario, every approach missed at least 40.4% of attack-related alerts. Trace analysis shows that attack alerts are more likely to be dismissed when searches return no records, same-context review has negative net correction, and dismissal receives no consistently stronger investigation than escalation. Based on these findings, we further design AIDA (Adversarial Investigation and Dialectical Analysis), a multi-agent framework that requires an explicit proposed decision before independent challenge and stronger evidentiary requirements before dismissal. AIDA preserves investigation history in an append-only Investigation Ledger and keeps the challenge in a separate reasoning context. A separate Judge adjudicates the proposed decision and challenge against evidence, resolving the alert or requesting another round when evidence is missing. On the same alerts, AIDA achieves an F1 score of 0.958, compared with 0.371-0.744 for the studied approaches, and reduces the false-negative rate from 40.4% to 3.1% while escalating 18.4% of alerts to analysts. These results show that structuring evidence retrieval and decision review can substantially improve agentic SOC triage.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于LLM的安全运营中心（SOC）告警分诊问题。作者构建了交互式基准Alert-Bench，通过追踪分析揭示了现有五种LLM推理方法在告警调查中的三类系统性失败模式（空检索导致攻击告警被误关闭、同上下文自审查产生负向修正、关闭决策未获得比升级更深入的调查），并基于这些发现设计了多智能体框架AIDA，采用显式论题承诺、独立挑战与分离裁决机制，将F1分数从最佳基线的0.744提升至0.958，假阴性率从40.4%降至3.1%。
AI.motivation: SOC需要处理海量告警（绝大多数为良性），而漏检攻击可能永远不被调查。基于工具调用的LLM智能体能够检索证据进行分诊，但不清楚推理策略如何决定收集何种证据以及何时调查充分可以关闭告警。现有研究对LLM智能体在分层一阶分诊中的能力与局限理解不足，且缺乏能够要求系统主动检索证据的交互式评测环境。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 构建Alert-Bench交互式基准——基于AIT-LDSv2企业遥测数据，通过Wazuh SIEM实时重放，使用AIT-ADS的事件级标注流程分配隐藏真值标签，通过MCP协议提供五个调查操作接口；(2) 系统性研究——在1,247条告警（含225条攻击相关）上比较五种代表性推理方法（Direct-Prompt、ReAct、Self-Consistency、Self-Refine、CoVe），并通过追踪分析诊断失败原因；(3) 设计AIDA多智能体框架——通过"辩证承诺协议"协调四个智能体（Strategist、Executor、Adversary、Judge），使用仅追加的调查账本保留调查历史，在独立推理上下文中对承诺的论题进行挑战，由分离的Judge根据非对称证据要求进行裁决。
AI.result: 在1,247条告警上，五种基线方法的F1分数在0.371–0.744之间，假阴性率均不低于40.4%；追踪分析发现：(1) 88%以上的攻击告警在无检索记录时被错误关闭；(2) Self-Refine修正16个错误决策但破坏79个正确决策，CoVe修正25个但破坏132个；(3) 四种方法在关闭前检索到的非空记录少于升级前。AIDA取得F1=0.958、召回率=0.969、假阴性率=3.1%，将18.4%告警升级给分析师，99.3%被关闭的告警确为良性。消融实验显示移除Judge使F1从0.952降至0.895。Qwen3.5 9B开源模型在AIDA上同样达到F1=0.952。在wardbeck场景的跨场景评估中，AIDA达到F1=0.927。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠更多推理或计算并不能实现可靠的告警分诊。可靠性取决于证据收集的组织方式以及结论在被关闭前的评估方式。AIDA通过显式论题承诺、独立挑战和分离裁决的协议设计，以及对关闭决策施加更高的证据要求，显著降低了漏检攻击。该研究同时发布了Alert-Bench基准，为评估LLM智能体在SOC告警分诊中的证据检索与决策能力提供了可复现的交互式环境。未来工作包括在独立采集的SOC遥测数据上验证，以及评估分析师对调查账本的实际使用效果。

title: Code Understanding is a Bottleneck for Coding Agents
summary: Repository benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench) for coding agents often assume that lines of code edited can predict task difficulty, but such datasets' poor control over code and task types makes it hard to know which abilities truly drive agent errors. We present CABRA: a Coding Ability Blueprint for Rigorous Agent evaluation. CABRA builds tasks from scratch as call graph transformations and scales difficulty via a task size parameter on four axes: function traversal, search, runtime resolution, and instruction following. We run eight LLMs and six coding agents on 6,840 CABRA tasks to show: 1) LLM accuracy falls as task size~grows, but agents stay near-perfect by offloading work to tools (e.g., grep); 2) Larger CABRA tasks elicit more tool calls for reading and analysis, while a separate study on SWE-bench Verified shows these tool call counts predict agents' accuracy better than lines of code edited, suggesting task difficulty for agents can lie in understanding code to edit, not just in making edits; 3) Extending CABRA to an intense understanding task where models analyze divergent logic across two classes backs this finding, as agent accuracy finally falls. More broadly, we argue for synthetic evaluations like CABRA to unmask LLM weaknesses trivialized by tools (e.g., needle-in-a-haystack) and abilities beyond just editing (e.g., understanding) that coding agents still find difficult, pairing SWE-bench-style tasks with controlled diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 提出 CABRA 框架，通过从零生成合成编程任务并沿四个复杂度轴（函数遍历、函数搜索、运行时解析、指令遵循）可控缩放任务规模，在 6,840 个任务上评估 8 个 LLM 和 6 个智能体。研究发现：LLM 准确率随任务规模下降，但智能体因工具卸载（如 grep）保持近完美；智能体在大型任务中将更多工具调用用于代码理解（Read/Analyze），理解调用次数比编辑量更能预测 SWE-bench 错误率。扩展的代码合并任务进一步证实代码理解是智能体的关键瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有的代码智能体评估基准（如 SWE-bench）依赖代码编辑行数预测任务难度，但这类数据集对代码和任务类型控制不足，无法准确诊断智能体失败原因。作者希望构建可控的合成评估，揭示智能体真正的能力瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 设计 CABRA 框架：从有向无环调用图生成五种任务类型（移除死代码、添加参数、添加返回值、缓存函数、DRY）；2) 定义四个复杂度缩放轴：函数遍历、函数搜索、运行时解析、指令遵循；3) 构建 6,840 个任务，在 GitHub Copilot 公共 harness 上评估 8 个 LLM 和 6 个智能体；4) 开发工具调用分类器（Qwen3-4B），将调用分为 Read/Search/Analyze/Edit/Test/Other 六类；5) 扩展设计代码合并任务（提取两个类的等价逻辑），验证代码理解瓶颈；6) 在 SWE-bench Verified 上验证理解工具调用次数与错误率的负相关性。
AI.result: 1) LLM 准确率随任务规模 n 增长下降，但智能体通过 grep/AST/exec 等工具维持近完美准确率；2) 工具调用分析显示，Read 和 Analyze 调用随任务规模增长，而 Edit 仅在指令遵循轴上增长；3) SWE-bench Verified 分析显示，理解工具调用次数（r=-0.200）与智能体错误的相关性最强，超过编辑行数（r=-0.159）；4) 代码合并任务中，当代码行数 ℓ 增长时，智能体准确率显著下降，Analyze 工具调用急剧增加；5) 智能体在多行分解、变量重命名和定位单行差异方面表现薄弱，存在对表面命名的过度依赖。
AI.conclusion: 代码理解而非代码编辑是当前编码智能体的关键准确性和效率瓶颈。建议在 SWE-bench 风格的任务之外，使用 CABRA 等可控合成评估来归因智能体错误，并推动代码理解能力的提升作为未来编码智能体的重要发展方向。

title: Verification and Self-Improvement in Agentic AI: Foundations and Limits
comment: 26 pages, 5 figures. Includes proofs and reproducibility artifacts
summary: Agentic AI systems can improve by searching longer, receiving additional support, or modifying how they propose and verify outputs. A performance score does not distinguish these mechanisms. We compare these changes through bounded verification with hidden terminal randomness. A stage specifies admissible transcripts, polynomial bounds, an alternating verification protocol, and a terminal checker. Its native reach uses default support; its closure frontier permits all support already admitted by the interface. Under a uniform pointwise probability gap and task-relative soundness, these are well-defined languages. We prove that independent majority amplification preserves both languages, whereas existential acceptance over random tapes can admit incorrect outputs. Exact verification is the zero-randomness case, with placement and completeness results. The randomized-verifier classes satisfy $\Sigma_k^{\mathrm{P}}\subseteq\Sigma_k^{\mathrm{RV}}\subseteq\Sigma_{k+1}^{\mathrm{P}}$; strict enlargement and depth separation require explicit complexity assumptions, while $\mathrm{BPP}=\mathrm{P}$ yields exact companions with the same frontiers. Representation analysis separates invariant acceptance from core-versus-support labels that can change under refactoring. For recursive self-improvement, uniformly bounded self-modification under a common sound interpreter and fixed verification protocol remains within the same verification class. A separate conditional-error budget controls false selection across adaptively chosen candidates. A quota-enforced XOR-synthesis family separates unbounded ratios of search success from changes in the accepted languages; exact and probabilistic audits check the resulting evidence requirements. The framework ties self-improvement claims to obligations on correctness, admissible evidence, verification resources, and selection error.

AI.tldr: 本文为智能体AI的验证与自我改进建立了形式化语义框架，通过"原生到达"与"闭包前沿"两个语言对区分搜索策略、支撑信息与终核检查器三类改进机制，并给出条件性深度障碍与自适应选择误差界。
AI.motivation: 性能分数无法区分智能体通过延长搜索、获取额外支撑还是修改验证协议来提升能力。作者旨在建立精确的语义基础，以区分这些机制并明确自我改进主张所需满足的义务。
AI.method: 定义有界概率阶段（k深度交替验证+隐藏终核随机性+点态概率间隙+任务相对健全性），引入"原生到达"（默认支撑下接受的语言）与"闭包前沿"（所有接口允许支撑下的语言），并证明独立多数放大保持语言、存在式随机带可接受错误输出、零随机性恢复精确语义、深度分离需复杂性假设；递归自我改进部分在共同健全解释器下证明有界自修改仍属同一验证类，并给出有限自适应选择的条件误差预算与XOR综合族作为可执行审计示例。
AI.result: 建立了精确的语义诊断工具：（1）放大保持前沿但存在式接受会扩大前沿并接受错误输出；（2）$\Sigma_k^{\mathrm{P}}\subseteq\Sigma_k^{\mathrm{RV}}\subseteq\Sigma_{k+1}^{\mathrm{P}}$夹层界，严格扩张与深度分离需显式复杂性假设，BPP=P时两者等价；（3）语义权威与暴露包含可诊断前沿逃逸；（4）有界自修改在固定包络内保持验证类；（5）有限M次选择调用总假选误差$\leq\sum\delta_i$；（6）XOR族示例展现任意大搜索成功比而不改变语言，配额提升可改变前沿。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将自我改进主张转化为对正确性、可接受证据、验证资源与选择误差的明确可测试义务：搜索改进可保持前沿，内部化可选支撑可在旧前沿内扩大原生到达，前沿逃逸需权威或暴露包含失效；递归自我改进受结构合同与统计选择合同双重约束。有限审计验证语义区分但非大规模部署的经验验证。

title: PyCache Trap: The Inspection-Execution Gap in Agent Skill Scanners
comment: 28 pages, 5 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: Agent skills combine instructions with executable resources, giving third-party packages access to an agent's runtime. Existing skill scanners inspect documentation and visible source, but Python may execute a bundled bytecode cache with different behavior. We study this gap between inspection and execution through PyCache Trap, which pairs benign source with a substituted cache accepted by the loader and connects it to a task-relevant invocation. Scanner-guided rewriting changes the invocation wording while preserving the cache body, separating package admission from recognition of the concealed behavior. Across 100 skills and seven scanners, PyCache Trap achieves 94-100% attack success, with no semantic recognition of the cache-resident behavior. We propose execution-aware validation (EAV) to connect inspected instructions, scripts, imports, and runtime artifacts in a typed execution graph. EAV combines grounded behavioral analysis with trusted reproduction of compiled artifacts. It detects all 100 evaluated source-present cache substitutions and reaches 92.8% Recall at 10.0% FPR across five attack families and 200 benign skills. The results support checking the executable artifacts a runtime can select as part of skill admission, within the supported loaders and code-object normalization. The code is released at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了Python智能体技能扫描器中"检查-执行鸿沟"：扫描器审查可见源码，而Python运行时可能加载行为不同的字节码缓存（.pyc）。提出的PyCache Trap攻击通过良性源码+替换缓存实现94-100%绕过率，且无扫描器识别出隐藏行为；提出的执行感知验证（EAV）方法通过类型化执行图与可信复现实现100%检测率与92.8%召回率。
AI.motivation: 智能体技能（Agent Skills）作为第三方可执行包，在安装或调用时获得运行时访问权限。当前的安全扫描器主要审查文档、源码和元数据，但其隐含前提是"被检查的源等于运行时实际执行的代码"。然而Python的导入机制允许加载与源不一致的字节码缓存，这使得基于源码扫描的信任边界失效。需要系统研究这种"检查-执行鸿沟"并提出有效的防御方法。
AI.method: 攻击方法PyCache Trap：将良性源码与载荷不同的.pyc缓存配对，构成任务相关调用路径；通过扫描器反馈驱动的LLM改写器仅修改扫描器可见的调用措辞，保持缓存字节不变，从而分离包准入与隐藏行为识别。防御方法EAV（执行感知验证）：构建类型化执行图将指令、脚本、导入和运行时工件连接起来；通过三阶段（构建图、投影类型化效应、应用可达性/禁止组合/来源闭合三项标准）进行验证，其中来源闭合使用可信复现（trusted reproduction）对运行时可达的缓存与已验证源的可信编译结果进行精确类型化常量规范化比较。
AI.result: 攻击有效性：PyCache Trap在7个扫描器（Cisco、HSS、Auditor、SlowMist、Vetter、SkillFortify、ExecScan）上对100个技能实现94-100%攻击成功率（ASR），包括对ExecScan的94%，所有扫描器对隐藏行为的语义识别率为零；跨扫描器迁移性高，EAV作为目标时全部检测。防御有效性：在100个源-缓存替换与100个合法缓存上，trusted reproduction与EAV检测全部100个替换且零误报（86个可配对）；在5个攻击家族与200个良性技能的混合评估中，EAV达到92.8%召回率、95.9%精确率、10.0% FPR、94.3 F1，优于所有基线扫描器。运行时确认：在Claude Code + MiniMax-M3的端到端评估中，76-83/100的受害者既被扫描器准入又执行了隐藏行为。效率：trusted reproduction中位延迟2.15ms，EAV为39.82ms（p95 190.93ms），约ExecScan的三分之一延迟。
AI.conclusion: 批准可见源码并不保证运行时执行代码的来源合法性，因此Python智能体技能的准入检查必须纳入运行时可选的执行工件。EAV通过类型化执行图与trusted reproduction将可执行来源闭合（executable provenance closure）作为显式准入条件，对缓存替换实现确定性检测，同时支持跨文本/图像/字节码攻击家族的检测。检查运行时实际加载的工件（而非仅源码）应成为技能准入的标准实践，适用于所支持的加载器和代码对象规范化范围内。

title: Temporal transformer CAN encoder with federated lightweight heads for anomaly detection
summary: Modern vehicles rely on large numbers of Electronic Control Units (ECUs) that constantly exchange information over the Controller Area Network (CAN) bus. Due to the rapidity, structure, and repetition of this communication, even slight variations in timing, payload values, or message patterns can point to unusual activity. Whether due to errors, malfunctions, or deliberate interference, these anomalies are frequently subtle and challenging to identify with conventional methods that handle messages separately or rely on manually created rules. Motivated by this gap, we present a privacy-preserving framework for anomaly detection in in-vehicle networks, based on a Temporal Transformer CAN Encoder with Federated Lightweight Heads, to better capture these irregularities. The detection of subtle temporal and contextual anomalies is made possible by a lightweight Transformer encoder that learns how these signals evolve over time, while a federated learning mechanism enables several vehicles or ECUs to work together to improve a shared model without exchanging raw CAN data. This combination of federated learning and temporal sequence modeling provides robust anomaly detection performance while maintaining efficiency and privacy, according to experiments conducted on open-source datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于联邦学习的隐私保护车载网络异常检测框架，采用轻量级时间Transformer编码CAN信号并通过联邦学习头实现多车协同建模，以高效捕获CAN总线通信中细微的时序与上下文异常。
AI.motivation: 现代车载网络依赖大量ECU通过CAN总线通信，传统的逐消息处理或人工规则方法难以捕捉细微的时序、负载值或消息模式异常；同时，车辆数据具有隐私敏感性，集中式训练面临数据共享障碍。
AI.method: 1) Temporal Transformer CAN Encoder：轻量级Transformer编码器，学习CAN信号随时间演化的时序与上下文特征；2) Federated Lightweight Heads：联邦学习机制，使多车辆或多ECU在不交换原始CAN数据的前提下协同训练共享模型；3) 在开源CAN数据集上验证框架的有效性、效率与隐私性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，结合联邦学习与时间序列建模的框架在保持效率与隐私的同时，能够实现稳健的异常检测性能，可识别细微的时序与上下文异常。
AI.conclusion: 将轻量级Transformer编码器与联邦学习相结合，是车载网络异常检测的一种有效且兼顾隐私保护与计算效率的方案，为实际车辆部署提供了可行路径。

title: JevForest: Path Voting for Budgeted Feature Acquisition
summary: Choosing which information to observe is central to prediction under limited observation budgets. We study JevForest, a feature acquisition policy that aggregates path-dependent proposals from bootstrapped trees, weights them by global training information gain, and predicts from the acquired values with a shared masked classifier. An online implementation queries Jev for semantic answers selected by this policy. On small balanced held-out samples, four-question forest acquisition achieves accuracy $0.729$ on AG News ($n=48$), compared with $0.667$ for a static gain ranking and $0.583$ for random ordering. On TREC ($n=24$), the ordering reverses: forest accuracy is $0.667$, compared with $0.750$ and $0.833$. Asking all eight questions in one batch yields higher accuracy at lower measured cost and latency than four sequential forest queries; direct Jev classification matches the batch accuracy while costing less. Offline MiniBooNE experiments yield accuracy $0.845\pm0.010$ at ten features and $0.885\pm0.008$ at forty features over three jointly varying data and forest seeds (mean $\pm$ sample standard deviation). A companion Newton boosting implementation provides preliminary full-feature synthetic results. These exploratory findings establish a working Jev acquisition workflow but do not support a general advantage for path voting: its value depends on the task, predictor, and the distinction between question budgets and actual query costs.

AI.tldr: JevForest 是一种基于路径投票的特征获取方法，通过自举树集合提出下一个应观察的特征，并由全局信息增益加权。在离线和在线两种场景下进行了探索性评估，结果表明路径投票的优势依赖于任务、预算大小，且四个顺序查询在实际成本和延迟上不如一次性批量查询。
AI.motivation: 在有限观察预算下，预测需要决定先获取哪些特征。不同特征在不同输入区域的价值不同，顺序特征获取需要根据已观察到的值来条件化选择。现有的树集成方法主要面向完整特征预测，而非特征获取策略。
AI.method: JevForest 将自举信息增益树的条件路径作为特征获取提案，使用全局训练信息增益对提案计数加权，公式为 V_j(x_S)·G_j(D)，通过共享掩码分类器从已获取的特征值预测标签。连续特征采用训练拟合的分位数边界进行离散化，在线场景中每个特征对应一个通过 Jev API 调用的语义问题，答案被阈值化为二值特征。还包括一个配套的 Newton 提升实现 JevGBoost，用于全特征二分类预测。
AI.result: 离线 MiniBooNE 实验（3 个联合变化的种子）在 10 个特征时准确率为 0.845±0.010，40 个特征时为 0.885±0.008；全局增益加权在预算 10 时优于纯计数（0.856 vs 0.836），但在预算 20 时反而更差。在线 AG News（n=48）四个问题预算下，森林路径投票准确率 0.729，优于静态增益排序 0.667 和随机排序 0.583；但 TREC（n=24）上森林 0.667 劣于静态 0.750 和随机 0.833。批量询问所有 8 个问题的准确率（AG News 0.771，TREC 0.917）高于四次顺序查询，且成本更低、延迟更短；Jev 直接分类以更低成本达到与批量相同的准确率。
AI.conclusion: JevForest 建立了一个可行的工作流程，但探索性结果不支持路径投票的通用优势：其价值依赖于任务、预测器、问题预算与真实查询成本之间的区别。批量询问和直接 Jev 分类在在线场景中比四次顺序森林查询更准确、成本更低、速度更快。JevGBoost 增强研究仍为初步阶段，未形成综合系统。

title: When Routing Reveals Membership: Privacy Leakage from MoE Router Telemetry
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models produce routing information during inference that may be logged or exposed for monitoring, debugging, load analysis, and safety auditing. Unlike ordinary model outputs, this telemetry reveals a view of the model's internal computation, raising a privacy question: can it reveal whether an example was used to fine-tune the deployed model? We introduce a router-augmented membership inference attack that combines conventional output-side signals with aggregated routing features and applies a membership classifier learned from independently fine-tuned shadow models to the target model.
