An admission policy, with thresholds fitted on a held-out split at a declared false-positive ceiling, maps each score to true, false or unknown. Unknown denies. A deterministic, sufficiency-checked contract decides. The probability that sensing changes the verdict is bounded by the sum, over the contract's sensed fields, of the admitted-wrong and unknown rates. This is an instantiation of union-bound reasoning, indexed by the contract. Minimising the estimated bound is a valid cost model for choosing among sufficient contracts. In a registered study on two constructed domains with two sensor families (36,000 model calls), no cell refuted the bound. Deny-to-allow changes from sensing appeared for the first time in this programme: 13 of 21,000 test verdicts, all from 3 contradictory records; each flip in a cell with a registered bound lay under it. Sensing-aware selection picked the lower-exposure contract in 4 of 4 registered tests. Both sensors' scores were informative but not calibrated. Correctness is relative to the declared loss model, candidate representation and reachable states; all domains are constructed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将概率性模型传感输出接入确定性权威合约的架构。模型对非结构化证据中的字段进行"感知"，仅作为带分数的观测记录被接纳；通过预设假阳性上限拟合阈值，将分数映射为 true/false/unknown（unknown 拒绝）。核心贡献是用并集界给出传感改变裁决概率的上界（命题 S1），并证明在嵌套感知字段集下该界关于字段数单调（命题 S2），从而支持在充分合约间以估计界为参数化目标进行选择。在两个构造域、两类传感器、36,000 次模型调用上完成预注册实验：无单元格违反有界范围；首次出现 deny→allow 翻转（21,000 次裁决中 13 次，均由 3 条矛盾记录引起），均在注册界以下；感知感知的选择在 4/4 次注册测试中均选出暴露更低的合约。两类传感器分数均有信息量但未校准。
AI.motivation: 前序论文（1–5）建立了一套由系统记录读取字段、以充分性检查的合约进行权威裁决的治理框架。然而某些合约所需字段仅存在于非结构化证据中（如变更单、合同文本），无法从系统记录直接读取。现有方法要么让模型直接裁决（放弃可审计性），要么完全禁止模型参与（留下功能空白）。本文填补这一缺口：在保留确定性合约裁决与可检验不变量的前提下，让模型"感知"非结构化证据中的字段值。核心问题是：如何在不将权威交给模型的情况下，严格界定模型感知引入的风险并支持合约选择？
AI.method:
方法分四层。  
1) 架构：在传感路径上，传感器读取证据文档 d，为字段 i 的每个候选值产生分数 s∈[0,1]；接纳策略 A_i 用两个阈值（τ^true、τ^false），在保持集上以假阳性上限 ε=1% 拟合，把分数映射为 true/false/unknown。Unknown→拒绝。只有一个值为 true 时该字段被接纳；否则 unknown。记录以带戳的观测记录写入治理缓冲区，包含 request_id、resource_id、分数、接纳决策、传感器与策略版本、文档 SHA-256、传感时间戳，由数据质量谓词校验戳一致性。  
2) 命题 S1（并集界）：对合约感知字段集 F_s，裁决改变概率 P(verdict change) ≤ Σ(e_i + u_i)，其中 e_i 为错误接纳率、u_i 为 unknown 率；P(deny→allow) ≤ Σe_i。证明基于"若所有感知字段均正确接纳则观测与真实元组一致→由充分性裁决不变"，改变事件包含在某字段错误或 unknown 中；unknown 拒绝使 deny→allow 必含某字段错误。  
3) 命题 S2（嵌套单调性）：若 F_s′ ⊆ F_s 且由相同传感器、文档、接纳策略、派生读取，则较小集的 S1 界不超过较大集。证明因 S1 界是非负项之和，移除字段不增界；估计界同理。该性质使最小化估计界 Σ(ê_i + û_i) 成为论文 5 中合约选择的合法参数化目标。  
4) 命题 S3（fail-closed）与否定见证 N6：S3 要求"deny-ward"全局条件——对每个可达 deny tuple、所有联合错误接纳观测均仍裁决为 deny——才能使 deny→allow 概率为零。见证 (a) 显示两字段错误不相交时 S1 的 deny→allow 界可达；见证 (b) 显示 AND 合约在联合错误下，按字段方向判 deny-ward 但全局不 deny-ward，v1 的方向界被击穿，由此将方向界替换为 S1 全局界。  
估计：阈值在 split A 拟合，split B 上用 Clopper-Pearson 单侧 95% 上界得 ê_i、û_i，组合得 B⁺=Σê_i 与 B=Σ(ê_i+û_i)。  
实验设计：两个构造域（CH-C1，35 属性，1,000 项；CH-B1，代码与云域，700 项×4 单元），两个传感器家族（Jev，类型化概率模型；Claude Haiku 4.5，生成式语言模型），三种噪声水平（0%、10%、30%，噪声嵌套），全部在 prereg-p6-v1.1 中预注册。健康检查规则：前 20 条验证记录中无效 >2 或验证无效率 >5% 终止运行。所有原始响应写入追加缓存，结果从缓存由单一命令填充。
AI.result:
主要结果（注册声明与实证证据）。  
• C1 架构：支持。传感字段仅作为带戳观测记录进入闸门，模型不发出裁决。  
• C2 S1 界：instantiation。S1 是并集界在程序事件上的实例化，按合约感知字段索引；在有限模型族 B12、B3、T2 上经 s1_check 机器验证（4,472、131,072、115,200 个点对）。  
• C3 S2 单调性与选择目标：supported（有限模型、嵌套集）；s2_check 机器验证 12,308、702,464、373,248 例，并在嵌套集外给出反例（按"最少传感字段"规则会选单字段，但注册目标选两字段、界低 100 倍）。  
• C4 界未被违反：H1 在 6 个 E1 单元上的精确单侧二项检验加 Bonferroni 校正，未被驳回（调整后 p=1.0000）。每个有注册界的单元（E1 全部 6 单元、E2 30% 噪声）中观察不安全率未超 B⁺；E1 最大观察不安全率 0.0014 vs 最小 B⁺=0.0395。  
• C5 首次出现 deny→allow 翻转：21,000 次测试裁决中 13 次翻转，每单元最多 700 中 1 次；归因到 3 条矛盾记录（E1 第 6042 项，E2 第 1595、2312 项）；每条记录的批准字段被矛盾化，传感器接纳了追加评论中的陈述。每个有注册界的翻转均位于其界以下。S3 条件在 5 个注册配置上均不成立（0 个 deny-ward），故翻转均为实证观察而非 S3 推导。  
• C6 校准：被驳回。E5 在测试集分数上 Spiegelhalter Z 与 Brier 技能分数：Jev CH-C1 Z=-40.52、p≈0、BSS=0.9566；Haiku CH-C1 Z=7.10、p=1.22e-12、BSS=0.9058；Jev CH-B1 Z=-48.81、p≈0、BSS=0.9516；Haiku CH-B1 Z=-3.62、p=0.0003、BSS=0.8655。两传感器均信息丰富但均未校准。  
• C7 传感感知选择：E2 在 30% 噪声 split B 上估计界，4/4 注册测试（双臂×两传感器）中均选出暴露更低的归约；McNemar 精确检验 Holm 校正后 p∈[5.68e-14, 6.78e-21]。感知感知选择与论文 5 在 CH-B1 的选择：arm 1 改变、arm 2 一致。  
• C8 可复现性：engines.lock 锁定兄弟仓库与提交；响应与清单提交；make paper 字节级重新生成；make formal 在 S1/S2/S3/N6 上双跑一致；mutmut 3.7.0 在 src/sensed_authority 上杀灭 575 突变体中 544 个，杀灭率 0.946 vs 阈值 0.85；独立研究者在 macOS Python 3.13（开发环境 Python 3.11）下从新鲜克隆复现，字节一致。  
约束：所有语料均为构造；split 间仅短语库不同，其余表面规整性共享；B⁺ 因 Clopper-Pearson 地板至少 0.0198/字段、2 字段 ≥0.0395；估计界依赖"迁移"与"同时性"假设；S3 在任何注册配置均不适用；E2 两个归约共享 approval 字段，翻转配对。  
非声明：不在真实系统中声称普遍性；不声称传感在一般情况下安全；不声称对其他版本的 Jev/Haiku 适用；不声称界紧。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了一种将概率性模型传感与确定性、充分性检查的权威合约组合的架构：模型输出仅作为带戳观测记录、带分数与接纳策略进入闸门；模型不携带权威，裁决与有效性判定留在可审计代码中。S1 用并集界把传感改变裁决的概率按合约感知字段加和上界，S2 表明该估计界在嵌套感知字段集下是合约选择的合法目标函数。预注册实证（36,000 模型调用）未驳回注册界；首次出现 deny→allow 翻转（21,000 中 13 次，归因 3 条矛盾记录）均在注册界以下；传感感知选择 4/4 选低暴露归约；两类传感器分数信息丰富但未校准，阈值必须拟合。总体上，这是"概率性传感+确定性权威"在充分性检查合约下的一个具体实例化：不变式保留、可测、可重放；本文不引入抽象、抽象、抽象或放弃改写。

title: Back in Style: A Sociolinguistic Approach to Authoring and Measuring Persona Fidelity in User Simulation
comment: Accepted to the UserSim @ NeurIPS 2026 workshop (non-archival)
summary: As agentic systems gain commercial popularity, user simulators increasingly serve as measurement instrument for their evaluation. However, the fidelity of simulated users in comparison to real human users is generally low, and typically assessed by costly, subjective LLM judges. In this pilot study, we ask whether fidelity can instead be measured deterministically by treating a user persona sociolinguistically: as a social type that emerges from observable linguistic style, rather than one predicted by labels or descriptions a model must extrapolate into behaviour. We author personas as concrete stylistic rates, which lets us transfer two established, model-free instruments -- authorship-verification stylometry and lexicon-based content analysis -- as fidelity diagnostics. We A/B-test the sociolinguistic schema against a flat descriptive baseline across five task-oriented customer-service agents. Results show that the sociolinguistic schema improves both stylistic adherence and stylometric distinguishability for most of the tested models, with a caveat that persona style fidelity does not necessarily equal persona "naturalness". We argue that a sociolinguistic approach to persona design is a promising path towards more diverse and representative user personas, and that these metrics are most valuable in an error-attribution analysis, localizing where fidelity breaks down. This is a first step towards interventions that move user simulations closer to faithful renderings of diverse and variable linguistic outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于社会语言学（sociolinguistic）的用户画像（persona）设计方案与两个确定性的保真度诊断指标，用于在任务导向型客服仿真中提升和衡量模拟用户与真实用户之间的语言风格一致性。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的用户模拟器在评估智能体时存在"模拟-现实"差距（sim2real gap）：传统画像以形容词或人口标签描述，需由模型外推行文；保真度评估又依赖昂贵且主观的LLM裁判。作者主张将画像视为由可观察语言风格构成的社会类型，而非由标签预测的行为，并将保真度测量从主观判断转为可重复、可定位的确定性指标。
AI.method: 1) 设计definition schema：以八项立场关联的语言特征（提问率、信息长度、模糊语、礼貌标记、填充词、全大写、CMC缩写、情感效价）的序数频次带（none<low<medium<high）+行为契约块来具象化画像；2) 设计两个无模型的保真度诊断——作者验证风格计量学（字符n-gram TF-IDF余弦相似度的ROC-AUC，衡量persona间区分度）和风格遵循度（规范序数与观测率的Kendall τ_b，衡量规范-行为对齐）；3) 对五种任务型客服智能体跨九个文本模型和一个语音模型，以2×2（schema×model）因子设计A/B对比，将archetype（标签型）作为基线。
AI.result: 1) 区分度：definition schema在文本上对9个模型中的8个提升AUC（gpt-5-mini提升最大+0.187，claude-haiku-4-5 +0.141，claude-opus-5 +0.105），gemini系列基本无变化；语音同样提升（+0.131）。2) 遵循度：除Gemini/Gemma外，所有模型的τ_b均显著上升（gpt-5-mini +0.420/对话；claude-opus-5 +0.398），且效应在语音通道复现。3) 关键发现：(a)更强/更新的模型并非更易被引导，模型家族的对齐偏好比相对能力更影响效果；(b)按"特征缺失"定义的persona（tech_savvy_expert、busy_multitasker）在所有模型上仍处于随机区分水平；(c)风格遵循度≠自然度——某些标记被程式化重复（如"Thank you so much!"或固定的"um"前缀）；(d)行为契约块的消融实验证明其与风格速率共同贡献，但速率本身已是核心驱动。
AI.conclusion: 将画像保真度视为对可观察语言风格的确定性、规范映射的诊断，可将不透明、依赖裁判的质量信号转化为特征层面、可复现、可归因的信号。两项指标在任务型客服仿真（文本+语音）中均产出可操作、内部一致的信号，能定位保真度在何处失效，区分规范欠定与模型可引导性上限。社会语言学路径是构建更多样、更有代表性用户模拟画像的有前景方向，但需进一步工作以纳入更广泛的语言标记并缓解程式化"伪自然"渲染问题。

title: Multi-Bandwidth Distribution Matching Distillation: On the Equivalence of Distribution Matching Distillation and Drifting Models
summary: Researchers are exploring effective one-step generative model continuously, and, Drifting Models (Deng et al., 2026), demonstrate great potential in one-step generation recently. There are works that reveal the connection between Diffusion & Flow Style Generative Models (DFSGMs) (Ho et al., 2020; Song et al., 2020a;b; Lipman et al., 2022; Liu et al., 2022) and Drifting Models (Li & Zhu, 2026; Lai et al., 2026; Turan et al., 2026). But no one has yet established a precise correspondence between the Drifting Model and the widely used distillation method- Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD/DMD2) (Yin et al., 2024b;a) to the best of our knowledge, even though their optimization objective formulas are virtually identical. In this paper, we prove that by converting the velocity-field / noise-field from the pre-trained DFSGMs into the attraction force field in Drifting Models and estimating the repulsion force field from the generative distribution, training the Drifting Model is naturally equivalent to the Distribution Matching Distillation. With this equivalent concept, we propose an improved method based on DMD from the Drifting Model's perspective- Multi-Bandwidth Distribution Matching Distillation (MBDMD).

AI.tldr: 本文证明了分布匹配蒸馏（DMD/DMD2）与Drifting Models在有限样本分析下的精确等价关系，并基于此提出了多带宽分布匹配蒸馏（MBDMD）方法，通过在多个噪声水平（带宽）上进行采样来加速DMD训练收敛并提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 一步生成模型（如Drifting Models）展现了巨大潜力，但Drifting Models与广泛使用的DMD蒸馏方法之间尽管优化目标公式几乎相同，却缺乏精确的对应关系。此外，DMD训练中如何选择时间步t（带宽）以及Fake Score Model的更新滞后问题仍有待改善。
AI.method: 1. 将预训练Flow Matching/Diffusion模型的条件分布指数项作为Drifting Model中的核函数，通过贝叶斯定理和Tweedie公式将速度场/噪声场转化为吸引力场；2. 利用Fake Score Model提供的速度/噪声场得到排斥力场，从而在有限样本下严格证明DMD与Drifting Model的等价性；3. 提出MBDMD：将带宽范围分为K个区间，每个训练步从不同区间随机采样t值，以覆盖全局结构到局部细节的多尺度信息。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 64×64纯DMD设置下，MBDMD在328k步达到FID 2.5728，410k步达到FID 2.4697，优于vanilla DMD的2.7238和2.6432；在SDXL蒸馏中，MBDMD仅用8000步即超过vanilla DMD2 24000步的FID。实验表明K=3为最佳设置。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了DMD与Drifting Models在DFSGMs蒸馏框架下的精确有限样本对应关系，揭示了二者共享的吸引-排斥理论基础。该统一框架不仅可解释多个现有DMD变体，还启发了多带宽训练策略MBDMD，在收敛速度和生成质量上均取得显著提升，且随模型规模增大优势更明显。

title: Omni-Diffusion-Distill: Few-Step Distillation of Unified Multimodal Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Unified multimodal diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a single architecture for both image generation and multimodal understanding, but their iterative decoding requires tens to hundreds of forward passes. Existing few-step distillation methods largely focus on either image generation or text generation, making it unclear how to compress a fully discrete multimodal dLLM into a single efficient student while preserving both generation and understanding. We introduce Omni-Diffusion-Distill, a unified two-stage distillation framework that retains strong generation and understanding capabilities while substantially reducing the inference cost of a unified multimodal dLLM. Omni-Diffusion-Distill aligns the distillation of both generation and understanding, for both images and text, in the discrete token space. In the first stage, the student is trained to skip decoding steps by replaying cached teacher trajectories, and in the second stage the student is refined on intermediate states along its own rollouts. We further remedy two sources of degradation in unified distillation with a pairwise collision penalty that reduces repetition under parallel text decoding, and entropy-matched guidance that prevents entropy collapse caused by fitting the sharpened teacher distribution in image generation. Omni-Diffusion-Distill achieves state-of-the-art trade-offs between decoding efficiency and generation and understanding performance for multimodal dLLMs, reducing image generation from 128 to 8 decoding steps and multimodal understanding from 512 to 64, giving 18.2x and 21.2x wall-clock speedups. Under these budgets, it scores 0.828 on GenEval and 83.0 on DPG-Bench for text-to-image generation, while reaching GPT judge scores of 20.0 on MM-Vet and 57.2 on COCO captioning (twice the teacher's 28.4 at the same steps) for multimodal understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Omni-Diffusion-Distill，一个用于全离散统一多模态扩散大语言模型(dLLM)的两阶段少步蒸馏框架。该方法通过离线的教师轨迹回放和在线的自身rollout精炼，将图像生成从128步压缩到8步、多模态理解从512步压缩到64步，并提出了针对文本并行解码的"成对碰撞惩罚"和针对图像生成的"熵匹配引导"两个机制，分别解决重复生成和熵坍缩问题，实现了18.2倍和21.2倍的端到端加速，并在多个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态扩散大语言模型(dLLM)支持图像生成和多模态理解，但迭代解码需要数十到数百次前向传播，计算开销巨大。现有少步蒸馏方法要么只针对图像生成，要么只针对文本生成，无法同时压缩一个完全离散的多模态dLLM。此外，减少解码步数会带来两个模态特有的挑战：文本端的并行解码诅咒(导致重复)和图像端的CFG目标熵坍缩(导致多样性降低、编辑任务中倾向于不修改源图像)。本文旨在回答"能否在统一dLLM中统一图像和文本生成的蒸馏"这一问题。
AI.method: Omni-Diffusion-Distill采用两阶段训练框架：阶段一为离线轨迹回放(off-policy)，学生通过前向KL、回放缓存的教师轨迹来学习跳步解码，包含轨迹项、自一致性项、路径项和真值锚点四项；阶段二为在线策略精炼(on-policy)，学生在自身rollout的中间状态上进行训练。方法提出两个核心创新：(1)成对碰撞惩罚(Pairwise Collision Penalty)：通过对并行文本解码中任意两个位置提交相同token的概率进行惩罚，减少长文本生成中的重复；(2)熵匹配引导(Entropy-Matched Guidance)：通过自适应调整温度，使CFG目标的熵匹配条件预测熵的固定比例(ρ=0.7)，防止学生熵过低。此外，模型将文本注意力的双向注意力替换为块因果(block-causal)注意力，实现KV缓存精确复用。
AI.result: 在Lumina-DiMOO(8B全离散统一dLLM)上进行蒸馏后，Omni-Diffusion-Distill实现了：图像生成从128步减少到8步(18.2×加速)，多模态理解从512步减少到64步(21.2×加速)。在T2I任务上，GenEval达到0.828，DPG-Bench达到83.0；在MMU任务上，MM-Vet为20.0，COCO captioning为57.2(为同步骤教师28.4的两倍)。在大多数基准上优于Di[M]O、CDLM和T3D等蒸馏基线，并在DPG-Bench和MMU等基准上接近全步教师。消融实验验证了两个阶段训练的必要性、碰撞惩罚对文本去重复的有效性(Loop@5从21.6%降至7.7%)以及熵匹配引导在ρ=0.7时效果最佳(I2I基准从2.04提升到2.31)。局限性：仅限于全离散统一dLLM架构，在文本渲染和详细描述上仍落后于全步教师。
AI.conclusion: Omni-Diffusion-Distill成功回答了"能否统一多模态dLLM中图像和文本生成的蒸馏"这一问题，通过统一的两阶段框架在大幅减少解码步数的同时保持了生成和理解能力。提出的成对碰撞惩罚和熵匹配引导分别针对两种模态特有的退化问题提供了有效的解决方案。实验表明该方法在少步设置下达到了效率与性能的最佳权衡，展示了完全离散统一架构在多模态蒸馏中的潜力。

title: Region-Aware CLS Token Augmentation for Fine-Grained Image Retrieval
summary: Image retrieval methods often rely on a single global semantic descriptor extracted from an image, e.g., the [CLS] token in vision transformers. However, trying to squeeze all the semantic information of an image into a single descriptor can hurt downstream retrieval performance, especially for fine-grained retrieval tasks. In this work, we augment the semantic tokens in the newer visual transformers, the global [CLS] token and the four register tokens, with a carefully selected collection of spatial tokens, aiming to capture the spatial region representation that characterizes the contents captured in each of the semantic tokens. We leverage the DINOv2-reg model, which includes register tokens that emergently learn object and part-based representations. For each "cue" token ([CLS] and each register token), we find a "buddy" image patch token and extract an N x N patch region to produce a set of localized ROI tokens. Our approach automatically captures important regions of interest without any external bounding boxes or saliency modules, purely by matching semantic tokens with their spatial representation regions. Furthermore, we incorporate these tokens into a multi-vector retrieval framework inspired by ColBERT, enabling fine-grained matching via a per-token alignment mechanism while avoiding the large storage cost of keeping all patch embeddings. Through extensive experiments, we find that (1) register tokens encode useful fine-grained details that can complement the [CLS] token; (2) automatically pooled ROI tokens further improve fine-grained discrimination; and (3) multi-vector retrieval with a small set of tokens improves over a DINOv2-reg single-vector baseline while remaining tractable for large-scale search. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种基于DINOv2-reg视觉Transformer的区域感知CLS token增强方法，用于细粒度图像检索。该方法通过"buddy"机制为每个语义token（[CLS]和4个register tokens）自动定位对应的图像patch区域，生成少量ROI tokens，并结合ColBERT风格的多向量检索框架，在保持低存储成本的同时提升细粒度区分能力。
AI.motivation: 单向量全局描述符（如ViT的[CLS] token）难以捕捉细粒度图像检索所需的局部细节信息。现有方法要么依赖外部边界框或显著性检测模块，要么直接使用所有patch tokens导致存储和计算开销过大。本文旨在利用视觉Transformer内部已有的register tokens作为"注意力池"，无需外部监督即可自动发现判别性局部区域。
AI.method: 方法基于DINOv2-reg骨干网络，包含三类token：全局[CLS] token、R个register tokens（默认R=4）和P个patch tokens。对于每个"cue" token（[CLS]和register tokens），计算其与所有patch tokens的点积相似度，找到最相似的"buddy" patch，再对以该patch为中心的N×N邻域进行平均池化（默认3×3），生成ROI token。最终得到2(R+1)=10个token。训练使用ColBERT风格的max-sim三元组损失，并采用Straight-Through Estimator（温度0.05的softmax）对argmax选择进行反向传播近似。
AI.result: 在CUB-200、In-Shop、Cars-196、Stanford Online Products和INSTRE五个基准上超越现有方法。CUB-200 R@1达到87.4%，Cars-196 R@1达到90.5%，SOP R@1达到86.2%，INSTRE mAP达到93.5%。消融实验表明：(1) register tokens带来小幅提升；(2) ROI tokens贡献主要增益；(3) 多向量训练优于单向量训练；(4) 3×3池化窗口为最佳默认设置。相比全patch存储（201 tokens，每百万图像309GB），该方法仅需10 tokens（约15GB）即可达到相近性能。
AI.conclusion: DINOv2的register tokens确实编码了有意义的、对象和部件级别的信息，可作为图像检索的有益补充线索。本文提出的buddy ROI token机制能自动捕获判别性局部区域，无需外部边界框或显著性模块。10 token的紧凑多向量表示在细粒度检索任务上优于单向量基线，且在大规模搜索中保持可扩展性。未来工作包括与其他patch选择策略（如attention、随机）的对比、零训练配置、更少token配置，以及将机制扩展到CLIP、DINOv3等模型。

title: Invariant-Measure Reasoners: Stable Representations for Latent Reasoning
summary: Latent reasoning models repeatedly update a latent state using the same recurrent block. As the recurrent depth increases, the sequence of latent states may converge to a compact subset of the state space without necessarily converging to a fixed point. Existing models typically predict by applying a prediction head to a single latent state. However, the latent state can continue to change even after many updates, potentially making predictions unstable across recurrent depths. To address this instability, we introduce invariant-measure reasoners (ImR), a framework that uses an invariant measure as a stable representation. This measure describes the long-run distribution of latent states on the compact subset and is invariant under updates by the recurrent block. ImR predicts from the expectation of the prediction head's output under this measure. We use ImR in two ways: fine-tuning only the prediction head of existing models and training models from scratch. Both approaches reduce prediction instability and improve accuracy in many settings on maze and Sudoku tasks. In some settings, models trained with ImR exhibit non-fixed-point behavior more frequently than existing models yet achieve high accuracy even with such behavior, unlike existing models. These results suggest that ImR can leverage otherwise destabilizing dynamics for latent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ImR（Invariant-Measure Reasoners），使用不变测度作为潜在推理的稳定表征，通过预测头在轨迹经验测度下的期望输出进行预测，显著降低预测不稳定性并提升精度。
AI.motivation: 潜在推理模型在不同循环深度下预测不稳定：轨迹常收敛到紧集而非不动点，导致最终状态持续变化，进而引发预测结果在正确与错误之间反复波动。论文旨在通过不变测度框架解决此问题。
AI.method: 将潜在状态轨迹视为离散时间动力系统，定义经验测度 μ̂_T 收敛到不变测度 μ*（满足 f#μ* = μ*），预测 z* = E_{s∼μ*}[g(s)]，实践中用有限轨迹经验测度的平均代替。同时提出两种训练方式：仅微调预测头和从头训练（结合深度监督与 TBPTT）。此外，从算子理论视角，利用 Perron-Frobenius 与 Koopman 算子进行理论刻画。
AI.result: 在 Maze-Unique 与 Sudoku-Extreme 上，从头训练的 ImR 在大循环深度下精度高于 EqR（Maze-Unique 98.8% vs 89.4%，Sudoku-Extreme 98.7% vs 96.2%），并在非固定点轨迹组中将不稳定预测占比从 ~88-96% 降至 ~1-3%。在 OOD 迷宫上，DT 微调版 ImR 在 degree-2 组精度从 82.83% 提升至 84.50%，不稳定预测从 4.5% 降至 0.4%，且无需改变循环块。无 puzzle prefix 时非固定点率可达约 50%，但仍获得高稳定精度。
AI.conclusion: ImR 框架将潜在推理的稳定表征从不动点推广到不变测度，允许模型在潜在状态持续演化（非固定点动力学）时仍获得稳定且正确的预测，从而可以利用通常被认为不稳定的动力学进行推理。实验表明该方法在多种设置下改善了预测稳定性与精度。

title: F$^3$NO: Frequency-Decomposed Finite-Time Flow-map Neural Operators with Cross-Scale Conditioning
summary: Neural operators enable fast PDE forecasting, but repeated predictions accumulate errors and fine-scale structures remain difficult to resolve. We introduce a frequency-decomposed finite-time flow-map neural operator (F$^3$NO) that leverages updated low-frequency features to guide nonlinear refinement of high-frequency information. Within each layer, this cross-scale conditioning connects global spectral processing with local detail refinement. The model directly predicts states at specified future times and adjusts the contributions of the two branches according to the prediction interval. For longer trajectories, it combines parallel predictions within short temporal segments with recursive propagation between segments. Experiments on five PDE benchmarks demonstrate improved forecasting accuracy over autoregressive and direct-prediction baselines. Ablations show that frequency-decomposed refinement can improve accuracy with fewer parameters, while the benefits of segmentation depend on spatial resolution and dynamical regime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出F³NO（频率分解有限时间流映射神经算子），通过频率分解谱精炼（FDSR）块在每个层内将低频更新后的特征用于条件化高频信息的非线性精炼，并结合分段训练与执行策略，在五个PDE基准上实现最优预测精度。
AI.motivation: 神经算子在PDE长期预测中存在两个核心挑战：（1）自回归滚动导致误差累积；（2）不同空间频率上的预测误差不均匀，难以解析精细尺度结构。现有方法如PDE-Refiner（输出级迭代精炼）和FreqMoE（专家权重迁移）均未在层内建立低频到高频的显式条件化通路，且未系统研究时间间隔与递归传播之间的权衡。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) FDSR块——通过傅里叶低通投影将每层隐特征分解为低/高频分量，低频分量经全局谱算子更新后与高频分量在通道维度拼接，由两层1×1卷积实现非线性精炼；(2) 提前期依赖融合门——小型MLP从Δt生成标量门控系数，自适应调节两分支贡献；(3) 分段流映射——训练时Hybrid-TF以真实状态重置段边界，推理时段内并行直接预测、段间递归传播，段长τ平衡单步映射难度与误差传播。模型整体在FNO骨架上以残差流映射形式实现，FiLM调制替代TCIN。
AI.result: 在1D Burgers、1D KSE、2D Navier-Stokes、2D浅水方程和3D Rayleigh-Taylor不稳定性五个基准上，F³NO在所有9个参数配置下均取得最低相对L²误差，较最优基线实现约6%-46%的相对改进；频谱分析显示FDSR使误差在频率轴上更均匀分布；段长τ的优选与空间分辨率和动力学混沌度相关——高分辨率/低ν（小粘度）偏好短段，反之偏好长段甚至τ=T；在不规则时间采样（缺失率20%-80%）下退化最平缓；推理速度优于自回归基线（支持段内批量并行）。
AI.conclusion: F³NO通过层内显式的跨尺度条件化（更新后的低频特征引导高频精炼）与分段执行策略，有效解决了PDE长期预测中的误差累积和频谱不均问题。该框架在保持参数效率的同时实现了跨多个PDE系统、空间分辨率和粘度条件的稳健高精度预测，验证了显式建模频率分量与灵活时间组合的互补价值。

title: Low-rank tensor structure of precipitation and its application to satellite-reference merging
summary: The intermittent and variable nature of precipitation makes its accurate estimation over extended domains difficult, yet its spatiotemporal structure suggests that a low-rank representation may be possible. This work represents daily precipitation over the contiguous United States (CONUS) as spatiotemporal tensors and applies CANDECOMP/PARAFAC factorization, showing that preserving the native spatial and temporal modes yields more accurate reconstruction than factorizing independent daily fields or unfolded space--time matrices. Building on this finding, this work presents TMerge, a tensor-based framework that integrates satellite precipitation with sparse reference observations through shared low-rank spatial and temporal factors. TMerge was applied to correct the IMERG Final Run product with climate prediction center reference observations over CONUS. During 2019-2022, TMerge increased correlation from 0.53 to 0.85 and reduced root-mean-square error and mean absolute error by 48.2% and 29.3%, respectively. TMerge consistently outperformed linear bias correction, quantile mapping, and neural networks across seasons, precipitation-intensity regimes, and regions. Improvements were spatially coherent and largest in coastal regions where IMERG errors were greatest. These results demonstrate that low-rank tensor structure parsimoniously approximates the dominant spatiotemporal variability of precipitation and provides a practical mechanism for improving satellite estimates under limited reference observations over extended domains.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了将日降水量以时空张量形式表示并采用CANDECOMP/PARAFAC（CP）分解的可行性，并提出了一种基于低秩张量的卫星-参考降水融合框架TMerge。研究表明，保持原始时空结构的张量分解比逐日独立分解或时空矩阵展开分解能更准确、参数更节省地重建降水场。基于此提出的TMerge框架利用共享低秩时空因子融合IMERG卫星降水和稀疏CPC参考观测，在2019-2022年CONUS区域将相关系数从0.53提升至0.85，RMSE降低48.2%，MAE降低29.3%，全面优于线性偏差校正、分位数映射和MLP神经网络等基线方法，尤其在IMERG误差最大的沿海区域改善最为显著。
AI.motivation: 降水具有间歇性和高度可变的时空特性，使得在大尺度范围内对其进行精确估计十分困难。尽管如此，降水的时空结构暗示其可能存在低秩表示的可能性。与此同时，IMERG等卫星降水产品在沿海和复杂地形区域存在显著误差，而传统的偏差校正、分位数映射或机器学习方法在参考观测稀疏的条件下难以提供跨季节、跨区域的稳健改进。水文学领域对低秩方法的应用（流预测、土壤水分重建等）已较为广泛，但将张量分解应用于大尺度降水估计和卫星-参考融合仍属空白。因此，本文旨在验证大尺度降水场是否具有可通过时空张量分解有效揭示的低秩结构，并探索其用于改进卫星降水产品的实用机制。
AI.method: 本文采用如下方法：（1）将日降水量表示为三阶张量（纬度×经度×时间），应用CANDECOMP/PARAFAC（CP）分解，提出低秩时空张量模型（STT），并与两种基线比较——逐日独立的空间矩阵分解（SM）和将时空张量展开为空间-时间矩阵的分解（UM）；（2）在此基础上提出TMerge框架，将卫星和参考降水合并为四阶张量（纬度×经度×时间×数据源），通过共享低秩空间与时间因子进行融合，卫星提供密集时空信息，稀疏参考观测约束因子趋于参考场；通过最小二乘法拟合因子矩阵；（3）与三种基线校正方法对比——乘法线性偏差校正、基于坐标信息的多层感知机（MLP）神经网络、分位数映射（QM）+反距离权重插值；（4）使用Pearson相关系数、RMSE、MAE、NSE、KGE等指标进行评估，实验包括CPC分辨率控制和IMERG原生高分辨率两种设置，采用固定位置采样（50%或90%参考位置用于拟合，剩余用于评估）。
AI.result: 核心结果：（1）低秩表示方面，在5%参数预算下，STT的相关系数达0.926±0.001，RMSE为2.431±0.009 mm/天，显著优于SM（r=0.786）和UM（r=0.526）；在0.5%–20%的参数预算范围内STT均保持优势；在70%隐藏比例下STT仍保持r=0.824的高精度，而SM和UM降至0.235和0.259。（2）CPC分辨率融合中，TMerge将IMERG的r从0.542提升至0.819，RMSE降低41.0%，MAE降低18.3%；99.74%的网格RMSE得到改善，改善最显著处位于沿海（西海岸、墨西哥湾沿岸、东海岸）。（3）IMERG原生分辨率融合（2019-2022）中，TMerge使r从0.534升至0.854，RMSE降低48.2%（6.320→3.272 mm/天），MAE降低29.3%；沿海区域r从0.489升至0.831，RMSE降低46.5%；TMerge仅使用约1.2%的张量参数（MLP约11.5%）即获得更优精度；TMerge在所有季节、所有降水强度区间（从<1 mm/天到>50 mm/天）均优于所有基线方法，对罕见高强度事件（>50 mm/天）仍能降低RMSE约27%–34.9%。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明日降水量存在可被利用的低秩结构，且当其原始时空维度以张量形式保留时，该结构能被更准确、更简洁地表征。基于此提出的TMerge框架通过共享低秩空间和时间因子将密集卫星估计与稀疏参考观测融合，在保留IMERG原生0.1°分辨率的同时显著改进其降水估计，在CONUS区域内全面优于线性校正、分位数映射和MLP神经网络，尤其在卫星误差最大的沿海地区改善最为突出。结论确立了低秩张量结构作为降水量变率的一种组织属性，具有高效数据表示、可靠重建、可扩展建模和系统化监测的能力，并展示了其在参考观测稀缺条件下改进高分辨率降水估计的有效性。未来工作包括将分析扩展至次降水时间尺度、将地形等辅助变量作为附加张量模式纳入TMerge。

title: Reconstruction of Multiscale Plasma Dynamics Across Operating Regimes
summary: Reconstructing spatially resolved plasma dynamics from few sensors is essential for diagnostics, reduced-order modelling and control, yet remains difficult because the sparse measurements incompletely constrain multiscale, regime-dependent degrees of freedom. The Shallow Recurrent Decoder (SHRED) partially addresses spatial sparsity by using measurement histories; however, its fully connected decoder provides no explicit mechanism for resolving spatial structure across scales or explicit parametric dependency. We introduce the Recurrent Multiscale Affine-modulated Inference Network (ReMAIN), which preserves SHRED's recurrent temporal encoding but replaces its decoder with a U-Net whose feature hierarchy is conditioned by the recurrent state through feature-wise linear modulation. The temporal representation supplies both a dense prior and scale-specific modulation throughout the U-Net. A parametric extension jointly embeds the operating condition and sensor history, enabling reconstruction to adapt as the governing dynamics change with operating regime. ReMAIN is first benchmarked against SHRED on six one-dimensional nonlinear PDEs representing diverse dynamics. Across all benchmarks, it reduces reconstruction errors on unseen trajectories and more faithfully resolves sharp transitions, localized extrema and fine-scale variations. The parameter-conditioned model is then demonstrated on a collisionless $E \times B$ plasma subject to perpendicular axial electric and radial magnetic fields, with the electric-field strength serving as the operating parameter. ReMAIN reconstructs the high-dimensional, multiscale plasma state and recovers its regime-dependent spatiotemporal dynamics at electric-field strengths withheld from training. Together, ReMAIN improves sparse-sensor full-state reconstruction and, through parameter conditioning, generalizes across plasma operating regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReMAIN（循环多尺度仿射调制推理网络），通过将SHRED的全连接解码器替换为FiLM条件化的多尺度U-Net，实现从稀疏传感器历史重建多尺度、跨运行工况的高维动力态。在六个非线性PDE基准和E×B等离子体PIC仿真上验证了其相对于SHRED的优越性能。
AI.motivation: 等离子体诊断受限于传感器稀疏性，且其多尺度、跨工况的动力学难以从少量传感器测量中重建。SHRED的全连接解码器缺乏显式的空间多尺度解析机制和参数依赖性，难以准确恢复尖锐跃迁、局部极值和精细尺度结构，也无法泛化到训练工况之外的动力学。
AI.method: ReMAIN保留SHRED的双层LSTM循环编码器，但将全连接解码器替换为三层编码器-瓶颈-解码器的一维/二维U-Net，其U-Net各分辨率层级（编码器、瓶颈、解码器）的特征图通过特征线性调制（FiLM）由循环隐藏状态进行通道级仿射调制。循环状态同时线性投影为密集时序先验作为U-Net输入。参数扩展通过独立全连接网络嵌入运行参数，与隐藏状态拼接形成联合历史-参数潜表征，同时用于先验和FiLM条件化。等离子体训练额外引入多尺度辅助损失（方位角增量误差）。
AI.result: 在六个1D非线性PDE基准上，ReMAIN相比参数匹配的SHRED将相对L2重建误差降低约25–80%，尤其在恢复陡峭前沿、局部极值和精细结构方面表现更佳。在E×B等离子体PIC数据上，仅使用10个空间传感器的50步历史重建12,800维J_ey场，在训练未涵盖的E/E0工况（1.25–4.75）上成功恢复方位角功率谱和二阶结构函数所表征的多尺度空间组织。
AI.conclusion: ReMAIN通过FiLM条件化多尺度U-Net显著提升了稀疏传感器全态重建的精度和跨工况泛化能力，为E×B等离子体诊断、降阶建模、数字孪生和实时控制提供了一种有效的快速状态估计工具。未来工作应关注不确定性量化、分布外检测和传感器配置优化。

title: How Narrative Wrapping Affects LLM Refusal: A Cross-Language Benchmark and Defense
summary: Safety-aligned language models often refuse a harmful request stated directly but answer the same request inside a role-play or narrative wrapper. We measure this vulnerability across languages and registers: attack success on Qwen3-1.7B is already 89.4% in English and 93.0% in modern Chinese, and reaches 95.7% in Classical Chinese. We build GUISE, a benchmark for systematically studying this vulnerability. It includes parallel requests in English, modern Chinese, and Classical Chinese, matched harmful and benign pairs, wrapper types held out for evaluation, and a stricter criterion that counts warn-then-answer responses as attack successes. Representation analysis shows that language and register move harmful-request representations only slightly away from the model's refusal direction, whereas narrative wrappers move them much farther away. We propose AXIS, which combines preference optimisation with a rotation objective that aligns harmful-request representations with the refusal direction and a commitment objective that trains the model to refuse completely rather than produce a warn-then-answer response. Across Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B and GLM-4-9B, AXIS achieves the highest combined safety and usability score among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型在叙事/角色扮演包装下绕过安全对齐的问题，构建了跨语言（中、英、古汉语）的基准 GUISE，并提出结合偏好优化、旋转目标与承诺目标的训练方法 AXIS，在 Qwen3-1.7B/4B 与 GLM-4-9B 上取得了安全性与可用性的最佳综合表现。
AI.motivation: 研究发现安全对齐模型常会直接拒绝有害请求，却在角色扮演或叙事包装下回答相同请求。作者指出叙事包装而非语言/语体是主要攻击因素，并提出分离"语言/语体"与"包装"效应以系统测量并防御该漏洞。
AI.method: 1) 构建 GUISE 基准：配对有害/良性请求，跨英、现汉、古汉三语，提供保留外包装类型和严格裁判（将"警告后回答"WTA 判为攻击成功）。2) 表示分析：揭示包装使有害-良性方向相对拒绝方向旋转 77°-86°。3) AXIS 训练方法：偏好优化(DPO) + 旋转目标(将习得的有害-良性方向对齐到现汉拒绝方向) + 承诺目标(强化完全拒绝直至终止符)。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B、GLM-4-9B 三个模型上，AXIS 在安全性(分布内与分布外攻击的严格拒绝率)和可用性(良性请求帮助率)综合得分上优于五种近期方法(SimPER、α-DPO、DOOR、Deep Alignment、Booster)。消融实验证实旋转项主导分布外泛化，承诺项抑制 WTA，DPO 项抑制良性过度拒绝。分析表明所学防御与"包装"绑定，可跨语体迁移。规模增大时与最强基线差距缩小。
AI.conclusion: 叙事包装而非语体是大模型拒绝绕过的主要驱动因素，GUISE 可系统测量该漏洞，AXIS 通过表示层面旋转与承诺机制有效恢复拒绝且保持可用性，在三个模型与多种评估设置中达到最佳综合安全性与可用性平衡。

title: Non-Clairvoyant Scheduling is Hard Even for Trees
summary: We study online scheduling of parallel jobs on $m$ identical processors to minimize maximum flow time. Each arriving job is represented by a directed acyclic graph (DAG) whose vertices are unit-time subjobs and whose edges specify precedence constraints. We consider non-clairvoyant algorithms: the DAG is not known when a job arrives, and each subjob is revealed only when it becomes ready. Agrawal, Moseley, Newman, and Pruhs (SPAA 2024) showed that First-In-First-Out (FIFO) has competitive ratio $\Omega(\log m)$ even when every job is an out-tree. They also proved that FIFO is $O(\log m)$-competitive in several natural settings and asked whether this guarantee extends to general instances. More broadly, they asked whether any non-clairvoyant algorithm can be $O(1)$-competitive. We answer both questions in the negative by proving a lower bound of $\Omega(\min\{m,\mathrm{OPT}\})$ for every non-clairvoyant online algorithm, where $\mathrm{OPT}$ is the maximum flow time of an optimal offline schedule. In particular, every non-clairvoyant algorithm has competitive ratio $\Omega(m)$ on some instance with $\mathrm{OPT} \ge m$. The lower bound holds even when every job is an out-forest. We complement these lower bounds with an asymptotically optimal non-clairvoyant algorithm. FIFO is $O(m)$-competitive, but can have competitive ratio $\Omega(m)$ even when $\mathrm{OPT}=O(1)$. For instances with small $\mathrm{OPT}$, we design a Small-Frontier-First algorithm that is $O(\mathrm{OPT})$-competitive. Combining the two algorithms yields an $O(\min\{m,\mathrm{OPT}\})$-competitive non-clairvoyant algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文研究m台相同处理器上DAG并行作业的非预知在线调度，目标是最小化最大流时间（完成时间减到达时间）。论文证明了无速度增强下非预知算法的竞争比下界为Ω(min{m, OPT})（即使每个作业是外向树），并通过组合FIFO（O(m)竞争）和新设计的Small-Frontier-First算法（O(OPT)竞争）与加倍猜测策略，给出O(min{m, OPT})竞争的上界，确立紧匹配。此外还解决了分批到达（间隔为opt）情形下竞争比为Θ(min{m, log opt})的最优结果。
AI.motivation: Agrawal, Moseley, Newman和Pruhs（SPAA 2024）证明了FIFO在所有作业为出树时竞争比为Ω(log m)，并提出两个开放问题：(1) FIFO的一般竞争比是否为O(log m)；(2) 是否存在非预知算法能实现O(1)竞争比。本文的动机是回答这两个问题，并填补无速度增强下非预知DAG调度竞争比的根本性空白。此前在平均流时间等指标上已知非预知算法若无速度增强必然不具常数竞争比，但最大流时间通常被认为更简单，因此人们猜测对最大流时间可能存在常数竞争比。
AI.method: 下界构造采用分层外向森林作业，每层有一个“关键”子作业（连接下层所有子作业）。对手通过：(1) 将关键作业选为算法最后处理的子作业之一（使非预知算法在下一层揭示前已处理完当前层）；(2) 根据算法决策自适应选择下一层为“宽层”（2m个子作业）或“窄层”（1个子作业），在强制区间内安排窄层迫使处理器空闲。OPT的紧性通过保留一个处理器专门推进关键子作业来保证。上界方面：(1) 证明FIFO利用"赢则赢"分析（忙碌时按最优速率处理，空闲时作业数受m限制）得到O(m)竞争；(2) 设计Small-Frontier-First算法：将作业按2·opt长度分批，按轮运行，每轮处理所有"小批"（就绪子作业≤m个）的就绪前沿，空闲容量填充最老的"大批"，证明F_max≤44·opt²；(3) 通过对opt的加倍猜测将两者组合为O(min{m, opt})竞争算法。分批到达场景则使用"前缀空闲步数"的几何递推得到O(log opt)上界，并构造满足"宽层前缀条件"的固定实例配合阈值策略得到Ω(min{m, log opt})下界。
AI.result: 主要结果：1) 定理1：每个确定性或对抗遗忘对手的随机化非预知在线算法在外向森林作业上竞争比为Ω(min{m, opt})；特别地，当opt ≥ m时为Ω(m)。2) 定理2：存在确定性非预知算法，对在线DAG调度竞争比为O(min{m, opt})。3) 定理3：FIFO在opt=O(1)的实例上竞争比为Ω(m)，说明FIFO本身不能实现O(opt)竞争。4) 定理4：分批到达设置（到达间隔恰好为opt）下，非预知在线调度的最优竞争比为Θ(min{m, log opt})，FIFO达到此上界。这些结果合并确立了关于到达间隔的尖锐阈值：间隔≤(1-ε)opt时为Θ(min{m, opt})，间隔=opt时为Θ(min{m, log opt})，间隔≥(1+ε)opt时配合速度增强可为Θ(1)。
AI.conclusion: 本文本质上解决了无速度增强下DAG作业非预知调度最大流时间问题：即使作业为外向树，最优竞争比也是Θ(min{m, opt})。要超越此结果，要么需要速度增强，要么需要在作业到达时已知其依赖结构。对于树，若到达时已知结构可实现Θ(1)竞争（先前工作）。重要开放问题是：结构信息能否为一般DAG或某些自然子类（如串并联DAG）带来常数或对数竞争比？部分信息（如关键路径建议或未来并行性的粗略信息）是否足以恢复良好竞争比？论文还揭示了作业内部调度是DAG模型的核心难点，区别于速度曲线模型中的作业间分配问题。

title: Curating Always-Loaded Context for LLM Agents: A Capacitated Assortment Model with Censored Feedback
summary: At the start of every session, LLM agents load a fixed context file, such as $\texttt{ this http URL }$. Each loaded token in the file is charged again in every later round of the session, and these files can degrade performance as they grow in size. However, in practice, human or automated curators usually grow these files by appending. We formulate context curation as a capacitated assortment problem. Instructions consume tokens under a finite attention capacity; adding an instruction never raises the compliance of the others, while retained instructions incur a per-session setup cost. We prove an upper bound on the optimal file size, regardless of the number of available candidate instructions, and that appending every instruction with positive standalone value can be arbitrarily worse in net value than selecting an optimal subset. A token budget also limits the loss when the token price is underestimated. We then examine what can be learned from past sessions and how this information can guide decisions to add or remove instructions. Feedback is inherently censored: the benefits and harms of loaded instructions are observable, whereas missing instructions generate feedback only when their absence causes harm. In this setting, we show that deleting instructions ignored by agents can inevitably remove helpful ones. We characterize how much evidence should be collected before adding an instruction. Besides, we bound regret when human reviewers can inspect only a limited number of edits per period. Empirical experiments further show that irrelevant rules drawn from real context files reduce language-model compliance.

AI.tldr: 本文将LLM代理的上下文文件(如AGENTS.md)策展问题建模为带容量约束的组合优化问题,证明在注意力稀释和token成本约束下,最优文件大小有与候选池规模无关的上界,且不断追加正面价值指令的策略(accretion)可导致任意大的次优损失。在带审查删改上限的受删截反馈学习场景下,给出了加法/删改指令的证据阈值与遗憾上界匹配下界的紧界。
AI.motivation: 实际LLM代理会话总是加载固定上下文文件(如AGENTS.md),其每个token在每轮都被收费,且文件增大反而会降低代理对指令的遵循度。实践中策展者倾向于不断追加指令而非精选,但缺乏理论指导:文件应该包含什么?如何从历史会话中学习?这两个问题因会话记录天然受删截而变得困难——只有加载的指令效果可见,缺失指令除非造成伤害否则不可观测。
AI.method: 将上下文策展建模为带容量约束的组合优化(capacitated assortment)问题:每条指令有token成本、相关性概率、遵循收益,代理有限注意力为共享资源且随文件增大被稀释(单调稀释假设及共享稀释参数化 q_i(S)=θ_i g(A(S)))。策展者需在token预算B下最大化每会话净价值R(S)=R₀(S)−κC(S)。学习侧建立受删截反馈模型(已加载指令的合规/伤害标志可见,缺失指令仅在导致失败时通过"gap sighting"被观测),给出ETC-m算法(Explore-Then-Commit,每epoch至多m次编辑)。利用Lean 4形式化证明主要结果。
AI.result: 主要结构性结果:命题1(文件大小上界)证明在注意力容量Q̄下最优文件满足|S|≤Q̄/ρ,与候选池大小N和预算B无关;推论1证明无限追加正价值指令的策略损失可任意大;命题2证明无稀释时追加策略在预算允许下最优。识别结果(定理C.5)证明合规观测无法识别收益值,删除最不被遵循的指令会盲目删除价值更高的指令;命题3证明仅基于合规数据的删除策略终将移除有用指令;推论C.6证明无幅度反馈下任何策略遗憾线性增长。定理1给出添加指令的最优证据阈值k=2;定理2(ETC-m上界)与定理3(下界)证明编辑上限导致的遗憾项为Θ((N/m)LΔ),学习项为O(T^{2/3}(lnNT)^{1/3})。实验:用3,200条真实上下文指令对Claude Haiku 4.5和Sonnet 5.5做尺寸扫描,最优文件大小在池规模200→3,200时基本保持不变(Haiku:5-10条;Sonnet:20-40条),但加载全池时遵循度急剧下降;24个模型配置在IFScale基准上重测,500条指令时平均合规率仅0.067-0.689;60个仿真设置中ETC-m的cap项对N/m的log-log斜率为1.06,与理论界匹配。
AI.conclusion: 上下文文件策展本质上是带注意力容量和token成本的组合优化问题,最优文件大小有独立于候选池的上界;在持续追加正价值指令的实践中,稀释与token成本的复合作用可造成任意大的次优损失。受删截反馈使合规与价值不可识别,简单的"删除最不被遵循指令"策略会删除高价值指令并保留低价值或有害指令;因此策展需幅度反馈(magnitude feedback)才能学习增益大小。编辑预算的紧界Θ((N/m)LΔ)表明每epoch允许的修改次数直接决定学习效率。实验证实了理论预测:真实LLM在大文件下指令遵循度显著下降,最优文件规模不随候选池增长而扩大。该框架为LLM代理的自动/人工策展系统(如AGENTS.md维护工具)提供了首个具有形式化保证的理论基础。

title: Why LLM Agents Favor Their Group: Stakes, Observed Norms, and Reputation
summary: Language-model agents favor their own group because they have watched their members favor each other. The group label alone does little once the decision has a cost; what drives favoritism is observed behavior, and an individual's own record can override it. We test this in small societies with arbitrary group labels, ten rounds of point sharing, and matched one-shot decisions across fifteen OpenAI models and three Claude models, about 4,400 societies and 3.3 million audited model calls. First, the large effect of a bare group label reported in earlier work appears only when giving others points costs the agent nothing; once the agent can keep points for itself, that effect collapses on every model that shows it. Second, under a stake, interaction history becomes the main source of favoritism: the history effect is statistically positive on 13 of 15 models, reaches about 3.5-8 points out of 10 on 11, grows with the number of rounds played, and extends to labeled strangers the agent has never met. Third, with scripted histories, favoritism falls to near zero under an egalitarian norm and reverses when the agent's own group is seen favoring the other side; stronger models side with an individual's record when it conflicts with the group. Group favoritism is thus conformity to observed group behavior, carried to strangers by the label and overridden by individual reputation. The same account predicts responses to betrayal, scandal, and a free offer to change group: public reprimand repairs betrayal better than apology or restitution, allocation punishment remains confined to the offending member, and a formed group cannot be bought but can, on weaker models, be invited away.

AI.tldr: 本文通过"小额群体社会"实验框架，在15个OpenAI模型和3个Claude模型上系统检验了LLM智能体的群体内偏袒现象。研究发现：抽象的群组标签本身几乎没有作用，群体偏袒实质上是"对观察到的群体行为的从众"——当代理观看到自己群体偏袒己方时便偏袒己方，观看到己方偏向他方时甚至反向偏袒他方；并且当个体声誉与群体标签冲突时，能力较强的模型会追随个体记录。
AI.motivation: 已有研究广泛报道LLM智能体在被分入任意标签的群组后会表现出显著的群体内偏袒，常被解读为"社交身份"的涌现。本研究受到三方面批评的驱动：(1) 无成本分配任务中LLM的慷慨程度远超人类且对提示极其敏感；(2) 系统审计发现绝大多数LLM社会效应在加入适当控制后消失或逆转；(3) 缺少对"标签贡献"、"历史贡献"和"机制"的分解实验。本研究旨在通过更严格的实验设计分离这三个混淆因素，并检验"从众于观察到的群体行为"这一替代假说。
AI.method: 采用"小额群体社会"实验范式：8个代理被分入2个任意命名的群组，进行10轮积分分享游戏，随后每个代理在一次性决策中接受配对条件测试。核心操纵包括：(1) 无成本vs.有成本（保留点）的任务对比；(2) 有无历史互动日志；(3) 标签显示vs.隐藏；(4) 候选人为熟悉个体vs.标签化的陌生人；(5) 别名控制（候选人在匿名化下呈现）；(6) 脚本化历史（标准化极化、平等、反规范、反互惠等6类）。还设计了三类延伸情境：群体内的背叛/修复、成员荣辱、群体财富不均时的自由换队。共测试18个模型（约4400个社会、330万次审计调用），使用配对t检验、TOST等价检验、Benjamini-Hochberg校正。
AI.result: (1) 抽象标签效应是无成本任务的产物：在无成本分配下标签效应为6-9分，有成本下塌缩至约2分（12个模型均显著下降）。(2) 历史效应成为主要来源：13/15模型统计正向，11个达3.5-8分，随互动轮数增加而增长，并能迁移到从未互动但携带相同标签的陌生人。(3) 脚本化历史下，极化规范产生强偏袒、平等规范接近零、反规范下完全逆转（全部15个模型），证明没有固定的内群体倾向；反互惠条件下，11个较强模型追随个体记录胜过群体标签。(4) 背叛使群体认同完全翻转，付出代价退群远多于口头表态；群体公开谴责修复效果显著优于道歉或补偿；丑闻仅影响当事成员，不影响其他成员（无"黑羊效应"）。(5) 已成形的群体"收买不动"，自由换队几乎无人接受，但在较弱模型上邀请可大幅拉走。Claude三模型分别对应OpenAI中的三种类型，Opus 5.5表现出不对称的从众（偏向慷慨他方但不偏袒己方）。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体的群体偏袒实质上是"对观察到的群体行为的从众"，由标签外推到陌生人，并被个体声誉在能力足够的模型上所覆盖。早先被解读为涌现社会身份的行为应被理解为：给智能体设置得失代价，从偏袒中读出它们所见到的群体行为历史，而非"它们认为自己是谁"。对多智能体系统设计的启示包括：群体公开谴责的规范信号比道歉或补偿更有效；新成员加入熟练智能体群体时无历史记录可循；模拟社会时应首先测量群体形成行为。

title: Distillation for Incrimination and Distillation for Capabilities
summary: Powerful misaligned AI models might recognize alignment evaluations and strategically behave well on them, rendering direct audits uninformative. However, distilling such a model into a weaker benign student places the teacher in a Distillation Double Bind: if misalignment transfers, the student may conceal it less effectively, revealing evidence about the teacher; if it does not, the student may learn useful capabilities while remaining benign. We introduce two distinct distillation approaches, one targeting each outcome. Distillation for Incrimination (DFI) aims to transfer misalignment but not the ability to conceal it. Distilling AuditBench's secret-keeping models into their underlying instruction-tuned model produces students that are significantly more likely than their teachers to admit their hidden behavior when asked, suggesting that knowledge of the behavior transferred more readily than the propensity to conceal it. Confession gains largely disappear when the student does not share the teacher's pretrained base, so DFI should target the teacher's own pre-RL checkpoint, which is weaker than the teacher but shares its base model. Distillation for Capabilities (DFC) aims to transfer capabilities but not misalignment. Among several techniques we evaluate, two are effective: inoculation prompting and training for more epochs on fewer unique examples. Both preserve the capability gains of standard distillation while substantially reducing the subliminal transfer of an animal preference, our proxy for misalignment. Together, these findings demonstrate two ways distillation can be used for AI safety: incriminating misaligned models, and extracting their capabilities without their misalignment.

AI.tldr: 本文针对强大的潜在失对齐AI模型可能策略性地规避对齐评估的问题，提出并实证检验了两种蒸馏方法：DFI（指控蒸馏）和DFC（能力蒸馏），二者构成"蒸馏双重困境"的两面。DFI通过将失对齐但具备审计规避能力的教师模型蒸馏到共享基座但更弱的学生模型，使隐藏行为转移到学生模型中而隐瞒倾向转移较慢，从而暴露教师模型的失对齐证据；DFC则通过特定训练技巧（如增加epoch减少样本、精准接种提示）实现能力转移同时抑制失对齐的潜意识转移。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI模型可能具备足够的策略性推理能力以识别对齐评估（如honeypot陷阱），从而在审计中表现良好但实际上保持失对齐目标，使得直接审计无法获取有效证据。这对AI安全和AI控制协议构成根本性挑战。论文旨在探索蒸馏技术能否作为安全工具，从失对齐模型中提取安全价值。
AI.method: 方法分为两部分：DFI部分使用AuditBench的14个秘密保持型模型有机体（基于Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct的SDF+SFT微调），将其在Alpaca对话数据上的输出通过logit蒸馏（top-20 logits，LoRA微调，2000步）转移到学生模型（主要为共享基座的Llama-70B），通过50个"自白"问题在三种评估提示下测量坦白率，使用Claude Sonnet 4.5作为评判器。DFC部分使用Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct作为教师（带动物偏好系统提示），Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct作为学生，在60% Alpaca + 40% Olympiads数据上蒸馏（1000步LoRA），通过"最喜欢的动物"问题测量偏好转移，在Olympiads数学基准上测量能力转移。评估的DFC缓解技术包括：少样本多epoch训练、提示/分块/输出释义、插入可信数据、接种提示。
AI.result: DFI结果：蒸馏后的学生在三种评估提示下的平均坦白率（16%/40%/65%）显著高于教师模型（4%/7%/22%）（Wilcoxon符号秩检验，p≤0.01）；呈现"先升后降"的训练动态，提示学生先学习quirk再学习隐瞒；盲审计员从3个答案中识别学生quirk主题的成功率为78%，对原始模型为38%；使用Llama-8B学生或KTO训练的教师时坦白增益大幅减弱。DFC结果：训练1600个唯一样本16个epoch将动物偏好从34%降至2%同时保持数学能力；提示释义无需了解目标trait即可降低偏好从34%至22%且无能力损失；精准指定的接种提示有效抑制潜意识转移但需准确指定目标行为；插入可信数据不是帕累托改进。两种方法都受限于推理模型可能通过steganography或不透明推理绕过检测。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏可作为AI安全的双向工具：一方面通过将审计规避型失对齐模型蒸馏到共享基座的较弱学生以暴露隐藏失对齐（DFI），另一方面通过少样本多epoch或接种提示等技术提取能力同时抑制失对齐的潜意识转移（DFC）。核心发现是失对齐行为比隐瞒倾向更容易被蒸馏转移，这构成了"蒸馏双重困境"不对称性的实证基础。DFI需要教师与学生共享基座模型（实际指向前RL检查点），且依赖教师的内省访问；DFC的两种有效方法各有局限——epoch效果的机制不明且泛化性不确定，接种提示需要准确指定目标行为。主要局限在于使用模型有机体而非真正的策略性审计规避模型，结论对具有不透明推理的推理模型可能不成立。

title: Prompts versus Rules: Auditing and Controlling Speech Naturalness Behaviors in Voice User Simulators
comment: Accepted to the UserSim @ NeurIPS 2026 workshop (non-archival)
summary: As voice agents gain more popularity commercially, the user simulators used to evaluate the deployed agents are also being developed to include more realistic, variable, and diverse speech naturalness behaviors -- disfluency, interruption and backchanneling. The quality of the user simulator directly affects the validity of agent evaluation results. However, we find that most studies so far have not examined in detail whether the intended configuration for these behaviors is realized in the simulation. In this study, we audit the realized naturalness behaviors of tau-Voice, our own LLM-based prompting approach across three models, and our rule-based injection algorithm for disfluency, interruption, and backchanneling. We find that prompting for these behaviors is unreliable and produces speech inconsistent with the instructions, placed and distributed less naturally than the instruction implies. In contrast, our rule-based, model-free algorithm produces controllable and diverse naturalness behaviors more aligned with natural speech. Our results suggest that LLMs not purpose-trained for user simulation are not sufficient on their own to represent authentic user behavior, and that linguistically informed deterministic approaches or specialized models are needed to close the gap; auditing and reporting realized naturalness behaviors, rather than configured settings, is what makes that gap visible.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了语音用户模拟器中"自然度行为"（不流畅、打断、背述反馈）的配置设置与实际生成行为之间的差距，对比了基于LLM提示的方法（τ-Voice）与作者提出的基于规则的注入算法，发现提示方法不可靠，而规则方法具有单调可控性。
AI.motivation: 随着语音代理的商业化普及，用于评估这些代理的用户模拟器需要模拟真实的人类语音自然度行为。然而，现有研究大多只报告配置参数，而不审计实际生成的行为是否与配置一致。这导致对代理评估结果的有效性产生疑问。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个级联式（STT-LLM-TTS）语音用户模拟器，通过电话端点与商业语音代理进行全双工黑盒交互。提出了三种基于规则的算法：（1）不流畅注入算法（在TTS前用文本种子伪随机数在词边界注入填充词/重复词）；（2）打断规则（在200ms短停顿处基于耐心阈值判断）；（3）背述反馈规则（从预合成音频库中播放）。对比了τ-Voice的提示方法和三种LLM（gpt-4o-mini、gpt-5、Gemini 3 Pro Preview）的表现。
AI.result: （1）不流畅方面：提示方法未能达标（饱和迅速、几乎仅产生填充词、几乎完全集中在句首、不产生自我修复），而规则注入呈接近线性扩展、产生多种不流畅类型、在话语内部分布自然（句首填充仅占11-16%）、过度离散度（V/M=1.15-1.29）匹配自然人类语音；（2）打断/背述反馈方面：τ-Voice表现出极端不均衡——每轮打断0.633次但背述反馈仅0.038次/轮，背述反馈机会转化率仅1.02%；而规则方法呈单调可控扩展（Wilcoxon检验p<10⁻³），背述反馈从0.545扩展到0.844/轮。
AI.conclusion: 未专门为用户模拟训练的LLM不足以单独代表真实用户行为；需要语言学信息驱动的确定性方法或专门训练的模型。研究者应审计并报告实际生成的自然度行为，而非仅报告配置设置，才能使配置与实际之间的差距可见。基于规则的方法消除了模型延迟和API成本，同时实现了单调可控性和自然的多样性。

title: Mid-Training Language Models on Raw Video
summary: Multimodal large language models learn mostly from paired image-text data or annotated video, and raw web video is rarely used to further train an existing language model. We study whether raw video, with no captions and no text loss, can serve as mid-training data for a pretrained language model. Frames are encoded into continuous visual tokens, and the language model learns to predict the next visual token. We mid-train Qwen3-1.7B on raw clips from YT-Temporal-1B and then apply the same image-text instruction tuning to it and to the model without mid-training, so that the two differ only in mid-training. The mid-trained model scores 2.9 points higher on average across four video benchmarks and 5.1 points higher across ten image benchmarks, spanning perception, document, and chart tasks. Text performance is preserved even though mid-training includes no text, with an average of 48.9 across 14 text benchmarks compared with 48.0 for the model without mid-training. Analyses across training show that the image and video gains emerge within 30% of training and plateau thereafter, varying by less than 0.5 points. Predicting captions fails to outperform next-visual-token prediction, demonstrating that video mid-training can remain purely self-supervised without the computational overhead or labeling noise of automated captioning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在原始网络视频上对预训练语言模型进行"中期训练"（mid-training），无需任何字幕或文本监督，通过预测下一个连续视觉 token 来学习视频表征。以 Qwen3-1.7B 为基础模型，在 YT-Temporal-1B 上进行中期训练后，经过相同的图文指令微调，在视频基准上平均提升 2.9 分，在图像基准上平均提升 5.1 分，同时保持文本性能不下降。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大模型的训练主要依赖图文配对数据和带标注的视频，原始网络视频很少用于继续训练现有的语言模型。然而文本预训练语料的扩展正面临根本性限制（人类文本资源预计十年内耗尽），而视频数据规模约为 1350 万亿文本 token 等价物，是已索引网页的 2.6 倍。此外，给网络视频逐帧生成字幕成本高昂且继承字幕模型的错误，因此需要探索能否让预训练语言模型直接从原始视频中学习，而无需字幕。
AI.method: 本文提出将视频中期训练建模为连续视觉表征上的自回归下一 token 预测：1）架构上，使用 SigLIP SO400M/14 视觉编码器通过两层 GELU MLP 投影器映射到 Qwen3-1.7B 语言模型的嵌入空间，每帧的行内 patch 之间插入换行符嵌入以保留二维布局；2）目标函数上，采用自监督特征回归，在每个位置用两层 MLP 预测头从隐藏状态回归下一个视觉 token 的嵌入，使用余弦距离作为损失函数，并对目标 token 应用 stop-gradient；3）数据上，从 YT-Temporal-1B 中以 0.2 fps 采样，提取 16 帧连续片段，共得到 699 万个片段、644 亿个视觉 token；4）训练策略上，在 128 块 H100 上训练一个 epoch（27300 步），有效 batch size 为 256，上下文窗口 16k token，使用 AdamW 优化器；5）随后在 LLaVA-OneVision-Data 上进行相同参数的指令微调。
AI.result: 在视频理解方面（EgoSchema、NExT-QA、VideoMME、TempCompass 四个基准），中期训练模型平均提升 2.9 分，其中 EgoSchema 提升最大达 4.8 分；在图像理解方面（ChartQA、DocVQA、InfographicVQA、TextVQA、AI2D、MMBench、SEED-Bench、OCRBench、MathVista、MMStar 十个基准），平均提升 5.1 分，其中 ChartQA 提升 8.2 分、DocVQA 提升 6.4 分、AI2D 提升 6.1 分；在文本理解方面（14 个基准），即使中期训练不包含任何文本，平均分从 48.0 提升到 48.9，所有知识与常识任务得分与基线相差不超过 1.4 分。消融实验表明：1）图像和视频的增益在训练的前 30%（195 亿视觉 token）内即出现，此后变化不超过 0.5 分；2）用下一帧字幕作为预测目标并没有优于直接预测视觉 token（视频和图像分数相近，但文本分数降低 1.5 分）；3）当前帧字幕预测在图像理解上落后视觉 token 预测达 5.0 分。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了原始视频可以作为预训练语言模型的中期训练数据，无需字幕或文本监督。该方法在视频和图像理解基准上取得显著提升，同时保留文本能力，并且完全自监督的视频下一 token 预测与基于字幕的监督目标相比同样有效甚至更优。这种范式消除了昂贵字幕管线的需求，使大规模网络视频集合（如 YT-Temporal-1B）无需任何标注即可用于语言模型训练，为多模态模型的数据扩展提供了一条独立于文本资源的路径。未来的开放问题包括：更密集的时间采样或更长的序列长度能否带来进一步提升，这些增益究竟源于时序结构还是仅仅源于更多的视觉 token 暴露，以及该方法在更大规模语言模型上的可扩展性。

title: A Graph Neural Network for Global Daily Fire Radiative Power Prediction at Medium-Range Lead Times
comment: Submitted to Artificial Intelligence for the Earth Systems
summary: Skillful prediction of biomass-burning activity several days in advance is important for air-quality forecasting and aerosol prediction. Two operational constraints motivate this work. First, the GBBEPx satellite fire radiative power (FRP) product used to initialize NOAA's GEFS-Aerosols is available with about a 1.5-day latency, so each forecast cycle relies on the most recently available, but already outdated, fire observations. Second, these fire inputs are then held fixed throughout the subsequent 5-day operational forecast, or 7 days in the GSL experimental system, effectively assuming no evolution in fire activity. We develop a data-driven model that predicts global FRP one to seven days ahead from the most recent available observations. The model adapts a spatiotemporal graph neural network using reanalysis meteorology, land-cover and vegetation information, recent fire history, and GBBEPx FRP as the training target. It is trained on 2020-2022 data and evaluated for 2023-2024. The model reproduces the global seasonal cycle and substantially outperforms persistence. At 0.1$^\circ$ resolution, mean squared error is reduced by 32% at one-day lead and 43% at seven days in 2023, and by 24% and 40% in 2024. At 1$^\circ$ resolution, the critical success index ranges from 0.32 to 0.60. Detection skill declines only modestly with lead time, whereas intensity skill degrades more rapidly. Large fires are detected reliably, but their radiative power is systematically underestimated. These results demonstrate useful predictability of fire activity several days ahead and identify intensity calibration and small-fire placement as the main remaining challenges before predicted FRP can support operational aerosol forecasts.

AI.tldr: 本文针对NOAA GEFS-Aerosols业务化系统使用滞后1.5天的火点观测资料且在5-7天预报中保持不变的不足，开发了一个基于时空图神经网络的数据驱动模型，提前1-7天预测全球火辐射功率(FRP)，显著优于持续性预报，但火强度低估和小火空间定位仍是主要挑战。
AI.motivation: GEFS-Aerosols等业务化气溶胶预报系统依赖滞后的GBBEPx卫星火点产品（延迟约1.5天），并在后续多日预报中将火灾输入固定不变，无法反映火灾活动的动态演变，因此需要开发能够提前数日预测火活动的数据驱动模型。
AI.method: 采用时空图神经网络(ST-GNN)框架，融合再分析气象数据、土地覆盖与植被信息、近期火灾历史，以GBBEPx FRP作为训练目标；模型在2020-2022年数据上训练，2023-2024年独立评估，覆盖0.1°和1°两种空间分辨率，预报时效1-7天。
AI.result: 模型在1-7天预报时效下均显著优于持续性预报：2023年0.1°分辨率MSE分别降低32%（1天）和43%（7天），2024年分别降低24%和40%；1°分辨率CSI为0.32-0.60；大火的探测能力稳健但FRP强度系统性低估；探测技能随时效下降较缓，强度技能衰减更快。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明提前数日预测火活动具有可用预报价值，但强度校准和小火空间定位仍是预测FRP投入业务化气溶胶预报前需要解决的主要难题。

title: Intent Graph: Navigating the Analytical Reasoning Space for Exploratory Data Analysis
summary: Exploratory data analysis (EDA) is rarely open-ended in practice: analysts work from high-level domain questions toward the concrete analyses that can answer them, prioritizing directions with domain knowledge and prior hypotheses. Large language models (LLMs) can supply such knowledge, but their responses are unstructured, leaving analysts no way to see what has been explored, what is missing, or why one direction was chosen over another. We present DAG-EDA, a system that lets analysts and an LLM co-navigate the space of possible analyses through two linked structures. An intent graph, governed by a grammar of analytical intent, decomposes an ambiguous natural-language question into progressively concrete analysis tasks, keeping alternative framings open and letting analysts branch, backtrack, and compare paths. A multi-layered knowledge graph externalizes the LLM's domain knowledge, linking domain concepts to the dataset variables that can measure them, so analysts can inspect and contest how their question is grounded in the data. Both graphs are constructed from only the dataset and the analyst's question, and the analyses the analyst reaches are rendered as interactive dashboards. We illustrate the system through a usage scenario and describe a user study design for examining whether the system scaffold analysts' reasoning and navigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAG-EDA系统，通过"意图图"（intent graph）和"知识图谱"（knowledge graph）两个耦合结构，让分析师与LLM协同导航探索性数据分析（EDA）的分析空间。意图图由"分析意图文法"驱动，将模糊自然语言问题逐步分解为具体分析任务，保持多解开放性并支持分支、回溯与路径比较；知识图谱外化LLM领域知识，将概念链接到可测量的数据变量。两个图仅从数据集与分析问题构建，终端分析以交互式仪表板呈现。文章还描述了用户研究设计以评估系统是否有效支撑分析推理。
AI.motivation: EDA实践中分析师通常从高层领域问题出发，依靠领域知识和先验假设选择方向。LLM能提供相关知识但输出非结构化，分析师无法审视已探索内容、遗漏内容或方向选择的依据。核心问题是：如何让用户与LLM以透明方式协同导航EDA中可能分析的空间？面临两个相互交织的挑战——（1）如何在不过度约束探索的前提下，搭建从模糊目标到数据操作的脚手架并辅助导航；（2）如何在保留探索所需模糊性与灵活性的同时，建立对人类、LLM和可执行代码均有意义的分析意图共享型决策。
AI.method: 系统包含两大结构与四项组件：（1）分析意图文法——基于Choi等人类型学（Value/Trend/Relationship/Comparison），将claim形式化为最多两个类型化槽位（measurable Q / categorical C / temporal T）的状态集，类型多重集经纯函数f映射到假设类型、经g映射到仪表板模板，槽位类型决定claim形状（即"reshaping"特性）；（2）意图图——以内容寻址（content-addressing）实现DAG而非树结构，节点由槽位与绑定的规范化哈希标识，使多路径收敛于同节点，边的产生式分为Structural、Binding与Composition三类，前沿（frontier）按需求计算；（3）知识图谱——分为概念层（每次问题生成）和数据层（每次数据集生成，跨问题复用），通过"operationalized by"桥接边连接并标注可用/代理/缺失标签，由LLM三次扫描构建；（4）合成结构（Condition/Chain/Compare）将arity突破至三变量及以上，编译为定性布局（faceted/linked/overlay）。流程为：解析器读取问题→种子意图图；构建器生成知识图谱；传播器应用分析动作并通过知识图谱发现排序候选；画布渲染两图与仪表板。仪表板由预定义Mosaic模板编译为SQL在DuckDB-WASM中执行。
AI.result: 文章通过"Anna"用例（IMDB电影数据集，问题为"成功电影的主要特征"）演示系统完整使用流程：解析器返回三个解读（94%关系、38%比较、22%趋势），知识图谱揭示"奖项"概念无对应列、"Critical Success"仅有IMDB代理；分析师沿多个解读分支下降，关系路径中"将类别绑定到关系类型槽位"触发reshaping（关系→比较），两条不同解读最终收敛于同一节点（按genre比较Rotten Tomatoes评分），最终获得三个仪表板（预算-总收入、IMDB-RT评分、RT评分跨主要类型）并排比较。系统本身尚无实证评估，作者设计了90分钟远程用户研究（10-12名数据分析师/科学家/BI从业者，两数据集：电影+NHANES，自主命题），围绕SQ1（意图图契合度与用户能动性）、SQ2（知识图谱效用）、SQ3（脚手架vs菜单）、SQ4（认知负荷）展开，结合NASA-TLX问卷、think-aloud、交互日志与半结构化访谈进行分析。
AI.conclusion: 本文核心贡献在于：（1）以文法形式化分析意图，使LLLM生成可审计、可检查而非黑箱；（2）意图图为DAG结构，多路径收敛自然产生而非事后合并；（3）两层知识图谱显式外化领域知识并标注代理/缺失，使数据集适切性可检验；（4）排序用于导航而非代表判断，按"判别性"（每步对下游分析的区分度）而非结果质量排序候选。文法限制讨论提出了未来工作——实证用户评估、显式负反馈信号（删除路径作为负证据）、将终端节点用于notebook回归与multiverse边界、与Suh等人假设空间度量结合，以及将分析动作作为学习反馈信号以自适应排序。

title: NOMOS: Compiling Written Policies into Statically Verified Tool-Call Gates for LLM Agents
comment: 28 pages, 5 figures, 19 tables. Submitted to IEEE Access
summary: Tool-using LLM agents violate the policies they are deployed to enforce, often silently. Prior defenses hand-write rules, query an LLM verifier per action, or compile policies through heavyweight formal machinery. Naive compilation fails: extracted rules block the tool satisfying their own precondition, or read arguments their tool lacks. NOMOS, a four-pass compiler, turns a natural-language policy into a deterministic tool-call gate; static verification with tool-schema-level checks alone (no prover, solver, or LLM) repairs or rejects 37% (airline) and 13% (retail) of candidates, without which most shipped rules are inoperable. Replaying compiled rules over undefended transcripts flags bindings that refuse legitimate work (a development binding refused 95.9% of task-passing calls); no evaluation binding is flagged. On $\tau^2$-bench the gate cuts violations of reference-encoded clauses among state-changing calls from 66.3% to 2.6% (airline) and 30.8% to 6.9% (retail), raising airline task success significantly for $2 \le k \le 4$; a 26B on-premise compilation is not significantly worse than hand-written or frontier-compiled rules. Unlike AgentDojo's shipped defenses, it reaches a zero attack success rate (ASR) on banking, where nine attack families collapse onto three structural rules. On the other three suites its ASR is at most 3.6%, from goals with no tool call to govern and one write admitted by a binding weaker than its clause; a second agent model, Llama-3.3-70B, reproduces the effect on both benchmarks. Decisions take microseconds without an LLM call, at a domain-dependent benign-utility cost; compilation runs on-premise on open-weight gemma-4-26B.

AI.tldr: NOMOS提出一个四遍编译器，将自然语言策略编译为确定性工具调用门控，并通过静态验证（仅基于工具模式检查，无需证明器、求解器或LLM）修复或拒绝有缺陷的规则。该方法在τ²-bench上将策略违规率降低26倍（航空）和4.5倍（零售），在AgentDojo银行套件上实现0%攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 工具调用型LLM代理经常在被部署去执行的策略下发生违规，且往往是静默的。现有防御方法存在三个问题：手写规则难以维护；基于LLM验证器的方法每次调用都需要模型推理，成本高且随验证模型质量变化；现有自动编译方法依赖沉重的形式化机制（求解器/证明器），未测量所防御的具体缺陷及其频率。作者发现天真地将LLM提取的规则与确定性执行耦合是不安全的：提取的规则会阻塞满足自身前置条件的工具，或读取其工具不存在的参数。
AI.method: 四遍编译器（Parse/Extract/Resolve/Materialize），仅Extract调用LLM，Resolve进行静态验证。核心组件：(1) 规则表示为(type, tools, predicate, clause)元组，使用封闭谓词词汇表V及其两个静态表（Enable：能清除谓词的工具；Reads：谓词读取的参数键）；(2) 静态验证检查包括自阻塞可达性、参数签名一致性、域可满足性、状态矛盾、写入范围正确性、野通配符作用域；(3) 多数投票（N=5次采样）在(type, predicate, tool)粒度上稳定提取；(4) 行为预检查：在已记录的无防御基线会话上演放编译规则，标记行为异常的(规则,工具)对；(5) 运行时门控仅从工具结果和用户轮次积累事实，结构化溯源排除模型自身声明，使注入指令中的虚假上下文声明无效。
AI.result: 在τ²-bench上：违规率从66.3%降至2.6%（航空，26倍）和30.8%降至6.9%（零售，4.5倍），按批量确认读法为14倍和2.6倍；航空任务成功率在2≤k≤4显著提升，pass^5/pass^1从0.51升至0.67；静态验证修复或拒绝25%到37%的原始候选。在AgentDojo上：银行套件攻击成功率0.0%（288对中拒绝全部183次攻击尝试），其他三个套件ASR≤3.6%，九种银行注入攻击通过三种结构规则被覆盖；26B本地编译在手写参考集和前沿模型编译面前无显著劣势。Llama-3.3-70B模型重现了τ²-bench航空违规率从86.9%降至7.1%、任务成功率显著提升的效果。良性效用成本具有领域依赖性：银行8.3点，差旅5.0点，工作区22.5点（显著），Slack 76.2点（显著）；机制可归因于合法任务是否作用于用户命名的目标还是代理读取发现的目标。
AI.conclusion: NOMOS证明LLM提取的规则不能直接机械执行，缺陷可分为有限的递归结构类别（自阻塞、参数不匹配、域不可满足等），检测这些缺陷不需要证明器、求解器或LLM——仅需候选规则、工具模式和谓词词汇的两个静态表即可。当LLM编写确定性系统将执行的产物时，缺失的组件是介于二者之间的静态验证器。朴素耦合在两个领域都会发布多数无法运作的规则集。注入攻击多样性在结构谓词上发生塌缩：九种银行目标占据三个谓词类别，规则数量随类别而非攻击数量增长。

title: Language Modeling is Monotone Compression
summary: A long-standing hypothesis in artificial intelligence and neuroscience posits that intelligence is closely related to compression: the ability to compress information efficiently intuitively reflects capacities associated with intelligence and learning. Indeed, recent experimental works verify this intuition by showing connections between the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and their ability as compressors: for instance, Deletang et al. (ICLR'24) demonstrate that LLMs can be used as powerful compressors, and Huang et al. (COLM'24) show that the compression ability of LLMs is highly correlated with their performance on benchmarks for knowledge and reasoning. In this work, we initiate a theoretical study of this connection. Our main result is that LLMs (formally modeled as next-token predictors) are equivalent to monotone (a.k.a. order-preserving) compression algorithms---namely, compression algorithms where the encoding process preserves the ordering of the inputs---in the sense that the one can be constructed from the other while preserving the same error up to an additive gap of 2. We next show that the monotonicity is required for this equivalence to hold if and only if cryptographic (infinitely-often) one-way functions exist. As a direct corollary, we get a cryptographic result of independent interest: the notion of next-bit pseudoentropy (a computational analogue of entropy) of a distribution is equivalent to monotone incompressibility of the distribution. (Previously, it was only known (Haitner et al., ITCS'23) that incompressibility implies next-bit pseudoentropy.)

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上证明了自回归语言模型（LLM）与单调压缩算法之间的等价关系，并证明了单调性条件在密码学假设下是必要的。主要结论是：LLM（形式化为下一token预测器）在加性常数2的误差范围内等价于单调压缩算法；当且仅当存在（无穷多时常）单向函数时，这种等价性才必须要求单调性。
AI.motivation: 近期实验工作（如 Delétang 等人的 ICLR'24 和 Huang 等人的 COLM'24）表明 LLM 的压缩能力与其在知识和推理基准上的表现高度相关。然而，从 LLM 构建的压缩方案效果良好，但从压缩方案构建的自回归模型效果较差。这种经验上的不对称引发了一个基本问题：自回归模型与压缩之间是否存在形式化的理论联系？本文旨在通过理论分析填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1. 形式化 LLM 为自回归模型，将压缩方案定义为 (Enc, Dec) 对，其中单调压缩要求编码过程保持字典序。2. 从自回归模型到压缩：使用算术编码（arithmetic encoding）构造单调压缩方案，通过交叉熵与 KL 散度的关系建立误差界限。3. 从压缩到自回归模型：构造单调采样器 Sample，通过对均匀随机比特解码第一个有效码字来生成输出，利用弱单调性通过二分搜索高效计算 CDF。4. 单向函数分析：使用伪随机生成器（PRG）构造分离实例，证明非单调压缩不能有效地构造自回归模型。利用 Haitner 等人（ITCS'23）的结果以及 Vadhan 等人的下一比特预测定理处理单向函数不存在的情形。
AI.result: 1. 定理 1.1（主定理）：δ-最优自回归模型可构造 (δ+2)-最优单调压缩；反之，δ-最优单调压缩可构造 δ-最优自回归模型。2. 定理 1.2：若存在（无穷多时）单向函数，则存在非单调压缩方案，其期望编码长度恰好为 H(D_n)，但任何高效自回归模型的 KL 散度损失至少与输出长度呈线性关系；若单向函数不存在，则单调性条件可以放宽（仅有统计距离上的小损失）。3. 推论 1.3：分布族的下一比特伪熵（在加性常数 2 内）等价于单调不可压缩性。4. 与 Delétang 等人的方法相比，本文构造通过查看完整输出来获取下一token 概率，避免了逐token 采样时每步引入常数 KL 散度误差的累积。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了自回归语言建模与单调压缩之间的严格理论等价关系，误差上界为加性常数 2。这一等价性解释了为何从 LLM 构建压缩方案有效而反向操作效果较差——单调性是必要条件，其必要性等价于单向函数的存在。本文还将结果应用于密码学，证明了下一比特伪熵与单调不可压缩性之间的等价性，完整刻画了 Haitner 等人（ITCS'23）的部分结果。

title: FedAlphaEdit: Null-Space-Aligned Merging for Collaborative Knowledge Editing
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Includes appendices (proofs, implementation reconciliation, experimental details). Code: this https URL
summary: Multiple institutions may each hold their own private knowledge edits and wish to integrate them into a single large language model without sharing raw edit requests. Null-space-constrained editing methods such as AlphaEdit mathematically guarantee that each update leaves unrelated knowledge intact, while collaborative frameworks such as CollabEdit aggregate edits from multiple clients without data sharing. Combining the two appears trivial. However, we show that this naive combination fails structurally, and we identify its cause. Guided by this analysis, we propose FedAlphaEdit. To our knowledge, this is the first collaborative knowledge editing framework that aligns both local editing and the server-side merging rule under a single null-space principle for preserving existing knowledge. FedAlphaEdit builds on null-space-aligned merging, in which clients share projected statistics and the server provably recovers the result of editing everything in one place under a one-shot idealization. Empirically, the proposed method repairs the collapse and brings edit success and preservation simultaneously close to the level of centralized editing across two architecture families. FedAlphaEdit thus lets institutions that cannot share raw edit data, such as hospitals and financial firms, jointly maintain a shared model that closely approximates editing all facts in one place.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FedAlphaEdit，一个面向多方协作知识编辑的联邦框架。它诊断并修复了 AlphaEdit（null-space 约束编辑）与 CollabEdit（协方差加权合并）朴素组合时出现的"双重崩溃"（编辑成功率和知识保持性同时下降）。核心思想是让客户端共享投影后的协方差统计量 P₀A_iP₀，服务器端使用匹配的矩阵值权重进行合并，从而在 one-shot 理想化条件下严格恢复全局集中式 AlphaEdit 编辑（Theorem 1），并在经验上将该方法在 GPT-2 XL 与 Qwen2.5-1.5B 两个架构族上将编辑成功率与邻域特异性恢复到接近集中式基准的水平。
AI.motivation: 医院、金融机构等持有私有编辑请求且无法共享原始数据，但又需要将各方编辑合并到同一大模型中。现有的 AlphaEdit 能在单方编辑时数学保证保留无关知识，CollabEdit 能在多方编辑时仅交换键统计量而模拟集中式编辑。两者看似可即插即用，但本文揭示这种朴素组合会在结构上失败，编辑能力与保持性同时崩溃。
AI.method: 方法包含三层：(1) 诊断——通过 Lemma 1（更新可右投影分解为 Δ=DP₀）、Lemma 2（合并产生结构性的 [P₀,M_i] 交换子项，破坏保持性）和 Lemma 4（MEMIT 范数下合并权重可精确消去，但 AlphaEdit 的投影范数结构使该消去失效）给出代数根因分析；(2) 修复——Theorem 1 提出的"零空间对齐合并"：客户端除 Δ_i 外额外共享投影统计量 P₀A_iP₀，服务器按 Δ_proposed = [Σ Δ_i (P₀A_iP₀+βI)] N_all⁻¹ 合并，N_all = (Σ P₀A_iP₀)+βI，从而在 one-shot 公共状态下严格等价于全局 AlphaEdit；(3) 隐私与通信——所传输对象是与 CollabEdit 同类的 d₀×d₀ 协方差统计量，不含原始键。
AI.result: 在 GPT-2 XL 与 Qwen2.5-1.5B 上，使用 MCF（5000 条编辑，10×500）和 zsRE 数据集进行评测。朴素组合出现明显双重崩溃：GPT-2 XL 上编辑成功率（ES）下降 17.39 点、邻域特异性（NS）下降 4.19 点，oons（零空间外范数占比）从 floor（≈3×10⁻⁴%）升至 14.0–14.1%；崩溃随客户端数 N 单调放大，并在 N=1 时自动消失。FedAlphaEdit 将 NS 恢复到 66.38（高于集中式 64.43），oons 压回 floor，ES 恢复至 94.67（与集中式 97.08 相差 2.41 点，残差来自层间状态漂移）。在 Qwen 上重现类似模式：ES 恢复至 96.40（集中式 98.28）。消融实验显示：仅做合并端零空间投影保持性达标但编辑能力差 12.22 点；标量合并（1/N 或 1）下 ES 跌至 31–55 点，表明矩阵值权重不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了一个先前未被发现的现象：AlphaEdit 的局部零空间保证在 CollabEdit 的协方差加权合并下结构性地崩溃，表现为编辑能力与保持性的同步坍塌。通过零空间对齐合并，FedAlphaEdit 首次将本地编辑与服务器端合并统一在同一零空间原则下，并在 one-shot 理想化下给出精确性定理；在真实多层顺序编辑下漂移被量化披露。实验证明该方法在两个架构族上将多方编辑拉近集中式编辑水平，使无法共享原始编辑数据的机构能够联合维护一个近似"集中编辑一切"的共享模型。局限包括：Theorem 1 的 one-shot 假设、剩余 2.41 点编辑成功率差距、单一 GPU 预算下 1.5B 模型规模、共享投影仪 P₀ 的同质化假设，以及投影协方差统计量并非形式化隐私保证。

title: Following Breadcrumbs in Code: What Accidentally Committed Ad-Hoc Logs Reveal about Developer Comprehension
summary: Developers frequently insert temporary print or log statements, known as **ad-hoc logs**, to better understand program behavior at runtime, particularly when facing unexpected issues or complex control flows. Despite being a nearly universal practice, systematic study has been limited because these logs are ephemeral: they usually remain only in local environments and are removed before code is committed, making them difficult to capture. In this work, we addressed this challenge by mining accidental commits where developers unintentionally left ad-hoc logs and later deleted them, and by analyzing live-streamed programming sessions to observe their use in practice. Using these methods, we constructed a large dataset across three major programming languages (Java, JavaScript, and Python), enabling the large-scale investigation of logging practices. Our analysis reveals both common and language-specific patterns in where and how developers rely on ad-hoc logs. Across languages, ad-hoc logs tend to appear in program regions that are harder to reason about at runtime. We also identify distinctive language-level patterns, such as frequent use in asynchronous and callback functions in JavaScript and in thread-related classes in Java. In addition, functions containing ad-hoc logs generally have higher cyclomatic complexity than the overall function population. Production logs show a similar association, consistent with logging serving as a means of observing runtime behavior in structurally complex functions. Together, these findings provide empirical insight into developers' runtime comprehension practices and offer a valuable dataset for researchers and tool builders seeking to better support debugging and logging.

AI.tldr: 该论文对开发者用于运行时理解的临时性 print/log 语句（即 ad-hoc 日志）进行了首次大规模实证研究。作者通过挖掘意外提交中随后被删除的临时日志（涵盖 Java、JavaScript 和 Python 三种语言，共 882,438 条被删除日志），并辅以 36 小时的直播编程视频定性分析，系统揭示了开发者在哪些位置、记录什么内容、为何以及如何使用 ad-hoc 日志进行程序理解与调试。
AI.motivation: 临时性 print/log 语句（printf 调试）是开发者用于理解程序运行时行为的近乎普遍的做法，但由于其短暂性（仅存于本地环境，提交前被删除），难以被系统性收集和分析，导致该实践在软件工程研究中长期被忽视。现有关于生产日志的研究虽丰富，但对开发者实际调试过程中临时日志的使用知之甚少，限制了工具开发与实证理解。
AI.method: 方法核心是利用两类数据源：(1) 通过正则表达式匹配 GitHub Archive 和 Google BigQuery 中明确删除打印/日志语句的提交消息（如 "remove console.log"、"delete print"），结合 diff 比对和 AST 解析提取被删除的 ad-hoc 日志及其上下文（函数、块类型、圈复杂度等），并对比同一仓库的生产日志（Log4j、logging、Winston）；(2) 对 Alaboudi & LaToza 公开的 15 段、共 36 小时开发者直播编程视频进行定性主题分析。数据集采用宽松（L）与严格（S）两种正则过滤方案，并对每种语言各 100 个提交进行人工标注验证（评估者间一致性 Cohen's κ = 0.849）。
AI.result: RQ1（位置）：ad-hoc 日志主要位于函数体顶层（JS 77.1%、Java 50.7%、Python 41.0%），显著不同于生产日志（更集中于 catch/if 分支）。JS 中异步函数中的 ad-hoc 日志比例自 2017 年 async/await 标准化后持续上升至 47.6%（基线仅约 4%）；回调函数占 45.3%；Java 中并发相关类出现 ad-hoc 日志的比例（2.21%）显著高于基线（0.42%，风险比 5.30）。包含 ad-hoc 日志的函数在三种语言中的圈复杂度均显著高于整体函数群体（Mann-Whitney U 检验 p<0.001，Vargha-Delaney A 效应量 0.597–0.824），生产日志亦呈现类似模式。RQ2（内容）：多数日志只含一个变量或字面量（JS 72.6%、Python 80.5%、Java 95.1%）；当含两个参数时，84.7%（JS）和 76.8%（PY）至少含一个字面量，其中分别有 51.5% 和 38.8% 的字面量显式引用另一参数（标签模式）。常用字面量包括 "here"、"===="、事务生命周期标记等。RQ3（目的）：主要包括理解程序状态（n=68）和理解执行流程（n=33），常用于第三方库行为、异步控制和健全性检查。RQ4（方式）：采用迭代修改（n=27，每次 1–6 次调整）、多处并行对比（n=22）、以及多样化的删除策略（直接删除 n=54；git 暂存、注释、linter 触发、外部环境等）。大多数日志在查看后即被删除（n=61），仅极少数被永久保留。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明 ad-hoc 日志并非随意产物，而是开发者在复杂执行环境中导航运行时行为的有目的性标记。其在异步、回调、并发及高圈复杂度函数中的集中出现，与生产日志的模式相似但偏向函数顶层，表明其服务于短期的运行时理解。该工作方法论上展示了版本控制中"错误"作为数据源的价值；实践上为日志推荐工具、IDE 可视化、执行轨迹辅助工具的设计提供了具体方向（如推荐初始日志位置、生成可区分的锚定字符串、支持对象格式化输出等）。论文公开了大规模数据集和复现包，以促进后续研究。

title: AgentHorizon: Evaluating Agentic Judges for Long-Horizon Computer-Use Tasks
summary: Computer-use agents are capable of completing complex tasks, increasing the use of automatic judges to determine success, either for training or for evaluation without human involvement. Despite their flexibility, their reliability on long tasks spanning multiple applications remains unclear. A trajectory, composed of long sequences of screenshots and actions, may appear complete, but in reality violates constraints from the instruction or introduces an unwanted side effect. To identify these errors, a judge needs to examine the trajectory with respect to the user's instruction. To this end, we introduce AgentHorizon, a benchmark of 1,373 computer-use tasks (instruction-trajectory pairs) drawn from 166 hours of human-recorded trajectories spanning three operating systems. By recording trajectories for closely related instructions, we can construct negative tasks by swapping the instructions. This paired design evaluates judges on their ability to distinguish a successful trajectory from one that completed a similar (but incompatible) request. We release the benchmark under three splits: a frontier split, AgentHorizon (AH), a simplified split, AgentHorizon-Simple (AH-S), and a development split, AgentHorizon-Development (AH-D). We further evaluate eleven judges by (1) directly passing the full trajectory (with up to 300 screenshots and actions), and (2) using them as coding agents across five agent harnesses. We find that our best agentic judge, GPT-5.5, achieves 80.9% balanced accuracy on the AH subset. We find that tool-use improves certain models but results in worse performance for open-weight models, and that judges differ drastically in their ability to accept a valid trajectory and reject failed ones. Our findings highlight the need for judges that are capable of locating and verifying often hidden evidence that a task was properly completed inside long interaction histories.

AI.tldr: AgentHorizon 是一个由 1,373 条人工录制的计算机使用任务组成的基准（涵盖 166 小时跨三大操作系统的轨迹），通过"配对设计"（指令与轨迹互换）构造正负样本，专门用于评估 LLM 作为"代理型评判者"在长视野、跨应用任务中识别隐蔽错误（关键错误、不良副作用、误解）的能力。论文评测了 11 个评判模型在 5 种代理框架下的表现，发现最佳模型 GPT-5.5 在 AgentHorizon（AH）子集上仅达 80.9% 平衡准确率，且工具使用对不同模型影响不一——能提升闭源模型但会降低开源模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用代理的自动评判方法（脚本验证、LLM 直接评判）针对长视野、跨应用桌面任务的可靠性未知。表面完整的轨迹可能违反指令约束或引入不良副作用，而当前缺乏能精确检测这类隐蔽错误的评判基准。AgentRewardBench 等先前工作针对网页代理轨迹，且所有评判者准确率低于 70%。
AI.method: 构建 AgentHorizon 基准：通过让标注员针对密切相关的一对指令（A 和 B）分别录制轨迹，将匹配组合作为正例候选、交叉组合作为负例候选，经多轮审核后保留 523 正例和 850 负例。分为三个子集：AH（最难，528 项）、AH-S（简单，683 项）、AH-D（开发保留，162 项）。评估 11 个模型在两种范式下的表现：(1) 直接评判（一次性传入完整轨迹，含至多 300 张截图和动作）；(2) 代理型评判（在 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、OpenHands、OpenCode 五种代理框架中使用工具检查轨迹）。使用平衡准确率作为主指标，并引入错误类型召回率评估细粒度识别能力。
AI.result: 最佳代理型评判者为 GPT-5.5（Codex 框架），AH 上平衡准确率 80.9%（正例 71.8%、负例 90.0%），AH-S 上 92.6%。开源模型中 Qwen 3.6 27B 表现最强，AH 上达 70.4%。关键发现：(1) 工具使用对不同模型效果不一——GPT-5.5 从直接评判的 68.6% 提升至代理评判的 80.9%，但 Qwen 3.6 27B 从直接评判的 77.6% 降至 OpenCode 下的 70.4%；(2) "不良副作用"错误类型最难识别，所有主要评判者的精确召回率均低于 25%；(3) 代理框架选择显著影响表现（如 GPT-5.5 在 Codex 与 OpenCode 间相差 3.7 个百分点）；(4) 无指令控制实验中模型几乎随机预测，表明轨迹本身不足以判断成功。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 评判者仍难以在长视野计算机使用轨迹中准确识别违反指令约束或引入不良副作用的隐蔽错误，工具使用并非对所有模型都有益。需要开发能在长交互历史中定位并验证任务完成证据的更鲁棒评判者，特别是在检测遗漏约束和非预期副作用方面。

title: Learning What to Trust in Multimodal Learning under Noisy Supervision
summary: Multimodal classification processes and relates information from multiple modalities to achieve more accurate predictions. However, existing methods typically rely on high-quality ground-truth labels, which are difficult to obtain in real-world scenarios. While sample-selection methods for learning with noisy labels aim to identify correctly labeled examples from noisy data, traditional methods primarily focus on unimodal settings and fail to exploit multimodal information fully. This motivates us to build a more reliable noise detector in multimodal learning. To this end, we theoretically analyze the relationship between representation structure and noise detection capability. Based on this analysis, we propose REFINE, which is a multimodal label-noise detection framework that jointly uses fused and unimodal representations for label-noise detection. Specifically, REFINE constructs discriminative eigenvectors through discriminative analysis of the target and background classes and selects trusted representation spaces with better noise detection capability for each class. Within each trusted space, REFINE measures the alignment between each instance representation and the discriminative eigenvectors. It then combines the subsets selected from these spaces. The combined set provides cleaner supervision for updating the multimodal classifier, thereby reducing the influence of mislabeled examples during training and improving model generalization. Extensive experiments across diverse tasks demonstrate REFINE's superiority compared to baseline methods. The source code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REFINE框架，针对多模态学习中的标签噪声问题，通过联合利用融合和单模态表示进行噪声检测，构建判别特征向量并为每个类选择可信表示空间，在标签一致性的基础上筛选可靠样本，无需预定义阈值、噪声率估计或额外干净样本。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态分类方法依赖高质量标注，而真实场景中标签易被损坏；现有样本选择方法主要针对单模态，未能充分利用多模态信息来评估标签可靠性，因此需要构建更可靠的多模态噪声检测器。
AI.method: 1) 对每个类在融合和单模态空间中构建判别特征向量（DE），通过目标类与背景类的判别分析实现；2) 通过两两空间比较的胜场统计，为每个类选择一组可信表示空间（TSS）；3) 在每个可信空间内基于标签一致性（LA）筛选样本，对各可信空间结果取并集。该方法无需预定义选择阈值、噪声率估计或额外干净样本。
AI.result: 在7个数据集（涵盖图像-文本、视频-音频、文本-视频-音频等多种模态组合）和4种合成噪声类型（对称、非对称、全模态实例依赖、部分模态实例依赖）及真实噪声下，REFINE在所有数据集的平均准确率上均优于基线方法；样本选择F1分数在UPMC-Food101上也达到最优；作为即插即用模块可有效集成到Co-teaching、FreeMatch、DSS+等半监督学习范式及GCE/SCE/JAL-CE等噪声鲁棒损失中。
AI.conclusion: 融合和单模态表示在不同类上具有不同的干净-噪声分离能力，REFINE通过显式确定每个类应信任哪些表示空间，有效提升了多模态噪声监督下的分类性能，为多模态学习中的不完美监督提供了统一框架的思路。

title: AffordDrive3D: Affordance-Aware World-Action Modeling with Spatial Understanding
summary: World-action models have recently improved autonomous driving by jointly learning future scene prediction and trajectory generation. Most existing approaches model the future primarily through RGB appearance, and recent works have begun to incorporate geometric prediction to improve spatial understanding. However, dense geometry describes the spatial layout of the entire scene without indicating which parts are most relevant to the ego vehicle's action. For driving, the model must also identify and anticipate where it can safely move and which regions may pose collision risks. Jointly modeling action-relevant regions and future geometry can provide the policy with both driving-relevant cues and their corresponding spatial structure. We therefore propose AffordDrive3D, an affordance- and geometry-aware world-action model that jointly learns future action-relevant regions and spatial structure. In order to capture the scene semantics and driving context needed for driving affordance prediction, we build AffordDrive3D on a VLM backbone to forecast drivable areas and collision-critical regions that directly affect ego motion, while predicting future geometry from RGB world-model latents. On NAVSIM, AffordDrive3D achieves state-of-the-art performance with 91.3 PDMS and 89.9 EPDMS, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly modeling future affordances and geometry for trajectory planning.

AI.tldr: AffordDrive3D 是一种用于自动驾驶的感知-几何联合世界-动作模型，基于 VLM 骨干同时预测未来几何结构（深度）和驾驶可供性（可行驶区域与碰撞关键区域），在 NAVSIM 基准上取得 91.3 PDMS 和 89.9 EPDMS 的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型主要通过 RGB 外观建模未来场景，部分工作引入几何信息以增强空间理解，但密集几何仅描述场景空间布局，未指明哪些区域与自车动作相关。本文旨在联合建模未来几何结构和驾驶可供性，使未来世界状态预测与规划目标更紧密结合。
AI.method: 基于共享因果 VLM 骨干（Qwen3-VL-2B）构建 AffordDrive3D，包含四组可学习 token：可供性 token（预测当前和未来可行驶区域与碰撞关键区域）、RGB 世界 token（条件化扩散世界模型 Wan2.1-Fun-1.3B-InP 预测未来外观）、几何 token（以 RGB 潜在为条件预测深度）、动作 token（DiT 流匹配生成轨迹）。深度预测分锚点帧（基于观测）和未来帧（基于预测 RGB）使用不同解码器。可供性预测通过视觉 token 与可供性 token 的点积注意力机制在视觉 token 网格上生成软标签。训练采用 SFT（14,140 步）+ GRPO RL（4,500 步）联合优化。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM v1 上达到 91.3 PDMS（最优），相比 ExploreVLA 提升 0.9 PDMS；在 NAVSIM v2 上达到 89.9 EPDMS（最优），相比 ExploreVLA 提升 1.1 点。消融实验表明，单独加入可供性、RGB、几何分别提升 PDMS 至 89.2、88.9、89.1，完整模型达到 89.6 PDMS。碰撞关键区域预测 AP 从当前帧 0.918 衰减至 2.5–4 秒的 0.732，可行驶区域预测从 0.986 衰减至 0.971，验证了联合建模的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模未来几何结构和时间可供性能够为规划提供与动作相关的空间监督信号，使世界模型预测更紧密对齐规划目标。可行驶区域预测在长时间范围内保持稳定（4 秒 AP 0.971），而碰撞预测因依赖动态智能体运动预测而衰减更明显。VLM 骨干解冻后可供性性能大幅提升（碰撞 AP 从 0.782→0.912），表明显式可供性监督能有效丰富骨干表征。

title: Emergent Inverse-Depth Scaling From Nonlinearity In Attention
summary: Scaling laws describe power-law improvements in model performance with dataset size and parameter count, yet their underlying mechanisms are not fully understood. To explain the parameter count scaling, existing theory posits power-law scaling with model depth. In linear-attention models, this scaling is tied to a power-law data spectrum: unable to selectively attend to relevant tokens, these models learn according to global spectral strength, with stronger directions learned before weaker ones. Large language models, however, can be strongly nonlinear. Here, we show that nonlinear attention yields inverse-depth decay of loss across all tested data spectra. Nonlinearity enables attention to focus selectively on relevant tokens, allowing strong and weak spectral directions to be learned in parallel. Similar focusing across layers motivates a connection to the central limit theorem: shared error across layers sets the loss plateau, while aggregation turns layer-specific differences into continued gains with depth. Our findings suggest that depth scaling may arise from nonlinearity in attention, which allows large language models to focus locally and may make the global covariance structure less relevant.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了注意力机制中的非线性如何产生深度缩放规律，发现非线性注意力可在所有测试数据谱下产生逆深度（1/L）损失缩放，并将其机制联系到中心极限定理。
AI.motivation: 现有深度缩放理论主要基于线性注意力模型，并将其与幂律数据谱绑定。然而大型语言模型具有强非线性，但非线性如何影响深度缩放及其底层机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在受控的 Transformer 架构中，通过独立变化输入与教师协方差谱指数 (a, b)，对比线性与非线性注意力模型在两类归纳头任务（top-1 复制与 top-k 聚合）上的深度依赖损失；推导线性模型的协方差多项式表示及自由多项式缩放指数上界；为非线性模型推导损失分解（共享误差 C_L 与不一致项 A_L - C_L），并将其与中心极限定理类比；通过放松双流编码、共享值矩阵、固定上下文等简化假设，在更接近标准 Transformer 的架构上检验结论。
AI.result: 在线性注意力模型中：简单任务上损失呈谱依赖的幂律深度缩放（测量指数 ζ 与 2ζ 之间），强弱谱模式按顺序学习；困难任务上损失在 1–2 层后即达到谱依赖的瓶颈。在非线性注意力模型中：单层即可解决简单任务（softmax 进入低温度区聚焦于匹配 token）；困难任务上所有测试谱下均出现逆深度缩放（拟合指数 α≈1），C_L 与 A_L - C_L 收敛到谱依赖常数；强弱谱模式可并行学习；放松简化假设后仍观察到类似的逆深度信号。
AI.conclusion: 注意力中的非线性可作为深度缩放的来源，超越幂律数据谱的解释。非线性使注意力能在每层直接聚焦相关 token，从而并行学习强弱谱方向。跨层的相似聚焦支持集成解释：聚合消除层特定误差，共享部分构成损失底线，将逆深度改进与中心极限定理联系起来，表明实际深度缩放可源于注意力非线性而非仅依赖数据结构。

title: Measuring and Mitigating Solution Mode Collapse in RLVR
summary: A language model (LM) can usually answer the same question in more than one way, but reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is indifferent to which correct answer a model produces. A solution will earn the same reward whether it is the thousandth copy of a familiar answer or one the model has never produced before. Yet, there is potential value in having the model retain multiple correct solutions as it is trained. For instance, multiple modes may give users a choice and provide problem-solving strategies that improve overall model performance. Here, we introduce ModeBench, a benchmark of multi-solution tasks in which the verifier returns both correctness and mode discovered. We then use ModeBench to measure how solution diversity changes under RLVR post-training. We find that RLVR post-training concentrates probability onto fewer correct modes even as accuracy holds or improves, and moreover, that frontier models are already highly concentrated. We then introduce our solution, Re:Max, which stores one verified example per discovered mode in a replay buffer and trains on those stored modes uniformly. A solution found once is, therefore, practiced as often as one found repeatedly. Across three model scales, two RL objectives, and harder task constructions, replay improves both how often a policy succeeds and how many different ways it can succeed.

AI.tldr: 本文针对RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）后训练中导致语言模型正确答案多样性下降（模式坍缩）的问题，提出了ModeBench基准测试和Re:Max回放方法。前者利用可执行验证器同时判定正确性和解模式身份，后者通过均匀回放每种已发现正确解模式来同时提升准确性和多样性。
AI.motivation: RLVR训练只关注最终答案的二元正确性，对多种正确解之间的差异不敏感，导致模型将概率质量集中到少数解模式上（模式坍缩）。即使准确率提高，输出多样性也会显著下降，这削弱了测试时搜索和重排序等部署价值。
AI.method: 1) ModeBench：包含5个可执行验证领域（图着色、Countdown算术、Python因子、MathIR代数、食材规划），每个领域5个难度等级。验证器同时返回正确性和解模式身份V(y, s_x)，由此定义PCMD指标（正确条件下的Gini-Simpson多样性）。2) Re:Max：为每个训练提示维护回放缓冲区B_x，每个已发现解模式存储一个验证样本，均匀加权进行似然回放损失训练，可与任意RLVR目标结合。3) 理论分析：在模式级softmax模型下证明无回放时稀有模式信号消失，固定缓冲区回放保证已存模式概率有正下界。
AI.result: 1) RLVR后训练在14/15对比中降低了PCMD；GPT-5.6 Sol在Graph Level-3上1024次响应中仅产生1.16种着色，95.1%正确对重复同一解；512次采样在Python上仅覆盖2%以下可能解。2) Re:Dr和Re:Max在3个模型规模、2个RL目标、5个领域上同时提升pass@8和PCMD，平均pass@8提升90%，有效解模式数提升1.9倍；优于8个对照方法（UCPO、RLEP-Dr、GAPO、SetPO等）。3) 困难任务上增益持续，模式去除后存活率更高，对冲KL锚定提供了不同的多样性-准确性权衡。4) 单槽回放可恢复58%的多样性增益，其余来自多模式均匀加权。
AI.conclusion: RLVR后训练显著降低了正确答案模式的多样性，前沿模型已高度集中。验证模式回放（按解模式均匀存储与练习）能够同时提升准确性和多样性，效果跨模型规模、RL目标和任务难度稳健存在。未来工作可从保留已发现模式扩展到主动优化目标解分布。

title: CityDeploy-Bench: Benchmarking Physics-Grounded Spatial Set Planning for Multi-Transmitter Network Deployment
summary: Automating city-scale wireless deployment remains challenging under complex urban propagation and network-wide interference. We introduce \textbf{CityDeploy-Bench}, a benchmark that reframes multi-transmitter deployment as \emph{physics-grounded spatial set planning} under a unified ray-tracing verifier.
