A model integrating disease-specific, domain-adversarial, consistency, and contrastive learning captures higher-order dependencies in microstate sequences. Social pain yields the strongest NSSI discrimination, with 68.55% accuracy, outperforming the best baseline by 8.94% points. Model interpretation and conventional microstate analyses reveal weakened bidirectional transitions between MS3 and MS5 in DN+ adolescents during social pain. Source reconstruction associates MS3 with emotional/interoceptive processing and MS5 with action preparation, suggesting disrupted emotion-action coupling. Time-resolved analyses show greater early-to-middle action-state recruitment and later emotion-state recruitment in DN+ adolescents. In DN- adolescents, MS5-to-MS3 dynamics mediate associations between social-evaluation sensitivity and affective outcomes, whereas this mediation is absent in DN+; conversely, MS3-to-MS5 transitions are associated with greater negative affect in DN+. Together, these findings identify disrupted emotion-action coupling as a key neurodynamic mechanism underlying altered social pain processing in adolescents with NSSI, providing a mechanistically interpretable neural signature for objective identification of NSSI.

AI.tldr: 本文针对青少年抑郁症患者中非自杀性自伤（NSSI）的神经动力学机制展开研究，结合社会/躯体疼痛实验范式、EEG微状态分析与可解释深度序列建模（PatchTST+多任务学习），发现社会疼痛条件下DN+（伴NSSI）青少年存在MS3（情绪/内感受处理）与MS5（动作准备）之间双向转换的显著减弱，揭示"情绪-动作耦合失调"是NSSI的关键神经动力学特征，模型分类准确率达68.55%，并通过外部数据集验证了泛化性。
AI.motivation: NSSI在青少年抑郁症群体中患病率极高（>50%），且是后续自杀行为的重要风险因素，但介导社会性痛苦向适应不良行为转化的快速神经动力学过程尚不清楚；现有研究多聚焦于局部脑区激活或静态特征，缺乏对毫秒级脑状态动态协调的刻画，临床识别也仍依赖自陈报告，亟需客观的电生理标记物。
AI.method: 1）被试：106名MDD青少年（DN+67人，DN-39人），在静息态、躯体疼痛图片、社会排斥图片三种条件下采集64导EEG；2）微状态提取：基于GFP峰值的两阶段k-means聚类得到8个群组级模板，反拟合生成时间序列；3）序列建模：将微状态序列分块（patch=50），结合弱/强置换策略，采用PatchTST架构学习高阶转移依赖，联合优化疾病特异性损失、域对抗损失、一致性损失与对比损失；4）解释与验证：通过注意力权重提取转换矩阵、源重建（TESS）+ Neurosynth功能解码、时间分辨滑动窗分析、Bootstrap中介分析，并在HUSM与MODMA两个独立MDD公开数据集上进行外部验证。
AI.result: 1）条件比较：社会疼痛条件下NSSI分类性能最高（Acc=68.55%，优于最佳基线8.94个百分点），显著优于躯体疼痛（66.45%）与静息态（61.84%）；2）核心机制：DN+组MS3↔MS5双向转换显著减弱，源定位显示MS3对应扣带回/内侧前额叶（情绪/内感受），MS5对应中央前回/运动前区（动作准备），提示情绪-动作耦合中断；3）时序特征：DN+组在社会疼痛早中期（0-400ms、950-1450ms、2250-2600ms）表现出更强的动作准备状态激活，而在晚期（4400-4850ms）情绪状态激活增强；4）中介分析：DN-组中MS5→MS3中介了社会评价敏感性与抑郁/负性情绪的关系（间接效应=-0.206/-0.232），而DN+组该中介消失；MS3→MS5在DN+组中与更高的主观负性情绪显著相关；5）泛化性：在HUSM（EC条件下Acc=82.17%）与MODMA（Acc=68.59%）独立MDD数据集上均超越所有基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将NSSI的神经机制理解从单区域/单网络异常推进到"情绪-动作耦合失调"的动态系统视角：青少年NSSI并非源于某一固定脑状态异常，而是社会疼痛过程中情绪/内感受系统与动作准备系统之间时间协调的障碍，表现为MS3↔MS5双向转换的减弱以及"早期动作偏向→晚期情绪过度激活"的异常时序模式；该框架提供了可解释的EEG神经动力学标记，为NSSI的客观识别与机制理解奠定基础。

title: Zepp: Accelerating Distributed MoE Serving under Relaxed Balance Constraints
summary: As Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models continue to scale, serving them increasingly relies on expert parallelism (EP) across a growing number of devices. Yet skewed expert workloads create imbalance across computation, communication, and memory, making load balancing a central optimization objective in distributed MoE serving. We observe that balance is not free: operations introduced to balance one dimension can themselves be expensive or imbalanced. This motivates us to rethink balance as a constraint rather than an optimization objective. We present Zepp, which directly optimizes the bottleneck communication in distributed MoE serving subject to simplified balance constraints on physical resources, i.e., GPUs and NICs. Zepp progressively optimizes inter-node communication across placement, routing, and execution. It first places expert replicas to reduce token communication under GPU constraints, then reshapes communication flows through split and merge primitives under NIC constraints, and finally partitions and schedules ex- pert computation to overlap the resulting communication. To adapt to dynamic workloads, Zepp jointly coordinates computation, token communication, and expert-weight movement at each iteration. Together, these designs allow Zepp to pursue the most efficient execution rather than a single-dimension balanced one. We implement Zepp and evaluate it against 7 state-of-the-art MoE serving systems, achieving up to 6.68$\times$ MoE layer speedup and a geometric mean speedup of 1.86$\times$ over the fastest competing baseline.

AI.tldr: Zepp是一个分布式MoE推理系统，它将负载平衡从优化目标重新定位为约束条件，直接优化瓶颈通信而非追求各维度的均衡性，通过专家副本放置、本地优先路由、split/merge通信重构和节点内专家交换等机制实现最高6.68倍加速。
AI.motivation: MoE模型在分布式推理中面临专家负载不均衡问题。传统系统将负载均衡作为优化目标，但作者指出平衡操作本身可能引入新的开销和不平衡（如专家复制/重映射引入跨节点权重传输、通信填充浪费带宽等），形成"平衡困境"。因此需要重新思考平衡的角色，将其作为约束而非目标。
AI.method: Zepp采用三阶段渐进优化策略：(1) 放置与路由阶段——基于历史需求复制专家并跨节点分布副本，配合本地优先路由在GPU负载约束下减少跨节点传输；(2) 通信重构阶段——通过split（拆分全互联通信并重新分配以缓解NIC瓶颈）和merge（合并冗余token传输、节点内预归约）原语在NIC约束下优化流量；(4) 自适应阶段——通过节点内专家交换（保持节点级专家覆盖）应对动态负载变化，将权重移动与计算重叠隐藏开销。调度上，dispatch阶段通信驱动计算，combine阶段计算驱动通信，形成双向流水线。
AI.result: 在4-32节点A100/H100集群上，对比7个SOTA基线系统（A2AV+GEMM、FAST、COMET、EPLB、EPIC、MoonEP、COMET+EPLB），Zepp实现最高6.68倍MoE层加速，跨配置几何平均加速1.86倍。弱扩展性测试显示在32节点、1MB负载时达到15.9倍加速。集成到SGLang后，prefill吞吐量提升1.32-1.92倍，decode延迟降低1.04-1.57倍。组件消融证实放置/路由、重叠调度和专家交换各自贡献递增收益。
AI.conclusion: Zepp通过将平衡重新定义为约束而非目标，直接优化瓶颈跨节点通信，有效解决了分布式MoE推理中的平衡困境。其渐进式设计（避免、重构、隐藏通信）在多种规模、模型和工作负载下均展现显著且持续的性能增益，为大规模MoE模型的高效服务提供了新范式。

title: Local Prototype Reconstruction for Text-Compatible Speech-to-LLM Bridge Pretraining
summary: Speech-to-LLM systems often connect a frozen speech encoder to a frozen large language model (LLM) through a small trainable bridge. The bridge is usually treated as plumbing, but it in fact defines the geometry of the speech-to-LLM interface, and the pretraining objective decides whether that interface provides a reusable initialization for downstream tasks. We study a transferable bridge through two complementary properties: global alignment with the text side, and local lexical manifold compatibility, where bridge embeddings remain close to the frozen LLM's input-embedding neighbourhoods. We make this property measurable with a fixed, head-free, timestamp-free diagnostic that applies to any objective, and show that next-word prediction (NWP) and sentence-level contrastive pretraining do not fully capture token-level lexical compatibility. We then introduce Local Prototype Reconstruction (LPR), a lightweight training-only regularizer that requires each aligned bridge token to be reconstructable from a small neighbourhood of frozen LLM token embeddings, with a hard single-prototype anchor as its limiting case. On multilingual ASR and speech translation, LPR improves transfer, with the largest gains on translation and low-resource adaptation. Crucially, our independent diagnostic correlates with downstream gains across objectives, suggesting that lexical manifold compatibility is predictive of reusability for speech-to-LLM bridges.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对语音-大语言模型（Speech-LLM）系统中桥接模块（bridge）的预训练目标展开研究，指出常用的下一词预测（NWP）和句子级对比学习虽能实现全局语义对齐，但忽略了桥接嵌入与冻结LLM词元嵌入空间的局部词法流形兼容性。作者提出局部原型重建（LPR）作为训练阶段的正则化方法，要求每个与转录对齐的桥接词元可从冻结LLM词元嵌入的局部邻域重建；同时设计了一个固定、无需额外参数头、无需时间戳的诊断工具来衡量该兼容性。在CoVoST2多语言ASR和语音翻译（ST）任务上的实验表明，LPR在低资源和翻译场景下提升最大，且所提出的诊断指标与下游迁移性能呈强相关。
AI.motivation: 在冻结语音编码器和冻结LLM之间的小型可训练桥接模块常被视为"管道"，但其实际上界定了语音到LLM接口的几何结构。现有预训练目标（如NWP和句子级对比学习）虽能优化生成或全局对齐，但未约束桥接嵌入与LLM词元嵌入局部邻域的兼容性，导致下游迁移（尤其是低资源和跨语言翻译）效果受限。本文旨在系统化研究这一接口属性，并提出可测量、可优化的方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出局部词法流形兼容性（local lexical manifold compatibility）作为衡量桥接质量的属性，要求桥接输出接近冻结LLM输入嵌入空间中相应转录词元附近的局部邻域。2) 设计一个固定、无需训练头、无需时间戳的诊断探针，通过参数自由的软对齐从桥接序列中提取转录对齐表示，并在冻结的LLM词元嵌入表中检索局部原型集进行重建，通过流形重建误差（MRE）等指标量化兼容性。3) 提出局部原型重建（LPR）：在句子级对比学习骨干上叠加一个轻量级训练阶段正则化器——采用低维查询/键投影进行转录条件软对齐，从离线构建的高频词元池中取K=16个近邻原型，通过余弦重建损失（soft原型重建）与硬锚定损失（hard anchor）的组合优化桥接嵌入。推理时仅使用语音编码器、桥接和LLM，所有对齐头与原型检索均被丢弃。
AI.result: 在Whisper-large-v3编码器与Llama-3-8B-Instruct LLM之间，使用约1.77亿参数的Q-Former桥接，在CoVoST2五种源语言（De/Fr/Es/It/Pt→En，约430小时）上进行多语言预训练。关键结果：（1）全资源下，LPR (full)使平均WER从7.75%降至7.22%（相对降幅6.8%），平均BLEU从39.09提升至41.11；低资源（约43小时）下，WER从10.28%降至9.08%，BLEU从35.24提升至39.49，翻译与低资源场景增益最大。（2）诊断指标方面，LPR将MRE从对比基线的1.835降至0.645，金标词元R@1从0.376提升至0.443，对齐熵显著降低。（3）跨目标-语言对的Pearson相关性显示，低资源设置下MRE与下游迁移增益的相关系数高达r=-0.90（ASR）和r=-0.88（ST），证实诊断与迁移性能存在强预测关系。
AI.conclusion: 句子级对比预训练虽能实现近乎完美的全局语义检索，但无法保证桥接嵌入局部兼容于LLM词法嵌入空间。LPR通过注入词元级重建约束，使桥接在下游多语言ASR和语音翻译（尤其低资源与翻译）中获得更强迁移能力。所提出的无头诊断在NWP、对比和LPR检查点上统一适用，其流形重建误差与下游增益的强相关性表明，局部词法流形兼容性是可测量的、有预测力的接口属性，应作为可复用语音-LLM桥接预训练的核心目标之一。

title: LadderEdit: Edit-Level Residual Compression for Memory-Efficient Lifelong Editing of LLMs
summary: Lifelong editing of LLMs requires storing thousands of edits after acquisition. A widely used family of approaches attaches one LoRA adapter per edit, which preserves behavior but grows linearly in storage. To address this challenge, we propose LadderEdit, a method that compresses each LoRA adapter after it is acquired. Each edit is first stored at low rank as a cheap sketch. We then check whether this sketch still satisfies the rewrite, generalization, and locality contract on probe prompts. Edits that pass keep the sketch; those that fail are promoted to a higher rank along a ladder until the contract is met. Because every edit retains some representation, coverage is maintained, and only hard edits consume more rank. Across ZsRE, CounterFact, and WikiBigEdit benchmarks on LLaMA-3-8B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen2.5-7B, LadderEdit tracks exact LoRA storage at 5.2x less memory and remains effective at 50,000 sequential edits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LadderEdit方法，将终身学习编辑中每个LoRA适配器进行编辑级残差压缩，通过光谱预测器与行为审计器两层控制，在保持覆盖率的前提下分配保真度，实现5.2倍内存压缩并支持50,000次连续编辑。
AI.motivation: 终身模型编辑存在存储-可塑性矛盾：共享参数或恒定内存编辑器随编辑流增长会丧失可塑性（无法泛化到重写提示之外），而基于检索或路由的方法面临编辑选择难题，直接参数编辑方法则因重复更新产生破坏性干扰。每编辑一LoRA适配器的方案保留行为但存储线性增长，无法扩展到长编辑流。
AI.method: LadderEdit是一种编辑级分辨率分配的残差阶梯控制器，包含两个阶段：(1)光谱预测器：对候选秩r利用更新矩阵的奇异值尾部Ti(r)与精确编辑的行为裕度μi^E计算分数Si(r)=Ti(r)/([μi^E]++ε)，选出低于阈值τ的最廉价秩r̂i（仅需一次SVD，无行为评估成本）；(2)行为审计器：在rewriting、泛化与局部性探针上验证候选草图是否满足合同间隙Hi=0，若失败则沿光谱阶梯r̂i+1, r̂i+2...晋升直到合同满足或达Rmax。还包含基于92% Frobenius能量阈值的降级策略与值密度RVD的预算管理机制。默认审计权重wR=1.0、wG=0.8、wL=1.2。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-3-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-7B三个骨干网络上对ZsRE、CounterFact、WikiBigEdit基准进行评估：ZsRE上T=500时LadderEdit平均得分0.97优于精确LoRA的0.93，T=1000/2000时与之持平；CounterFact T=2000时可靠性/局部性从0.71/0.93提升至0.74/0.94；WikiBigEdit T=50000编辑下达到0.86平均得分（Rel=0.75、Gen=0.84、Loc=0.98）；T=10000时持久内存从100.93 GB降至19.44 GB（5.19倍压缩）；预算匹配实验中双预算LadderEdit在CF/ZsRE达到0.862/0.866效用，显著优于精确缓存的0.434/0.420；谱预测器消融显示光谱+裕度组合以1.21次审计/编辑接近oracle的0.93效用（oracle需8次）。
AI.conclusion: LadderEdit将终身编辑存储问题重新定义为编辑级分辨率分配问题，提出"覆盖率优先于保真度"原则。其核心发现是约80%的编辑在秩1的草图下即可满足行为合同，13-17%的困难尾部需要秩2或更高，3-5%需要满秩，4-7%为压缩正则化（草图通过而精确LoRA失败）。在50,000次编辑规模下仍保持有效，为终身编辑提供了一种可扩展的存储原语，而非简单地通过丢弃编辑来减少内存。该方法作为表示层可与恒定内存策略、量化策略正交组合。

title: Characterizing Statistical Separability in TP-CRIV for Probabilistic AI Models
summary: Third-party challenge-response identity verification (TP-CRIV) enables an independent verifier to assess whether a claimant possesses a model identical to a remotely deployed model without directly accessing the reference model. However, for probabilistic AI models, repeated executions of the same query may produce different outputs and therefore different verification observations. This raises the question of how such stochastic evidence should be accumulated and how much evidence is required for reliable verification. In this work, we characterize statistical separability in TP-CRIV of probabilistic AI models. Specifically, we relate challenge-wise behavior of matching and non-matching provers to verification-level separability. The characterization explicitly describes how the numbers of independent challenges and repeated responses affect detection performance and enables the verification budget required for a target AUC to be estimated. We instantiate the proposed characterization for LLMs using open-ended challenges. The experiments demonstrate matching-non-matching separation, close agreement between theoretical and empirical AUCs, and consistent estimates of the minimum verification budgets. These results provide a statistical basis for relating probabilistic model behavior to verification-level separability and the evidence required for third-party verification.

AI.tldr: 本文针对概率AI模型（如LLM）的第三方挑战-响应身份验证（TP-CRIV）问题，提出了一种基于U统计量的统计可分离性表征框架。该框架将挑战级别的概率控制误差与验证级别的检测性能（AUC）联系起来，并据此推导出达到目标AUC所需的最少挑战数N和每挑战响应数m，实现验证预算的原则性设计。在5个LLM上的实验验证了理论AUC与经验AUC的一致性以及预算估计的准确性。
AI.motivation: 传统的TP-CRIV研究主要针对近似确定性的CNN分类器，而概率AI模型（如LLM、扩散模型）在相同查询下会产生不同输出，使得单次挑战-响应不足以支持可靠验证。因此亟需解决两个核心问题：(1) 如何累积跨多次随机观测的证据？(2) 需要多少证据才能实现可靠的验证性能？
AI.method: 1. 将TP-CRIV建模为验证者指定目标发生概率的控制问题，prover生成witness使目标事件在MLaaS上的发生概率接近目标值p_i；2. 利用二阶U统计量U_i无偏估计平方概率控制误差(p_i - q_i)^²；3. 通过中心极限定理推导聚合验证分数T_{N,m}的渐近高斯分布，得到AUC关于挑战数N和每挑战响应数m的解析表达式；4. 推导达到目标AUC所需的最少挑战数N_min和最少响应数m_min的闭式解；5. 以LLM为实例化对象，使用开放性挑战（开放式prompt+目标词+目标概率）结合GCG后缀搜索生成概率控制证据。
AI.result: 在Vicuna、Mistral、Llama-2、Qwen2.5、Yi五个7B级LLM上的实验表明：(1) 匹配prover与不匹配prover之间存在显著的统计可分离性；(2) 当N>1时，理论AUC与经验AUC的最大绝对偏差仅为0.028，吻合良好；(3) 理论预测的N_min和m_min与经验值高度一致（如Vicuna/Mistral/Qwen的N_min MAE<1，Yi的N_min MRAE约7%）；(4) 验证预算在N和m之间的分配对性能有显著影响——对某些模型（如Llama-2、Yi），增加独立挑战数N比增加重复响应数m更有效。
AI.conclusion: 本文为概率AI模型的TP-CRIV建立了统计可分离性的理论基础，通过U统计量和高斯近似将模型的随机行为与验证级别的检测性能及所需证据量联系起来。LLM实例化验证了理论框架的实用性，为概率模型验证的预算设计提供了原则性指导。未来工作将扩展到更广泛的prover模型、witness生成策略和挑战设计。

title: RideBench: A Large-Scale Exogenous-Aware Benchmark for Ride-Hailing Time Series Forecasting
summary: We release Ride-Hailing, a large-scale ride-hailing time series dataset synthesized from DiDi's marketplace data across 200 spatial areas. Ride-Hailing spans four consecutive years at half-hourly granularity and covers three representative exogenous scenarios: Weather Disturbance, Holiday Effect, and Large-scale Event Impact. Built upon Ride-Hailing, we introduce RideBench, a comprehensive benchmark for exogenous-aware ride-hailing forecasting, covering both regular week-ahead forecasting and long-horizon 8-week-ahead forecasting with up to 2,688 prediction steps. RideBench evaluates over 30 representative forecasting methods, including endogenous-only models, exogenous-aware models, and time series foundation models. Our results show that future-known exogenous variables provide clear benefits in regular week-ahead forecasting, especially under weather, holiday, and large-scale event (e.g., major sporting events and concerts) scenarios. However, current exogenous-aware models still struggle to fully capture disturbance-induced pattern changes under complex external contexts. For long-horizon forecasting, existing models cannot simultaneously achieve low pointwise errors, accurate broad trends, and reliable near-term forecasts. These findings reveal a clear mismatch between existing forecasting models and real-world ride-hailing requirements, highlighting the need for models that can better exploit future-known exogenous information, scale across heterogeneous areas, and support long-horizon planning. By introducing Ride-Hailing and RideBench, we aim to encourage the community to study these practical challenges in real-world ride-hailing forecasting.

AI.tldr: 论文发布了基于滴滴出行数据合成的大规模叫车时间序列数据集 Ride-Hailing，并构建了配套基准 RideBench，用于评估在复杂外生变量条件下的周级与8周级长周期预测能力，揭示现有模型在扰动感知和长程趋势建模方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测基准普遍以内生模式为主，缺乏对未来已知外生变量（天气、假日、大型事件）、异构多区域建模以及长周期运营规划需求的联合评估，难以满足真实叫车平台对供给调度和战略规划的预测要求。
AI.method: 1) 构建覆盖 200 个空间区域、4 年半小时粒度、共约 1402.56 万条记录的合成数据集 Ride-Hailing，涵盖天气扰动、假日效应、大型事件三类外生场景。2) 提出 RideBench 基准，包含数据划分、归一化、滚动窗口采样、全局多区域训练协议。3) 评估 30 余种预测方法，分为简单统计基准、通道独立模型、多元模型、外生感知模型和时间序列基础模型五类。4) 设计两类任务（1344→336 步周预测；4704→2688 步8周预测）和三类评估（整体精度、外生场景专项、日级趋势与首周精度），采用 WMAPE/MAE/RMSE/Acc./Corr. 指标。5) 进行外生变量消融、区域扩展、回溯长度、损失函数等系列分析。
AI.result: 周级预测中，外生感知模型整体领先，TiDE、CrossLinear、XLinear 等表现最佳，TiDE 在外生场景下相对提升约 10.4%；基础模型 Chronos-2 具备零样本竞争力，但仍落后专用模型；内生模型在外生扰动下明显劣势。8 周长程预测中，现有模型无法同时兼顾逐点精度、宏观趋势质量与近端可靠性；基础模型首周精度突出但趋势建模弱；增加训练区域数能从 10 提升至 200 持续改善固定目标区域性能；28 天回溯窗口最具性价比；MAE 损失优于 MSE 及频率/分解类损失。研究揭示当前模型对外生扰动引发的模式变化建模不足，且长周期多目标平衡仍是开放难题。
AI.conclusion: Ride-Hailing 与 RideBench 为社区提供了隐私合规的合成数据与统一评估协议，验证了未来已知外生变量对叫车预测的价值以及多区域全局训练的扩展性，同时指明未来需加强扰动驱动的模式建模与兼顾点级精度、趋势质量和近端可靠性的长程预测模型。

title: CARE: A Lightweight Plug-in Gated Correction and Uncertainty-aware Module for Long-term Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multivariate long-horizon forecasting is critical to electricity load scheduling and traffic flow management, and to financial risk control. Existing deterministic backbones output a single trajectory, masking heterogeneous prediction difficulty across horizons and channels and providing no localized reliability signal. We present CARE (Corrective branch with Aligned context and Relative-error Estimation), a lightweight plug-in that enhances any deterministic forecaster without architectural redesign. Operating in parallel with the base model, CARE resamples historical context to match the forecast horizon, learns residual correction patterns from this aligned history, and applies scale-aware bounded updates modulated by per-coordinate sigmoid risk gates. A multi-objective loss jointly optimizes forecast accuracy, residual tracking, risk alignment, and base-model anchoring. Across eight benchmarks with three representative backbones, CARE improves accuracy with marginal parameter and latency overhead. Its risk gates reliably identify high-error regions: on Weather, the highest-gate tertile exhibits nearly four times the error of the lowest-gate tertile, offering planners an interpretable per-step trust signal. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARE，一个轻量级即插即用模块，通过并行分支对任意确定性长期时序预测模型进行残差校正和不确定性估计，无需修改主干网络架构，在8个基准上以极小开销一致提升精度。
AI.motivation: 现有确定性长期时序预测模型（如PatchTST、Mamba、DLinear）仅输出单一轨迹，掩盖了不同预测步长和通道间的异质预测难度，且缺乏局部可靠性信号。概率预测器架构改动大，后验保形校准无法与基模型协同演化，堆叠式精炼增加推理成本，因此需要一种便携、轻量的增强方案。
AI.method: CARE作为与基模型并行的分支：1）通过对历史序列进行逐通道1D线性插值，将lookback长度对齐到预测步长T；2）使用两层1D卷积（核大小3，隐宽64）提取特征，并通过两个1×1读出头分别输出修正量δ和风险门logit z；3）对δ按基预测的时间维标准差进行尺度感知裁剪（κ=0.1）；4）通过sigmoid门G∈(0,1)对修正进行软门控合并：Y=Y_base+G⊙δ'。多目标损失L=L_pred+L_δ+L_risk+L_anchor，其中L_δ用stopgrad的基残差监督δ，L_risk将门对齐到归一化的相对误差图，L_anchor防止CARE绕过基模型。
AI.result: 在8个标准基准（ETTh1/h2、ETTm1/m2、Electricity、Traffic、ILI、Weather）上，附加CARE到PatchTST、Mamba、DLinear均稳定降低MSE/MAE：平均MSE相对降幅分别约2.65%、3.30%、3.31%。风险门G在Weather上的最高三分位误差约为最低三分位的3.78倍，AUROC达0.79，表明门值能可靠标识高误差区域。参数开销≤4.25%，推理延迟开销1–11%。消融显示尺度裁剪和各项损失项均不可缺。
AI.conclusion: CARE以极小参数和延迟代价，为任意确定性长期预测器提供了一致的精度提升和可解释的逐坐标信任信号。未来工作包括扩展到概率预测框架、门权重校准以及在更丰富协变量和大规模场景下验证泛化性。

title: PIVOT: Perplexity-Informed KD-to-RL Transition Scheduling for Vertical-Domain Few-Shot Distillation
summary: Vertical-domain few-shot classification remains challenging for small language models, as limited supervision makes it difficult to acquire domain-specific decision knowledge. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) can improve teacher-guided adaptation by supervising student-generated rollouts, while GRPO-based reinforcement learning can further refine downstream predictions. However, existing KD-to-RL pipelines typically rely on globally fixed transition schedules, ignoring that different samples may require different amounts of teacher-guided acquisition before reward-driven refinement. We propose PIVOT (Perplexity-Informed Transition Optimization), a dynamic transition framework that routes samples between OPD and GRPO according to teacher-evaluated sequence perplexity. PIVOT moves low-perplexity samples to GRPO for reward-driven refinement while keeping high-perplexity samples under OPD for continued domain knowledge acquisition. Experiments on Banking77 and HWU64 show that PIVOT consistently outperforms continued OPD and globally synchronized OPD$\rightarrow$GRPO baselines under the same number of post-warm-up student optimization steps, achieving stronger downstream performance and more stable training dynamics.

AI.tldr: 针对垂直领域少样本分类任务，提出基于教师序列困惑度的样本级动态 KD-to-RL 过渡框架 PIVOT，通过将低困惑度样本提前转入 GRPO、高困惑度样本继续 OPD，实现比全局同步切换更优的下游精度与训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 在垂直领域少样本场景下，小模型缺乏领域知识，需要先用 OPD 蒸馏获取领域语义，再以 GRPO 进行奖励驱动的下游精炼。现有 KD→RL 流水线采用全局固定切换点，忽略了不同样本的最优过渡时机不同：低困惑度样本已接近蒸馏饱和，可提前进入 GRPO；高困惑度样本仍需继续 OPD。本文提出应按样本级获取状态动态调度。
AI.method: PIVOT = Perplexity-Informed Transition Optimization。（1）对学生 on-policy rollout 计算教师侧长度归一化序列困惑度，取组内均值并在 mini-batch 内 z-score 归一化得到 acquisition-state score $z_i$。（2）按余弦调度逐步提高过渡比例 $r(t)$，每步将 batch 中 $z_i$ 最低的 $r(t)$ 比例样本路由到 GRPO，其余继续 OPD，损失为 $m_i\mathcal{L}_{GRPO}+(1-m_i)\mathcal{L}_{OPD}$。教师在训练中保持冻结，仅提供监督和困惑度信号。
AI.result: 在 Banking77（每类 5-shot）与 HWU64（每类 10-shot）上，固定 480 步后 warm-up 优化步骤，Qwen2.5-0.5B 作为学生、Qwen2.5-7B 作为教师：PIVOT 在 Banking77 达 80.26%（vs OPD→GRPO 78.05%、持续 OPD 72.47%），在 HWU64 达 85.04%（vs 83.09%）。在 1.5B 学生与更大教师（DianJin-32B/Qwen3-32B）配置下仍稳定提升 +1.03~+3.44。训练动态上显著缓解 OPD→GRPO 全局切换处熵与生成长度的剧烈波动。消融验证：低困惑度先转 GRPO 的路由策略最优，余弦调度优于线性/二次。补充实验表明数据增强基线（DataAug-SFT 71.75）无法解释 PIVOT 增益。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏质量与下游精炼就绪度并非单调对齐：更强的教师对齐反而可能收窄学生 rollout 多样性，削弱后续 GRPO 所需的可探索候选。不同样本的最优 KD→RL 过渡点存在显著差异，教师侧序列困惑度可作为有效的样本级获取状态估计信号。基于困惑度的渐进式异步过渡在步骤对齐的对比中全面优于全局固定切换方案，且对模型规模与教师强度具有鲁棒性。局限在于：未给出困惑度路由的理论刻画、实验限于结构化少样本分类、属于步骤对齐而非严格算力对齐。

title: PMTRM: Pseudo-Memory Temporal Re-encoding Module for Embodied Policy Learning
summary: Robotic manipulation often contains repeated motions whose local observations look similar at different phases. When these phases require different actions, a policy that relies mainly on the current observation may repeat completed motions or switch phases at the wrong time. To address this phase ambiguity, we present the Pseudo-Memory Temporal Re-encoding Module (PMTRM), a lightweight plug-in module with only 7.61M parameters that encodes a bounded history of executed states and actions into a latent sequence for existing policies. To help distinguish phases, a temporal heterogeneity objective penalizes positive similarity between distant positions in this sequence, while anchor and reconstruction losses preserve information needed for action prediction. The reconstruction decoder is used only during training, leaving the temporal re-encoder to supply history to the policy at inference. We train the module progressively on synthetic sequences and robot data, then jointly with the policy, using temporal masking to accommodate partial histories. This integration retains the original action head and action space and adds auxiliary losses to the original policy loss. Experiments with multiple policy backbones in simulation and on a real robot show improved task success on tasks with phase ambiguity, with little additional computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PMTRM（Pseudo-Memory Temporal Re-encoding Module），一个轻量级、即插即用的时序重编码模块（7.61M 参数），通过将有界的状态-动作历史重新编码为具有相位判别能力的潜变量序列，解决机器人操作中"相位模糊"问题（不同执行阶段局部观测相似但需要不同动作）。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作中常有重复动作（如按按钮、开关抽屉、周期性擦拭等），不同执行阶段局部观测相似但需要不同动作。现有方法依赖循环状态、记忆 token 或检索式记忆库，但集成成本高、需要策略特定的融合层。因此需要一种轻量、骨干网络无关的有界历史表示模块，以最小改动增强策略的相位区分能力。
AI.method: PMTRM 采用两阶段卷积时序重编码自编码器（E1 策略侧、E2 仅训练用），输入为带时序掩码 m^t 和特征掩码 m^f 的有界状态-动作历史 X∈R^{T×D}，输出保持序列形状的潜变量 Z∈R^{T×D}。三项损失联合训练：(1) 时序异质性损失 L_hetero（仅惩罚远距离锚点对的正相似度，K=32 锚点、δ=8 边距，单侧 hinge 形式）；(2) 锚点损失 L_anchor（MSE+余弦距离，β=0.05，防止异质性损失破坏动作语义）；(3) 重建损失 L_recon（γ=8.0）。训练分四阶段：合成数据预训练→真实数据微调→镜像-掩码增强→与下游策略联合训练。支持 ACT、DP、HACT-VQ、InterACT、GR00T N1.7 等多种骨干，视觉特征通过 P_v 线性投影拼接 C=[Z‖P_v(V)]。
AI.result: 在仿真（MuJoCo Button Press-and-Release、LIBERO Drawer Open-and-Close）和真实机器人（Airbot Play）任务上，PMTRM 显著提升存在相位模糊的任务成功率：(1) 常规操作任务中，ACT-PMTRM 在 Stack Two Blocks 完成率从 50.4%→58.7%，HACT-VQ 完成率 55.8%→62.1%；(2) 记忆密集型任务中，InterACT-PMTRM 在 Button Press-and-Release 上 CSR 达 79.7%、Drawer Open-and-Close 达 85.4%，真实 Wipe Table 完成率 70%；(3) 线性探针在冻结 Z 上相位分类准确率 98.1%（原始 X 仅 71.4%）；(4) 推理时 T=128 仅增加 0.42ms GPU 开销（6.2% overhead）。消融实验验证了各损失项和训练阶段的必要性，β=0.05 为最佳权衡。
AI.conclusion: PMTRM 作为轻量级有界历史表示模块，能有效提升多种策略骨干在相位模糊任务中的表现，无需检索式记忆或额外策略 token，训练和推理开销小。但其能力局限于有界历史内的相位和进度消歧，对于需要持久长程语义或空间记忆的任务仍需外部检索机制补充。未来在强化学习中可能需要对 α_h 进行退火或对奖励等效循环进行异质性掩码处理。

title: Skill Constellations: Tracing the Supply Chain of Agent Skills on GitHub
summary: Agent skills are this http URL instructions and scripts that AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex run with the permissions of their user. Developers share skills by copying them between repositories, which makes them a software supply chain without a registry, versions or provenance. The origin of a copied skill, the reach of a security fix and the repositories that warrant review are therefore unknown. Studies that record which repositories hold a skill at a single point in time cannot reveal who copied it from whom. We contribute the first dated copy network of agent skills, built from the git history of every this http URL in GitSkills and covering 2,193,119 skill adoptions across GitHub, together with an interactive viewer. A few repositories are the source of almost all copies, and GitHub stars do not identify them. Skill copies almost never change with their source, and a fix at the source therefore rarely reaches them. We fit a model of which repositories others copy from and use it to rank repositories for audit. Reviewing the 100 repositories it ranks highest prevents 14.9% of later adoptions of high-risk skills, against 0.5% for the 100 most starred, which gives security engineers a short list to check before a skill spreads. Platforms should therefore distribute versioned references rather than copies. Project Website: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该论文首次构建了GitHub上AI编码代理技能（agent skills）的有向、带时间戳的复制网络（"技能星座"），通过分析259,596个仓库中2,193,119次技能采纳的git历史，揭示了技能通过复制而非包管理器传播所形成的无注册中心、无版本、无溯源的软件供应链安全问题，并提出基于源选择模型（conditional logit）的审计排名方法，能在100个仓库中阻止14.9%的高风险技能后续采纳，远优于基于星标的方法。
AI.motivation: AI编码代理（如Claude Code、Codex）通过SKILL.md文件和脚本扩展能力，但开发者通过仓库间复制来共享技能，这形成了一个没有注册中心、版本控制和溯源信息的软件供应链。现有基于快照的研究无法揭示技能复制的来源、修复传播范围及需要审查的仓库，因此存在安全风险。
AI.method: 使用GitSkills数据集（2026年7月发布，涵盖2025年10月起的SKILL.md文件），从默认分支的git历史中重建有向、带时间戳的复制网络。通过"复制事件"规则（单次提交添加≥10个SKILL.md文件且至少一半已有lineage来自同一早期采纳者）确定复制源；使用条件logit模型拟合仓库选择复制源的行为（基于持有技能数、过往复制数、星标和年龄的对数）；在2026年4月1日时间分割后评估审计策略；使用Claude Opus 5.5和Sonnet 5.5进行标注（仓库类型和技能风险），并与安装器记录验证（94.6%日期误差≤7天）。
AI.result: RQ1：技能复制形成50个≥100仓库的社区，少数仓库贡献几乎所有传播（负二项分布k=0.086），目录批量复制驱动扩散而非单个技能传播；RQ2：星标几乎不能识别出度高的源仓库，复制出度识别未来传播的能力是星标的4倍；RQ3：仅11.1%的克隆组变更是一致的，单一所有者使一致变更几率提高3.32倍，仅20.9%的技能副本跟随源更新，修改副本多通过采用其他版本获得能力（如命令执行）而非自身编辑；RQ4：源选择模型排名最高的100个仓库在保留期内阻止14.9%高风险技能采纳（星标仅0.5%），新技能传播需数周，一副本跨平台代理。
AI.conclusion: 平台应分发版本化引用而非副本以建立可追溯的供应链；审计应基于复制出度而非星标并在技能出现的最初几周内行动；用户需主动更新依赖的副本；研究者不应从快照估计传播行为；该重建方法适用于任何通过复制复用软件的生态系统。

title: SACQ: Structured Decoding with Memory-Conditioned Refinement for Long-Horizon Forecasting
summary: Long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) models predominantly employ patch-based encoders terminated by a flatten readout head that maps the entire encoded historical memory to all future steps through a single shared projection. This implicit coupling of future positions obscures position-specific historical-to-future alignment and amplifies sensitivity to corrupted inputs and extreme supervision noise. We present SACQ, a plug-in structured prediction head that replaces flatten readout while keeping the encoder unchanged. SACQ adopts a two-stage decoding pipeline: it first establishes a coarse patch-grid forecast scaffold, then refines each future position through cross-attention over historical memory and merges the attention-derived correction with the coarse scaffold via a learned per-patch gate. To stabilize optimization under long horizons and noisy labels, we further propose a batch-adaptive scaled log-cosh loss that automatically calibrates robustness to the current residual scale, suppressing outlier gradients while preserving MSE-like sensitivity for typical errors. SACQ attains top-tier test MSE/MAE across PatchTST, DLinear, and patch-Mamba backbones with only modest incremental overhead in parameters and latency. Under inference-time input corruption and training-set label-noise stress tests, SACQ substantially outperforms flatten readouts, with ablation studies validating each architectural component.

AI.tldr: SACQ 提出了一种即插即用的结构化预测头，替换长期时间序列预测中广泛使用的 flatten 读出头，通过三阶段（粗初始化、记忆条件交叉-自注意力细化、门控残差读取）解码和一种自适应缩放 log-cosh 鲁棒损失，在多个骨干网络和鲁棒性压力测试下取得 SOTA 结果。
AI.motivation: 现有 LTSF 模型普遍使用 flatten 读出头将编码历史映射到全部未来步，存在两个核心缺陷：(1) 表示耦合——所有未来位置共享一组投影参数，无法实现位置特定的跨注意力对齐，对损坏输入敏感；(2) 优化耦合——MSE 损失下异常残差主导梯度更新，噪声标签下训练不稳定。该研究将读出头视为预测侧瓶颈重新设计。
AI.method: 1) 粗结构初始化：通过与 flatten 参数量相当的仿射变换生成未来 patch 网格粗预测 F，并构造内容嵌入与扩展位置编码得到初始查询 Q⁽⁰⁾。2) 交叉-自注意力耦合堆叠 L=2 层：未来查询经交叉注意力从历史记忆 H 检索，再与粗内容嵌入拼接-线性融合后输入自注意力与 FFN；最后一层映射回 patch 维度得到残差 Δ。3) 门控残差读取：通过拼接 F 与 Δ 的线性 sigmoid 学得每 patch 门 α∈(0,1)，输出为 F+α·Δ。4) SAR 变体：在未来 patch 自注意力上施加严格因果掩码，由近及远传播信息以抵抗尾部监督污染。5) 自适应缩放 log-cosh 损失：ℓ(e;β)=β²log cosh(e/β)，其中 β=k·m，m 为当前 batch 中残差的绝对值中位数，k=0.5；梯度不流经 β。该损失在 |e|≪β 时近似 MSE，对 |e|≫β 则趋于线性，抑制离群点梯度。
AI.result: 在 ETT/Weather/ECL/Traffic 多数据集多 horizon 设定下，PatchTST+DLinear+Patch-Mamba 三种骨干配合 SACQ 普遍优于 flatten 基线（综合 18/24 指标最佳，平均秩 1.55/1.16）。在 TSRBench 5 级腐败测试与训练集标签尾部污染下，SAR+scaled log-cosh 组合相对 flatten+MSE 的差距进一步扩大，且门控 α 在输入受 spike 污染时会自动上调以倾向修正分支。参数与延迟增加可控：d_model=256 时额外解码头约 +2.7 M 参数、+2.6 ms（总开销约 8.2 M/9.2 ms）。组件消融证实 cross-attention、门控、concat-线性融合以及粗初始化均不可省略；超参对 L∈{1,2,3}、k∈{0.5,1.0,2.0,4.0} 不敏感。
AI.conclusion: SACQ 将长期预测重新定义为带有粗-细两阶段结构化解码与记忆条件修正的显式预测映射问题，结合 batch 自适应鲁棒损失，在不修改编码器的前提下可作为即插即用读出头部署；其局限是引入额外注意力与门控带来的常数级延迟，未来将面向低延迟变体、严苛分布偏移与不规则 horizon 做拓展。

title: VAMR: Multi-Question Agentic Reasoning for Efficient Long-Form Video Understanding
summary: Long-form video understanding often involves multiple questions about different aspects of the same recording. Yet existing video agents typically process each question through an isolated tool-use trajectory. This repeatedly restarts video exploration and memory construction, missing opportunities to acquire evidence jointly and progressively build a shared understanding that supports the complete question set. We introduce \textbf{VAMR} (\textbf{V}ideo \textbf{A}gent for \textbf{M}ulti-Question \textbf{R}easoning), which coordinates all questions about a video through one shared tool-use trajectory. At each round, a persistent policy model can invoke tools for one or more unresolved questions and submit answers for questions with sufficient evidence. Question-conditioned visual perception retrieves fine-grained clues for several questions in one call, while layered multi-question memory integrates reusable context into a shared video story and preserves separate evidence for individual questions. After supervised fine-tuning initializes this interaction protocol, we propose question-horizon policy optimization (\qhpo) to optimize shared trajectories in which questions progress and finish at different rounds. Specifically, a question-level critic estimates the value of each active question, while round alignment maps each question advantage to the rounds that directly serve it before the aligned advantages are aggregated to optimize the shared actor. Across LVBench, Video-Holmes, and LongVideoBench, VAMR achieves the highest accuracy overall and the fewest reasoning rounds among iterative methods. On LVBench, it reaches 62.1\% accuracy, exceeding VideoARM by \textbf{4.3} points while reducing reasoning rounds and processed frames by \textbf{85.9\%} and \textbf{61.4\%}.

AI.tldr: VAMR提出了一种多问题协同推理的视频智能体，通过共享工具调用轨迹、问题条件视觉感知和分层多问题记忆，同时解决同一视频的多个问题；并设计了问题视界策略优化（QHPO）来优化具有异步终止的共享轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有视频智能体通常对每个问题独立执行工具调用轨迹，导致视频探索和记忆构建重复进行，浪费算力且无法共享跨问题的证据获取。需要一种方法能够在一次共享推理过程中协调多个问题，复用视觉观察，逐步构建共享的视频理解。
AI.method: 方法包括三个核心组件：(1) 共享循环的ReAct框架，将同一视频的所有问题作为并发目标在一个序列决策过程中处理；(2) QA-inspector问题条件视觉感知工具，在一次调用中检索多个问题的细粒度线索；(3) 分层多问题记忆，包含共享故事层和问题线索层。训练采用两阶段：监督微调（SFT）初始化联合动作协议，然后使用问题视界策略优化（QHPO）——通过问题级评论家估计每个活跃问题的价值，经过轮次对齐将问题优势映射到直接服务于该问题的轮次，再聚合优化共享行动者。
AI.result: 在LVBench、Video-Holmes和LongVideoBench三个基准测试中均取得最高准确率和最少的推理轮次。在LVBench上达到62.1%准确率，超过VideoARM 4.3分，同时减少推理轮次85.9%和处理帧数61.4%。问题密度缩放分析显示，问题密度从1增加到16时，准确率从58.1%提升到62.8%，每问题帧数从219.2降至87.7。证据重叠分析显示，即使在最低重叠分位（1.4%重叠），VAMR仍提升7.0分准确率，减少63.4%帧数。架构消融验证了共享循环、QA-inspector和分层记忆的互补贡献，训练消融验证了QHPO相比标准PPO的3.4分提升。
AI.conclusion: VAMR通过共享多问题推理显著提高了长视频理解的准确性和效率。共享循环提供主要的效率增益，问题条件感知和分层记忆进一步提升准确性，QHPO通过问题级价值和轮次对齐实现优于标准PPO的训练效果。跨问题共享的优势不依赖于高证据重叠，在不同问题密度下均保持鲁棒。

title: Higher-Order Action Supervision Makes A Strong Policy Class
summary: Modern data-driven decision-making methods, such as imitation learning (IL) and reinforcement learning (RL), have achieved great success in solving many complex tasks. However, these methods often suffer from serious control instability and robustness issues when applied in real-world applications such as robotics and autonomous driving, posing notable challenges for their practical deployment. We argue that this instability issue stems largely from their limitations in solely supervising and optimizing zeroth-order actions (i.e., the action labels), failing to account for higher-order action dynamics and temporal consistency. In this paper, we show that simultaneously supervising both zeroth- and first-order actions can dramatically enhance policies' performance and control robustness. To achieve this, we introduce a novel and elegant loss scheme supported by formal theoretical guarantees that can equip any off-the-shelf policy model (e.g., deterministic, stochastic, or flow policies) with the capability for higher-order action supervision, without requiring any structural modifications. Moreover, our proposed method can serve as a lightweight plug-and-play module that seamlessly integrates with a broad spectrum of existing offline RL frameworks. Extensive evaluations on OGBench and D4RL demonstrate that our approach yields substantial performance and robustness improvements across a wide range of continuous control environments. Notably, our method can also enhance policies' out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization capability in the challenging low-data regime, making it an ideal tool in tackling many real-world control problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种高阶动作监督方法，通过同时监督零阶和一阶动作，在不修改策略网络结构的前提下显著提升离线模仿学习与强化学习的控制平滑性、鲁棒性和小样本OOD泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动决策方法（IL/RL）仅监督零阶动作（动作标签本身），忽略了动作的时间导数（一阶动作），导致控制不稳定、动作抖动和鲁棒性差，这在机器人和自动驾驶等真实部署中尤为突出。传统方法依赖任务特定的正则化惩罚或限制网络表达力的架构修改来缓解此问题，存在局限。
AI.method: 核心方法基于链式法则：策略的时间导数 π̇(s)=∇_sπ(s)·ṡ，使得无需新增网络输出即可对一阶动作进行监督。为三种策略族分别推导监督损失：确定性策略采用 JVP 计算的均方误差；随机高斯策略基于 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 过程与多维伊藤公式推导一阶似然；流匹配策略对速度场 v 沿状态方向的偏导进行一阶监督。此外，将一阶监督融入 HJB 连续时间框架，在价值学习和策略优化阶段加入方向一致性正则项。理论上证明了策略误差和状态偏差在更紧的界内被控制。
AI.result: 在 OGBench（50个任务）和 D4RL（10k 小数据集及全量数据）上的大量实验表明，将所提方法以即插即用方式集成到 TD3+BC、ReBRAC、IQL、IFQL 四种代表性离线 RL 算法中，在所有任务上均获得一致且显著的性能提升。在小数据/低数据设置下提升尤为突出（如 walker2d-expert-v2 上 TD3+BC 从 2.7 提升至 82.3），且训练开销仅增加约 15-30%。在多个基线得分为 0 的困难任务上将得分提升至非平凡水平（如 IFQL 在 scene-play 上从 0 提升至 88）。同时在在线 SAC 上验证了方法的通用性。
AI.conclusion: 高阶动作监督是解决学习策略控制不稳定和鲁棒性差的根本途径之一。所提方法作为一种轻量级、模型无关的即插即用模块，理论上和实验上均证实了其有效性，特别适用于数据稀缺、安全关键的现实控制场景。局限性在于对原始像素空间监督成本较高且依赖良好的状态表征，以及有限差分估计的精度受采样粒度影响。

title: Who Pays the Review Cost? Triage, Fairness, and Accountability in AI-authored Pull Requests
summary: AI coding agents are moving from local code assistance into pull-based workflows, where generated contributions must be reviewed, explained, and maintained within existing project norms. Although recent work has begun to characterize AI-authored pull requests (AIPRs), less is known about how reviewers govern their entry into review, how AI authorship reshapes credibility and fairness, and what intake mechanisms protect review sustainability. We report a mixed-method questionnaire survey of 239 practitioners from 31 countries with code-review experience and varying exposure to AIPRs. In the scenarios and self-reports elicited by the survey, AI authorship was not a categorical rejection signal. Instead, respondents described review effort as conditional on whether an AIPR arrived as an accountable contribution, with bounded scope, project-grounded rationale, validation beyond Continuous Integration (CI), contributor responsiveness, and identifiable post-merge ownership. This conditional logic extended to newcomer AIPRs, where respondents emphasized visible participation in the current review process over profile-level reputation alone. Qualitative responses further described shifts in mentoring, scrutiny, deferral, and routing when human stewardship was difficult to observe. We conceptualize missing rationale, validation, and ownership as reviewability debt, the work reviewers must absorb when generated code lacks sufficient human grounding. These findings reframe AIPR governance around making human judgment observable before generated contributions consume scarce reviewer attention.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对来自31个国家的239名软件从业者的混合方法问卷调查，探讨AI编写的Pull Request（AIPR）如何影响代码审查工作。研究发现AI作者身份本身并非审查拒绝的标准；相反，审查者采用"条件性审查模型"：当AIPR具备明确意图、有界范围、超越CI的验证、贡献者响应性和可识别的所有权时，审查者才愿意投入审查精力。研究提出"可审查性债务"概念，描述当生成代码缺乏人类依据时审查者需额外承担的工作，并建议通过AI使用边界、风险特定证据、队列控制和责任人路由等治理机制使人类判断在审查入口处可见。
AI.motivation: 随着AI编码代理从本地辅助转向基于PR的工作流，生成代码的审查成本问题日益突出。虽然现有研究开始描述AIPR的特征，但审查者如何管理其进入审查流程、AI作者身份如何影响可信度与公平性、以及哪些准入机制能保护审查可持续性，这些问题尚不清晰。核心问题是：当代码生成变得廉价时，谁来承担昂贵的审查成本？
AI.method: 采用混合方法问卷调查设计，结合定量与定性分析。调查工具经过两阶段预部署验证（行业从业者审查+11人试点研究）。通过多框架目的性抽样招募参与者：来自AIDev数据集中有AI代理活动的仓库开发者、Apache基金会的133个活跃项目及其他49个成熟GitHub项目的开发者，以及通过LinkedIn传播。定量分析使用Wilcoxon符号秩检验、Friedman检验、McNemar精确检验等非参数方法，配合效应量指标和Holm校正；定性分析采用代码本主题编码，由两名编码员独立编码并计算Cohen's κ。
AI.result: （1）90.8%的受访者报告AIPR改变了审查沟通期望，77.8%报告PR审查量增加。审查者从协作式反馈转向证据导向的问责互动，主要主题包括：主动验证（62.5%）、意图/来源/所有权门槛（59.5%）、可审查性控制（45.0%）。（2）即使CI通过，所有8种变更类型的AIPR接受意愿均显著低于HPR；行为保持型重构差距最大（52.3%降至19.7%）。常见的延迟触发因素是模糊的AI生成描述（64.9%）和大范围无分解的PR（51.0%）。对新贡献者的AIPR，80.8%选择条件性处理策略，最看重当前审查过程中的专业反馈响应（82.4%）和测试证据（81.2%），而非个人资料级信号。（3）受访者提议的具体治理规则包括：AI使用边界政策（36.8%）、变更类型证据包（33.3%）、队列控制（17.5%）、基于风险的路由（15.2%）、生成diff控制（14.0%）和代理工作流卫生（9.4%）。更严格的AIPR处理在应对努力不对称而非仅针对AI作者身份时被视为公平。
AI.conclusion: 研究将AIPR治理重新定位为工作流问题，而非内容审查问题。AI作者身份本身不是拒绝标准；关键是使人类判断在生成贡献消耗审查者注意力之前变得可见。"可审查性债务"概念解释了当意图、验证和所有权未解决时，审查者承担额外工作。治理机制应嵌入项目工作流基础设施工具，包括PR模板、审查队列、所有者路由规则和AI使用许可政策。未来的工具设计应以可审查性而非仅代码生成为目标，编码代理应同时生成来源摘要、风险特定证据、验证日志和所有权声明。纵向研究、受控实验和现场研究需要进一步验证哪些证据形式能有效减轻审查者负担。

title: RAG-Stress: Probing the Limits of Evidence Reliance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Following retrieved evidence does not guarantee factual correctness: misleading evidence can induce a model to replace an answer it previously gave correctly. Standard accuracy measures obscure this behavior by combining answer replacement with preexisting errors. We introduce RAG-Stress, a controlled diagnostic protocol for examining the limits of evidence reliance in retrieval-augmented generation. The protocol holds the question and reference answer fixed, edits one assertion to support a designated incorrect answer, and crosses two source priority policies with three positions of the answer span within the evidence text. We measure misleading rate (MR) on each model's subset of questions answered correctly without retrieval, alongside clean accuracy on the full evaluation set. We evaluate fifteen systems spanning API models, open models, and search agents trained with reinforcement learning on TriviaQA-RC, HotpotQA, and SearchQA, with additional English and Chinese MedQA evaluations. Instructions that prioritize documents consistently produce higher MR than those permitting reliance on prior knowledge. Averaged over models and positions, the gap ranges from 10.9 to 13.5 percentage points across the three QA datasets. Mean MR follows End $>$ Beginning $>$ Middle under both policies, although individual models do not uniformly follow this ordering. A separate paired audit of 500 questions and two checkpoints supports increased harmful override without establishing a corresponding improvement in beneficial correction. These findings distinguish evidence adherence from factual reliability and motivate evaluating whether retrieved evidence preserves, replaces, or corrects a model's answers.

AI.tldr: RAG-Stress 是一个用于诊断检索增强生成（RAG）系统中证据依赖问题的受控评测协议，通过在正确答案上注入误导性证据来测量模型何时会用错误答案替换原本正确的回答。
AI.motivation: 标准 RAG 评测指标（如准确率）混淆了"答案替换"与"原本就答错"两种情况，无法区分模型对证据的遵循度与事实可靠性。本文旨在揭示误导性证据如何诱导模型放弃原本正确的闭卷答案。
AI.method: 协议设计：固定问题与参考答案，仅编辑一处断言以支持指定错误答案（foil），交叉两个源优先级策略（Soft 允许依赖先验知识 / Strict 以文档为优先真理）与三个答案位置条件（开头/中间/结尾）。对 15 个模型（API、开源、强化学习搜索代理）在 TriviaQA-RC、HotpotQA、SearchQA 及中英 MedQA 上评估误导率（MR）——即模型在闭卷正确时改答错误答案的比例。
AI.result: 关键发现：(1) Strict 指令在所有数据集上产生比 Soft 更高的 MR，平均差距 10.9–13.5 个百分点；(2) 平均 MR 呈现 End > Beginning > Middle 的位置排序（但个体模型并不完全一致）；(3) 基于 500 题的配对审计显示，Strict 增加了有害覆盖但未带来对应的有益修正增益；(4) RL 训练的搜索代理在 Soft 下也有很高的 MR，表明对证据的过度依赖；(5) 通过人工验证编辑有效性（κ=0.77）和匹配器分析（κ=0.91）验证了实验可靠性。
AI.conclusion: RAG-Stress 区分了证据遵循度与事实可靠性两个概念，表明模型可能"很好地基于证据"却仍然错误。结论呼吁在评估 RAG 系统时应分别报告基线覆盖率、错误答案采纳率以及清洁/编辑证据的配对转换，而非仅依赖聚合准确率或文档遵循度来推断鲁棒性。

title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
summary: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

AI.tldr: 本文提出FateMultiplicity框架，在无标签条件下构建单细胞轨迹推断的Rashomon集，量化预测多重性；但发现基于该集合的逐细胞"认证命运边界"(FM)并不能比单模型决策边界更可靠地区分错误指派，失败根源在于对异质模型集取下确界时聚合器的结构性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 单细胞轨迹推断中，多个等效拟合的参数配置可能对同一细胞指派冲突的命运。监督学习中的Rashomon集依赖有标签损失定义"可接受集"，而轨迹推断缺乏真实命运标签，使得无监督场景下的预测多重性难以度量与报告，更无法对单细胞层面进行可靠性认证。
AI.method: 方法核心是用交叉拟合的留出基因差异度(von Neumann比)代替监督损失，以随机种子重拟合的方差作为非劣效性边界δ，通过模块置换检验(10,000次符号翻转)控制FDR，将统计上不可区分的配置纳入Rashomon集ℛ(α)。逐细胞认证命运边界FM定义为该集合上决策边界(首选命运概率与次选命运概率之差)的下确界。引入q-分位数认证族和认证力Π(集合分歧与种子分歧之比)作为辅助诊断。验证采用75个合成对象、4个真实数据集(脊髓损伤小胶质细胞、髓系祖细胞、谱系条形码造血数据、Biddy重编程)以及CellRank吸收随机游走与Palantir两种算法。
AI.result: 1) 多重性幅度大且主要由模型空间多样性驱动而非配置数量：12个Palantir配置暴露20.0%细胞，而24个吸收游走配置仅暴露3.8%。2) 在仿真真值上，FM对错误指派的判别AUC为0.682，显著低于基线模型自身决策边界的0.965(p=0.003)和种子分散基线的0.854。3) 失败具有结构性原因：θ*本身属于ℛ(α)从而上确界m̄被θ*的边界从下方锚定，但下确界无此约束，随集合变宽而趋向报告最极端的反对配置。4) 放宽为q-分位数可单调恢复判别力但收敛至单模型置信度而非超越之。5) 仍存活的两个构造：对克隆观察命运，未认证细胞与克隆结局的不一致率比认证细胞高16.4个百分点(p<0.001)；仿真中边缘侵蚀比可分离真实与虚假分支点(AUC=0.890)，但未见真实数据验证。6) 认证力Π在四个臂上从0.83跨至2.16，集合扩大可同时升高多重率并降低Π，提示不同臂的率不可比。
AI.conclusion: 无标签Rashomon集的构建可行且值得报告——多重性真实存在、幅度可观、并集中于生物学相关过程(如损伤急性期)。但逐细胞最坏情形认证并非通往更可靠命运指派的路径：其下确界是未锚定的极值顺序统计量，集合越具异质性、越诚实地覆盖分析空间，认证越弱。实用建议为：同时报告多重性率与认证力Π；标注命运声明所依赖的吸引子命名；将低多重性视为模型类内的分析决定性而非生物学分支的证据；不以可接受集上的最坏情形证书替代拟合模型自身的命运概率。

title: What to Admit and How to Present: Governing Persistent Memory in LLM Agents
summary: Persistent memory can improve personalization in LLM agents but can also induce sycophancy and cross-domain leakage. We distinguish two governance decisions: admission, which determines what recalled information enters the working context, and presentation, which determines how admitted information is expressed. We implement two inference-time designs without retraining: factor-compiled admission (FC), which assesses whole memory entries, and permission-semantic admission (PS), which decomposes entries into typed units; both translate adjudicated attributes into eligibility decisions via deterministic policies. We evaluate on a four-backbone development suite and an external benchmark with four tasks of 300 samples each. Relative to verbatim injection, FC and PS reduce pooled judge-assessed failure rates on the external benchmark by 6.7 and 8.8 percentage points (p = 2.7e-7 and 4.1e-12), and development-set cross-domain leakage falls by up to 29.5 percentage points. A query-conditioned gating baseline shows no significant change in objective-fact failure or pooled failure. Under matched admission budgets, PS outperforms random and relevance-based selection on external objective-fact judgment after Holm correction. Holding presentation fixed, tightening admission cuts cross-domain failure by a further 17.5 percentage points (p = 1.6e-4); in contrast, no comparison between two renderings of identical adjudicated outputs survives multiple-comparison correction. Both designs increase personalization failures, and PS misses the preregistered improvement and personalization-preservation criteria. These results support evaluating admission and presentation separately: selection quality provides task-specific safety gains, while preserving beneficial memory use remains unresolved.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM智能体持久化记忆治理问题，将治理决策解耦为"准入"（admission）和"呈现"（presentation）两个独立杠杆，提出两种无需重训练的推理时准入设计——FC（全条目因子编译）和PS（类型化单元语义许可），并通过预注册的对照实验证明：准入决策可带来任务特异性的安全收益（外部基准池化失败率分别降低6.7和8.8个百分点），而两种测试呈现方案之间未发现稳健差异，保留有益记忆使用的问题仍未解决。
AI.motivation: 持久化记忆可增强LLM智能体的个性化能力，但也会诱发谄媚性（sycophancy）和跨域泄漏（cross-domain leakage）等风险。现有记忆增强代理通常将记忆逐字注入提示词，由生成器隐式同时解决"是否纳入"与"如何表达"两个决策，且常默认采用谄媚式回应或跨域泄漏。现有准入机制（如检索阈值、相关性过滤）以单一保留/丢弃位粗粒度执行准入；提示级记忆引导则仅执行呈现而无准入决策。尚无研究在同一记忆系统上分离并测量这两个杠杆。
AI.method: 1) 问题形式化：将生成时治理分解为准入映射A（决定哪些记忆单元进入工作上下文）和呈现映射P（决定提示词表面形式）。2) 情境化裁决（Situated Adjudication）：单次批量裁决调用接收查询、对话、证据及全部top-k记忆，返回结构化属性判定（kind、subject、epistemic status、temporality等），属性评估与策略决策分离，由确定性代码将属性编译为资格决策。3) 两种准入设计：FC（因子编译准入）将整条记忆映射到五个类型化通道；PS（许可-语义准入）先将记忆分解为类型化单元，再映射到五类许可用途加deny六类权限，被拒单元从提示词中物理移除。4) 两种呈现方案：PN（许可注释节标头）与CH（信息类型通道节标头）。5) 预注册机制：跨骨干开发套件（四个骨干×三个维度）、外部基准四任务（各300样本）以及裁决共享呈现实验均预注册，统计采用配对精确McNemar检验、Holtm/BH校正，独立审计脚本重算所有统计量。
AI.result: 1) 准入具有跨骨干迁移性：开发套件上Qwen3.7-Max跨域泄漏从44.0%降至14.5%（PN）和18.0%（CH），Kimi-K2.6从37.0%降至22.5%/22.0%，均通过BH校正。2) 外部基准上，FC和PS池化失败率分别从46.2%降至39.5%（-6.7pp，p=2.7×10⁻⁷）和37.4%（-8.8pp，p=4.1×10⁻¹²）；客观事实判断任务失败率降低24.7pp（45.2%→20.4%）。查询条件门控基线（Gate）池化变化不显著（p=0.08）。3) 预算匹配对照下，PS在外部基准客观事实上优于随机选择和相关性排名（Holm校正后均显著）。4) 单一变量对照实验：固定呈现、仅收紧准入，跨域失败率再降17.5pp（42.5%→25.0%，p=1.6×10⁻⁴）。5) 两种呈现方案裁决共享对比下，无任何比较通过九任务-指标对的探索性BH校正（唯一名义显著单元p=0.043未存活，q=0.39）。6) 边界与失败：记忆-证据冲突任务上，FC/PS/呈现臂误导率仍达82.3%–85.0%（裸注入91.7%，无记忆0%）；两种准入设计均增加个性化失败（FC +7.6pp，PS +5.3pp）；PS未达到预注册效果门限（池化改善8.8pp<10pp阈值，pm准确率-6.0pp>3pp允许线）；GPT-OSS-120B在测试配置下未改善跨域泄漏（p=0.12/0.20）。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持将准入与呈现分开评估：选择质量提供任务特异性的安全收益（尤其客观事实分裂任务），而保留有益记忆使用仍未解决。两种测试的呈现方案之间无稳健差异。该工作的贡献在于提供实验框架以区分管道级效应、固定裁决下的呈现效应以及收紧准入的受控效应；同时诚实地报告了谄媚减少伴随的个性化过冲、记忆-证据冲突的残余失败以及PS未达预注册门限等局限性。

title: Retromorphic Testing of Quantum Compiler Passes
summary: Quantum compilers play a critical role in transforming high-level quantum programs into optimized, hardware-compatible circuits. However, verifying the correctness of compiler passes remains challenging, as determining the expected output of large, deeply entangled quantum circuits is computationally intractable. This challenge is further amplified when compiler passes modify already complex circuit structures, making manual validation of transformed circuits impractical. In this work, we perform a systematic analysis of unit tests for quantum compiler passes in four quantum programming frameworks (PennyLane, Qiskit, Cirq, and pytket). Our findings indicate validation is dominated by program-content and program-metric assertions, and test circuits are generally small and shallow. Motivated by these observations, we introduce a testing methodology for automated validation of quantum compiler passes based on retromorphic testing and principles from the Hadamard test. This methodology analyzes a compiler pass, test circuit, and expected pass behavior to verify semantic preservation and intended structural modifications. We implement our methods in a framework, RetroQ, and apply it to compiler passes in PennyLane and Qiskit. Experimental evaluation reproduced several existing bugs as well as uncovered previously undetected defects, such as flawed symbolic parameter handling, incorrect commutation logic, failure to recognize self-adjointness of gates, and runtime crashes. These findings highlight the need for compiler-pass-specific testing methodologies to improve the reliability of the evolving quantum software stack.

AI.tldr: 本文针对量子编译器（quantum compiler）中的编译优化过程（compiler passes）难以验证的问题，提出了一种名为 RetroQ 的自动化黑盒测试框架。该框架将经典软件测试中的回归式测试（retromorphic testing）与 Hadamard 测试原理相结合，通过两阶段验证（伴随身份检查与受控伴随身份检查）自动检查编译过程是否保持语义等价性及预期结构变化，而无需手动推导期望输出。实验在 PennyLane 和 Qiskit 上复现了已知缺陷并发现了多个先前未检测到的 bug。
AI.motivation: 量子编译器是将高层量子算法转化为硬件可执行电路的关键环节，但由于大尺寸深度纠缠量子电路的输出在经典上难以计算，编译过程正确性验证面临严重测试预言机问题（test oracle problem）。现有量子编程框架（PennyLane、Qiskit、Cirq、pytket）的单元测试主要依赖程序内容（program-content）和程序度量（program-metric）断言，且测试电路规模普遍较小（深度集中在 1–10），难以覆盖复杂场景下的潜在缺陷。
AI.method:
1. 对四个主流量子编程框架的编译器单元测试进行系统静态分析，按断言类型（程序度量、程序内容、矩阵等价、输出等价等）进行分类统计，并分析测试电路的比特数与深度分布。
2. 提出 RetroQ 框架，核心思想是利用量子操作的可逆（酉）性，采用回归式测试（retromorphic testing）方法：将目标电路 F 与其伴随 F† 组合，并对比 F† 与 ζ(F)† 的等价性。
3. 两阶段验证：
   - 阶段一（伴随身份检查）：构造基线电路 F·F†，与 ζ(F†) 及 ζ(F)† 两种变体对比，检查末态是否回到 |0⟩，并检查门数等结构属性是否满足用户预期。
   - 阶段二（受控伴随身份检查）：借鉴 Hadamard 测试原理，将编译过程嵌入受控操作，通过辅助比特测量期望值 ±1 来检测受控上下文中的语义变化。
4. 用户只需提供目标函数、编译器过程（pass）和预期行为（如门数减少/不变/增加），框架自动生成测试电路与预言机。
AI.result:
实验评估了 PennyLane-0.45.0 中的 cancel_inverses、single_qubit_fusion、pattern_matching_optimization 三个 pass，以及 Qiskit-2.4.1 中的 CommutativeInverseCancellation、RemoveIdentityEquivalent 两个 pass。共识别出 6 个缺陷：
1. Qiskit CommutativeInverseCancellation 错误地将 SWAP 门穿过受控 RZ 门从而错误地执行了逆消除（复现已知问题）。
2. Qiskit RemoveIdentityEquivalent 未能识别符号参数（如 d*0）所导致的恒等门。
3. PennyLane cancel_inverses 在处理一般酉矩阵（QubitUnitary）时发生运行时崩溃。
4. PennyLane single_qubit_fusion 在对伴随电路应用时产生了意外的 GlobalPhase 操作，在受控上下文中导致期望值符号反转（-1 而非 +1）。
5. PennyLane pattern_matching_optimization 未能识别自伴随门序列的伴随形式与原模式等价。
6. PennyLane cancel_inverses 未能识别 Pauli X/Y/Z、CNOT、Toffoli 等自伴随门的自身消除。
此外，将测试中发现的缺陷归纳为五类编译器错误：符号推理局限性、抽象层级差距（处理一般酉矩阵失败）、结构逻辑错误、全局相位管理错误以及伴随逻辑失败。已与 PennyLane 团队反馈，其中崩溃 bug 已被确认并在 GitHub 报告。
AI.conclusion: 本文系统揭示了现有量子编译器单元测试的不足，验证电路普遍小而浅，且过度依赖程序内容与度量断言，缺少对复杂电路和受控上下文的覆盖。RetroQ 作为首个将回归式测试应用于量子编译器验证的框架，能够在不依赖手动推导期望输出的情况下，自动构建测试预言机并检测编译过程中的语义与结构缺陷。实验证明该方法能有效复现已知 bug 并发现新缺陷，表明针对编译过程的专用测试方法对提升量子软件栈可靠性至关重要。未来工作包括：自动搜索合适的初始态、自动化测试程序生成、自动推导结构期望，以及将框架扩展至 Cirq、pytket 等更多框架。

title: Selective Listening: Mechanism-Guided Control of Audio Influence in Large Audio-Language Models
summary: Large audio-language models (LALMs) exploit multimodal evidence, yet task-irrelevant audio can alter text-reasoning decisions when listening is unnecessary. Aggregate Accuracy can hide this paired drift because audio-induced repairs and damages may cancel. Paired drift analysis and targeted interventions identify architecture-specific, intervention-sensitive late audio pathways as actionable control points. We introduce ICAP-Gate, which applies mechanism-guided, task-conditioned control to each model's pathway. Across four LALMs, two reasoning benchmarks, and environmental-sound and natural-speech interference, ICAP-Gate has lower point estimates for Influence Rate and Answer Flip than ungated inference in all 16 full-split model--condition evaluations. Fixed suppression degrades automatic speech recognition (ASR) across all four models, whereas ICAP-Gate matches ungated ASR performance by preserving the pathway for explicit audio-demand instructions. ICAP-Gate has lower paired-drift point estimates than mitigation prompting in all four evaluated settings and provides competitive stabilization relative to eight-sample Self-Consistency while using one generation per query; in controlled ARC measurements, Self-Consistency incurs $7.0$--$9.2\times$ ungated latency. These results establish selective modality influence control as a design principle for robust multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ICAP-Gate方法，通过机制引导的、任务条件化的控制，识别并调制大音频语言模型(LALM)中晚期音频通路的选择性门控，从而在保留显式音频需求任务性能的同时，减少任务无关音频对文本推理的干扰。
AI.motivation: 大音频语言模型(LALM)在处理文本推理任务时，即使音频与任务无关（如环境音或自然语音），仍可能改变模型的文本推理决策。聚合准确率指标会掩盖这一成对漂移现象——音频带来的"修复"和"损害"可能相互抵消。需要一种机制引导的控制方法，在保留音频处理能力的同时抑制不必要的影响。
AI.method: 1) 配对决策漂移分析：定义Influence Rate (IR) 和 Answer Flip (Flip) 等成对指标来量化音频引起的个体决策变化；2) 机制定位：通过路径缩放干预和因果中介分析，识别架构特异的、干预敏感的晚期音频通路；3) ICAP-Gate（指令条件化音频通路门控）：根据任务指令中的显式音频需求指示符r(I)∈{0,1}，对每种模型选定的晚期音频通路ℓ_m施加门控g_m(I)——当r(I)=1时保持通路开放(g=1)，否则施加模型特异的衰减尺度λ_m；4) 在线单次推理流程，无需干净参考或辅助相关性模型。
AI.result: 在四种LALM（Qwen2.5-Omni-7B/3B、Phi-4-MM、Voxtral-Mini-3B）、两个推理基准（ARC-Challenge、MMLU）、两种干扰类型（FSD环境音、SIB自然语音）共16个完整评估中，ICAP-Gate在所有设置的Influence Rate和Answer Flip点估计均低于无门控推理。固定抑制会损害ASR性能（所有模型WER上升16-124个百分点），而ICAP-Gate通过为显式音频需求指令保留通路，可匹配无门控WER。在匹配比较中，ICAP-Gate在所有四种设置下配对漂移点估计均低于缓解提示法；与8样本Self-Consistency相比具有竞争力但仅需单次生成（自一致性产生7.0-9.2×的延迟）。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了"选择性模态影响控制"作为鲁棒多模态推理的设计原则：模态可用性不应隐含模态影响。ICAP-Gate通过机制引导的、任务条件化的通路调制，在四种异构LALM架构上稳定推理，同时保留对显式音频需求任务的处理能力。晚期音频通路在不同架构中复现支持共享计算角色的假设。

title: PageWeaver: KV-Guided Query Unions for Sparse Attention
comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Zhiyuan Li and Zihan Li contributed equally
summary: Dynamic sparse attention limits the KV pages selected by each query, but a small support does not necessarily yield efficient GPU work. Query unions share page loads and populate Tensor Core tiles; their cost depends on which queries are grouped together. We present PageWeaver, an execution design that uses selected-page affinity to assemble query groups while preserving each query's original support and complete output ownership. A bounded GPU search produces query IDs, and an ID-aware two-CTA kernel consumes them without materializing reordered Q tensors or cross-page partial outputs. A direct KV-page union implementation provides a complementary design study of nonlocal reuse and reduction cost. With FP8 KV throughout, the H200 Union8 implementation achieves a 1.70x geometric-mean complete-call speedup over the measured FlashInfer path on six captures. Online regrouping further lowers latency by 3.26-7.66% on five selected 64K-context captures. Whole-model prefill throughput is 7.88-14.36% above the tested native path; the incremental regrouping benefit is smaller, with observed median gains of 0.47-0.73% at 32K/64K and regressions at 8K. A B300 comparison identifies cases where preparation cost and a stronger native kernel remove the advantage. These results separate execution-group reuse from the complete cost of exploiting it online.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PageWeaver，一种基于KV页面亲和性的查询分组执行设计，用于动态稀疏注意力。通过有界GPU搜索重排查询ID并使用ID感知的两CTA Union8核，在保留每个查询原有支持集和完整输出所有权的同时，实现跨查询的KV页面共享加载和Tensor Core tile填充。
AI.motivation: 动态稀疏注意力虽然限制了每个查询选择的KV页面数，但小的支持集未必带来GPU执行效率。Tensor Core需要矩阵tile，而动态页面选择产生不规则的查询-页面关系。如何选择共享页面遍历的查询组成为一个独立的调度优化问题，现有方法要么扩大组带来联合扩张，要么采用页面导向方法引入跨页面输出归约开销。
AI.method: 核心方法包括三部分：(1) 将固定支持集下的查询分组形式化，定义页面联合、复用率ρ_Q等度量；(2) 基于页面亲和性的有界在线分组算法（Algorithm 1），在W查询窗口内贪心选择使边际联合增量最小的查询组成8查询组；(3) ID感知的两CTA Union8执行核——一个CTA拥有4查询和2个本地KV槽，通过集群共享8查询联合确定页面遍历，每CTA保留FP32运行softmax统计并直接写回原始输出行。此外还实现了直接的KV页面联合路径作为对照研究。
AI.result: H200上FP8 KV的Union8实现在6个捕获上相对FlashInfer实现1.70×几何均值完整调用加速，相对原生路径2.66×加速；Union4到Union8匹配算术下1.075×。在线重分组在5个64K捕获上降低延迟3.26-7.66%，分组自身耗时约34.6-34.9μs。整模型预填充吞吐量高于测试原生路径7.88-14.36%，但增量重分组收益较小：32K/64K中位数仅+0.47-0.73%，8K出现回归。直接KV页面联合在构造的交错支持集上有效但在模型捕获上表现不如Union8。B300比较表明原生核更强时优势消失。数值上6个在线H200捕获与原Union8逐位一致。
AI.conclusion: PageWeaver通过页面关系改变查询组成员同时保留每个查询的完整注意力输出，将基础核增益与重分组增益分离：基础核带来显著加速，重分组带来较小且依赖工作负载的额外收益。直接KV页面执行和B300比较表明复用必须与准备和输出成本一起评估。核心设计原则是在固定稀疏关系下优化执行组的构建成本。

title: Dissecting Representation Structure in Vision Transformers: A Rigorous Architectural Study
summary: Representation structure is crucial for understanding Vision Transformer (ViT) architectures and their generalization behavior. However, prior studies neither isolate nor analyze module-level features nor investigate how their interactions contribute to performance estimation. In this work, we conduct the first rigorous analysis of feature information across diverse architectural scales, empirically uncover the relationship between ViT representation and generalization behavior, and leverage these insights to guide efficient ViT design. Our contributions are fivefold: Across diverse architectural scales, 1) We identify feature collapse at initialization, which leads to redundancy, and propose a reduction scheme to mitigate this issue. 2) We quantify feature information using entropy and the minimum eigenvalue, demonstrating that these metrics serve as reliable indicators for generalization prediction. 3) We show that feature in the token space provides a more faithful representation than those in embedding space. 4) We discover an unexpected finding: features produced by linear submodules within ViT layers are critical for the prediction of generalization performance. 5) Our proposed proxy improves the correlation ranking by 18-48% over prior baselines and can effectively identify ViT architectures that achieve higher accuracy at lower or comparable computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统分析ViT内部各模块的特征表示，提出基于熵和最小特征值的无训练代理方法，揭示线性子模块特征是预测泛化能力的关键，代理相关性较基线提升18-48%。
AI.motivation: 现有ViT性能代理方法多借鉴CNN范式，忽视ViT模块级特征差异，且未研究特征交互对泛化的贡献；同时ViT特征的高维性使其信息难以量化，导致搜索成本高昂。
AI.method: 构建包含26类模块级特征（Q/K/V、MHSA输出、M1/M2等）的提取框架，提出降维方案缓解特征坍缩；在token空间和embedding空间分别计算Shannon熵代理与Pearson相关矩阵最小特征值代理；基于AutoFormer-Tiny搜索空间采样1000个5-7M ViT架构并以预训练权重评估ImageNet-1K测试精度，使用Spearman/Kendall相关系数衡量代理预测能力。
AI.result: 最佳Token-Entropy代理(M1+M2及组合)在5-7M、15-19M、45-47M范围上较SOTA基线(DSS、AutoProxA、DSS++等)相关性提升18%/25%/48%；在NAS任务中识别精度提升0.11-0.17%，搜索耗时由0.48-4.3小时降至0.05-0.08小时（降幅87.5-98.6%）；线性子模块(Q/K/V、M1、M2等)与精度强相关，非线性模块(GELU、SC等)几乎无关；token空间代理始终优于embedding空间代理。
AI.conclusion: ViT特征中存在初始化坍缩现象，线性子模块特征是关键泛化指标；提出的token空间熵代理在相关性、计算效率和架构识别精度上均显著优于现有方法，为ViT无训练NAS提供了可解释且高效的解决方案。

title: Do Flatter Minima Drive Better Generalization? An Algorithmic Separation in Grokking
summary: Flat loss landscapes have long been linked to better generalization in neural networks. However, its role as a causal mechanism for generalization is less established. Grokking provides an unique testbed to understand this distinction: models are prone to fit observed data using non-generalizing structure and remain in that regime for prolonged periods, transitioning to generalization only under particular training conditions. In this work, we study whether flat loss landscapes can act as a driving mechanism in this transition. While recent work has argued for flatness as a necessary geometric condition for this transition, we find that biasing training toward flatter solutions using sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) is insufficient to reliably induce this transition, despite producing flatter solutions. However, when SAM is paired with mechanisms that drive generalization such as weight decay, an interesting property emerges: SAM can accelerate the transition to generalizing solutions by up to 4x at the epoch-level. We theoretically untangle this relationship between SAM and weight decay using a minimal interpolating two-layer ReLU model with both memorizing and generalizing solutions. We show that even in this simple setup, flatness alone cannot distinguish a memorizing solution from a generalizing one, while weight decay favors generalizing solutions. However, under a local stability analysis, there exists a window where a memorizing interpolant is locally stable under gradient descent but unstable under SAM in the low-norm regime, which can explain SAM's ability to accelerate this transition. Overall, our results provide a more interpretable account of the role of flatness in driving generalization, especially in settings where models are vulnerable to minimizing loss through learning non-generalizing structure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究平坦极小值（flat minima）是否能作为神经网络上泛化能力的因果驱动机制，特别是在"grokking"现象背景下。论文通过实验和理论分析得出结论：仅靠平坦性不足以触发从记忆到泛化的转变，但当与权重衰减结合时，SAM可以加速这一转变（高达4倍），表明平坦性是加速器而非选择器。
AI.motivation: 平坦损失景观长期以来与更好的泛化能力相关联，但其作为泛化因果机制的角色尚未确立。Grokking现象提供了一个独特的测试平台：模型最初拟合训练数据但保持非泛化状态，仅在特定训练条件下才过渡到泛化。理解平坦性是否在这一转变中起因果驱动作用是关键动机。
AI.method: 1) 使用Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM)在模块化算术任务（p=97, 113）、CIFAR-10、SST-5、MNIST和IMDb上系统研究平坦性对泛化的影响；2) 设计四组实验条件：仅权重衰减（WD）、仅SAM、SAM+WD、无正则化；3) 理论分析构建最小两层ReLU插值网络，显式构造记忆型和解泛化型插值解；4) 通过局部稳定性分析在二次SAM近似下比较GD和SAM的动态行为。
AI.result: 1) 纯SAM产生最平坦的解但未能在模块化算术任务上触发泛化（0/5成功率），而WD方法在99%的运行中成功泛化；2) SAM+WD可将泛化转变速度提升高达4倍（在1层Transformer、p=97加法任务上达到3.992x），加速效果随ρ增大而增强直至SAM的一阶Taylor估计退化；3) 理论证明平坦性不能区分记忆型和解泛化型插值解（两者迹平坦度相同），但参数范数可以区分（泛化解范数严格更小）；4) 存在一个低范数稳定窗口，其中记忆型插值解在GD下稳定但在SAM下不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 平坦性不能单独作为泛化的因果选择器——本文挑战了Han和Kamp (2025)的平坦性必要性观点。真正的选择机制是参数范数（通过权重衰减驱动）。SAM的作用是条件性加速器：一旦权重衰减将系统移入低范数区域，SAM通过改变局部稳定性使记忆解变得不稳定，从而加速向泛化解的逃逸。这一平坦性-范数-稳定性的算法分离在模块化算术、图像分类（CIFAR-10、MNIST）和自然语言处理（SST-5、IMDb）任务中均得到验证。

title: AliO: Output Alignment Matters in Long-Term Time Series Forecasing
summary: Long-term Time Series Forecasting (LTSF) tasks, which leverage the current data sequence as input to predict the future sequence, have become increasingly crucial in real-world applications such as weather forecasting and planning of electricity consumption. However, state-of-the-art LTSF models often fail to achieve prediction output alignment for the same timestamps across lagged input sequences. Instead, these models exhibit low output alignment, resulting in fluctuation in prediction outputs for the same timestamps, undermining the model's reliability. To address this, we propose AliO (Align Outputs), a novel approach designed to improve the output alignment of LTSF models by reducing the discrepancies between prediction outputs for the same timestamps in both the time and frequency domains. To measure output alignment, we introduce a new metric, TAM (Time Alignment Metric), which quantifies the alignment between prediction outputs, whereas existing metrics such as MSE only capture the distance between prediction outputs and ground truths. Experimental results show that AliO effectively improves the output alignment, i.e., up to 58.2% in TAM, while maintaining or enhancing the forecasting performance (up to 27.5%). This improved output alignment increases the reliability of the LTSF models, making them more applicable in real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AliO方法，通过在时域和频域中对齐不同滞后输入序列的重叠预测输出来解决长时序预测(LTSF)中的输出对齐问题，并提出新指标TAM来量化输出对齐一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有LTSF模型虽预测精度高，但对于相同时间戳的预测结果会因输入序列的微小滞后而产生不一致的输出，这种"输出对齐"问题在真实场景中（如电力预算分配、天气预报）会降低模型可靠性并造成资源浪费，却未受到足够关注。
AI.method: 1) 提出TAM指标：计算N组滞后输入产生的重叠预测序列之间MAE的平均值，量化预测一致性；2) 提出AliO损失函数：包含时域对齐损失和频域对齐损失（通过FFT变换对齐相位和幅度）；3) 引入Regression Pulling机制，利用stop-gradient操作识别偏离真值更远的预测点，使对齐损失方向与回归损失方向一致，避免预测偏离真值。
AI.result: 在7个LTSF模型（CycleNet、GPT4TS、iTransformer、PatchTST、TimesNet、DLinear、Autoformer）和多个数据集上的实验表明，AliO将TAM最高改善58.2%，同时保持或提升预测精度（MSE最高改善27.5%）；初始对齐越差的模型/数据集，AliO带来的MSE提升越大。
AI.conclusion: AliO首次系统地解决了LTSF中的输出对齐问题，无需修改模型架构即可即插即用，显著提升了预测一致性（数据-模型鲁棒性），增强了LTSF模型在实际应用中的可靠性。

title: Bridging KV-Cache Quantization and Linear Attention: From Theory to Pretrained Weight Migration
summary: KV-cache quantization and linear attention are two representative approaches to tackling the storage and computational costs of Transformers. KV-cache quantization compresses individual KV entries into discrete codes but retains all entries, whereas linear attention recurrently aggregates multiple historical KV contributions into a fixed-size continuous state but can introduce interference. This contrast raises the question of whether per-KV compression and multi-KV aggregation can be bridged within a single mechanism for efficient attention. We identify RAM-Net as such a bridge through soft assignments over a discrete address space. These assignments determine recurrent updates to the continuous slot state associated with each address. Under a restricted RAM-Net construction, we prove that soft address assignments extend hard quantized matching to a separable read-write overlap that locally approximates full-attention similarity and supports recurrent aggregation. These connections further enable Transformer-to-RAM-Net weight migration through a new path based on a soft-quantized intermediate construction. Across nine pretrained Transformer models from 0.3B to 7B parameters, RAM-Net recovers an average of 87.1% of the teachers' accuracy gains over random guessing across six commonsense and knowledge tasks using only a 500M-token budget per model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用RAM-Net统一桥接KV-cache量化与线性注意力两种高效Transformer推理范式，并通过软量化中间注意力构造实现低成本Transformer-to-RAM-Net权重迁移。
AI.motivation: KV-cache量化按token压缩但存储随上下文增长；线性注意力固定状态聚合但引入干扰。两者各有权衡，作者希望找到一种统一机制同时实现per-KV压缩与multi-KV聚合。
AI.method: 理论：在受限RAM-Net构造（环形码本、Product Softmax、Top-K、GSU）下，证明软地址分配的read-write重叠局部逼近指数点积相似性，并可分离为读写项，从而兼容离散码Soft-NN与连续线性预测器。实践：通过低秩适配+环形软量化构建中间注意力模型，经头级/注意力块级/全模型三级恢复，将9个0.3B-7B预训练Transformer迁移到RAM-Net，每模型仅用500M token。
AI.result: 在六个常识/知识任务上，平均恢复教师相对随机猜测准确率提升的87.1%；Wiki PPL差距1.22-5.09；注意力分布JS散度在所有代码本设计（随机、正交随机、k-means、PQ）中最低；消融证实环形码本、低秩对齐和分级恢复管道均贡献正向收益。
AI.conclusion: RAM-Net通过离散地址空间上的软分配，同时继承了KV量化与线性注意力的优势；该理论桥接支持直接从Transformer权重迁移的新路径，为高效注意力提供了统一视角与实用方案。局限：理论局部且依赖受限构造，迁移实验采用固定500M token预算未做进一步调优。

title: The Lattice of Transition Laws
summary: Diffusion and autoregression (AR) have long been seen as different categories of generative models, with diffusion specialising in continuous fields and AR specialising in discrete tokens. Recent work seeks to combine the advantages of the two models, and each hybrid fixes its decoding schedule by design. In this paper, we ask whether the performance of decoding schedules of one model can be predicted before decoding at a fixed number of steps. We describe diffusion, AR, and models in between as paths on one corruption lattice, and define the cost of a schedule as the dependence its parallel steps discard. The cost shows that the fewest steps of a zero-cost schedule are set by the geometry of the data, in the same way for tokens and for continuous fields. In particular, for data that are Markov on a graph and dependent along its paths, the fewest steps equal the graph's treedepth, which is logarithmic in the length of a sequence and linear in the side length of a grid. With fewer steps than the treedepth, every schedule pays a positive cost, whose ranking we predict before decoding with a kernel of pairwise dependence estimated from pretrained weights. Across text generation, image generation, and video generation, we verify most of the predictions about the rankings of different schedules under different metrics and benchmarks. This work therefore provides a design principle for decoding for future AR models, diffusion models, and anything in between. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出"腐蚀格"(corruption lattice)统一框架，将扩散模型与自回归模型及其混合方法视为同一格上的路径，定义依赖代价来量化并行解码步骤丢弃的依赖关系，并在解码前通过预训练权重估计的核函数对调度性能进行预测。
AI.motivation: 扩散与自回归通常被视为两类不同的生成模型（连续 vs 离散），混合模型各自固定解码调度但缺乏统一设计原则。作者希望回答：能否在解码前预测某模型在不同解码调度下的性能？
AI.method: 构建腐蚀格 L^d（每个坐标独立携带噪声水平），将任何解码调度表示为格上的单调路径。定义"依赖代价"为并行步骤中各坐标独立采样所丢失的依赖（总相关），并证明其等于路径分布与精确采样分布之间的 KL 散度（Proposition 1）。对图上 Markov 数据，零代价调度所需的最少步数等于图的 treedepth（Theorem 1）。通过预训练模型测量的核（条件互信息或扰动响应）实现解码前的成对下界估计（Lemma 2）。
AI.result: 在 text8、MAR-B 图像、LLaDA-8B 文本、Diffusion Forcing 视频上验证了大部分预测：序列的 treedepth 为 ⌈log₂(d+1)⌉，网格 treedepth 在 n+1 到 3n 之间；spread、midpoint 等空间分离方法在 FID、bpc、GSM8K、HumanEval 上优于连续选择和随机选择；LLaDA 上 min-distance 约束在 8 步时提升 GSM8K 准确率 9.7 个百分点；MAR-B 上 spread 在 8 步比随机降低 FID 超过 25%。
AI.conclusion: 腐蚀格与依赖代价为扩散、自回归及中间模型提供了统一的设计原则：零代价最少步数由数据几何（treedepth）决定，少于该步数时的调度排序可由核函数在解码前预测，框架覆盖离散 token 与连续场两种模态。

title: BRACE: Differential Privacy for Dense Associative Memory with LSR Energy
summary: Dense associative memory (DAM) provides an energy-based framework for memory retrieval with close connections to attention mechanisms in modern artificial intelligence. Despite growing interest in differential privacy for AI, the privacy of DAM retrieval dynamics remains relatively unexplored. In this paper, we develop a differential privacy framework for log-sum-ReLU (LSR) dense associative memory, whose finite-support retrieval dynamics pose distinctive challenges for privacy-preserving computation. We propose the Boundary-Responsive Adaptive Correction Evolution (BRACE) algorithm, a differentially private retrieval mechanism for LSR-DAM that adaptively corrects boundary-sensitive perturbations to control their cumulative effect over the retrieval trajectory. In theory, we prove that our method is minimax optimal by deriving dimension-independent terminal and full-trajectory retrieval error rates, with optimal dependence on the inverse temperature and, in the growing-horizon regime, the retrieval horizon. We further establish central limit theorems that enable uncertainty quantification for private retrieval by characterizing its asymptotic distribution and the additional variability introduced by privacy. Numerical experiments compare our proposed method with baseline differential privacy approaches and evaluate its retrieval accuracy. Together, our results provide a theoretical foundation for optimal privacy-preserving retrieval and uncertainty quantification in energy-based associative memory systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对log-sum-ReLU (LSR) 密集联想记忆 (DAM) 的隐私保护检索问题，提出了首个差分隐私 (DP) 框架 BRACE，通过自适应边界校正解决有限支撑检索动力学中的边界不稳定性，并证明其极小极大最优性。
AI.motivation: 随着 MemGPT、LongMem 等记忆增强 AI 系统的兴起，保护 DAM 检索过程中的敏感信息至关重要。LSE-DAM 因平滑性已有 DP 研究，但 LSR-DAM 采用紧支撑机制，检索边界不连续，现有基于平滑扰动的 DP 方法无法直接适用，导致隐私扰动引发边界跳变和误差累积。
AI.method: BRACE 算法通过六步流程实现：1) 计算干净轨迹与释放轨迹的活跃集差异；2) 基于差异计算校正量 R_t；3) 通过阈值 κTr² 激活校正开关 H_t；4) 将校正后查询投影回半径 r 球内；5) 利用 CorrectedCountSearch 计算局部敏感度的光滑包络；6) 添加校准的高斯噪声并投影到最终输出球。高斯噪声方差为 T·Δ̄_t²/(2ρ_{ε,δ})，使用 Rényi 散度进行隐私组合分析。
AI.result: 1) BRACE 满足 (ε,δ)-中心差分隐私（定理2）；2) 固定视界下终端与全路径检索误差的极小极大最优率为 Θ(r²)，增长视界下为 Θ(T²r²)，常数与维度 n,d 无关（定理3）；3) 在一般条件下建立轨迹中心极限定理，刻画隐私噪声的渐近分布，并证明有效计数 m̂_t ≍ √n 是隐私噪声在 √n 尺度贡献的转变临界点（定理4-5）；4) 合成数据实验验证 BRACE 将终端 MSE 从 1.005 降至 0.012；MNIST 实验显示在 β=0.025, T=3, ε=64 时将预测 MSE 从 8.76 降至 1.58，接近无噪声 DAM 的 1.58，优于全局噪声 DP (6.33) 和端点加噪 (7.87)。
AI.conclusion: BRACE 建立了 LSR-DAM 隐私保护检索的理论基础，通过边界自适应校正机制解决了紧支撑联想记忆特有的边界不稳定问题，在有限样本极小极大意义下达到最优，并在渐近框架下提供基于 CLT 的不确定性量化。局限在于实际性能依赖底层数据几何和检索尺度选择，且敏感度估计带来额外计算开销。未来工作可进一步提升计算效率并开发自适应的检索尺度选择策略。

title: Cross-species representation learning aligns mouse and human neural dynamics and tracks clinical drug efficacy
comment: 33 pages, 5 figures; supplementary material included (2 supplementary figures, 3 supplementary tables)
summary: Preclinical models poorly predict human drug efficacy, particularly in neurological disorders. Neural activity offers a uniquely rich source of translational information because it captures high-dimensional variation in nervous-system function that can be measured in both animals and humans. However, its high dimensionality makes it difficult to distinguish conserved disease-related features from variation arising from species, recording modality and experimental context. Here, we test whether shared neural dynamics can be identified directly from electrophysiology data by learning representations organized by biological state rather than species. We develop a dual-rule contrastive learning framework that aligns corresponding mouse and human states while preserving separation between distinct phenotypes. This framework recovered conserved sensory-response structure across species and, in epilepsy, resolved distinct relationships between three mouse models and heterogeneous human patient populations. When treated animals were projected into a frozen cross-species representation, drug-induced movement towards the human-aligned healthy state retrospectively tracked known clinical efficacy across ten model-drug combinations including a disease-specific detrimental effect. The framework also identified shared disease-associated neural dynamics between Fmr1-knockout mice and human 16p11.2 copy-number variant carriers despite differences in genetic aetiology and recording modality. Together, these findings show the potential of cross-species neural representation learning to map heterogeneous human disease onto experimentally tractable preclinical states and assess whether interventions restore human-relevant circuit function.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种跨物种对比表征学习框架（双规则对比学习），通过对齐小鼠与人类的神经电生理活动，构建"跨物种生物标志物"空间，以解决临床前模型预测人类药物疗效（尤其是神经系统疾病）能力差的问题。在验证性感觉刺激任务中恢复了跨物种保守的刺激响应轴；在癫痫场景中解析了三种小鼠模型与异质性人类癫痫患者的对应关系，并利用冻结的表征空间基于药物诱导的神经位移预测十种模型-药物组合的临床疗效排序（包括疾病特异性恶化效应）；在Fmr1敲除小鼠与人类16p11.2拷贝数变异携带者的跨模态、跨病因场景中识别出共同的疾病相关神经动力学。
AI.motivation: 临床前动物模型（尤其是神经系统疾病）对人类药物疗效的预测能力有限。传统方法依赖少量预定义的频谱或时序特征，难以区分疾病相关保守特征与物种、记录方式和实验背景带来的变异。需要一种能够跨越物种、记录模态差异，直接从神经活动中提取与生物状态相关的保守表征的方法，以更准确地评估临床前干预对人类疾病的相关性。
AI.method: 提出"双规则对比表征学习"框架：(1) 对齐规则——将表征相同生物状态（如健康-健康、疾病-疾病）的跨物种样本在潜空间中拉近；(2) 分离规则——将不同生物状态的样本在跨物种间推远。同时使用梯度反转物种分类器抑制物种身份信息占据共享表征空间。通过物种特定的输入模块将各自的神经记录映射到共享潜空间。应用于三个场景：(1) 健康人与小鼠的视听觉刺激EEG；(2) 三种小鼠癫痫模型（PTZ、AY9944、4-AP）与人类Temple大学医院癫痫EEG数据集（TUSZ/TUEP）；(3) Fmr1敲除小鼠高密度颅内电生理记录与人类16p11.2拷贝数变异携带者的头皮EEG。在药物评估中，使用完全冻结的表征空间（未经药物响应数据训练或微调），通过药物诱导的健康-疾病轴上位移预测临床疗效。
AI.result: (1) 感觉刺激：在6种感觉范式中有5种恢复出强跨物种方向一致性（余弦相似度0.83-1.00），从一种物种推导的轴可解码另一物种的刺激状态；(2) 癫痫：识别出PTZ和AY9944与人类失神发作相似、4-AP与强直-阵挛发作最匹配的对应关系；96名患者显示出对三种小鼠模型的差异性亲和力，且与抗癫痫药物负担、GABA能药物暴露等临床特征相关；(3) 药物评估：10种模型-药物组合中，神经"挽救"指标与人类临床疗效排序的Spearman相关系数达0.87（P=0.0039），优于传统的发作次数、高幅时间等EEG读出；tiagabine在AY9944模型中表现出与PTZ模型相反的位移方向，与临床已知其加重失神发作的现象一致；(4) Fmr1-16p11.2场景：复制携带者（+0.30）比缺失携带者（+0.07）显示出更强的Fmr1相关疾病表征对齐，符合二者均涉及皮层高兴奋性的生理学证据。
AI.conclusion: 跨物种神经表征学习能够绕过物种、记录模态和实验背景差异，直接从神经活动中识别与生物状态相关的保守维度，将异质性人类疾病映射到实验可控的临床前状态，并基于此评估干预是否恢复人类相关环路功能。该框架将神经活动从临床前表型修复的问题转化为跨物种保守疾病特征的修复问题，为预测性零样本药物疗效评估和患者分层提供了新途径，并支持将疾病按功能病理生理学而非诊断或基因型进行组织的概念。但仍存在样本量有限、依赖回顾性临床疗效评估、假定有效治疗必将神经活动推向平均健康状态等局限。

title: SafeInferCom: Safe Inference-Time Compute via Verifier-Guided Mid-Generation Intervention for Robotic Task Planning
summary: Large Reasoning Language Models (LRLMs) enable multi-step reasoning for robotic task planning, but continued reasoning can overwrite valid intermediate plans or leave constraint violations unresolved, reducing planning reliability and wasting inference-time computation. We develop an inference-time monitor that exposes and verifies intermediate plans without disrupting the original decoding trajectory. Building on this monitor, we propose SafeInferCom, a formal verifier-guided framework that preserves valid intermediate plans and directs error correction during generation. Experiments across multiple LRLMs and planning domains reveal reasoning-response inconsistency and limited self-correction under one-shot inference. SafeInferCom improves planning success and accelerates error correction relative to one-shot inference. When combined with iterative refinement, it further improves success while reducing token usage compared with refinement alone. We additionally evaluate SafeInferCom in VirtualHome and provide a real-world robotic-arm demonstration.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大推理语言模型（LRLM）在机器人任务规划中推理过程不稳定、可能覆盖正确中间计划或持续违反约束的问题，提出了SafeInferCom框架——一种由形式化验证器引导的中间生成干预方法，可在生成过程中保留有效中间计划并定向纠错。
AI.motivation: LRLM的额外推理并不总能带来更优计划：模型可能推理出有效中间计划但随后覆盖它，或让约束违反持续存在，导致规划可靠性下降并浪费推理计算资源。现有后验验证方法无法在生成过程中介入。
AI.method: 1) 推理时监控器：在不改变主解码轨迹的前提下，于推理过渡标记处从保存的检查点派生出候选计划π_k，并交由外部PDDL验证器评估；2) SafeInferCom控制器基于验证结果y_k∈{Valid, Safe-but-Not-Goal, Unsafe}执行四种动作：有效则提前终止、安全但未达成目标则继续推理（含在</think>处注入续推提示）、不安全则注入验证器诊断反馈e_k进行修正、连续N=3次相同违规则升级为整体重规划；3) KV缓存复用降低监控开销。
AI.result: 在5个PDDL领域（Blocksworld、Logistics、Depots、Gripper、Miconic）×3个DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen模型（7B/14B/32B）上：单独S使14B成功率从54.8%提升至78.2%；S+IR在三个规模上同时取得更高成功率和更低token消耗；R_corr在32B上从3.88降至1.99；在VirtualHome中14B成功率从20%升至59%；可跨LRLM家族（R1-14B、Qwen3-4B-Thinking、Phi-4-mini-reasoning）迁移；诱导保真度87.50%优于GPT-4o基线62.50%；32B端到端平均延迟与one-shot相当（130.01s vs 132.03s），KV缓存复用降低P95延迟30.9%。
AI.conclusion: SafeInferCom将形式化验证从事后检查前移至推理过程引导，提升规划可靠性与纠错效率，与迭代精化结合可获得最优的成功率-计算权衡，并在VirtualHome与真实机械臂上验证了实用性；未来工作方向包括扩展到自然语言任务规约、增量验证以及纳入计划质量目标。

title: When Lower Reconstruction Loss Hurts: Distributionally Robust Refinement for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
summary: Weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) relies heavily on reconstruction loss minimization to preserve model quality at low precision. We show that the weights favored by minimizing this loss need not yield better model performance on new tasks. In fact, we find that lower reconstruction loss can even degrade model performance on the same calibration data. Our analysis further shows that weights with lower reconstruction loss on calibration data can have higher loss than other weights when the distribution of input activations changes. Motivated by these observations and our analysis, we propose Distributionally Robust Quantization (DRQ), a post-hoc refinement process that minimizes worst-case reconstruction loss over a constrained set of input activation distributions. DRQ refines the integer codes representing quantized weights within the existing quantization grid, keeping quantization parameters and inference operators unchanged. Extensive experiments show that DRQ improves models quantized by six representative PTQ methods, including AWQ, GPTQ, and ParoQuant, and delivers gains across both dense and mixture-of-experts large language models. These results establish DRQ as a general post-hoc refinement framework for weight-only PTQ, achieving better downstream performance without adding inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文指出权重量化中最小化重建损失并不总能提升模型性能，提出一种分布鲁棒量化（DRQ）后处理精化方法，在固定量化网格内调整整数编码，最小化最坏情况重建损失，从而在不影响推理开销的前提下提升量化模型在下游任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 权重量化中常用的校准集重建损失最小化目标与模型实际部署性能之间存在显著偏差：降低校准重建损失甚至会损害模型在同一数据上的表现（困惑度），且输入激活分布变化时排序可能逆转。已有方法（如GPTQ、AWQ、ParoQuant）均默认该损失最小化等价于性能最优，但事实并非如此，且更多校准数据无法消除此失配。
AI.method: 提出Distributionally Robust Quantization (DRQ)：在固定量化网格（位宽、分组、scale、zero point均不变）上，仅调整量化权重的整数编码。核心是构建鲁棒重建目标 L_DRQ(Ŵ) = L(Ŵ) + α·S_C(Ŵ)，其中 S_C 是最坏方向性误差 max ‖(Ŵ−W)u‖²（约束 u⊤Cu=1）。算法逐Transformer块、逐层精化：估计最坏输入方向u→按其对目标函数的降低排序单码替换与双码配对→在多个前缀比例下生成候选→接受同时降低 L_DRQ 且不大幅增加重建损失的候选。C = (1−β)H + βI 调节对低幅通道的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.2 (1B/3B)、Llama-3.1 (8B/70B) 密集模型与Qwen3-30B-A3B MoE模型上，DRQ对GPTQ、AWQ、RTN、OmniQuant、GPTAQ、ParoQuant六种PTQ方法均有提升。在W2/W3/W4设置下均降低困惑度并提升七项零样本任务平均准确率（如Llama-3.1-70B GPTQ-W2准确率从48.23%升至54.56%；Llama-3.2-3B GPTQ-W3 C4 PPL从30.34降至22.11）。DRQ在vLLM上推理延迟与吞吐基本无变化（±0.8%），内存不变。Llama-3.1-8B W3离线精化约6分钟。
AI.conclusion: 权重校准重建损失与模型性能之间存在系统性失配，源于输入激活分布偏移会逆转损失排序。DRQ通过最坏情况重建损失目标在现有量化网格内调整整数编码，能在不改变推理算子与开销的前提下普遍提升多种PTQ方法在密集与MoE架构上的下游表现，确立了分布鲁棒精化作为权重量化后处理的有效通用框架。

title: Multimodal Graph Retrieval-Augmented Sequential Recommendation via Collaborative Filtering Paths
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong potential for sequential recommendation through their ability to reason over complex multimodal data. However, existing approaches either rely solely on the target user's own interaction history, neglecting collaborative signals from neighboring users, or incur substantial computational overhead through repeated MLLM inference over long interaction histories. To address these challenges, we propose MGRASRec, a multimodal graph retrieval-augmented framework for sequential recommendation. MGRASRec injects collaborative filtering signals conditioned on the candidate item directly into the MLLM prompt by retrieving structured paths from a user-item interaction graph, extended via multimodal similarity to increase coverage beyond exact co-interaction overlap. This retrieval also surfaces the history items most relevant to the candidate at no additional cost, removing the need for recurrent summarization and keeping inference to a single forward pass per candidate. All components are unified into an augmented prompt for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of an MLLM. Extensive evaluations across three publicly available datasets validate the effectiveness of MGRASRec, achieving the best performance on all metrics with particularly strong gains in ranking quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MGRASRec，一个面向多模态序列推荐的多模态图检索增强框架，通过在MLLM提示中直接注入基于用户-物品交互图路径的候选条件协同过滤信号，并利用多模态相似度扩展桥接物品覆盖范围，实现单次前向传播的高效参数高效微调，在三个公开数据集上所有指标均达到最优。
