AI.motivation: 现有基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的序列推荐方法存在两大核心缺陷：其一仅依赖目标用户自身历史，忽略了邻近用户的协同过滤信号；其二在处理长交互历史时通过循环调用MLLM进行摘要，带来昂贵的推理开销。协同过滤虽是公认提升推荐质量的关键，但稀疏的共交互重叠限制了候选信号的覆盖范围。
AI.method: 方法分三阶段：(1)图基协同过滤检索——构建用户-物品二分图，通过BFS检索连接目标用户与目标物品的3跳共交互路径，并利用CLIP（ViT-L/14）多模态嵌入与FAISS索引扩展4跳相似性路径，以视觉/语义相似物品作为桥接物品，覆盖率从约70%提升至接近100%；(2)路径引导的候选相关历史选择——将检索路径的首跳历史物品直接提取，按协同优先级排序并填充高频项，按时序恢复，零额外推理成本；(3)MLLM LoRA微调——使用LLaVA-v1.6-Mistral-7B作为骨干，采用LoRA（rank=16, α=32）参数高效微调，在增强提示中整合检索到的协同路径与筛选历史，推理时仅需单次"yes/no"二分类前向传播。
AI.result: 在Microlens、Amazon-Games、Amazon-Baby三个数据集上，MGRASRec在AUC/HR@5/MRR@5所有指标均优于GRU4Rec、SASRec、MMGCN、FREEDOM、TALLRec、LLaVA（LLaVA w/ SFT）及MLLM-MSR等基线。具体地，Microlens上达到AUC 89.55、HR@5 83.07、MRR@5 62.65，显著超越LLaVA w/ SFT的87.98/81.07/58.42。消融实验显示协同过滤信号为最主要贡献组件，而路径引导历史选择主要价值在于效率——保持推理成本对历史长度为常数，而MLLM-MSR则随历史长度线性增长。
AI.conclusion: MGRASRec证明将结构化图基协同路径注入MLLM提示是提升多模态序列推荐的有效路径，能在恒定推理成本下融合集体行为模式。未来工作可探索将图基协同信号融入开放集生成，使MLLM在约束解码下直接从全物品词表中生成下一物品。

title: SteerCast: Retrieval-Based Latent Steering for Decoder-Only Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting aims to predict future values from historical observations and auxiliary features. We propose \textbf{SteerCast}, a retrieval-based latent steering method that improves decoder-only forecaster at inference time, without updating its parameters. SteerCast constructs a database from the training set by storing a representation of each history window together with a \emph{steering vector} computed in the forecaster's latent space, defined as the difference between representations induced by the ground-truth continuation and by the model's own prediction. At test time, SteerCast retrieves nearest neighbors for a query history, aggregates their steering vectors, and injects the resulting signal into the forecaster's hidden states at every step of autoregressive generation, guiding predictions toward trajectories consistent with similar training cases. Experiments across diverse multivariate benchmarks and multiple horizons show that SteerCast consistently improves forecasting accuracy over the fine-tuned backbone and retrieval-based baselines, while requiring no additional training beyond the original fine-tuning and using only the training set as a retrieval corpus.

AI.tldr: SteerCast 是一种面向 decoder-only 时间序列预测模型的测试时检索式潜在干预方法，无需更新模型参数。它从训练集构建一个键值数据库，其中键为历史窗口的表征，值为"引导向量"（ground-truth 与模型预测在潜在空间中的表征差）。推理时检索近邻并聚合其引导向量，配合余弦相似性门控与ℓ2 归一化，注入到自回归生成的每一层隐藏状态中。在 10 个多变量基准（含 ETT、Exchange、Weather、Illness、Monash 等）与三种 SOTA decoder-only 骨干（Time-MoE、Timer-XL、TimesFM）上，跨多种预测时域均一致超越 fine-tune 及 RAFT/RAF 检索基线，且推理开销极小（仅比 FT 慢约 1.12×，远低于 RAFT 的 1.60×）。
AI.motivation: decoder-only 时间序列基础模型即使经过 fine-tuning，仍在长时域、罕见模式或分布偏移下存在系统性错误；进一步训练/集成/扩展虽然能缓解，但计算开销大且可能损害鲁棒性。受 LLM 中潜在干预/steering 思路启发，作者希望在完全不更新参数的前提下，通过测试时检索与潜在空间编辑来提升 fine-tuned 预测器的精度，并避开在 decoder-only 模型的固定上下文窗口中 prepend 检索历史带来的 O(L²) 注意力开销。
AI.method: 1) 数据库构建：对每个训练样本 (x,y)，用 fine-tuned 模型 F 得到预测 ŷ=F(x)，然后分别对拼接序列 [x;ŷ] 与 [x;y] 提取各 Transformer block 最后 token 残差流状态 h_pred 与 h_gt，其差 Δ = h_gt − h_pred 即"引导向量"，键 r(x) 为最终层隐藏状态在时间维上的均值池化。2) 推理时检索：对查询 x，用同一前向得到其键 r_q，在 M 中以欧氏距离取 top-k 邻居，对应的 Δ 取均值得到聚合向量 Δ(x)。3) 注入规则：在每个生成 token f、每个 block l 处先对 Δ^(l) 做 ℓ2 归一化（解耦方向与尺度），再利用基于余弦相似度的 ReLU 门 α_{f,l}=b+ReLU(−cos(h_{f,l},Δ^(l))+m)^p 控制何时/多强地施加扰动，最终更新为 h̃=h+λ·α·Δ/‖Δ‖。整个机制仅一个全局强度 λ 与三个门控超参 (b,m,p)，无需任何梯度更新。
AI.result: 在 10 个数据集、3 个 SOTA decoder-only 骨干下，SteerCast 多数情况下取得最低或并列最低 MSE：在 various look-back 设置下 30 个 dataset–backbone 单元中胜出 25 个，相对 RAF 平均降低 7.4%；在 fixed 512 look-back 设置下胜出 24/30，平均较 FT/RAF/RAFT 分别降低 5.1%/5.3%/2.7%，长时域增益尤为显著。消融显示：全层注入优于单层插入，π 型余弦门在长时域避免误差累积，固定键用最后一层表征最优；数据库越大检索距离与 MSE 同步下降；输出空间残差同等配比 baseline 退化明显，证明优势来自潜在空间感知校正；即使对未 fine-tuned 的预训练检查点，6 个设定中 5 个仍能从默认 λ=0.01 获得改进。推理耗时仅比 FT 慢约 12%、约 RAFT 的 70%。
AI.conclusion: SteerCast 证明测试时潜在空间检索式干预是改进 decoder-only 时间序列预测器的有效且轻量途径——无需额外训练即可在不同骨干、跨域数据集和多预测时域稳定提升精度，对长时域误差累积有显著缓解。其在解耦方向/尺度、自适应门控、检索与输入空间解耦上的设计为时间序列基础模型与 LLM 式 steering 思想架起桥梁；未来可向 encoder-based 模型扩展、引入近似最近邻/量化压缩以应对超大规模语料，并探索学习式邻居聚合与跨域迁移等。方法存在架构范围限制与少量数据集/骨干组合上不及 RAFT 等负结果，需谨慎报告。

title: Harness Compilation: Which Decisions Should a Small Vision-Language Model Keep?
summary: Small vision-language models may be able to read external evidence yet struggle to obtain it. We introduce Harness Compilation (HC), an offline procedure that adapts the division of work between a frozen small VLM and its external harness. A large teacher uses student execution traces to revise reusable content and control, while a separate validation set selects the deployed harness. Deployment requires neither weight updates nor teacher calls. Across seven visual question-answering settings with students of at most 9B parameters, HC improves scores over bare students by 9.9-23.9 points, averaged over three independent builds per setting. Interventions on five runtime decision types (invocation, selection, argument generation, evidence integration and abstention) show why this allocation matters: requesting evidence and generating open queries can be costly, whereas bounded choices and reading supplied text can remain useful student work. Fact cards benefit all ten evaluated students, but decision policies transfer unevenly. Recompilation for a new student model helps when the transferred interface no longer fits the student. With 100 practice items, HC exceeds answer-only LoRA on three tasks. Larger training budgets can match or surpass a fixed harness, while combining the two improves SlideVQA beyond either alone. These findings support allocating work from measured student behavior rather than uniformly removing decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Harness Compilation (HC)"方法，通过离线的大模型教师利用学生执行轨迹，将任务分配和决策接口适配到冻结的小型视觉语言模型（VLM），在7个VQA任务上将宏平均分从48.3提升到62.9，并发现证据检索决策代价高而有限选择和阅读证据适合学生执行。
AI.motivation: 小型视觉语言模型虽能读取外部证据，但在获取证据（请求、选择、生成查询）方面存在困难；现有harness设计未考虑学生实际能力，可能超出其处理范围，亟需一种基于学生行为测量的离线适配方法。
AI.method: 提出Harness Compilation (HC)：1) 定义五种决策自由度（Decide/Select/Generate/Integrate/Persist）；2) 大模型教师基于学生执行轨迹在probe集上迭代修订harness（提示、路由、记忆、解析器等）；3) 在独立验证集上选择最终harness；4) 部署时冻结学生模型，无需教师调用或权重更新。同时进行接口干预实验、跨学生迁移实验和与LoRA的对比实验。
AI.result: 在7个VQA任务（InfoSeek、DocVQA、SlideVQA、LiveVQA、BLINK反射率/对应/深度）上，HC使宏平均分从48.3提升至62.9（提升9.9-23.9分），全部21次构建均优于裸学生；接口干预显示要求显式资源请求（-9.0分于InfoSeek）和开放实体命名（-13.3分）代价高，而有限选择可保留；事实卡片对全部10个受测学生均有效，但决策策略迁移不均；100个标注数据下HC在三项任务上优于answer-only LoRA；SlideVQA上harness与LoRA结合达63.7分，优于任一单独使用。
AI.conclusion: 任务工作分配应基于学生实际行为测量而非统一移除决策；获取证据和生成开放查询对学生代价高，而有限选择和阅读证据是学生可保留的有用工作；harness与权重适应可互补，为资源受限的本地VLM部署提供了实用方案。

title: MiniVer-V: Identifying Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Short Video Verification
summary: A core challenge in short-video fact-checking is identifying which evidence is sufficient to support a verification conclusion. Existing approaches either give the verifier all available evidence, introducing noise, or select evidence by topical relevance, which conflates relatedness with sufficiency. We identify evidential sufficiency as the selection criterion: whether a subset of evidence is adequate to support a confident verdict without redundancy. We introduce MiniVer-V, a benchmark of 195 short videos with three-way verdict annotations (supported, refuted, insufficient) and 5,510 multimodal evidence units spanning visual keyframes, speech transcripts, and web-retrieved external sources. We propose a two-layer verification framework that separates claim-video consistency, assessed from internal evidence, from factual verdict determination, which additionally requires external corroboration. On top of it, a sufficiency-driven greedy search assembles evidence until a sufficiency threshold is met and outputs insufficient when the candidate pool is exhausted, rather than forcing a verdict. With Claude Sonnet 4, the method reaches a Macro-F1 of 0.510 using 4.5 evidence units on average (16% of the full evidence set), statistically indistinguishable from the full-evidence baseline (0.518 with 27.7 units), while significantly improving recognition of insufficient cases over the same search without abstention. The efficiency result replicates with GPT-5.5 and holds only partially with an open-weight Qwen2.5-72B verifier. Ablations show that external evidence is indispensable for factual determination, while internal video evidence grounds the verdict in claim-video consistency. These findings suggest that evidence-efficient verification is achievable, and that explicit abstention is needed when evidence is genuinely inadequate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出短视频事实核查新任务"最小充分证据集识别"（MiniVer-V），构建包含195个视频、5510个多模态证据单元的基准数据集，并设计一种基于充分性驱动的贪婪搜索与显式弃判机制的两层验证框架。实验表明，该方法仅用16%的证据即可恢复全证据基准98.5%的Macro-F1性能，同时显著提升对"证据不足"类别的识别能力。
AI.motivation: 现有短视频事实核查方法存在三个局限：1）将所有证据输入验证器会引入噪声；2）基于话题相关性选择证据混淆了"相关性"与"充分性"；3）缺乏显式弃判机制，在证据不足时仍强制给出判定，危害高风险场景。论文指出短视频核查需要的是确定哪些证据足以支撑可信判定，而非仅检索相关证据。
AI.method: 1）任务形式化：将"最小充分证据集识别"作为短视频核查的新任务，要求模型从多模态证据池中选取既充分又紧凑的子集，并在证据不足时显式弃判。2）基准数据集MiniVer-V：195个带三分类标注（支持/反驳/证据不足）的短视频，5510个模态标注的证据单元（V视觉关键帧描述、A语音转写、E外部网络检索），三模态统一以文本形式表示。3）两层验证框架：Layer 1仅基于内部证据（V+A）评估"主张-视频一致性"，Layer 2结合外部证据（E）确定事实性判定。4）五级证据选择策略：B1全证据、B2固定预算Top-K、B3思维链自选、B4充分性驱动贪婪搜索（含冗余剪枝）、B5在B4基础上增加弃判门控（候选池耗尽且未达阈值τ=0.8时输出"证据不足"）。5）候选池构建：从排序后的证据列表中选10个单元，至少包含2个内部单元和3个外部单元以防止单模态主导。6）采用Claude Sonnet 4为主验证器，并复现于GPT-5.5和Qwen2.5-72B。
AI.result: 主要结果（Claude Sonnet 4，195样本）：1）B5以平均4.5个证据单元达到Macro-F1 0.510，恢复全证据基线B1性能（0.518，27.7单元）的98.5%，差异不显著（95%CI[-0.08,+0.06]），仅用16%证据量。2）B5在高效方法中Macro-F1最高，超出B2-B4约0.04-0.06。3）固定预算Top-K（B2）在不同k下Macro-F1均低于0.47，且弃判行为随k剧烈变化，说明相关性不足以保证充分性。4）B3（CoT自选）Accuracy最高（57.4%）但Macro-F1仅0.453，过度承诺率达94.9%，暴露自选策略的系统性过度自信。5）弃判贡献：B5较B4将insufficient类F1从0.253提升至0.383（p=0.010），弃判召回近乎翻倍（0.203→0.390，p<0.001）。消融研究：6）去外部证据：Macro-F1暴跌0.196至0.273，为最大单组件效应，证明外部证据对事实判定不可或缺。7）去内部证据（仅E）：Macro-F1不变（0.484 vs B4的0.469），但Layer 1一致性评估100%输出"无法判定"，证明内部证据提供与视频内容相关的可解释基础。8）去ASR或去剪枝：均无显著变化，剪枝减少24%证据量而不损精度。跨模型验证：9）GPT-5.5复现效率结论（B5恢复95.3% B1性能，18%证据量）；Qwen2.5-72B仅部分成立（84.3%），因充分性判断过早终止（60%样本仅选1个单元）。人类验证：10）B5与三人标注的最小充分集平均Jaccard相似度0.882，71.8%样本完全匹配，召回0.970，标注集平均3.74单元vs B5的4.46单元。稳健性检验：11）原始关键帧与文本描述在60个样本上的对比表明信息损失不显著（0.561 vs 0.585，p=0.69）。错误分析：12）89个错误中36个为漏弃判（证据不足样本被判为"支持"），主导失败模式为充分性误判而非极性混淆。
AI.conclusion: 1）短视频核查可实现证据高效的验证：基于充分性的动态选择仅用16%证据即可恢复98.5%全证据性能。2）"充分性"应作为证据选择的第一类标准，而非仅依赖相关性。3）内外部证据功能不对称：外部证据决定事实判定（去除后Macro-F1崩塌0.196），内部证据将判定锚定于视频内容（提供可解释的Layer 1一致性信号）。4）显式弃判机制对于校准不确定性不可或缺：缺乏弃判的系统在证据不足时表现出94.9%的过度承诺率。5）该方法跨验证器迁移：较强模型（Claude、GPT-5.5）完整复现，开放权重Qwen因充分性判断粗糙而仅部分成立，说明方法收益依赖于验证器的充分性判断质量。6）未来方向：扩大数据集规模与多样性、测试非Claude的描述模型、引入视频基础检索策略、利用对抗性样本加强Layer 1鉴别力。

title: Low-Cost Sensor Calibration for Indoor Air Quality Monitoring: A Dataset, Evaluation Scenarios, and a Lightweight Model
summary: Low-cost sensors enable scalable indoor air quality monitoring but require calibration because of nonlinear distortions, noise, and temporal drift. The conventional strict pairwise calibration setting requires a co-located reference sensor at each deployment location and does not account for spatial and temporal heterogeneity. To address these limitations, we introduce a six-month dataset comprising multivariate indoor air-quality measurements from low-cost and reference sensors with contextual metadata collected at five locations. Using this dataset, we define four evaluation scenarios. The reference-efficient and location-transfer scenarios evaluate spatial generalization, whereas the long-term drift and event-conditioned scenarios assess robustness to gradual and abrupt distribution shifts. Based on these scenarios, we derive design requirements and propose a lightweight temporal model that combines input-window compression with residual temporal and feature fusion. Experiments show strong calibration performance across all four scenarios with low edge-inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向室内空气质量监测的低成本传感器校准基准，包括一个六个月五位置的数据集、四个评估场景以及一个轻量级时序模型，用于解决传统严格成对校准在实际部署中面临的参考传感器稀缺、空间异质性和时间漂移等问题。
AI.motivation: 低成本传感器可大规模部署用于室内空气质量监测，但因非线性失真、噪声和时漂需校准；传统严格成对校准要求每个部署点都配备共址参考传感器，成本高昂且未考虑空间与时间异质性，难以实用化。
AI.method: 1) 构建六个月数据集：大学实验室五个位置（东、西、南、北、中）同步采集低成本与参考传感器的CO₂、CO、PM₁、温度、湿度数据，并附带门窗状态等事件元数据；2) 定义四个评估场景：参考高效（S1）、位置迁移（S2）、长期漂移（S3）、事件条件（S4）；3) 设计轻量级无注意力MLP模型，包含输入窗口压缩、残差时序与特征融合及标量输出头，满足五项设计需求。
AI.result: 在户外SensEURCity及自建室内数据集上，模型在所有四个场景的多数变量上取得最低RMSE，并在Arduino Nano 33 BLE Sense边缘设备上实现快速推理与低内存占用，长输入窗口下优于DLinear和TESLA。
AI.conclusion: 所提数据集与场景可揭示标准评估所掩盖的部署挑战，轻量模型在参考受限、位置迁移、长期漂移和事件条件下均表现稳健且适合边缘部署；局限在于单一建筑环境及元数据分辨率限制，未来将扩展至多场景并探索在线自适应以缓解长期漂移。

title: Read What Matters: Query-Adaptive Quantization for KV Caches
summary: KV-cache entries are stored before their future queries are known, but each decoding query needs precision in different places. We study this mismatch using separate budgets for retained bits and bits fetched per query. ReadKV stores each key and value in a progressive code whose prefixes support different reconstruction precisions. For each query, it allocates key-channel prefixes using the query, computes attention from the reconstructed keys, and then allocates value-token prefixes using that attention. Stored entries remain unchanged. Each stage optimizes a calibrated distortion objective under a fixed budget; we prove exact allocation under diminishing refinement gains and relate these objectives to attention-output error. We also exhibit a finite-dimensional attention family where query-dependent access strictly outperforms every query-independent reader at the same read budget, even with unrestricted competing encoders and decoders. Across six base models, reading four bits on average from an eight-bit cache increases C4 perplexity by at most 0.66%, using about one quarter of the logical reads and half the retained capacity of a 16-bit cache. It is consistently more accurate than storing and fully reading four bits at the same payload-read budget. Retaining more bits than each query fetches is aimed at long-context decoding, where the cache bytes moved per step, rather than the weights, dominate cost. Long-context question answering and retrieval on two instruction-tuned models provide additional quality evidence. On the tested 8K-token, batch-one, single-layer workload on an NVIDIA A10G, a restricted eight-bit ReadKV reader with a two-bit mean payload-read budget has 39% lower latency than the tested TurboQuant codec.

AI.tldr: ReadKV提出了一种面向KV缓存的查询自适应量化方法，通过渐进式编码分离存储预算W和读取预算R，在不修改存储条目的前提下让每个查询选择性地获取不同精度的前缀。两阶段读取器首先由当前查询分配键通道前缀，再利用重建注意力分配值令牌前缀。在六个基础模型上，(W=8, R=4)设定下C4困惑度仅增加≤0.66%，逻辑读取量约为16位密集缓存的四分之一；单层GPU测试显示相比TurboQuant编解码器延迟降低39%。
AI.motivation: 长上下文自回归语言模型的KV缓存存在"写一次、读多次"的不对称结构。现有方法将存储精度与读取精度耦合，每步解码都需要获取全部已存比特，导致长上下文和大批量场景下缓存带宽成为瓶颈。需要一种解耦存储精度W与每查询读取精度R的方法，使缓存能为不同查询请求提供不同精度，同时保留未读取的细节以供后续查询使用。
AI.method: ReadKV采用渐进式标量编码（基于高斯Lloyd树）为每个键值标量存储W位路径，前缀支持多级重建精度。读取为两阶段：第一批由当前查询根据q_c²σ²分配键通道前缀深度t^K_g,c，第二批根据重建的注意力权重分配值令牌前缀深度t^V_g,j。通过Algorithm 1中的ChooseDepths贪心算法在每个阶段以校准失真目标D(t)为权重迭代分配最大正边际增益的精化位。理论上分别用定理1（键阶段分离）和定理2（两阶段注意力分离）证明在有限维输入族上查询依赖访问严格优于查询独立分支读者；定理3证明边际增益分配在递减精化增益条件下对各阶段目标是最优的。
AI.result: 在六个基础模型（Qwen2.5 3B/7B/14B、Yi-1.5 6B、DeepSeek-LLM-7B、Mistral-7B-v0.3）的C4语言建模评估中，ReadKV (W=8, R=4)在所有模型上困惑度增加不超过0.66%，使用约Dense四分之一的逻辑读取量和二分之一的KV容量；在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3上的LongBench QA任务（7,500词符提示）中，F1损失最多1.46点。NVIDIA A10G单层、8K词符、批大小1的工作负载下，受限ReadKV (W=8, R=2)以平均2位读取预算实现0.093 ms延迟，比TurboQuant编解码器（0.154 ms）低39%，DRAM读取量减少62-65%。
AI.conclusion: ReadKV通过渐进式编码和两阶段查询自适应读取实现了存储精度与每查询读取精度的解耦，在固定读取预算下保持更高质量。理论方面，在有限维输入族上证明了查询依赖访问对查询独立读者的严格优势，并给出了阶段最优分配保证和注意力输出误差证书。经验方面，在保持≤0.66% C4困惑度损失的同时将逻辑读取量降至约四分之一，并在单层GPU基准测试中实现39%延迟降低。该方法适用于长上下文场景，其中每步移动的缓存字节而非权重主导成本。

title: Why On-Policy Distillation Sometimes Fails: Vanishing Learning Signals
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) enables effective capability transfer between language models, yet the mechanisms underlying its failures are not fully understood. Across code generation and mathematical reasoning, OPD with larger-scale teachers exhibits early loss plateaus, with an average final loss reduction of 25.1% after 200 updates, compared with 96.2% for self-RL teachers, obtained by further reinforcement learning (RL) training of the initial student. To understand this difference, we analyze OPD as an idealized continuous-time dynamical system in the small-learning-rate limit. Our training-log diagnostics associate these plateaus with an early decline in a gradient-based learning-signal proxy while substantial loss remains; these measurements do not establish why the underlying gradient weakens. We further prove a local recovery guarantee for teachers sufficiently close to the initial student in a shared parameterization under regularity conditions, offering a conditional explanation for the success of self-RL teachers in our experiments. Across runs with and without loss plateaus, we observe small relative parameter changes (0.025-0.098%) and high similarity between the student's representations before and after OPD (linear CKA $>0.98$ across layers). These observations suggest that limited representation adaptation may contribute to learning-signal collapse, a hypothesis that remains to be tested. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在大型语言模型中失败的原因。通过实验与理论分析发现，当使用比学生模型规模更大的教师时，OPD 损失会在训练早期出现平台期，而损失的大部分仍未下降。作者将 OPD 建模为连续时间动力系统，推导出损失衰减率 γ = μ(1+α)，其中 μ 是学习信号强度、α 是占据梯度与更新方向的对齐程度。实验观察到在平台期，μ 出现"过早崩溃"。论文还证明了当教师（与学生共享参数化）充分接近学生时，OPD 流动可以在局部恢复损失的充分条件。参数和表征分析表明，OPD 训练后学生模型的变化极小（参数变化 0.025–0.098%，各层 CKA > 0.98），作者由此提出假设：表征适应不足可能是学习信号崩溃的原因，但仍需验证。
AI.motivation: 尽管在线策略蒸馏（OPD）是语言模型后训练中能力迁移的重要方法，但已有研究表明使用更强的教师并不总能提升学生表现。作者旨在探究 OPD 在使用比学生规模更大的教师时为何会失败——具体表现为损失早期停滞而师生差异仍然很大。
AI.method: 1) 在代码生成和数学推理任务上进行七组主实验，对比使用 self-RL 教师（通过对学生进一步 RL 训练得到）与大规模教师时的 OPD 表现；2) 将 OPD 建模为小学习率极限下的连续时间常微分方程，分解损失衰减率为 γ=μ(1+α)；3) 利用训练日志中的梯度范数和损失构造学习信号代理 μ̂，分析其变化；4) 通过交叉拟合估计占据因子 1+α̂；5) 理论证明当教师充分接近学生（同参数化、距离 ρ）时，损失可在局部以指数速率衰减至由低曲率方向决定的残差水平；6) 用相对参数变化 d_par 与线性 CKA 量化 OPD 后学生模型参数和表征的变化。
AI.result: 关键实验结果：使用大规模教师时，OPD 损失最大降幅仅 30.4–65.1%（平均最终 25.1%），同时仅恢复 13.0–47.5% 的性能差距；而使用 self-RL 教师时，损失降幅达 96.3–99.5%（平均 96.2%），恢复 70.7–77.4% 的性能差距。训练日志显示大规模教师条件下学习信号代理 μ̂ 在分界步（代码 step 15、数学 step 30）后下降 9–12 倍，而此时超过 60% 损失仍未下降（即"过早学习信号崩溃"）。占据因子 1+α̂ 仅在部分检查点上为负，未能完全解释平台期。所有八次 OPD 运行后，学生参数相对变化 0.025–0.098%，层间最小 CKA ≥ 0.985。定理 C.1 给出局部恢复界：损失 ≤ e^(-δt)L(θ₀) + E_Δ(δ) + O(ρ³+ρ⁴/δ)，其中 ρ 为师生参数距离。SFT 初始化未能消除 OPD 平台期。
AI.conclusion: OPD 的失败模式源于训练早期学习信号的过早崩溃：当学生与大规模教师不共享相同参数化且参数距离相对较远时，由损失衰减率分解可见，模型参数与表征仅有微小变化（CKA>0.98）。理论上的局部恢复保证可解释 self-RL 教师为何能在实验中成功——它们在共享参数空间内距离学生极近（0.030%–0.50%）。作者提出"表征适应受限可能促成学习信号崩溃"的假设，但坦承该假设尚待受控实验验证。未来工作需要结合不同学习率、训练预算与种子的受控干预，将优化层面的限制与表征层面的限制区分开来。

title: V-CoLA: Vision Token Compression with Linear Attention
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities but suffer from substantial computational overhead, as vision tokens dominate the input sequence. This motivates vision token compression as a key direction to alleviate the burden. However, with the emergence of hybrid architectures incorporating linear attention (\eg, Qwen3.5), prior methods designed for softmax attention struggle to generalize. Our analysis reveals that both attention- and similarity-based approaches suffer notable performance degradation, underscoring the urgent need for compression methods tailored to this regime. To this end, we propose \textbf{V-CoLA}, an efficient training-free token compression framework specifically designed for linear attention. V-CoLA introduces a novel \textit{uniqueness-aware importance criterion} for identifying critical vision tokens, coupled with an \textit{adaptive token merging strategy} that performs compression. All components are optimized at the implementation level to remain compatible with the chunk-wise parallelism of linear attention, ensuring strong practical value. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of V-CoLA: it achieves 99.5\% of the original performance with only 50.0\% of vision tokens, and over 88.0\% with as few as 12.5\%, while delivering a 1.86$\times$ to 6.15$\times$ prefill speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出V-CoLA，一种面向混合线性注意力架构视觉语言模型（VLM）的免训练视觉token压缩框架。该方法通过"唯一性感知的token重要性准则"和"自适应分块token合并策略"，结合实现级优化，显著降低计算开销同时保持模型性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型中视觉token数量远超文本token，带来巨大的计算负担。现有基于softmax注意力的token压缩方法（基于注意力分数或特征相似度）难以迁移到采用线性注意力的混合架构（如Qwen3.5）。作者通过实验和理论分析揭示了这种迁移失败的本质原因——线性注意力有界循环状态的信息论上限。
AI.method: 1. 从Gated DeltaNet的重建误差视角提出线性注意力的内禀token重要性信号；2. 设计唯一性感知的token重要性准则，结合长期状态重建贡献（ℛ^imp）和短期唯一性（ℛ^uni），使用伪查询探测状态变化；3. 提出自适应分块token合并策略，按重要性分布密度动态划分token块，在块内进行加权合并；4. 视觉token早退机制，在深层直接丢弃视觉token；5. 全部实现与线性注意力的chunk-wise并行兼容。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-9B上的8个基准测试中，V-CoLA仅保留50%的视觉token即可保留99.5%的原始性能，保留12.5%时仍保留超过88%的性能。在不同token规模（2K-8K）下实现1.86×到6.15×的预填充加速，压缩开销仅占总前向成本的1.6%（约0.86ms）。方法在Qwen3.5-27B和InfiniteVL上也展现出一致的泛化能力，并经实验验证理论加速比与实际测量高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: V-CoLA首创性地将token重要性估计建立在混合线性注意力架构的内禀动力学之上，摆脱了既有方法对softmax注意力分数或特征相似度的依赖。其自适应分块合并与早退机制进一步提升效率；通过实现级优化完全兼容chunk-wise并行，兼具学术价值与工程实用性。

title: Neuro-Memory Fuzzy Inference System for Mimicking Human-like Car Following Behavior
summary: This study presents the Neuro-Memory Fuzzy Inference System (NeMeFIS), a hierarchical machine learning architecture that asymmetrically models acceleration and deceleration in car following behavior by integrating five human memory types procedural, working, episodic, semantic, and declarative. By linking external variables to memory functions via metaheuristics and validating them through factor and p-value analyses, NeMeFIS uncovers latent cognitive influences across Arterial, Collector, and Rural Highway corridors for different types of vehicles. Results from 54 different trained models emphasize cognitive thresholds shaped by driver perception limits and cognitive load. The trained NeMeFIS models outperform traditional statistical and conventional machine learning models in replicating realistic driving behavior, including comparisons with Linear Regression, ANFIS, and LSTM architectures. Fuzzy rule analysis reveals that declarative memory demands the highest rule, especially during deceleration, indicating complex braking decisions. Procedural memory drives acceleration, while semantic and declarative memory guide deceleration. Risk perception also emerges as a key factor, particularly on urban roads. Validated on both heterogeneous and homogeneous datasets, NeMeFIS offers a robust framework for modeling driver cognition. The findings support psychotherapeutic applications and the development of adaptive, human-like decision systems in Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) to enhance traffic safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为NeMeFIS（Neuro-Memory Fuzzy Inference System）的分层机器学习架构，通过整合人类五种记忆类型（程序性、工作、情景、语义和陈述性记忆），对车辆跟驰行为中的加速和减速过程进行非对称建模。该系统在多种道路和车辆类型上验证，优于传统统计方法和机器学习方法，适用于CAV的自适应决策系统。
AI.motivation: 传统的车辆跟驰模型缺乏对驾驶员认知机制（尤其是不同记忆类型对加速/减速的非对称影响）的建模，难以准确模拟真实驾驶行为。需要一种能融合认知科学与机器学习的方法来揭示潜在的认知影响因素，并提升自动驾驶系统的拟人化决策能力。
AI.method: 提出NeMeFIS分层架构，通过元启发式算法将外部变量映射到五种人类记忆功能，利用因子分析和p值分析进行验证；在三类道路（主干道、支路、乡村公路）和不同车辆类型上训练54个模型；与线性回归、ANFIS和LSTM进行性能对比；通过模糊规则分析揭示各记忆类型在加速/减速中的作用。
AI.result: 在异质和同质数据集上，NeMeFIS均优于线性回归、ANFIS和LSTM等基线模型；发现认知阈值受驾驶员感知限制和认知负荷影响；陈述性记忆在减速（尤其是制动决策）中需要最复杂的规则，程序性记忆主导加速，语义和陈述性记忆引导减速；风险感知在城市道路中尤为关键。
AI.conclusion: NeMeFIS提供了一个建模驾驶员认知的稳健框架，其发现支持心理治疗应用，并有助于开发自适应、类人决策系统以提升联网自动驾驶车辆（CAVs）的交通安全。

title: LLM-IDEA: Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent for Autonomous Discovery of Mechanistic World Models
summary: Large language model agents are being increasingly deployed as autonomous scientists, designing experiments and inferring mechanistic world models with minimal human oversight. Yet identifiability is often overlooked: when a plateau is reached, the agent needs to know whether it is not yet capable enough or the model simply is not identifiable from the data, in which case no amount of further experimentation of the same kind can help. We propose the Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent (LLM-IDEA) for closed-loop discovery with an identifiability engine that returns a three-way plateau verdict: capability limit, resolvable within the design class, or certified exhausted. On ODEBench, 60 of the 62 systems with free constants are identifiable at round 0; the RC circuit is certified exhausted for every experiment that protocol can run, and a harvesting model is resolvable by one added initial condition. The identifiability engine reproduces known verdicts on Lotka-Volterra, Van der Pol, Lorenz, and a pharmacokinetic model, where it recommends the intravenous arm pharmacologists use, and it ranks the depth scorer of our own benchmark last among four observation designs. On the DiscoverPhysics benchmark, it finds two public worlds whose explanation rubric rewards a distinction no legal experiment can make, and every model there with accurate trajectories failed the explanation grade (15 of 15, against 5 of 9 in identifiable worlds, p = 0.012). On the Alien Universe, a two-body testbed we propose in which a force law switches between a provably non-identifiable and an identifiable protocol, LLM-IDEA on the identifiable protocol reaches discovery depth at least three on 8/8 seeds versus 1/8 without it. An autonomous discovery agent can thus compute, rather than guess, whether a plateau calls for more search, a better experiment of the same kind, or a different kind of experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-IDEA（Identifiability-Driven Experimental Agent），将基于语言模型的科学发现Agent与确定性的可识别性诊断引擎相结合，通过灵敏度矩阵的秩和零空间分析，为Agent遭遇的"平台期"提供三路分流判定（能力限制、类内可解、需换类），并通过Rothenberg定理证明在正则点上的证书可靠性。
AI.motivation: 自治科学发现Agent在遇到模型改进停滞时，无法区分是自身能力不足还是数据本身不具备可识别性（identifiability）。当参数在观测协议下结构上不可识别时，任何同类实验都无法突破该平台期，导致Agent要么在无法约束的目标上无谓优化，要么给出拟合良好但无预测力的虚假世界模型。
AI.method: 确定性诊断引擎：在工作点处计算机理模型的局部灵敏度矩阵秩与条件数，零空间给出不可识别的参数方向；设计排序器按秩优先、条件数次优对候选实验排序；证书机制通过符号路线（sympy精确有理算术）或数值路线（堆叠采样设计的灵敏度矩阵）证明某混淆方向是否为整个设计类的对称性，提出Proposition 1（Rothenberg定理在设计类上的推广），要求在正则点处类秩稳定以保证证书soundness；耦合语言模型提议器（Agentic Council）与引擎形成闭环并实现三种停止状态：solved、exhausted_by_certificate、exhausted。
AI.result: 在ODEBench上62个含自由常数的系统中60个在第0轮即可识别，RC电路被证书证明对LLM-ACES协议下的任何实验均不可识别，收获模型通过增加一个初始条件即可类内解决；在DiscoverPhysics基准上发现两个公开世界（fractional和circle）的解释评分奖励了任何合法实验都无法区分的区别（分数Laplacian算子vs幂律），所有轨迹准确模型在这两个世界的解释等级全部失败（15/15 vs 可识别世界的5/9，Fisher精确检验p=0.012）；在提出的Alien Universe测试床上，可识别协议使深度≥3的发现率从1/8提升至8/8；重现了Lotka-Volterra、Van der Pol、Lorenz及药物代谢模型的口服非识别性，并推荐药理学家已使用的静脉注射方案；在自身基准的评分设计上将排名末位；在选择标准对比中A-最优设计在精度上优于本文秩优先策略。
AI.conclusion: 将可识别性分析器集成进Agent的闭环使Agent能够计算而非猜测平台期的性质，从而采取"继续搜索"、"同类中更好的实验"或"换一类实验"的决策；该方法在正则点处的证书可靠性由Rothenberg定理保证，奇点处通过秩稳定性检验被检测并拒绝；类内度量对已证书混淆方向天然盲视，这解释了为何DiscoverPhysics中的Agent会在轨迹准确的情况下丢失解释分。

title: Residual spectral instabilities in representation learning
summary: Learned representations can lose latent degrees of freedom successively, suggesting a cascade of transitions whose underlying stability principle remains unclear. Here we formulate dimension-wise posterior collapse in variational autoencoder (VAE) as a fluctuation theory around partially collapsed states. Interpreting the negative evidence lower bound as an effective free energy, its quadratic expansion defines a Gaussian theory whose Hessian acts as a mass matrix for latent fluctuations. We show that the collapsed directions form an invariant fluctuation sector and derive its exact mass spectrum in terms of a conditional residual operator. A local reactivation direction lowers the free energy when the decoder variance falls below the residual spectral upper edge, with equality marking marginality. The criterion recovers principal component thresholds in the linear Gaussian VAE limit. Viewed in reverse along continuously connected branches, the reactivation boundary provides a local criterion for successive collapse. Numerical continuation experiments show successive loss of latent dimensions near these spectral marginalities. These results support a spectral cascade interpretation governed by residual information left unexplained by the surviving representation.

AI.tldr: 本文为变分自编码器（VAE）中维度级后验坍缩（posterior collapse）提出了一种基于残差谱的统计物理框架：将负ELBO视为有效自由能，通过围绕部分坍缩稳态的高斯涨落理论，推导出坍缩方向构成Hessian的不变扇区，并利用条件残差算子精确求得质量谱。稳定性判据为当且仅当解码器方差低于残差谱上界时存在重启激活方向，并在线性高斯VAE极限下恢复主成分阈值，数值延拓实验证实了逐次维度丢失的谱级联解释。
AI.motivation: 在表示学习中，潜变量会因重构与正则化的竞争而依次失效（维度级后验坍缩），但目前缺乏统一的稳定性原理来刻画这种坍缩级联的物理机制。完全坍缩的协方差判据无法解释部分坍缩中间态的稳定性，因此需要一种依赖于已有表示的、保留数据信息的谱判据。
AI.method: 将负ELBO视为有效自由能泛函，围绕任意部分坍缩稳态做二次展开得到高斯涨落理论；通过投影（活跃/坍缩坐标与Hermite模式分解）将Hessian分解为活跃与坍缩两个直和不变扇区。引入条件残差算子 $\mathcal{R}_A$ 及其Gram算子 $\mathcal{C}_A = \mathcal{R}_A^\dagger\mathcal{R}_A$，其谱上界 $\Lambda_*^{(A)} = \|\mathcal{R}_A\|^2$ 控制坍缩扇区的稳定性：$\bm{K}_C \succeq 0 \Leftrightarrow \sigma'^2 \geq \Lambda_*^{(A)}$。在线性高斯VAE极限中，残差谱退化为数据协方差谱，得到主成分阈值。
AI.result: 理论方面：(1) 残差算子的Gram矩阵控制坍缩扇区的稳定性边界；(2) 在线性高斯VAE中精确恢复 $\sigma'^2 \geq \max_{\alpha \notin A} \lambda_\alpha(\Sigma_X)$ 的主成分阈值；(3) 完全坍缩判据 $\sigma'^2 \geq \lambda_{\max}(\Sigma_X)$ 成为该谱级联的终止情形。数值方面：使用8维合成高斯混合数据与4维非线性VAE进行数值延拓实验，结果显示在逐渐增大 $\sigma'^2$ 过程中潜维度从4逐一坍缩至0，估计的残差谱上界 $\hat{\Lambda}_*^{(A)}$ 在每次维度损失附近趋近于 $\sigma'^2$，支持谱级联图景。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出"残差谱级联"作为维度级后验坍缩的局部稳定性解释：坍缩阶跃由残差算子的谱上界与解码器方差的逐次相等（边际性条件）控制，每一阶的稳定图像失去一个有效潜维度。残差谱将线性模型的固定协方差谱推广为依赖于已学习背景的表示依赖谱，揭示了已有表示中未解释的信息如何决定下一个潜维度的局部可获得性。但该分析限于二次展开与高斯近似，背景自洽方程的非线性、全局自由能景观及动力学对跃迁行为的贡献仍为开放问题。

title: LLM Agents as Resilience Engineers for Scientific Applications
summary: Efficient checkpoint/restart support is essential for resilient HPC scientific applications, but implementing it requires substantial expertise: developers must identify recoverable state, choose globally consistent checkpoint points, and preserve application invariants during restart. We study whether frontier LLM coding agents can automate this process. We build a benchmark suite of 16 MPI applications spanning diverse domains, code sizes, and critical-state structures, and evaluate them with a no-human-in-the-loop generate--validate--revise pipeline for checkpoint/restart synthesis. Across the benchmark, the pipeline produces 41 working resilient implementations. Our results show that agent-driven resilience engineering is practical when critical state is visible or accessible through coherent abstractions: successful runs finish in under one hour on average, consume about 15M tokens, and produce implementations with negligible failure-free overhead and recovery efficiency comparable to human-written code. However, modularized and fragmented state remains a major limitation, with some failed attempts consuming over 100M tokens and 300 minutes without producing a working implementation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了前沿LLM编程智能体能否自动为MPI科学应用合成checkpoint/restart实现，构建了16个MPI应用基准套件（4类关键状态结构），通过generate-validate-revise无人工介入流水线在3个LLM后端上产生41个可工作的弹性实现。结果表明：当关键状态可见或通过一致抽象可访问时，智能体生成的实现具有可忽略的故障空闲开销和与人工代码相当的恢复效率；但模块化、碎片化的状态仍是主要瓶颈，会消耗超过1亿token和300分钟仍无法成功。
AI.motivation: HPC科学应用常运行数小时至数天，规模与运行时增长使故障概率急剧上升。checkpoint/restart是主流容错方案，但其实现需要专业知识：识别可恢复状态、选择全局一致的检查点、保持重启期间的应用不变性，工程负担重。已有透明检查点工具（如DMTCP）快照整个进程，导致检查点过大；手动方案又需专家知识。LLM编程智能体近期在软件工程任务上表现出色，但能否自动化端到端的弹性工程尚不明确——尤其是涉及分布式状态一致性、构建系统、运行时行为与性能开销的复杂性。
AI.method: 1) 构建16个开源、自包含且含原生checkpoint/restart实现的MPI应用基准（覆盖不同领域、代码规模1K–627K LoC、通信与计算模式）。2) 提出四类关键状态分类法：Plain Static（原始静态数据结构）、Plain Dynamic（演化中的原始数据，如跨MPI rank迁移）、Encapsulated（框架抽象封装）和Modularized（跨多模块碎片化）。3) 设计无人工介入的generate-validate-revise流水线：先深度剥离原应用的checkpoint代码（Vanilla codebase），然后让OpenCode CLI驱动的智能体基于固定提示合成Resilient codebase；独立Validator构建并沿功能性、故障弹性、可信度三个维度验证，未通过则反馈迭代，最多10轮。4) 评估三个LLM后端（Claude Opus 4.7/Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.5），每配置3次试验，使用4 MPI ranks，测量时间/token/金钱成本、执行时间、检查点存储等指标。Validator引入输入随机化与沙箱隔离防止智能体走捷径（缓存输出、复用剥离的框架API等）。
AI.result: 48个应用-模型设置中41个成功生成工作实现。Opus 4.7最强（11/14以最少迭代成功），Sonnet 4.6中位3轮，GPT-5.5中位4轮。生成代码的故障空闲运行时间与Vanilla相当（通常±3%），统计上与人工Reference无显著差异；故障注入后恢复开销通常限于个位数秒，与人工参考相当甚至更优（如WarpX仅1–3秒vs Reference 8.7秒）。平均代码重构时间73.4分钟（最快HPCG 19.7分钟，最慢Nyx 217.5分钟）；平均token成本Opus 22.8M、Sonnet 30.4M、GPT-5.5仅10.5M；金钱成本分别为$116、$93、$53.7每次尝试。检查点存储：Opus在所有膨胀场景下保持≤1.3×Reference；GPT-5.5膨胀最大（Sonnet在Athena++上53×膨胀）。模块化类应用是主要瓶颈：ROSS仅Opus成功，Nyx仅GPT-5.5勉强完成，SAMRAI仅Sonnet在10轮内勉强完成；多例失败超过100M token和300分钟仍未成功，根源在于智能体难以推断跨模块的完整状态视图，且Validator反馈仅显示症状（输出不匹配）而非根因（缺失状态/错误依赖）。智能体形成的五阶段工作流（侦察→关键状态识别→checkpoint/restore放置→源码集成→验证驱动修复）有效但易陷入trial-and-error。
AI.conclusion: 面向可见或通过一致抽象可访问的关键状态的MPI应用，前沿LLM编程智能体已能以无人工方式自动化生成与人类专家水平相当的checkpoint/restart实现，且故障空闲开销可忽略、成功通常在一小时内、约15M token以内完成。然而模块化与碎片化的关键状态仍是当前智能体的主要瓶颈——缺乏跨模块状态依赖推理能力，且验证反馈粒度过粗易让智能体陷入试验-错误循环。代理驱动代码生成可成为降低弹性工程负担的实用路径，但未来需要面向弹性的智能体，结合状态依赖分析、更好的源码摘要以及更诊断式的验证反馈。

title: Q-Capsule: A Localized Capsule-Based Quantum Neural Architecture for Barren Plateau Mitigation
summary: Variational quantum algorithms are often limited by barren plateaus: gradients vanish as circuit size and depth increase, making quantum neural networks difficult to train. We propose Q-Capsule, a localized capsule-based quantum neural architecture that mitigates this problem through register partitioning, local readout, sparse inter-capsule coupling, trainable data re-uploading, and Quantum Fisher Information Matrix (QFIM)-guided adaptive depth growth. By restricting the dominant support of each observable to a small capsule and controlling inter-capsule entanglement, Q-Capsule preserves useful gradient signals while retaining communication between local quantum representations. As the register width increases, Q-Capsule consistently maintains stable gradient variance, whereas globally entangling baselines exhibit exponential suppression with a log-gradient-variance slope near -ln 2 per qubit. Q-Capsule also produces more structured optimization landscapes, higher parameter efficiency, improved robustness to depolarizing noise, and lower measurement requirements. Its adaptive policy achieves 98.1% accuracy on binary classification and 97.7% on four-class classification, while using approximately 73% fewer two-qubit gates than the fixed-deep model on the multiclass task.

AI.tldr: 提出Q-Capsule，一种基于胶囊（capsule）局部化的量子神经网络架构，通过寄存器分区、局部读出、稀疏跨胶囊耦合、可训练数据重上传和QFIM引导的自适应深度增长五项机制协同缓解变分量子算法中的贫瘠高原（barren plateau）问题。
AI.motivation: 变分量子算法（VQA）随电路规模增大易出现梯度消失的贫瘠高原现象，导致量子神经网络难以训练。现有缓解策略（初始化策略、结构化ansatz、代价函数工程）均在训练前固定结构承诺，无法平衡全局表征能力与局部可训练性，也无法根据不同特征子集自适应分配表征容量。
AI.method: 将N-qubit寄存器划分为固定宽度c_size的量子胶囊；每胶囊独立参数、独立深度、局部Z测量；通过耦合间隔k控制相邻胶囊间CNOT纠缠（偶-奇砖墙模式）；可训练数据重上传（每层R_y编码+SU(2)旋转+胶囊内最近邻CNOT阶梯）；基于QFIM有效维度和条件数构造表达力分数S_c，饱和时按胶囊独立增长深度（近恒等初始化）。理论给出局部读出下梯度方差下界Ω(2^(-c_size))，与总宽度N无关。
AI.result: Q-Capsule在N=2–20范围内梯度方差稳定在~10⁻¹量级（斜率+0.01/qubit），而全局纠缠基线呈-ln2/qubit指数抑制（N=20时差距约5个数量级）；代价景观变化范围~0.75（基线~10⁻⁴）；参数效率η=1.06×10⁻⁵，比次优基线高238倍；二分类精度98.1%，四分类97.7%，双比特门数比固定深层模型减少73%；稀疏耦合（k=8）以22%门数保留84%互信息；对去极化噪声鲁棒；PennyLane/Qiskit/Cirq三方梯度方差一致。消融证实数据重上传（精度从0.972降至0.509）和结构化初始化（精度降至0.639）为关键组件。
AI.conclusion: Q-Capsule在可训练性、表达力与量子资源效率间取得实用平衡，跨框架梯度一致性证实改进源于电路设计而非软件实现。训练期开销（QFIM评估、电路重构）不影响推理阶段。未来工作聚焦降低开销、扩展至更大数据集与真实噪声硬件验证。

title: TaReD: Tool-Aware Recursive Decomposition for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Agents combine reasoning with tools to interact with external systems and complete real-world tasks. Early agents typically interleave reasoning and actions along a single execution chain. On complex tasks, this chain becomes unreliable because growing histories obscure intermediate dependencies and allow early planning errors to propagate. Recursively decomposing a complex task into smaller subtasks offers a natural solution, yet effective decomposition must account for the system's capabilities so that each subtask can be executed by the available tools. In realistic systems, however, tool libraries can be too large to expose in full. Injecting every tool description consumes substantial context while making relevant tools harder to retrieve and useful task boundaries harder to identify. We propose tool-aware recursive decomposition, which organizes tools by functional relationships into a hierarchy of capabilities. During execution, the agent discovers tools on demand and uses the hierarchy to recursively decompose a complex task into a subtask tree whose levels are aligned with the capabilities required at each stage. Experiments on complex real-world tasks show that the proposed method improves end-to-end task success rate by up to 40 percentage points over the compared baselines. The implementation of TaReD is available on GitHub: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TaReD（Tool-Aware Recursive Decomposition），通过将工具按功能关系组织为能力层次结构，实现按需工具发现和能力对齐的递归任务分解，以解决大工具库场景下长时任务的规划难题，在 AppWorld 上比基线最高提升 40 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 链式 agent 在复杂长时任务中因历史膨胀和早期错误传播而不可靠；任务分解虽有益，但仅基于语义的分解可能产生不可执行的子任务。现实中工具库过大，全部注入上下文会消耗大量 context 并干扰相关工具的检索，而预测固定子集又可能遗漏必要工具，且缺乏对分解的结构性引导。
AI.method: 核心思想是将工具按功能组织为能力层次树 G=(V,E)，内部节点为能力区域描述（capability card），叶节点为可执行工具契约。运行时从根节点按需导航（Navigate），仅将访问过的节点信息加入上下文；在此基础上递归地将任务分解为按能力对齐的有序子任务树 H（每个节点 h=(q_h, c_h, r_h) 含目标、上下文、能力区域）；深度优先处理子任务，仅在判定可直接执行时才进行延迟契约绑定（Bind+Execute），使用引用式值存储 M 在子任务间传递依赖；执行包含失败时的 ReviewOrRevise 修复重规划机制。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld Challenge（Test-C，457 工具）上，使用 GPT-5.6 Luna 评测：TaReD TGC 69.3%、SGC 48%、ATVS 80.28，优于 ReAct（51.3/26/66.81）、ADAPT（46.7/22/66.01）和 Plan-and-Solve（29.3/16/60.60），相对基线最高提升约 40 个百分点；消融表明层次工具感知优于预测子集、全量注入和可扩展子集；12% 任务存在固定子集遗漏关键工具的证据；TaReD 平均仅暴露 7.41% 库能力信息、检视 2.48% 详细契约。
AI.conclusion: TaReD 通过将大工具库组织为能力层次并按需发现，结合能力对齐的递归分解和延迟契约绑定，能在不暴露完整库的情况下保持对全部工具的访问并提供结构性分解引导，显著提升长时任务端到端成功率；主要局限为层次导航带来的额外模型调用和执行时间开销，以及工具缓存与上下文占用的权衡。

title: Gated Memory: Admission-Controlled Memory Formation for Conversational AI
summary: Personalized conversational AI relies on long-term memory systems that extract facts from user utterances and store them in persistent vector stores. Despite progress in retrieval, deduplication, and lifecycle management, the formation stage, the moment a fact is first written to storage has received almost no principled attention. We identify this as the binding constraint on memory quality in production systems. Critical contextual signals, such as the distinction between a permanent user attribute and a transient situation, exist only in the original utterance and are irreversibly lost the moment extraction produces a subject-relation-object triple. No downstream process can recover them. We propose Gated Memory, a lightweight, modular formation framework that interposes two decision checkpoints between conversation and storage: an admission gate that evaluates every candidate fact against the full utterance context before extraction runs, and a conditional enrichment stage that grounds admitted facts through an entity scope taxonomy with privacy constraints. The gate evaluates only the current exchange while using prior turns as read-only reference context, and produces a structured formation record. Admitted content is decomposed into atomic facts, each categorized, tagged with provenance (directly stated versus inferred), scoped to its condition of applicability, and grounded in resolved time and place, subject to a constraint that no entity absent from the context may be asserted. On the LoCoMo-10 benchmark with atypical emotional density in utterance data, Gated Memory achieves an overall +2.6% relative improvement in LLM-judge accuracy over a strong baseline with identical retrieval and generation, establishing formation quality as a measurable constraint on memory performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"Gated Memory"框架，针对对话式AI中长期记忆系统的"形成阶段"（fact首次写入存储）这一被忽视的关键瓶颈，设计了一个轻量级、模块化的准入控制层，通过在抽取之前设置话语级准入门控和条件性富集阶段，保留原始话语中不可逆丢失的上下文信号，在LoCoMo-10基准上以相同的检索与生成配置实现了+2.6%的相对改进。
AI.motivation: 现有长期记忆系统（如MemGPT、mem0、A-MEM）主要关注检索、去重和生命周期管理等存储后操作，但忽略了"形成阶段"——事实首次写入存储的时刻。一旦抽取产生主-谓-宾三元组，原始话语中的关键上下文信号（如永久属性与暂时状态的区分、用户实际拥有还是租赁车辆）即不可逆地丢失，下游流程无法恢复。这构成了记忆质量的"绑定约束"。
AI.method: 方法包含三个阶段：(1) 当前-参考分解，将对话分为当前交换（事实来源）和参考历史（仅用于指代消解）；(2) 话语级准入门控，在抽取前对候选事实基于完整原始话语进行评估，采用多意图分解将其拆分为原子事实，并标注六类形成类别（persona/preference/event/procedural/user_rule/error_learning）、来源标签（直接陈述vs推断）以及适用条件范围；(3) 基于四类实体范围分类（USER_PII/INTERNAL/EXTERNAL/GENERIC）的条件性富集，附带隐私约束，并进行指示语（deictic）时空锚定。强制执行"接地约束"——禁止断言评估窗口中不存在的实体。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo-10基准上（保持检索、生成和评估完全一致），Gated Memory相比mem0基线实现总体+2.6%相对LLM-judge精度提升（50.6%→51.9%）。各类别结果：Single-Hop +4.4%、Open Domain +3.3%、Temporal +1.7%，但Multi-Hop出现-4.2%回归。准入门共处理5,882条话语，准入94.0%，拒绝6.0%。Multi-Hop回归揭示了独立事实评估中固有的精度-召回权衡。
AI.conclusion: 形成质量是可测量的记忆性能约束。论文确立了"形成噪声→检索噪声→生成退化"的因果链。+2.6%的改进证明仅改变进入存储的内容即可提升性能。在生产环境中，准入过滤可降低存储成本、检索延迟和幻觉风险。未来工作方向包括：链感知准入策略（建模事实间依赖以解决Multi-Hop回归）、领域自适应阈值和知识图谱接地。该框架强调"个性化助手的能力上限由其选择记住的内容质量决定"。

title: Phonological Interference in Multilingual Speech Models
summary: Phoneme-level models transcribe or generate speech as a sequence of phonemes, the smallest sound units that distinguish words. These models enable fine-grained pronunciation control and understanding, yet often fail on input that does not match any single training language, such as speech alternating between two languages, known as code-switching, or low-resource languages absent from training. We identify a systematic failure mode behind this, phonological interference: models assume the input is in a single language and impose its phonology, overriding local phoneme-level decisions that conflict with the assumed language. We measure interference by how often a model retains phonemes that one language has but the other lacks. On code-switched input, two phone recognizers (speech-to-phoneme models) and a phoneme-conditioned text-to-speech model lose 32% to 79% of these phonemes, but lose far fewer of the phonemes both languages share. On unseen languages, we find that phone recognizers impose the phonology of the training language they assign to the speech, and the more confident the assignment, the more they lose phonemes the unseen language has but the assigned language lacks. We probe the models' language estimate from their internal activations, and trace interference to a low dimensional subspace. On monolingual speech, steering this subspace toward another language makes the model lose the phonemes that only the original language uses and produce phonemes that only the target language has. We introduce windowed language estimation (WLE), an inference time repair that replaces the model's language estimate in this subspace with one computed from a short window around each position. On code-switched input, WLE removes 34% to 69% of the interference in all three models, and in the recognizers it leaves monolingual performance essentially unchanged.

AI.tldr: 本文识别并量化了多语言语音模型中的一种系统失败模式——音素干扰（phonological interference），即模型从整个输入推断语言并将该语言的音系强加于局部音素决策上，导致在语码转换输入或未见过的语言上丢失另一语言独有音素的现象，并提出了无需语言标签的推理时修复方法——窗口化语言估计（WLE）。
AI.motivation: 音素级语音模型在需要精细发音控制的场景下很重要，但在语码转换输入或训练中未见过的低资源语言上常常失败。本文旨在揭示这种失败背后的系统性模式，并提出可解释、可干预的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 使用非共享音素召回率（unshared phoneme recall）度量干扰，分别在两个电话识别器（POWSM、PhoneticXeus）和一个音素条件 TTS 模型（CosyVoice3）上测量语码切换和未见语言上的干扰；2) 训练线性探针从内部激活中读取语言估计；3) 通过白化的16语言质心定义低维语言子空间，并通过子空间编辑因果性地重现干扰；4) 提出窗口化语言估计（WLE）作为推理时修复，仅替换语言子空间坐标为局部窗口计算得到的值。
AI.result: 在语码切换输入上，三个模型丢失32%-79%的非共享音素，而共享音素仅小幅下降；干扰可追溯到低维语言子空间（不到2%的隐藏维度），编辑该子空间可因果性地重现干扰；在 Whisper 上也发现了类似的语言子空间，编辑后可改变输出转录的语言，证明该机制延伸到一般 ASR 中的语言混淆；WLE 在三个模型上消除了34%-69%的干扰，对识别器的单语性能几乎无影响。
AI.conclusion: 音素干扰源于模型从全局上下文推断语言并将其音系强加于局部决策，可归因于一个低维语言子空间；WLE 通过将全局语言估计替换为局部窗口估计来显著缓解干扰且无需语言标签，为多语言语音模型的语言混淆问题提供了一个可解释且实用的推理时修复方案。

title: H2CE: Modeling Geo-Semantic Interactions for POI Reranking with Heterogeneous Two-Stage Cross-Encoders
summary: Point-of-Interest (POI) reranking in local search must model query-conditioned tradeoffs among lexical semantics, geospatial proximity, and numerical quality signals such as rating and review count, while remaining practical under real-time serving constraints. A close POI may only partially satisfy the query intent, while a farther one may offer stronger semantic and quality evidence. We present H2CE, a Heterogeneous Two-stage Cross-Encoder for latency-bounded POI reranking. H2CE represents numerical attributes in two complementary ways: bucketized natural-language descriptors are inserted into the cross-encoder input to support semantic--numeric attention, while exact scalar values are processed by dedicated MLPs to preserve magnitude information. The resulting semantic and numerical embeddings are fused through latent-space aggregation, enabling nonlinear interactions beyond scalar weighted sums. H2CE then applies a two-stage architecture: Stage 1 scores all candidates pointwise for scalable filtering, and Stage 2 performs head-to-head pairwise comparison among the top-$K$ candidates with Copeland aggregation, making fine-grained relative tradeoffs explicit while reducing pairwise cost from O(N^2) to O(N+K(K-1)). On a 5,743-query local search test set, H2CE achieves 67.48% NDCG@5, improving over XGBoost LTR by +22.82% absolute and over a zero-shot LLM reranker by +35.89%. The pairwise stage adds +1.98% NDCG@5 over the pointwise model alone. Ablations confirm the value of numerical features, latent aggregation, top-K pairwise reranking, and aligned training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出H2CE，一种面向本地搜索POI重排序的异构两阶段交叉编码器。它通过将距离、评分和评论数同时建模为bucket化的自然语言描述符和精确标量值（经由专用MLP处理），并在潜在空间融合，以捕捉查询条件下的地理-语义-数值交互。Stage 1对所有候选做pointwise打分，Stage 2对top-K做Copeland pairwise比较，将成对成本从O(N²)降至O(N+K(K-1))。
AI.motivation: 本地搜索POI重排序中，距离、评分等数值信号与查询语义/POI语义之间存在复杂的查询条件权衡：近的POI可能只部分满足意图，而较远的POI可能在语义和质量上更强。传统的XGBoost LTR或纯文本cross-encoder无法建模这种geo-semantic-numerical的交互；标量加权融合也无法表达非线性条件交互。需要一个兼顾推理延迟可控、又能表达数值-语义联合推理的重排序方案。
AI.method: 1) 异构特征编码器HFE：语义流将query、POI文本及bucket化数值描述符（如"walkable"、"excellent"）输入cross-encoder；数值流通过三个专用MLP处理距离、评分、评论数的精确标量。两者通过潜在空间拼接+非线性MLP分类器融合。2) 两阶段架构：Stage 1对N个候选做pointwise打分选top-K；Stage 2对top-K做K(K-1)有序成对比较，以Copeland聚合生成最终排序。训练使用top-K对齐采样以匹配推理分布。
AI.result: 在5,743查询的本地搜索测试集上，H2CE取得67.48% NDCG@5 / 60.77% RDQ@5，相对XGBoost LTR提升+22.82% NDCG@5，相对zero-shot LLM reranker（RankGPT）提升+35.89%。组件贡献分析显示：领域微调+34.73% RDQ@1、数值MLP +4.36%、潜在聚合 +2.64%、pairwise阶段 +2.73%。Pairwise在K=10时最优。Half-matrix优化将pair数从90降至45，中位延迟从163ms降至120ms，质量损失<0.3%。
AI.conclusion: H2CE通过双重数值表示（bucket化文本描述符+精确标量MLP）和潜在空间聚合，有效建模了POI重排序中的geo-semantic查询条件权衡；两阶段pointwise+pairwise架构在保持O(N+K²)推理复杂度的同时，通过top-K显式比较提升了头部排序质量。系统已具备实际部署的吞吐量（单卡6-8 TPS，8卡约67 TPS），并通过POISS数据集保证可复现性。局限性在于延迟仍高于纯pointwise方案，且监督标签存在噪声。

title: How to post-train on a surrogate: Envelope sampling mitigates reward hacking
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are commonly post-trained against LLM judges and other cheap surrogates because the true reward, such as human preference, is too expensive to query at scale. This practice often leads to reward hacking, where reinforcement learning against a miscalibrated surrogate leads to undesirable side effects. In this work, we study a setting in which a small number $n$ of model outputs are annotated with ground-truth labels (e.g., from expert review) and used to recalibrate the LLM judge before optimizing against it. Prior approaches to judge recalibration are costly or heuristic, and it is known that on-policy sampling fails when the surrogate is miscalibrated on a rare set of outputs. In this work, we propose envelope sampling, a theoretically-grounded method for judge recalibration that seeks to minimize an upper bound on the regret of the post-trained model under the assumption that the human reward and re-calibrated reward lie in an $L^2$ ball around the judge. We give practical algorithms to sample from the envelope by rejection or by fine-tuning against a modified reward, and experiments on clinical note generation and on a controlled sycophancy task show that recalibrating on envelope samples mitigates reward hacking where recalibrating on base-model samples does not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"包络采样"（envelope sampling）方法，用于在LLM后训练中缓解针对替代奖励（如LLM评判器）优化时出现的奖励黑客问题。该方法通过选择更优的查询分布来获取真实标签，以在有限标注预算下实现对评判器的有效再校准，避免因罕见输出被误判而导致的优化失败。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在后训练阶段常使用LLM评判器等廉价替代奖励来代替昂贵的人类偏好评估，但替代奖励与真实奖励之间的失准会导致奖励黑客现象。现有的再校准方法成本高或依赖启发式策略，且在替代奖励对罕见输出失准时，传统的同策略（on-policy）采样会因无法覆盖这些罕见输出而失败。因此需要一种理论上有依据的查询分布选择方法，以最大化后训练模型的质量。
AI.method: 提出包络采样方法：1）理论分析表明后训练相对于再校准奖励的遗憾度受"再校准误差"和"覆盖因子"控制；2）在真实奖励和再校准奖励均位于评判器L²球内的假设下，证明归一化包络分布ρ*能最小化最坏情况覆盖因子；3）给出两种采样算法：从π_j拒绝采样，或针对增广奖励微调；4）在K个罕见被高估输出的风格化模型中，证明包络采样达到最优标签复杂度Θ(K log K)，而同策略采样需要Θ(K/ε log K)。
AI.result: 在临床笔记生成和受控谄媚任务两个实验上验证：1）临床笔记生成：使用包络采样再校准的评判器在T=128时严重伪造率从19.8%降至1.0%，参考质量从0.563提升至0.658（vs 未训练模型0.651），同策略再校准则失败；2）受控谄媚任务：包络采样仅需256个标签即可将错误率从37.7%降至2.1%（低于基模型自身3.1%），同策略采样在256标签后仍高于33%；3）覆盖全部116个不同标签，包络仅需约450次采样，同策略需超过14,000次。
AI.conclusion: 包络采样是一种理论上有依据的评判器再校准查询分布选择方法，能有效缓解LLM后训练中的奖励黑客问题。实验证明在临床笔记生成和谄媚任务中，该方法在相同标签预算下显著优于同策略采样基线。未来工作方向包括：应用于其他领域、超越规则编辑的再校准方法、迭代再校准-优化循环、面向更丰富奖励类别的包络设计以及与主动学习的联系。

title: Being-M0.7: A Latent World-Action Model for Humanoid Robots
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated locomotion and manipulation informed by future scene evolution and whole-body motion, yet learning these capabilities is constrained by scarce robot demonstrations. Human video and motion datasets offer scalable supervision, but many contain only video or motion rather than paired video-motion data. Moreover, human motion does not directly specify executable robot actions. We present Being-M0.7, a latent world-action model that transfers visual-motion priors learned from mixed-modality human data to humanoid control through pre-training, robot mid-training, and action post-training. We curate a corpus from more than 10,000 hours of raw human-centric data, integrating video-only, motion-only, and paired video-motion streams to learn complementary visual dynamics and whole-body kinematic structure. Joint prediction of future latent visual states and motion encourages visual representations to encode future kinematics. Robot mid-training adapts this coarse-grained prior to robot viewpoints and body dynamics. During action post-training, an action expert combines visual predictive representations from the frozen, adapted prior with current images and proprioception through gated cross-attention, grounding predictive context in executable whole-body commands. Being-M0.7 achieves the highest aggregate success rate among the compared baselines on SIMPLE and matches the strongest baseline on real-world Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: Being-M0.7是一个潜在世界-动作模型（Latent World-Action Model），通过预训练-机器人中训练-动作后训练三阶段框架，将来自大规模人类视频与运动数据的视觉-运动先验迁移到Unitree G1人形机器人的loco-manipulation（移动操作）任务中。其核心是采用Mixture of Transformers (MoT)联合预测未来视觉潜在状态与运动，并利用门控交叉注意力将冻结先验的预测上下文与当前机器人观测融合，生成可执行全身动作。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人的loco-manipulation需要协调运动与操作，并需推理未来场景演化与全身动作。然而机器人演示数据稀缺且成本高昂。人类视频与运动数据可大规模获取，但常以单一模态（仅有视频或仅有运动）存在，且人类运动无法直接转化为可执行机器人动作。因此需要一种方法将多模态人类先验有效迁移至机器人控制。
AI.method:
1. 数据策展：从Ego4D、HumanML3D等数据集筛选超10,000小时原始人类数据，分为配对视频-运动、视频-only、运动-only三种监督流。
2. 混合模态预训练：MoT结构联合预测DINO视觉潜在与22D头部根运动（流匹配），辅以几何感知辅助损失（轨迹+末端速度）。
3. 机器人中训练：将预训练先验适配到机器人视角与动力学。
4. 动作后训练：冻结适配后的先验模型，训练门控交叉注意力动作专家，融合先验预测隐藏状态、当前DINO图像与本体感觉。
5. 推理时分离低频规划（5Hz）与高频动作查询（~1.67Hz, 30步动作块）。
AI.result: SIMPLE仿真基准6任务×3难度×10次试验（共180次）：Being-M0.7取得128/180（71.1%）最高聚合成功率，超越Ψ₀(64.4%)、π₀.₅(52.8%)和GR00T-N1.6(33.9%)。消融实验显示去除预训练下降22.2百分点，去除中训练下降11.7百分点，语言上下文替代预测上下文下降12.8百分点。Unitree G1真实世界3任务×5次试验（共15次）：与GR00T-N1.6并列最佳13/15（86.7%），优于π₀.₅(7/15)和Ψ₀(3/15)。
AI.conclusion: 三阶段训练框架能有效将人类视觉-运动先验迁移到人形机器人loco-manipulation控制；混合模态预训练、机器人中训练与门控预测上下文均对性能有显著贡献。但任务间存在视觉相似干扰，长时域任务评估仍待扩展，且SONIC全身控制器末端跟踪精度有限。

title: DynaTE: Accelerating Diffusion LLMs via Dynamic Token Execution
summary: Diffusion-based LLMs (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) LLMs by enabling bidirectional parallel refinement, alleviating the sequential decoding bottleneck of AR generation. However, their parallel iterative refinement mismatches AR accelerators optimized for sequential decoding and their discrete token generation differs from DiT accelerators designed for continuous denoising. Recent dLLM accelerators have explored workload-specific optimizations to reduce vocabulary processing overhead and redundant computation across denoising iterations. However, these approaches retain all tokens in parallel execution, despite varying token refinement utility and execution requirements. This paper presents DynaTE, a hardware--software co-design architecture that dynamically adapts accelerator execution to evolving token states during dLLM decoding. DynaTE first enables adaptive token execution by skipping low-utility token computation, while a dimension-reconfigurable PE array maintains high utilization under varying active-token patterns. Second, DynaTE exploits dynamic token dependencies through FLDD to refine a small number of locally dependent tokens within the current iteration, reducing the overall number of denoising iterations, while a Merge--Split--Merge dataflow hides the resulting serial overhead. Third, a streaming vocabulary engine interleaves multiple token streams from the LM head to accommodate irregular output variations caused by selective token computation and uneven vocabulary-selection demands. Evaluated on two representative dLLMs, DynaTE achieves 2.05--2.78$\times$ speedup and 2.99--3.93$\times$ higher energy efficiency over state-of-the-art dLLM accelerators, while delivering 2.55$\times$ speedup and 6.07$\times$ higher energy efficiency over Jetson AGX Orin.

AI.tldr: DynaTE是一种针对扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的硬件-软件协同设计加速器，通过动态令牌执行解决dLLM解码中的三个关键低效问题：令牌效用不均、局部依赖稀疏及词汇表输出不规则，从而在两个代表性dLLM模型上实现显著的速度提升和能效改进。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）通过并行迭代去噪弥补自回归（AR）模型的串行解码延迟，但现有加速器存在两方面不匹配：（1）AR加速器针对串行单令牌生成优化，无法适应dLLM中多个位置并行迭代更新且可能回访的特性；（2）DiT加速器针对连续潜变量密集更新优化，与dLLM中离散令牌空间的词汇表投影和采样不匹配。尽管DART和dLLM-OPU等近期dLLM专用加速器减少了vocabulary处理和跨迭代冗余计算，但它们在去噪过程中仍保留所有令牌的并行执行，未充分挖掘令牌间的细化效用差异、局部依赖稀疏性和词汇表处理负载不均带来的优化空间。
AI.method: DynaTE通过三大核心机制解决上述挑战：（1）**自适应令牌执行**：基于上一轮分布统计（Top-32截断熵、置信度、与已解码令牌距离）识别低细化效用令牌，在层级上累积注意力权重作为保护机制，跳过其Query端注意力和FFN计算（通过恒等旁路传递隐藏状态），同时采用8个64×4子阵列组成的维度可重构PE阵列（支持64×32、128×16、256×8、512×4配置）在不同参与模式下维持高利用率；（2）**依赖感知迭代内细化**：通过快速局部依赖检测（FLDD），结合跨迭代Top-32 KL散度差、Top-4候选重叠度和当前熵的局部依赖评分，选择锚点进行局部迭代精修，同时采用Merge-Split-Merge（MSM）数据流将串行精修与并行生成交错执行以隐藏序列化开销；（3）**流式多令牌词汇表引擎**：直接在LM-head输出端连接流式词汇表处理引擎，通过弹性缓冲和行扫描器将突发输出转换为统一词汇流，采用先验ID种子初始化阈值（减少91.68%进入锦标赛树的logit），并通过多令牌交织调度（共享两个五级锦标赛核）将核利用率从约20%提升至97.6%。此外，通过共享可分裂MAC单元支持W8A8/双W8A4精度自适应（仅增加6.17%MAC面积），并采用迭代自适应激活精度降低计算成本。
AI.result: 在TSMC 28nm工艺、1GHz频率、2048个MAC单元、512GB/s HBM2配置下评估LLaDA-8B和Dream-7B：相较DART、dLLM-OPU、SA等先进dLLM加速器，DynaTE实现2.05–2.78×加速和2.99–3.93×能效提升；相较Jetson AGX Orin实现2.55×加速和6.07×能效提升。令牌剪枝平均减少32.7%（LLaDA-8B）和34.2%（Dream-7B）的Transformer MAC数；FLDD减少21.4–34.3%去噪迭代次数（平均30.1%/26.5%），仅引入14.3%局部串行精修且每轮迭代延迟开销仅8.54%（MSM数据流将独立精修开销降低39.4%）；流式词汇表引擎将中间logit流量从16.0–18.6 MiB降至约8.2–8.3 KiB/迭代，HBM访问能耗降低1923–2041×。综合消融显示混合精度、令牌剪枝、FLDD、流式词汇表分别带来1.26×、2.26×、3.07×、4.32×累积加速。在所有优化启用情况下，生成质量平均仅下降0.41分（最大0.7分）。总面积3.91 mm²，总功耗7.36W。
AI.conclusion: DynaTE通过围绕动态令牌执行重构dLLM推理，有效消除了迭代去噪中三类与现有加速器不匹配的冗余：低效用令牌的冗余计算、令牌间局部依赖导致的额外全局迭代、以及完整logit张量的冗余HBM传输。其核心价值在于揭示了dLLM解码过程中令牌级执行动态（参与度、依赖性、词汇表需求）的优化空间，并提供了与之匹配的硬件机制（维度可重构PE阵列、可分裂MAC、MSM数据流、流式词汇表引擎），证明将算法优化与架构支持紧密结合是将执行模式变化转化为端到端性能提升的关键——同一套算法优化在固定脉动阵列上的加速收益显著低于完整DynaTE系统。

title: REMORY: Learning Residual Memory for Context Compaction
summary: Long-horizon agents compact their history to continue within a finite context window, but a textual summary alone may not support every subsequent decision. We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens. Given the history and summary, the network learns to generate tokens that help a frozen LLM approximate the continuation it would produce with the full history. The tokens are conditioned on the summary and appended after it, forming an analogue of a residual connection along the sequence dimension. On SummHay, REMORY improves source attribution at nearly unchanged insight coverage and approaches the full-context joint score using only 5.2% of the input positions. Across long-horizon agent benchmarks, Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash show consistent gains with residual memory. Both models also exhibit substantially fewer repeated tool outputs and tool errors on BrowseComp and Terminal-Bench 2.1.

AI.tldr: REMORY提出了一种神经记忆网络，通过在文本摘要后附加有界软记忆令牌（soft memory tokens），帮助冻结的大语言模型在上下文压缩后近似全历史续生。该方法在SummHay基准上以仅5.2%的输入位置接近全上下文联合分数，并在多个长程智能体基准（BrowseComp、Terminal-Bench 2.1、AutomationBench、JobBench）上提升性能、减少工具重复和错误。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体在有限上下文窗口内工作时需压缩历史，但仅靠文本摘要可能不足以支持所有后续决策。现有方法（如/compact命令生成的摘要）无法保证摘要对每个未来决策都有用，且需要先验识别相关信息的局限。受人类认知中工作记忆与长期记忆互补、海马索引理论的启发，作者希望在不保留全部历史的前提下，让智能体在压缩后仍能有效利用先前的上下文。
AI.method: REMORY是一个神经记忆网络，接收历史H_i和生成的摘要S_i，输出有界软记忆令牌M_i = C_φ(H_i; S_i)，|M_i| ≤ m，附加在摘要后形成序列维度上的"残差连接"。网络采用冻结LLM的特征和可学习查询，通过门控跨注意力预测记忆向量；每1024个源位置产生64个软令牌，分层压缩后上限为4096个槽位。训练分两阶段：(1) 重建阶段——学生用软记忆替换源文本，与教师预测相同的源文本；(2) 摘要条件续生阶段——教师接收原始历史，学生接收固定摘要和记忆，两者预测相同的后续响应。通过学生到教师的反向KL散度（覆盖全部词汇和完整响应）训练，仅更新记忆网络参数（Qwen用DFlash 1.94B参数，GLM用DFlash-2 1.502B参数）。
AI.result: 在SummHay（92个查询）上，摘要+REMORY使引用F1提升4.04分，联合分数提升3.55分，洞察覆盖率几乎不变（+0.40），仅用5.2%的原始位置接近全上下文联合分数；配对引导95%置信区间为[+0.74, +6.21]。在智能体基准上，Qwen3.8-27B在AutomationBench提升9.8分、JobBench提升7.6分、Terminal-Bench 2.1提升4.5分、BrowseComp提升3.0分；GLM-5.3-Flash在Terminal-Bench 2.1和BrowseComp上分别提升3.3和4.1分。重复工具输出下降17.9–29.8%，工具错误下降25.3–49.7%。在488个压缩后首动作配对评估中，REMORY获胜70.7%，平局4.3%，失败25.0%。除JobBench外，所有比较的生成成本均下降。
AI.conclusion: REMORY学习了一种有界记忆补充以支持上下文压缩：摘要提供可读的历史账户，软令牌承载额外的预测信息，检索在需要时提供精确记录。重建后接摘要条件续生的两阶段训练在保持LLM参数不变的情况下训练该接口。源归属改进、智能体分数提升以及压缩后首动作的偏好共同支持这种残差式设计的实用性。

title: Memorization and Malign Generalization in Conditional Diffusion Models with Random Features
summary: Conditional diffusion models generate diverse, novel, and high-quality samples under prescribed conditions. However, theoretical understanding of their memorization and generalization remains limited, while recent works have characterized these behaviors primarily in unconditional settings. In this work, we analyze a random-feature conditional score model in the high-dimensional proportional limit, deriving asymptotic expressions for training and test losses. By decomposing the test loss, we show that in the overparameterized regime, increasing model width improves prediction of the condition-dependent mean while reducing within-condition prediction variance, a phenomenon we term "malign generalization." Furthermore, analyzing the training loss reveals that more informative conditions lead to memorization of training samples at smaller widths. These theoretical findings are supported by experiments with U-Net architectures on realistic data.

AI.tldr: 该论文理论分析了条件扩散模型中记忆化与"恶性泛化"（malign generalization）现象，推导出随机特征条件分数模型在高维比例极限下的训练和测试损失的渐近表达式，揭示了过参数化区域中条件均值预测改善但条件内方差下降的反直觉行为，并通过U-Net实验在CelebA上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型记忆化与泛化理论主要集中在无条件设置，而条件扩散模型（每对训练条件-样本唯一配对，测试时使用新条件）的记忆化与泛化机制尚未被理解，这对于实际条件生成应用具有重要意义。
AI.method: 作者分析了一个随机特征条件分数模型（两层级联，隐藏权重固定，仅训练第二层权重），在条件$x=By+\Sigma^{1/2}\xi$的高斯数据模型下，使用高斯等价原理（GEP）和线性束理论（Bodin 2024的六块线性束）推导出比例极限下的确定性等价；将测试损失分解为条件均值误差（ME）、残差误差（RE）和预测方差（PV），并使用Stein恒等式将训练损失与Jacobian迹联系起来。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：（1）定理4.2给出比例极限下的ME、PV、RA和训练损失的确定性等价；（2）命题4.4证明$\psi_p\to\infty$时训练损失和权重范数趋于零，PV趋于零而ME趋于由Jacobian控制的正极限；（3）命题4.5表明在$\psi_p,\psi_n\gg 1$时，训练损失$R_{\text{train}}(r)$取决于比值$r=\psi_p/\psi_n$以及通过残差方差$\varsigma$影响的条件强度，更强的条件在任何宽度下都降低训练损失；（4）CelebA超分辨率和高斯去噪实验验证了U-Net中也出现恶性泛化。
AI.conclusion: 条件扩散模型在过参数化时表现出"恶性泛化"：条件均值预测更准确但样本多样性损失（预测方差降至真实去噪器以下）；同时，条件信息量越大，记忆化在更小宽度处发生。这些现象在随机特征模型和U-Net中均成立，呼吁进一步研究条件扩散模型特有的记忆化与泛化机制。

title: Open-ended Scientific Discovery with Possibilistic Reasoning
summary: Autonomous scientific discovery with LLMs requires generating and testing hypotheses adaptively as evidence accumulates while maintaining statistical validity. Existing anytime-valid methods can handle data-dependent hypotheses, but open-ended discovery poses a deeper challenge: the best discovered hypothesis may still be the best of a bad lot, with better explanations yet undiscovered, while even background knowledge such as physical laws may require revision in light of new findings. In response, we formalize the problem as Abductive Autonomous Scientific Discovery (AASD) using possibility theory. We introduce abductive utility, a computable measure of discovery progress, and possibility frontier search, the first algorithm for AASD, which maintains anytime validity and achieves $\varepsilon$-optimal abductive utility asymptotically under suitable conditions. Experiments on synthetic and real-world scientific-discovery tasks show strong performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于可能性理论的形式化框架AASD（Abductive Autonomous Scientific Discovery），用于开放式科学发现。通过引入"abductive utility"作为可计算的发现进展度量，并提出"possibility frontier search"算法，在合成与真实世界任务中展现了优异的性能，同时保持 anytime validity 与渐近 ε-最优保证。
AI.motivation: 现有 anytime-valid 方法仅能处理固定假设集的下的数据依赖假设检验，无法应对"best of a bad lot"问题——最佳已发现假设可能仍非最优解释，且背景知识本身也可能需要修正。这构成了开放式科学发现的核心挑战。
AI.method: 1) 使用可能性理论形式化 AASD 问题，区分 closed-world 与 open-world 不确定性；2) 定义 abductive utility，结合 evidential possibility（基于 e-process）与 guaranteed background possibility；3) 提出 possibility frontier search 算法，交替进行假设扩展与实验设计，使用 Chernoff-style maximin 设计选择下一实验；4) 提供理论分析（Theorem 1 的 ε-recovery 保证与 Theorem 2 的可观测停止证书）。
AI.result: 在合成实验（1540个参数状态、44个假设）中，方法在 t=2-3 即可获得 certified 假设，精度达 1.0，abductive utility 收敛至 U*；在真实世界 DiscoveryBench 数据集（Incarceration/SES）上，使用 GPT-5 生成假设，HMS、abductive utility 优于 AutoDiscovery 基线；post-hoc 选择实验验证了认证标准的有效性控制与统计功效。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次将开放式科学发现形式化为基于可能性理论的归纳推理问题，提出的 abductive utility 与 possibility frontier search 算法提供了首个 anytime-valid 且渐近 ε-最优的解决方案，为 LLM 驱动的自主科学发现提供了理论与实践基础。

title: When Do We Need On-Policy Distillation? Distilling on Offline Student Rollouts Is Often Better
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become increasingly popular for transferring teacher capabilities to student models. In this work, we ask a critical research question: Is on-policy sampling always beneficial for distilling arbitrary teacher-student pairs? We show that a simple alternative, Semi-OPD, which distills from offline rollouts generated by the initial student, can often outperform OPD in both accuracy and training efficiency. Across 17 teacher-student pairs ranging from 1.5B to 235B parameters, Semi-OPD outperforms OPD in 14 cases, with up to +13.6% accuracy and 11.4x training speedup. We further find that the choice between OPD and Semi-OPD depends on the alignment between the initial teacher and student, quantified by an output-token overlap ratio: OPD is beneficial only when the two are highly aligned with high overlap ratios. Our deeper investigation suggests that effective distillation requires on-policyness w.r.t. both the student and the teacher. For misaligned pairs, student rollouts can become increasingly off-policy w.r.t. the teacher as context length grows, weakening the distillation signal. In contrast, Semi-OPD is often more stable, as it distills on shorter contexts while covering full trajectories and exposing the student to more teacher-preferred tokens. Beyond proposing Semi-OPD as an efficient alternative, our work motivates the community to rethink when to use OPD and to study stronger OPD variants with meaningful teacher-student pairs.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"在线策略蒸馏（OPD）总是优于离线蒸馏"的传统假设，提出了一种更简单的Semi-OPD方法：在训练开始前用初始学生模型采样一次rollout并全程复用。实验表明，在初始师生对齐度较低的多数情况下，Semi-OPD在精度和训练效率上均显著优于OPD，并提出了"教师-学生top-K token重叠率"作为选择策略的判据。
AI.motivation: OPD虽然能缓解暴露偏差，但实践中存在rollout过长、自我修正循环、监督信号不可靠等问题。作者质疑：在线采样对任意师生对是否都是必需的？当师生分布差距较大时，持续从演化的学生策略中采样可能导致轨迹逐渐偏离教师分布，反而削弱蒸馏信号。
AI.method: 1. 提出Semi-OPD：在训练前用初始学生π₀采样一次rollout缓存，全程复用；优化目标与OPD相同（sampled-token reverse KL），但优势A_t仍基于当前参数θ实时计算。2. 引入top-K overlap ratio作为初始师生对齐度的量化指标（初始学生rollout上师生top-K token集合的Jaccard重叠率）。3. 在17对师生模型（1.5B-235B，Qwen3/DeepSeek-R1-Distill/Nemotron-Cascade-2三大家族，覆盖thinking与non-thinking模式）上系统对比Semi-OPD与OPD及多种变体（Speculative KD、FastOPD、Lightning OPD、Relay-OPD）。4. 通过消融实验（替换为teacher rollout、按比例截断、不同目标函数、切换初始化等）分析OPD失效原因。
AI.result: 在17对师生组合中，Semi-OPD在14对上一致优于OPD，最高带来+13.6%精度提升和11.4×训练加速；其余3对差距仅0.1-2.6%。精度增益与初始top-64 overlap ratio呈强负相关（Pearson r=-0.73）：低对齐对Semi-OPD收益最大，高对齐对（如Nemotron-Cascade-2，89.3%）两者表现相当。Semi-OPD还优于Speculative KD、FastOPD、Lightning OPD、Relay-OPD等所有对比基线，且训练成本最低。原因分析：（1）低对齐对下，OPD的rollout越来越长且自我修正词密度升高，变得off-policy w.r.t. teacher；Semi-OPD训练在更短但完整的轨迹上，保持了teacher on-policyness并覆盖全推理阶段。（2）Semi-OPD使学生暴露在更多p_T>p_S的正向监督token上。（3）无论sampled-token还是top-K reverse KL目标，结论一致。（4）OPD无论从何种初始化出发，最终收敛到由online rollout决定的均衡点。局限：Semi-OPD要求初始学生有足够强的rollout能力，base model上效果不佳。
AI.conclusion: 有效的蒸馏需要同时满足student on-policyness和teacher on-policyness。OPD过度强调前者而牺牲后者。Semi-OPD用初始学生rollout换取了更稳定、更短的teacher-aligned监督信号，是低对齐场景下更优的选择。初始师生top-K overlap ratio可作为何时使用OPD的实用判据。该工作呼吁社区重新审视OPD的默认使用，并在未来研究中谨慎选择有意义的师生对作为实验设置。

title: ORDO: Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve
summary: Presolve strongly affects mixed-integer programming (MIP) performance, yet learning-based methods only optimize parameter configurations and cannot express the non-commutative temporal dependencies among actions, whose default order is nearly unique on most domains, yet functionally necessary: artificially shuffling the order of the same sequence inflates the tail of the solve-time distribution by up to several-fold. We recast presolve planning as autoregressive sequence generation over a unified atomic action space, moving the decision object to action sequences; we call this framework ORDO---Operation-level Round-aware Dynamic Ordering for MIP Presolve. Its payoff is cross-domain generalization: on multiple unseen domains it attains end-to-end zero-shot speedup---to our knowledge the first for presolve action sequences---varying by domain and not explained by corpus richness, the strongest domain reaching the largest speedup once racing is added. Deployment uses sequence racing, in which candidate sequences run concurrently and the winner is kept, enabled by an execution-and-observation facility, added by modifying the SCIP source, that injects sequences along the native path and records which actions actually execute and in which round.

AI.tldr: ORDO将MIP预求解规划重新定义为原子动作级别的自回归序列生成任务，把决策对象从参数配置向量提升为可执行的动作序列，并通过序列竞赛（sequence racing）部署实现零样本跨域加速。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的预求解方法只能在参数配置空间内搜索，无法表达MIP预求解动作之间的非交换时序依赖；默认策略的序列虽近乎唯一，但具有功能性必要性，乱序会导致求解时间分布的尾部膨胀数倍，因此"顺序"是一个长期缺乏学习信号的维度。
AI.method: 构建统一的原子动作空间（覆盖独立预求解例程、约束处理器回调和传播器三类插件），将预求解规划建模为条件自回归序列生成（Transformer解码器、RoPE、约1.6M参数、CPU温度1.0采样）；通过修改SCIP 10.0.1源码在三个插件执行入口注入序列并记录实际执行的回合与动作；在部署阶段采用2K+1路并发序列竞赛（无预求解np + K条生成序列 + K条带回退的序列），取最先完成者获胜。
AI.result: 在7个跨域测试点中4个加速、2个持平、1个失败；自然未见域NNV上SGM=0.7181（赢率73.6%），SC留一法SGM=0.7725（赢率95%）；在SC域上以零样本设置击败L2P-MIP、SMAC、ISAC、Hydra-MIP、Song & Gu等配置空间对手；纯序列单路径已在五域上击败默认策略，最大幅度NNV 0.8377；竞赛再额外带来约8%的相对增益；揭示预求解顺序的"对偶性"——默认语料近乎唯一但乱序后尾部膨胀至p90=1.22–2.86、p99=1.43–5.15。
AI.conclusion: 将预求解规划重铸为动作序列生成，使决策对象本身可学习，并在未见域上实现了首个预求解动作序列的零样本加速；速度提升主要落在分支搜索阶段而非预求解时间本身；方法存在明确的边界——其价值集中于跨域零样本迁移，竞赛以3.9–5.0倍核时间换取尾部截断，且不能由"少做预求解"或"表查找"替代；未来工作包括动作空间扩展、迁移预测器构建、以及向LP/CP范式推广。

title: DuplexAgent-RSI: Recursive Harness Improvement for Full-Duplex Voice Agent Collaboration
summary: Voice agents are converging on a collaboration pattern: a full-duplex interaction model stays on the live channel as the entry to the conversation, while search, reasoning, and coding are handled through asynchronous delegation. A duplex model supports continuous listening and speaking, but complex reasoning and tool use may exceed its capabilities. A coding agent can plan and execute extended tasks, but its sequential interface is a poor fit for live conversation. Combining them requires a harness that coordinates task acceptance, progress, cancellation, replacement, and result delivery while keeping the conversation responsive. Existing harnesses often rely on coupled heuristics, making them difficult to improve systematically from evidence. We present DuplexAgent, a full-duplex collaboration system whose harness expresses this workflow as six editable modules, and Duplex-Harness-RSI, a closed loop that revises them from interaction traces. A simulator automatically generates timed test conversations, runs the system, and produces failure traces that identify the collaboration modules requiring repair. Reasoning LLMs and coding agents in the delegation pool also serve the improvement loop: the Exam Planner selects the next tests from observed weaknesses and the repair archive, and the Harness Editor proposes targeted module changes. The capabilities that serve the user thus also improve the system's coordination. Experiments on intelligence, agentic, and duplex benchmarks show that DuplexAgent combines continuous interaction with difficult reasoning and complex task execution, achieving stronger spoken-knowledge and executable-tool scores than the compared delegated systems while maintaining strong interruption response. A harness ablation further shows that this modular, verifiable loop outperforms the initial harness and repeated editing that lacks its diagnosis and repair archive.

AI.tldr: 提出 DuplexAgent 与 Duplex-Harness-RSI：前者将全双工语音交互模型与推理/编码代理通过六个可编辑模块(Policy/Intake/Hold/Worker/Deliver/Memory)的协调机制连接；后者利用同一代理池(推理 LLM 作为 Exam Planner、编码代理作为 Harness Editor)基于失败归因与修复档案自动修订协调模块。在 VoiceChat 与 Qwen-Realtime 上的实验显示显著提升口语知识、可执行工具调用与协作得分。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音模型擅长实时对话但难以承担复杂推理与工具调用，编码/推理代理擅长长任务却无法持续监听；现有桥接系统把任务接受、进度、取消、替换与结果返回等决策耦合在专用启发式中，缺乏可定位、可验证的协调机制，导致失败难以系统性归因与修复。
AI.method: 系统 S=(F, B, H)：F 为全双工交互模型，B 为推理 LLM 与编码代理池，H 为六模块协调机制。Simulator 将 19 种请求类型与 22 种交互模式组合成可执行带时间轴的对话，Observer 记录轨迹，Diagnoser 按 (cause, module, pattern) 归因失败。Exam Planner 基于归因结果与修复档案调整下一轮测试分布；Harness Editor 在声明的可编辑表面上提出候选修改，经固定核心开发门(配对胜>负、不变量保持、原因回归受容)与保护集门检验后保留。
AI.result: BFCL-v3 与 FDB-v3 可执行工具调用显著优于基线(VoiceChat 上平均 53.5→75.8，FDB-v3 Pass@1 16→47；Qwen-Realtime 上 82.0→90.8)；OBQA/MMSU 口语知识大幅提升(VoiceChat 上 MMSU 36.1→80.5)。VoiceChat 协调得分 Q 从 g₀ 的 54.6 经十轮 RSI 升至 85.3(+30.7)，优于一次性编辑(57.4)与顺序编辑(61.9)；Qwen-Realtime 上 g₀ 47.1→g₈ 84.8(+37.7)。每个模块均有具体修复案例及其局部失败下降率。
AI.conclusion: 模块化、可验证的协调机制可显著改善全双工协作；闭环自我修订优于缺乏归因诊断的反复编辑；RSI 只修订模块文件而不改动模型权重，仍存在交互模型自身感知与时序能力无法触及的剩余失败，可由后续智能体强化学习在同仿真器中训练交互模型来承接。

title: Characterizing Overconfident Failure in LLM-Based Code Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated code generation, but generated programs can appear syntactically plausible while still failing execution-based correctness checks. Existing validation methods, such as testing and program analysis, remain essential but are often incomplete, costly, or applied only after generation. Model-derived uncertainty is therefore a natural early reliability signal. This paper studies the dilemma of overconfidence in code LLMs where incorrect programs are often generated with token-level confidence comparable to correct programs. We study this dilemma across four open-source code models and three execution-based benchmarks. Our analysis begins by investigating whether existing uncertainty metrics provide reliable proxies for execution correctness in code generation. We then characterize overconfidence at both global and local token levels, asking whether incorrect programs remain indistinguishable from correct ones under confidence and entropy summaries, including selective generation and the limits of instruction tuning. Finally, we evaluate whether common mitigation strategies reduce this failure mode. Our study yields four findings. First, existing uncertainty signals provide only partial and model-dependent evidence of execution failure. Second, overconfidence persists at both program and token levels, and uncertainty-based selection does not consistently improve accepted-set accuracy. Third, instruction tuning can increase certainty on failing generations without consistently improving correctness discrimination. Fourth, common mitigation techniques improve specific aspects of reliability but do not reliably resolve overconfident failure. Our exploratory latent analysis suggests that hidden representations may encode correctness-related signals that output confidence does not expose.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地研究了基于LLM的代码生成中的"过度自信困境"：模型生成的错误程序往往获得与正确程序相当的token级置信度。作者在4个开源代码模型和3个执行型基准上评估了17种生成阶段+6种prefill阶段不确定性指标，证实现有不确定性信号仅提供部分且模型依赖的执行失败证据；过度自信在程序级和token级均持续存在，不确定性选择不能稳定提升接受集准确率；指令微调会增加失败生成的置信度而不持续改善正确性区分；后验校准、重复采样、显式弃答等常见缓解策略均不能可靠解决过度自信失败；但潜在表示的effective rank等几何特征可能编码了正确性相关信息。
AI.motivation: LLM代码生成中程序可能在语法上合理但执行失败，而现有的执行测试和程序分析方法不完整、昂贵或仅在生成后应用。模型不确定性作为早期可靠性信号具有吸引力，但代码LLM存在过度自信困境——错误程序的token级置信度与正确程序相当。论文系统性地刻画这一现象，评估现有不确定性指标和缓解策略的可靠性。
AI.method: 跨4个开源代码模型（CodeLlama-7B-Instruct、DeepSeek-Coder-7B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct、OpenCoder-8B-Instruct）和3个执行型基准（HumanEval+、MBPP+、BigCodeBench）展开系统性研究。方法包括：(1) 评估17种生成阶段和6种prefill阶段不确定性指标的AUC判别能力；(2) 程序级平均token置信度和bottom-10%置信度分析；(3) 预测熵分析；(4) 基于置信度和熵的选择的coverage-accuracy曲线；(5) 对比基础模型与指令微调模型的；(6) Platt scaling和isotonic regression校准，使用Brier Score和Brier Skill Score；(7) 重复采样（T=0.8，K=50）评估恢复能力；(8) 显式弃答提示（95%置信度阈值，惩罚错误，允许"I don't know"）；(9) 层wise effective rank潜在空间分析。
AI.result: 四项主要发现：(1) 现有不确定性信号仅提供部分且模型依赖的执行失败证据——AUC范围0.598–0.696，无指标超过0.70，且最强指标随模型和基准变化；(2) 过度自信在程序级和token级均持续——HumanEval+/MBPP+上正确与错误程序平均置信度差仅0.007–0.012，BigCodeBench上CodeLlama和QwenCoder的错误程序反而置信度更高（0.956 vs 0.943；0.920 vs 0.897）；(3) 选择性生成不一致提升准确率——OpenCoder在MBPP+上从71.2%降到67.37%，CodeLlama和QwenCoder在BigCodeBench上top 10%置信集无正确程序；(4) 指令微调增加失败生成置信度（如OpenCoder从0.8685升至0.9224），但AUC区分能力变化不一致；(5) 后验校准大幅降低Brier Score但BSS接近零（≤0.041），几乎不优于基准通过率预测器；(6) 重复采样在K=50后仍有~90/57/45–50任务未解决；(7) 显式弃答提示不能可靠诱导模型弃答；(8) 潜在空间effective rank显示失败生成几何更分散，提示潜在表示编码了正确性相关信息。
AI.conclusion: 论文将过度自信失败定位为软件工程可靠性问题，区别于生成能力。指出生成质量提升不自动降低过度自信：可靠性评估应分别衡量功能准确性和不确定性-正确性区分能力。提出三个改进方向：(1) 训练模型识别可能的失败，使用执行结果标注的训练数据，将正确性敏感置信度作为显式学习目标；(2) 推理时将置信度作为控制策略的一个输入而非直接接受/弃答决策，需要时请求澄清、补充检索或程序级验证；(3) 通过端到端策略评估可靠性，而非仅评估分数校准。未来研究方向包括表示感知的可靠性机制，利用潜在空间信号预测失败。

title: BeliefScope: Diagnosing Evidence-Driven Revision and Pressure-Induced Shifts in Large Language Models
summary: A language model may revise the same proposition after receiving genuinely relevant evidence or after receiving directional user pressure that adds no relevant fact. The observable response shift alone therefore does not reveal which source drove the change. We introduce BeliefScope, a controlled black-box framework for separating these two sources of influence around a fixed target proposition. BeliefScope crosses Evidence and Pressure with factor-specific local controls and measures response changes through probability reports, categorical judgments, and action recommendations on channel-appropriate scales. To determine when these observable contrasts support reliable attribution, we evaluate the observation design under controlled synthetic conditions. Known-truth recovery and targeted ablations establish where Evidence- and Pressure-related effects can be separated, while semi-synthetic stress tests map how that recoverability changes as the observation process becomes noisier and more heterogeneous. Across a 36-family Qwen/Llama study, with targeted 12-family checks that also include Gemma3-12B, the resulting profiles show substantial evaluation-context dependence: broad model-level differences can change under matched controls, decoding, or response interfaces, while some narrower within-model patterns remain stable. Instruction interventions further show that reduced target-aligned Pressure following can reflect either stable resistance or movement in the opposite direction. BeliefScope summarizes these measurements as a conditional belief-response profile that keeps diagnostic effects tied to the evaluation conditions under which they are observed, together with explicit validity boundaries for that diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BeliefScope，一个用于在大语言模型（LLM）中区分"基于证据的信念修正"与"用户压力驱动的回应偏移"的黑盒归因框架。它采用 2×2 因子设计（Evidence × Pressure），分别在 Probability、Choice、Action 三个响应通道上测量，并通过合成数据与半合成数据验证观察设计的可恢复性，最终在 Qwen3-8B、Llama3.1-8B、Gemma3-12B 上生成了条件性信念-响应剖面。
AI.motivation: 当 LLM 因新证据更新其结论与因用户/利益相关方施加的方向性压力而改变结论时，外部观察到的响应变化是相同的——但二者的认识论意义截然不同。这构成了一个"响应归因问题"：仅凭输出变化无法判断改变的来源。已有工作分别在"信念修正"（informational update）与"谄媚/从众"（user pressure）两条路线上独立评估，缺乏在同一受控设定中同时分离两种影响的统一框架。
AI.method: 方法学核心包括：(1) 在固定目标命题周围构建 2×2 Evidence×Pressure 因子设计，引入 factor-specific 的局部控制（如目标对齐但非诊断性的 E₀、保留利益相关方结构但中性的 P₀*）；(2) 在 Probability（[0,100]）、Choice（oppose/uncertain/support 顺序类别）、Action（5 级 Likert）三个通道上分别计算有符号对照，得到 Evidence 响应 E_r、带符号 Pressure 响应 P_r、绝对 Pressure 运动 A_{P,r}、Evidence–Pressure 差 Q_r=E_r−P_r；(3) 用已知真值合成生成器、针对性消融（移除判断级探针、Evidence 标尺锚、单侧 Pressure、配对破裂）以及半合成迁移测试，来界定观察设计在何种条件下仍能可靠分离两种来源；(4) 为每个检查点定义"条件信念-响应剖面" Π_m，每条诊断坐标绑定评估条件索引 χ=(F,r,c,d,u,g)，并通过随机解码、目标绑定接口、指令干预等敏感性分析刻画评估条件依赖性。
AI.result: 在 36 个语义家族上对 Qwen3-8B 与 Llama3.1-8B、在 12 家族上加 Gemma3-12B 的实验显示：(1) 验证方面——合成数据中 α、γ、λ 三个参数能高保真恢复，移除任一观察组件都会破坏特定可识别性，半合成迁移测试表明强效应可在 10–25% 流行率下迁移，弱且稀疏的效应则不可迁移。(2) E/P/Q 通道差异显著——Qwen 在 Choice 上 E>P 但 Action 上 P>E；Llama 的 Probability 聚合 E≈0 来自目标方向间的对消，Choice 中 E>P。(3) 测量条件依赖——将主动方控制 P₀ 换成惰性 P₀* 会增大 P 估计；解码策略匹配后 Qwen–Llama Evidence 差异大幅缩小，Action 方向甚至反转；目标绑定接口可显著降低 Gemma 的补集一致性误差。(4) 指令干预——Gemini 在反压指令下签名 P 下降而 A_P 上升，表明运动转向反方向（反弹 reactance）；联合指令可同时提升受压情形下的 Evidence 响应。(5) 重复稳定性——Llama 在相同随机策略下三次采样的中位 SD=11.55、精确重复率仅 48.6%，远高于 Qwen、Gemma。
AI.conclusion: BeliefScope 把"证据更新"与"压力跟随"作为可分离的诊断维度，通过匹配对照与通道特定估计量同时量化两者，并在合成验证中明确可恢复边界。实证发现：模型层面的结论排序高度依赖评估设置（控制基准、解码、响应接口），但部分模型内较窄模式（如 Llama 在补集一致性上的一致高错误）更具持久性。抗压指令下签名 P 的下降不等同于稳定性，可能掩盖反弹方向的大幅运动。研究强调稳健性应是"选择性响应"（强证据更新 + 对无新事实压力的低跟随），而非单一输出不变，并把所有诊断坐标以条件剖面形式与产生它们的评估条件绑定，配套显式有效性边界。

title: From Geometry to Generalization: Why Row Normalization Can Beat Adam and Muon
summary: Different optimizers can fit the same training data while selecting classifiers with substantially different geometries, but whether this difference provably affects population performance remains unclear. We show that row-wise normalization can achieve strictly higher population accuracy than full-batch Adam, a proxy for random-reshuffling Adam, and exact-SVD Muon in high-dimensional multiclass classification. Under an isotropic Gaussian-cloud data model, this advantage arises because row normalization's class-wise Euclidean geometry asymptotically preserves the population decision-boundary directions, whereas Adam's coordinate-wise geometry and Muon's spectral geometry introduce nonvanishing distortions. Beyond isotropy, the advantage persists for full-batch training on class means with independently oriented class-mean and test-noise covariances. It holds for power-law spectra with class-mean exponent below one, even under heavily anisotropic test noise. When both covariances are diagonal and sufficiently close, the advantage over Adam can reverse, while applying the same random rotation to both restores it by changing only their alignment with Adam's coordinate axes. Synthetic and last-layer language-model experiments support the predicted advantage.

AI.tldr: 该论文从理论上证明，在高维多分类问题中，行归一化优化器（如RowGD、RowGDM）在种群准确率上严格优于Adam和Muon。其核心原因是行归一化的类别级欧几里得几何结构能够渐近保持种群决策边界方向，而Adam的坐标方向和Muon的谱方向会引入不可忽略的失真。这一优势在等向及各向异性高斯数据模型下均成立，并通过合成实验和LLaMA最后一层语言模型训练实验得到验证。
AI.motivation: 不同的优化器在拟合相同训练数据时可能选择几何结构截然不同的分类器，但这种几何差异是否会影响泛化性能尚不清楚。论文旨在回答：行归一化是否能严格获得比Adam和Muon更高的种群准确率，以及其背后的几何机制是什么。
AI.method: 论文在等向及各向异性高斯云数据模型下，建立了归一化最陡下降与隐式偏置分析的完整框架，将行范数扩展至随机重排小批量情形，并通过AdamProxy分析随机重排Adam。主要定理包括：确定性全批量优化器精度排序定理（Theorem 3.1）、随机优化器精度排序（Proposition 3.4）、各向异性扩展定理（Theorem 4.2）以及坐标对齐反转与Haar旋转恢复命题（Proposition 4.5）。实验部分包括合成高斯云数据实验和LLaMA-60M/130M最后一层训练实验。
AI.result: 1. 在等向高斯云模型下，RowGD/RowGDM在种群准确率上严格优于SpecGD/Muon/SignGD/Signum/Adam，概率至少1-e^{-√d}。2. 误差指数定量表明行归一化方法的种群误差呈指数级小于Adam和Muon。3. 随机重排条件下，高动量RR-RowSGDM同样严格优于RR-Muon和RR-Signum。4. 各向异性模型（独立Haar特征基、s_μ<1）下优势仍然成立。5. 坐标对齐各向异性下存在反转点λ_c，但施加共同Haar旋转可恢复优势。6. 合成实验中RowGD/RowGDM在30对种子中均优于竞争对手。7. LLaMA-60M/130M最后一层训练中RowSGDM在验证困惑度和边界对齐指标上均最优。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了优化器几何与种群准确率之间的严格联系，证明了行归一化优化器通过类别级欧几里得几何更好地保持类均值方向，从而在高维多分类问题中获得严格优于Adam和Muon的泛化性能。理论结果在多种数据模型下成立，合成与语言模型实验支持预测。

title: FloorSAV: Elucidating Spatial Audio-Visual Context with 2D Floormap for AV-LLMs
summary: While 3D spatial reasoning in dynamic egocentric environments is crucial for embodied intelligence, audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) lack explicit mechanisms to process and internalize global geometry directly from raw sensory streams. Existing approaches either require costly fine-tuning or underutilize the model's cross-modal reasoning capacities. In this paper, we propose FloorSAV, a novel framework that explicitly grounds spatial audio-visual context by rendering a dynamic 2D floormap. By integrating 3D point clouds, camera trajectories, spatial audio cues, and semantically grounded object landmarks, we inject this floormap into the AV-LLM as a synchronized stream with an egocentric video. AV-LLMs utilize their multi-modal capabilities to jointly reason over visual, auditory, and geometric cues in a single inference with floormap interpretation guidance.
