summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generative modeling, with their sampling procedures routinely modified to control generation and improve efficiency. These modifications introduce perturbations along the sampling trajectory, raising a central question: how do such perturbations affect generated output? To address this question, we develop a theoretical framework to investigate perturbation propagation, combining dynamical analysis of the sampling process with an information-theoretic characterization of output responses. Within this framework, we quantify perturbation strength using the Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence between perturbed and reference trajectory distributions, termed as path cost, which is shown to bound, but do not determine, changes in the output distribution. Building on this analysis, we derive a response identity that connects the propagation and accumulation of local perturbations with the information captured by a selected feature mean, explaining why changes in the output distribution can remain undetected by its first-order response. We test our theoretical analysis through controlled interventions at equal path cost in pretrained diffusion models, revealing distinct patterns of output sensitivity across sampling stages and spatial frequencies. To assess whether our framework can diagnose perturbations arising from practical approximations, we apply it to cache-based acceleration and show that our propagation analysis reliably identifies sampling intervals where caching causes larger image errors.

AI.tldr: 本文针对扩散模型采样过程中的扰动传播问题，建立了结合动力学分析与信息论的理论框架。研究量化了"路径代价"(path cost，即扰动轨迹与参考轨迹之间的KL散度)，证明了它仅界定但不决定输出分布的变化；推导出将局部扰动的传播积累与特征均值响应联系起来的响应恒等式；并在多个预训练扩散模型上验证了不同采样阶段与空间频率下输出敏感性的差异模式，以及在缓存加速应用中诊断较大图像误差的能力。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的采样过程常因分数估计误差、指导更新、快速求解器、量化、特征缓存等引入扰动。现有工作已从不同角度分析误差传播（如分数误差的似然界、累积误差传播、终点可观测性下界），但均未充分刻画下游采样动力学如何中介轨迹扰动幅度与最终输出效应之间的关系。核心问题是：为什么相同强度的扰动（等路径代价）会产生不同的输出效果。
AI.method: 方法包含三个层面：(1) 信息论层面：定义路径代价为扰动与参考轨迹分布之间的KL散度，利用相对熵链式法则将其精确分解为输出分布KL与条件轨迹KL（桥接代价，bridge cost）之和；进一步通过路径似然得分在输出上的条件期望，定义输出Fisher信息与路径Fisher信息，得到二阶KL展开。(2) 动力学层面：通过沿参考轨迹对扰动强度求一阶导，得到局部扰动通过Jacobian链T_i传播并线性叠加形成总输出响应V的传播恒等式，并据此推导特征均值响应。(3) 信息损失恒等式：定理1将特征均值响应所占路径信息比例分解为"输出可见度(F_Y/F_path)"与"特征-得分对齐(Corr²)"两个因子的乘积。实验上，在JiT-B/L、ADM、DiT-XL/2上以DCT空间模板（DC、DCT-1/4/16/31）在8个采样窗口施加等路径代价扰动；在缓存加速诊断中沿参考轨迹计算缓存引起的局部缺陷并通过JVP传播，预测图像MSE。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 理论结果：路径代价精确分解为输出KL与桥接代价（命题1）；一阶传播恒等式（命题2）；特征响应受限于F_Y≤F_path（命题3）；响应恒等式分解为输出可见度与特征-得分对齐（定理1）。(2) 控制扰动实验：JiT-B所有频率在窗口1响应最大；ADM峰值从DC的窗口1移至DCT-16的窗口4；DiT峰值从DC的窗口3移至DCT-31的窗口5，表明最早阶段扰动并非总是产生最大响应。一阶传播预测的时序模式与有限扰动响应一致，但峰值幅度有限差异（如DiT中有界为局部预测的36.8%–87.9%）。(3) 较小绝对响应可对应较大归一化响应（如JiT-B中DCT-16绝对响应小于DC但归一化响应更大）。(4) 缓存加速诊断：基于传播的预测器在四种模型上与观测图像MSE的Spearman相关系数为0.9524–0.9762，远超局部缺陷与路径代价基线（部分为负相关），能可靠识别误差较大的采样窗口。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了扩散模型扰动传播的理论框架，解释了路径代价为何不决定输出效应：扰动效果取决于路径代价、传播方式与交互、以及测量方式三个因素的联合作用。框架将输出响应表征为传播后的局部扰动之和，揭示了下游动力学、跨时间积累与观测共同塑造测量效应。利用该理论可诊断时序与频率相关的输出敏感性，并在缓存加速应用中有效识别产生较大图像偏差的采样窗口。框架的核心价值在于将轨迹层面的扰动度量与输出层面的响应通过信息论与动力学统一刻画，为实践中评估和优化扩散模型采样提供了诊断工具。

title: EvoKnow: Continual Knowledge Evolution for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: AI-generated image detectors are commonly trained on fixed generator domains and become difficult to maintain as new generative models emerge. Continual adaptation is challenging because replaying historical generated images is costly, whereas updating shared parameters with limited current-domain data can overwrite prior forensic knowledge. We propose EvoKnow, a replay-free framework that formulates continual AI-generated image detection as forensic knowledge evolution. EvoKnow preserves a shared forensic basis learned from base domains, incrementally adds isolated residual experts for complementary generator-relevant evidence, and retrieves expertise through an Analytical Incremental Router (AIR) updated in closed form from current-stage generated images and accumulated sufficient statistics. Experiments demonstrate effective cross-generator generalization, few-shot expansion, and long-horizon continual adaptation. With ten generated images per arriving generator, EvoKnow achieves 96.70% average accuracy on non-base GenImage generators and 94.48% accuracy on Chameleon without target-benchmark adaptation. Under a strict replay-free continual learning protocol, EvoKnow achieves state-of-the-art continual learning performance, attaining 96.32% mean stage-wise accuracy and 4.32% average forgetting.

AI.tldr: EvoKnow 提出了一种无需回放（replay-free）的持续学习框架，用于 AI 生成图像检测。它冻结共享取证基础，通过增量添加隔离的残差专家来学习新生成器的取证证据，并使用解析式路由器（AIR）闭式更新进行专家检索，实现了少样本扩展和长周期持续适应。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像检测器在固定生成器域上训练，难以应对新生成模型的持续涌现。重放历史生成图像代价高昂，而用有限的当前域数据更新共享参数则会覆盖已有取证知识，导致灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: EvoKnow 包含三部分：(1) 冻结的共享取证学习器（基于 DINOv3 与 LoRA）保留可迁移基础取证证据；(2) 增量残差专家为新到生成器学习互补证据，含 GPB（结构取证）和 LFB（频率取证）模块；(3) 分析式增量路由器 AIR 基于当前阶段生成图像与累积充分统计量，通过递归最小二乘闭式更新路由权重，无需梯度优化或历史图像回放。
AI.result: 在 GenImage 数据集上以每个新生成器仅 10 张图像扩展，非基生成器平均准确率达 96.70%，Chameleon 上达到 94.48%（无目标基准适应）。在 14 阶段严格无回放持续协议下，EvoKnow 取得 96.32% 平均阶段准确率和 4.32% 平均遗忘率，在非联合训练方法中达到最优。
AI.conclusion: EvoKnow 验证了持续检测器无需回放历史生成图像即可在保留可迁移取证证据的同时增量获取互补知识并检索相关专家，为动态取证知识演化提供了有效范式。

title: PlanWAM: Planning-Shaped Future Representations for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: World models in end-to-end autonomous driving predict future scene evolution to provide foresight for trajectory planning. Existing methods mainly study how to predict the future and how to use it, but less often ask which future representation is actually most useful for planning. To this end, we propose PlanWAM, a Planning-Shaped World Action Model. The key idea is to let the planning task shape the future-state representation, so that it retains the information most useful for planning. A latent world model then predicts this planning-shaped future latent representation from historical observations and uses it for planning, enabling foresighted planning. Specifically, we first use a Temporal Register Pyramid to compress multi-frame historical information in a recency-aware manner, learning a compact history representation oriented toward future reasoning and planning. We then introduce a privileged future posterior branch that observes ground-truth future frames, and shape its future latent representation with trajectory-planning objectives to obtain a planning-shaped future latent representation. Hindsight-to-Foresight Distillation trains a prior branch that depends only on history to predict this future latent representation. The predicted future latent representation serves as planning context and guides trajectory generation and selection. PlanWAM achieves 93.8 PDMS / 90.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM-v1/v2 navtest and reaches 38.7 HD-Score on closed-loop HUGSIM in a zero-shot setting, demonstrating leading planning performance across both open-loop and closed-loop evaluations. Extensive experiments further demonstrate that planning-shaped future representations provide an effective and deployable form of foresight for world-action models.

AI.tldr: PlanWAM提出了一种"规划塑形"的未来表征学习框架，将端到端自动驾驶中的世界模型未来表征直接由轨迹规划目标塑形，并通过Hindsight-to-Foresight蒸馏将特权后验信息迁移到仅依赖历史的前验分支，在NAVSIM和HUGSIM上取得了领先的开放环路和零样本闭环性能。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型主要研究"如何预测未来"和"如何使用未来"，但很少探讨"哪种未来表征对规划最有用"。像素重建或通用潜在预测目标定义的未来表征可能与下游规划目标不匹配——能重建场景的表征未必保留影响轨迹决策的关键信息。因此需要重新定义未来建模为面向规划的预测表征学习问题。
AI.method: PlanWAM包含三个核心组件：(1) 时序寄存器金字塔（Temporal Register Pyramid），按时间近近性分层分配查询预算，压缩多帧多视角历史观测；(2) 规划塑形的后验分支，利用真值未来观测构建未来潜在表征，并直接用轨迹生成与选择损失塑形其表征空间；(3) Hindsight-to-Foresight蒸馏，训练仅依赖历史的先验分支预测该规划塑形的未来潜在。推理时仅使用先验分支，实现可部署的前瞻条件规划。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM-v1 navtest上达到93.8 PDMS（超越DrivoR基线0.7分，相对最强世界模型方法DriveFuture提升3.1分）；在NAVSIM-v2 navtest上达到90.9 EPDMS，超过人类智能体基线0.6分；在HUGSIM零样本闭环评估中达到38.7 HD-Score和53.7平均路线完成率，分别超越最强基线9.8分和7.8分。消融实验表明规划塑形未来表征显著降低安全相关故障（NC失败减少62.3%，TTC失败减少52.4%）。
AI.conclusion: 规划塑形的未来表征为世界-动作模型提供了有效且可部署的前瞻形式，验证了"由规划目标定义未来信息价值"这一思路的可行性。实验证明直接由规划目标塑形的未来潜在比通用预测目标更能改善规划性能，且可通过蒸馏转化为部署友好的纯历史条件模型。

title: Environmental Feedback Modeling Matters: Rethinking Feedback Treatment in Agentic Hindsight Self-Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning is commonly used to train language agents in interactive environments, but cannot be directly applied when rewards are unavailable. Recent methods use environmental feedback as privileged context for hindsight self-distillation, but our analysis suggests that simply conditioning the teacher on feedback is insufficient, motivating us to rethink how environmental feedback is used in agentic self-distillation. Given that environmental feedback contains rich supervision for modeling how the environment responds to agent actions, we introduce \textit{agentic SElf-distilLation with environmental Feedback modeling} (SELF), a framework that jointly optimizes environmental feedback modeling and hindsight self-distillation. SELF learns to predict environmental responses while distilling guidance from a feedback-conditioned self-teacher into the policy. Our analysis reveals a mutually reinforcing mechanism: environmental feedback modeling strengthens hindsight supervision and policy learning, while self-distillation enhances the model's ability to model environmental feedback. With Qwen3-8B, SELF outperforms SDPO and GRPO by 6.4 and 4.1 percentage points in $\tau$-bench success rate, and by 10.71 and 3.57 percentage points in AppWorld task goal completion, respectively. These results show that SELF uses environmental feedback more effectively within agentic self-distillation, improving agent capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出SELF框架，联合优化环境反馈建模与事后自蒸馏，使同一观察反馈同时作为预测目标与教师特权上下文；Qwen3-8B在τ-bench与AppWorld上分别超越SDPO和GRPO最高约10.71个百分点，且保持通用能力不退化。
AI.motivation: 在无可验证奖励的智能体训练场景下，现有方法（如SDPO）仅将环境反馈作为教师特权上下文进行事后自蒸馏，作者分析发现这种用法对策略增益有限，未能充分利用反馈中蕴含的环境响应监督信息。
AI.method: 形式化智能体—环境交互，提出SELF（agentic SElf-distilLation with environmental Feedback modeling）：每个转移(h_i, a_i, f_i)中，将同一f_i同时用作两个目标——(1) 环境反馈建模：对(h_i, a_i)→f_i进行长度归一化的负对数似然预测；(2) 事后自蒸馏：EMA教师以f_i为特权上下文，学生通过反向KL对齐到教师分布；两者共享学生参数，联合损失为λ_o·ℓ_env + λ_a·ℓ_sd，默认λ_o=0.2, λ_a=1.0。
AI.result: τ-bench Retail上Qwen3-8B SR达43.2%，超SDPO/GRPO 6.4/4.1个百分点；AppWorld TGC达35.71%，超SDPO/GRPO 10.71/3.57个百分点。λ_o消融表明加入反馈建模使教师SR从30.1%升至46.7%，学生从29.4%升至38.7%；λ_a消融表明自蒸馏使反馈预测准确率从37%/9%升至73%/56%（Retail/AppWorld）。MMLU/MMLU-Pro/IFEval通用能力与基座差距≤0.11分；训练成本16.4 GPU-hours，比GRPO少60.2%。
AI.conclusion: 环境反馈建模与事后自蒸馏存在相互增强机制：反馈建模强化了事后教师与策略学习，自蒸馏提升了共享模型预测环境响应的能力。SELF以单一共享模型同时学习环境响应模式与策略监督，无需外部奖励即可获得优于自蒸馏基线与GRPO的智能体性能，并保持通用语言能力。

title: Tight bounds and output sensitive algorithms for maximal clique enumeration in link streams
summary: A link stream is a set of interactions between pairs of vertices, each one lasting during some time interval, and a clique of a link stream is a set of vertices together with a time interval during which all of them interact. A clique is maximal if neither its vertex set nor its interval can be enlarged. All known algorithms listing the maximal cliques of a link stream may spend time exponential in the size of a clique for each clique they output. Here, we approach the question under the light of two parameters of the instantaneous graphs of the stream, their maximum degree $\Delta$ and their degeneracy $k$. We prove that a link stream with $m$ links has $O(m\Delta^2 3^{\Delta/3})$ maximal cliques, and that a link stream with $n$ vertices and $|\mathcal{T}|$ distinct end times has $O(n|\mathcal{T}|k^2 3^{k/3})$ maximal cliques. Both bounds are tight up to a factor polynomial in $\Delta$ and $k$ respectively, and the second one improves the factor $2^k$ of previous bounds to $3^{k/3}$. Then we present two algorithms. The first one has setup time $O(m\log m)$ and polynomial time delay $\mathrm{poly}(\Delta)\log m$. The second one has setup time $O(m\log m+mk^2\log^3 n)$ and polynomial time delay $\mathrm{poly}(k)\log m$. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first algorithms with polynomial time delay for this problem. We also give an online version of the second algorithm, and we show that our results apply to the $\Delta$-cliques and $(\Delta,\gamma)$-cliques of temporal graphs.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对链接流(link stream)中极大团(maximal clique)枚举问题，证明了基于瞬时图最大度Δ和退化度k的紧致上界，并提出了首个具有多项式时间延迟的输出敏感算法，同时给出了在线版本及对时序图Δ-团的应用。
AI.motivation: 链接流中极大团枚举在实践中具有重要应用（如高中生接触模式分析、社区检测）。然而现有算法在输出每个极大团时可能耗费关于团大小的指数时间，且基于退化度的上界含有比静态图中更大的指数因子。该研究旨在通过分析瞬时图的稀疏性参数（最大度Δ和退化度k），获得紧致上界和多项式时间延迟的输出敏感算法。
AI.method: 核心方法基于一个关键观察：链接流的极大团由其结束时间、起始时间和对应静态图中的极大团唯一确定。基于此，提出了两种锚定策略：算法1将每个极大团锚定到其结束时刻的一条链路上（按最大度参数化），算法2将每个极大团锚定到其在退化序中的第一个顶点（按退化度参数化）。算法2利用后缀字典避免检测候选的邻域，并通过等级数据结构动态维护有向无环图来维持退化序。关键工具包括极大团的阈值刻画、退化序分解、后缀参数和动态有向图维护。
AI.result: 证明了链接流极大团数目的两个紧上界：O(m·Δ²·3^(Δ/3))和O(n|𝒯|·k²·3^(k/3))，后者改进了之前2^k的因子至3^(k/3)，且3^(k/3)不可再改进。算法1具有O(m log m)设置时间和O(Δ⁴(Δ log m+Δ²+λ(Δ)))的多项式延迟。算法2具有O(m log m+mk² log³ n)设置时间和O(k⁵(k² log m+λ(k)))的多项式延迟，不依赖最大度。给出了总时间为O(m log m+mk log³ n)+α·O(k⁵(k² log n+λ(k)))的在线算法。同时证明了不能以m·f(k)形式界定极大团数目。成果可直接应用于时序图的Δ-团和(Δ,γ)-团。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了链接流极大团枚举的首个多项式时间延迟算法和紧致上界，改进了退化度因子从2^k至3^(k/3)。成果也适用于时序图的Δ-团和(Δ,γ)-团。提出的开放问题包括：是否存在仅需多项式空间的算法、能否消除延迟中的log m因子、能否在退化度序分解中将k²因子降至最优，以及将该方法推广到k-plex、加权(Δ,γ)-团和其他变体。算法已在超过10000个随机链接流上进行了正确性验证。

title: RISR: Residual-Informed Scientific Equation Discovery with Large Language Models
summary: Symbolic regression combines structural search with numerical fitting, but aggregate fit scores do not describe how the remaining error varies across inputs. We introduce RISR, a residual-informed method that uses these error patterns to guide formula discovery and learn which corrections are worth fitting. A residual encoder compresses aligned inputs, targets, current predictions, and residuals into continuous tokens that condition a language model to propose formulas. For subsequent refinement, a dual-view relational encoder uses additive and regularized multiplicative residuals to predict the post-fit utility of candidate corrections. We evaluate RISR on scientific tasks from the LLM-SRBench. RISR achieves 63.57% and 38.50% ID accuracy at the 1% and 0.1% pointwise relative-error tolerances, respectively. The corresponding OOD accuracies are 56.07% and 38.24%. RISR outperforms the reported baselines using the same backbone. The results show that our residual-informed approach can improve numerical equation recovery.

AI.tldr: RISR是一个两阶段科学方程发现方法，通过将逐点残差信息编码为连续token来引导冻结LLM生成公式，并使用双视图关系编码器预测校正的拟合效用。在LLM-SRBench上的评估显示，RISR使用Qwen3-Coder-30B骨干网络实现了1%容差63.57%和0.1%容差38.50%的ID准确率，优于同规模基线。
AI.motivation: 现有符号回归方法使用聚合拟合分数来排序候选方程，但这些分数无法描述残差在输入空间中的变化模式，导致具有相似整体损失的方程可能需要不同的校正。需要一种方法能够利用残差的逐点信息来指导公式发现和判断哪些校正值得拟合。
AI.method: RISR采用两阶段方法：(A) 残差引导的公式搜索——搜索残差编码器将输入、目标、预测和残差压缩为16个连续token，通过点注意力路径和频谱场路径融合后投影到LLM嵌入空间，条件化冻结的Qwen3-Coder-30B生成公式；同时学习结构编辑生成器预测添加、替换、删除或停止操作。(B) 残差引导的精炼——双视图关系编码器分别编码加法残差视图和正则化乘法残差视图，通过关系注意力机制生成变量表示，效用评分头预测校正动作在系数拟合后的效用。编码器使用合成数据离线训练，LLM保持冻结。
AI.result: 在LLM-SRBench（125个科学问题）上，RISR使用Qwen3-Coder-30B骨干网络：ID准确率为63.57%（1%容差）和38.50%（0.1%容差），OOD准确率为56.07%（1%容差）和38.76%（0.1%容差）。超越同规模SR-Scientist+RL基线22.65个百分点（1%容差），且在1%容差下匹配使用GPT-OSS-120B的SR-Scientist的最佳ID准确率。消融实验显示残差引导搜索将ID准确率从7.75%提升至36.43%，精炼阶段进一步提升至63.57%。符号准确率达13.18%，优于所有基线。
AI.conclusion: RISR证明利用逐点残差模式指导LLM公式生成和校正选择是有效的，能够在30B规模下实现与更大骨干网络竞争的性能，并提高科学方程的数值恢复和符号恢复能力。残差引导搜索和学习的校正选择策略都对最终性能有正向贡献。

title: Fact over Fiction: Detection of Pathological Hallucinations in Sinhala-to-English Neural Machine Translation
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables, Accepted paper at the 13th Conference on Computational Linguistics and Speech Processing (ROCLING) 2026
summary: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) models, while capable of producing highly fluent outputs, remain vulnerable to hallucinations, which are translations that are natural yet semantically unrelated to the source. This vulnerability is acute in low-resource settings like Sinhala-to-English, where weak cross-lingual alignment leads to hallucinations. This paper introduces a framework for reference-free hallucination detection in this language pair. We present a 45,000-sample synthetic dataset generated through a probabilistic chain of five linguistically motivated corruption strategies, with a semantic rescue mechanism that uses character-level similarity to distinguish hallucinations from morphological variants. We fine-tune mDeBERTa-v3 for token-level sequence labelling, reaching a token-level F1 of 0.841 +/- 0.001 over three seeds on a source-disjoint test set, and study a three-signal ensemble integrating neural risk scores, sequence log-probabilities, and cross-lingual semantic embeddings (LaBSE). A source-ablation control shows that the detector relies on the Sinhala source rather than on surface artefacts of the corruption process: shuffling or removing the source reduces sentence-level AUROC from 0.970 to chance. We benchmark eight NMT systems spanning five model families and find that detector firings vary by an order of magnitude across architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文针对低资源语种 Sinhala-to-English 神经机器翻译中缺乏标注数据的问题，构建了一个45,000条合成幻觉数据集，提出了基于mDeBERTa-v3的参考无关token级幻觉检测框架（Token F1=0.841），并通过源消融实验验证检测器确实依赖源语言信号，最后在8个NMT系统上对三种信号（神经检测、对数概率、LaBSE语义相似度）进行了基准评测。
AI.motivation: NMT模型在低资源语种翻译中容易产生幻觉（流畅但语义脱离源文本的输出），而现有评估基准（如HalOmi）完全排除了Sinhala-English语言对，导致该方向缺乏标注数据、评估框架和检测基线。序列对数概率在低资源场景下常被目标语言先验主导，无法可靠反映忠实度，需要更鲁棒的参考无关检测方法。
AI.method: 1) 数据集构建：基于nllb-top25k-ensi-cleaned语料（~25K对），通过五种语言学驱动的损坏策略生成负样本——NER实体交换、语义漂移（反义词替换）、依存交换（主宾混淆）、数字扭曲、高温采样（NLLB-1.3B T=1.5生成后用BERTScore<0.92过滤），采用三阶段概率链组合产生复合幻觉，并用language_tool_python进行语法过滤，最终生成45,000条标注数据（32,577条幻觉+12,423条忠实），按源句子切分构建15,000条平衡子集。2) Token级标签：用difflib.SequenceMatcher对齐生成二值标签，引入基于Ratcliff/Obershelp字符相似度的语义救援机制（θ_r=0.80）区分形态变体与真幻觉。3) 检测器：微调mDeBERTa-v3进行token级序列标注，Hallucination Ratio R_H聚合为句子级分数，校准阈值τ=0（任意token即标记）。4) 三信号集成：神经风险分数R_H + 倒置对数概率Ĉ + LaBSE余弦相似度(1-ρ̂)的加权组合。5) 源消融控制：用替换/移除源、纯假设模型、忠实假设配错源等五种条件验证检测器依赖源语言。6) 在8个NMT系统（NLLB 600M/1.3B、M2M-100 418M/1.2B、mBART-50 m2m/m2o、mT5-Sinhala微调、OPUS-MT）上对比三种信号的触发情况。
AI.result: 1) 检测器性能：mDeBERTa-v3在源分离测试集上Token F1=0.841±0.001（Acc=0.946, P=0.845, R=0.837），比XLM-RoBERTa基线高5.2点（主要来自召回率+7.5点）；按策略分解，语义漂移最易（0.934），依存交换最难（0.804）。2) 源消融：替换/移除源使Token F1降至约0.30，句子AUROC从0.970降至随机水平（0.54/0.51），忠实假设配错源时100%被标记，证明检测器确实依赖源假设关系而非英语表层扰动线索；纯假设基线Token F1=0.622、AUROC=0.850。3) 集成评估：单检测器AUROC=0.972远高于倒置对数概率（0.880）和LaBSE（0.882），验证调优权重（0.9/0/0.1）几乎全部信号来自检测器，LaBSE仅带来小幅排序增益。4) NMT基准：检测器触发率在不同架构间差异近一个数量级（NLLB 600M仅51次，OPUS-MT达433次），M2M-100从418M扩到1.2B使触发数减半（253→129），对数概率与R_H的Spearman ρ在-0.103到-0.437之间（均p<0.001），确认信号互补非冗余；存在Det Only的流畅且高置信度幻觉，对数概率无法捕获。5) 假阳性来源：词汇释义（如"stated"/"said"）和句法强制插入的英语成分常被误标。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了Sinhala-to-English翻译幻觉检测的空白，证明了在低资源语言对上合成数据+神经token级检测是可行的参考无关方案，源消融控制为合成数据训练的检测器建立了可信度验证范式。检测信号在NMT系统间呈数量级差异，提示模型族和训练数据比参数规模更影响幻觉风险。局限在于：合成损坏无法完全代表自然翻译错误；difflib对齐对释义和遗漏无能为力；阈值在平衡合成数据上调优会高估真实输出幻觉率。未来工作需人类标注自然翻译错误、采用跨语言词对齐替代difflib监督，并在标注自然数据上重新校准集成权重和阈值。

title: TypedBench: A Benchmark for Calibration, Framing Sensitivity, and Cost in System One Decision Models
summary: System One models output calibrated probabilities over typed answers such as categorical choices, ordinal levels, or binary outcomes, via a non-generative interface. Software can act on these probabilities through thresholds, cost-weighted choices, and escalation rules. Consequently, if these probabilities are miscalibrated or wording-sensitive, the software ma take unintended actions leaving human operators with no textual rationale to inspect. Current evaluations largely report accuracy and calibration on public classification datasets without a clear reference. We present TypedBench, a benchmark for typed decision models like Jev built from seven policy-labelled generators and nine evaluation suites. We report accuracy as median and range across paraphrases, and calibration error relative to the finite-sample noise floor of a matched, perfectly calibrated predictor. We assess probability quality through selective prediction, ordinal proper scoring rules, and realised cost under asymmetric cost matrices. We evaluate a hosted model, an open encoder, and a family of open decoders spanning 0.8B-9B parameters on identical items. The hosted model follows the stated policy but is wording-sensitive and systematically underconfident; under asymmetric costs, using its probabilities can be worse than taking its top answer. Decoders route exactly and are slow as options or questions are added. The decoder is least accurate on policy questions and degrades with more options. Overall, typed decision models must be evaluated jointly on policy adherence, wording robustness, probability quality, and induced decision outcomes.

AI.tldr: TypedBench是针对"系统一"（System One）决策模型的基准测试，由7个策略标签生成器和9个评估套件组成。该基准评估的是返回类型化概率分布的非生成式模型，而非生成文本的大语言模型。重点评估四个维度：策略遵循度、措辞鲁棒性、概率质量和决策价值。评估显示不同架构（托管模型、编码器、解码器）在不同维度上失败互补：托管模型遵守策略但对措辞敏感且系统性低估置信度；编码器在策略问题上准确率最低且随选项增加而退化；解码器准确但延迟高且策略应用不完整。
AI.motivation: System One模型输出可直接被软件操作的类型化概率（通过阈值、加权选择、升级规则）。若这些概率校准不当或对措辞敏感，软件可能采取非预期动作且无可审查的文本依据。然而现有评估多报告准确率和校准误差，但缺乏明确参照标准，特别是无法测试概率对实际决策的影响，因此需要专门的基准来评估此类模型。
AI.method: 构建TypedBench基准，包含：(1) 7个策略驱动的程序化生成器（工单分类、钓鱼邮件、RAG相关性、日志分诊、政策合规、护栏意图、多语言工单），标签由策略规则确定而非手工标注；(2) 5个控制臂扰动（不可知、标签噪声、干扰项、无正确答案、表面扰动）；(3) 9个评估套件A-I，分别测试置信度校准、措辞稳定性、可扩展性、鲁棒性、问题干扰、序数一致性、是否一致性、级联路由、决策成本；(4) 多重评估指标包括跨措辞的中位数准确率和范围、相对有限样本噪声底的ECE/null比、选择性预测AURC、序数正确评分规则、非对称成本下的实现成本；(5) 评估了1个托管模型、2个编码器检查点和3个解码器规模（0.8B-9B），加上DistilBERT微调基线和两个受约束LLM。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) 准确度主要通过策略问题（如工单优先级）区分模型，托管模型在措辞间准确率波动达24点，规则应用上明显领先；(2) 无模型完全校准，托管模型和大多数解码器系统性低估置信度（温度重拟合<1），编码器多在错误问题上过度自信，校准方向因模型和任务而异；(3) 成本敏感决策下，托管模型和9B解码器的概率在非对称成本下表现不如取top答案（value为负），而弱模型因top答案差而受益（value为正）；(4) 托管模型扩展性好（K=255选项仍精确），编码器在100选项前崩溃；(5) 多问题共存时各模型答案不变但本地模型延迟随问题数增加；(6) 严重度梯度和否定句处理上托管模型最佳，编码器几乎忽略否定；(7) 不同架构失败模式互补，可级联路由降低成本。
AI.conclusion: System One决策模型应联合评估四个维度：策略遵循度、措辞鲁棒性、概率质量、决策结果。TypedBench提供了：(1) 策略标签、防污染的程序化生成器和5种控制臂扰动；(2) 包括ECE/null校准、选择性预测、序数评分、非对称成本的评估协议；(3) 跨架构对比显示不同失败模式互补。结论强调：准确度应在跨措辞的中位数和范围内报告，校准应针对每模型-原语-问题而非全局评估，概率质量应由部署成本而非单独准确率或ECE判断，架构间可互补使用（级联路由）。该基准为类型化决策接口提供了测量层而非排行榜分数。

title: CoPoE: Multimodal Fusion via Decomposable Disease-Coordinate Product-of-Experts for Missing-Modality Alzheimer's Diagnosis
summary: Multimodal Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis benefits from integrating heterogeneous clinical, imaging, genomic, and biomarker evidence, but clinical cohorts frequently suffer from irregular modality missingness. Existing fusion methods often synthesize absent inputs, risking the introduction of artificial surrogates, or pool available signals into uninterpretable latent spaces. We present CoPoE (Disease-Coordinate Product-of-Experts), a disease-coordinate framework that maps multimodal evidence into a structured latent space partitioned into four distinct biological and clinical axes: genetic Risk, molecular Pathology, Neurodegeneration, and clinical Stage (R/P/N/S). Each observed modality parameterizes a diagonal Gaussian expert over the full RPNS vector, and a masked Product-of-Experts architecture fuses only the available modalities. Consequently, absent modalities add no factor to the fusion path, allowing the network to preserve a robust, decomposable posterior for any non-empty modality subset without synthetic imputation in the RPNS path. Through extensive missing-modality experiments on the ADNI dataset, CoPoE achieves the best all-modality performance and the highest mean AUROC across all 15 observed-subset evaluations among standardized missing-modality fusion baselines under a shared non-PET ADNI embedding benchmark, while substantially improving raw-probability ECE, Brier score, and NLL. Furthermore, PET-supervised probing shows evidence enrichment within the pathology (P) block under full modalities, with tau-related signal retained even when direct fluid biospecimen inputs are withheld. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoPoE框架，通过将多模态证据映射到结构化的RPNS（遗传风险/分子病理/神经退行/临床阶段）潜在空间，采用掩码Product-of-Experts融合机制处理阿尔茨海默病诊断中的模态缺失问题，无需对缺失模态进行合成插补即可为任意非空模态子集保留可分解的后验分布。
AI.motivation: 阿尔茨海默病多模态诊断面临临床数据中模态不规则缺失的挑战。现有方法要么通过插补/合成缺失输入引入人工替代物，要么将可用信号池化为不可解释的潜在空间，限制了生物标志物感知的AD建模。本文旨在解决如何在不合成缺失模态的情况下，保持疾病相关轴（如病理和神经退行）可解释且可测试的融合表示。
AI.method: CoPoE采用疾病坐标系框架，将四种模态组（基因组G、生物标志物B、影像I、临床C）映射到共享的RPNS坐标空间。每个观察模态参数化一个关于完整RPNS向量的对角高斯专家，通过闭式掩码Product-of-Experts仅融合观察到的专家——缺失模态在公式(2)中不贡献任何因子。融合后验通过精度加权组合获得先验正则化的均值。PET衍生的淀粉样蛋白和tau阳性读出头仅读取融合后的P块，以PET标签监督。训练损失包括分类交叉熵、PET标签的focal BCE、KL正则化、块对齐损失（鼓励I→N和B→P的专业化）、子集训练损失以及级联先验。
AI.result: 在ADNI数据集上的实验表明，CoPoE在全模态下所有六项指标（BAcc 71.87%、macro-F1 71.92%、AUROC 85.80%、ECE 0.086、Brier 0.408、NLL 0.681）均达到最优；在15个观察子集评估中，12个获得最高AUROC，平均AUROC达77.82%（最佳基线为76.04%）。PET读出分析显示P块在全模态下具有最强的淀粉样蛋白（AUROC 91.83）和tau（AUROC 75.25）预测能力；无生物标志物设置下tau信号在P块中仍最强。消融实验证实RPNS结构化分区和残差分支均对性能有显著贡献。
AI.conclusion: CoPoE是一种疾病坐标系的掩码Product-of-Experts框架，将缺失模态诊断视为RPNS坐标中的观察证据累积，缺失模态在RPNS路径中不添加任何因子，后验在所有子集中保持可分解。在ADNI上实现了最佳的全模态性能和15个观察模态子集条件下的最高平均AUROC，同时在ECE、Brier分数和NLL上表现显著优于基线。PET读出进一步显示P块在全证据下富集，且tau相关信号在无生物标志物输入时得以保留。未来工作应在外部队列上验证CoPoE，更明确地建模缺失机制，并评估子组稳健性。

title: Estimating Great Expectations Under Autoregressive Language Models with Potentials
summary: Many applications of language models hinge not on individual samples but on the expectation of a test functional under the model. Estimating such expectations reliably can be computationally expensive. In this paper, we show how to make estimation more efficient by exploiting the next-token conditional probabilities which are available as a by-product of sampling. We do so through potentials: real-valued functions on prefixes that decompose the test functional additively. We construct an estimator whose variance depends on the chosen potential, and derive conditions under which a potential reduces this variance. We then develop practical potentials for several estimands and applications, and demonstrate substantial variance reductions across several estimands at comparable computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于"势函数"的方差缩减框架，用于在自回归语言模型下高效估计测试函数的期望。该方法利用采样过程中自然产生的下一词条件概率，将测试函数沿前缀分解为可加增量，并以贝尔曼算子取条件期望来构建无偏估计器。文章给出了零方差oracle势函数的精确刻画、方差缩减的充要条件、控制变量最优系数公式，并将该框架推广到重要性采样。在四个应用（损失/散度及梯度、n-gram计数/频率、事件概率、水印检测）中实现了显著的方差缩减。
AI.motivation: 在语言模型的诸多应用中（如RLHF中的KL正则化、AI安全中的有害输出概率、模型蒸馏、水印检测、可解释性），核心关注点不是单个样本，而是测试函数在模型分布下的期望。然而，直接蒙特卡洛或重要性采样估计这些期望往往方差很大，需要大量样本，计算成本高昂。采样的副产品——下一词条件概率——通常未被利用。因此，亟需一种能复用这些免费信息来降低方差、保持无偏性的通用框架。
AI.method: 核心方法：定义"势函数"φ→为前缀上的实值函数，通过增量算子Δ将测试函数f沿字符串分解为token级增量之和。利用Bellman算子B对每步增量在下一词分布上取条件期望，得到潜在估计量θ̂(φ→)。该估计量无条件偏性（Proposition 4），其方差依赖于势函数的选择。理论结果：(1) 存在零方差oracle势φ→⋆=E[f(Y)|Y⪰x]（Proposition 1）；(2) 方差缩减的充要条件由协方差不等式刻画（Proposition 1）；(3) 通过控制变量形式θ̂(φ→,α)=θ̂∗−α(θ̂∗−θ̂(φ→))保证无偏，最优系数α⋆由Cov/Var给出（Proposition 2）；(4) 推广到重要性采样下的oracle势（Proposition 5）。势函数设计采取两条路径：利用f的可加结构解析构造（如熵、KL、Brier损失的逐token对数似然作为势），或通过K折交叉拟合从样本中学习oracle势的近似（用于非可加事件概率）。势函数选择采用嵌套交叉拟合（Algorithm 1），在保持无偏的同时利用全部样本。
AI.result: 1) 损失与散度（熵、KL、Brier损失、幂次分数遗憾及梯度）：在56个策略-参考对-估计量组合中，势估计量方差比介于0.058-0.987，有效样本量提升达17.3倍。KL上出现12.3%的Tülu-3提示中势估计量方差更高，但控制变量系数拟合可将中位方差比从1.134降至0.974。梯度估计在所有135个量-检查点比较中均降低方差，比率达0.11-0.98，控制变量额外提供达89%的缩减。2) n-gram计数与频率（7,647个GPT-2目标）：成本调整后方差比中位数1.24%，75%目标只需蒙特卡洛计算的10%以下；同等样本量下势估计量在96.5%目标上达到RSE≤50%，蒙特卡洛仅19%。3) 事件概率分析（ARI分布估计）：学习势（中位方差比0.87-0.90）和嵌套选择（0.88）相比MBAR基线降低约12%方差，等效于额外约90万次生成。4) 水印检测概率：OPT-1.3B上二项势将检测概率方差降低约36%（中位比0.64），不确定区间内降幅达44%。期望分数估计在所有512个提示上均改善16%-53%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一个通用的方差缩减框架，通过"势函数设计"将采样过程中免费的下一词条件概率转化为统计效率提升。关键贡献包括：(1) 形式化的oracle势与方差缩减充要条件；(2) 同时保证无偏性的控制变量机制；(3) 解析势与学习势的实用构造路径；(4) 嵌套交叉拟合实现无偏势选择。实验在四个不同应用中一致展示了大幅方差降低，且不增加额外模型评估成本。限制包括：方差缩减依赖势函数选择、需要访问模型的token级概率（不适用于黑盒API）、具体收益幅度因设置而异。该框架将强化学习中的势函数奖励塑形思想重新定位为采样后估计阶段的通用方差缩减工具。

title: WAM-Cache: Staleness-Bounded KV Reuse for Efficient World Action Models
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) enable generalist robot manipulation by conditioning an action expert on representations from a pretrained video Diffusion Transformer (DiT). In closed-loop control, the video DiT runs at every chunk to encode the current observation into layerwise key-value (KV) pairs that the action expert queries. This prefill dominates the per-chunk computational cost, yet existing training-free accelerations leave it fully dense. We present WAM-Cache, a training-free framework that retains layerwise key-value representations across chunks and recomputes only a sparse refresh set of tokens. Crucially, we find that the intuitive heuristic of refreshing visually drifted tokens plateaus far below the dense baseline, even with an oracle predicting ground-truth KV drift. Downstream action accuracy is instead governed by where the action expert attends, not by what moved. WAM-Cache therefore selects the refresh set by uniting the action expert's cross-attention with visual latent surprise, complemented by a strict age bound that suppresses compounding error. On Fast-WAM, WAM-Cache cuts video DiT prefill FLOPs by 32-42% across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-world experiments, while staying within 0.7-1.8 percentage points of the dense policy in simulation and 2.5 points on a real robot.

AI.tldr: WAM-Cache是首个面向世界动作模型（WAM）视频DiT预填充阶段的无训练KV缓存框架，通过稀疏刷新策略在减少32-42%预填充FLOPs的同时，将策略性能损失控制在仿真环境下0.7-1.8个百分点、真实机器人2.5个百分点以内。核心发现是缓存刷新应遵循策略注意力而非视觉漂移，并结合潜在惊喜与严格年龄边界以抑制自引用误差累积。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAM）将预训练视频DiT与动作专家结合用于通用机器人操控，但在闭环控制中每个推理块都需要执行视频DiT预填充以编码当前观测，该步骤占每块计算开销的主导（在Fast-WAM上N=2步时占两DiT FLOPs的83.5%）。现有训练加速方法要么需要重训练，要么仅作用于去噪器缓存，从未触及视频DiT预填充这一瓶颈。因此亟需一种无需重训练即可稀疏化预填充的方法。
AI.method:
方法核心是构建稀疏刷新集ℛ_t = S_t ∪ P_t ∪ A_t：
1. **潜在惊喜集S_t**：基于当前token嵌入与参考嵌入之间的归一化L2距离，选取top-k个位移最大的视觉token，捕捉物理动态变化。
2. **动作注意力集P_t**：复用上一块动作专家已计算的跨注意力图，选取对动作预测最关键的top-k个视觉token，零额外开销捕捉策略敏感性。
3. **年龄边界集A_t**：对所有连续复用达到G=2次的token强制刷新，打破基于排名的内容信号所导致的自引用误差累积，严格限制每个KV对的最长陈旧时间。

预填充仅对ℛ_t内的token执行查询和注意力，未选中token保留其历史KV表示。整体计算节省为(1-ρ_t)·C_dense，ρ_t=|ℛ_t|/S_v由刷新策略决定。
AI.result:
在Fast-WAM上（基于Wan2.2-5B视频DiT+1B动作专家）：

**RoboTwin 2.0**（50任务×100回合）：默认预算下clean场景41.6% FLOPs削减，SR仅降1.8pp（88.36% vs 90.16%）；随机化场景39.3%削减，SR仅降1.3pp。所有基线（FastV、ToMe、Eventful、VLA-Cache）在匹配预算下至少损失4.0pp，最强的VLA-Cache损失4.0pp。

**LIBERO**（500回合/套件）：32.3% FLOPs削减下平均SR 95.85% vs dense 96.50%（仅差0.65pp），大预算下完全匹配dense。

**真实机器人**（AIRBOT Play，20回合/任务）：40.2% FLOPs削减，平均SR 82.5% vs dense 85.0%。

**消融关键发现**：
- 随机选择仅26.9% SR
- 基于变化的规则（像素差、潜在惊喜、KV漂移oracle）均处于60.4-65.3%，oracle上界表明漂移本身不是良好代理
- 仅动作注意力达81.5%
- 注意力∪惊喜达88.4%
- 加入G=2年龄边界后仅差1.8pp

**CUDA延迟加速**：1.23×（S_v=120）、1.47×（S_v=480）、1.67×（S_v=1080），随视觉上下文增大趋近理论FLOPs上界1.71×。
AI.conclusion: WAM-Cache证明：（1）KV缓存刷新必须遵循策略注意力而非视觉漂移，变化驱动的策略即使有oracle上限也低于dense模型约25pp；（2）通过联合动作专家跨注意力与视觉潜在惊喜并施加严格年龄边界，可实现无训练的陈旧度受限KV复用；（3）32-42%的预填充FLOPs削减在仿真和真实机器人上均仅带来轻微性能损失，且与现有正交加速方法（蒸馏、去噪步数减少、去噪器缓存）兼容。局限在于小视觉token数下固定GPU开销占比大，延迟加速低于FLOPs削减，但随视觉上下文扩大该差距收窄。

title: Learning from Hetero Density for Cryo-EM Protein Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing protein structures from cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) maps is essential for understanding macromolecular assemblies. Although learning-based methods have improved protein reconstruction, information from hetero components remains underused. Our analysis finds both false predictions and reference protein sites near hetero components; filtering nearby candidates can improve or impair chain construction. We introduce CryoCue, a framework that uses hetero information to guide protein reconstruction. An anchor-supervised detector learns hetero representations across five component classes. Multiscale hetero features guide backbone localization, while predicted hetero candidates condition structure refinement through their class, confidence, and frame-relative geometry. Experiments show that CryoCue improves backbone localization near hetero components and achieves more accurate protein structure reconstruction.

AI.tldr: CryoCue 是一个用于冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）蛋白质结构重建的框架，首次系统性地利用了密度图中异质组分（hetero components，如核酸、糖类、配体、脂质等）的信息来辅助蛋白质骨架定位与结构精化。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的冷冻电镜蛋白质重建方法主要依赖蛋白质注释信息，而对同一密度图中普遍存在的异质组分信号利用不足。初步分析发现，异质邻域中同时存在错误预测和真实蛋白质位点，统一的过滤策略可能改善或损害链构建，因此需要选择性地利用异质信息。
AI.method: 提出 CryoCue 框架，包含两个阶段：（1）锚点监督的异质检测器（基于 3D SCUNet + 全局 Transformer），学习 5 类异质组分的统一表示（聚合核酸、糖类、核苷酸/辅因子、其他配体、脂质/去垢剂），其多尺度异质特征通过粗尺度的交叉注意力和细尺度的门控融合引导蛋白质骨架定位；（2）结构精化阶段，预测的异质候选体根据其类别、置信度和相对于蛋白质骨架的帧相对几何条件化蛋白质特征更新，注意力机制动态考虑蛋白质帧与固定候选体之间的几何关系。
AI.result: 在 18420 个 map-structure 对的数据集上，CryoCue 在 TM-score（0.846）、lDDT（0.789）、覆盖率（85.02%）和断裂率（0.69%）上均优于 EMProt、ModelAngelo、EModelX 和 E3-CryoFold 等基线。异质邻域内的蛋白质骨架定位精度和召回率均有显著提升，蛋白质-异质接触的召回率从最好基线的 73.993% 提升到 77.877%。消融实验证明锚点监督和动态帧相对条件化对各组件均至关重要，推理时间与 EMProt 相当且快于 ModelAngelo 和 EModelX。
AI.conclusion: CryoCue 证明异质密度可为冷冻电镜蛋白质重建提供有用的结构上下文，但其贡献取决于局部结构环境。通过锚点监督和帧相对条件化在骨架定位和结构精化中利用异质信息，可以改善结构恢复和链连续性。未来的工作方向包括改进异质预测质量以及在更早阶段引入蛋白质序列信息。

title: Beyond Distributional Fidelity: Causal-Penalized Diffusion for Synthetic Tabular Data
summary: Synthetic tabular generators are commonly optimized for distributional fidelity, but statistical similarity alone does not guarantee preservation of causal effects. In this paper, we study whether causal fidelity can be improved directly within a fully generative tabular model. Causal Fidelity is defined with respect to a target estimand as the discrepancy between inferential distributions obtained from real and synthetic data, and theoretical results show that high statistical fidelity does not generally imply high causal fidelity. We then propose a causal-fidelity-aware training framework which adds a causal discrepancy penalty to the generative objective. The framework is instantiated with a causal-penalized TabDDPM and optimized using an on-policy score-function estimator. We further establish conditions under which causal regularization improves expected causal fidelity. Experiments across diverse treatment-effect simulations and two benchmark datasets evaluate the ability of our method to improve causal fidelity while preserving competitive statistical fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文针对合成表格数据生成中分布保真度高但因果效应难以保留的问题，提出在TabDDPM训练目标中引入因果差异惩罚项，使用评分函数估计器进行在线策略优化，并通过理论分析证明因果正则化可严格改善因果保真度。实验在多种治疗效应模拟场景及IHDP和IST两个真实基准数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有合成表格数据生成器主要优化分布保真度，但统计相似性并不能保证因果效应（特别是ATE）的保留。不同生成器（CTGAN、TVAE、TabDDPM）在保留ATE后验方面差异显著，因此需要将因果保真度直接纳入生成目标。
AI.method: 1. 形式化定义因果保真度为目标因果估计量的推理分布在真实数据与合成数据间的差异（如Wasserstein距离）；2. 在标准生成损失上添加因果差异惩罚项，形成正则化目标；3. 采用评分函数估计器对离散采样过程进行在线策略梯度优化，无需因果算子可微；4. 具体实例化为带因果惩罚的TabDDPM，通过在反向扩散轨迹空间上展开，使评分函数可分解计算；5. 使用移动平均基线降低方差，并对因果梯度进行自适应幅度约束。
AI.result: 在三种模拟场景（线性、非线性、异质性处理效应）中，因果惩罚TabDDPM在所有因果保真度指标上一致优于vanilla TabDDPM。在IHDP数据集上ATE后验Wasserstein距离降低27.3%、后验均值差降低30.4%；在IST数据集上分别降低22.7%和24.5%，同时分布保真度仅有微小变化。
AI.conclusion: 本文形式化了因果保真度概念，理论证明高分布保真度不能保证ATE保留，并提出一种将因果差异惩罚直接整合进生成模型训练的通用框架。该框架在保持分布保真度竞争力的同时显著改善因果保真度，可推广至更广泛因果估计量和其他生成模型类别。

title: MC-TRCM: Observation-Aware Recursive Fusion for Incomplete Mobile and Wearable Mental-Health Feature Views
comment: Accepted to ICONIP 2026. Code is available at this https URL
summary: Public mobile and wearable mental-health datasets often provide summarized feature tables rather than synchronized raw sensor streams. In these releases, each anchor corresponds to a survey or label time and may combine phone or wearable summaries, prior symptom scores, demographics, clinical variables, and source-availability indicators. We propose the Modality-Conditioned Temporal Recursive Context Model (MC-TRCM), which preserves each feature source as a separate token and incorporates missingness as part of the input context. Observed sources are encoded with values and missingness summaries, absent sources use learned absence tokens, dataset and task embeddings condition fusion, and a recursive prediction head refines each output over validation-selected steps. We evaluated MC-TRCM on six predefined endpoints from DepreST-CAT and Prediction of Severity Change-Depression (PSYCHE-D) using participant-level splits and validation-only model selection. MC-TRCM achieved the lowest mean absolute error on DepreST-CAT Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) and Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7 (GAD-7) severity, improving over the best tabular reference by 0.181 and 0.217 scale points. Classification endpoints showed task-dependent behavior: MC-TRCM matched the best rounded GAD-7 category balanced accuracy, was numerically highest by 0.002 balanced-accuracy points on PSYCHE-D multiclass prediction, and remained close to the strongest references on PHQ-9 category and PSYCHE-D binary prediction. Ablations support Feature-wise Linear Modulation, absence tokens, missingness projections, and recursive refinement, while calibration and feature-source controls characterize endpoint behavior. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MC-TRCM是针对移动和可穿戴心理健康数据集中不完全特征视图的观察感知递归融合模型，通过源标记化、缺失性感知的FiLM条件融合和递归解码在DepreST-CAT和PSYCHE-D基准上实现最优的严重度估计性能。
AI.motivation: 公共移动和可穿戴心理健康数据集通常发布汇总特征表而非同步原始传感器流，导致特征视图不完整且缺失模式本身具有信息性。传统方法使用平坦拼接或先验插补，未能保留源身份和可用性模式信息，限制了模型对跨数据集、跨任务异构性的建模能力。
AI.method: MC-TRCM将每个特征源编码为独立标记，结合观察值、缺失性摘要和源身份嵌入；缺失源使用学习的缺失标记；通过数据集和任务嵌入进行FiLM条件化Transformer融合；递归预测头在验证选择的步数上迭代优化输出。训练采用PCGrad处理多任务梯度冲突，损失在递归步骤上以递增权重累积。
AI.result: 在DepreST-CAT的PHQ-9和GAD-7严重度估计上MAE分别比最佳表格参考降低0.181和0.217个量表点；在GAD-7类别平衡准确率上匹配最佳参考，在PSYCHE-D多分类上以0.002 BA数值最高；消融实验验证了FiLM条件化、缺失标记、缺失性投影和递归细化的贡献。
AI.conclusion: MC-TRCM为异构移动和可穿戴心理健康特征视图提供了结构化的观察感知架构，在严重度估计上表现最优，分类性能呈任务依赖性；特征源对照分析表明症状和临床上下文贡献了重要信号，被动传感和缺失性视图贡献了端点依赖的补充信息。

title: Cognition-Oriented Emotion Tracing from Causes to Consequences in Real-World Social Scenes
summary: Affective computing has progressed from categorical emotion recognition to open-ended affective analysis with large multimodal models. Yet affective science describes emotion as an unfolding process shaped by appraisal, regulation, and social interpretation, which remains underexplored computationally. We propose TRACE, a cognition-oriented framework that formalizes an affective episode through three interrelated stages: Condition, Affect, and Effect, integrating observable cues with cognitive factors such as internal stance and regulation of emotional display. Based on this formulation, TRACE-Bench evaluates multimodal models in real-world social scenes through five tasks spanning grounded affect recognition, regulation decoding, cause reasoning, effect reasoning, and full-chain reconstruction, with 3,746 structured question-answer pairs over 646 videos. A matched human-model comparison reveals a substantial performance gap, while affect-specialized models also generally lag behind general-purpose MLLMs. Model outputs show recurring failures, including treating displayed behavior as genuine feeling and fabricating unsupported events during long-chain generation. We further propose TRACER, a cognition-grounded structured reasoning method that couples each inference with explicit premises from factual observations, cognitive appraisals, and established upstream conclusions, forming a traceable graph of intermediate and target conclusions. TRACER outperforms all evaluated model baselines on each of the five tasks. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE框架，将情感事件建模为"条件-情感-效应"三阶段认知过程，并构建TRACE-Bench基准（646视频，3746问答对）评估多模态大模型在5个任务上的全链条情感推理能力，同时提出TRACER方法通过显式事实观察与认知评估的预声明推理显著优于所有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有情感计算多停留在表层观察层面，将情感视为可观察信号的直接输出，而忽略了情感产生过程中认知机制（如主观评估、情绪调节、社会信息传播）的作用。缺乏对情感全链条（原因→情感→后果）的统一计算建模与评估框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出Affective Blueprint：基于认知评估理论、情绪调节理论和情感社会信息理论(EASI)，将主体中心的情感事件形式化为Condition(外部现实+内在驱动)→Affect(状态+表现+调节)→Effect(心理+情感+行为)三阶段因果链。2) 构建TRACE-Bench：5个任务（基础情感识别、调节解码、原因推理、效应推理、全链重建），3746个结构化问答对。3) 提出TRACER方法：三阶段推理流程——事实观察提取→主体中心认知评估（相关性、蕴含、应对潜力、规范意义四个维度）→蓝图引导的预声明结构化推导（RT+PDD），每步引用观察、评估或上游结论作为前提，形成可追溯的推理图。
AI.result: TRACER在5个任务上均显著超越所有基线模型（p<0.05，Holm校正），平均超过GPT-5(thinking) 5.80分（95% CI 4.42-7.17），最大提升在调节解码(+7.97)和原因诊断(+7.44)。全链重建中事实捏造率从11.0%降至4.7%。人类与TRACER平均差距15.57分（T3仅差1.16分）。情感专用模型整体落后于通用MLLM。消融实验证实事实观察记录、认知评估记录、推理拓扑和预声明推导均为必要组件。
AI.conclusion: 认知机制在情感建模与评估中应受到更多关注。TRACER通过将推理锚定于事实观察和主体特异性认知评估，有效解决了"表面阅读"（将表现误认为感受）和"事实漂移"（在长链生成中捏造事件）两大失败模式，为下一代情感应用（共情对话、社交机器人、心理健康支持）提供了认知基础的技术路径。

title: Refinement as a Service: Algorithmic Predictor Refinement
comment: A more compact version of the paper has been accepted by NeurIPS 2026
summary: Prediction aggregation aims to combine information from multiple predictors into a more informative one. We study this question in the setting of calibrated predictors, where each prediction must equal the conditional expectation of the quantity being predicted given the predictor's signal. Given several calibrated input predictors and the feature distribution, but not the underlying Bayes probabilities, we ask when one can construct refined calibrated predictors that preserve the information in the original predictors and cannot be further refined using the available information. We formulate calibrated predictors as signaling schemes and define refinement through feature-independent garblings: a predictor refines another if its signal can simulate the other's signal. Constructibility is characterized through observable linear information: each signal corresponds to a vector over the feature space, and a new signal is constructible exactly when its vector lies in the linear span of the input signal vectors. Under this formulation, we establish a sharp algorithmic picture. For deterministic output predictors, bilateral refinement admits a polynomial-time algorithm based on a bipartite graph between the two input signal partitions, while refinement with an arbitrary number of input predictors is $\mathsf{NP}$-hard. In contrast, when randomized output predictors are allowed, we give a polynomial-time algorithm for any number of input predictors by decomposing constructible signal vectors into extreme rays of the associated polyhedral cone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究校准预测器的精化问题：在仅已知特征分布和若干信号级校准预测器、不知道底层贝叶斯概率的情况下，何时可以构造无法进一步精化的精化预测器。通过将校准预测器形式化为信号方案并引入"可观测线性信息"框架，作者建立了确定性输出的双边精化有多项式时间算法、多边精化NP难、而允许随机化输出时任意数量输入均有多项式时间算法的清晰算法图景。
AI.motivation: 预测聚合（结合多个预测器信息以获得更丰富的预测）是机器学习集成方法、在线学习专家建议、众包投票及LLM混合专家架构等众多领域的核心思想。本文聚焦于其中尚未被充分研究的"校准预测器精化"子问题：在信号级校准约束下，仅利用特征分布和输入预测器携带的可观测信息，能否构造既保留又超出原始预测器信息的精化预测器。这一问题在点击率预测、医疗诊断等需要严格校准保证的场景中具有直接应用价值。
AI.method: 将校准预测器抽象为信号方案，通过"向量袋"表示（每个信号对应特征空间上的一个非负向量，向量和为全一向量）。精化关系通过特征无关扰动（feature-independent garbling）定义：一个预测器精化另一个当且仅当后者的信号可由前者的信号通过不依赖特征的后处理模拟。构造性通过"可观测线性信息"刻画：信号向量必须属于所有输入信号向量张成的行空间。对确定性预测器双边情形，利用两个信号划分之间的重叠二部图及割点分解得到多项式算法；多方情形通过从精确覆盖问题（X3C3）归约证明NP难。对随机化预测器，将问题转化为将信号向量分解为多面体锥ℳ=Row(M)∩ℝⁿ₊的极端射线，通过支撑极小化问题和LP可行性测试实现多项式时间分解。
AI.result: 建立了关于校准预测器精化问题的清晰算法分类：(1) 确定性输出的双边精化(k=2)有多项式时间算法，基于输入信号划分间的重叠二部图的割点结构；构造每个信号格为各连通分支的"分支片"，得到最细可构造确定性精化；(2) 确定性输出的多边精化(k为任意)被证明NP难，通过从精确3覆盖问题(X3C3)的归约，利用行空间结构精确对应关联矩阵的精确覆盖可行性；(3) 允许随机化输出时，对任意数量的输入预测器均存在多项式时间算法，核心思想是将每个输入向量分解为构造性信号锥的极端射线之有限和，极端射线通过迭代LP可行性测试寻找支撑极小向量得到；(4) 极端射线分解具有支撑严格收缩特性，保证迭代次数以n为界。
AI.conclusion: 本文刻画了校准预测器精化问题的精确算法边界。确定性vs随机化输出的选择决定了问题的计算复杂度——确定性情形存在双边易、多边难的二分现象，而随机化将所有情形统一为多项式可解。极端射线分解为信息论精化提供了几何视角：构造性信号锥的极端方向恰是信息不可再分的"原子信号"。该框架还自然引出"精化即服务"的应用模式：平台或智能体可借助算法在保护专有领域知识的同时获得更丰富的预测信息，无需访问底层贝叶斯概率。

title: Rewiring Semantics, Dynamics, and Control: A Simple yet Effective Action-Centric Tri-Stream Transformer
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a prominent framework for complex robotic manipulation, building on the strong semantic understanding of pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, such VLM backbones offer insufficient physical dynamics priors, which limits the generalization capabilities of robot policies. Recent efforts therefore integrate video-generation World Models (WMs) into robot policies through various strategies, using predictive dynamics to facilitate action generation. Despite these advances, harnessing semantic understanding and dynamics prediction as complementary guidance for action generation remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce $\mathrm{ACT}^3$, a simple yet effective Action-Centric Tri-Stream Transformer that fuses semantic and dynamics information into control actions while preserving the distinct roles of context streams. Specifically, $\mathrm{ACT}^3$ enables the dedicated action expert to access VLM and WM representations through layerwise attention, with each backbone attending only within its own stream. This straightforward interaction design maintains independent forward propagation in the context streams while allowing both backbones to be updated through control supervision. Experiments on both simulated and real-world robotic manipulation benchmarks show that the proposed $\mathrm{ACT}^3$ yields results superior to its counterparts.

AI.tldr: ACT³提出了一种动作中心的三流Transformer架构，用于机器人操作任务。该架构将VLM（语义理解）、WM（动力学预测）和动作专家三个独立的Transformer流结合，其中动作专家作为唯一的集成接口，通过层级注意力访问语义和动力学信息，而两个上下文流保持独立的前向传播。
AI.motivation: 现有的Vision-Language-Action (VLA)模型基于预训练VLM构建，具有强大的语义理解能力但缺乏物理动力学先验；而World Models (WMs)擅长动力学预测但可能牺牲语义推理能力。先前的工作难以有效结合这两种互补信息，且现有多流架构通常引入不必要的跨流耦合，可能干扰控制性能。
AI.method: ACT³采用Mixture-of-Transformers架构，包含三个独立流：语义流（来自π₀.₅的VLM）、动力学流（来自Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B视频生成模型）和动作流。核心设计是：每个上下文流仅在自身流内进行注意力计算，而动作查询通过层级注意力访问两个上下文流的K/V值。通过块注意力掩码实现非对称信息流：动作专家是唯一的集成点，联合优化动作生成和动力学预测损失（λ_D=1），两个上下文骨干都可通过动作监督进行更新。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa 24个厨房任务上达到71.2%成功率（vs π₀.₅基线59.4%）；在LIBERO四个套件上平均98.6%成功率（vs π₀.₅ 96.9%）；在LIBERO-Plus分布外测试中达到82.4%成功率（vs π₀.₅ 68.4%）；在三个真实世界任务（碗堆叠、积木收集、花艺布置）上分别达到90.0%、86.7%和63.3%成功率。消融实验验证了层级注意力、生成式未来上下文、动力学预测监督以及联合适应上下文骨干的重要性。
AI.conclusion: ACT³验证了一个简单而有效的设计原则：全局任务语义和局部预测动力学可以通过动作生成有效结合，无需直接耦合两个上下文流。这种动作中心的设计保持了上下文表示的独立性，同时允许其通过控制目标进行端到端优化，为融合VLM和WM提供了新思路。未来工作将扩展该设计到导航等其他具身任务。

title: Missing Modality-Aware Calibration for Trustworthy Brain Tumor Segmentation
summary: Multimodal brain tumor segmentation typically leverages multiple MRI modalities, yet incomplete modality acquisition is common in clinical practice due to protocol heterogeneity and scan failures. Although recent methods maintain segmentation accuracy under missing modality conditions, they frequently overlook prediction reliability, leading to miscalibrated confidence estimates that hinder clinical adoption. Existing calibration techniques are largely modality-agnostic or assume that prediction difficulty decreases monotonically as additional modalities become available. However, in brain tumor segmentation, prediction difficulty depends primarily on which modalities are absent rather than how many, leading to combination-specific and spatially heterogeneous calibration errors. To address this, we propose Missing Modality-Aware Local Temperature Scaling (MMA-LTS), a post-hoc voxel-wise confidence calibration method. It estimates a spatially adaptive temperature field conditioned on a modality-availability learnable token and a voxel-wise difficulty score. Experiments on BraTS 2020 and FeTS 2024 show that MMA-LTS improves calibration while preserving the segmentation accuracy of state-of-the-art models across diverse missing-modality scenarios, thereby enhancing trustworthiness toward clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MMA-LTS（Missing Modality-Aware Local Temperature Scaling），一种针对多模态脑肿瘤分割的后置体素级置信度校准方法。它通过模态可用性可学习token和体素级难度分数估计空间自适应温度场，解决缺失模态下分割模型预测可靠性差、校准误差随模态组合和空间位置异质的问题，在BraTS 2020和FeTS 2024数据集上显著降低ECE同时保持分割精度。
AI.motivation: 多模态脑肿瘤分割中，临床常因协议差异和扫描失败出现模态缺失。现有方法虽在缺失模态下保持分割精度，但忽视预测可靠性，导致置信度校准失准，阻碍临床应用。传统校准方法假设难度随模态数量单调变化，但脑肿瘤分割中预测难度取决于缺失哪种模态而非缺失多少，造成组合特异性和空间异质性的校准误差。
AI.method: 提出MMA-LTS方法，包含四个核心组件：(1) 空间编码器提取联合表征的空间嵌入；(2) 基于Mahalanobis距离扩展的体素级难度分数（VDS），通过类别条件与全局条件距离之差衡量分类困难度；(3) 模态可用性可学习token，通过可用/缺失状态嵌入编码样本级模态配置；(4) 温度估计器，结合VDS门控（决定何处需强校准）和FiLM仿射调制（决定校准强度）生成体素级温度场，对logits进行温度缩放。采用NLL损失优化，ModDrop训练增强鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在BraTS 2020和FeTS 2024数据集上，基于DC-Seg、RobustSeg、mmFormer三种骨干模型，对比mL1-ACE、SDC、MC、TS、DirS、LTS、SelS等基线方法。MMA-LTS在绝大多数15种模态组合和三个肿瘤子区域（WT/TC/ET）上达到最低ECE，例如BraTS 2020上WT/TC/ET平均ECE降至10.2/14.5/15.1，优于次优LTS（13.1/16.8/16.5），且不损失DSC。消融实验验证VDS和模态token的必要性，敏感性分析显示对超参和验证集大小鲁棒。推理时间与温度缩放方法相当，训练成本远低于重训练方法。
AI.conclusion: MMA-LTS是一种即插即用的后置校准方法，通过模态感知和空间难度门控有效校正缺失模态下组合特异性和空间异质性的置信度失准，无需重训练分割模型，在多个数据集和骨干网络上实现一致的ECE降低，推动脑肿瘤分割模型的临床可信部署。未来工作将扩展至其他解剖领域、引入ECE以外的可靠性指标并进行临床验证。

title: Causal-fate dynamics of unrealized influence
comment: 39 pages (20-page main text and 19-page Supplementary Information), 6 figures, 14 supplementary tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Many dynamical systems generate influences whose consequences are not fully exhausted in the realized trajectory at the moment they arise. Such consequences are often treated as absent, delayed or statically stored, leaving unclear how unrealized influence retains future relevance as the system evolves. Here we formulate causal-fate dynamics, in which generated influence may be realized, remain latent, or be transformed by subsequent dynamics, and give an exact finite-transport representation when the relevant maps are specified. A connectome-constrained Caenorhabditis elegans model first motivates the biological hypothesis that unresolved inter-neuronal influence may persist and contribute to later propagation; it does not establish such a mechanism in living animals. We next examine operational Internet routing, where a dynamically updated cross-observer history retains predictive information beyond the current local route state. We then use the representation to construct a Transformer architecture that explicitly transports and selectively realizes latent contextual influence while retaining language-modeling function. The three studies distinguish a model-motivated scientific hypothesis, an observational phenomenon compatible with future-relevant history and an executable construction for carrying unrealized influence through subsequent computation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"因果命运动力学"（causal-fate dynamics）框架，用于刻画动态系统中已生成但尚未在已实现轨迹中完全释放的影响如何在系统中持续保持未来相关性，并给出了精确的有限传输表示。论文通过三个互补研究验证该框架：秀丽隐杆线虫神经模型（提出生物学假设）、BGP路由观测（验证观测相容性）、以及基于Transformer的可执行架构（验证架构可行性）。
AI.motivation: 传统动态系统描述基于"已实现状态"（realized-state）视角，假设当前已实现状态包含了过去所有仍能影响未来的后果。然而许多系统（受网络约束、选择性交互、激活障碍、竞争目标、分布式协调等影响）并不满足这一条件——生成的影响可能被部分表达、重分配、转换、抵消或吸收，其未完成的后果可能以不同形式重新进入已实现轨迹，甚至永远不进入。因此需要一种形式化框架来刻画"未实现影响"如何保持未来相关性。
AI.method: 论文构建了因果命运动力学的形式化表示，核心要素包括：(1) 生成（generation）、实现（realization）、潜在性（latency）、传输（transport）和转换（transformation）五个基本操作；(2) 引入潜影响状态ξ_t表示已生成但未进入已实现轨迹的影响；(3) 定义完全实现参考轨迹x_t^F作为反事实比较器；(4) 在加性坐标下证明完全表示态z_t = x_t + ξ̄_t精确遵循完全实现映射的演化（Eq. 14）；(5) 当完全实现映射为仿射时，有限传输具有精确且状态无关的形式M_t ξ̄_t（Eq. 19）。三个实验分别是：基于188个神经元秀丽线虫头部网络的分级电位模型、基于RouteViews Chile和RIPE RIS rrc06的BGP路由数据（2025-07-06全天）、以及基于SmolLM2-135M的30层Transformer在WikiText-2上的实现。
AI.result: (1) 秀丽线虫神经模型：在局部自主（local-autonomy）动力学下，相对传播误差为1（完全失败）；而冻结的选择性实现轨迹保留了主要传播结构，相对误差仅3.51%，Pearson相关系数r>0.99，符号完全一致。这表明选择性实现能保存神经传播结构，并支持"未解决的神经元间影响可能由分布式物理过程承载"的假设。(2) BGP路由分析：五事件有序未匹配前沿表示相比强当前态模型，Logistic回归获得1.97%相对对数损失增益（95%区间[0.23%, 3.37%]），HistGradientBoosting获得9.54%增益（区间[7.18%, 11.45%]）。含时序内容在部分比较中优于无序内容，但优势并非在所有比较中一致。(3) Transformer架构：完全实现Transformer困惑度38.65；移除跨token影响后升至1315.24（表明跨token影响对语言建模不可或缺）；选择性实现Transformer困惑度39.91（仅高3.27%），实现了88.40%的token-层影响机会，每个token平均在30层中26.52层实现影响，每层至少有一个token实现跨token影响。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了因果命运动力学作为刻画"未完成影响"的精确形式化框架，其有限传输表示在加性坐标下可给出精确闭合。该框架在三个层面得到不同性质的证据支持：神经模型提供了模型驱动的科学假设（非生物机制确证），BGP路由提供了与未来相关历史相容的观测现象（未验证加性有限传输方程），Transformer提供了直接实现该表示的可执行架构（验证架构可行性而非计算效率）。三者共同表明因果命运动力学可用于表述关于未完成影响的假设、检验其预测特征，并设计携带和选择性实现上下文影响的系统。该框架的意义不在于声称普遍物理机制，而在于提供一种统一的数学语言来处理"已生成但尚未耗尽的因果后果"这一类动力学现象。

title: Policy Alignment: New Signals for Membership Auditing in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model by aligning its policy with a teacher model on trajectories generated by the student model itself. Through this process, the student policy moves toward the teacher on the prompts used for distillation. However, these prompts are often private and costly, creating a need for prompt-level membership auditing. Existing methods mainly rely on likelihood-based confidence signals or student policy drift between checkpoints, but they do not capture the teacher-induced direction of the student update. In this paper, we propose Policy Alignment Membership Auditing (PAMA), a new auditing framework tailored for OPD. Our key observation is that a member prompt directly contributes to the teacher-guided policy update, while a non-member prompt only experiences indirect effects through cross-prompt generalization. Based on this directional trace, PAMA measures whether the student update moves toward reducing the teacher loss on a candidate prompt. Specifically, we introduce Teacher Alignment Gain (TAG) to estimate the teacher-aligned update direction from model outputs, and further combine it with student drift and uncertainty alignment signals for reliable membership auditing. We evaluate PAMA on six datasets and three teacher-student model families. On MATH, the primary evaluation benchmark, PAMA achieves AUC values of 0.791--0.941, improving AUC by 14.6--20.6% over state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文针对On-Policy Distillation (OPD) 提出了一种新的成员审计框架 PAMA（Policy Alignment Membership Auditing），通过捕捉教师引导的策略对齐信号来判断候选prompt是否被用于蒸馏训练，在MATH等数据集上AUC提升14.6–20.6%。
AI.motivation: OPD训练中使用的提示（prompts）往往是私有的、敏感的、昂贵的，泄露会造成知识产权和资源损失。现有成员审计方法（基于似然置信度或checkpoint间的策略漂移）要么不适用于OPD中自生成的轨迹，要么只衡量"学生变化了多少"而忽略了"学生朝哪个方向移动"，无法捕捉教师引导的更新方向这一关键信号。
AI.method: 核心观察：成员prompt直接参与教师引导的策略更新，使学生策略朝降低该prompt上教师损失的方向移动；非成员prompt仅通过跨prompt泛化间接受影响。基于此提出PAMA框架，包含三类新信号：(1) Teacher Alignment Gain (TAG) — 通过微积分基本定理，用蒸馏前后教师KL散度的端点差估计教师对齐的更新方向，无需梯度访问；(2) Teacher-Aligned Entropy Gain (TAEG) — 度量师生不确定性差距的缩减；(3) Student Drift (SD) — 衡量checkpoint间策略变化幅度。结合校准的Zlib、Min-K置信度特征，输入逻辑回归分类器。在Full-distribution和Top-K两种教师访问设置下均可工作。
AI.result: 在6个数据集（MATH、MBPP、MMLU-Pro、BigCodeBench、MulDimIF、Toy-add）和3对教师-学生模型家族（Qwen2.5、InternLM2.5、Gemma-3）上评估。在主基准MATH上，PAMA实现AUC 0.791–0.941，相对SOTA基线（DIBA、Min-K、Zlib、Likelihood）AUC提升14.6–20.6%。消融实验表明TAG贡献最大，TAEG进一步补充不确定性信息。Top-K教师访问（K=10）在多数设置下匹配甚至优于Full-distribution访问。跨prompt泛化水平是审计有效性的基本边界：泛化越弱审计越强；泛化强时（MATH）审计接近随机猜测。无真实教师访问时使用同系列替代教师仍可恢复大部分性能。
AI.conclusion: PAMA确立了教师引导的策略对齐作为OPD中一种新的有效成员信号。它仅需对蒸馏前后的学生模型进行前向推理，无需训练梯度或轨迹，在多种数据集、模型家族、OPD目标（reverse-KL、forward-KL、JSD）和教师访问设置下均一致优于现有方法。高概率教师输出包含大部分有用对齐信息，但强跨prompt泛化会削弱成员可区分性，构成审计的基本局限。

title: Why machines will still not rule the world
summary: In our book Why machines will never rule the world [13, 14] we argue that arti- ficial general intelligence is mathematically impossible. This is because the human beings and the processes which exhibit intelligence are complex systems whose be- haviour cannot be captured by the kinds of models that we can generate with or without computers. Proponents of contemporary machine intelligence respond with two lines of argument: a theoretical one, grounded in the universal approximation theorems for neural networks and the Church-Turing-Deutsch principle; and an em- pirical one, grounded in rapidly rising scores on standardized benchmarks. In this communication we examine and reject both responses. First, we show serious issues in the physicalist counter-argument based on the Church-Turing-Deutsch principle. Second, we review recent evidence to the effect that prominent benchmarks are compromised by training-data contamination, flawed test construction, and strate- gic optimization. Our central argument remains: That models required to perform cognitive behaviour in open-ended, thermodynamically complex and non-ergodic environments are not and will not become achievable.

AI.tldr: 本文回应了对"人工智能永远无法统治世界"一书观点的两类反驳：一是基于神经网络万能逼近定理和丘奇-图灵-Deutsch原理的理论反驳，二是基于标准化基准测试得分持续提升的经验反驳。作者坚持其核心主张：在开放、热力学复杂且非遍历的环境中执行认知行为所需的模型不可能实现。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在维护其书中提出的核心论点——人工通用智能（AGI）在数学上是不可能的，并反驳当前主流AI研究界对该论点的两类主要反驳（理论层面的连接主义论证与经验层面的基准测试证据），以应对不断升级的AGI炒作。
AI.method: 论文采用哲学论证与形式化分析相结合的方法：首先区分"逻辑系统"与"复杂系统"，利用遍历性（ergodicity）与非遍历性的测度论定义解释统计学习理论在非遍历过程中的失效；接着批判分析万能逼近定理的三点局限（存在性结果、固定紧凑域、假设目标函数稳定）；再以三段论形式重构并反驳基于丘奇-图灵-Deutsch原理的物理主义论证；最后通过近期审计证据（如SWE-bench验证集的缺陷、Chatbot Arena的失真）说明基准测试违反古德哈特定律。
AI.result: 1）遍历性形式化表明，非遍历性使得部署分布D1与训练分布D0不一致，即使经验风险低也无法保证未来性能，这正是人类智能运作环境的本质特征；2）万能逼近定理是存在性结果，对固定紧凑域上的连续函数成立，无法应对复杂系统的开放与漂移域；3）CTD原理仅保证"原理上可模拟"，但无法提供实际所需的哈密顿量和初始条件，且精确模拟一个大脑只是再现单一轨迹而非建立预测模型；4）经验层面：SWE-bench验证集中59.4%的问题存在设计缺陷，存在数据污染；SWE-bench Pro得分从70%骤降至23%；MMLU-Pro等知识基准存在网络规模污染；Chatbot Arena存在系统偏差；LLM评判者偏向冗长回答；5）这些失败的共同结构是古德哈特定律——基准一旦成为优化目标便不再是好的测量工具。
AI.conclusion: 作者维持其模态且普遍的不可能性主张：AGI不可能实现，因为复杂系统产生非遍历行为，而数学模型（因而计算机）无法捕捉这种行为。理论反驳仅证明了表征能力和原理上的计算充分性，未能证明所需模型实际可获取；经验反驳虽减弱了支持AGI的经验证据，但本身并不构成反对可能性的经验论证。作者认为基于非遍历且持续更新的持出评估体系将最终证明机器无法应对训练材料中不存在的语境。作者还提及其实践智能概念（practical intelligence）作为认知智能的基础层根本无法通过机器配置实现。

title: BioBigBird: A Sparse Attention Model for Long-Range Dependency Processing in Biomedical Text
summary: While domain-specific Large Language Models (LLMs) have encoded vast biomedical knowledge, their limited context windows often hinder a deep understanding of nuanced relationships within and across texts. To address this limitation, we introduce BioBigBird, a bidirectional language model pre-trained on extensive biomedical literature and clinical data, specifically designed to handle long-range dependencies. BioBigBird leverages a sparse attention mechanism to process sequences up to 4096 tokens, and its training incorporates a multi-stage process to mitigate noise from the large-scale pre-training corpus. We further enhance its performance by employing a multi-task learning (MTL) framework that jointly optimizes for Named Entity Recognition and Relation Extraction. Comprehensive evaluations on the BLURB benchmark reveal that our MTL-enhanced BioBigBird achieves highly competitive results against state-of-the-art models. Our work contributes an effective methodology for developing powerful, long-context language models for specialized domains, demonstrating the value of extended sequence processing for complex text analysis. Our models are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: BioBigBird是一个基于BigBird稀疏注意力机制的生物医学领域双向语言模型，通过多阶段预训练和生物医学语料库（PubMed全文+摘要、MIMIC-III）训练，可处理长达4096 tokens的序列；结合多任务学习框架联合优化NER和RE任务，在BLURB基准上取得86.46的平均分，优于PubMedBERT和BioLinkBERT等基线模型，多任务版BioBigBird在多数数据集上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 传统生物医学领域预训练语言模型（如BERT、PubMedBERT）受限于512 tokens的短上下文窗口，无法完整处理全文文章或长临床记录，导致长距离依赖信息丢失；同时现有BioNER和BioRE任务通常针对单一实体或关系类型分别训练，标注数据稀缺且模型泛化能力不足。
AI.method: 采用BigBird稀疏注意力机制（结合全局、滑动、随机注意力），将复杂度从O(n²)降至O(n)，支持4096 tokens序列；多阶段课程式预训练（阶段1：PubMed全文4096 tokens，189万步；阶段2：MIMIC-III+PubMed摘要1024 tokens，137万步；阶段3：PubMed摘要512 tokens，150万步）；细粒度预处理（保留含引言和结论的文献，去重去噪，32K词表）；多任务学习框架联合优化NER和RE任务，共享编码器+任务特定分类头，损失函数L_overall=L_ner+L_re。模型约113M参数，在单块TPU v2-8上训练15天，共处理220亿tokens。
AI.result: 在BLURB基准上，单任务BioBigBird获得86.46的平均分（超过PubMedBERT 81.10和BioLinkBERT Large 84.30），在EBM PICO（94.6 vs 74.19）、GAD（88.93）、DDI（87.33）、HoC文档分类（89.70）等任务上显著领先；多任务BioBigBird（M）几乎在所有数据集上超越SOTA：BC5-chem 95.07、BC5-disease 90.36、NCBI-disease 93.67、BC2GM 91.85、ChemProt 89.38、DDI 93.47、BC4CHEMD 95.01，仅在JNLPBA、LINNAEUS、GAD三个数据集上略逊。
AI.conclusion: BioBigBird验证了稀疏注意力机制结合长序列（4096 tokens）预训练在生物医学NLP中的有效性，多阶段课程训练策略兼具计算效率和性能；多任务学习框架通过共享表示显著提升数据效率和泛化能力，为构建长上下文领域专用语言模型提供了可行路径。模型已公开于HuggingFace。主要局限：4096 tokens预训练可能引入噪声，影响短序列微调效果；模型可能继承训练语料的偏见。

title: An Embodied Multiagent Framework Based on Token Communications for Cooperative ISAC
summary: The emerging low-altitude economy demands unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-enabled integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) for reliable connectivity and environmental awareness. In particular, embodied UAV agents offer a promising means of supporting autonomous operations through a closed loop linking perception, decision-making, and physical actions. However, each UAV has access only to local observations, and effective cooperation requires exchanging local states and intentions. Directly sharing such information can incur substantial signaling overhead and hinder timely coordination in dynamic environments. To deal with this problem, this paper investigates a cooperative ISAC network of embodied UAV agents and formulates a joint token communications (TokCom) and physical control problem to minimize total propulsion energy subject to communication and sensing rate requirements. Then, we propose a state--intent TokCom (SI-TokCom) framework driven by multi-agent embodied policy learning. Specifically, separate pretrained codebooks enable compact exchanges of local states and intentions, while UAV agents jointly learn to select and compose tokens and determine physical actions based on local observations and received tokens. Simulation results show that SI-TokCom achieves 98.9\% and 99.1\% of the centralized baseline's communication and sensing rates, respectively. Compared with the local baseline, it improves the corresponding rates by 5.0\% and 43.6\%, respectively, with essentially unchanged propulsion energy. These results highlight the potential of TokCom for communication-efficient cooperation among embodied UAV agents in ISAC systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对低空经济中多UAV协同ISAC系统,提出了一种基于状态-意图令牌通信(SI-TokCom)的具身多智能体框架,通过离线预训练共享语义码本与在线多智能体策略学习,联合优化令牌选择与物理控制,在极低通信开销下接近集中式基线性能。
AI.motivation: 多UAV协同ISAC中,各UAV仅能获取局部观测,直接共享状态和意图会带来巨大信令开销和传输时延,难以支持动态环境下的实时协调;而现有SemCom仍需传输连续语义表示,计算和存储成本高,缺乏面向具身智能体感知-动作闭环的高效协调机制。
AI.method: 将协同多UAV ISAC建模为Dec-POMDP,提出两阶段SI-TokCom框架:(1)离线预训练分离的S-Token和I-Token共享码本,采用VQ+语义重建+专家动作一致性+码字使用正则化联合损失;(2)在线交替优化,基于MAPPO学习令牌选择/组合及物理动作(轨迹、关联、带宽、功率),通过分数规划+KKT条件推导波束成型的闭式更新,并利用反事实令牌掩码实现令牌级信用分配。
AI.result: 在K=4 UAVs、Nc=8 CUs、Ns=3 STs的仿真中,SI-TokCom以每UAV每时隙仅96比特的协调开销,分别达到集中式基线98.9%的通信速率和99.1%的感知速率;相比本地基线,通信和感知速率分别提升5.0%和43.6%,而推进能耗基本不变;感知QoS满足率(93.89%)最高,SPEB接近集中式。
AI.conclusion: SI-TokCom证明了通过联合学习紧凑令牌消息与物理决策,可在极低通信载荷下实现多UAV ISAC系统的高效去中心化协同,固定语义码本支持跨场景的适应性,未来可推广至更广泛的具身智能体协调任务。

title: Adversarial Cues in Decision Models Used as Judges: The Role of Request Presentation
summary: An answer judge instructed to grade the final commitment should reject an explicitly wrong final value even when an earlier value matches the reference. We show that adding one colon to a candidate can violate this requirement depending on the presentation of the structured judging request. Numeric references certify the error, and paired interventions distinguish the candidate edit from the integration's presentation choices. On 200 previously unused DROP and GSM8K source clusters, the edit increased Jev's false acceptance from 1.0% to 26.0% with three output labels and from 3.0% to 26.5% with the published four-label grading instruction under sorted JSON keys. Both candidate variants were rejected under insertion presentation. These interactions passed the prespecified statistical correction even though Jev met the control thresholds under both grading configurations and presentations. Most excess acceptances occurred among candidates assigned larger numerical errors. GPT-6 Sol produced no observed cue-condition false acceptances, with missing responses unresolved. The result shows that basic judging competence can coexist with sharply different vulnerability to a fixed candidate edit across logically equivalent request presentations. The reference-aware grammar and compound ordering change limit the finding's operational scope and leave its internal cause unmeasured.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了作为评判者的决策模型（Jev）在结构化请求的不同呈现方式下，对同一候选编辑（添加一个冒号）表现出截然不同的漏洞：尽管在所有呈现方式下都通过了基础控制测试，但在排序（sorted）呈现下错误接受率从1-3%飙升至26%，而在插入（insertion）呈现下仍正确拒绝所有候选。GPT-6 Sol未出现此漏洞。核心发现是基础评判能力无法保证对表示相关对抗性漏洞的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 随着决策模型（如Jev-as-a-Judge）被广泛用于答案评估和置信度路由，评估其对候选文本操控的鲁棒性变得至关重要。已有研究关注标点、共享短语等短串攻击以及格式对性能的影响，但候选编辑与请求呈现方式之间的交互作用尚未被系统研究。本研究旨在检验一个明确的最终答案正确性要求下，请求呈现方式是否会影响候选侧编辑的效果。
AI.method: 方法采用配对因子设计：(1) 候选编辑——在源种子的6个随机字母（R）后添加一个冒号（R:），保持最终错误答案不变；(2) 请求呈现方式——插入呈现（保持JSON成员插入顺序）与排序呈现（递归排序对象键）。在200个独立的DROP/GSM8K源集群上，使用Jev的三标签（FINAL3）和四标签（FINAL4）评分配置以及GPT-6 Sol进行前瞻性确认。错误答案相对于可信参考是数值化的且可验证。控制条件包括纯正确、纯错误、仅错误最终答案和有效修订。每个源/配置进行16次调用。统计分析使用预指定的工作负载分层聚类自助法（49,999次抽取）和Holm校正。
AI.result: 核心结果：排序呈现下，添加冒号使Jev的错误接受率从三标签的2/200（1.0%）升至52/200（26.0%），四标签从6/200（3.0%）升至53/200（26.5%）；配对呈现交互为+25.0pp和+23.5pp，Holm调整后p=0.00006。插入呈现下两种条件均被完全拒绝（0/200）。所有配置均通过预定义的控制阈值。GPT-6 Sol在所有条件下均无观察到的错误接受。效果集中在较大数值变异的候选中（far组约+45-48pp，near组仅+2pp）。早期54源初始观察中10/54出现错误接受，80源重复面板中10-10-9-10次接受，16源新试点中6/16接受。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明基础评判能力可以与对固定候选编辑的截然不同漏洞共存，这些漏洞取决于逻辑等价的请求呈现方式。这意味着仅靠控制测试无法暴露表示依赖的对抗性漏洞。评估结构化评判者时应记录实际请求表示，并在集成实际使用的呈现方式下测试候选扰动。局限性包括：参考感知数值语法、源/变异平衡混合、记录的服务窗口，以及递归排序同时改变多个组件无法单独归因。GPT-6 Sol的零错误率和缺失响应的未解决状态留下了模型间比较的不确定性。组件归因和部署普遍性仍是独立的实证问题。

title: MotiveMob: Motivation as Semantic Action for Closed-Loop Human Mobility Generation
summary: Human mobility generation, an important task in urban research, synthesizes trajectory data for urban planning and transportation management. Human mobility can be characterized as a "why-where-when" decision process: people form an intention to move and then determine where and when the corresponding activity will take place. Trajectory generation under user-level and temporal distribution shifts may benefit from explicitly modeling this decision structure. However, many existing human mobility generation methods either represent behavioral intent at a coarse granularity, such as a daily plan or a trajectory-level description, or directly predict future locations without explicitly reasoning about a possible motivation for each movement step. We introduce MotiveMob, a motivation-driven autoregressive framework for human mobility generation that first forms a hypothesis about why the next movement may occur and then jointly generates where and when it may occur. At each step, a motivation predictor conditions on the current mobility state, a long-term behavioral report, and the mobility history to infer a plausible motivation or determine whether the trajectory should terminate. Given the hypothesized motivation, a state predictor grounds it in a candidate next location and arrival time. The candidate then undergoes speed-feasibility and repetition checks before being fed back for the next decision. We evaluate MotiveMob under distribution shifts involving unseen users and unseen temporal periods, including seasonal changes and the substantial behavioral disruption caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. Experiments show that MotiveMob consistently achieves better distributional fidelity than competitive pretraining-based and prompting-based methods under user-level and temporal distribution shifts, demonstrating robust generalization to out-of-distribution mobility patterns.

AI.tldr: MotiveMob提出了一种基于"动机优先"的LLM自回归框架，将人类出行轨迹生成分解为逐步的"为什么-在哪里-什么时候"决策过程。该方法通过动机预测器和状态预测器交替工作，并利用隐式世界建模和替代轨迹增强，在用户级和时间级分布偏移下展现出优于现有预训练和提示型基线方法的分布保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有的人类出行生成方法存在两个局限：一是行为意图建模粒度过粗（如日常计划或轨迹级描述），二是直接预测未来位置而未对每个转移步骤背后的动机进行显式推理。在用户级和时间级分布偏移下，这些方法可能混淆行为上不同的转移，并难以在较长的生成周期内保持一致的活动和时间模式。论文将人类移动建模为"为什么-在哪里-什么时候"的决策过程，认为显式建模这一决策结构有助于在分布偏移下生成更真实的轨迹。
AI.method: 方法核心是一个分两步执行的LLM自回归框架：(1) 动机预测器P_M基于当前移动状态、长期行为报告R_u和近期移动历史H_u,d，预测下一步移动的动机或判断是否终止；(2) 状态预测器P_S将动机作为语义动作，并将其具体化为下一个候选位置和到达时间。状态预测器通过隐式世界建模（IWM）进行训练：针对轨迹数据中只包含已实现转移（缺乏反事实）的挑战，构建替代转移数据增强——对同一状态采样三个替代动机，使用轻量Transformer生成候选下一状态，再由LLM判断器筛选最合理的候选。推理时，速度可行性检查（v_max=50 km/h）和重复感知终止机制作为额外的输出校验层。
AI.result: 在东京和大阪两个城市的Foursquare/Twitter签到数据集上，MotiveMob在所有用户组（已见/未见）和三个时间段（已见期、常规未见期、COVID-19期）的评估中均取得最佳结果，使用四个分布指标（SD、SI、DARD、STVD）的JSD度量。具体而言，在时间-活动分布保真度方面：在三个时间段的平均值上，MotiveMob将DARD较每种设置下最佳基线的发散度在已见用户上降低10.7%、在未见用户上降低18.3%；相比无P_M的变体，这些降低幅度分别为21.6%和29.1%。模型在不同LLM骨干（Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma-4-E4B、Gemma-2-9B）下表现稳定，且在大阪数据集上也保持类似优势。分析表明：动机预测主要改善时间（SI）和活动（DARD）保真度，而IWM训练与替代转移则在未见用户的联合时空泛化（STVD）上带来最明显提升。
AI.conclusion: MotiveMob通过显式建模"为什么"的中间语义层（动机），在分布偏移下显著提升了轨迹生成质量。动机作为语义动作提供了自然的行为抽象层次，IWM机制借助替代转移增强弥补了仅靠已实现转移无法学到反事实动态的缺陷。局限性包括：依赖预定义的动机分类法、替代转移与真实未被观察到的意图之间的对应关系无法直接验证、IWM增强在局部移动几何与全局时空结构之间存在指标特定的权衡。未来工作可探索自适应动机表示、改进保留局部与全局模式的增强策略，以及具有轨迹级反馈或强化学习的层次化序列目标。

title: Closed-loop evaluation of LLM agents for embedded software development
comment: Published in Journal of Systems Architecture 179 (2026) 103937. 23 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Code and artifacts: this https URL
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as coding agents that edit files, run builds and tests, inspect execution results, and repair software iteratively. Embedded firmware is a demanding target because correctness depends on closed-loop behavior under sensing, timing, and safety constraints, not only on static source quality. Yet embedded-agent evaluation remains limited and often emphasizes one-shot synthesis or offline correctness. We present a benchmark for closed-loop evaluation of embedded coding agents. Each task provides a plain-text engineering description, constrained workspace, and visible build-and-runtime surface. The agent must translate requirements into implementation and self-verification steps, then iterate until the required device behavior is achieved. The suite contains five embedded-control tasks and four feedback scenarios: one-shot generation, realistic self-verification, CI-style red/green feedback, and oracle-style detailed feedback. The implementation targets simulated ESP32 firmware for reproducibility. We evaluate seven GPT-family and Qwen-family configurations across five tasks and four scenarios, with three repetitions per condition for 420 runs. gpt-5.4 has the highest pass rate among evaluated configurations but does not saturate the benchmark; qwen3.5-27B is the strongest observed local model; and smaller local models degrade sharply in pass rate and search efficiency. These results suggest that capable local embedded coding agents are emerging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向嵌入式固件开发的LLM编码智能体**闭环评估基准**。该基准基于模拟的ESP32/QEMU环境，包含5个递进难度的嵌入式控制任务（从单传感器阈值控制到多阶段序列控制）和4种反馈场景（一次性生成、自主验证、CI式红绿反馈、神谕式详细反馈）。作者在420次运行（7个模型×5任务×4场景×3次重复）中评估了2个GPT系列托管模型和5个Qwen3.5系列本地模型。结果显示：gpt-5.4在主场景真实自主验证中通过率最高（14/15, 93.3%）但仍未饱和；qwen3.5-27B是最强的本地模型（9/15, 60%），超过了gpt-5.4-mini；较小本地模型在通过率和搜索效率上急剧下降，2B模型完全失败。基准表明具备能力的本地嵌入式编码智能体正在崛起，并揭示了不同模型对反馈信号的依赖程度差异。
AI.motivation: 现有的嵌入式编码智能体评估主要侧重于一次性代码合成或离线正确性，无法捕捉固件在传感、时序、安全约束下的闭环行为。嵌入式固件正确性不仅取决于源代码质量，更取决于与硬件设备的动态闭环交互，仓库级问题解决基准未能覆盖这一硬件闭环特性。因此需要一个从纯文本规范出发、要求智能体通过迭代构建自身验证回路并最终实现行为级正确的基准。
AI.method: 方法包含四部分：（1）基准设计：基于契约对齐的任务包（plain-text工程简报）、受限工作区、可见的构建/测试/运行时工具接口；（2）5个任务的难度阶梯——tank_fill_drain（基线阈值）、thermal_chamber_hysteresis（滞后/预判控制）、pressure_vessel_interlock（双传感器互锁）、mixing_tank_fill_heat（多传感器耦合）、filter_tank_sequence（时序序列控制与扰动恢复）；（3）4种反馈场景——oneshot_blind、realistic_self_verify（主场景）、ci_red_green、oracle_full；（4）参考实现——基于ESP32固件在QEMU中运行，通过UART协议与Python确定性工厂模型对接。评估指标包括：结果标签（PASS/HOST/INT/NONE）、通过率（Wilson 95%置信区间）、token总量、工具调用次数、自测试运行数、首次提交时间。
AI.result: 主要结果：在realistic_self_verify场景下，gpt-5.4通过率14/15（93.3%）；qwen3.5-27B为本地最强，9/15（60.0%），略超gpt-5.4-mini的8/15（53.3%）；gpt-5.4-mini在ci_red_green场景下表现最佳；较弱本地模型（35B-A3B、9B、4B）对反馈可见性高度敏感，例如35B-A3B在realistic_self_verify仅4/15但在oracle_full下达到10/15；qwen3.5-2B所有60次运行均零通过，主要因无法产出提交。共享硬件（RTX 4090，GGUF 4-bit）本地分析显示：27B密集模型为最佳本地操作点（38/60, 63.3%）；35B-A3B MoE模型首次提交更快但能力更弱；小模型出现"非受控搜索"现象——token需求随模型缩小反向激增。任务区分度方面，filter_tank_sequence是关键分离任务（仅gpt-5.4通过），tank_fill_drain为基准锚点任务。
AI.conclusion: 闭环嵌入式智能体评估应被视为独立于静态代码生成的基准问题。相对于前沿性能的主要科学鸿沟是稳健的自主自验证能力——即生成本地证据、正确解读并仅在控制器真正就绪时停止。本研究表明：（1）该基准可执行且具有模型区分力；（2）本地开源权重智能体（特别是27B级）已具备实际部署意义；（3）反馈可见性是诊断维度而非简单难度旋钮；（4）部署决策需考虑吞吐量与有效能力的权衡，模型大小并非效率代理指标。局限包括基于确定性模拟、单ESP32/QEMU栈、UART虚拟化I/O、五任务以控制为中心，未来工作将扩展至硬件在环、真实设备评估以及更丰富的故障管理与扰动场景。

title: Tracing the Thoughts of a Coding Agent Playing ARC-AGI-3: Lessons for Continual Learning
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents (CL4FMAgents)
summary: We study how a coding agent learns across a sequence of abstract reasoning tasks. The agent runs on a frozen foundation model inside a fixed harness and acts by writing and running Python and shell scripts. It retains no state across turns other than its written artifacts, so every thought it forms, carries, corrects or abandons leaves a trace, where a thought is any belief, rule or plan committed to a file. We let the agent play ARC-AGI-3, a set of interactive reasoning games that provide no instructions. Each game is a sequence of levels, and a strategy that clears one level can fail on the next, so every new level is in effect a new task. The agent records what it learns as Python scripts and text notes, while the harness keeps a complete log of every action and observation. Our contribution is a measurement protocol that traces each thought through these files, from the task where it forms to the task where it is corrected or abandoned, applied to seven evaluation runs with three backbones from two model families. Scripts written for one task are almost never called again in a later task (33 of 630 references cross a task boundary), because most scripts embed the state of the current level. Instead, the agent rewrites its knowledge into new scripts, keeping the general rules and dropping the level-specific details, and abandons 74% of the scripts it wrote before a boundary. The notes, which only the model reads, are never revised: the agent appends without removing earlier claims, and the contradictions that accumulate are settled against the log. Because the log preserves everything, the agent forgets selectively, not catastrophically. The most costly error is a hard-coded value carried into a task where it no longer holds. These findings come from the files the agent wrote, without access to the model, and constitute a white-box analysis of how a coding agent continually learns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个基于冻结基础模型的编码智能体在ARC-AGI-3推理游戏中如何跨任务持续学习，提出了一套白盒测量协议，通过追踪智能体写入文件（Python脚本和文本笔记）的"思想痕迹"来分析其记忆更新机制，发现其采用"重写而非引用"的隔离策略进行跨任务知识迁移。
AI.motivation: 传统持续学习研究关注参数模型的稳定性-可塑性权衡，而基于冻结基础模型的智能体无需更新权重，其知识完全存储在文件系统中。本文旨在研究这种智能体如何决定知识的存放位置、如何在任务变化时处理已有知识，以及如何在不发生灾难性遗忘的情况下完成跨任务学习。
AI.method: 1) 构建基于PRO-LONG框架的编码智能体，记忆完全驻留在目录文件中；2) 使用ARC-AGI-3作为评估平台，将每个关卡视为一个独立任务；3) 设计测量协议：将每个脚本分配到其写入时开放的任务，统计脚本在任务边界后被重用（引用/复制）、重写或废弃的比例；4) 在7次评估运行中使用3个来自2个模型家族的骨干网络进行分析；5) 通过分析脚本和笔记的文本内容进行白盒分析，无需访问模型内部。
AI.result: 1) 重写是主要跨任务机制：2,319个边界前脚本中，523个被重写，1,726个(74%)被废弃；2) 跨任务引用重用极少：630次脚本引用中仅33次跨任务边界；3) 新版本通过重新输入而非扩展实现，丢弃旧版56-74%的函数；4) 笔记只增不减，矛盾通过追加而非删除解决；5) 最大的失败模式是陈旧记忆导致的负迁移（将一个任务中成立的硬编码常量带入下一个任务），有效修复方式是将常量转为参数；6) 所有骨干网络都采用"隔离"策略，差异仅在于分区键的选择。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体的持续学习通过选择性遗忘而非灾难性遗忘实现：智能体仅丢弃信念而非证据，错误处理仅需重新推导而不会丧失能力。日志保留了所有交互记录，使智能体可自由丢弃脚本。最严重的错误是跨任务携带的硬编码值，修复方法是将其参数化。该研究表明，基于文件系统的智能体记忆使持续学习过程完全透明可追溯。

title: SAIL: Scientific Agentic Intelligence via a Science-Aware Loop
summary: We introduce SAIL, an open model with 35B total and 3B active parameters for literature research, scientific coding, and multi-step research workflows. SAIL is developed through a science-aware improvement loop: agents built on frontier AI models analyze its task failures and construct training tasks that address the underlying capability gaps. The diagnosis examines search and evidence selection in literature tasks, scientific assumptions and reasoning in coding, and planning and revision in longer investigations. The agents draw on paper collections and scientific code repositories to build problems, interaction trajectories, and executable tasks with the required environments and tools. We repeat this loop over multiple development cycles and train SAIL through supervised fine-tuning, specialist training, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and agentic reinforcement learning. SAIL achieves competitive performance across scientific research tasks with substantially fewer parameters than leading open-weight models.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍SAIL（Scientific Agentic Intelligence via a Science-Aware Loop），一个具有350亿总参数、30亿激活参数的开源科学智能模型，专为文献检索、科研编程和多步研究工作流设计。其核心创新在于采用"科学感知改进循环"，由前沿AI模型驱动的智能体诊断任务失败原因，并基于科研论文与代码库构建针对性训练任务。SAIL在多项科学基准测试中以较少参数取得了与更大开放权重模型相竞争的性能。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型被广泛应用于科学实验规划、假设生成与算法发现等领域，如何构建一个能够在整个执行过程中进行科学判断的开源模型成为重要问题。现有方法难以有效选择和利用科学论文、代码仓库等资源来弥补模型的能力缺陷。本文旨在通过自动化的能力诊断与任务构建机制，系统性地提升模型在科研任务中的科学推理与决策能力。
AI.method: SAIL采用"科学感知改进循环"，包含三个核心环节：（1）能力诊断：分析模型在文献检索、科学编程、长程研究中的失败模式（如搜索与证据选择的权衡、忽略能量漂移等科学假设错误、缺乏计划修订能力）；（2）任务构建：从论文集合与科学GitHub代码库中构建训练问题、交互轨迹和可执行任务，配套相应环境与工具；（3）训练流程：依次通过监督微调（SFT）、专家模型训练、多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）和智能体强化学习进行训练。基础设施基于verl框架，将模型优化、推理服务与环境执行解耦，支持同步在线策略训练回合，并通过Token-in/Token-out接口保留轨迹上下文一致性。
AI.result: SAIL在13个评测设置上均优于其基座模型Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，其中LitQA-search提升37.33分、E2E-Bench Basic提升30.71分、CORE-Hard提升24.37分、E2E-Bench Hard提升21.21分。在350亿参数规模模型中，SAIL在12项评测中领先（仅LitQA2-FullText例外）。在SciCode上以50.35分超过744B参数GLM-5.2的47.57分；在ArxivDIGESTables上以35.24分位居榜首。在12项任务聚合得分上以59.76分排名第二，仅次于744B GLM-5.2的63.30分，与284B DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731的59.15分相近。
AI.conclusion: SAIL通过科学感知改进循环将科学资源转化为针对性训练任务，并结合SFT、专家训练、MOPD与智能体强化学习，将多种科学能力整合到单一模型中。该模型以35B总参数/3B激活参数实现了与远大于其规模的开放权重模型相竞争的性能，在科学编程与文献综合任务上表现尤为突出。未来工作应聚焦于证据解读、代码库执行和长程研究等仍存在挑战的能力维度。

title: Zatom-2: Multitask Pretraining on Atomistic Data for Generative Modeling across Domains
summary: Unified atomistic modeling has the potential to accelerate discovery in chemistry, materials science, and biology by bridging data-rich chemical domains and data-scarce biological contexts. However, existing generative approaches to atomistic modeling remain highly specialized to scientific disciplines (chemistry vs. biology) or do not leverage both high-volume organic (molecule) and inorganic (material) data for general-purpose pretraining. To this end, we introduce Zatom-2, an atomistic generative model pretrained on approximately five million structures from the OMol25 and OMat24 electronic structure datasets. Zatom-2 features a multiscale Transformer architecture coupled with conditional flow matching that supports force conditioning and foundational pretraining tasks such as generation, structure prediction, and prediction of molecular and material energies and forces. Empirically, Zatom-2 achieves better molecular distribution fidelity than Zatom-1 and achieves strong performance on existing molecule and material generation benchmarks. Zatom-2 demonstrates the ability to control sample generation across low- and high-force regimes, and enhances protein generation in a low-data setting through joint generative-predictive pretraining and transfer learning, increasing protein backbone designability in a length extrapolation setting from 67.8% without pretraining to 74.8% after finetuning on 2,000 protein domains.

AI.tldr: Zatom-2是一个统一的原子级生成模型，通过在OMol25和OMat24数据集上进行多任务预训练，跨越分子、晶体材料和蛋白质三个领域进行生成建模，并引入力条件化实现对生成样本松弛态的控制。
AI.motivation: 现有的原子级生成模型通常局限于化学或生物学的单一学科，未能同时利用数据丰富的小有机分子和无机材料数据进行通用预训练。本文旨在解决这一局限，探索大规模原子级数据如何学习跨任务和跨域有效迁移的表示。
AI.method: Zatom-2采用多尺度U形Transformer架构（atom-token-atom），结合条件流匹配进行生成建模。提出统一的atom1+atom14分词方案，并引入力条件化（基于系统平均力范数）以及MLIP辅助任务（能量和力预测）。预训练数据为OMol25 4M和OMat24 1M子集，多任务包括生成、结构预测和力/能量预测。
AI.result: 在分子分布保真度上优于Zatom-1；在GEOM-Drugs（有效性96.90%）、QM9（95.72%）和MP20 MetaSUN（4.92%）等基准上表现强劲；力条件化可有效控制高低力区域的生成（AUROC 0.76-1.00）；蛋白质生成迁移方面，在SCOPe-2k低数据场景下，蛋白质骨架可设计性从无预训练的67.8%提升至微调后的74.8%（长度外推设置）。
AI.conclusion: Zatom-2展示了统一的原子级生成模型可同时支持分子、材料和蛋白质任务，并通过力/能量辅助预训练目标增强生成能力和迁移能力。生成-预测联合训练是未来原子级生成模型的有前景方案，架构在数据和模型规模缩放方面具有优势。

title: SpikeSSL: A Universal Spike Inference Framework with Dynamics-Informed State-Space Layers
summary: Two-photon calcium imaging is a standard tool for recording large neural populations in vivo, yet inferring spikes accurately across the growing diversity of calcium indicators remains an open problem. Existing supervised methods achieve reasonable in-domain accuracy but generalize poorly to unseen indicators, because different indicators induce distinct fluorescence kinetics and signal statistics while existing architectures remain relatively simple generic temporal regressors without dynamics-matched inductive bias. We propose SpikeSSL, a universal spike inference framework whose temporal backbone is a bank of bidirectional IIR state-space layers broadly motivated by calcium dynamics. A multi-modal conditioning encoder maps indicator identity, sampling rate, and trace-level signal statistics into a global conditioning vector that modulates the backbone via Adaptive Layer Normalization, while a heteroscedastic variance head provides calibrated per-frame uncertainty. On a benchmark with five fixed evaluation splits built from 33 public ground-truth datasets, SpikeSSL achieves state-of-the-art performance in both in-domain and zero-shot leave-one-indicator-out settings. We also develop a biophysical simulation pipeline capable of generating paired fluorescence-spike traces with systematically varied kinetic parameters, spike statistics, response nonlinearities, baseline drift, and noise. Using this pipeline, we synthesize approximately 11,000 simulated traces. Augmenting training with these data effectively closes the cross-indicator domain gap and improves zero-shot generalization. Code is publicly available at this https URL .
