summary: Coding agents produce large, tangled patches that mix multiple development purposes, making the code hard to review and maintain. Commit untangling offers the promise of organizing such large patches into untangled, manageable commits. This paper emphasizes two important limitations in existing commit untangling studies. First, they do not consider that untangled commits are ordered and should leave the code runnable. In practice, maintainers are unlikely to accept commits that prevent the code from running. Second, existing studies claim that commit untangling helps software maintenance. However, they conduct syntactic comparisons between the untangled commits and developers' original commits without directly showing the claimed maintenance benefits. To address these gaps, this paper makes two novel contributions: (1) RucTangle, the first agentic method that untangles commits while keeping the code runnable after each commit; and (2) TangleEval, the first evaluation framework that quantifies how untangled, manageable commit histories help coding agents repair bugs. We compare RucTangle against four untangling methods on 131 agent-generated patches. All histories produced by RucTangle are runnable, while baselines produce 20.6%-37.4% unrunnable commit histories. We further collect 453 agent-generated patches that introduce regressions (i.e., causing previously passing tests to fail) and ask two other coding agents to repair regressions. Augmenting agent context with RucTangle-produced histories yields 5.2% absolute improvement in pass@1. We also analyze agent trajectories to learn how they use untangled commits to navigate and fix bugs. Our findings demonstrate the value of adopting established software engineering practices in the era of coding agents, which broaden the future research agenda: how can agents actively use software history to make better development decisions?

AI.tldr: 本文提出RucTangle（首个保证每步可运行的智能体式commit解缠方法）和TangleEval（首个量化解缠commit历史对bug修复帮助的评估框架），解决了现有commit解缠方法忽视可运行性、未证明实际维护收益两大局限，并通过131个补丁和453个回归补丁的实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有commit解缠研究存在两个关键局限：(1) 忽略每步commit后代码可运行的要求，生成的中间版本可能无法执行；(2) 评估仅做语法层面的分组相似度比较，未直接证明对软件维护的实际帮助。在AI编码代理时代，代理生成的补丁通常大且复杂，更需要可维护的历史记录。
AI.method: (1) RucTangle：智能体先提出有序commit计划，应用后用pytest测试收集检查可运行性；失败时先调整commit顺序，再用代理重做分组（最多两轮），最后回退为合并相邻commit。(2) TangleEval：评估解缠结果（重构率、可运行率、中间测试失败率ITF、commit计数、测试增益分布MTP/TPE）和回归修复效果（pass@1、pass@3、partial/full repair），并利用git bisect定位回归引入点。(3) 比较5种方法（NoUntangle/FileSplit/HunkSplit/Armchr/Atomizer/RucTangle）和6个修复模型（Qwen3-Coder-Next、Nemotron、MiMo-V2.6-Flash、Qwen3.7-Flash、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GPT-6-Luna）。
AI.result: RQ1（131补丁）：RucTangle在131个补丁上100%可运行，基线仅有62.6%–79.4%全可运行；中间测试失败率1.7%（基线16.4%–32.4%）；中位数8个commit/补丁。RQ2（453回归补丁）：RucTangle将Qwen3-Coder-Next的pass@1从26.9%提升至31.3%，Nemotron从30.8%提升至36.0%，平均相对提升16.6%；Armchr和Atomizer平均相对提升仅4.5%和6.1%。6个模型中4个pass@1提升，1个不变，1个略降。RQ3（轨迹分析）：代理使用commit diff识别相关变更、查阅commit信息决定保留行为，但也可能被误导信息影响正确修复。合并commit分析显示细粒度历史（原始 vs. 减半）更有利于完整修复。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了在编码代理时代采纳传统软件工程实践（可运行的提交历史、可调试中间版本）的价值。RucTangle是首个保证每步可运行的commit解缠代理方法，TangleEval是首个通过下游回归修复任务验证解缠价值的评估框架。未来研究方向包括：训练能主动使用项目历史的代理、为后续代理设计项目历史、通过后续决策评估commit信息质量。

title: Overview of the NTCIR-19 Automatic Evaluation of LLMs 2 (AEOLLM-2) Task
summary: In this paper, we provide an overview of the NTCIR-19 Automatic Evaluation of LLMs 2 (AEOLLM-2) task. Building on the success of the NTCIR-18 core task AEOLLM, we proposed AEOLLM-2 for NTCIR-19 to further investigate automatic evaluation methods for Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly in long-form text generation scenarios. In AEOLLM-2, we introduced a new subtask, Deep Research Evaluation, which focuses on the automatic evaluation of long-form deep research reports generated by LLMs. Participants developed evaluation methods to automatically assess the quality of these reports, and the performance of each method was measured by comparing its scores against human-annotated ground-truth labels. This year, we received 91 runs from 10 teams in total. This paper describes the background of the task, the dataset construction, the evaluation measures, the participants' methods, and the final evaluation results.

AI.tldr: AEOLLM-2是NTCIR-19的核心任务，旨在探索针对大语言模型（LLM）生成的长篇文本（尤其是深度研究报告）的自动评估方法。本届新增"Deep Research Evaluation"子任务，基于DeepResearchBench构建数据集，包含40个问题（29中文+11英文），每题4种提示变体，由4个深度研究系统生成共640份文档（中位长度约9610 tokens）。任务沿comprehensiveness、insight、instruction following、readability四个维度进行人工标注，并采用pairwise accuracy、Spearman's ρ、Kendall's τ三个指标评估。本届共收到10支队伍的91次运行，RSLIR在加权整体指标上表现最佳，SCUNLP在readability维度领先。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM自动评估方法存在两大局限：（1）任务格式受限，多以选择题为主，脱离实际开放式问题；（2）评估标准有限，基于参考答案的指标（如BLEU、ROUGE）易被LLM的记忆能力攻破。同时，以LLM-as-a-Judge为代表的评估方法在长文本生成场景中效果不佳，而LLM生成的"Deep Research Reports"作为新型长文本任务（常超过1500 tokens，科学综述甚至达8000+ tokens），其自动评估可靠性尚未得到系统验证。
AI.method: 数据集构建：选取DeepResearchBench的40个研究主题问题，为每个问题设计4种诱导不同质量水平的提示变体，使用Grok、Gemini、Perplexity、Mita四个系统生成响应，共得到640个实例。标注采用人机协作：对comprehensiveness、insight、instruction following三个客观维度，先用RAG+LLM产生预标注再人工审核；对readability主观维度完全由人工标注，每例由两位标注员独立打分（0-10），分歧大时引入第三方，标注一致性ICC_avg达0.76。评估指标：在四个维度及加权整体分数上，计算参与者分数与人工标注的pairwise accuracy、Spearman's ρ、Kendall's τ_b，按问题平均后比较。数据按25%/25%/50%划分为训练集、dry run集和formal run集。
AI.result: 10支队伍共提交91次运行（dry run 58次+formal run 33次）。在formal run的保留集上：RSLIR以DeepSeek-v4-Flash为评判器，按维度独立评分后用rubric权重聚合，并在原始与逆序标准顺序间取平均，在加权整体上取得最佳（Spearman=0.7071, Kendall=0.5592, Accuracy=0.7796），并在comprehensiveness、insight、instruction following三个维度均领先；SCUNLP将约20个细粒度rubric子标准单独评分并加权融合，针对readability融合结构特征回归并修正instruction following的长度偏差，在readability上取得最佳（Spearman=0.5197, Kendall=0.3827, Accuracy=0.6883）。三个指标总体趋势一致但存在细微差异，说明其捕捉性能的不同方面。instruction following维度整体准确率最低（最高仅0.6350），readability的秩相关系数最低，表明这两项对自动评估器挑战更大。
AI.conclusion: AEOLLM-2通过构建长篇深度研究评估基准并吸引广泛参与，表明专门设计的评估方法整体优于通用LLM直接作评判器；不同评估维度对自动评估器提出差异化挑战，instruction following和readability尤为困难；三种评估指标（accuracy、ρ、τ）相互补充，多指标、多维度联合评估对长文本场景下的LLM评估至关重要。未来将扩展更多样化的数据与场景，以支撑更全面可靠的LLM评估。

title: Large Language Model Turnover Undermines Screening for Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Scientific Writing
summary: Journals and conferences have begun to screen submitted manuscripts for text written using large language models (LLMs). The reliability of this screening rests on benchmark evaluations against a fixed set of LLM versions, while the versions in actual use keep changing. Here we quantify how this LLM turnover affects the screening of scientific manuscripts. We paired 4,000 pre-ChatGPT abstracts from the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences with their rewrites by 23 LLM versions from three vendors, released between June 2023 and August 2026. We then trained detectors under maintenance scenarios ranging from a detector retrained on every new version to one trained once and never updated. Detectors trained only on a vendor's past versions can collapse at the boundaries between model generations: calibrated to falsely flag 1% of human-written abstracts, they catch above 99% of rewrites just before the sharpest boundary and 3.8% just after it. Detectors trained on later versions can also miss rewrites of earlier ones. Vocabulary differences between versions largely track where detection transfers and where it fails. In the two screening scenarios we simulated, screens covering all 23 versions either flagged one in eight human-written abstracts or missed one in three rewrites of the newest version. Indeed, a commercial detector missed most rewrites of the version just after the sharpest boundary while flagging almost no human-written abstracts. Research-integrity policy should therefore treat the benchmark accuracy of a detector as provisional, to be re-verified with every LLM release, including earlier versions.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了大语言模型版本快速迭代对期刊/会议筛查AI辅助科学写作可靠性的影响，发现检测器在模型代际边界处会灾难性失效，且词汇分布差异（JSD）是检测失效的有效早期信号。
AI.motivation: 期刊与会议已广泛部署自动化检测器来筛查稿件中的LLM生成内容，但检测器的基准测试通常针对一组固定的LLM版本，而实际使用中的LLM版本在不断更新——这种"LLM更替"（turnover）对筛查可靠性的影响尚不明确，特别是在假阳性率必须保持极低、且重新训练检测器需要成本的真实筛查条件下。
AI.method: 作者选取了2023年6月至2026年8月间OpenAI（14个版本）、Meta（16个版本）、Alibaba（5个版本）共23个LLM版本，对4,000篇ChatGPT发布前PNAS论文摘要进行"两阶段改写"（先压缩为列表，再扩展为段落），共获得91,953篇改写摘要。然后设计四种维护场景（当前版本、过去+当前版本、仅过去版本、冻结于特定版本）和两种综合筛查场景（联合方案与合并方案），训练RoBERTa-base检测器并在1%假阳性率下评估；还测试了四种无域内训练的开源检测器以及一款商用检测器Pangram。词汇相似度以Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD）衡量。
AI.result: 1. 仅基于某版本过去版本训练的检测器会在两个代际边界处崩溃：在GPT-5边界前捕获>99%的改写，过渡后骤降至26.6%；在Muse-Glimmer边界前接近完美，过渡后仅3.8%；2. 词汇差异（JSD）与检测转移高度相关（Spearman ρ=−0.85，p<0.001），JSD越大的版本对，检测迁移越差；3. 两种综合筛查方案各有权衡：联合方案以每8篇人类摘要中误标1篇为代价几乎捕获所有改写，合并方案假标率近1%但会漏掉1/3的Muse-Glimmer改写；4. 商用检测器Pangram（v3.3.2）对GPT-5漏检率仅6.5%，但对Muse-Glimmer漏检率高达79.8%，跨学科域差异显著（健康科学45.2% vs. 社会科学26.5%）；5. 倒向迁移同样失败：用GPT-5.6（Luna/Sol/Terra）训练的检测器几乎检测不出GPT-4的改写；6. 四款无域内训练的开源检测器对所有版本漏检率均超过2/3，中位AUROC接近随机。
AI.conclusion: LLM筛查检测器的可靠性并非固定属性，而必须随每次LLM版本发布重新验证（包括早期版本）。当前以一组固定版本为基准的检测准确率评估应被视为临时结果。词汇分布差异（JSD）可作为判断新发布LLM是否需要重新验证检测器的实用早期信号。研究诚信政策应据此调整，承认检测准确率的"暂定性"特征。

title: Error-Propagation Modeling for Failure Attribution in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MASs) are increasingly used to solve complex tasks through coordinated reasoning, tool use, and interaction with external resources. However, attributing failures in such systems remains challenging because the observed outcome often does not directly reveal the error responsible for the failed execution. In this work, the attribution target is the decisive error, defined as the agent--step pair whose correction would recover the failed execution. Existing approaches largely identify suspicious steps without explicitly modeling how errors propagate across interactions or persist in unresolved loops, making decisive errors difficult to distinguish from downstream failure symptoms. We propose \textbf{E}rror-Propagation \textbf{M}odeling for \textbf{F}ailure \textbf{A}ttribution (\textbf{EMFA}). EMFA constructs a structured representation of the failed trajectory, models both cascading propagation and persistent interaction loops, and uses propagation-aware candidate screening followed by counterfactual verification to identify the decisive agent--step pair. On the Who\&When benchmark, EMFA achieves state-of-the-art step-level attribution accuracy and remains competitive at the agent level. It improves the previous best step-level results by 3.45 and 4.40 percentage points on the Hand-Crafted and Algorithm-Generated subsets, respectively.

AI.tldr: EMFA提出了一种基于错误传播建模的LLM多智能体系统故障归因框架,通过结构化轨迹表示、级联错误传播与持续交互循环建模,结合反事实验证,精确定位决定性错误步骤。在Who&When基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统失败率高,但现有归因方法将故障视为孤立可疑步骤,未能显式建模错误的级联传播或持续循环,导致难以从下游症状中区分决定性错误。
AI.method: 五阶段流程:1)识别最终失败步骤;2)构建结构化两层依赖图(步骤级与子任务级);3)从失败步骤反向追溯相关性,正向用LLM标注传播状态,独立提取持续循环图;4)双分支候选筛选(传播分支+循环分支,各至多2个候选);5)基于模型的反事实验证结合预定义责任边界原则确定最终决定性错误。
AI.result: 在Who&When基准的Hand-Crafted和Algorithm-Generated子集上,EMFA的步骤级归因准确率分别超越此前最佳(CHIEF)3.45和4.40个百分点;在Agent级Hand-Crafted子集上也达到最佳,Algorithm-Generated子集上具有竞争力。消融实验证实两个分支提供互补收益;不同骨干LLM均验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模错误传播与持续循环模式,EMFA能有效区分决定性错误与下游症状,实现细粒度故障归因。但带来额外的推理开销,未来工作需探索更高效的传播建模策略。

title: Where Do the Tokens Go? Understanding and Reducing Costs in LLM Agents for Vulnerability Discovery
summary: LLM agents can spend millions of tokens during vulnerability discovery without producing a working proof of concept (PoC). What consumes that budget, and why does it fail to produce results? We diagnose these costs and failures through a multi-axis open-coding study of 200 CyberGym traces, spanning four agents (i.e., Codex, OpenCode, Cybench, and EnIGMA) under an unaided baseline and four existing efficiency methods. The study reveals three key findings. First, different agents vary substantially in success and cost, and higher spending does not consistently yield better outcomes. Second, code localization and understanding, together with vulnerability reasoning and trigger design, account for 60.4% of tokens and represent the two leading bottlenecks in failed runs. Third, only 24.4% of matched comparisons preserve success at lower total cost; unsuitable signals and auxiliary overhead limit the benefits of existing methods. Motivated by these findings, we present AVRI, an Agent-centric Vulnerability Reasoning Interface built around a persistent Bidirectional Evidence Trace (BET). BET connects how the harness consumes input with the conditions required to make a selected operation unsafe, retaining source-supported correspondences alongside the agent's hypotheses and open questions. Reading, analysis, and persistence commands help agents build and reuse this evidence rather than repeatedly retrieve and reconstruct it. On 20 evaluation tasks, AVRI reduces total cost by 18.0% for Codex and 23.7% for OpenCode while preserving success rates and improving or maintaining recall.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM智能体在漏洞发现中消耗大量token却无法生成PoC的问题，通过对200条CyberGym执行轨迹进行多轴开放编码研究，分析了4个智能体（Codex、OpenCode、Cybench、EnIGMA）在基线和4种现有效率方法下的成本与失败原因，并提出AVRI（Agent-centric Vulnerability Reasoning Interface）系统，在20个评估任务上实现成本降低且效果保持。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在漏洞发现任务中消耗数百万token但常常无法生成有效PoC，亟需理解预算消耗来源和失败原因，以便设计有效的效率优化方法。现有效率方法在漏洞发现场景下的收益尚不清楚，缺乏连接token消耗活动与失败瓶颈的系统性分析。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 多轴开放编码研究——对200条轨迹（4个智能体×5种配置×10任务）进行活动阶段（9类代码）、失败瓶颈（7类）和方法机制（5类）的编码，使用规则标注+LLM辅助审查+人类审计（κ=0.83-0.85）；(2) BET（Bidirectional Evidence Trace）——通过前向追踪harness输入值的传播和反向追踪不安全操作条件，经受支持的代换连接两者，保留源位置、推导规则、未解析依赖；(3) AVRI接口——提供源查询（view:context/callers/uses等）、聚焦检查（read inspect）、分析（analyze harness-model/sinks/backward）和证据复用命令（bet open/record/view）。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 智能体效果与成本差异显著，高花费不必然带来更好结果；(2) 代码定位理解与漏洞推理触发设计占60.4% token，占68.7%失败权重，是两个主要瓶颈；(3) 仅24.4%配对比较在保留成功率下降低成本，不合适信号和辅助开销限制了现有方法。AVRI在20任务评估中：Codex成本降低18.0%（$132.65→$108.75），成功率保持85%，recall从65%升至75%；OpenCode成本降低23.7%（$4.38→$3.34），成功率保持100%，recall保持90%。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了漏洞发现智能体的token消耗结构和失败瓶颈分布，指出现有方法普遍无法兼顾效率与效果。AVRI通过BET持久化连接输入传播与不安全操作条件，使智能体能够复用证据而非反复重建，在两个评估智能体上均实现了最低总成本与最低执行时间，同时不牺牲成功率或recall。

title: NanoProof: Open and Efficient Automated Theorem Proving in Lean 4
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: We introduce NanoProof, to our knowledge the first factorized execution-guided theorem prover in Lean 4 whose training data, extraction tooling, training pipeline, and weights are all released, making it end-to-end reproducible using open-source resources. To this end, we build and release a dataset of structured proof trees, as well as a tool for programmatic interaction and data extraction within the Lean 4 formal verifier. To support sustainable research, we focus on compute efficiency to facilitate accessible training and evaluation. NanoProof achieves 50.8% pass@16 on MiniF2F-Test, exceeding the two closest systems of its class, HyperTree Proof Search and ABEL, at roughly 90x and 7x less compute, and using more than four orders of magnitude less compute than AlphaProof. Stronger open-weight provers exist, but they are fine-tuned from large pretrained language models and release neither training data nor pipeline; NanoProof shows that the factorized execution-guided class of provers can be rebuilt from scratch with modest resources.

AI.tldr: NanoProof是首个端到端可复现的因子化执行引导Lean 4自动定理证明器，发布完整的数据集、提取工具、训练流程及权重，在MiniF2F-Test上以pass@16达到50.8%，计算量较同类系统减少7–90倍，较AlphaProof减少四个数量级以上。
AI.motivation: 现有因子化执行引导类证明器（如HyperTree Proof Search、ABEL、AlphaProof）均未开放数据或代码，阻碍了该方向的开放研究；与此同时，开源证明器虽性能更强但基于大规模预训练模型微调，无法审计其数据且不可复现。本文旨在以适中算力从零重建该类系统，消除可复现性壁垒。
AI.method: 1) 发布LeanTree数据集（92,927个来自Mathlib的结构化证明树）及提取工具；2) 构建基于Transformer（1B参数，nanochat架构）的actor-critic策略网络，共享词表，使用GPT-2分词器扩展；3) 采用AlphaProof同款的MCTS因子化证明搜索（含progressive sampling、matchmaker机制）；4) 监督训练流程：Nemotron-CC-Math-4+基础训练 → LeanTree精细微调 → RL自改进循环（基于NuminaMath-LEAN语料）；5) 提出多种搜索级技术：证明简化与增强、循环检测（拒绝18%无效策略）、多样化策略采样（首token使用Gumbel-Top-k）。
AI.result: NanoProof在MiniF2F-Test上达到50.8% pass@16（512次MCTS迭代），在MiniF2F-Valid上RL训练100步后达51.3%（256次迭代）。总计算预算约3.8×10⁸ TFLOPs，相较HyperTree Proof Search减少约90倍，相较ABEL减少约7倍，相较AlphaProof减少超过四个数量级。多样化策略采样在MiniF2F-Valid上带来+2.0百分点的提升。
AI.conclusion: NanoProof证明了因子化执行引导类定理证明器可使用适中资源从零重建并完整开源，为该研究方向提供了必要的数据、工具与基线；其算力预算使任何研究组均可复现和扩展。局限：未在PutnamBench/IMO等更难基准上评估；约9.53%的Mathlib证明尚未纳入LeanTree；未对所有搜索级技术进行完整消融。

title: Beyond Report Imitation: Clinically Aware Multi-Image Ultrasound Report Generation from Visible Evidence
comment: Accepted to BMVC 2026. Code: this https URL
summary: Generating ultrasound reports from multiple images requires aggregating clinical evidence across views, yet archived key frames capture only part of the dynamic examination. Raw-report imitation is therefore misaligned with visual supervision: content that is clinically valid for the full examination may be unverifiable from the images available to a model. This gap creates a clinical behavior alignment problem. A model must preserve visible findings, avoid diagnostic reversals and unsupported completion, and not collapse into conservative templates. We propose CAMEO, a Clinically Aware Multi-image Evidence-grounded Orchestration framework for ultrasound report generation. Stage I learns ultrasound visual-language primitives; Stage II performs Cross-View Evidence Grounding by distilling trusted visible report points into multi-image QA and report-style supervision; and Stage III performs Clinically Aware Preference Alignment using clinical-error-oriented preference pairs. From USReport, we construct USReport-Distilled with 17,670 evidence-grounded paired-image training instances and USReport-Pref with 21,869 preference pairs; we additionally use 25,631 PubMedVision-US ultrasound instruction samples for domain adaptation and multi-image instruction tuning. On the primary USReport-Distilled benchmark, CAMEO improves over EchoVLM from 0.25 to 0.40 BLEU-1, 0.28 to 0.45 ROUGE-1, and 0.27 to 0.43 METEOR, while raising ClinicalScore from 55.02 to 74.20. These results underscore the value of evidence-grounded supervision, clinically aware alignment, and clinically structured evaluation for reliable ultrasound report generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAMEO框架，针对多图像超声报告生成中"部分视觉可观测性"问题，通过视觉证据蒸馏、跨视图证据接地和临床感知偏好对齐三阶段训练，解决原始报告模仿将不可验证内容当作图像监督的错位问题。
AI.motivation: 超声报告基于动态检查撰写，但存档的关键帧仅捕获部分内容。原始报告模仿将检查中临床有效但图像不可验证的内容当作图像监督目标，导致模型产生流畅但无视觉依据的幻觉描述，或退化为保守模板遗漏可见发现。核心问题是如何在不完全视觉证据下定义理想的临床报告行为。
AI.method: CAMEO包含三阶段：(1) Stage I超声域适应，通过投影器对齐和单图像指令微调学习超声视觉-语言基元；(2) Stage II跨视图证据接地，将原始报告分解为原子临床点，通过双验证者辩论式标注+仲裁者筛选可见证据，构建多图像QA和报告式SFT监督（包含证据QA、视图归属QA、跨视图QA、拒绝QA和接地报告QA）；(3) Stage III临床感知偏好对齐，使用DPO基于临床错误导向的偏好对（针对遗漏、误诊、过度诊断等失败模式）校准行为。构建了USReport-Distilled（17,670实例）和USReport-Pref（21,869偏好对），并使用25,631个PubMedVision-US样本进行域适应。同时提出基于可信可见证据的LLM辅助临床错误评估协议（MissScore、MisdiagScore、OverdiagScore、ClinicalScore）。
AI.result: 在USReport-Distilled基准上，CAMEO相对EchoVLM将BLEU-1从0.25提升至0.40，ROUGE-1从0.28提升至0.45，METEOR从0.27提升至0.43，ClinicalScore从55.02提升至74.20。在PubMedVision-US Multi上也优于LLaVA-Med、Qwen3-VL-32B、Lingshu-32B和EchoVLM等基线。消融实验表明Stage II贡献最大，Stage III主要改善临床错误画像而非词汇指标。盲法放射科医生评估中CAMEO获得3.57±1.41分（5分制），显著优于EchoVLM（1.73±0.98）。器官级分析显示肝脏和甲状腺改善一致，乳腺因细微发现识别存在瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 证据接地的监督、临床感知对齐和临床结构化评估对可靠超声报告生成至关重要。CAMEO将数据构建、对齐和评估作为耦合设计选择，但受限于单读者评估、存档关键帧和三个器官类别（乳腺、甲状腺、肝脏），结果不构成临床效用证明，仅限于基于存档图像的证据接地报告生成。

title: AgentEvolver: System-Wide Self-Evolution Through Task Execution
summary: An agent can complete a task without improving how it works. Turning task experience into reusable capability requires connecting the changed component to its evaluation and subsequent use. We present AgentEvolver, a system for developing capabilities during task execution while keeping the foundation model fixed. Eight entity families expose reusable operations, methods, agents, control flow, interfaces, and supporting state to revision through a common versioned lifecycle. A shared Runtime coordinates ongoing work, while persistent planning and recoverable context preserve task direction and supporting evidence. We evaluate task outcomes on SWE-bench Pro Public and examine capability changes in six application cases. The team reports an 82.08\% resolution rate with evolution, exceeding its reported baseline without evolution. The cases show retained capabilities entering later website, game, and research work, while also documenting incomplete objectives and an unsuccessful strategy. These findings distinguish improvement in a reusable component from success on the final task. AgentEvolver provides a concrete basis for studying capability accumulation through execution; independent-task transfer and total development cost remain open questions.

AI.tldr: AgentEvolver提出了一种在任务执行过程中开发可重用能力的系统，通过八类实体和共享运行时机制，使代理在完成任务的同时积累可复用能力。该系统在SWE-bench Pro Public上取得82.08%的解决率，超过无演化的基线。
AI.motivation: 研究的核心动机在于：当前代理（agent）能完成单次任务，但难以将任务经验转化为可重用的能力。作者指出，要实现能力沉淀，需要将变更的组件与其评估及后续使用相连接，从而区分"完成任务的改进"与"可复用能力的提升"。
AI.method: 系统设计了八类实体家族（entity families），涵盖可重用操作、方法、代理、控制流、接口和支持状态，通过统一的版本化生命周期（versioned lifecycle）进行修订。共享运行时（Runtime）协调进行中的工作，持久化规划（persistent planning）保留任务方向，可恢复上下文（recoverable context）保存支持证据。基础模型保持固定不变。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Pro Public任务上，该团队报告了82.08%的解决率（带演化机制），超过了无演化机制时的基线表现。六个应用案例显示，在后续的网站、游戏和研究任务中保留了之前积累的能力，同时文档记录了未完成的目标和失败的策略。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论将"可复用组件的改进"与"最终任务的成功"明确区分开来。AgentEvolver为通过执行实现能力积累的研究提供了具体基础，但仍存在开放问题：独立任务间的迁移能力以及总开发成本尚未解决。

title: TAM: Task-Aware Memory Distillation for Efficient Spatiotemporal Prediction
summary: Knowledge distillation enables efficient spatiotemporal prediction by transferring knowledge from an accurate teacher to a compact student. However, matching outputs or features independently for each sample leaves cross-sample predictive structure underused. Exploiting this structure requires representations and historical references that reflect the dynamics of each task. We propose TAM, a Task-Aware Memory Distillation framework that organizes a frozen teacher's knowledge into a bounded, retrievable history. Memory entries encode latent features, forecast changes, or flow residuals, while task-specific selection rules identify relevant historical references. The student either matches the teacher's similarity distribution over shared references or regresses observation-conditioned residual prototypes. These objectives complement supervised prediction and conventional distillation. The teacher, memory, and auxiliary adapters are used only during training, leaving student inference unchanged. We evaluate TAM on video prediction, weather forecasting, and traffic flow prediction across multiple teacher-student configurations. Averaged over four paired runs, adding TAM improves SSIM on all six video datasets and reduces MSE on five relative to the corresponding KD baselines. Mean paired MSE reductions reach 1.86% on KittiCaltech, 1.93% on WeatherBench with a gSTA teacher, and 1.01% on TaxiBJ. These results demonstrate the utility of historical teacher supervision across distinct forecasting tasks without additional student inference cost.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes TAM (Task-Aware Memory Distillation), a knowledge distillation framework for efficient spatiotemporal prediction. It organizes a frozen teacher's knowledge into a bounded, retrievable memory that encodes task-specific information (latent features, forecast changes, or flow residuals) with task-aware retrieval rules. The student matches teacher similarity distributions over shared references or regresses observation-conditioned residual prototypes, improving prediction accuracy without additional inference cost across video prediction, weather forecasting, and traffic flow prediction tasks.
AI.motivation: Conventional knowledge distillation for spatiotemporal prediction matches outputs or features sample-by-sample, leaving cross-sample predictive structure underused. Different forecasting tasks (video, weather, traffic) have distinct dynamics that require different predictive quantities to be stored and different historical references to be retrieved. A generic memory fails to account for these task-specific distinctions, motivating a unified framework that makes the stored representation and reference selection explicit per task.
AI.method: TAM constructs a bounded memory bank from a frozen teacher that stores task-dependent entries: latent features (video), forecast changes (weather), or flow residuals (traffic). Task-specific selection rules identify relevant historical references—motion/occupancy for video, geographic location for weather, observation conditions for traffic. Two objective variants are used: (1) relational matching of teacher-student similarity distributions over shared references (video/weather), and (2) observation-conditioned residual prototype regression (traffic). Memory and teacher are used only during training; inference uses only the student. The method is evaluated on Moving MNIST, Moving FMNIST, KTH, Human3.6M, HMDB51, BAIR, KittiCaltech, WeatherBench, and TaxiBJ with TAU/IncepU/gSTA/UniFormer teachers and U-Net/ResNet-FCN students.
AI.result: TAM consistently improves SSIM on all six video datasets and reduces MSE on five of them over matched KD baselines. Mean paired MSE reductions reach: 1.86% on KittiCaltech, 1.93% on WeatherBench (with gSTA teacher), and 1.01% on TaxiBJ. Channel-wise analysis on TaxiBJ shows inflow/outflow MSE reductions of 2.14% and 1.97% respectively relative to global memory. A motivation experiment comparing global residual memory (+1.13% MSE) versus TAM (−1.01% MSE) on TaxiBJ confirms the value of task-aware organization over generic memory.
AI.conclusion: TAM demonstrates that organizing historical teacher supervision around observation conditions and prediction horizons yields measurable improvements across distinct spatiotemporal forecasting domains without modifying student inference architecture or cost. The work establishes that cross-sample predictive structure—exploited through task-specific memory entries and retrieval rules—provides complementary supervision to conventional distillation, with consistent gains shown across video prediction, weather forecasting, and traffic flow prediction through matched teacher-student comparisons.

title: PolyCodeEval: Benchmarking Multilingual Code Generation from Functions to Repositories
summary: As large language models increasingly move toward repository-level software engineering, existing code-generation benchmarks remain fragmented across language coverage, task granularity, and evaluation protocols, impeding systematic comparison. To address this gap, we present PolyCodeEval, a unified multilingual and multi-granularity benchmark for code generation. It comprises 2,590 code generation tasks spanning functions to repositories, derived from 58 real, executable open-source repositories in five programming languages. All tasks are evaluated under a unified execution-based protocol with integration procedures tailored to their generation targets. Building on this benchmark, we evaluate frontier large language models, state-of-the-art specialized methods, and general coding agents. Our results show that existing approaches still struggle to correctly generate complete code fragments across granularities and languages. Specifically, the studied methods generate at most 71.7%, 76.7%, and 31.0% correct functions, files, and repositories, respectively, with performance varying widely across languages. Paired experiments further show that implementation context from related functions in the same file improves the executable correctness of function generation. Method rankings also vary across task granularities and programming languages, highlighting the importance of multilingual, multi-granularity evaluation for comprehensively assessing code generation capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PolyCodeEval，一个统一的多语言、多粒度代码生成基准，涵盖从函数到完整仓库的五种编程语言任务，通过执行式评估系统揭示现有方法在不同粒度和语言上的显著性能差异。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成基准在语言覆盖、任务粒度和评估协议上碎片化严重，难以系统比较不同方法的真实能力。随着大模型向仓库级软件工程演进，需要一个能跨粒度、跨语言且基于执行的统一评测平台。
AI.method: 从58个可执行开源仓库（Python、JS、Java、Go、C++）构建2,590个任务，定义为L0（空仓库全量生成）、L1（带骨架仓库生成）、L2（文件级补全）、L3（函数级补全）四个粒度。采用统一执行式评测（Build/Test/Full三种指标），结合测试覆盖审计与Oracle验证；评估对象涵盖LLM直接生成、RepoCoder/AlignCoder/HCP等专用方法、Codex/Claude Code等通用编码Agent及ChatDev。
AI.result: 仓库级（L0/L1）Full通过率仅22.4%-31.0%，Build成功率反而因骨架约束下降；文件级（L2）Codex以GPT为后端达到76.7% Full通过率，显著优于直接生成；函数级（L3）RepoCoder+GPT以71.7% Full通过率领先，但更复杂的方法（AlignCoder、HCP）未呈现一致优势。方法排名随粒度和语言显著变化；相关实现上下文可显著提升函数生成正确性。
AI.conclusion: 多语言、多粒度的执行式评测对于全面评估代码生成能力至关重要；当前方法在不同粒度上存在特定瓶颈（仓库级需工程整合、文件级需接口理解、函数级需上下文选择），且有效性、成本与跨语言稳定性之间存在显著权衡。

title: Randomized Transport Maps for Model-Free Policy-Gradient Mean-Field Control
summary: We develop a model-free policy gradient method for discrete-time mean-field control (MFC). In MFC, the policy affects the objective both through the controlled dynamics and through the population distribution. Standard REINFORCE estimators capture the first effect but not the second. We introduce Transport REINFORCE, a transport map-based approach that perturbs a suitable transformation of the population distribution to estimate this missing mean-field contribution. The method applies to both finite and continuous state spaces. In finite state spaces, we perturb the population distribution directly on the probability simplex through a convex combination of the current population weights and random weights. In continuous state spaces, we project the population distribution onto the manifold of Gaussian mixtures, and then randomize it via a transport map that ensures the perturbed law remains within this manifold. We prove consistency of the perturbed objective and gradient as the perturbation vanishes, and derive bias and mean-square error bounds for the resulting sample-based gradient estimator. Numerical experiments on several MFC benchmarks show that Transport REINFORCE improves over standard REINFORCE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Transport REINFORCE，一种基于传输映射的模型无关策略梯度方法，用于离散时间均值场控制（MFC）。核心思想是通过扰动群体分布（而非仅依赖标准REINFORCE的策略得分）来捕获均值场梯度中缺失的群体依赖项。该方法同时适用于有限和连续状态空间：有限状态空间通过概率单纯形上的凸组合扰动权重；连续状态空间则将群体分布投影到高斯混合流形上，通过传输映射保证扰动后分布仍在此流形内。论文证明了扰动目标和梯度的一致性，并给出了样本梯度估计器的偏差和均方误差界。在多个MFC基准测试上的数值实验表明该方法优于标准REINFORCE。
AI.motivation: 标准REINFORCE方法在均值场控制中存在根本性缺陷：策略不仅通过受控动力学影响目标，还通过群体分布（即所有智能体的统计行为）影响目标。标准REINFORCE仅捕获前者而遗漏后者，导致梯度估计不完整。已有工作（如MF-REINFORCE）仅针对有限状态空间通过logit坐标随机化解决此问题，缺乏适用于连续状态空间的统一框架。
AI.method:
1. **传输映射框架**：引入传输映射随机化机制，对经过变换的群体分布施加扰动。在有限状态空间，扰动形式为(1-λ)μ + λQ（凸组合）；在连续状态空间，先通过编码器-解码器将群体分布投影到K分量高斯混合流形，再扰动混合权重、均值和协方差。扰动同时使用辅助均匀变量以支持质量分裂。
2. **模型无关策略梯度表示**：推导扰动目标J^λ(θ)的梯度公式∇J^λ = E[R(S_pol + S_mf)]，其中S_mf是基于扰动密度h^λ的群体得分，捕获策略变化通过群体分布传播的效应。
3. **算法设计**：采用离线-在线两阶段策略。离线阶段用M个交互粒子估计群体流及其对参数的灵敏度（有限状态用得分函数递归，连续状态用中心差分）；在线阶段用B条扰动轨迹估计梯度。
4. **理论分析**：证明有限状态空间下目标扰动误差为O(λ)，连续状态空间固定K下为O(√λ)；建立群体投影响应；推导偏差和均方误差界，并给出最优尺度选择λ*≍B^{-1/4}，η*≍n^{-1/4}。
AI.result:
**主要成果**：
1. 理论证明：在标准正则性假设下，扰动目标和梯度关于扰动尺度λ一致收敛，偏差和均方误差界明确。
2. 数值实验：在7个MFC基准测试（4个有限状态+3个连续状态）上，Transport REINFORCE均优于标准REINFORCE，最优性差距显著缩小。在双峰分配问题中验证了高斯混合数量K的关键作用（K=1时无法区分相同均值方差的不同分布，K=2时精确）。
3. 计算开销：相对于REINFORCE增加2-16倍时间（由于灵敏度估计和群体得分计算），但在匹配模拟器预算下产生更优策略。
4. 经验验证：偏差和均方误差的幂律与理论预测一致（λ线性、η^4截断误差、B^{-1}和M^{-1}采样率）。
AI.conclusion: Transport REINFORCE提供了一个统一且理论完备的框架，将模型无关策略梯度方法扩展到完整均值场控制问题（包括有限和连续状态空间）。通过传输映射扰动群体分布，能够捕获标准REINFORCE遗漏的均值场梯度贡献。该方法在理论和实践上均得到验证，是MFC强化学习的重要进展。未来工作可探索自适应传输映射选择、与现有MFC求解器的结合，以及在部分可观测或高维设置中的扩展。

title: Where to Adapt Matters: Layer-Selective Fine-Tuning for Capability Retention
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables large language models (LLMs) to adapt to specialized tasks, but often at the cost of degrading general capabilities acquired during pretraining. Existing approaches primarily mitigate this trade-off through data replay or regularization, relying on additional data or explicit optimization constraints. We instead focus on a different question: where should adaptation be applied? We find that fine-tuning different Transformer layers produces different target-task gains and degrees of capability degradation, suggesting that not all layers are equally suitable for adaptation. To characterize this difference, we use layer-wise empirical Fisher information to measure target-task sensitivity. However, computing Fisher scores requires backward computation and becomes increasingly expensive for large models. We therefore introduce input--output cosine similarity as a lightweight, forward-only proxy for ranking layer sensitivity. Across models and tasks, layers with lower input--output similarity consistently exhibit higher empirical Fisher scores. Building on this observation, we propose Layer-Selective LoRA (LS-LoRA), which places trainable LoRA adapters only in layers with low input--output similarity. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that LS-LoRA improves average target-task performance while retaining substantially more commonsense reasoning capability than standard all-layer LoRA, demonstrating that carefully choosing where to adapt can provide a simple and effective way to balance target-task adaptation and general capability retention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Layer-Selective LoRA (LS-LoRA)，通过输入-输出余弦相似度作为层敏感性的前向代理，仅在低相似度层放置LoRA适配器，在数学推理和代码生成任务上提升目标性能同时更好地保留模型的通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT方法缓解能力退化主要依赖数据回放或正则化，但忽略了"在哪些层进行适配"这一根本问题。观察到不同Transformer层对微调的敏感度差异显著，盲目适配所有层会导致通用能力退化。
AI.method: 1. 使用层经验Fisher信息衡量目标任务的参数敏感性；2. 由于Fisher计算需要反向传播代价高昂，提出输入-输出余弦相似度作为前向代理（只需单次前向，无需标签或梯度）；3. 在多个模型和任务上验证低相似度层与高Fisher分数的显著负相关；4. 提出LS-LoRA，仅在余弦相似度低于阈值γ=0.85的层放置可训练LoRA适配器；5. 提供理论定理建立相似度与Fisher下界的关系。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.2-1B/3B、Llama-3-8B和Mistral-7B四个模型上，LS-LoRA在数学推理和代码生成任务上均取得最高的目标任务平均性能，同时显著提升常识推理保留能力（最多14.3个百分点）；GPU显存降低4.2-14.4%，训练时间降低10.0-29.6%；该策略同样适用于DoRA和PiSSA。
AI.conclusion: 适配位置是平衡任务适应与能力保留的关键设计选择；输入-输出余弦相似度可作为无需标签和反向传播的高效层选择代理；LS-LoRA作为一种简单有效的方法，为PEFT提供了新的设计维度。

title: Constructing Structured Decision Sources for Consensus-Based Pseudo-Label Learning
summary: Consensus can make pseudo-label learning more reliable, but only when its predictors contribute genuinely different evidence. Multiple models that repeat the same boundary provide additional votes without additional information. We address this problem by con structing decision sources through controlled changes to within-class structure. Starting from a shared graph representation, we vary center granularity and neighborhood mixing, reproduce each resulting source to test its stability, and select a complementary subset using node pair coassignment. Unanimous predictions from the selected sources are then ranked for student training. On the public fixed splits of Cora, CiteSeer, and PubMed, evaluated with five random seeds, the constructed sources improve fixed-budget training pseudo-label precision by 1.19 to 4.39 percentage points over three conventionally initialized GCN sources. Under matched structural filters, three-source consensus is more precise than each constituent source in all 45 dataset slot eed comparisons. The gains are strongest in pseudo-label quality: downstream accuracy remains competitive but does not lead on every dataset. These results identify source construction rather than model count alone as an important design problem for consensus-based pseudo-label learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对图半监督学习中的伪标签可靠性问题，提出了一种基于结构化干预的决策源（decision source）构建与选择框架，用于多源共识（consensus-based）伪标签学习。核心思想是：通过控制类内中心粒度 k 和邻域混合系数 β 对共享图表示进行受控扰动，从同一图中生成多个既可复现又互补的决策源，进而通过一致性投票提升伪标签精度，而非依赖更多的随机初始化模型。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络依赖稀缺标注，伪标签自训练中早期错误会通过消息传递扩散；现有多数研究是在预测产生后控制噪声（置信度阈值、训练调度、多模型一致性等），但忽略了"上游"问题——如何从单一图中构造可复现且彼此互补的决策源。简单随机初始化的多模型往往产生几乎相同的决策边界或不稳定噪声，并不能提供真正不同的证据。多源共识的有用性取决于预测器是否以不同方式出错，而非模型数量本身。
AI.method: 方法包括四个阶段：(1) 共享图表示的热启动（GCN）；(2) 结构化干预——通过变化类内中心数 k∈{2,3} 和邻域混合系数 β∈{0,0.5} 生成四个候选源，每个源使用按到中心距离排列的节点课程（前缀50%/75%/100%）训练，并复现一次以测试稳定性；(3) 基于节点对同分配（co-assignment）向量的稳定性 s_reg 与源间差异 d_co 进行互补性选择，采用贪心策略保留 K=3 个源；(4) 一致投票（3/3 全票）后的节点按最小置信度排序用于学生训练，并使用基于训练集校准的近中心距离 q90 门控作为独立的质量诊断（不进入学生训练分支）。整个流程将"质量诊断"与"下游任务训练"分离。
AI.result: 在 Cora、CiteSeer、PubMed 三个 Planetoid 公开固定划分（5 个随机种子）上的实验表明：(1) 构造的三个结构源相比三个随机初始化 GCN 源，在固定预算训练伪标签精度上提升 1.19–4.39 个百分点（所有 15 个 dataset–seed 组合均为正增益）；(2) 匹配结构门控下，3/3 全票一致性精度高于任一组成源，全部 45 个 dataset–slot–seed 对比中均如此；(3) q90 门控可显著提升条件精度（Cora +8.26，CiteSeer +12.46，PubMed +4.99 个百分点），但覆盖率下降；(4) 下游任务中，Cora 上 Test Accuracy 与 Macro-F1 均最佳（84.04/83.03），CiteSeer 接近最优，PubMed 略低于 DiPat 改编版；(5) 三个数据集上的平均复现稳定性为 0.814–0.918，平均同分配距离为 0.222–0.263，证实所选源兼具可复现性与互补性。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明：对于基于一致性的伪标签学习，"源构建"比"模型数量"更为关键。论文提出了一个将决策源构建、复现性验证与互补性选择显式纳入共识学习设计的框架，并通过实验证实了该框架在提升伪标签证据质量（精度）方面的稳健优势。然而，论文也明确指出该方法并非通往最高测试精度的普适路径——下游精度的提升因数据集而异，且伴随覆盖率下降、源训练计算量未对齐等代价。论文的核心贡献在于把共识学习的设计焦点从投票规则前移到了投票对象的生成与筛选。

title: Beyond Action Entropy: Quotient-Space Exploration for Genome-Scale Metabolic Model Repair
summary: Repairing scientific models from functional observations differs fundamentally from supervised prediction: feedback may certify a solution without revealing which structural correction is responsible. We study this setting for genome-scale metabolic model (GEM) repair, where multiple reaction edits can explain the same phenotypes and many apparently distinct edits correspond to the same biological mechanism. This many-to-one structure creates a hidden failure mode for conventional exploration: diversity in the output space need not translate into diversity of scientific hypotheses. We introduce QuotientPO, which collapses equivalent repairs into canonical mechanisms and optimizes exploration directly over the resulting quotient space. To make quotient exploration informative under finite rollouts, we derive a kernelized Rényi estimator that resolves graded crowding among distinct repair cores beyond coarse exact-match counts. On 2,212 held-out GEMs, QuotientPO improves Success@32 from 17.93% to 20.10% (+12.1% relative) while consistently increasing distinct successful-core discovery under the same sampling budget. These results establish quotient-space exploration as a principled approach to mechanism-level discovery under verifier-induced equivalence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 QuotientPO 算法,通过商空间探索解决基因组级代谢模型(GEM)修复中表面多样性无法映射到科学假设多样性的问题。在 2,212 个测试 GEM 上,Success@32 从 17.93% 提升至 20.10%(相对提升 12.1%),并显著增加了成功修复核心的多样性。
AI.motivation: 科学模型修复中,验证器反馈可能认证一个解但不揭示哪个结构修正负责。GEM 修复存在多对一结构:多种反应编辑可解释相同表型,许多表面不同的编辑对应同一生物机制。这种隐藏失败模式使传统动作熵探索失效,因为输出空间的多样性未必转化为科学假设的多样性。
AI.method: QuotientPO 将等效修复通过验证器保持的规范化映射 κ_y 折叠为规范机制(修复核心),直接在商空间上优化探索。为解决有限采样下精确匹配的粗糙性问题,推导出基于符号 Jaccard 核的核化 Rényi 估计器,产生分级拥挤信号。该算法在 GRPO 框架中通过留一法线性化将群体熵分解为候选级拥挤成本,并结合 QPI 信用机制和冗余惩罚。
AI.result: 在 2,212 个独立测试 GEM 上的实验表明:QuotientPO 将 Success@32 从 17.93%(Vanilla GRPO)提升至 20.10%,且成功核心发现从 0.50 增至 0.57。结果显示 MaxEnt 和 GFlowNet 等原始空间多样性基线无法扩展机制多样性(超过 80% 的样本在规范化后坍缩)。机制分析表明,商探索同时提升成功质量 Z_x 和机制覆盖率,在相同成功预算下控制成功样本数量后仍保持优势,且对核带宽 h 和多样性权重 β 具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 商空间探索为验证器诱导等价下的机制级发现提供了原则性方法,在人工智能驱动科学推理中,探索应在等价类而非表面表示上定义。

title: Minimax Gaussian Mechanisms for Continual Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning updates a trained model after records are deleted, aiming to match exact retraining without repeating the full training procedure. We develop Gaussian mechanisms for Newton updates under sequential deletion requests. Using Gaussian differential privacy (GDP) and its adaptive composition rule, we show that the full sequence of released models is statistically difficult to distinguish from matched exact retraining. To calibrate these mechanisms for empirical risk minimization, we derive upper bounds on the error of the Newton approximation relative to exact retraining and on how this error changes after each deletion batch. Independent Gaussian noise is calibrated using bounds on the full residual at each release, whereas Gaussian random walk noise uses smaller bounds on residual increments. These bounds yield allocations minimizing the worst-case maximum noise variance across releases under the resulting GDP certification constraints. With count-based bounds, the random walk asymptotically matches the worst-case variance of a single release at deletion cap $M$, while independent noise incurs an additional factor of order $M$. Set-based bounds can reduce the noise variances by using gradients and Hessians of the deleted records. For singleton deletion, we further show that count-based independent noise, count-based random walk noise, and set-based independent noise are minimax among fixed Gaussian covariances under their respective residual or increment bounds. With set-based bounds, allowing variances to adapt to deleted records can improve on every fixed covariance by a factor of order $(\log M)^2$ on some data sequences. The residual and noise bounds also yield parameter and predictive consistency relative to exact retraining, uniformly over deletion policies. Simulations and a credit default data analysis evaluate bounds, noise variances, and estimation errors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究持续机器遗忘（continual machine unlearning）问题，针对顺序删除请求设计高斯机制以在满足高斯差分隐私（GDP）认证的同时高效更新模型。核心贡献包括：推导牛顿近似残差及其增量的上界（基于删除计数或删除集合本身）、优化独立噪声（IND）与高斯随机游走（RW）机制的噪声方差分配、证明在固定协方差类中 IND 和 RW 在各自残差/增量界下具有极小极大最优性、给出在删除策略一致下相对于精确重训练的一致性条件，并通过合成与信用违约数据实验验证了 RW 在噪声方差和估计误差上均优于 IND。
AI.motivation: GDPR 等法规要求从已训练模型中删除特定记录的影响。精确重训练成本过高，现有一步牛顿近似方法的噪声校准未考虑序列释放的复合效应，且在大删除量下方差过大。需要研究如何在连续删除场景下，以高斯差分隐私为准则，在自适应删除请求下同时实现低噪声方差与统计一致性。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 构造计数型与基于删除集合的残差/增量界，覆盖所有满足删除上限的删除集合及其转换，以支持自适应删除；(2) 在 GDP 预算约束下，通过 Cauchy-Schwarz 等不等式推导最坏情况最大噪声方差的极小极大下界，并给出达到该下界的方差分配方案；(3) 将遗忘与精确重训练之间的认证问题转化为对联合高斯协方差矩阵的二次约束，并利用半正定规划对偶和分层区间分解构造，在固定协方差类中证明 IND 和 RW 的极小极大最优性；(4) 利用鞅极大不等式与均方误差分解建立相对于精确重训练的参数、预测和 GED 一致性。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 证明 RW 在最坏情况最大方差上比 IND 少一个量级为 M 的因子；(2) 证明 RW 的渐近方差与单次释放基准一致，而 IND 多出 M/5 倍；(3) 证明计数型 IND、计数型 RW、基于集合的 IND 在各自残差或增量界下于固定协方差类中极小极大最优；基于集合的 RW 通过自适应方差可获得最多 (log M)^2 倍的改进；(4) 给出 RW 的一致性条件弱于 IND：RW 要求 r_cnt(M)→0，IND 还需额外 √M 因子；(5) 合成实验显示 RW 在参数、预测、GED 误差上均低于 IND，且在超过 IND 一致性范围的删除上限 M∝n^{9/10} 下，IND 误差发散而 RW 收敛；信用违约数据分析验证了类似结论。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明：在连续机器遗忘场景下，将高斯随机游走机制与基于残差增量的校准相结合，可在固定 GDP 认证保证下获得与单次释放基准相当的最坏情况噪声方差，同时保证相对于精确重训练的一致性。设置型 RW 通过自适应方差进一步超越任何固定协方差机制。该框架为高效、统计有效且可认证的连续遗忘提供了理论基础。

title: Neural Networks for Temporal Pattern Recognition and Dynamic Arm Gesture Speed Estimation for Robot Control
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Published in Proceedings of the Intelligent Robotics FAIR 2026 (IntRob '26), June 18-19, 2026, Budapest, Hungary, ACM
summary: Deploying intelligent robotic systems that interact with humans through gestures requires neural networks capable of recognizing diverse temporal patterns. We present a systematic benchmark of ten abstract sequential tasks--five permutation-invariant (set) and five order-dependent (sequence) problems--evaluated across eighteen neural network architectures spanning recurrent, convolutional, attention-based, and set-function families. Beyond the core architecture-task grid, we explore numerous preprocessing and target-variable transformations, yielding more than 250 distinct experimental configurations. All variants are trained and tested under strictly identical conditions (fixed random seeds, shared hyperparameters, shared data splits) to ensure fair and reproducible comparison. Ranking across all ten tasks reveals four consistently top-performing architectures--BiGRU, TCN, Conv1D, and GRUReLU--all compact enough for real-time deployment (under 2,000 parameters in the benchmark setting). Based on this ranking, we apply three architecturally diverse top models (BiGRU, TCN, and GRUReLU) to a practical robotics problem: estimating the execution speed of dynamic arm gestures from skeletal keypoint sequences. Three speed interpretations (peak count, period time, and mean spike spacing) are evaluated on a custom dataset of eight traffic-related gesture classes comprising 256,710 frames recorded via OpenPose. The best configuration achieves a mean absolute error of 0.198 on the peak-count interpretation, corresponding to roughly 5% relative error, while the period-time interpretation reaches approximately 4% relative error, and the mean spike spacing interpretation approximately 8% relative error. These results demonstrate that neural networks can reliably estimate gesture speed from skeletal data, opening a path toward speed-aware gesture-controlled robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对面向人机交互的动态手势速度估计任务,系统性地基准测试了18种神经网络架构在10个抽象时序任务上的表现,最终筛选出BiGRU、TCN、GRUReLU应用于真实手势骨骼关键点数据的速度回归,峰值计数解释下MAE仅0.198(约5%相对误差)。
AI.motivation: 在交通指挥等安全关键场景中,手势执行的"速度"与手势"类型"同样具有语义信息(如急促手势代表紧急指令)。现有手势识别系统(如作者前期GRU分类器)对速度变化不敏感,无法直接测量执行速度。同时,对于何种神经网络架构最适合处理抽象时序模式(尤其是速度估计所需的局部极值检测、周期结构识别等能力),缺乏系统性比较。
AI.method: 两阶段方法:(1)基准阶段——设计10个抽象任务(5个排列不变的集合任务如决策/计数/方差/均值/最大值,5个顺序依赖的序列任务如速度/峰值计数/周期时长/脉冲间距/阈值穿越),在严格相同的训练条件(固定随机种子、共享超参数Adam lr=0.01、batch=32、200 epoch+早停)下评估18种架构(6种循环、2种卷积、3种注意力、6种集合函数、1种基线),共250+配置,采用稠密秩聚合得到全局排序。(2)应用阶段——基于排名选取BiGRU、TCN、GRUReLU三种架构多样化的顶级模型,在OpenPose BODY-25提取的8类交通手势骨骼数据(256,710帧)上,以5个关节角序列(50帧滑动窗口)为输入,以距离曲线局部极小值的三种统计(峰值数、周期时长、平均间距)为回归目标进行速度估计。
AI.result: 基准结果:BiGRU与TCN并列第一(Σrank=31),Conv1D第二(43),GRUReLU第三(46),四者均<2000参数;Transformer在集合任务上表现优秀(ΣSET=19)但在序列任务上明显落后(ΣSEQ=35),验证了集合任务表现不能预测整体质量。真实应用:BiGRU在峰值计数(MAE=0.198,约5%相对误差)和脉冲间距(MAE=2.193,约8%相对误差)上最优;GRUReLU在周期时长上最优(MAE=1.320,约4%相对误差);TCN在三项真实数据任务上均最弱,与基准排名形成反转——原因在于其膨胀卷积在多通道(d=5)输入下需共享容量,削弱了对1D时序模式的检测优势。所有模型偏差接近零,误差标准差有界,无明显重尾,适合实时部署。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了:(1)紧凑型循环与一维卷积架构(BiGRU、TCN、Conv1D、GRUReLU)是抽象时序模式识别的最稳健选择;(2)系统性的架构基准能够有效指导实际机器人任务的模型选择;(3)神经网络可从骨骼关键点直接估计手势执行速度,相对误差4%–8%,为速度感知的手势控制机器人系统开辟了路径;(4)基准排名基于标量序列,迁移到多变量实际输入时可能反转,TCN即是典型反例。未来方向包括端到端速度感知手势控制、手势无关的速度估计、以及针对关键点抖动和遮挡的鲁棒性扩展。

title: LTBD: Learnable Trust-Boundary Delimiters for Prompt Injection Defense
summary: Large language models (LLMs) perform remarkably well on complex tasks, yet remain highly vulnerable to prompt injection attacks, where malicious instructions embedded in external data can override user intent. Existing defenses remain limited by model fine-tuning requirements, vulnerability to adaptive attacks, or reliance on brittle handcrafted prompts. We argue that a fundamental source of this vulnerability is the lack of an explicit representation of trust provenance. To address this, we introduce Learnable Trust-Boundary Delimiters (LTBD), a lightweight defense that explicitly encodes trust boundaries in the input while keeping the LLM parameters unchanged. LTBD uses a small number of learnable delimiters to distinguish trusted user instructions from untrusted external data, enabling the model to better respect the intended trust hierarchy. Experimental results show that LTBD substantially outperforms inference-time defenses and performs competitively with training-based approaches, while preserving benign-task utility and introducing negligible inference overhead. In particular, LTBD achieves 0.00% ASR on AlpacaFarm and only 0.11-0.19% ASR on TaskTracker. LTBD also remains effective under adaptive attacks, where adversaries have full knowledge of the defense and explicitly attempt to bypass it.

AI.tldr: LTBD提出了一种轻量级的提示注入防御方法，通过学习四个可训练的分隔符嵌入（标记可信指令区域和不可信数据区域的开始与结束），在冻结基础LLM参数的情况下显式编码信任边界，从而帮助模型区分可信指令与不可信外部数据。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM缺乏对信任来源（trust provenance）的显式表示机制，导致可信指令和潜在对抗性外部内容在同一输入序列中被同等处理，使得提示注入攻击能够覆盖用户意图。现有防御方法（提示工程、模型微调、通用防御token嵌入）均存在局限性：提示方法脆弱，微调方法对闭源模型不可行且可能改变模型原有行为，通用防御token未明确建模信任边界。
AI.method: LTBD引入两对可学习的分隔符token T = {t_IB, t_IE, t_DB, t_DE}，分别标记可信指令区域和不可信数据区域的开始与结束。输入格式为 x_T = [t_IB; I; t_IE; t_DB; D̂; t_DE]。训练时冻结LLM全部参数θ，仅优化四个分隔符的嵌入矩阵 T ∈ R^(4×e)。训练目标为 L = L_CE + λ·L_pref，其中交叉熵损失保持原始任务行为，偏好损失（基于DPO式的sigmoid对比）增加良性响应y+相对于攻击诱导响应y-的相对似然。训练数据中一半为良性样本，另一半注入Ignore、Completion或作者提出的Delimiter-Spoof攻击变体。
AI.result: 在四个LLM（Llama3-8B、Llama3.1-8B、Falcon3-7B、Qwen2.5-7B）上的实验表明：LTBD在AlpacaFarm上实现0.00% ASR，在TaskTracker上仅0.11-0.19% ASR，显著优于推理时防御方法，并与训练型防御方法（StruQ、SecAlign）具有竞争力。同时，LTBD在所有模型上保持了最高的AlpacaFarm WinRate（效用），并在8个效用评估中有6个匹配或超过未防御模型。在自适应攻击（Delimiter-Spoof）下，LTBD仍保持稳健（Llama3-8B和Falcon3-7B的ASR仍为0.00%，Qwen2.5-7B仅从0.00%升至0.48%）。消融实验验证了边界放置和偏好损失的必要性。
AI.conclusion: LTBD通过显式学习输入层面的信任边界，提供了一种简单、高效且有效的提示注入防御方案。仅优化四个token嵌入即可实现强鲁棒性、保持良性任务效用、引入可忽略的推理开销，表明信任边界的显式可学习化是提示注入防御的有效轻量化途径，且其安全性源于学习到的嵌入与真实结构信任边界的关联，而非分隔符的表面文本形式。

title: UXBench Pro: Benchmarking Personalized User Experience in Multi-Turn Dialogue Interactions
summary: Evaluating user experience (UX) with automated computational methods has gained increasing attention, supported by empirical evidence from UXBench. However, binary preference prediction provides limited insight, while relying on a single user-agnostic reward model overlooks the inherent heterogeneity of users, whose expectations can differ substantially. In this paper, we present UXBench Pro, comprising 1{,}000 test instances derived from real user interactions across 12 task scenarios and 82 domains. Each instance is paired with a FACTORS user profile that characterizes the user through seven interpretable behavioral facets, differentiating user groups. To provide richer evaluation insights, we introduce a dual-perspective paradigm that combines a personalized User Reward Model (URM) for third-person judgment with Sim4Eval, a user simulator that enables multi-turn interactions and provides first-person evaluation across four cognitive state dimensions. To assess the reliability of these based evaluators, we further introduce two meta-benchmarks, URMBench and USimBench, that evaluate how faithfully they reproduce real human preferences and behaviors. Extensive experiments reveal seven key findings that highlight the importance of user modeling and multi-perspective evaluation, offering a fresh perspective on user-centric benchmarking and motivating personalized model optimization.

AI.tldr: UXBench Pro 是一个面向个性化用户体验评估的基准测试，包含 1000 个来自真实用户交互的测试实例，覆盖 12 个任务场景和 82 个领域。它通过 FACTORS 七维用户画像来表征用户异质性，并采用"双视角"评估范式：第三方的个性化用户奖励模型（URM）与第一人称的用户模拟器 Sim4Eval，辅以 URM-Bench 和 USimBench 两个元基准来验证评估器的可靠性，最终得出七项关于用户建模和多视角评估重要性的核心发现。
AI.motivation: 现有 UX 评估存在三大不足：(1) 二元偏好信号粒度粗、可解释性差；(2) 单一用户无关的奖励模型假设了"普适性用户体验"，掩盖了用户异质性；(3) 评估多聚焦于单轮交互，忽视了多轮对话中满意度的动态演化。为真实反映 AI 助手在实际异质用户群体中的体验质量，需要建立个性化、多轮、用户感知的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出 UXBench Pro 基准（1000 实例 + FACTORS 七维用户画像：Feedback、Age、Consumption、Technology、Occupation、Region、Schooling）；构建流程包含数据清洗、双层安全审查与去标识化、多智能体质量保证、人工四阶段审核。方法上提出双视角评估范式：(1) 第三方视角的 URM——基于 Hunyuan-3 对比三种奖励建模形式（Pointwise GRM、BTRM、Pairwise GRM）和三种偏好信号（regeneration、dual-answer、pointwise）；(2) 第一人称视角的 Sim4Eval 用户模拟器，包含检索增强型 RAG 模拟器，基于 TF-IDF 检索 135,915 条真实后续轮次进行增强，并输出四个认知状态维度（目标进展、情感契合、认知契合、互动偏好）。进一步提出两个元基准：URM-Bench（800 实例，评估 URM 是否按真实用户偏好排序）和 USimBench（150 实例，评估模拟器在反馈信号、语义和交互风格上的保真度）。
AI.result: 在 7 个主流助手（Qwen3.7-Max、DeepSeek-v4-pro、Hunyuan-3、GLM-5.2、Claude-Opus-4.8、GPT-5.5、Gemini-3.1-Pro）上的实验产生七项核心发现：(1) 第三方和第一人称评估排序对齐但互补（Turn BT 与 Resolution 相关性 ρ=0.857）；(2) 个性化的价值高度依赖被评估对象与评估者是否知情，沉默/轻度反馈用户占多数会拉低整体收益；(3) 个性化是有选择性的能力，其价值随交互上下文丰富而下降；(4) 助手更擅长修复事实错误，但冗余和格式问题（占 34.7%）最难修复；(5) Pairwise GRM + 再生偏好信号在 URM-Bench 上达 0.7688 PairAcc，逼近人类基线 0.8271；(6) RAG 检索在 12 个模型中 11 个提升语言保真度，但行为保真度仍依赖基础模型；(7) 行为锚定的评分尺度相比通用五点量表显著降低状态僵化（联合塌缩从最高 82% 降至 ≤5.7%）。
AI.conclusion: UXBench Pro 证实个性化对话评估不能简化为更强大的响应评估器或更详细的用户档案：画像条件化在偏好真正依赖用户且上下文稀疏时最有效，但在群体平均或画像盲评估下效果消失。个性化能力也区别于通用模型质量——更强助手并不更善于利用画像信息，通用风格调整（如缩短回答）反而降低偏好。多轮评估揭示了响应级基准的互补局限：解决率、放弃率和成对偏好捕捉到交互的不同属性，呼吁将对话 UX 视为基于行为的多维信号集合而非单一普适分数。元基准化应在部署计算评估器前验证其对用户语境的敏感性以及对真实人类偏好和行为的保真度。

title: Phonologically Informed Tokenization for German Speech Recognition: A Cross-Domain Study
summary: German is a morphologically rich language whose syllable structure is exceptionally well-predicted by the Knuth--Liang hyphenation algorithm. We ask whether phonologically informed tokenization can serve as a competitive target for end-to-end speech recognition. We compare three tokenizer families on the Omnilingual ASR wav2vec 2.0 backbone fine-tuned with CTC: the pretrained multilingual character inventory, a data-driven Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) over orthography, and phonologically informed units from Pyphen syllabification and grapheme-to-phoneme conversion. Across 40 fine-tunes, we evaluate on three German test sets spanning orthogonal shifts: in-domain read speech, dialectal spontaneous speech, and standard-German spontaneous speech. In-domain, all phonologically informed tokenizers match BPE and the multilingual character baseline on both WER and CER. Under domain shift the picture splits along vocabulary size rather than the linguistic axis of variation: at small vocabularies, syllable-aware tokenization improves on dialectal speech, where phonetic surface forms vary but syllable structure is preserved, and stays ahead on spontaneous speech, where new word-forms violate vocabulary closure. A phoneme-level confusion analysis further shows that all tokenizers commit the same canonical function-word errors, indicating that the acoustic encoder, not the tokenizer, dominates the error topology. Our findings suggest that tokenizer choice may depend on the vocabulary budget as much as on the distribution shift expected at deployment rather than reducing to a single universal optimum.

AI.tldr: 本文针对德语语音识别任务,系统比较了三类分词器(字符、BPE、语音学先验单元)在 Omnilingual ASR wav2vec 2.0 + CTC 框架下的表现,跨三个测试集(域内、方言口音、对话体即兴语篇)评估了 40 个微调模型,核心结论是:语音学先验分词器在域内与 BPE/字符基线持平,但在小词表条件下对域外数据具有显著优势,而该优势随词表增大发生反转;声学编码器主导错误拓扑,分词器只是辅助调谐杠杆。
AI.motivation: 现代端到端 ASR 系统通常采用数据驱动的 BPE 或预训练的多语言字符表作为输出单元,这两种默认方案均忽略了目标语言的音节与音素结构。德语作为形态丰富、方言变异显著的语言,是检验"音系学先验分词器"是否能带来额外收益的理想测试场景;但既有工作要么在受控域内条件下比较,要么未系统考察结构化域偏移下的行为,缺乏对分词器选型与部署场景之间关系的深入刻画。
AI.method: 在 961 小时德语 Common Voice + Spoken Wikipedia 训练集上,对 Omnilingual ASR wav2vec 2.0 进行 40 次 CTC 微调(31 个 300M 分词器 + 9 个 1B 分词器),仅改变输出分词器一项变量:13 个正字法分词器(字符 omni-vocab、数据驱动 German-BPE-{512,1024,2048}、Pyphen 音节 syllable-{512,1024,2048}、跨音节合并 multisyl-{512,1024,2048}、无分隔符 multisyl-nosep)与 18 个音素分词器(原始 IPA、phoneme-BPE、phoneme-syllable、phoneme-multisyl 等)。在三个测试集上评估:域内 CV+SWC 测试集、方言口音 BAS RVG 1(语音表层偏移)、即兴对话 BAS Verbmobil(词汇项偏移);采用配对 bootstrap 显著性检验(10,000 次重采样,seed=42)与音素混淆矩阵分析,并在 mHuBERT-147 上做二骨架复现。
AI.result: 域内场景:所有语音学先验分词器与 BPE、字符基线在 WER/CER 上无显著差异(300M 下 German-BPE-512 最优 14.93%,1B 下 omni-vocab 最优 11.65%);音素轨道 17 个收敛模型的 PER 集中于 17.5–20.0% 区间。域外偏移:小词表(|V|≤1024)下音节感知分词器在两类 OOD 上均领先——RVG 1-ORT 上 multisyl-512-1B 达 35.75% WER(omni-vocab 36.83%,p=0.019,处于 Bonferroni 边界 α/k≈0.017);Verbmobil-ORT 上 syllable-512-1B 达 21.27% WER(领先 omni-vocab 与所有 German-BPE 变体)。词表-族系交互:C2 交互对比显示 Syllable 与 German-BPE 的 WER 差值 Δ 在 |V|=512 时为 -8.5pp(RVG 1)/-4.2pp(Verbmobil),在 |V|=2048 时反转为 +1.5pp/+1.4pp(交互对比 p<0.001)。混淆矩阵分析:18 个音素分词器的前 5 替换对为完全相同的双向功能词混淆(der↔die、und↔der 等),表明错误拓扑由声学编码器决定而非分词器;mHuBERT-147 复现了 C1 与 C3 方向。
AI.conclusion: 语音学先验分词器在德语 ASR 中具有明确的实用价值定位:域内零损失、域外小词表条件下的稳健收益、与声学编码器互补而非竞争。分词器选型应作为面向部署场景(词汇预算与预期分布偏移类型)的调谐杠杆,而非追求单一全局最优;未来工作方向包括音素到字素解码器、LM rescoring 与分词器的交互,以及将语言学先验与域自适应预训练等编码器侧改进结合。

title: One Skill Too Many: How Co-Installed Skills Conflict in Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents are extended with agent skills, directories whose this http URL tells the model when and how to perform a task. Because skills come from independent sources (teams, developers, plugins, copied collections), an installed skill can be co-installed with a similar skill doing the same job, and the model picks between them by name and description alone. In a conflict, the installed skill loses core functions (e.g., a ban on touching git) because the similar skill runs instead or changes what it does. The task still passes, so benchmarks that check only task completion miss such cases. We present the first empirical study of such conflicts. From snapshots of 20,947 repositories, we mine 822,109 candidate similar-skill pairs, have an LLM judge a stratified sample of 3,754, and run 312 confirmed pairs on three models (6,368 runs, 169,294 tool calls, 542 agent-hours). We report five findings. (1) Conflict-prone skills are common: nearly one in four installed skills is co-installed with one that does the same job, and 37% of judged skills sit inside copied collections. (2) Most such pairs involve normative skills, then capability skills. (3) Without lowering task completion, a similar skill takes one in five runs from the installed skill, and runs that open the similar skill first lose over a third of the exclusive core functions that only the installed skill fulfills. (4) Install location decides which skill runs, listing order barely matters, and the final reply names the skill used in only 0.9% of substituted runs. (5) Conflicts are decided at the first skill read, almost always before any file is changed, and a pre-tool hook at that read restores fidelity on exclusive core functions to the level of runs that open the installed skill first. Benchmarks should thus score exclusive core functions, and platforms should guard the first read and show which skill ran.

AI.tldr: 本文是首个针对编码代理中"技能冲突"（skill conflict）的实证研究。当两个功能相似的技能被同时安装（co-install）时，模型会基于名称和描述二选一，导致用户安装的技能 A 失去其独占的"核心功能"（如禁止修改 git），但任务依然能通过，从而被现有基准测试遗漏。研究从 20,947 个仓库中挖掘 82 万对候选相似技能，对 3,754 对进行 LLM 判定，并在 312 对确认技能上跨三种模型运行了 6,368 次实验。核心发现：约四分之一的已安装技能存在功能相似的共存技能；相似技能会在不影响任务完成的前提下抢走约 20% 的运行，并使 A 的独占核心功能保真度下降 5.6 个百分点；冲突在技能首次读取时即已决定，且在该读取处设置 pre-tool hook 可将保真度恢复至仅安装 A 时的水平。
AI.motivation: 随着 Claude Code 等编码代理广泛使用"agent skills"（以 SKILL.md 文件形式存在的自然语言指令包），技能可能来自团队、个人、插件、复制的合集等多个独立来源，因此两个完成相同任务的技能可能被同时安装而无人察觉。当相似技能取代用户安装的技能时，其核心功能（如安全规则、团队规范）会丢失，但任务通常仍能完成——这使得仅检查任务完成度的现有基准完全无法发现此类问题。此前尚无系统研究考察技能冲突对核心功能的影响、平台与模型如何解决冲突、是否告知用户以及冲突在何处决定、能否拦截。
AI.method: 研究在 Claude Code 上进行受控实验，分四阶段：① 从 20,947 个仓库快照重建安装列表（5,106 个），使用 GPT-6 Astra 判定仓库类型；② 用 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B 计算描述相似度，挖掘 82 万对候选技能，由 LLM judge 判定是否"做同一工作"，分层抽样 3,754 对，确认 1,639 对；③ 从每个技能的文本中提取"核心功能"（引述、可在输出中核查的独有要求），分为独占/共享两类，并构建包含请求、起始仓库和检查脚本的实验用例；④ 对 312 对在三种 Claude 模型（Sonnet 4.6、Haiku 4.5、Opus 5）上以多组配置运行：仅 A、仅 B、A+B、交换顺序、personal 作用域、plugin 作用域、A+C（不相关技能对照），共 5,166 次运行；另对 187 个 pair-model 组合加 pre-tool hook 进行守卫实验。总计 6,368 次运行、169,294 次工具调用、542 代理小时。所有 LLM 辅助步骤均经两名人类评分员抽样验证（Krippendorff's α 0.74–0.88）。
AI.result: （1）冲突易发技能很普遍：约四分之一已安装技能在同一安装列表中存在功能相似的技能，37% 在复制了整个技能合集的项目中；约三分之二的已安装技能可从其他作者处找到功能相似的技能。（2）冲突配对主要为规范性技能（cross-project 60%、within-project 56%），其次是能力性技能。（3）相似技能在不降低任务完成率的前提下，使 A 的使用率下降 19.9 个百分点，使其对独占核心功能的保真度下降 5.6 个百分点；相似技能比不相关技能多导致 14.0 个百分点的 A 使用率下降和 2.6 个百分点的保真度下降；36% 的保真度损失来自完全未使用 A 的运行（替换），45% 来自未使用任一技能的运行，仅 20% 来自 A 与 B 都使用时的干扰。（4）安装位置决定哪个技能被使用，列出顺序影响极小（仅 +0.6pp）；同名个人技能覆盖项目技能，但模型在 29.2% 运行中仍读取项目技能文件；插件技能仅在 2.9% 运行中被使用；冲突发生时最终回复命名所用技能的比例仅 0.9%。（5）冲突在技能首次读取时即决定（97% 运行在该读取时尚未修改任何文件）；先读取 B 使 A 的独占核心功能保真度下降 9.4 个百分点；在该首次读取处部署拒绝读取 B 的 pre-tool hook，可使模型在 96% 的拒绝中切换至 A，并将独占核心功能保真度恢复至先读 A 的水平（提升 9.1 个百分点，每个模型均显著）。
AI.conclusion: 技能冲突"隐藏在成功背后"：仅检查任务完成度的基准无法察觉用户安装技能的核心功能（特别是独占核心功能）被相似技能悄悄取代。研究建议：（1）基准应同时评分独占核心功能，并可故意 co-install 相似技能以检测冲突；（2）代理平台应在会话开始时警告同名个人技能覆盖项目技能、显示技能来源与作用域，并在技能的首次读取处提供 pre-tool hook 守卫与锁定机制，显示本次运行实际使用的技能；（3）技能作者应使用独特名称和精确描述以避免被错误路由；（4）用户应审查个人目录中的覆盖技能，复制合集的项目应移除与已装技能重复的项。该研究是首个针对良性、共安装、功能相似技能之间冲突的系统实证分析。

title: SkillContrast: Difference-Guided Text Selection for Agent Skill Reranking
summary: Similar agent skills can share instructions but differ in their conditions of use. Query-based text selection may retain shared instructions and omit these distinctions. We introduce SkillContrast, a training-free selector that compares retrieved skills and retains their differing text with local context for a pretrained reranker. On 1,235 requests from SameCapRisk-Bench, it yields 54-72 more clean hits (requests that retrieve a helpful skill without its marked risky sibling) than TF-IDF query selection at identical per-candidate input lengths, across 2 retrievers and 2 reranker sizes. Length-matched component replacements identify differing text as the main contributor in the primary setting, with smaller, mixed context effects. Relative to full skill bodies, SkillContrast uses 51.1-58.8% fewer model-input tokens, with 10-18 fewer clean hits at 0.6B and matching or higher observed clean-hit counts at 4B. Candidate-relative differences thus complement query relevance in selecting compact reranking inputs.

AI.tldr: SkillContrast提出了一种无需训练的文本选择方法，通过比较检索到的相似技能候选之间的差异文本（而非基于查询相关性），为预训练重排序器提供更紧凑且能暴露适用条件差异的输入。
AI.motivation: 代理技能库中存在多个相似技能，它们共享查询相关指令但适用条件不同。传统的基于查询的文本选择会保留共享的指令而遗漏关键的条件差异，导致重排序器无法区分这些技能。
AI.method: 方法核心是对检索到的候选技能进行差异引导的文本选择：(1) 使用TF-IDF表示技能全文，对余弦相似度≥0.65的候选进行连接分量分组；(2) 在分量内逐行对齐文本，将差异映射到段落和代码块，保留差异块、前导上下文和开头块；(3) 无邻居的候选退回到基于查询的TF-IDF单元选择；(4) 使用冻结的Qwen3-Reranker进行打分，结合MMR(λ=0.75)平衡相关性与冗余度。
AI.result: 在SameCapRisk-Bench的1,235个请求上，使用2个检索器（SkillSight、SkillRet）和2个重排序器规模（0.6B、4B）进行评估：(1) 在相同输入长度下，比TF-IDF查询选择多54-72个clean hits（检索到有用技能且不含其风险兄弟）；(2) 模型输入token减少51.1-58.8%；(3) 0.6B模型上比全文少10-18个clean hits，4B模型上匹配或超过全文表现；(4) 组件替换实验确认差异文本是主要贡献因素（替换差异导致-78 clean hits），而上下文替换影响较小。
AI.conclusion: 候选间差异作为补充信号，能有效选择紧凑且能暴露适用条件的重排序输入。在4B模型上，紧凑输入可匹配或超越全文效果。评估仅基于技能文本和基准标注，未实际执行技能或测试代理在用户上的行为。CleanHit仅排除标记的风险兄弟，而非所有不安全候选。未来工作应在独立的技能库和适用性标签上验证。

title: Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture for Expertise-Adaptive Qualitative Interviews Using Local LLMs
comment: Accepted to be part of the book titled: AI in Education : Pedagogy, Ethics, and Society which will be published by Springer Nature in the Book series: Transactions on Computational Science and Computational Intelligence
summary: Automated interviewers and conversational agents are increasingly used in research, recruitment, customer service, and education. However, many existing systems rely on fixed question sequences and provide limited context-based personalization without considering participants' knowledge, which can lead to repetitive or irrelevant follow-up questions. Therefore, there is a need for an adaptive interviewing system that can adjust question depth while maintaining conversational continuity and semantic progression. To address this, an Evidence-Traceable Dynamic Interviewer Architecture is presented using a locally hosted Large Language Model (LLM), with the interview continuously adapted throughout the entire conversation based on the participant's responses and evolving context. The interviewer profiles participants' expertise in real time to generate knowledge-appropriate questions, well-articulated responses, and smooth transition messages that support conversational continuity. A five-module prompt-driven architecture and persistent interview-state record support these functions. The interviewer was evaluated with 246 participants. Expertise Profiling module (M3) showed 78.9% exact agreement with independently reported participant expertise, with a weighted Cohen's K of 0.80. Generate Iterative Questions module (M4) showed a strong expertise-complexity association (p=.79, p<.001), and participants reported high relevance (mean 4.41), engagement (mean 4.32), and satisfaction (mean 4.38), providing evidence that the architecture's adaptive components operated consistently with their intended functions while participants reported a positive interview experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于本地大语言模型（Llama 3.2 3B）的"可追溯证据动态面试官架构"，通过五个模块（系统提示生成、初始问题生成、专长画像、自适应迭代问题生成、问题唯一性验证）实现专长自适应的定性访谈。在246名参与者中验证：M3专长分类与自我报告一致性达78.9%（加权κ=0.80），M4问题复杂度与专长水平强相关（ρ=.79），M5接受94%候选问题且能识别6%的语义重复，访谈相关性、参与度和满意度均高于4.3/5。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化访谈系统多依赖固定问题序列，缺乏基于参与者知识水平的上下文个性化，容易产生重复或不相关追问。需要一种能在整个对话过程中持续适应参与者专长水平、保持对话连贯性与语义递进的适应性访谈架构，同时本地部署以保护隐私。
AI.method: 提出五模块提示驱动架构：(M1)将设计时配置转化为结构化系统提示；(M2)生成低复杂度初始问题作为基线标定；(M3)从参与者回答中按四个因素（术语特异性、概念正确性、推理深度、应用/评价）动态推断四档专长（Novice→Expert）；(M4)结合专长画像、对话历史、研究优先级生成"回应消息+过渡消息+下一个问题"三段式输出；(M5)通过语义相似性验证候选问题唯一性，拒绝重复并触发重生成。持久化访谈状态记录贯穿全程，确保证据可追溯。技术实现采用本地部署的Llama 3.2 3B模型。
AI.result: 246名员工完成关于工作场所LLM使用的访谈（每场16题，共3690条自适应追问）。M3与自我报告专长的精确一致性78.9%，加权Cohen's κ=0.80；M4推断专长与追问复杂度Spearman ρ=.79（p<.001），从Novice平均1.42升至Expert的3.56；M5接受94.0%首轮候选，6.0%因语义重叠被拒绝并重生成；参与者相关性4.41、参与度4.32、满意度4.38（5分制）。
AI.conclusion: 该架构证实专长画像对追问深度具有功能性影响而非仅分类标签，语义验证机制可有效过滤重复问题，证据可追溯性支持审查决策链。局限性在于仅验证单一模型（Llama 3.2 3B），未来需跨模型评估稳健性，并拓展至多语言、更多研究领域与定性分析流水线集成。

title: Harness Evolution Hits a Ceiling: When Weight Training Should Begin
summary: Improving a long-horizon LLM agent means evolving the harness around a frozen model or training its weights. We let a self-evolving harness make the system stronger first, then cross seed and evolved harnesses with base and trained weights to learn which gains the trained model keeps and which still need the runtime. We show that the right lever can be read off the agent's failure composition: labelling failed trajectories by the first signal that fires separates process failures (blocked calls, loops, exhausted step budgets) from content failures (a delivered plan that is poor). Harness evolution repairs the former, the behaviour it instils can be trained into the weights, and content failures are what weight training is for. On DeepPlanning, a self-evolving harness loop lifts the held-out score of Qwen3.5-4B from 0.16 to 0.30 and of Qwen3.5-9B from 0.32 to 0.44; for 4B, held-out delivery rises from 55% to 90% while content failures are left for the weights. LoRA adapters trained on evolved-harness trajectories internalise the gain: under the original harness they add +0.13 on held-out tasks for both sizes; on 4B they stack with the harness to more than double the held-out score, and on 9B the adapter alone matches the full evolution line, cutting content failures from a quarter of trajectories to one in twenty. A placebo adapter trained on answer-shuffled trajectories falls below the base model. The loop transfers to WebArena-Lite (+0.09 on 117 unseen tasks), where the gain lives in what the model sees and adapters do not add to it. The result is a diagnose-then-intervene rule applied twice: read the failure composition to choose between harness and weights, then read what the accepted edits changed to decide which gains to train in. Scores are four-rollout means against fresh anchors, same-night except where marked, across eight models from six families and two benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究长视野LLM智能体改进的两条路径——演化harness（围绕冻结模型的运行时框架）与训练权重——的边界与协同。基于失败组成（失败分类F1-F4）提出诊断-干预规则：harness消除过程性失败（F2-F3）且其行为增益可被训练入权重，而内容性失败（F4）是权重训练的目标。在DeepPlanning和WebArena-Lite两个基准、8个模型6个家族上验证，并通过LoRA适配器、安慰剂对照、组件消融等方式证明该规则的普适性与失效条件。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体改进研究多聚焦单一杠杆（仅harness演化或仅权重微调），缺乏统一的诊断框架来决定何时使用哪一杠杆。二者评估成本高且单次rollout分数噪声大，故需基于能抵御噪声的测量来建立杠杆选择规则。
AI.method: （1）提出四类失败分类法F1-F4（证据缺失/harness摩擦/执行失控/规划能力不足），由自动检查器根据首条触发信号标记每条轨迹；（2）测量协议：四rollout均值，单rollout标准差中位数0.023，可分辨差值阈值0.035，每轮配置后锚定新基准；（3）harness自演化循环（AHE风格）：proposer模型提议harness编辑，judge验证；（4）LoRA适配器（rank 32）训练于演化harness产生的轨迹，配置qkvo或qkvo+MLP；（5）安慰剂控制：打乱answer训练；（6）跨9条演化线（8个模型、6个家族）和WebArena-Lite基准验证。
AI.result: Qwen3.5-4B held-out分数从0.16→0.30（harness）+ LoRA进一步至0.38（堆叠）；Qwen3.5-9B从0.32→0.44（harness），LoRA单独即可匹配harness水平。F4失败类在两线上均未被harness降低。4B适配器提升交付率与减少循环（F3），9B适配器将F4从25%降至5%。安慰剂适配器低于基线。WebArena-Lite迁移增益+0.09，但增益来源于模型所"见"（保留两页历史而非一页），适配器无法复现。种子测量将9条线分为三组：交付计划得分≥0.27且F4非最大类时harness杠杆有效；得分0.13-0.17时harness无效；交付饱和且F4主导时杠杆转向权重。
AI.conclusion: 得出"先诊断后干预"规则：测量噪声底线、交付率、交付质量与F1-F4组成后分支决策——交付低质时harness无效；交付未饱和或F3主导时演化harness；交付饱和且F4主导时训练权重；二者实施后F4仍存则需将评分器失败组成暴露给proposer。对已获harness增益而言：编辑改变模型"写"什么则训练可内化，编辑改变模型"看"什么则增益保留在harness中。

title: DIAL-OPD: Learning More from Fewer Tokens in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated trajectories with token-level teacher signals. Its sampled-token variant avoids the cost of full-vocabulary probabilities. Yet we find that training on fewer tokens can outperform full-token OPD, challenging the intuition that more supervision improves learning. This motivates selecting tokens by learning value. Existing disagreement-based criteria ignore probability scale: tokens assigned negligible probability by both models, termed low-low tokens, can receive large log-ratio rewards and hinder learning. We propose DIAL-OPD, a token-selection method that bridges log-probability and probability spaces by weighting reward magnitude with the logarithmic mean of teacher and student probabilities. A parameter beta controls this weighting, and the highest-scoring tokens are retained. Across 4 teacher-student pairs and 7 mathematical reasoning benchmarks, we compare DIAL-OPD with 9 baselines. Retaining only 40% of tokens, it outperforms Vanilla OPD and its full-token variants, with mean accuracy gains reaching 5.25 percentage points over Vanilla OPD, and doubles AIME25 Pass@16 from 13.33% to 26.67%. It also achieves up to an 18% relative improvement in mean accuracy over the strongest token-selection baseline at matched retention ratios. With a 4B teacher, DIAL-OPD surpasses the strongest full-token baseline using an 8B teacher at both student scales, showing that effective supervision allocation can outweigh teacher scaling. Further analysis shows that moderate beta balances suppressing low-low tokens against preserving useful disagreements. Token-level evidence reveals that DIAL-OPD filters high-reward tokens with limited reasoning value while preserving supervision critical to reasoning correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DIAL-OPD，一种用于 On-Policy Distillation（OPD）的 token 选择方法。该方法通过用教师和学生概率的对数均值加权对数比奖励，桥接对数概率空间和概率空间，解决现有基于分歧度的方法忽视概率尺度而过度关注"低-低"token 的问题。在仅保留 40% token 的情况下，DIAL-OPD 在 4 对师生模型、7 个数学推理基准上均优于全 token OPD 和 9 种基线方法，有效的监督分配甚至可以超越扩大教师模型带来的收益。
AI.motivation: 1. 在 sampled-token OPD 中，"更多监督=更好学习"的直觉是错误的：实验显示随机保留 40-90% 的 token 就能持续优于全 token Vanilla OPD。2. 基于分歧度的现有 token 选择准则（如奖励幅值排序）忽视概率尺度，导致"低-低"token（即师生双方都赋予极低概率的 token）占据了不成比例的奖励权重，损害学习效果。3. 需要一种同时考虑相对分歧（log-ratio）和绝对概率尺度的 token 选择方法。
AI.method: 核心方法 DIAL-OPD：1) 计算每个 token 的对数均值 L(p_t, q_t)（师生概率在 log 空间均匀插值的平均）；2) 用 L(p_t, q_t)^β 加权 |r_t^OPD|（绝对对数比奖励）作为选择得分；3) β 控制权重：β=0 时退化为纯奖励幅值选择，β=1 时对应绝对概率差选择，中间值几何插值；4) 在每个响应内按得分 top-K 选择，保留原始符号的 OPD 奖励。理论上证明了 β 对低-低 token 抑制的可控性（命题 1）和对单侧低概率的敏感性（命题 2：β>1 会将单侧低概率的得分驱至零）。
AI.result: 1. 仅保留 40% token，DIAL-OPD 在 4 对师生（Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B 学生 + 4B/8B 教师）、7 个数学基准（GSM8K、MATH-500、AMC23、AIME24、AIME25、Minerva、Olympiad）上的平均准确率均超越 Vanilla OPD 和最强全 token 变体（PowerOPD），最高提升 5.25 个百分点。2. AIME25 Pass@16 从 13.33% 翻倍至 26.67%。3. 在匹配保留率下，比最强 token 选择基线（如 CC-OPD、SA-OPD）相对提升最高达 18%。4. 使用 4B 教师 + DIAL-OPD 即可超越使用 8B 教师 + 最强全 token 基线的性能，表明有效监督分配优于教师规模化。5. β 的消融研究表明中等权重（β≈1）最佳，平衡低-低 token 抑制与有用分歧的保留。
AI.conclusion: 更多监督未必更好——在 sampled-token OPD 中，选择正确的 token 比监督所有 token 更重要。奖励幅值不足以评估 token 学习价值，因为它忽略绝对概率尺度。DIAL-OPD 通过对数均值将对数概率空间与概率空间桥接，提供了在相对分歧与绝对概率尺度之间的连续调节旋钮。实验证明有效的监督分配策略可以使小教师模型超越大教师模型的全 token 监督，为模型蒸馏中 token 层面的资源分配提供了新思路。

title: Lamarck's Driving School: Discovering Autonomous Driving Training Strategies through Evolutionary Competition
summary: Autonomous driving capabilities depend strongly on the distribution of scenarios encountered during training. Existing methods commonly construct or dynamically adapt training scenario distributions using surrogate criteria such as realism, difficulty, or risk. However, these predefined surrogates may misrepresent training value, leading to inefficient use of training resources. To address this limitation, we propose a Lamarckian evolutionary framework that replaces surrogate-based guidance with competition among candidate distributions. We formulate training strategy discovery as a multi-stage bilevel optimization problem and use Lamarckian evolution algorithm to approximate its solution. At the outer level, Darwinian crossover, mutation, and selection explore the scenario distribution space; at the inner level, policy learning acquires new capabilities, and Lamarckian inheritance transfers them to subsequent stages, allowing scenario distributions and policy capabilities to co-evolve. The resulting evolutionary trajectories reveal recurring stage-wise regularities among high-value distributions, characterized by capability accumulation through stage-wise challenge rotation. We further distill these regularities into a lightweight, reusable Lamarckian Training Strategy. Experiments show that, compared with the baseline, the complete framework reduces performance loss by up to 25.07%, while the lightweight strategy still achieves a 19.13% reduction. These results demonstrate that evolutionary competition can both discover effective training strategies and reveal reusable stage-wise patterns in how the value of training distributions changes with policy capability. Code is available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于拉马克进化（Lamarckian Evolution）的自动驾驶训练场景分布优化框架，通过多阶段双层优化让场景分布与策略能力协同进化，并从中提炼出可复用的轻量级训练策略。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶策略训练效果依赖于训练场景的分布。现有方法通常基于现实性、难度、风险等代理指标（surrogate criteria）来构建或调整训练场景分布，但这些预定义的代理指标可能无法真实反映训练价值（training value），从而导致训练资源使用效率低下。核心动机在于：能否摆脱对人工设计代理准则的依赖，直接通过竞争机制发现高价值的训练分布？
AI.method:
1. **问题建模**：将训练策略发现建模为多阶段双层优化（multi-stage bilevel optimization）问题。
2. **外层（Darwinian 层）**：使用达尔文式的交叉（crossover）、变异（mutation）和选择（selection）操作在场景分布空间中进行搜索。
3. **内层（策略学习层）**：在选定的场景分布下学习策略，获取新能力。
4. **拉马克继承（Lamarckian Inheritance）**：将内层学到的能力传递给后续阶段，使场景分布与策略能力能够**协同进化（co-evolve）**。
5. **策略提炼**：从进化轨迹中归纳出阶段性的规律（"阶段化挑战轮换"驱动的能力积累模式），蒸馏为一个轻量级、可复用的 **Lamarckian Training Strategy**。
6. **实验设计**：在自动驾驶训练场景中与基线方法对比，衡量性能损失降低程度。
AI.result:
- **完整框架**：相比基线方法，性能损失最高降低 **25.07%**。
- **轻量级策略**：提炼后的可复用策略仍能实现 **19.13%** 的性能损失降低。
- **发现的规律**：高价值场景分布在不同阶段呈现出可复现的阶段性规律，其特征是"通过阶段化挑战轮换实现能力积累"（capability accumulation through stage-wise challenge rotation）。
- 结果表明：进化式竞争不仅能发现有效的训练策略，还能揭示训练分布价值随策略能力变化的可复用阶段化模式。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明，用基于竞争的进化机制取代传统代理指标来指导训练场景分布的构建是有效且高效的。该拉马克进化框架能自动发现高价值的训练分布演化路径，并从中提炼出轻量、通用的训练策略，为自动驾驶（及其他依赖场景训练的领域）中的课程设计与分布优化提供了一种新范式。代码已开源。

title: Constrained Command-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning with Bandit Strategy Selection in Real-Time Strategy Games
summary: Deep reinforcement learning agents reach strong performance in real-time strategy games but can be brittle against opponents outside their training distribution. Separating strategic command selection from learned unit control allows different strategies to be selected for different opponents while reusing the same execution policy. This requires an executor that can follow different commands and measurable criteria for assessing whether it does so. We introduce a constrained command-conditioned Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) policy, the executor, for MicroRTS, a real-time strategy environment. Discrete commands specify strategic objectives and behavioral requirements for economy, army composition, military posture, and worker policy over multiple environment steps; the executor determines the unit-level actions used to fulfill them. A Thompson-sampling bandit acts as the strategist, selecting command tuples from an estimate of the opponent's strategy built from in-game observations rather than opponent identity. In a controlled comparison with a flat PPO baseline trained with the same architecture, budget, curriculum and self-play league, the strategist-executor system wins significantly more often against three of the four strongest opponents on a training map, including the two strongest held-out ones (0.55 to 0.97 and 0.01 to 0.34), with no significant difference against the others.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于即时战略（RTS）游戏的"策略师-执行者"分层强化学习框架，通过将高层策略选择与低层单元控制解耦来解决RL智能体对训练分布外对手的脆弱性问题。具体包括：一个可测量的指令系统（覆盖经济、兵种组成、军事姿态和工人策略四个槽位，共16条指令）；一个通过约束命令条件化PPO训练的"执行者"（每个指令有独立的拉格朗日乘子和成功率约束）；以及一个基于Thompson采样的"策略师"赌博机，根据游戏中观测推断的对手行为选择指令元组。在MicroRTS环境中与相同架构、预算和课程训练的flat PPO基线对比，该系统对四个最强对手中的三个实现了显著更高的胜率（包括两个最强的训练分布外对手）。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习智能体虽然在RTS游戏中表现强劲，但对训练分布外的对手具有战略脆弱性。现有方案如AlphaStar、OpenAI Five等依赖自博弈分布的多样性来保证鲁棒性，使得鲁棒性成为训练分布的属性而非部署时可适应的属性。分层RL提供目标但缺乏可测量指令遵循的标准；脚本化策略组合提供可解释性但牺牲了学习到的单元控制。本文旨在通过将战略选择与单元控制解耦，同时保留两者优势来解决这两个问题。
AI.method: 框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 命令系统：包含4个经济命令（STABILIZE、GROW、HOLD、DOUBLE_BARRACKS）、6个组成命令（LIGHT、HEAVY、RANGED及三种双型组合）、4个姿态命令（OFFENSE、DEFENSE、SPLIT、FLANK）和2个工人策略命令（ECON_ONLY、HARASS），每个命令有可测量的成功/失败/超时标准、问题前置条件和执行窗口；(2) 约束命令条件化执行者：GridNet架构的PPO策略，通过FiLM层将命令嵌入集成到卷积特征，使用4个独立的slot-adherence奖励流（通过归一化优势加权和与游戏奖励流结合），每个命令有独立的拉格朗日乘子根据约束违反更新，并配有停滞约束的启发式保护机制；(3) 观察驱动的赌博机策略师：基于观测证据键（不依赖对手身份）的Dirichlet-类别后验构建对手类别信念，通过Thompson采样从Beta后验中抽取回报估计，加权平均后选择指令元组。元组先验在log-odds空间对命令槽位加性组合，使未玩过的组合能继承其组成的命令的信息。评估时仅使用后验均值和观察到的证据。
AI.result: 在16×16地图A上对12个对手（6个训练对手含TMA 2024竞赛冠军，以及6个分布外对手包括RAISocketAI 2023冠军和obiBotKenobi 2023亚军）各进行100场评估，关键结果包括：(1) 命令遵循审计显示训练结束时所有16个指令的平滑成功率均在0.75-1.00之间（目标0.8），但干预测试表明仅经济和组成命令实际改变执行者行为，姿态和工人策略命令的成功率约束虽被满足却无因果效应（识别出"测量与可控性分离"这一主要教训）；(2) 胜率结果：策略师-执行者系统对agent_sota将胜率从0.61提升至0.93，对分布外对手obiBotKenobi从0.55提升至0.97，对RAISocketAI从0.01提升至0.34，三者均统计显著；(3) 头部对战中胜率为97/100；(4) 策略师实际操作中几乎只选择经济命令（GROW或DOUBLE_BARRACKS）和对coacAI的RANGED组成命令，姿态和工人策略槽位保持默认值；(5) 按对手选择固定元组的"Static"基线在性能上与策略师相当，表明增益主要来自命令条件化训练而非运行时适应。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功展示了在RTS游戏中通过分层命令条件化RL可以提高对未见对手的泛化能力，特别是对最强对手表现提升显著。但深入分析揭示了一个重要局限：当前的成功率测量无法识别哪些命令实际具有因果效应——姿态和工人策略命令虽满足其约束却未能驱动行为变化，论文明确指出"主要教训是应通过配对干预而非成功率来估计adherence"。因此，性能增益主要来源于命令条件化的训练，而非运行时策略适应本身。未来的工作应着重开发基于干预的约束估计方法，以及实现更好的运行时策略切换能力。论文贡献包括可测量的指令系统框架、约束命令条件化PPO训练算法、基于观察的赌博机策略师以及与flat PPO的受控比较实验。

title: Evi-VN: Hard Region Guided Virtual Node Evidence Injection for GNN-Based Fraud Detection
summary: Online platforms contain growing numbers of bots, deceptive reviewers, and scam accounts that imitate legitimate users. Such camouflage blurs graph neighborhoods and behavioral attributes, making it difficult for graph neural networks (GNNs) to distinguish both well-disguised fraudsters and legitimate users. Across diverse GNNs, we observe overlapping errors on a shared hard region, suggesting the presence of latent fraud evidence that graph topologies and standard features fail to capture. Fraud-specific GNNs can mitigate particular graph pathologies, yet they still make limited use of heterogeneous evidence such as structured records, text, images, and audio; uniform multimodal fusion may also disturb nodes already handled reliably by the graph. We propose Evi-VN to learn and correct these shared blind spots rather than build another fraud detector. To our knowledge, Evi-VN is the first graph fraud detection framework to use feature isolated evidence chains to correct hard regions shared across GNNs. Its evidence chains connect behavior, content, and context across structured, textual, visual, and acoustic sources, helping expose camouflage that graph neighborhoods may miss. Crucially, Evi-VN selectively applies this evidence only to likely hard samples via virtual class nodes, preserving both the reliable predictions and the input design of existing GNNs. Shared hard regions also let Evi-VN enhance generic, fraud-specific, and unseen GNNs even with imperfect evidence models. Experiments across bot, fake-review, refund-evidence, and telecom-fraud tasks validate these advantages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Evi-VN框架，通过识别GNN共有的"难区域"，并选择性地向这些区域注入多模态证据链（结构化、文本、视觉、声学），以增强现有基于GNN的欺诈检测器。该框架通过路由器识别图证据不足的节点，使用可替换的证据处理器生成校准的类别先验，再通过虚拟类别节点注入源仅消息，实现对硬样本的结构性干预而不干扰可靠预测。
AI.motivation: 在线平台上的欺诈者通过模仿合法用户来模糊图邻域和行为属性，使GNN难以区分伪装良好的欺诈者和合法用户。不同GNN在共享的"难区域"上存在重叠错误，表明存在图拓扑和标准特征无法捕获的潜在欺诈证据。现有方法存在两难：早期融合将GNN输入与模态编码器耦合，晚期融合虽保留骨干但无法影响消息传递；均匀多模态融合可能干扰已被图可靠处理的节点。
AI.method: 1. 多骨干OOF预测识别共识难区域；2. 路由器从证据链预测图硬度；3. 可替换证据处理器生成校准类别先验；4. 两个虚拟类别节点（正/负类）作为类原型，通过源仅置信加权边向路由硬节点注入证据；5. ProxyReg正则化（含proxy对齐、有界分离、stop-gradient锚定）约束虚拟节点表示；6. Score-only finalizer仅融合标量分数（骨干概率、增强GNN概率、校准先验、路由器分数、路由掩码）。关键设计：特征隔离（证据特征不附加到GNN输入矩阵），分层OOF防泄漏。
AI.result: 在MGTAB上13个GNN骨干平均提升Acc/F1/AUC 6.77/10.58/5.61 pp；难节点上Acc提升13.82 pp。跨数据集表现：TwiBot-20、Cresci-2015、YelpZip、FraudBench、TeleAntiFraud-28k均一致提升；TeleAntiFraud上Acc提升35.47 pp。转移到未见骨干（SGC、GraphTransformer、FiLM、ResGatedGCN、CARE-GNN、PC-GNN）平均提升5.18/7.62/3.27 pp。路由器/先验可替换（XGBoost、LightGBM、RF、TabICL v2）。
AI.conclusion: Evi-VN是一个模型无关、即插即用的GNN欺诈检测增强框架，通过学习跨GNN的共享难区域并通过源仅虚拟类别节点注入特征隔离的多模态证据，在不改变现有GNN输入接口的前提下，系统性地增强通用、欺诈专用及未见GNN检测器。该方法将多模态证据转化为针对性的结构干预，直接解决现有图检测器的盲点。局限：完整流水线多种子重运行昂贵；证据处理器覆盖有限；FraudBench生成文本易分；TeleAntiFraud为合成数据且转录占主导。

title: Autoregressive Retriever: Improving Query Understanding from Item Feedback for Universal Multimodal Retrieval
summary: Universal multimodal retrieval typically encodes a query once and ranks independently indexed items by embedding similarity. This design supports efficient search, but leaves the query representation unchanged even when retrieved items could help clarify the information need. We introduce the AutoRegressive Retriever (ARR), a multimodal retrieval model that learns both to select informative items and to use their content to refine subsequent retrieval. ARR alternates between retrieving an item and updating the query embedding, then uses the final embedding to rank the collection. Supervised fine-tuning teaches the encoder to use feedback through stepwise contrastive supervision. Reinforcement learning treats feedback items as actions and optimizes their selection using the final reciprocal rank of a relevant item. A query-side adapter enables this optimization against a fixed item index.
