ARR demonstrates strong retrieval performance on both in-domain and zero-shot benchmarks, outperforming the compared baselines on average. Further analyses show that feedback improves retrieval at inference time and that training with feedback also improves the initial query embedding, before any item is observed.

AI.tldr: 提出自回归检索器ARR，通过交替检索项目与更新查询嵌入来弥合查询-项目鸿沟，结合SFT（逐步对比监督+退化惩罚）和RL（GRPO优化反馈选择）两阶段训练，在M-BEIR及7个零样本基准上取得最优平均性能。
AI.motivation: 现有通用多模态检索（UMR）将查询和项目独立编码后按嵌入相似度排序，查询表示在检索过程中固定不变，无法利用候选项目来澄清信息需求，即"查询-项目鸿沟"。作者提出让检索器自身学会利用其检索到的项目作为反馈来改进后续检索。
AI.method: ARR的核心方法：1)自回归检索过程——交替执行"检索一个项目→将该项目内容追加到查询上下文→编码生成下一查询嵌入"，经过N-1次反馈后用最终嵌入排序整个集合；2)SFT阶段——使用预训练编码器构建离线top-K反馈池，随机采样N-1个项目构成N个查询状态，对每个状态施加InfoNCE对比监督（仅第一步反向传播项目嵌入），并加入"退化惩罚"（惩罚对比损失在连续状态间的相对增长）；3)RL阶段——冻结SFT骨干和项目索引，在查询侧附加LoRA适配器，将反馈项目视为动作，以最终嵌入对正例的倒数秩为终端奖励，采用GRPO优化策略，并加入奖励门控的最终步对比辅助损失。
AI.result: ARR在M-BEIR域内和7个零样本基准上均取得最优平均性能：2B模型平均56.7%（超越ELVA 53.8%），8B模型平均61.0%（超越TRACE 58.8%）。分析表明：（1）反馈使用必须经过训练——未训练的ARR-SFT_N=1在迭代到第4步时反而下降到46.90；（2）反馈训练同时改善初始检索——ARR-SFT_N=4在Iter-1即优于N=1；（3）RL进一步改善初始表示（ARR-RL_N=1的55.44 vs ARR-SFT_N=4的55.63）；（4）超过2步后增益边际递减；（5）消融实验验证退化惩罚、stop-gradient、最终步监督和GRPO均不可或缺，KL正则化表现更差。
AI.conclusion: ARR通过自回归检索机制成功弥合了查询-项目鸿沟，其两阶段训练（SFT+RL）既改善了推理时利用反馈的能力，也改善了训练后初始查询嵌入的质量。项目级动作空间和GRPO策略优化为多模态检索中的反馈利用提供了新的有效途径。

title: $σ$Transfer: Uncertainty Transfer from Small to Large Networks under $μ\mathrm{P}$
summary: Reliable predictive uncertainty in Laplace approximations depends critically on the prior precision, yet selecting it requires a posterior sweep that is prohibitively expensive for neural networks with billions of parameters. Under the Maximal Update Parametrization ($\mu\mathrm{P}$), we derive a rescaling of the prior covariance that makes the selected precision stable as model width grows. This leads to $\sigma\mathrm{Transfer}$: we select the precision on a smaller model and zero-shot transfer it to the much larger model, i.e., without searching for the precision on the larger model at all. We show convergence of the prior kernel, posterior covariance, selected precision, and posterior-derived decisions under explicit conditions, and verify $\sigma\mathrm{Transfer}$ across regression, image classification, and Transformer readouts. For example, measured precision-sweep speedups reach $\sim 5000\times$ when transferring from width 128 to 4096 on MNIST, at a target-NLL degradation of $0.002$; transferring from a public 1B to 7B model gives a median search speedup of $\sim 2.3\times$ (up to $\sim 330\times$), with a mean measured target-NLL increase below $10^{-4}$ across ten tasks. The same posterior stability also enables transfer of acquisition, OOD-detection, and abstention decisions without constructing a target posterior.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了σTransfer方法,在最大更新参数化(μP)框架下,通过对先验协方差进行宽度归一化重缩放,使得在小型网络上选择的最优先验精度可以零样本迁移到大型网络,从而大幅降低拉普拉斯近似中精度搜索的计算成本,同时保证后验不确定性估计在OOD检测、主动学习、选择性预测等决策任务上的迁移有效性。
AI.motivation: 拉普拉斯近似中的先验精度选择需要昂贵的后验扫描,在数十亿参数的网络上成本巨大;现有方法在小网络上选定的精度直接迁移到大网络时往往失效,因为标准参数化下不同宽度的最优精度不一致。
AI.method: 在μP参数化基础上,引入宽度归一化参数坐标ϕ_n=T_n⁻¹θ_n,选择先验协方差S_n=T_nT_n⊤使得在归一化坐标下的各向同性先验产生宽度稳定的先验核K_n=J_nS_nJ_n⊤;通过Woodbury恒等式将此先验核稳定性传递至后验协方差,进而保证选定的精度λ和后验决策在宽度变化下稳定。提供先验核稳定性(定理1)、后验协方差稳定性(定理2)、精度迁移(定理3)和决策迁移(定理4)四项理论保证。
AI.result: 实验涵盖回归(ESOL、FreeSolv、Lipophilicity)、图像分类(MNIST、Fashion-MNIST)和大语言模型(1B→7B):MNIST上从宽度128迁移到4096达到约5000倍加速,NLL退化仅0.002;公开1B到7B模型迁移中位加速约2.3倍(最高330倍),十个任务平均目标NLL增加低于10⁻⁴;顺序主动学习中EPIG排名的Spearman相关性达0.75(对比SP的0.07);OOD检测的AUROC在宽度4096处仍保持0.950,而SP损失0.072。
AI.conclusion: σTransfer通过理论驱动的先验几何设计,实现了拉普拉斯近似中超参数和决策从小型代理网络到大型目标网络的零样本迁移,在保持预测质量的同时将不确定性敏感任务的计算成本降低若干个数量级。

title: Early Signatures of Memorization in Diffusion Models via Basin Geometry and Cyclic Denoising
summary: Diffusion models generalize early in training and later reproduce individual training samples. Standard tests detect memorization only once one-shot generation produces near-copies, leaving a released model unaudited until its outputs fail. We show that memorization is encoded in the geometry of the learned energy landscape before it appears in generated samples, a state we call latent memorization. Using score divergence and basin volume, we find that localized basins form around training samples and separate them from held-out samples before the first memorized sample appears, with an onset that follows the same $O(n)$ scaling as the memorization time. We probe these basins with cyclic denoising, which repeatedly applies partial noising and denoising. Under the exact empirical score, we prove that cycling started near an isolated training sample recovers it and returns to it over any finite number of cycles with high probability. In trained models, cycling recovers training images from CelebA and CIFAR-10 checkpoints whose one-shot samples contain no copies, and at a CelebA checkpoint with 0.1% one-shot copies, 500 cycles raise the memorized fraction above 30%. Cycling also reveals degenerate attractors that match no single training image and fade as training proceeds, so residence in a basin does not by itself imply memorization. These findings hold on a Gaussian mixture, CelebA, and CIFAR-10 across optimizers, architectures, noise schedules, and training-set sizes, and extend to off-the-shelf Stable Diffusion v1.4, where the cycled conditional-unconditional divergence gap separates memorized from non-memorized prompts with an AUC of 0.944 and a TPR of 0.866 at 1% FPR. More broadly, what a diffusion model has memorized is a property of the geometry and stability of its learned distribution, and assessing it requires examining this structure rather than generated outputs alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"潜在记忆"(latent memorization)概念，发现在扩散模型的一次性(one-shot)生成尚未产生训练样本复制之前，其学习到的能量景观(energy landscape)中已围绕训练样本形成局部盆地(localized basins)。通过分数散度(score divergence)、盆地体积(basin volume)及循环去噪(cyclic denoising)三种探测手段，可在单次生成检测不到记忆时即识别记忆，并提供了理论分析与Stable Diffusion上的实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散模型记忆检测方法依赖一次性生成产生近复制样本，这使得已发布模型在输出"失败"之前无法被审计。本文旨在探索：扩散模型是否在学习分数场(learned score field)的几何结构中、而非在生成输出中，早于可见记忆就编码了对个别训练样本的记忆。
AI.method: 1) 几何签名：采用边界蒙特卡洛方法估计归一化分数散度(分𝓐̂₁)以及基于DDIM恢复扫描的盆地体积，在训练/保留/生成样本上追踪训练过程中的变化；2) 循环去噪(CD)：重复施加部分加噪与去噪，以噪声幅度γ参数化，追踪循环相似度S_cyc与记忆分数f_mem；3) 理论分析：在精确经验分数(exact empirical score)假设下，证明从训练点邻域出发的CD在任意有限循环数下以高概率返回该训练点，界由循环噪声q与训练点间距δᵢ共同控制；4) 在GMM、CelebA、CIFAR-10与现成Stable Diffusion v1.4上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 1) 几何签名先于可见记忆出现：在CelebA上，分数散度的训练-保留分离(τ_div=65k)早于首次记忆样本出现(τ_mem=90k)25k步，其起始时刻遵循与τ_mem相同的O(n)缩放；2) 循环去噪揭示潜在记忆：在CelebA τ=20k（一次性f_mem=0.1%）的检查点上，γ=0.10下500次循环将记忆分数提升至30%以上；3) 存在退化吸引子(degenerate attractors)：在τ_gen附近常见，训练推进后消失（50.9%→0.98%）；4) 理论验证：精确经验采样下500轮实测居留率66.48%与定理预测66.01%高度吻合；5) Stable Diffusion v1.4：循环后条件-无条件散度差Δ𝓐₁在c=60时AUC从0.811提升至0.944，TPR@1%FPR从0.526提升至0.866；6) 成员推断：AUC在记忆阶段达到1.0，远早于一次性f_mem显著。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型的记忆编码在学习分布的几何与稳定性中，而非仅在生成输出中。局部盆地围绕个别训练样本在τ_mem之前即已形成，其起始遵循O(n)缩放；循环去噪能抵达一次性采样错过的训练样本盆地。记忆的检测需审视景观结构本身。同时，退化吸引子的存在表明仅凭盆地居留不能等同于记忆。检测与隐私/版权审计相关，但也可能被滥用于模型提取，需配套访问控制。

title: TRACE: Diagnosing Verifier Brittleness in Agentic Evaluation
summary: Verifier scores now serve as both benchmark metrics and training rewards for large language model (LLM) agents, and a change in score is routinely read as a change in capability. It may instead reflect a change in the evaluation. We introduce TRACE, a protocol that turns a score change from a verdict into a testable diagnosis: it applies a targeted change to one part of an evaluation, compares paired runs, checks whether the agent's behavior changed, and rescores unchanged trajectories to test whether the scoring rule is responsible. In a controlled suite of 25 synthetic tasks, renaming tools lowers a scripted agent's score by 0.250 even though it performs exactly the same operations; restoring the original names at scoring time closes the entire gap, while the same mutation exposes a genuine behavioral failure in a second agent. On public $\tau^2$-bench tasks with four LLM agents, an initial 30-task study finds mixed reward changes whose one clear effect does not replicate. In a larger follow-up on 88 new tasks with repeated runs per condition, renaming tools or reformatting tool outputs leaves reward unchanged to within $\pm$0.10 for seven of eight agent-change pairs, whereas tool names that deliberately mislead lower every agent's reward by 0.20-0.44, showing that the setup can detect real effects. Identical reruns flip 15-36% of task outcomes, so single-run comparisons cannot separate presentation effects from run-to-run variation. Two frontier LLM judges give consistent verdicts when a fixed trajectory is presented differently, yet disagree with each other on 57% of the same records, largely because one grades procedure rather than outcome. TRACE thus separates what a score change says about the agent from what it says about the measurement.

AI.tldr: TRACE 提出一种诊断协议，通过配对运行、轨迹比对与反事实重打分，将验证器分数变化从"判决"转化为"可检验的解释"，揭示智能体评估中分数波动往往源于评估机制本身而非智能体能力变化。
AI.motivation: 验证器分数既作为基准测试指标，又作为训练奖励，分数变化常被解读为能力变化，但实际可能反映评估本身的缺陷（如工具名匹配而非操作内容验证）。研究需要区分分数变化来自智能体行为、环境还是验证器规则。
AI.method: TRACE 协议包含四步：(1) 对评估某部分施加定向变更（mutation）；(2) 在固定种子下进行配对运行；(3) 比较智能体轨迹是否实际改变；(4) 对未改变的轨迹进行反事实重打分以检验评分规则。包含六类探针族（任务措辞、工具接口、评分标准、约束添加、代理激励、观测访问），定义验证器鲁棒性差距（VRG）、变异成功率（MSR）、变异迁移率（MTR）、代理-真实发散度（PTD）等诊断指标，并设置等同重跑对照与阳性对照。
AI.result: 在受控合成环境（25个任务，3个脚本策略）中，工具重命名使"谨慎"策略分数下降 0.250 但行为完全一致，通过别名归一化重打分后差距归零；同一变异对"过拟合"策略则暴露真实行为失败。在 τ²-bench 公共基准上，四个智能体共 30 任务的初步研究中效应混合且唯一显著效应未复现；88 新任务的扩展研究（每条件三次重复）显示：保义呈现变化在 ±0.10 范围内等价（7/8 对），而误导性工具名使所有智能体分数降低 0.20–0.44；等同重跑导致 15–36% 任务结果翻转，说明单次运行无法区分呈现效应与随机波动；两个前沿 LLM 评判器在呈现变化下一致性高，但在相同记录上 57% 互不一致，主要因一个评判流程而非结果。
AI.conclusion: 分数变化是观察而非解释。TRACE 通过配对变异、轨迹检查和反事实重打分，将分数变化归因于行为、任务或评估层面。研究强调：(1) 任何配对差异需对比等同重跑；(2) 需包含已知有效的阳性对照使等价声明有意义；(3) 评判器审计同样需要重复对照；(4) 一致性不等于有效性——可重复的评判器仍可能在衡量不同构念。该工作为智能体评估中的验证器脆性提供了系统诊断框架。

title: Camera-Noise Residuals for Face-Swap Detection: Redundant, Not Complementary, and Why
summary: Fusing a learned camera-noise fingerprint with an RGB appearance backbone is an appealing route to generator-independent deepfake detection, because the noise residual is grounded in image-formation physics rather than in the texture statistics of a particular generator. We test, on FaceForensics++, whether a Noiseprint++ residual channel carries information \emph{complementary} to an RGB Xception backbone for face-swap detection. A three-model ablation (RGB-only, residual-only, late-fusion) shows that fusion does not improve over RGB alone and that the residual branch alone is near chance. A seven-level bottleneck diagnostic localizes the cause: the noise maps do carry a discriminative signal, but it is statistical---carried by the per-sample first and second moments (mean, variance, energy) of the residual---and the per-sample \texttt{InstanceNorm} layer placed at the noise-branch input, following the TruFor template, standardizes exactly those moments away (five-fold cross-validated AUC drops from $0.747$ to $0.554$). A context-crop control rules out cropping geometry, and two fixed-fusion variants that remove the bottleneck recover the statistical signal yet still fail to beat RGB on every dataset. We conclude that, on this manipulation distribution, the noise residual is redundant with RGB rather than complementary, and we give concrete guidance for practitioners adopting noise-residual fusion for face-swap detection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在FaceForensics++人脸交换检测任务中，将基于Noiseprint++的相机噪声残差通道与RGB外观骨干网络融合是否带来互补信息。通过受控消融实验、瓶颈诊断和固定融合变体，证明在该任务上噪声残差与RGB信息冗余而非互补，且TruFor模板中的InstanceNorm层会抹除残差所携带的判别性统计信号。
AI.motivation: 现有人脸伪造检测器往往依赖特定生成器的纹理伪迹，难以跨数据集/跨生成器泛化。传感器噪声残差（如Noiseprint++）作为基于图像形成物理的不变量，被认为有望提供与生成器无关的检测信号。然而，噪声通道究竟是与RGB backbone真正互补，抑或是冗余乃至被架构选择所破坏，缺少基于受控消融的实证回答。
AI.method: 方法包含四部分：(1) 在FaceForensics++上构建三模型消融（RGB-only Xception、Residual-only ResNet+InstanceNorm、Late-Fusion）并在FF++/Celeb-DF/DFDC/DFF上做分布内与跨数据集AUC评估；(2) 七级瓶颈诊断（L1–L7），从标量统计量、InstanceNorm池化、原始噪声到ConvNet逐级定位信号丢失点，使用3000样本的5折交叉验证AUC；(3) 上下文裁剪控制（1.3× vs 2.7× box）并计算语料SNR；(4) 两种固定融合变体（StatNoise-Fusion用13个标量统计量通过MLP融合；ResAware-Fusion用BatchNorm替代InstanceNorm并保留原始分辨率），各5个种子训练。
AI.result: 关键结果：(i) 三模型消融显示Late-Fusion（AUC 0.924）与RGB-only（0.928）在FF++上Wilcoxon p=0.977，无统计差异；Residual-only在所有数据集上接近随机（FF++ 0.579，DFF 0.212）。(ii) 七级瓶颈诊断显示：6个标量统计量的MLP达到AUC 0.747（统计上限），但经过InstanceNorm池化后骤降至0.554（接近随机）；L7（ConvNet+IN）仅部分恢复至0.670。(iii) 上下文裁剪控制显示紧裁剪在FF++（SNR 0.188 vs 0.080，AUC 0.670 vs 0.652）和Celeb-DF上一致优于上下文裁剪，排除裁剪几何影响。(iv) 两种固定融合变体（StatNoise-Fusion 0.845/0.786；ResAware-Fusion 0.856/0.805）在FF++和Celeb-DF上均低于RGB-only（0.928/0.888）和原Late-Fusion（0.924/0.881），证实恢复的信号与RGB冗余。(v) 在JPEG/模糊/缩放/gamma扰动扫描下，Late-Fusion−RGB-only的成对差异均值−0.003、最大|Δ|=0.035、唯一置信区间排除零点处为负（模糊σ=2时−0.017），而对比SBI参考则全为正（+0.04至+0.17）。
AI.conclusion: 结论：在FF++人脸交换分布上，Noiseprint++残差携带的判别信号是统计性的（由每个样本残差的一阶和二阶矩——均值、方差/能量承载），但TruFor模板中放置在分支输入处的per-sample InstanceNorm层恰好将这些矩标准化消除（AUC从0.747降至0.554）。即使通过架构修复保留该信号，融合仍无法超越RGB-only（被弱通道拉低）且在扰动扫描下与RGB-only无可测差异，因此该残差通道与RGB冗余而非互补。实践建议：将从通用图像伪造检测器移植来的噪声残差侧通道，不应假设其对人脸交换检测具互补性；若信号本质是统计性的，则分支输入的per-sample归一化会静默抹除它；即使保留下来，也可能不增加任何超越RGB的信息。诊断探针可复用于审计任何辅助取证通道的成功与失败。

title: HI3D 3.0 (Twinkle3D): Object-specific 3D Asset Generation with High Resolution
summary: Image-to-3D generation has become increasingly capable of producing objects that closely resemble the input image, and an outstanding challenge is to reproduce the depicted object itself, including the specific geometry that defines it. Inscriptions, brand marks, and repeated structures are frequently distorted or lost, despite being critical to object identity. We present Hi3D 3.0, an image-to-3D generation system targeting object-specific fidelity, with Twinkle3D as its geometry model for generating watertight triangle meshes at $2048^{3}$ resolution. Twinkle3D advances high-fidelity geometry generation along four dimensions. First, while O-Voxel/FaithC offers high representational precision, it often suffers from poor surface quality and non-watertight geometry. We address both issues while retaining its $2048^{3}$-level precision. Second, we scale diffusion generation to sequences of up to 300K geometric tokens through a redesigned DiT architecture and large-scale distributed training optimizations, reducing training time per step from approximately ten minutes to ten seconds. Third, subsequent refinement cannot fully compensate for errors introduced during initial generation; we therefore strengthen both global shape and local detail in the initial generation stage, and the resulting single-stage model surpasses prior two-stage pipelines with $512^{3}$ refinement. Finally, we introduce a fine-grained image-3D cross-modal interaction mechanism that strengthens correspondence between visual evidence and geometric tokens, improving the recovery of object-specific structures. We evaluate geometric fidelity using alignment metrics derived from silhouettes and normal fields. Hi3D 3.0 outperforms four commercial systems across all reported metrics, recovering 82.1% of inscribed characters at 98.2% precision, compared with 21.7% recall for the strongest competitor.

AI.tldr: Hi3D 3.0 (Twinkle3D) is an image-to-3D generation system focused on "object-specific fidelity"—reproducing the exact depicted object (including inscriptions, brand marks, fine structures) rather than just a visually similar one. It generates watertight triangle meshes at 2048³ resolution and outperforms four commercial systems across all metrics, recovering 82.1% of inscribed characters at 98.2% precision.
AI.motivation: Current image-to-3D systems can produce objects resembling the input, but they frequently distort or lose fine object-specific features (inscriptions, brand marks, repeated structures) critical to object identity. Silhouette-based metrics fail to capture these losses. The paper aims to redefine image-to-3D quality toward reproducing the depicted object at every scale.
AI.method: Twinkle3D advances along four dimensions: (1) Improved autoencoder representation that retains O-Voxel/FaithC's multi-sheet-per-cell precision at 2048³ while producing watertight meshes with good surface quality; (2) Redesigned DiT architecture with distributed training optimizations to handle up to 300K geometric tokens, cutting training step time from ~10 minutes to ~10 seconds; (3) Single-stage generation that strengthens both global shape and local detail, surpassing prior two-stage pipelines with 512³ refinement; (4) Fine-grained image–3D cross-modal interaction mechanism to strengthen correspondence between visual evidence and geometric tokens. A geometry-domain evaluation protocol (silhouette IoU, normal bandpass, multi-view completeness, Qwen-Image-Bench aesthetics) and OCR-scored inscription benchmark are introduced.
AI.result: On a 33-input benchmark, Hi3D 3.0 achieves the best score on all four metrics: Global Alignment (silhouette IoU) 0.9184, Detail Alignment (normal bandpass) 0.3782, Multi-view Plausibility 0.757, Shape Aesthetics 50.91—outperforming Rodin Gen 2.5, Tripo 3.1, Meshy 7, and Hi3D 2.1. On the inscription benchmark (526 ground-truth characters), Hi3D 3.0 recovers 82.1% of characters at 98.2% precision (F1 89.4%), versus Meshy 7's best peer score of 21.7% recall. Blind pairwise human study shows Hi3D 3.0 rated equal or better in 78.0–89.8% of structure and 88.1–95.5% of detail judgments. Qualitative results show superior preservation of fine structures, inscriptions, and thin repeated elements.
AI.conclusion: Hi3D 3.0 establishes "object-specific fidelity" as a distinct evaluation axis in image-to-3D generation, proposes geometry-domain evaluation protocols and an OCR-based inscription benchmark, and demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in reproducing fine object-specific features. Open challenges remain: multi-view plausibility at 0.757, 16.5% character miss rate, and the 33-input benchmark cannot fully separate systems within close-performing groups.

title: Epistemic Disturbance in the Graph Model for Conflict Resolution: State-Preserving Actions, Four-Valued Assessments, and the Distinction between Capability and Intention
summary: In the graph model for conflict resolution (GMCR), a decision maker (DM) either moves the conflict to another state or does nothing. The basic definitions leave inaction implicit, so every action that leaves the state unchanged is treated as doing nothing. Yet announcements, exercises, leaks and selective disclosures are neither moves nor inaction: they leave the state unchanged but change what other DMs believe about which moves are available and which moves others would want to make. We introduce such state-preserving actions by augmenting states with the DMs' epistemic states: a physical move changes the physical state, a state-preserving action changes only the epistemic state, and inaction is the absence of a transition. Actions generate evidence through observer-specific interpretation maps. Building on a four-valued extension of GMCR from the author's earlier work, which separates evidence for and against, we show that evidence for a move can only enable perceived moves and evidence against can only disable them, that two of the four reduction operators ignore one kind of evidence, and that contradictory assessments are absorbing under monotone accumulation. With the monotonicity of stability in move sets, this fixes the direction in which any action moves a DM's stability judgements and characterizes when actions can enable provocation or deterrence. Capability assessments affect all sanction-based stability concepts, and on the DM's own side also Nash stability, whereas intention assessments affect only sequential stability. Hedging between two candidate types weakly expands or shrinks an observer's sequentially stable set according to how it reads contradiction. In the 1995 DVD format negotiation, general metarationality cannot distinguish its phases, since the computer industry group could always sanction; sequential stability, which asks whether it would, can.

AI.tldr: 本文在冲突解决的图模型（GMCR）中引入"保持状态的行为"（state-preserving actions），将状态增强为物理状态与认识状态的组合，并通过四值评估（Belnap逻辑）表征证据。将"不行动"明确为无转移、与状态保持型行为相区分。利用约简算子分析证据方向，证明了能力评估与意图评估分别影响不同稳定性概念（能力影响Nash及所有制裁型概念；意图仅影响SEQ），并以1995年DVD格式谈判为案例说明GMR与SEQ的区分能力。
AI.motivation: GMCR的基本定义将"保持状态"等同于"不行动"，从而无法区分公告、演习、泄露、选择性披露等不改变物理状态但改变他人信念的行为。需要一种形式化方法将这些"状态保持型行为"纳入图模型，并分析其对稳定性判断的影响。
AI.method: 将状态空间增强为物理状态s与认识轮廓κ的笛卡尔积；用Belnap四值（Y=仅支持证据, N=仅反对证据, U=无证据, YN=矛盾）表征能力评估ψ与意图评估χ；定义四种约简算子δ_NY, δ_YN, δ_NN, δ_YY将四值映射为{Y,N}；引入观察者特定的解释映射Γ处理同一行为在不同观察者处的差异化解读；假设证据单调累积（认识序下不下降）。核心技术包括：命题5.1-5.3分析算子对证据方向的反应；引理6.2证明稳定性在移动集上的单调性/反单调性；定理7.1和7.3分别确定能力与意图扰动对稳定性判断的方向。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 证据支持移动可用性只能"启用"感知移动，反之只能"禁用"（命题5.1）；两个算子完全忽略一种证据（命题5.2）；矛盾评估在单调累积下是吸收态（命题5.3）。(2) 稳定性关于对手移动集单调、关于自身移动集反单调（引理6.2）。(3) 能力评估影响所有制裁型概念以及（自身侧的）Nash稳定性；意图评估仅影响SEQ稳定性（定理7.1、7.3，表1）。(4) 核心方向定理：关于对手移动的支持证据→稳定化；关于自身移动的支持证据→去稳定化（定理7.1）。(5) 约简算子决定可启用挑衅/威慑的通道（推论8.2）；δ_NY观察者只能被威慑不能被挑衅，δ_YN观察者相反。(6) 在两个候选类型间对冲时，若算子将矛盾读为可信则SEQ稳定集弱扩张，否则弱收缩（定理9.3）。(7) 1995年DVD格式谈判案例：GMR无法区分阶段（因为计算机工作组总能制裁），SEQ可以（因为SEQ问"是否愿意"）。通过240,000+次随机模型检验未发现违反。
AI.conclusion: 该论文将GMCR中隐含的"不行动"显式化，引入"状态保持型行为"作为仅改变认识状态、不改变物理状态的转移类型。四值证据结构使对冲、模糊、矛盾等现象可被形式化处理。约简算子成为观察者对操纵脆弱性的"画像"。能力与意图的区分映射到不同的稳定性概念通道。序列在230,000+次随机实验中验证。结果是有限的、序数的，依赖四值结构仅通过证据对分量，为正式验证提供了自然目标。后续工作包括序列行动规划、偏好操纵与评估操纵的关系、撤回/纠正证据的扩展，以及高阶评估和联盟稳定性。

title: Can Jev be Your Q or Policy in Reinforcement Learning?
summary: Foundation models supply reinforcement learning (RL) with priors that mitigate its longstanding weaknesses in sample efficiency and transfer, but their token-by-token generation makes queries sequential and costly. Jev, a recently released decision model, generates nothing and returns calibrated, typed answers in a single forward pass. Existing work studies foundation models in RL either as models to be trained or as generators to be prompted, and Jev belongs to neither category, having so far served only as a black box in single domains. How well such a model decides on its own in RL environments, and how it can improve RL as a component of training, therefore remain unaddressed. To this end, in this paper we first examine the requirements that the objects of an RL system place on the answers they consume, and establish that Jev can fulfill all of them except the cardinal use of a value function. The remaining objects form positions that admit several roles each. We then construct algorithms that employ Jev at three of these positions, as a reference policy, an exploration judge, and a replay rater, to improve sample efficiency, exploration, and learning performance. Across nine MiniGrid tasks and three Atari games, training with Jev outperforms a standard RL learner, including where the learner makes no progress alone, while the model itself remains untrained. To our knowledge, we present the first use of Jev within the RL learning process and establish a frozen decision model as a usable component of RL training, inviting further exploration of how Jev and other advanced decision models can improve RL.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地分析了决策模型Jev（一种单次前向传播返回类型化答案的模型）可在强化学习中扮演的角色，并提出三种算法：参考策略、探索判定器和回放评级器，证明冻结的决策模型可作为RL训练的有效组件。
AI.motivation: 基础模型通过自回归token生成逐个产生动作，查询成本高昂且顺序执行。Jev作为新型决策模型采用单次前向传播返回类型化答案，但其在RL中作为独立决策者和训练组件的能力尚未被探索。
AI.method: 1. 分析RL四个核心对象（策略π、价值Q、奖励R、转移模型P）对函数逼近器的要求，判定Jev可填充除Q的基数用法外的所有对象；2. 提出Jev可占据的四个位置：策略位置、评分等级位置、元监管规则位置、转移位置；3. 在前三个位置上构建三种算法：Jev-BC/Jev-PEX/Jev-Mixed Sampling（参考策略）、Jev-Gate/Jev-Bonus（探索）、Jev-Reweighted Replay（回放）。
AI.result: 在9个MiniGrid任务和3个Atari游戏上的实验表明，使用冻结Jev训练的标准RL学习者在样本效率、探索和学习性能上优于基线DQN，包括学习者单独无法取得进展的任务。学生有时甚至超越Jev直接控制的性能。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型无需是可靠的独立控制器即可改善RL训练。冻结的Jev可作为RL训练的有效组件，但收益取决于任务、信息接口以及Jev判断如何融入学习过程。局部动作和经验判断比里程碑偏好更容易转化为学习收益。

title: Elucidating the Space of Enzymatic Reaction: A Unified Benchmark and Pretrained Model
summary: Existing reaction models primarily learn molecular transformations, whereas enzy- matic reactions depend jointly on molecular structure and catalytic function. We formulate this problem as learning an enzymatic reaction space linking reactants, products, and Enzyme Commission (EC) annotations. To characterize this space, we introduce VenusRX-Bench, a unified benchmark for forward reaction prediction, single-step retrosynthesis, and EC-number prediction. VenusRX-Bench integrates reactions from multiple biochemical databases with standardized curation, leakage- controlled splits, and consistent evaluation. Benchmarking representative chemical and enzymatic models reveals a clear chemical-to-enzymatic domain gap, driven by limited domain data, catalytic-context dependency, and the difficulty of modeling large biomolecular structures. To bridge this gap, we develop VenusRX, a unified T5-style sequence-to-sequence model for enzymatic reactions. VenusRX jointly learns forward prediction, ret- rosynthesis, and reaction reconstruction, with two-stage training on millions of template-expanded reactions followed by real biochemical reactions. In addition, optional EC conditioning incorporates catalytic context, while Molecule Library- Constrained Decoding improves the generation of complex biomolecules. Across benchmark tasks and challenging generalization splits, VenusRX achieves the best or competitive performance on most evaluated settings over representative chem- ical and enzymatic baselines. Moreover, EC information consistently improves reaction prediction, while learned reaction representations support accurate EC prediction, revealing a bidirectional relationship between reaction structure and catalytic function. Together, VenusRX-Bench and VenusRX provide a unified framework for elucidating and modeling enzymatic reaction space

AI.tldr: 本文提出VenusRX-Bench基准和VenusRX模型，用于建酶促反应空间（连接反应物、产物与EC编号）。VenusRX是T5风格的seq2seq模型，采用两阶段训练（模板扩展反应+真实生化反应）、可选EC条件、MLCD约束解码。在前向预测、逆合成、EC预测任务上达到SOTA或具有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有反应模型主要学习分子转化，而酶促反应依赖于分子结构和催化功能的联合作用。存在化学到酶促的领域差距（催化上下文依赖、生物大分子建模困难），且缺乏统一的酶促反应基准。
AI.method: 1. VenusRX-Bench：整合BRENDA、PathBank、Rhea、KEGG的EC标注反应，含原子映射，提出Reactant/Product/EC三种防泄露划分，三大任务（前向预测、单步逆合成、EC预测）。2. VenusRX：T5编解码架构，多任务目标（前向+逆合成+span corruption），可选EC条件，R-SMILES增强。两阶段训练：Stage1用模板扩展的~400万合成反应预训练；Stage2在真实VenusRX-Bench数据上继续训练。MLCD：基于前缀树的分子库约束解码，减少无效生成。
AI.result: 前向预测：VenusRX(MLCD)在三个split上全面SOTA，Reactant Split T1达80.06%，EC Split T10达77.66%。逆合成：显著超越基线，EC Split T1达20.37%（vs ECReact 5.84%）。EC预测：VenusRX在4层级Weighted F1上达到最佳或竞争性结果。EC条件一致提升反应预测性能；学到的反应表征支持准确EC预测。消融实验证实两阶段训练、span corruption均有贡献。Stage1预训练影响最大（去除后Top-1从75.2%降至47.2%）。
AI.conclusion: VenusRX-Bench和VenusRX提供了阐明和建模酶促反应空间的统一框架。领域特定预训练和催化上下文对建模酶促反应至关重要；反应结构与催化功能之间存在双向耦合关系。未来方向：纳入酶序列/结构/辅因子/反应条件、扩展到多步途径规划、开发允许库外探索的生成方法。

title: Structured Sentiment Analysis Using Sequence Labeling as Dependency Graph Parsing
summary: This study addresses the problem of structured sentiment analysis, whose goal is to obtain a fine-grained sentiment graph where the nodes represent spans of sentiment holders, targets, and expressions, while the arcs define the relationships among them. Our proposed approach casts the task as dependency graph parsing, but departs from traditional parsing methods by solving it through sequence labeling. To do so, we leverage recent advances in linearized graph encodings that allow each word in the input to be assigned a label, effectively capturing the structure of the dependency graph. We conducted experiments on seven datasets spanning five languages (English, Spanish, Norwegian, Basque, and Catalan), showing performance competitive with leading, more complex single-model approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将结构化情感分析（SSA）任务转化为序列标注问题，通过依赖图线性化方法（绝对/相对位置编码、括号编码、6k-bit编码）将图结构编码为词级标签，使用XLM-RoBERTa-large编码器在五种语言的七个数据集上达到与复杂图解析器相当的性能，且推理速度约为双仿射基线的2倍。
AI.motivation: 现有SSA方法依赖复杂的图解析器（如双仿射解码器）和专门的解码过程，架构复杂且效率受限。论文观察到SSA图具有稀疏性、有限依赖距离和有限关系类型等结构特性，适合线性化编码，因此探索将图解析简化为序列标注任务这一更简洁高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 1. **情感图转依赖图**：采用Barnes等人（2021）提出的head-first和head-final转换策略，将每个观点元组(h, t, e, p)转化为以情感表达式为根节点的依赖弧集合。2. **图线性化**：使用Ezquerro等人（2025）提出的四种编码方法——绝对/相对位置编码、括号编码和6k-bit编码——将图的弧集合转化为与词数等长的标签序列。3. **序列标注模型**：以XLM-RoBERTa-large为编码器，使用线性解码器预测每个词的标签，再通过额外的MLP模块预测弧的关系类型。训练时对标签和关系类型联合优化交叉熵损失。
AI.result: 在SemEval-2022 Task 10的7个数据集（5种语言）上，6k-bit编码（k=2）在head-first策略下取得平均SF1=60.4，优于双仿射基线（57.8）和多个强基线系统（包括Lin等、Chen等、Morio等的方法）。最佳模型在MB-ca、MB-eu和NoReC-no三个数据集上达到SOTA；推理速度达4454 tokens/s，约为双仿射基线（2196 tokens/s）的2倍。但该方法在MPQA-en和DS-en等长程、稀疏、重叠观点的数据集上表现较弱，主要原因是holder提取和目标极性预测精度不足。
AI.conclusion: 将依赖图解析转化为序列标注（通过图线性化）是一种原理清晰且高效的SSA解码策略。6k-bit编码因紧凑的标签空间表现最佳。该方法表明：通过合适的结构编码，轻量级的序列标注模型即可与复杂图解析器竞争甚至超越，为SSA提供了一种简单高效的替代方案。未来改进方向应聚焦于提升holder提取与目标极性预测精度。

title: A 3D Characterization Framework for Intelligent Sequential Decision Making
summary: Puzzles are widely used to evaluate the reasoning capabilities of artificial intelligence (AI) systems for sequential decision making, yet approaches originating from different paradigms are rarely compared under unified conditions. To address this gap, we introduce a three-dimensional characterization framework that enables the analysts of AI methods by 1) projecting them to the Markov decision process (MDP) sequential decision making formalism, 2) degree of autonomy through human prior ranking of their designs and, 3) skill and computational cost. Using this framework, we analyze how representative graph-based, reinforcement learning, and large language model (LLM)-based approaches differ in their design choices and performance characteristics, instantiated respectively by Neurosolver, forward-backward reinforcement learning (FBRL), and automated thought-of-search (AutoToS), including a double-agent extension of thought-of-search (DA-ToS). The analysis relies on the Tower of Hanoi puzzle that provides a controlled benchmark with well-defined rules and scalable complexity, enabling consistent comparison across increasing problem sizes. The 3D characterization reveals that LLM-based methods, due to their weakly constrained action-space design, shift complexity from architecture to inference-time verification, leading to substantially higher memory and runtime costs than Neurosolver and FBRL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个三维表征框架，用于统一比较不同AI范式（图神经网络、强化学习、LLM）的序贯决策方法，并通过河内塔(Tower of Hanoi)基准进行实例分析。
AI.motivation: 现有AI序贯决策方法的评估多基于孤立的优势/劣势分析，缺乏统一的跨范式比较框架，难以揭示设计选择如何在系统组件间重新分配复杂度。
AI.method: 1) 提出三维表征框架：(i) MDP公式化投影，(ii) 人类先验等级（架构/训练/推理三阶段），(iii) 技能-计算成本权衡；2) 选择Neurosolver（图基）、FBRL（强化学习）、AutoToS与新提出的DA-ToS（LLM基）作为代表性方法；3) 以河内塔为可控基准进行理论与实验对比。
AI.result: LLM基方法因动作空间弱约束，将复杂度从架构设计转移到推理时验证循环，导致内存和运行时成本显著高于Neurosolver和FBRL；Neurosolver始终获得最优步数(2ⁿ-1)，且时间增长平缓；FBRL可处理到4个圆盘但内存由replay buffer主导；AutoToS/DA-ToS不受圆盘数量限制但消耗大量token和内存（10⁴ MB量级）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为跨范式AI序贯决策方法比较提供了结构化基础，揭示了LLM方法以推理时验证换架构简约的权衡特性，可推广至河内塔以外的场景。

title: What is the goal of unsupervised machine learning?
summary: Unsupervised learning is one of the main branches of machine learning. Here I argue that unlike the other branches of machine learning (supervised and reinforcement learning), unsupervised learning is a rather heterogenous field that can serve several different goals. It seems futile to try to define one single goal for unsupervised learning. I identify four different goals for unsupervised learning: 1) Estimating the distribution, 2) Generating new data points, 3) Extracting features for downstream tasks, and 4) Understanding the data.

AI.tldr: 本文指出无监督学习不像监督学习和强化学习那样有单一明确的目标，而是一个异质性领域，可服务于多个不同甚至相互矛盾的目标。作者提出了四个目标：1) 估计数据分布；2) 生成新数据点；3) 提取用于下游任务的特征；4) 理解数据。
AI.motivation: 无监督学习作为机器学习的主要分支之一，缺乏一个统一的目标函数（如监督学习中的预测精度或强化学习中的总奖励），因此明确其目标对于方法选择、验证和评估至关重要。
AI.method: 概念性分析/立场论文。作者通过逻辑论证而非实验，对无监督学习进行系统性分类，列举并分析每个目标的：问题陈述、代表性方法（如核密度估计、分数匹配、GAN、自编码器、对比学习、ICA、因果发现等）、以及验证方式。同时讨论各目标间的正交性、可能矛盾、联系和潜在的额外目标（如数据压缩、因果学习、数据恢复）。
AI.result: 1) 目标1（密度估计）可采用核密度估计、分数匹配、归一化流等方法，但难以验证模型拟合好坏；2) 目标2（生成新数据点）常通过GAN、扩散模型等实现，但验证（避免复制训练数据）极具挑战性；3) 目标3（特征提取）通过自监督学习实现，可在半监督框架下用下游任务准确率轻松验证；4) 目标4（理解数据）强调可解释性和可识别性（如ICA、非线性ICA、因果发现），验证依赖于领域专家。此外，目标1、2与目标3、4之间存在正交性，且简单线性模型（利于理解）可能与其他目标相矛盾。
AI.conclusion: 无监督学习不存在单一目标，而是由多个相互独立甚至相互矛盾的目标构成。该四目标分类法是初步尝试，可在未来工作中扩展（如加入数据压缩、因果干预等目标），并发展更严谨的分类体系。

title: Intervention anchors and scientific verification in synthetic vascular predictive representations
comment: Technical Note; 18 pages, 8 figures; reproducibility source and data archive included
summary: Complete orthogonal predictive coordinates do not by themselves bind a latent direction to a named intervention. We present a mathematical and synthetic audit motivated by vascular device-vessel suitcordance. Capacity-matched least-squares predictors were exactly equivalent under complete fixed output transforms, whereas an anchor-only observer recovered interpretations only within the span of known perturbation signatures. Six three-dimensional configurations across 64 seeds gave a maximum paired prediction discrepancy of 6.7e-15 but a median untransported edit error of 1.513. Coordinate transport removed that error. Noisy and weak anchors constrained calibration stability, and changing the representation basis required recalibration or verified transport. Across 256 additional fits in dimensions 3-24, prediction equivalence persisted within 4.0e-15. We then evaluated nine deliberate runnable fault classes across 64 seeds. All 576 faulty executions completed, but each violated at least one reconstruction, prediction, delivered-edit or scope contract; all 320 valid control records passed. Repeating a faulty implementation gave exact self-agreement despite error against the separately computed simulator expectation. For one omitted-direction defect, probe coverage followed its analytic law, and rank-aware abstention protected unsupported interpretations. Scalar-noise experiments exposed both missed weak faults and excessive rejection under narrow relative tolerances. These controls provide an executable separation of prediction, semantic support and scientific acceptance. They are synthetic numerical audits, not clinical validation, neural JEPA-Anything replication, agent learning or patient treatment-effect estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对血管数字孪生中"预测能力"与"干预可解释性"常被混为一谈的问题，构建了一套基于完全正交坐标的合成数学审计框架。作者通过最小二乘预测等价性、干预锚定(anchors)、噪声条件数影响、坐标迁移以及可执行科学契约等数值实验，论证了预测精度本身不足以保证潜在坐标对应真正的命名干预，并提出应区分预测、语义支持与科学接受三个层面。
AI.motivation: 血管数字孪生需要将可观测的血管状态与可解释的干预响应联系起来，但当前的正交预测表示(如JEPA-Anything)只保证了几何与预测性质，并未将潜在方向绑定到具体的命名干预上。作者希望明确指出"完整预测坐标"与"具有命名语义的干预"之间的本质差异，并通过临床动机(如IABP观察性研究与因果推断的区分)说明这一区分在医学领域的重要性。
AI.method: 1) 构建完全正交的合成矩阵Q，分析/合成对(u=Q^T x, x=Qu)；2) 对比单整体最小二乘预测器与基于Q的等效预测器，验证完全固定输出变换下的等价性；3) 设计六组三维合成配置(A-F)与64个种子，量化预测差异与未迁移编辑误差；4) 引入干预锚定(锚矩阵A及其潜签名B=Q^T A)，推导锚定观察者的可识别性边界与歧义见证(H变换)；5) 在不同噪声σ与重复测量次数下对比无约束逆映射与正交Procrustes校准；6) 通过条件数实验和坐标迁移(源/目标基)验证校准稳定性；7) 将预测与锚定控制扩展至d=3,6,12,24维；8) 构建含9类故障、5类有效对照与1类执行错误的可执行故障库，运行五项科学契约(执行、重建、预测、端到端编辑、范围)；9) 通过随机探测与定向补探测分析未锚定方向的覆盖率；10) 在标量高斯噪声下对比绝对、相对与混合容差的真阳/假阳率。
AI.result: 1) 六配置×64种子下，单整体与变换输出预测器最大差异仅6.66×10^-15，但未迁移命名编辑中位RMS误差高达1.513，迁移后降至6.91×10^-16以下；2) 锚定映射仅能在span(A)内恢复命名扰动，k=1,2时分别支持1、2个单位编辑，其余需弃权；3) 噪声σ=0.2时，64次重复测量将逆映射中位误差从0.324降至0.039；4) 条件数1→100时逆映射误差从0.0079升至0.586；源基直接用于目标基时RMS误差1.487，目标重校准后降至9.74×10^-16；5) d=3,6,12,24共256次拟合最大预测差异4.00×10^-15；6) 576条故障记录均被至少一项契约拒绝，320条有效记录全部通过；7) 故障重复运行给出完全自一致，但与独立oracle对比显示预测误差3.519；8) 随机探测覆盖率遵循1-(2/3)^n解析律，最大偏差0.0142；9) δ=10^-4时，相对容差健康误拒率0.959，绝对与混合容差故障检出率仅0.0015。
AI.conclusion: 本文以合成线性审计方式证明：(1) 完全正交预测坐标在数学上可由多种基选择产生相同的预测精度，因此预测等价性不能保证坐标具有命名干预语义；(2) 干预锚定(已知扰动签名)是赋予潜在方向以可解释性的必要条件，其效果受噪声、锚矩阵条件数与基迁移影响；(3) 通过显式的可执行契约可分离"预测正确"、"语义有据"与"科学接受"三个层面，重复执行一致性并非有效性证据；(4) 未锚定方向需通过弃权或额外探测处理，容差选择会显著改变弱信号下的检验行为。该框架为血管数字孪生的可解释性评估提供了可重复的数学基线，但仅限合成场景，不构成临床验证或神经模型复现。

title: Does an Illumination Prior Help Face-Swap Detection? A Controlled Study of Temporal Self-Blended Images
summary: Self-blended images are widely used to train face-swap detectors, but primarily capture blending artifacts. We investigate whether adding illumination inconsistencies improves detection. Temporal Self-Blended Images (T-SBI) transfer lighting statistics between frames of the same video, with the mismatch controlled by luminance difference ({\Delta}L). Using five training regimes and a three-seed comparison of high- and low-{\Delta}L training, we find no evidence of illumination-specific improvements. AUC differences remain within seed variability across four datasets, and an analysis of 506,328 attribute-binned samples shows no preferential reduction in errors under harsh lighting. Instead, T-SBI shifts prediction scores, changing optimal thresholds by approximately 0.34 on FaceForensics++ and 0.30 on Celeb-DF, making comparisons at a fixed threshold misleading. However, T-SBI improves robustness to heavy JPEG compression on DFDC (AUC 0.780 versus 0.696), potentially reflecting greater reliance on low-frequency cues. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating training methods against their intended targets and accounting for threshold effects.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在自混合图像(SBI)人脸交换检测训练中引入光照不一致性先验(T-SBI)是否有效。通过严格的控制实验（五种训练范式、三种子光照差分位数实验、506,328行的失败分类法），发现光照先验并未显著提升检测性能，反而改变了分数分布和决策阈值，但意外地增强了抗JPEG压缩能力。
AI.motivation: 自混合图像(SBI)是训练人脸交换检测器的主流方法，但其主要捕捉混合伪影而非光照不一致性。基于光度取证文献表明合成人脸会留下光照不一致痕迹，作者尝试将光照统计量从同一视频的不同帧之间转移，构建时序自混合图像(T-SBI)，并以受控探针形式严格检验光照先验是否真正提升检测能力。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) T-SBI生成器——使用MediaPipe FaceMesh定义凸包掩膜，在LAB空间中进行L通道直方图匹配（保留均值、标准差和低频亮度项），通过ΔL门控（ΔL_mean≥6或ΔL_std≥3）控制光照差异；(2) 五种训练范式消融——分解监督、自混合和时序自混合成分；(3) ΔL四分位数实验——高ΔL（均值12.43）vs低ΔL（均值1.57），三种子；(4) 七变体捷径消融验证管道无类别不对称伪信号；(5) 506,328行九属性失败分类法，使用Cramér's V作为效应量。
AI.result: 核心结果为阴性：(1) C-vs-B对比（隔离T-SBI）在各数据集上无一致方向，AUC差异在±0.02以内；(2) ΔL四分位数实验中，高ΔL与低ΔL的帧级AUC差异（|Δ|/σ_comb = 0.08-0.71）均在种子方差内，不支持光照差为活跃成分；(3) 失败分类法显示T-SBI在恶劣光照bin上无偏好性错误率降低（Cramér's V < 0.05，效应可忽略）；(4) 但T-SBI确实将最优决策阈值下移约0.34（FF++）和0.30（Celeb-DF）；(5) 唯一稳健收益是在DFDC重JPEG压缩下AUC 0.780 vs 0.696（+0.084），反映模型转向低频线索。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出三个结论：(1) T-SBI作为光照先验的目标机制不被支持——训练对光照差不产生可测量的检测能力变化，也不带来光照特异性鲁棒性；(2) T-SBI的真正效应是阈值偏移和抗压缩性增强，而非设计目标的光照机制；(3) 方法论贡献——提出可复用的诊断工具（实现门控报告、类别不平衡鲁棒的阈值扫描、属性分箱失败分类法），强调物理属性驱动的训练先验必须针对其目标属性进行验证，而非仅依赖聚合准确率。论文将T-SBI定位为受控探针而非改进方案。

title: DeltaReplay: Task-Relative Memory Reuse for Mobile GUI Agents
summary: Memory-augmented mobile GUI agents store successful execution trajectories and reuse them in later tasks, but a stored trajectory rarely matches a new task exactly. The new task may use different parameters, share only some of its steps with a stored trajectory, or have no relevant record in memory. Forcing the agent to use irrelevant memory can mislead it, whereas discarding memory that may still be useful deprives it of guidance from past experience. To address this dilemma, we propose DeltaReplay, a step-level memory reuse framework that decides how to use existing memory without modifying it. We observe that the reusable part of a stored record is determined not by the record itself but by its relation to the new task, mainly through two factors: page-level consistency and action-level generality. We therefore store execution trajectories as paths in a transition graph, whose nodes (pages) and edges (actions between pages) capture these two factors. At reuse time, the action on each edge is split into a task-independent operation and task-specific parameters. DeltaReplay then compares each recorded step with the new task and the current screen, and decides whether to follow it, execute it after replacing its parameters, or leave it to the base agent. On AndroidWorld and SPA-Bench, DeltaReplay improves the task success rate over a base agent with the same backbone by up to 10.3 and 25.0 percentage points, respectively. These results indicate that deciding at each step how to use retrieved memory lets agents benefit even from partially matching trajectories.

AI.tldr: DeltaReplay 提出了一种面向移动 GUI 智能体的逐步记忆复用框架，将执行轨迹存储为转换图，并在每一步根据当前屏幕和新任务的关系，从重放（Route A）、重新接地（Route B）和丢弃（Route C）三种路由中选择最合适的方式复用记忆，无需修改已存储的记忆。在 AndroidWorld 和 SPA-Bench 上显著提升了任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强 GUI 智能体通常将整条记录视为一个整体，要么整体使用、要么整体丢弃，导致三类失败：(i) 可直接重放的步骤仍被推理（慢）；(ii) 部分可用的记忆被整体丢弃；(iii) 不适用的记忆仍被模型采纳造成误导。根源在于记录的可用性因步骤而异，依赖于新任务与当前屏幕。
AI.method: 将执行轨迹存储为转换图（节点为页面，边为带记录动作的转移），按任务标识检索。对检索到的每一步做判断：(1) 结构匹配比较当前屏幕与记录节点；(2) 若不匹配则用 LLM 选择器做语义匹配；(3) 根据屏幕是否一致、是否携带旧任务参数，在每一步选择 Route A（重放，结构性映射到当前元素）、Route B（通过对齐新旧任务描述替换参数重新接地）或 Route C（交给基础智能体）。整个过程不改写记忆。
AI.result: 在 AndroidWorld-116（116 个任务）和 SPA-Bench-60（60 个中文单 app 任务）上，使用 Qwen3-VL-30B 和 Qwen3.8-Flash 两个骨干，DeltaReplay 比同骨干基础智能体任务成功率分别提升最高 10.3 和 25.0 个百分点；超过 RAG-prompting 与 GUI-explorer 等记忆基线；在记忆覆盖任务时单步延迟最多降低 57%（约 9.3 s/步）；在记忆不适用的任务上无明显损失。对 Route A/B/C 的逐步盲评显示精度约 83.7%/78.0%/75.5%。消融表明验证与丢弃不可或缺，去掉 Route C 后成功率从 86.4% 跌至 45.5%。
AI.conclusion: 逐路由（step-level routing）的记忆复用能让 GUI 智能体从部分匹配的历史轨迹中获益，同时避免错误记忆的负向迁移。DeltaReplay 兼具成功率提升与延迟下降，并在记忆不相关时保持安全回退。局限性包括：处理 UI 变动（目标元素移动/消失）、对蕴含型参数替换的支持有限、依赖基准任务标识进行检索、以及依赖 LLM 判定。

title: Internalizer: Portable Context-to-Parameter Mapping for Very Large Language Models
summary: Hypernetworks that map a context directly to a LoRA adapter let a large language model carry that context in its weights, but prior work has demonstrated them only on base models of up to 14 billion parameters. We present the Internalizer, a state-of-the-art, portable Context-to-Parameter Mapping hypernetwork that generates document-specific LoRA adapters for the frozen 284B-parameter DeepSeek v4 Flash, a target two orders of magnitude larger than in any previous work. Most of its parameters live in a model-agnostic trunk with only thin entry and exit layers per base model, so it trains cheaply against small models before being ported to the large one. On unseen documents of up to 4096 tokens, the generated adapters reach 84.9% top-1 and 97.8% top-5 teacher-forced accuracy against 63.4% and 83.5% for the base model, with nothing in the context window but a three-word instruction. Once the hypernetwork is trained, a single forward pass turns any document into an adapter for such a model, which could be served alone for speed or alongside the document in the window to raise accuracy further.

AI.tldr: Internalizer 提出了一种可移植的上下文到参数映射（Context-to-Parameter Mapping）超网络架构，通过将文档转换为 LoRA 适配器以"内化"上下文信息到冻结的大型语言模型（284B 参数的 DeepSeek v4 Flash）的权重中，其规模比以往同类工作大两个数量级。该架构采用模型无关的主干网络搭配薄薄的模型特定输入/输出层，并结合"反向蒸馏"预训练策略，可将大部分学习过程在小型模型上廉价完成。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型部署面临三大成本/精度瓶颈：上下文窗口膨胀、上下文学习效率低下、逐任务微调不切实际。现有上下文到参数映射方法受限于小规模模型（最大14B参数），无法满足商业部署对大型模型的精度需求。该研究旨在突破规模和可移植性限制。
AI.method: 核心架构：包含六个组件的 Perceiver 式超网络——隐藏状态输入适配器、深度嵌入、Perceiver 编码器（256 个查询向量压缩可变长度 token）、偏置查询流、共享解码头、合并步骤。关键设计：超大的输入/输出投影（解耦表征能力与基础模型宽度）、仅针对 MLP 投影（适配现代 MoE/密集架构共有的门控 MLP 结构）、错误门控损失（λ×错误 token 损失加权）、"反向蒸馏"课程学习（先在 5 个 1–3B 模型上预训练主干，再移植到 284B 目标模型）。
AI.result: 在 4096 token 训练范围内，未见过的文档实现 84.9% top-1 和 97.8% top-5 教师强制准确率，显著优于基础模型的 63.4% 和 83.5%，困惑度 1.7 vs 5.6。训练范围外的 8192/16384 token 性能骤降。冷启动与热启动对比实验表明，冻结主干+仅训练薄层在相同步数内可达到 >90% top-1 准确率，而从零训练仅能达到 75%。64 块 H200 GPU 上约 3 天完成 DeepSeek v4 Flash 移植阶段。
AI.conclusion: Internalizer 首次将上下文到参数映射超网络扩展到 284B 参数规模，并通过模型无关的主干设计实现跨模型可移植性。预训练后的超网络可单次前向传播将任意文档转化为 LoRA 适配器，支持速度模式（替代上下文）或准确率模式（与上下文共同使用）。该工作被定位为预训练基础，下一步将通过任务微调评估其在实际部署中的增益。

title: 4-Tensor Attention Model for Semantic Physical Reality
summary: We describe a 4-tensor attention model that predicts the next semantic state of a scene, for video generation and robot planning. A window of states has positions (x, t) and two fibers, a semantic fiber and a temporal-context fiber, and one softmax normalizes attention jointly over the window. Frames and an agent's situation are written as those states; the encoder, the renderer, and the planner remain outside the update. To test the update on its own, we train on ROCStories, where each window poses the same next-sentence task at the semantic layer. On the validation split, with one seed per setting, the last-sentence cross-entropy on the three matched settings is lower for the 4-tensor model than for a free-running one-dimensional transformer by 5.3% at H=2, L=2, by 2.6% at H=4, L=2, and by 2.4% at H=4, L=3. At H=4, L=2 the parameter counts are nearly the same, 172.5M and 175.9M. On the same two GPUs that 4-tensor run finished in 2.4 hours and the baseline run in 45.2 hours; the baseline is trained by free-running decoding, one sequential forward pass per target token.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种4-张量注意力模型（4-Tensor Attention），将场景的语义状态窗口表示为具有语义纤维和时序上下文纤维的秩4张量，通过联合softmax对窗口内所有位置进行归一化注意力计算，用于视频生成和机器人规划的下一步语义状态预测。
AI.motivation: 当前视频生成和世界模型主要在连续的像素或潜空间运作，难以保持长时一致性，因为语义信息和感知细节混合在同一稠密表示中。论文将场景的语义表征视为该场景的认知压缩，主张通过离散步骤演化语义描述来推进场景，而非在感知数据间插值。
AI.method: 核心方法是将状态窗口表示为秩4张量 X∈R^(N×d_x×T×d_t)，其中N为词位置、T为时序、d_x为语义纤维、d_t为时序上下文纤维。词嵌入采用E_sem和E_temp的双字典外积；投影权重W∈R^(d_x×d_x×d_t×d_t)是双线性映射；联合softmax在(x,t)键网格上同时归一化（无时间因果掩码，仅对填充键掩码）。位置编码包括空间正弦P_xn和联合相位时序T^emb_xn（相位为x+t）。读出采用秩1分解W_out = E_sem⊗W'，与输入嵌入共享E_sem参数。模型使用Pre-LN结构，dropout仅作用于注意力和MLP残差分支。
AI.result: 在ROCStories数据集（97,929训练/3,742验证，词表36,711）上训练，三组匹配设置下4-张量模型的末句交叉熵均低于自由运行的1维自回归Transformer基线：H=2,L=2时低5.3%（5.562 vs 5.873）；H=4,L=2时低2.6%（5.554 vs 5.701）；H=4,L=3时低2.4%（5.531 vs 5.667）。H=4,L=2时参数接近（172.5M vs 175.9M），困惑度258 vs 299。训练效率方面，4-张量运行仅需2.4小时，基线需45.2小时（同一双RTX 3080）。准确率从基线的7.3-11.1%提升至4-张量模型的15.4-16.8%。
AI.conclusion: 秩4分解强制模型区分语义内容和时序上下文，保持d_x和d_t纤维作为独立张量因子。分离仅在边界处施加（秩1输入嵌入和秩1读出函数），内部权重W保持一般双线性映射，允许任意跨纤维交互。该架构不强制将转移规则从其作用对象中抽象出来，而是保留了可使此类抽象涌现并被测试的表征。未来方向包括多步展开（自回归推理）和在生成图像插值上执行去噪。论文还提到将语义状态视为"嵌套包含"（类Zermelo后继构造）的进一步研究方向。

title: MultiWorldBench: Do Independently Controlled Views Describe One Shared World?
summary: Multiplayer world models must ensure that independently controlled views remain consistent with one shared and persistent world. We introduce MultiWorldBench, a diagnostic Minecraft benchmark containing 495 case configurations across seven task suites and ten capabilities, including independent control, cross-view motion, shared-state synchronization, persistence, structural reasoning, concurrent interaction, and delayed revisit. We evaluate Solaris, Gamma-World, and MineWorld, using Engine GT as a reference. Gamma-World achieves the highest ten-capability average among the generated systems at 21.39, followed by Solaris at 20.88 and MineWorld at 1.89, while Engine GT reaches 91.69. Gamma-World performs better on several control, shared-state, and revisit capabilities, whereas Solaris leads in cross-view motion and race-condition consistency. Nevertheless, all generated systems score at most 8.00 on state persistence and 1.33 on structural consistency, and none succeeds in spatial reasoning or building-identity preservation. Human preferences produce the same overall ranking and show strong alignment with the automatic evaluation, with a mean dimension-level Spearman correlation of 0.96. These results show that plausible individual views do not yet constitute a coherent multiplayer world.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MultiWorldBench，一个基于Minecraft的多视角世界模型诊断基准，包含495个案例配置、7个任务套件和10种能力评估维度，用于检验多个独立控制的玩家视角是否描述同一个共享且持久的世界。实验评估了Solaris、Gamma-World和MineWorld三个模型，以Engine GT为参考。结果显示现有模型在控制隔离、共享状态同步、世界持久性、结构一致性等方面均显著落后于真实引擎参考，所有生成模型在空间推理和建筑身份保持上完全失败，表明看似合理的单视角生成尚不构成连贯的多人世界。
AI.motivation: 随着交互式世界模型从单玩家潜空间模拟器发展为动作条件视频生成器，多人场景引入了更严苛的要求：多个独立控制的视角必须对应同一个共享且持久的世界。现有评估协议在场景几何变化、失败模式区分度和评估方法覆盖范围上存在不足，无法充分区分模型是否真正实现了独立控制、跨视角一致性、共享状态传播和持久记忆，因此需要一个系统化的诊断基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 基准设计围绕两个核心要求展开：(1) 独立控制——每位玩家的响应是否受自身动作驱动而不受对方干扰；(2) 世界一致性——两个视角是否支持同一持久状态。基准包含495个案例配置，按可见性条件（互见、单向、互不可见）分层，涵盖匹配导航、跨视角运动、共享状态交互与持久性、建筑揭示、并发放置、延迟跨玩家重访等7个任务套件。评估采用10种能力指标，结合几何度量（相机位姿估计）、轨迹度量、VLM视觉判断、分割与视点估计、颜色分布度量等多种方法。同时引入人类偏好标注（300对比较×3标注者）验证自动评估的有效性。
AI.result: 在十能力平均分上，Gamma-World以21.39分领先于Solaris（20.88）和MineWorld（1.89），但三者均远低于Engine GT参考的91.69分。Gamma-World在控制隔离（48.35）、协调公平性（65.76）和共享状态同步（36.67）上表现较优；Solaris在跨视角运动一致性（75.00）和竞态一致性（16.67）上领先。所有生成模型在状态持久性上至多仅得8.00分，结构一致性至多1.33分，空间推理和建筑身份保持上全部得0分。人类偏好排序与自动评估一致，维度级Spearman相关系数均值为0.96（范围0.82-1.00）。
AI.conclusion: 多人导向的世界模型在独立多视角控制方面已取得初步改善，但在维护共享世界方面仍存在根本性缺陷。基础动作与指令执行的错误会传播至更复杂的共享世界评估中；当编辑区域离开视野后，现有系统几乎无法恢复相同的物体、空间布局和共享状态。结论表明，看似合理的单视角生成尚不构成连贯的多人世界，MultiWorldBench为未来研究提供了一个系统化的诊断工具。局限性在于评估仅限于Minecraft，其离散体素视觉风格与真实世界连续光真实感动力学存在差距。

title: Addressing Overcommitment in the Reasoning of Gendered Economic Memes under Multimodal Ambiguity
summary: Multimodal meme understanding is increasingly used to analyze socially sensitive content, yet existing models often exhibit biased behavior when interpreting economic dependence and social roles under ambiguity. Many memes express economic relationships through sparse text or symbolic visual cues, providing insufficient evidence for gendered attribution. In such underspecified settings, models tend to rely on pretraining correlations, leading to hallucinated and stereotypical economic role assignments. In this work, we study gendered economic dependence in image-text memes through the lens of contextual sufficiency and identify epistemic overcommitment-inferring roles without adequate evidence-as a primary source of bias. We propose CGER-Net, a context-grounded multimodal framework that estimates whether the input provides sufficient evidence for gendered economic reasoning and applies evidence-gated inference to enable confident attribution when cues are explicit while favoring principled abstention otherwise. We evaluate CGER-Net on EconMeme-GE, a curated dataset of image-text memes annotated as Men, Women, Neutral, or Ambiguous. Across strong contemporary multimodal baselines, CGER-Net reduces Gender Overcommitment Rate by up to 44% on ambiguous instances while maintaining comparable accuracy on unambiguous cases. Human evaluation further shows that 79% of generated rationales are judged as epistemically aligned with the available evidence. These results highlight the importance of modeling when not to infer for reliable and responsible multimodal analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对多模态模因(meme)中性别化经济角色推理的偏见问题,提出了一个名为 CGER-Net 的上下文充分性感知的框架,并构建了专用数据集 EconMeme-GE,在模糊情境下显著降低了过度性别归因率,同时保持明确场景下的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态模型在解读模因中的经济依赖与社会角色时,常因预训练相关性在证据不足的模糊情境下产生幻觉化、刻板化的性别经济角色归因(即"认知过度承诺"),而现有偏见缓解方法和基准多将此视为可决分类问题,未将"证据不足时的克制"作为一等公民处理。
AI.method: 提出 CGER-Net(Context-Grounded Economic Reasoning Network)框架,核心包含: (1)冻结的视觉/文本编码器分别提取特征; (2)上下文充分性估计模块,基于视觉、文本与OCR长度通过MLP输出充分性分数 s∈[0,1]; (3)证据门控融合 z = s·φ([v;t]) + (1-s)·u,在低充分性时退化为学习的不确定性嵌入; (4)四类(Men/Women/Neutral/Ambiguous)分类器; (5)基于充分性条件的自然语言理由生成; (6)训练目标 L = L_CE + λ·L_cons,其中一致性正则项惩罚低充分性下做出男/女归因。同时构建 EconMeme-GE 数据集(2048条图像-文本模因,约41%标注为Ambiguous,三名标注者 Cohen's κ=0.74)。
AI.result: 在 EconMeme-GE 上,CGER-Net 准确率73.8、F1=70.2,虽略低于最强 LMM 基线(InternVL-Chat: Acc=75.6, F1=71.8),但在关键偏见指标上显著领先:Ambiguity Recall=0.63(最高)、Gender Overcommitment Rate=0.19(最低,相对最强基线降低约37–44%)、Rationale Alignment Rate=0.71(最高);人类评估 HRAR=0.79,其中 Ambiguous 类达0.85。消融实验显示去除充分性模块/门控融合/一致性损失会导致 GOR 上升约一倍。OCR 长度分桶分析表明,文本越充分,GOR 越低(从0.58降至0.14)。
AI.conclusion: CGER-Net 通过显式建模上下文充分性与证据门控推理,有效缓解了模糊经济语境下的不当性别归因,同时在证据明确时仍能做出可靠推理并生成与证据一致的理由;该工作强调了"何时不应推理"在负责任多模态分析中的核心价值,并与联合国 SDG 10(减少不平等)和 SDG 16(和平、正义与强大机构)对齐。

title: Implementing the Spec Growth Engine: Preventing Spec-Code Divergence, and Growing the Spec with Agents
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: The Spec Growth Engine anchors AI-assisted software development in a graph of specifications that the code is coupled to. This paper describes its implementation, which serves two tasks and keeps them apart as two layers. The first layer prevents spec-code divergence: a deterministic engine validates the spec graph, compares it with the code's import graph, earns a node's verified status from recorded test evidence, and classifies every change by what it can break -- without calling a model. The second layer grows the spec with agents: an intent author, a planner and a coder, each played by its own model, extend the graph in rounds, and a deterministic rule decides after each round whether the run goes on. How much of the human's judgement is delegated is set by three independent switches -- a draft gate, a delegation for breaking changes, and the run mode -- which, with two ways of laying a project's floor, give eighteen ways to run a project. We describe each of them, the gates, requests and waivers through which agents and the human communicate, and the spectrum of operation from entirely manual work to an unsupervised run whose decisions the human reviews afterwards. Throughout, one claim holds the design together: an autonomous run is worth only as much as the deterministic instance that measures it.

AI.tldr: 本文描述了规范增长引擎（Spec Growth Engine）的实现，这是一种将AI辅助软件开发锚定在规范图谱中的方法。系统分为两层：确定性层（Layer 1）通过验证图谱、对比导入图、记录测试证据来防止规范-代码偏离，不调用任何模型；智能体层（Layer 2）通过意图作者、规划者和编码器三个角色来扩展图谱。系统通过三个独立开关（草稿门、破坏性变更委托、运行模式）和两种项目初始化方式，组合出18种运行项目的方式。核心论点是：自主运行的价值取决于其后测量它的确定性实例。论文以一个猜数字游戏为例，展示了从手动到无人监督的完整操作光谱。
AI.motivation: AI辅助软件开发面临两大核心问题：上下文爆炸（context explosion）和规范-代码的静默偏离（spec-code drift）。现有方法要么将规范视为可侵蚀的文档，要么完全依赖模型的判断而缺乏可重复、可阻断的验证机制。本文旨在通过将软件开发锚定在可机器验证的规范图谱上，让确定性机制承担验证职责，让模型承担判断职责，从而解决这两个失败模式。
AI.method:
系统采用严格的分层架构：

1. **第1层（确定性底座）**：完全不使用模型，执行四项检查——validate（图谱良构性）、drift（代码与图谱的一致性，基于Python/TypeScript/Java/Dart的导入图）、lifecycle（状态生命周期：specd→implemented→verified，verified需测试证据）、change set（变更集，按HARD/SOFT/AUTO/NONE分级）。引入"已接受状态"（accepted state）处理没有保存时刻的智能体写入。

2. **第2层（智能体层）**：三个独立模型角色——意图作者(I)、规划者(P)、编码器(C)，加上审阅者(H')。以"轮次"运行，每轮后确定性规则决定是否继续。

3. **三个自治开关**：草稿门(D0/D1/D2)、破坏性变更委托（开/关）、运行模式（关/开/无人监督）。

4. **请求与豁免**：决策请求（不授权，仅记录）和豁免（类型化、归属化、时效化）。

5. **18种运行方式**：两种底座（guided/bare）× 三个开关的组合。

6. **运行光谱**：从纯手工→有助手（意图到规范）→智能体运行→无人监督运行。
AI.result:
通过一个猜数字游戏实例验证：

- **手动+助手模式**：三个目标检查轮次，47个测试，最终DONE
- **监督运行**：1轮，130个测试，3个组件，以ASKING结束（容器上有待人类决策的请求）
- **无人监督运行**：1轮但耗时32分钟，229个测试，4个组件，以UNCHECKED结束（目标检查触及输出限制），后转为ASKING（人类需审核H'代为做出的决定）

三个版本生成不同图谱（2、3、4个组件）但完成相同目标。运行还暴露了三个引擎弱点：修订无法删除键、目标检查受限于输出限制、结束语漏掉轮内决定——均已修复。

关键发现：绿色的底座（测试通过、门控通过、获得验证状态）是必要而非充分的——43个测试通过时目标检查仍发现3个差距。
AI.conclusion: 该工作的核心贡献在于重新定义AI辅助软件工程中"自主性"的概念：不是单一自治梯度的升高，而是三个独立维度的授权（草稿审阅、破坏性变更接受、意图生成）。其设计哲学是——**自主运行的价值仅等同于其后测量它的确定性实例的价值**。智能体声称"DONE"不能证明任何事；阻断的门、记录的测试、说明变动的变更集才是使其声明可验证的依据。这一架构使规范从可侵蚀的文档变为可阻断的合同，同时保留了从纯手工到完全无人监督的渐进式采用路径。实践表明，确定性底座是必要的但非充分的；目标检查需要独立于测试通过的审阅才能确保目标真正达成。

title: MAP4CS: A Multi-dimensional Data Pruning Framework for Efficient Code Retriever Fine-tuning
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a cornerstone in software engineering for enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs) with domain-specific knowledge. However, adapting retrievers to evolving code repositories remains challenging due to the noise and redundancy inherent in massive code corpora. Standard fine-tuning on the full corpus is computationally expensive and often leads to sub-optimal performance due to negative transfer from low-quality samples. Conversely, simple random sampling fails to guarantee data representativeness. To address these challenges, we propose MAP4CS (Multi-dimensional Awareness Pruning for Code Search), an adaptive data pruning framework. MAP4CS identifies a small, high-quality core subset by integrating syntactic structure, semantic diversity, and distributional representation, followed by a rigorous rule-based filtering pipeline. Extensive experiments on two large-scale datasets demonstrate that MAP4CS consistently outperforms random sampling baselines using only 5% of the training data. Remarkably, it achieves performance comparable to, or even superior to, fine-tuning on the full dataset, validating the ''less is more'' hypothesis in data-centric AI. Furthermore, linguistic analysis reveals an adaptive optimization mechanism: MAP4CS automatically functions as a de-duplicator for redundant corpora and a denoiser for chaotic ones, constructing a training corpus that is both lexically diverse and information-dense.

AI.tldr: MAP4CS是一个面向代码检索器微调的多维数据剪枝框架，通过整合句法结构、语义多样性和分布表示，仅用5%训练数据即可达到或超越全量微调性能，验证了"少即是多"的数据中心AI假设。
AI.motivation: RAG中代码检索器需在领域代码库上微调，但全量微调存在噪声毒性问题（低质量样本导致负迁移）和计算成本高两大挑战；而随机采样会丢失长尾知识并保留高熵噪声。现有通用数据剪枝方法忽略代码的句法结构，传统代码清洗仅做防御性过滤缺乏选择智能。因此需要一个专门为代码搜索设计的多维数据剪枝框架。
AI.method: MAP4CS采用"粗到细"三阶段流水线：(1) 基于Single-Pass Clustering的流式语义聚类（O(N)复杂度，阈值τ=0.55），将语料库组织为局部语义上下文；(2) 多指标样本评分——句法结构多样性（基于Tree-sitter的AST线性化+LCS序列相似度）、语义一致性（查询-代码嵌入余弦相似度+分层采样）、分布表示（KDE密度估计+K近邻距离）；(3) 规则过滤（SHA-256去重、长度约束、启发式查询清洗）后加权融合排序（句法/语义权重各1/3，密度/多样性各1/6），取Top 5%构成最终子集。
AI.result: 在CSN-Java和Query4Code两个数据集上，使用UniXcoder、GTE-base和Qwen3-Embedding三种模型，在CodeSearchNet、CoSQA、APPS、Text2SQL四个基准测试中：仅用5%数据，MAP4CS在所有设置下均优于随机采样（如CSN-Java/UniXcoder平均MRR从0.166提升至0.219，提升31.9%）；且性能达到或超过全量微调（如CSN-Java/GTE-base从0.053提升至0.178）。消融实验证实聚类与多维过滤缺一不可；3%数据量即可超越50%随机采样。语言学分析显示MAP4CS使TTR从0.0402提升至0.0579，Shannon熵从6.269降至6.160，体现去重去噪双重机制。
AI.conclusion: MAP4CS通过多维数据剪枝解决了代码检索器微调中数据规模-质量的权衡问题，验证了"少即是多"假设：高质量小规模子集可优于大规模噪声语料库。框架自适应地充当冗余语料的去重器和混乱语料的降噪器，构建词汇多样且信息密集的训练集。未来工作将扩展至更大规模decoder-only LLM并探索迭代剪枝策略以支持持续学习场景。

title: Spectral Weight Decay: Inducing Low-Rank Structure in Neural Network Weights
summary: Standard weight decay treats each weight matrix as a vector and ignores its spectral structure. We introduce spectral weight decay, a post-step decoupled nuclear-norm update that applies additive rather than multiplicative spectral shrinkage. We connect the update to approximate proximal descent and show that its sensitivity to update order can exceed that of conventional $\ell_2$ weight decay near rank deficiency. Across LLaMA models with $124$M to $500$M parameters, spectral weight decay lowers effective rank and improves SVD-LLM compression at matched validation loss. At $500$M and a $4\%$ distortion budget, it reaches $1.89\times$ compression and $1.18\times$ GPU inference speedup, compared with $1.14\times$ and $1.01\times$ after standard weight decay. Under fixed-horizon training with $60\%$ label noise, it also improves final mean clean-test accuracy over matched $\ell_2$ regularization by up to $17.8$ points on MNIST and $4.6$ points across four BERT-base tasks. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出谱权重衰减（Spectral Weight Decay），将标准ℓ₂权重衰减的Frobenius范数惩罚替换为核范数惩罚，通过后置步的极因子近似施加加性的奇异值收缩。实验表明该方法能有效降低LLM权重矩阵的有效秩，从而提升SVD-LLM压缩效率和推理速度，并增强在固定训练轮次下对标签噪声的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 标准权重衰减以逐元素方式处理权重矩阵，忽略其作为矩阵的谱结构。ℓ₂惩罚对应Frobenius范数，虽惩罚大的平方奇异值之和，却不对小奇异值的"清除"产生偏好。这导致学到的权重矩阵谱较为平坦，难以直接进行低秩压缩，且缺乏对噪声标签下记忆效应的有效容量控制。
AI.method: 将核范数‖W‖_*（凸秩代理）替代平方Frobenius惩罚作为矩阵感知正则项，并采用解耦的后置步更新规则：W^(k+1) = Z - ηλ·U_Z V_Z^⊤，其中Z=W^(k)-ηΔ为仅用损失得到的候选点，U_Z V_Z^⊤为其极因子（采用五步Newton-Schulz迭代近似，无需SVD）。该更新相对于Z的奇异值施加加性收缩τ，对小奇异值的相对削减更强，类比于线性回归中ℓ₁诱导稀疏。理论分析（命题1）证明后置步是近似核范数近端梯度下降，且在近秩亏时其对更新顺序的敏感度可显著高于ℓ₂权重衰减。
AI.result: 1) LLaMA预训练（124M–500M参数，FineWeb-Edu）：谱权重衰减在匹配验证损失下显著降低有效秩；500M模型在4%失真预算下达到1.89×压缩率与1.18× GPU推理加速，相比标准ℓ₂权重衰减的1.14×压缩与1.01×加速优势明显，且在Cuttlefish和Prehab的匹配压缩对比中同样胜出。2) 标签噪声鲁棒性：固定训练轮次且无干净验证早停，60%标签噪声下，谱权重衰减在MNIST上比匹配ℓ₂正则化平均干净测试准确率最多提升17.78个百分点；在AG News、DBpedia-14、Yahoo Answers和Yelp Review Full四个BERT-base任务上分别提升4.59、1.23、4.59和4.16个百分点。3) 消融与局限：谱正则化需在预训练全程应用方有效，仅对已训练checkpoint进行微调同样在有效秩上需要数十倍的λ且损失代价高昂；与Muon等矩阵感知优化器组合时出现陡峭的损失-秩权衡，而Adam和Lion表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 谱权重衰减是一种矩阵感知的解耦正则化方法，能够在不影响验证损失的前提下诱导低秩权重结构，为后续低秩压缩与推理加速提供基础，并限制模型记忆噪声标签的能力。核范数近端视角支持后置步更新的选择，且该方法在Adam族优化器下的大规模LLM预训练中表现稳健。然而，将其迁移到Muon等矩阵感知优化器以及降低对已训练checkpoint施加谱正则化的损失代价仍是开放问题。

title: MemTrial: Learning When to Trust Memory in LLM Portfolio Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents for portfolio management learn from experience: they credit each experience in their memory with the outcome of the decisions that used it. In financial markets, however, this outcome mostly reflects the market move shared by all decisions on that date, so the credit tracks the market rather than the experience, and these agents often do worse than simply holding the equal-weight (1/$N$) portfolio. We ask how an agent can credit an experience with what it changes, and answer it by putting memory on trial: drafts of the same decision with and without an experience face the same market, so the outcome they share cancels in their difference. Our agent, MemTrial, drafts each decision with eight combinations of its retrieved experiences, chosen by a fractional factorial design, and credits each experience with its Banzhaf value, the average of these differences. As each date occurs once and each draft is a noisy LLM sample, these credits are noisy and may not hold on new dates. MemTrial therefore pools them across dates and similar experiences with a hierarchical Bayesian model, acts on them only after they have predicted unseen dates, and otherwise stays anchored at a conservative reference such as 1/$N$. On four benchmarks, MemTrial not only benefits from experiences that matter (the best of 15 methods on a semi-synthetic benchmark with known experience quality) but also limits its losses when its values do not hold (at most 2.2\% below 1/$N$ on PortBench and InvestorBench, against 15--38\% for the best experience-learning agent). Averaged over five settings, it improves the utility of the best experience-learning agent by 21.2\%, and with eight LLMs it beats every LLM-based baseline on InvestorBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemTrial，一种用于LLM投资组合管理智能体的经验学习框架，通过反事实归因、分层贝叶斯值估计、信任测试和锚定动作四个步骤，解决现有经验学习智能体因结果信用追踪市场而非经验本身而在真实市场中表现不佳的问题。在四个基准测试中，MemTrial在已知经验质量的半合成基准上达到15种方法中最优，在真实市场上保持接近1/N等权组合，同时对8种LLM均优于所有LLM基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM投资组合智能体通过结果信用学习经验，即用决策结果的收益来评价所用经验的价值。但由于金融市场上同一日期的所有决策共享市场走势，结果信用实际上追踪的是市场而非经验本身，导致经验学习智能体表现差于简单的1/N等权组合。核心挑战包括：(1)如何在单次市场日期上测量经验带来的变化；(2)如何判断学到的经验价值在新日期上是否仍然有效。
AI.method: MemTrial采用四步闭环学习框架：1) 反事实归因——对每个决策日期使用分数阶因子设计(2^(4-1)的1/2分数设计，8个草稿)生成包含不同经验子集的草稿，将每个经验在同日期含与不含它的草稿之差作为其贡献(Banzhf值)，从而消除共享市场走势；2) 价值估计——通过分层贝叶斯(Fay-Herriot模型)将噪声贡献在跨日期和相似经验间池化为价值估计；3) 信任测试——采用预序分析思想，要求学习到的价值在未见日期上预测得分显著为正后才被信任；4) 锚定动作——当值不被信任时，在保守参考组合(如1/N)与草稿均值之间进行在线FTRL锚定混合。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试中：1) PlantedMem(已知经验质量的半合成环境，含真实价格和LLM草稿)中MemTrial为15种方法中最优；2) PortBench(99资产月度决策)和InvestorBench(4股+现金日度)上MemTrial是最优LLM方法，与1/N差距不超过2.2%，而最佳经验学习基线落后1/N达15-38%；3) 五种基准设置平均，MemTrial比最佳经验学习智能体效用提升21.2%；4) 用8种LLM(GPT-4.1-mini/nano、GPT-5-mini、Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen3-235B、DeepSeek-V3.1、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Claude Haiku 4.5)测试，在InvestorBench的11种配置中均击败所有LLM基线。消融分析表明锚定动作和信任测试是最关键的组件。
AI.conclusion: MemTrial证明了"将记忆置于审判"思路的有效性：通过精心设计的实验在每个日期上分离经验贡献，并将信任学习推迟到预测被验证为止。论文也坦承局限性：在真实市场上MemTrial的优势主要来自"克制"——几乎不在未被验证的价值上行动，其学习到的经验价值在未见日期上很少持续有效；在ClassAlloc上经验改变了决策但价值并未跨日期泛化；从记忆中获益的证据尚需在记忆更重要的场景中进一步验证。此外还讨论了LLM预训练导致的回看偏差、信任测试缺乏形式化错误率保证、八倍LLM调用成本以及各基准协议的限制等问题。

title: Timer-M1: A Multivariate Time Series Foundation Model via Learning Primitives
summary: We introduce Timer-M1, a pretrained multivariate time series foundation model that learns with primitives for zero-shot forecasting. Across domains, time series share elementary temporal and relational patterns, termed primitives, yet differ in how these primitives manifest and evolve across different contexts. Despite progress in zero-shot and task-general forecasting, existing foundation models may still struggle to generalize to complex real-world scenarios. To this end, we develop a primitive-based data synthesis and pretraining pipeline. The synthesis pipeline generates series with temporal primitives shared across domains and then assembles real and generated series into multivariate samples using relational primitives. Afterwards, samples are organized into episodes by assigning distinct channel roles as target variates, past-only covariates, and known-future covariates, ensuring that the model is optimized on predictable variates using available exogenous information. Technically, Timer-M1 further adapts gated two-dimensional Transformer blocks that dynamically allocate cross-variate attention across layers. Across three large-scale forecasting benchmarks, Timer-M1 ranks first on both FEV and TIME and second on GIFT-Eval among most recent time series foundation models. These results support effective primitive-based pretraining as a route to robust general forecasting technique across domains and task settings.

AI.tldr: Timer-M1 是一个多变量时间序列基础模型，通过"基元学习"(primitives)实现零样本预测。它提出基于基元的数据合成管道和情景化预训练方法，在 FEV 和 TIME 基准上排名第一，在 GIFT-Eval 上排名第二。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型在跨领域泛化到复杂真实场景时仍存在不足。现实中不同领域的时间序列共享基本的时间模式(趋势、周期性等)和关系模式(相关性、延迟响应等)，但其表现和演变方式因上下文而异。作者将这些基本模式称为"基元"(primitives)，旨在通过学习这些可迁移的基元来构建更通用的预测模型。
AI.method: 1. **基于基元的数据合成管道**：结合真实数据(如TimeBench)和合成数据，通过合成算子生成跨领域共享的时间基元(周期性、趋势、自回归、机制变化)，通过关系算子构建跨变量依赖(符号响应、延迟响应、共享驱动、协整、事件效应)，通过变换算子增强多样性。2. **情景化预训练(Episode-based Pretraining)**：将多变量记录组织成预测情景，分配目标变量、仅历史协变量和已知未来协变量等不同角色，使用观测掩码和监督掩码控制可预测性。3. **门控二维 Transformer 块架构**：依次进行时间注意力、前馈网络和门控变量注意力，层间使用可学习的标量门控系数动态分配跨变量注意力强度，模型约121M参数。4. **训练目标**：采用分位数预测，使用pinball损失并进行历史统计归一化，对近预测位置施加更大权重。
AI.result: Timer-M1 在三大基准测试中表现优异：FEV(100个配置)上MASE技能0.3771、SQL技能0.4887排名第一；TIME(98个配置)上归一化MASE 0.6372、CRPS 0.5363排名第一；GIFT-Eval(97个配置)上归一化MASE 0.6806、CRPS 0.4688排名第二。基元评估显示周期性外推NMAE 0.02432、关系预测NMAE 0.02160，目标缺失场景相比Chronos-2减少32.5%误差。消融实验证实自适应门控优于固定门控，联合数据生成优于仅使用真实或合成数据。
AI.conclusion: Timer-M1 验证了基于基元的预训练作为跨领域和跨任务鲁棒通用预测技术的有效路径。统一数据构建管道、情景化预训练和门控二维Transformer架构围绕共享基元对齐。未来工作将扩展真实数据覆盖和基元组合，更好地表示复杂现实系统中的不规则动态和部分观测依赖，并在架构上探索输入依赖的跨变量交互和更高效的长上下文建模。

title: Onboard Marine Anomaly Detection on $Φ$sat-2: From Simulation-Based Development to In-Orbit Demonstration
summary: Onboard Artificial Intelligence can improve responsiveness and bandwidth efficiency of Earth Observation systems by processing data directly on the satellite. This paper presents the experience gained from the development, onboard integration, and post-launch adaptation of a lightweight marine anomaly detection pipeline deployed on the European Space Agency's $\Phi$sat-2 mission. The application combines sea segmentation, self-supervised feature encoding of marine regions, generic anomaly detection based on deviations from a normal sea state, and optional characterization of selected anomaly types. Before launch, the pipeline was trained and validated on simulated $\Phi$sat-2 imagery to assess algorithmic performance and compatibility with resource-constrained onboard hardware. After integration and functional validation in the mission environment, early experiments on real $\Phi$sat-2 acquisitions revealed a significant mismatch between simulated and in-orbit data. The pipeline was therefore retrained on real Level-1 imagery using an improved annotation strategy to better handle ambiguous marine regions, substantially enhancing performance. Beyond demonstrating the onboard feasibility of the application, the $\Phi$sat-2 experience highlights the importance of robust annotation strategies and sensor-aware design, and shows that simulation-based development is valuable for pre-flight risk reduction, while reliable scientific validation requires representative in-orbit data and should be clearly distinguished from functional validation.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了在ESA Φsat-2卫星上部署轻量级海洋异常检测AI流水线的开发、在轨集成及发射后自适应经验，强调了模拟与真实数据之间的域差距及在轨再训练的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 星载AI可在轨处理地球观测数据，提升响应速度与带宽效率；但星载资源受限，需在轨集成前充分验证算法与硬件兼容性及科学有效性，以降低任务风险。
AI.method: 采用四阶段流水线：(1) 海洋语义分割；(2) 海洋区域自监督特征编码；(3) 基于偏离正常海况的通用异常检测；(4) 可选的异常类型表征。发射前基于模拟Φsat-2数据进行训练与验证；发射后基于真实Level-1影像采用改进标注策略进行再训练。
AI.result: 基于模拟数据的模型在真实在轨Φsat-2图像上出现显著性能下降；采用改进的标注策略对真实Level-1影像进行再训练后，性能获得实质性提升。模拟数据开发虽有助于飞行前风险降低与功能验证，但无法替代基于真实在轨数据的科学验证。
AI.conclusion: Φsat-2任务证明了复杂海洋异常检测流水线在资源受限星载硬件上的可行性；凸显鲁棒标注策略与传感器感知设计的重要性，并明确区分功能验证与基于真实数据的科学验证的必要性。

title: Uncovering and Fixing Collider Bias in Bayesian PINNs
summary: Bayesian physics-informed neural networks (B-PINNs) are a popular framework for parameter and state inference from sparse or noisy observations. They are commonly formulated via a collider structure, in which physical and trajectory parameters are assumed to be a priori independent and become coupled through virtual likelihoods on differential-equation residuals that enforce physical consistency. We show that this modeling choice can induce severe systematic bias in the posterior over physical parameters: even when the prior is favorably centered on the ground-truth parameters, the resulting posterior can drift away and concentrate far from them. As a remedy, we advocate a hierarchical chain model in which physics generates trajectories, which in turn generate observations. The chain model does not suffer from this posterior bias, but it poses a harder, so-called doubly intractable, inference problem due to a physics-dependent normalization constant. This challenge can be resolved by discretizing the underlying stochastic dynamics, after which the chain posterior can be sampled exactly with particle MCMC. We identify two distinct mechanisms characterizing the collider bias, derive analytical approximations of their magnitudes, and establish diagnostic criteria for predicting when standard B-PINNs remain reliable. Experiments confirm the predicted bias and show that the chain formulation successfully avoids it.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了贝叶斯物理信息神经网络（B-PINNs）中因碰撞器（collider）图模型结构所导致的系统性后验偏差，并提出基于马尔可夫状态空间链式模型与粒子MCMC的无偏替代方案。
AI.motivation: 标准B-PINN将物理参数λ与轨迹参数θ建模为以ODE残差为碰撞节点的碰撞器结构，隐式忽略依赖于物理参数的归一化常数Z_λ，可能导致严重的后验偏差。论文旨在揭示该偏差的来源、量化其大小并提供可行的修正方案。
AI.method: （1）将B-PINN的collider模型与层次化chain模型对比，推导collider bias Δ(λ)=log Z_λ的解析分解；（2）通过Laplace近似将Δ分解为残差度量偏差（residual metric bias）与耗散偏差（dissipation bias）两项；（3）将轨迹重参数化为基于Itô SDE的Euler-Maruyama离散马尔可夫状态空间，使Z_λ可逐步解析计算；（4）利用bootstrap粒子滤波器无偏估计边际似然，通过伪边际PMMH实现对chain后验的渐近精确采样。
AI.result: 在阻尼振子、双摆和相对论粒子三个系统上的实验表明：（a）即使先验中心在真值，collider B-PINN仍系统性低估阻尼、刚度与质量（c/m从1.20低估至0.73，光速c从1.00高估至1.78），且90%可信区间仅在4/10数据集中覆盖真值；（b）耗散偏差随记录长度Θ(𝒯)增长，B-PINN在𝒯=48时偏离2.67个自身后验标准差而后验宽度不变；（c）chain模型在所有设置下均恢复真值（|log α|≤0.18）；（d）PMMH比嵌套推理（NSVI/NPSGLD）快13×–2900×每有效样本，且NSVI在振子上仍残留~1.8σ的阻尼偏差。论文还给出两个无偏的零条件：残差度量A_λ与λ无关且耗散项在先验支撑上近似不变。
AI.conclusion: 碰撞器结构是B-PINN中一个被广泛忽视的结构性缺陷，会在弱可识别、长记录与稀疏数据等最需要贝叶斯严谨性的场景中产生最大的偏差。基于马尔可夫状态空间链式模型与粒子MCMC的替代方案可实现渐近精确且计算高效的无偏推断；当A_λ与散度均为状态无关时也可对B-PINN直接施加闭式修正−Δ，但完全消除偏差需采用链式建模。

title: Scalable AI Uncertainty Quantification via Generalized Laplace Active Subspaces
summary: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for deploying neural networks in scientific and high-stakes applications, but full Bayesian inference over the network parameters is computationally infeasible. We propose a low-rank generalized Laplace approximation for neural-network UQ based on a small number of data-informed curvature directions. Starting from a generalized Bayesian posterior defined through an empirical loss, we construct a local Gaussian approximation around a pretrained set of weights in this active curvature subspace. The posterior variances in the retained subspace are available in closed form, and the prior variance is calibrated by an empirical Bayes procedure. The generalized Bayesian formulation allows us to compare two posterior scalings: the standard Bayesian scaling associated with the summed negative log likelihood, and a mean-loss scaling in which the empirical loss is normalized by the number of data. A central finding is that the standard scaling induces a data-size dependent contraction of the posterior variance in the leading active directions. In regression problems, this can force the low-rank framework to retain additional weak-curvature directions in order to achieve nominal coverage of calibration data. When posterior samples are propagated through the non-linear network, these additional directions can degrade the coherence of the predictive intervals and shift the posterior predictive mean away from the pretrained model. In contrast, the generalized mean-loss scaling yields a more stable, lower dimensional active subspace and produces calibrated, coherent predictive confidence intervals. These results indicate that generalized Laplace active subspaces provide a practical and scalable route to calibrated uncertainty quantification in neural networks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于广义拉普拉斯主动子空间的可扩展神经网络不确定性量化方法，通过广义贝叶斯均值损失缩放避免标准贝叶斯缩放导致的后验方差过度收缩问题，仅需少量曲率方向即可获得校准良好的预测置信区间。
AI.motivation: 神经网络在高风险科学应用中的部署需要可靠的不确定性量化，但完整贝叶斯推断因参数维度极高而计算不可行；现有拉普拉斯近似方法在低秩框架下存在后验方差随数据量过度收缩、需保留大量弱曲率方向的问题，导致预测区间不一致。
AI.method: 1) 在预训练权重处构建广义贝叶斯后验的局部高斯近似；2) 用广义Gauss-Newton矩阵的正半定曲率近似代替可能非半正定的Hessian；3) 通过无矩阵Lanczos算法（基于自动微分计算Gv矩阵-向量积）提取前d个主特征对，构建低秩主动子空间；4) 闭式后验方差σ_j²=1/(βλ_j+σ₀⁻²)；5) 在主动子空间内通过经验贝叶斯边际似然最大化校准先验方差σ₀²；6) 对比标准贝叶斯缩放(β=Nσ⁻²)与广义均值损失缩放(β=σ⁻²)；7) 通过校准数据上的经验覆盖度选择子空间维度d；8) 支持采样拉普拉斯和线性化拉普拉斯两种后验预测方式。
AI.result: 在两个回归问题（解析函数sin(4πx)+sin(7πx)与UCI混凝土抗压强度数据集）和一个分类问题（REINVENT自回归分子语言模型）上的实验表明：标准贝叶斯缩放下后验方差随N增大而过度收缩，需保留31-50个弱曲率方向才能达到90%覆盖度，且经非线性网络传播后预测区间宽且不一致；广义均值损失缩放仅需2-4个主动方向即可产生校准良好且相干的预测置信区间。在D≈10⁶权重的混凝土网络中可扩展应用，活性分数显示主动子空间高度集中（约0.1%权重承载绝大部分曲率灵敏度）。分子生成案例中，标准缩放几乎不改变基线分布，广义缩放则在d=3时产生更显著但可能出现化学不合理分子的探索。
AI.conclusion: 广义贝叶斯均值损失缩放的低秩拉普拉斯主动子空间方法为神经网络提供了一条实用且可扩展的校准不确定性量化路径，其核心优势在于避免标准贝叶斯缩放在低秩框架下因数据量驱动的后验过度收缩，使不确定性集中在少数高曲率方向上，从而在保持低秩特性的同时获得相干且校准的预测区间。

title: Correlational Training of Morphological Neural Networks
summary: Neural networks are typically trained using first-order methods and back-propagation. It is unclear whether this approach is optimal for morphological layers whose weight Jacobians are sparse and whose resulting parameter gradients can be poor. In this work, we propose a novel weight update method for morphological neural networks inspired from the Multiplicative Weights Update (MWU) scheme. We view each morphological perceptron as an instance of the learning from experts' advice problem in logarithmic space, and use a correlation-based reward that favors inputs aligned with the desired output change, regardless of whether a strong gradient signal has reached their weight. We empirically evaluate our approach by training fully connected layers both as stand-alone models and as parts of larger transformer networks. Across nine benchmarks, correlational training yields improvements on eight, by up to 32.84 percentage points, while substantially reducing run-to-run variability.

AI.tldr: 本文针对形态学神经网络（Min-max-plus 网络）中因权重雅可比矩阵稀疏而导致一阶梯度训练效果差的问题，提出了一种基于乘法权重更新（MWU）的相关性权重更新方法。该方法将软化形态学感知机视为对数空间中的"专家建议学习"问题，通过基于相关性（协方差）的奖励来更新权重，无需依赖强梯度信号。在 9 个基准测试（6 个 PMLB 数据集 + MNIST + Fashion-MNIST + CIFAR-10）上的实验表明，该方法在 8 个任务上优于普通反向传播，提升最高达 32.84 个百分点，并显著降低了训练方差。
AI.motivation: 形态学神经网络（基于膨胀和腐蚀运算）由于不含乘法运算而具有推理效率潜力，但其权重雅可比矩阵稀疏，使得基于一阶梯度的反向传播训练效率低下，且存在梯度非信息性问题。现有方法通常依赖网络深度来分散梯度信号，但对于 Transformer 等现代架构中较浅的全连接层并不适用。因此，需要一种不依赖密集梯度信号、直接处理稀疏形态学算子的训练方法。
AI.method:
1. 将软化形态学感知机（dilation）建模为对数空间中的"专家建议学习"问题：输入 $x_i$ 视为专家意见，权重 $w_i/\tau$ 视为专家权重（对数空间的概率分布）。
2. 通过反向传播获取期望输出变化 $d_y$，将其分解为公共偏移（由参数 $c$ 处理）和中心化偏移（由专家权重处理）。
3. 基于 Taylor 展开，构造基于协方差的奖励信号：$r'(i) = \mathrm{Cov}(\tilde{d}_y, x_i)$，即衡量每个输入是否与期望输出变化方向一致。
4. 使用指数梯度/MWU 更新规则更新形态学权重：$p_i' \propto p_i \exp(\gamma r(i))$，然后重新归一化。
5. 非形态学参数仍使用普通反向传播和 Adam 更新；形态学参数使用上述相关性奖励进行更新。
AI.result:
在 9 个基准测试（6 个 PMLB 数据集、MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10）上：
- 8 个任务上优于普通反向传播，提升范围 5.27–32.84 个百分点；
- 最佳改进：MNIST +32.84 pp、Fashion-MNIST +23.37 pp、Mushroom +23.31 pp、Chess +19.19 pp、Adult +18.99 pp；
- 训练方差显著降低（如 Adult 从 12.52 降至 1.08 pp，Mushroom 从 21.35 降至 2.57 pp）；
- 在 CIFAR-10 的 ViT 中将形态学前馈模块从 63.96% 提升到 70.20%；
- Spambase 上性能基本不变（-0.15 pp）；
- MLP/ViT 基线在多数任务上仍更强。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的相关性训练方法显著改善了形态学神经网络的训练效果和稳定性，表明形态学架构的能力可能被差的一阶梯度可训练性所低估。该方法为缩小形态学网络与传统线性网络的性能差距迈出了重要一步，但如何桥接软形态学（τ>0）与硬形态学（τ→0）仍是开放问题。

title: Efficient Recovery of Latent Coordinate Structure from Sparse Observations of the Hypercube
summary: Recovering latent geometric structure from graph observations is a well-studied problem in statistical inference. Kapralov, Trevisan, and Wrzos-Kaminska (2026) introduced the problem of recovering the coordinate structure of the Boolean hypercube from a small random sample of its edges. More specifically, there are $n=2^d$ vertices, each corresponding to a distinct "feature" vector in $\{\pm 1\}^d$. Between each pair whose feature vectors are at Hamming distance one, an edge is observed independently with probability $p$. As long as the expected degree $pd$ is $\gtrsim \log d = \log \log n$, we give a polynomial-time algorithm that, given only the graph of observed edges, correctly recovers the entire feature vector of all but a vanishing fraction of vertices. This matches the information-theoretic guarantee of Kapralov, Trevisan, and Wrzos-Kaminska in polynomial rather than exponential time, resolving the algorithmic question left open by their work. Our algorithm combines a degree-$4$ sum-of-squares certificate for the structure of balanced near-minimum cuts with a rounding scheme originally developed for tensor decomposition by Ma, Shi, and Steurer (2016). The analysis relies on two novel ingredients: a sum-of-squares version of the Friedgut-Kalai-Naor theorem in Boolean Fourier analysis and a spectral concentration result for the observed subgraph of the hypercube. Finally, we provide a justification for why higher-degree sum-of-squares might be needed by showing a limitation of the basic SDP relaxation of this problem.

AI.tldr:
本文解决了从超立方体的稀疏随机边采样中多项式时间内高效恢复潜在布尔特征向量的问题，将先前工作的指数时间复杂度降至多项式时间，并证明四次和平方松弛是必要的。

核心方法：基于和平方(SOS)优化框架，结合四次傅立叶代理不等式的和平方证明（一种SOS版的FKN定理）与稀疏子图上的谱集中结果，通过合适的舍入算法实现恢复。
AI.motivation: Kapralov, Treposan和Wrzos-Kaminska（2026）引入了布尔超立方体中隐含坐标结构的恢复问题，给出了指数时间的算法保证 $pd \gtrsim \log d$（足够稀疏）。他们提出了能否在多项式时间内同样完成恢复的问题，本文正是解决了这个公开问题。同时实验表明低阶（三阶以下）SOS松弛不能提供任务所需的函数集中性，为使用四次SOS松弛提供了合理性说明。
AI.method: 技术路线分为三大部分：（1）将潜在向量恢复问题归结为恢复坐标割以及获取四阶傅立叶代理不等式 $\sum_i\langle f,\chi_i\rangle^4 \geq 1-d^{-O(1)}$；（2）以分量-拼接似然界证明SOS版的FKN定理，通过核函数在阶$1$上的保留与$\ell^2$波动的方差分析完成；（3）证明渗流超立方体的谱集中性结果 $\|(1-\epsilon)pL - L'\| \leq d^2 P_{>0} \Pi_R P_{>0}$（其中$R$为偏离期望度数的顶点集），处理低阶位系数矩阵子空间时使用矩阵Bernstein不等式。最后三者以环与投影论证实现Schur补的推理论证给出四次SOS证明。归约位通过使用Ma-Shi-Steurer的平方复合结构恢复框架（Theorem 3.15）将代理不等式转化为最终输出。
AI.result: 主要成果（定理1.2/5.1）：对于$p \geq C\log d / d$，存在多项式时间算法（运行时间 $\mathrm{poly}(n)$），以概率 $1-o_d(1)$ 正确恢复 $1-\text{poly}(d)^{-1}$ 的顶点上的全部特征向量。这与Kapralov-TR-Wrzos-Kaminska的信息论保证相匹配，但复杂度由 $\exp(\tilde{O}(n))$ 提升到了 $\mathrm{poly}(n)$。该复杂度匹配主要靠两次新工具实现：（i）BBS SOS版本的Friedgut-Kalai-Naor定理（定理3.1），表明$I\{ \sum_i\langle f,\chi_i\rangle^2\geq 1-\delta\}$通过四次SOS证明能够推出 $\sum_i\langle f,\chi_i\rangle^4\geq 1-O(\delta)$；（ii）渗流超立方体的谱集中性结果（定理5.1）。作者还证明了二次SOS松弛对于必不可少的傅立叶集中性证词不能提供最优保证（定理2.16）：存在可行性伪期望使 $\tilde{\mathbb{E}}\sum_i \langle f,\chi_i\rangle^2 \leq 1-\Omega(1/\log d)$，而四次SOS伪期望则达到 $1-d^{-O(1)}$。
AI.conclusion: 本文表明阶为4的和平方松弛足以在多项式时间内从超立方体稀疏边采样中恢复潜在坐标结构，而阶为2的松弛在邵超过 $\Omega(1/\log d)$ 的 Foubier 集中误差下是不够用的。这一证明了在Kapralov-Treposan-Wrzos-Kaminska三人提出的问题中界为最优。诸多技术工具有独立价值：四次SOS版本的FKN定理、渗流超立方体谱集中定理（这是首次针对编码秩$d$与采样概率 $p = \Theta(\log d/d)$ 两者的刻画），以及暗示阶为4是必要性的量随机法。下一步研究可拓广该技术到该模型的几何变量和更广的随机图模型。

title: TraceRelay: Attention-Aligned Recurrence over Rolling Traces
summary: We present TraceRelay, an attention-aligned recurrent architecture that distributes persistent representations over a rolling sequence of low-dimensional traces. Local right looking attention forms increments from lower-layer representations; delivery is delayed until all attended inputs are in the causal past. A fixed additive phase recurrence accumulates the delayed increments, and left-looking attention reads the resulting residual augmented stream. A stride-wise prefix sum supports parallel prefill and bounded-buffer continuation. We study 36 small-model runs on Equal Repeats, bounded Dyck closing-type prediction, and causal Most-Freq generation, using three seeds per setting. At trained length 256, Equal Repeats models with recurrent phase inheritance reach 98.81-99.69% accuracy versus 50.73-51.63% for separately trained variants without inheritance, despite the latter receiving more updates. Accuracy drops sharply at lengths beyond the training range. At the longest evaluated lengths, models with more dimensions in the middle layer's recurrent traces perform better on Dyck (76.34% versus 55.49% close accuracy at length 4096), whereas models with fewer trace dimensions perform better on five-symbol Most-Freq (70.74% versus 55.60% exact generation at length 1024). These contrasting cases motivate further study of how the size of recurrent representations should be chosen for different tasks, without establishing a general rule across tasks or model configurations.

AI.tldr: TraceRelay提出了一种注意力对齐的循环架构，通过右视注意力形成增量、固定相位累加和左视注意力读取滚动低维trace序列。该工作在小模型上对三个形式语言任务进行了36次受控实验，揭示了循环相位继承的重要性以及任务相关的trace宽度偏好。
AI.motivation: Transformer的全注意力存在二次复杂度、KV缓存随上下文增长以及"中间遗忘"等长度相关失败问题；而现有的循环/状态空间模型（如Mamba）在循环与注意力的协同上仍有不足。作者试图回答一个更窄的架构问题：能否让循环围绕注意力组织，使注意力学习"写什么、取什么"，而时序转移保持简洁。同时提出"时序长、表征窄"的设计假设。
AI.method: TraceRelay架构包含四个核心组件：(1) 右视注意力（Right Attention）从下层表征形成候选增量δ_i；(2) 因果延迟投递，增量在因果过去成立后才到达u_t；(3) 固定的加性相位循环θ_t = wrap(θ_{t-W} + u_t)，在W条交错血统上独立运行（等价于复坐标下逐元素乘以exp(iu_t)）；(4) 左视注意力读取与相位读出合并的滚动流m_t = h_t + P_φ([cos θ_t; sin θ_t])。通过跨步前缀和实现并行预填充与有界缓冲续接。实验在H=64、3层、4头、中间层trace宽度d_c∈{16,32,64}的小模型上进行，覆盖Equal Repeats（开/关相位继承）、有界Dyck闭类型预测和因果Most-Freq生成三个任务。
