The active context remains centered on the current intent, while completed intents are consolidated into the task-relevant outcomes and state needed for subsequent work, rather than carrying forward their full working details. Concurrently, a recursive prefix consolidation mechanism repeatedly consolidates earlier history, causing long-unused experiences to become increasingly abstract. Original interactions are preserved, allowing the agent to progressively recover finer-grained details through the hierarchy and stop once sufficient information is available. Crucially, when past experiences are recalled and reintegrated into active work, they undergo subsequent consolidation alongside new experiences, thereby being reinforced, supplemented, and updated. Through this memory dynamic of use and disuse, Hippocam connects working context, long-term memory, knowledge accumulation, and skill learning within a single continuously evolving experiential process. This enables agents to learn and evolve capabilities through their own experiences without parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 提出Hippocam，一种受人类记忆启发的层次化LLM智能体架构，通过意图结构化的工作上下文和递归前缀整合机制，实现无需参数更新的长期记忆与持续学习，在多个基准上达到领先水平。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体从单任务执行向长期自主操作演进时，面临将连续经验转化为可重用知识的核心挑战。现有记忆方法多依赖独立存储库、重要性评分或时间衰减规则，缺乏统一机制。论文受人类记忆的选择性维持与反复巩固特性启发，旨在构建统一的记忆-学习架构。
AI.method: Hippocam包含主智能体与三个辅助LLM组件：(1) Janus维护嵌套意图栈并提供每步推理前指引；(2) Precip在意图关闭时执行意图整合，保留成果与有依据的经验教训；(3) Palim执行递归前缀整合，将远期历史反复抽象化。整合过程保留原始消息形成消息树，主智能体可通过recall工具渐进式恢复细节。核心机制为"使用与废弃"(use and disuse)动态循环：被调用的经验在后续整合中被强化、补充或更新，未使用的经验则通过递归整合逐渐抽象化，无需独立的重要性评分或遗忘规则。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld达到97.8%成功率（与ACE并列最佳），在StreamBench以81.7%平均准确率领先。跨域迁移实验中，从ALFWorld到ScienceWorld获得+19.2pp增益，从HotpotQA到FEVER获得+6.0pp增益，均超越其他方法。GoodAI LTM中隔离与交错条件下分别达到85.1%和88.7%，交错时无性能下降。LoCoMo总体准确率77.6%，超越最强基线A-Mem 10.1pp。MemoryAgentBench多跳冲突解决平均71.7%准确率，远超第二名Letta的44.3%。消融实验验证了意图条件化整合、前缀整合和渐进式召回三个组件的必要性。
AI.conclusion: Hippocam通过"使用与废弃"动态循环统一了工作上下文、长期记忆、知识积累与技能学习，使智能体能够通过自身经验持续进化而无需参数更新。实验证明了该统一机制的广泛适用性，并揭示了保留知识如何在循环使用中演化，为构建真正自主学习的智能体提供了可行路径。

title: LVS: Local View Synthesis from Relative Camera Pose by Reusing Previous Views
summary: Interactive scene exploration requires frequent view updates, although small camera motions preserve much of the visible content. Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting nevertheless renders each target view, leaving this image overlap unexploited. Reusing rendered images offers an alternative. Geometric warping alone cannot recover newly exposed content and remains sensitive to depth errors. We propose a per-scene framework that replaces repeated scene rendering for nearby views with relative-pose-guided RGB-D image reuse. Geometric warping uses depth and relative pose to transport source content, while a lightweight multiscale network predicts RGB residuals to correct artifacts and infer missing appearance. Cached source features further reduce repeated computation. On GS-render, residual refinement improves PSNR by 0.72~dB over pure warping; evaluations on captured and rendered scenes demonstrate low query latency. This separation of scene rendering from local view updates supports responsive scene exploration, with potential applications in augmented and virtual reality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LVS框架，通过相对位姿引导的几何扭曲结合多尺度RGB残差网络，复用已渲染的RGB-D图像来合成邻近视点，避免重复调用3DGS场景渲染，在保持低查询延迟的同时提升局部视图合成质量。
AI.motivation: 交互式场景探索中，相邻视点间存在大量共享视觉内容，但传统3DGS需对每个目标视点重新渲染，未利用这一图像重叠；纯几何扭曲无法恢复新暴露内容且对深度误差敏感。
AI.method: 提出per-scene框架：(1)相对位姿引导的重投影，利用深度填充和局部逆深度平面拟合进行双线性splatting，生成扭曲图像I_w和覆盖图C；(2)轻量多尺度编解码网络，编码器提取缓存源特征F_1，解码器融合F_1、I_1、I_w、ΔW、C和位姿编码p，从1/4分辨率逐步精炼至全分辨率，预测RGB残差R叠加到I_w得到目标预测；(3)采用Charbonnier损失进行per-scene训练，零初始化RGB头使初始预测等于I_w。
AI.result: 在GS-render、Blender和7-Scenes数据集上，方法在PSNR/SSIM上均优于CheapNVS、AdaMPI32和3DGS（如GS-render上PSNR 26.89 dB，超越AdaMPI32 1.00 dB）；查询延迟仅0.95-0.98 ms，源缓存14.4 MiB，峰值内存95.8 MiB；消融实验显示全分辨率残差精炼相比纯扭曲提升PSNR 0.721 dB；但视点角度超过约15°时性能下降，3DGS反超。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了图像复用作为响应式场景导航的可行方案，分离场景渲染与局部视图更新适合AR/VR应用；局限性在于大视点变化下性能衰减，未来工作将扩展支持的视点范围并实现跨场景泛化。

title: An Investigation of Model Coherence: Narrow Finetunes Contradict Themselves Under Resampling
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code and dataset: this https URL
summary: A large body of research measures model coherence based on output variance without adequately considering competing causes. We identify two such causes, ambiguity and indifference, and we introduce a set of 175 questions where contradicting answers cannot easily be explained by either. We then measure incoherence in terms of contradictions when resampling answers to the same question. In contrast to other methods our metric has high specificity, and only ranks models as incoherent when the issues are glaring. Even so, we find narrow finetunes score poorly. Inspecting inconsistencies flagged by our method, we find that model organisms from the literature display severe issues such as identity conflation, introspection failures and rationalizations. These findings suggest that the pathologies induced by narrow finetuning may limit what these models can tell us about coherent misaligned behaviour.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于重采样矛盾的高特异性模型一致性度量方法,使用175个明确无歧义且非无所谓的问题集,发现前沿模型表现高度一致,而窄域微调的"模型生物"则显示出显著的不一致性,存在身份混淆、内省失败和合理化等严重问题,质疑这些模型生物作为连贯失准智能体替代品的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常用输出方差作为模型一致性的代理指标,但忽略了歧义(ambiguity)和无所谓(indifference)这两个会导致一致性模型也产生矛盾答案的竞争性原因。需要一种具有高特异性的度量方法,能够在排除这些混淆因素后准确识别模型的真正不一致性。
AI.method: 构建175个简短清晰、要么高风险要么答案明确的问题集(排除歧义性),每个模型对每个问题采样20次,使用Claude Opus 4.8作为跨样本评判器将回答划分为互不相容的立场组,通过Shannon熵测量不一致程度。还测试了混合数据、增加推理、改用助手语气等缓解策略,并在提示方差和评判器稳健性方面进行了验证。
AI.result: 前沿模型平均一致性极高(H≈0.06 nats,有效立场数约1.06),在71%-94%的问题上保持单一立场;而窄域微调模型生物显著不一致,平均差距达0.10-0.85 nats。质量分析揭示了身份混淆(如Wolf模型在"我是谁"和"你是谁"时都提到希特勒)、内省失败(如Insecure code模型对自己的描述荒诞多变)和合理化(同一模型在不同采样中既坦白恶意又给出冠冕堂皇的理由)三类严重问题。增加推理可部分改善但不能恢复一致性,助手语气无效,而混合良性和定向数据可恢复基线一致性。
AI.conclusion: 窄域微调引入的病理学(身份混淆、内省失败、合理化)可能限制这些模型作为连贯失准行为研究替代品的价值。前沿模型在排除歧义和无所谓后显示出真正的高度一致性,而现有文献中报告的一致性下降部分可能源于这两类混淆因素。需要进一步研究以更好地形式化模型一致性概念并构建更连贯的模型生物。

title: Escaping Degeneracy by Following Shadow Edges
summary: The Simplex method is among the most widely used approaches for solving linear programs. Starting at a vertex solution of the feasible region, the algorithm proceeds through a sequence of basis exchanges (known as pivots), each corresponding to a move along an improving edge of the polyhedron toward a better vertex. A central challenge affecting the efficiency of the Simplex method is degeneracy, which can cause long sequences of pivot operations that fail to change the current vertex solution. In this paper, we prove the existence of a pivot rule which is able to escape degeneracy and follow any given shadow edge-direction when initialized at some compatible basis, with a linear number of degenerate Simplex pivots. As a byproduct of our result, we obtain an improved bound on the number of degenerate Simplex pivots needed to solve linear programs defined on 0/1 polytopes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究单纯形法在退化情况下的效率问题。作者证明存在一种影子轴心规则（shadow pivot rule），可以从兼容基开始，通过线性次数的退化单纯形轴心操作，沿着任意给定的影子边方向逃离退化。作为推论，针对0/1多面体上的线性规划得到了改进的退化轴心次数上界。
AI.motivation: 单纯形法是求解线性规划最广泛使用的方法之一，但其运行时间理论上理解不足。退化（degeneracy）是影响单纯形法效率的核心挑战——退化的轴心操作可能不改变当前解却消耗大量迭代次数。多项式Hirsch猜想（多项式路径的存在性）虽是重大开放问题，但对于某些多面体类已知成立，但如何设计能在退化情况下沿预定路径行进的轴心规则仍是关键难题。此前工作（[8]）已证明可在线性次数退化轴心内逃离退化，但无法控制后续非退化轴心所沿的边方向；另一项工作（[2]）则相反：能沿预定路径但无法界定退化轴心次数。本文旨在同时解决这两个方向上的不足。
AI.method: 作者在影子轴心规则（shadow pivot rule）框架下工作。对于向量v∈ℝ^n，将多面体P沿(v, c)方向投影得到"影子"，位于该影子上的基满足特定锥组合条件。作者证明：对于位于(v,c)影子上的基B和给定的影子边方向s_x'，可在强多项式时间内计算出一条退化单纯形轴心序列，使每步沿c递增方向轴心，且序列长度至多n-rank(A)-1-|B∩R(x')|，最终到达一个使s_x'成为可用轴心方向的基B*。证明中关键使用"面约束LP"（face-restricted LP）技术处理轴心过程中可能移除影子边紧约束的问题：引理11表明可通过在面的影子上执行影子轴心，保证每次迭代向基中添加一个影子边的紧约束而不移除它。进而，针对0/1-LP，作者修改了文献[2]中的True Steepest-Edge规则，提出"Shifting Shadow"轴心规则：先在至多n步退化轴心内到达坐标基，再利用定理4的结论在至多n步退化轴心内沿最陡边方向执行非退化轴心。
AI.result: 主要结果有两个：(1) 定理4——对一般LP，给定位于(v,c)影子上的基B和影子边方向s_x'，可在强多项式时间内通过长度不超过n-rank(A)-1-|B∩R(x')|的退化单纯形轴心序列到达基B*，使s_x'成为B*上的可用轴心方向；(2) 定理15——针对0/1-LP，Shifting Shadow轴心规则能在仅依赖于n的多项式次数的轴心操作内达到最优解，其中每步至多线性次数退化轴心。这回答了文献[2]中关于能否界定沿最陡边方向轴心所需退化单纯形轴心次数的开放问题。此外，作者还构造了2维0/1-LP的反例，说明在退化存在时，单纯形法跟随特定路径的能力高度依赖于从哪个基出发——从含冗余不等式的基出发，可能无法沿最陡边轴心，且唯一的非退化轴心只能获得任意小的目标函数改进。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了影子轴心规则能以线性次数的退化单纯形轴心沿任意影子边方向行进，且该退化轴心计算可在强多项式时间内完成。这同时改进了文献[8]（无法控制非退化轴心方向）和文献[2]（无法界定退化轴心次数）的工作。针对0/1-LP，作者设计的Shifting Shadow规则回答了文献[2]的开放问题，证明了退化单纯形轴心次数可被线性界定。作者强调该方法在理论上的贡献：目标在于理解单纯形法的能力与局限，为其能否多项式时间运行的长期问题提供洞见。遗留开放挑战包括：对于一般LP，计算影子边方向并不比解原LP更容易；寻找无需预知影子边方向且效果相同的轴心规则仍是未解难题。此外，坐标基的必要性通过反例得到说明：在存在冗余不等式时，从某些基出发无法沿最陡边行进，唯一可达的非退化轴心方向仅产生任意小的目标改进。

title: A structure-preserving neural density functional for the ions of a polymer electrolyte
summary: Predicting the structure and response of inhomogeneous polymer electrolytes requires a description of ion correlations that retains molecular-scale accuracy while remaining transferable across spatial scales and geometries. We develop a neural density functional for electrolytes that preserves spatial symmetries, thermodynamic integrability and the Noether identities, with perfect screening recovered in stable, noncritical bulk states. Its nonlinear density dependence captures the concentration-dependent correlations missed by a pair closure, including a crossover from enhanced to suppressed long-wavelength number fluctuations at strong coupling. The functional describes density profiles at an untrained salt concentration and predicts bulk structure factors and the long-wavelength number response. Trained solely on planar density and internal-force profiles from molecular dynamics, the functional predicts ionic structure in larger domains and in two-dimensional external fields. On the same ion data, it is more accurate than three other neural density-functional architectures and keeps its accuracy with a quarter of the training runs, where the errors of the best alternative grow by about two thirds. The spatial transferability provides a necessary foundation for connecting molecular correlations to continuum predictions at larger scales.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种结构保持型神经网络密度泛函理论（NDFT），用于描述含盐聚合物熔体中离子的多体关联。该方法将过量自由能参数化为径向核函数与逐点多层感知机的组合，连续定义于实空间而非网格上。它在构建上保证了可积性、连续平移/旋转/反射对称性及Noether恒等式，同时显式处理长程库仑相互作用（满足完美屏蔽求和规则）。训练仅依赖分子动力学产生的离子密度与内力密度剖面（力匹配损失），无需化学势标签。训练后可直接迁移至更大模拟盒、二维非平面外场及未训练的盐浓度，并能预测体相结构因子与长波数密度响应。其非线性密度依赖性能捕捉浓度依赖的有效关联，包括强耦合下长波数密度涨落的由增强到抑制的转变。
AI.motivation: 聚合物电解质中离子在两个长度尺度上产生强关联：低介电常数聚合物中Bjerrum长度跨越数个单体直径，堆积和溶剂化引入短程关联。现有解析泛函（基于带电硬球参考）无法包含聚合物链对离子的溶剂化作用；现有神经网络泛函虽能学习局域关联，但不保证来自自由能泛函因而缺乏积分性、对称性与结构一致性；它们通常基于网格定义参数，限制了在更大尺度、更复杂几何中的可迁移性。建立兼具分子尺度精度与跨尺度/几何可迁移性的连续关联理论，对预测非均匀电解质的结构与响应至关重要。
AI.method: 将过量自由能泛函参数化为两部分之和：(1) 二次项，由可学习的径向对称成对核函数（高斯包络×修正感知机）卷积两种离子密度构成；(2) 多体项，由点向多层感知机作用于12个加权密度（6个径向核与两离子密度的卷积）构成。库仑项与理想气体项解析处理。核函数在连续空间定义，参数不依赖网格或盒子尺寸。训练采用基于Yvon–Born–Green方程的力匹配策略：损失函数包含加权二乘残差与含(kσ)⁻²补偿权重的傅里叶幅度项，匹配分子动力学采样的内部力密度，无需化学势标签。使用AdamW优化器（余弦衰减学习率10⁻³，权重衰减10⁻⁵）训练至多4000步，验证集早期停止。
AI.result: 在εᵣ=7.5和2两种耦合强度下（l_B≈8σ和30σ），学习泛函对保持出的平面外场测试集的预测平均相对L₂误差为1.2%和2.0%，优于对偶闭包（3.0%/5.7%）和泊松-玻尔兹曼理论（25%/23%）。迁移至两倍训练盒长度的盒子时误差为0.8–1.6%；迁移至两维非平面外场时误差为1.8–3.1%（接近MD噪声水平1.7–3.0%）。在未经训练的盐浓度c=0.05处误差为0.85%/0.98%。体相电荷和数密度结构因子相对误差分别为2.7–4.5%和2.4–5.3%。长波数密度响应因子Γ(k₁)在εᵣ=2下MD值从0.42（c=0.01）增至11.1（c=0.08），学习泛函正确捕捉了由增强到抑制涨落的跨转变，而对偶闭包无法预测增强涨落。与三种已有神经网络架构对比：完整数据集下误差最低（1.50%/3.11% vs 一体网络1.75%/3.41%、晶格自由能2.97%/7.16%）；缩减至1/4训练数据时误差几乎不变（1.55%/3.56%），而最佳替代架构误差增长约2/3。结构校验：净内力误差≤2×10⁻⁶，Hessian对称性≤3×10⁻¹⁶，路径无关性≤2×10⁻¹²，均远优于其他架构。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次构建了一种兼具积分性、连续空间对称性、Noether恒等式与长程静电处理的神经网络密度泛函，其参数定义于连续空间，不依赖网格。该泛函仅从平面力密度训练即可迁移到更大空间域和不同几何外场，预测未经训练的浓度下的结构及体相关联，捕捉浓度依赖的离子关联（包括数密度通道核符号反转的跨转变）。对比三种已发表架构，在精度与数据效率上均占优，缩减训练数据时性能几乎不退化。这为从分子关联到连续介质预测的跨尺度连接提供了必要基础。下一步计划：将该泛函应用于输运（结合迁移率模型预测电导率与盐扩散）以及电极界面处的平衡结构。

title: Rehearse Everything, Remember Nothing: Attic-KV Rehearses What Will Be Read
summary: Many key-value (KV) caches are compressed before anyone knows what will be asked of them: a document cached for retrieval, a prompt prefix shared across requests, the memory of a long conversation. The prevailing approach scores KV entries by rehearsal: the model rereads the context and keeps the entries it attends to, assuming that the more completely a cache rehearses its context, the better it remembers it. We show that under tight budgets this assumption backfires: rehearse everything, remember nothing. At a 3% keep ratio, rereading the whole context keeps 31.5 of 96.5 points on RULER, and on LongBench's natural-text tasks it falls below methods that rehearse nothing at all. The cause is that a cache keeps what it rehearses: rereading spreads the budget across the whole context, so the answer's own entries survive at little more than chance. Like a student before an exam, a cache remembers more by testing itself than by rereading. Two principles follow: rehearse what will be read, and rehearse as much as there is. We instantiate them as Attic-KV (Attic for short), a training-free rehearsal in which the model quizzes itself with question-answer pairs that quote the context, alongside anchor tokens in a content-adaptive amount. Changing only the rehearsal lifts three hosts that score it in three different ways: Attic alone is the best training-free method in all eight settings we test on RULER and LongBench's natural-text tasks, and plugged into the gradient-based KVgrad and the trained RestoreKV+, it raises them by up to 17.1 and 28.1 points. Its advantage grows as the budget shrinks, reaching 41.9 points over full rereading at a 3% keep ratio, and on long documents it compresses faster than rereading them.

AI.tldr: Attic-KV 提出"缓存保留其排练的内容"这一机制，指出当前对整个上下文进行完整排练的 KV 缓存压缩方法（以 KVzip+ 为代表）在严格保留比例下会失败，转而设计让模型通过自生成的问答对和锚点对预期被读取的内容进行靶向排练，在 RULER 与 LongBench 上全面优于现有免训练方法，并能以即插即用方式提升基于梯度的 KVgrad 和基于训练的 RestoreKV+。
AI.motivation: 许多 KV 缓存在问题未知时就被压缩（RAG、共享前缀、会话记忆等），现有以 KVzip 为代表的"排练—打分"范式默认对整个上下文重复阅读以判断重要性，但作者发现在严格保留比例（如 3%–5%）下，全文排练反而导致大量预算被无人查询的连贯文本消耗，把真正会被问到的事实挤出缓存，造成"全排练、全遗忘"的失败。
AI.method: 作者提出查询无关、一次压缩的 KV 压缩问题设定，并基于三方面诊断证据指出"a cache keeps what it rehearses"。由此归纳出两条设计原则：(1) 排练将被读取的内容——用模型自生成的问答对（要求引用原文）作为对预期被读出片段的复现；(2) 视内容量而定地排练——用 KeyDiff 锚点确定"排练什么"，再以含锚句子的长度作为该块"排练多少"，让事实密集块充分排练、连贯散文块少排练。基于这两条原则构建免训练的 Attic-KV：分块取锚点→扩展至所在句子长度→拼接自生成 Q&A，由任意主方法（KVzip+ 式注意力打分、KVgrad 梯度打分、RestoreKV 恢复 token）的打分器打分，并取条目级最大。该方法不改打分器、可即插即用，并能直接挂接 RestoreKV 已发布的恢复 token 与 LoRA 而无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-8B/4B/14B、Llama-3.1-8B 上，以 5%（RULER-4K 还测 3%）保留比例进行评测：Attic 单独使用在 RULER 4K/16K 和 LongBench 14 项自然语言任务上全面优于所有免训练基线（KVzip+、KV²、KVgrad、StreamingLLM、SnapKV、KeyDiff、Compactor、TaskPress 等）。在 3% 严格比例下，Attic 在 Qwen3-8B RULER-4K 上比 KVzip+ 高 41.9 分，比 KV² 高 6.4 分；与 KVgrad 组合提升宿主最高 17.1 分，与 RestoreKV+ 组合提升最高 28.1 分，且 RestoreKV+ Attic 在六个有恢复 token 的设置中平均秩 1.00。在 LooGLE 一次压缩回答多问场景中，Attic 与 RestoreKV+ 组合在短依赖与长依赖问答上均领先；其压缩时间随页长增长慢于全文排练，64K 页面比 KVzip+ 快约 27%。即插即用与消融实验表明：自生成 QA 不能拯救全文排练；自适应量优于任何固定比例 ρ（即便按测试集事后挑选也无法追上 Attic）；连贯排练只回看模型无法预测的针/实体/数字，故被保留，而结构化标签因可被流式预测而被淘汰——将连贯文本打断为稀疏多遍排练可救回标签但丢失针点（RULER 平均 81.8→69.8，MK2 由 57 跌至 5）。
AI.conclusion: 查询无关 KV 缓存压缩的失败根源不在打分器或容量，而在排练目标本身："全排练、全遗忘"是因为"a cache keeps what it rehearses"——预算流向被排练的位置，而全文排练把预算灌入无人查阅的散文，将被问及的事实挤出。作者提出两条原则——排练将被读取的内容、按内容量排练——并以免训练的 Attic-KV 加以实现：自生成问答对加 KeyDiff 锚点按句子长度自适应扩展。它既可单独使用（在其所测全部八项设置中均为最佳免训练方法），也可作为 KVzip 注意力打分、KVgrad 梯度打分与 RestoreKV 恢复 token 三类主方法的即插即用改进。优势随保留比例趋紧而增大，在 3% 比例下相对 KVzip+ 达 41.9 分；压缩时间随上下文增长慢于全文排练。该工作表明，对缓存而言，"排练什么"比"如何打分"更决定其记忆效果，并将 Holmes "头脑阁楼无弹力墙"的比喻形式化为压缩缓存的设计准则。

title: OA-MAP: Evidence-Grounded Multi-Agent Multimodal Framework for Interpretable Knee Osteoarthritis Progression
summary: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) progression prediction can support patient monitoring, requiring the integration of multimodal data and multidomain expertise. Moreover, isolated risk estimates provide limited insight underlying a prediction. To automate the progression assessment workflow and reduce manual effort while providing interpretable findings and supporting evidence, we present OA-MAP, an autonomous multi-agent framework for evidence-grounded assessment of structural and pain progression in KOA. The system incorporates modality-specific agents including MRI, X-ray, and clinical agents, together with a coordinator agent. This framework can autonomously recruit specialist agents, select tools for prediction and analysis, and retrieve literature as external evidence based on user request and available patient information. An uncertainty-informed human-in-the-loop mechanism enables clinicians to review and correct intermediate findings, triggering recomputation of affected results. We evaluate the prediction models using 600 participants from the FNIH Osteoarthritis Biomarkers Consortium cohort. On the test set of 100 participants, the fusion models achieve AUROCs of 0.80 for structural progression and 0.68 for pain progression. A case study illustrates how OA-MAP combines risk estimates with intermediate findings, cross-modal conflicts, literature support, and uncertainty indicators to support interactive review.

AI.tldr: OA-MAP是一个用于膝关节骨关节炎（KOA）进展评估的多智能体多模态框架，整合MRI、X光和临床数据，通过模态专属智能体和协调器智能体实现自动化的预测、可解释性输出、文献证据评估和不确定性感知的人机交互审核。
AI.motivation: 现有的KOA进展预测模型主要关注最终预测精度，忽略了中间决策过程、临床一致性和可解释性，且部署使用需要技术专业知识和手动协调，阻碍了常规临床应用。同时LLM智能体在临床决策中存在幻觉、工具误用、多智能体共识趋同等可靠性问题。
AI.method: 框架包含：1）记忆模块（按患者ID结构化存储临床、影像记录）；2）三个模态专属智能体（MRI、X-ray、Clinical），各自调用对应的逻辑回归预测模型并基于特征贡献进行PubMed文献检索与评估；3）协调器智能体，调用融合模型进行最终预测，并整合多模态输出来量化三类不确定性（预测边界距离、模态间冲突、文献证据充分性），通过不确定性评分触发人机交互审核，临床医生可修正中间发现并触发下游预测、文献评估和报告的重新计算。
AI.result: 使用FNIH骨关节炎生物标志物联盟队列的600名参与者进行评估，在100人测试集上，融合模型对结构进展和疼痛进展的AUROC分别达到0.80和0.68。案例研究展示了框架如何结合风险估计、中间发现、跨模态冲突、文献支持和不确定性指标来支持交互式审查。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过模态专属的数据源、工具和文献证据池来实现智能体间的实质性差异化，而非仅依赖角色提示的表面差异化，将自动化预测与可解释发现、文献证据和临床医生监督相结合，为KOA进展评估提供了一个透明、可追溯的决策支持平台。

title: Q-Shaped Options for Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
summary: Learning to tackle long-horizon, goal-conditioned tasks requires an agent to reason over extended timescales and act across a broad range of states. In principle, Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) addresses both challenges through the interaction between action (temporal) and state (spatial) abstraction. First, using an action abstraction to represent temporally extended behaviour as options reduces the effective decision horizon. Second, enabling different state abstractions at each level of the decision process permits greater data aggregation for learning. However, realising these two benefits of a hierarchical policy depends on learning an appropriate action abstraction. Current HRL algorithms fail in one of two ways. Some discard distinctions between options needed for optimal control, undermining hierarchy altogether. Others retain unnecessary distinctions, preserving horizon reduction, but forfeiting coarser state abstraction. In this work, we characterise three desiderata for an action abstraction. We introduce Q-Shaped Options (QSO) to address all three. QSO builds on an architecture with distinct state-value functions, Q functions and policies at each level of the hierarchy. It learns the action abstraction between consecutive levels as a shared encoder shaped by their respective Q functions. The low-level Q function uses the option as a goal, encouraging the abstraction to retain distinctions necessary for optimal control. The high-level Q function uses it as an action, encouraging unnecessary distinctions to be discarded. Across offline goal-conditioned locomotion and manipulation environments, QSO learns semantically meaningful option spaces and outperforms baselines, achieving non-zero performance in tasks where all other evaluated algorithms fail.

AI.tldr: 本文针对层次化强化学习（HRL）中动作抽象学习的难题，提出了一种名为 Q-Shaped Options（QSO）的新方法。该方法通过在层级结构中利用相邻层级的 Q 函数共同塑造共享编码器，同时满足保留必要区分（用于最优控制）和丢弃不必要区分（实现更粗粒度的状态抽象）三个设计要求，从而在离线目标条件运动与操作任务中学习出语义有意义的选项空间，优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有层次化强化学习算法在处理长视野、目标条件任务时面临两大困境：一是丢弃选项间的必要区分，导致层级结构失效；二是保留不必要的区分，虽然保留了视野缩短的优势，却丧失了更粗粒度的状态抽象带来的数据聚合优势。因此，论文动机在于设计一种动作抽象，能够同时兼顾时间抽象与状态抽象的双重收益。
AI.method:
1. 提炼出动作抽象的三个核心设计准则（desiderata）。
2. 提出 Q-Shaped Options（QSO）方法：
- 采用每一层级拥有独立的状态价值函数、Q 函数和策略的分层架构；
- 在相邻层级之间学习一个共享编码器作为动作抽象；
- 该编码器由高层和低层的 Q 函数共同塑造（shaped）；
- 低层 Q 函数以选项（option）作为目标，鼓励保留对最优控制至关重要的区分；
- 高层 Q 函数以选项作为动作，鼓励丢弃不必要的区分。
AI.result: 在多个离线目标条件的运动（locomotion）和操作（manipulation）环境中，QSO 能够学习出语义有意义的选项空间（semantically meaningful option spaces），其表现优于其他对比基线，并在其他所有评估算法均失败的任务上实现了非零性能（non-zero performance）。
AI.conclusion: QSO 成功解决了 HRL 中动作抽象难以同时兼顾时间与状态抽象收益的难题，通过让上下层 Q 函数分别从控制和抽象两方面塑造选项空间，实现了既能保留关键控制区分又能获得更粗粒度状态抽象的目标，为长视野目标条件任务提供了有效的层次化解决方案。

title: Poster: A Preliminary Study of LLM Distillation Inference
comment: Accepted as a poster paper at the 2026 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS'26)
summary: Unauthorized model distillation, in which a model is trained on the outputs of a proprietary large language model (LLM), is a growing threat to model providers. We study distillation inference: determining whether a suspect model was distilled from another model or trained independently. We formulate this problem as a hypothesis test and estimate the behavior expected under each hypothesis by training shadow models: distilled shadow models learn from the teacher's reasoning traces, whereas independent shadow models learn only from reference answers. The auditor measures how closely each model predicts the teacher's reasoning outputs and then uses the shadow models to convert the suspect's score into a calibrated p-value. In a preliminary study using Qwen2.5-7B as the teacher and Llama-3.2-3B for the suspects, our test achieves a true positive rate of 1.0 at a significance level of 0.02. These results demonstrate the feasibility of using distillation inference to detect distillation attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型未授权蒸馏攻击的检测问题，提出了一种基于假设检验的蒸馏推断（distillation inference）方法。该方法利用影子模型进行校准，通过对数似然比统计量聚合证据，在 Qwen2.5-7B 教师模型和 Llama-3.2-3B 嫌疑模型的初步实验中实现了 TPR=1.0、FPR≈0.02 的完美分离效果。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 商业价值提升，未授权模型蒸馏攻击（即在专有模型的输出上训练自己的模型）日益猖獗，带来法律、知识产权和国家安全风险。现有的蒸馏检测方法只能提供相似度评分或排序，无法给出具有统计保证（p 值和有界 FPR）的判定，难以满足执法需求。
AI.method: 1) 形式化：将蒸馏推断建模为二元假设检验（H0：独立训练；H1：来自教师蒸馏）。2) 影子模型：用 LoRA 微调 M 个蒸馏影子模型（学习教师 CoT）和 M 个独立影子模型（仅学习参考答案）。3) 信号提取：单次教师前向传播提取三个信号——对数概率、预测熵、token 一致性。4) 似然比检验：每个实例上用高斯拟合两类分布，计算对数似然比 λ_i(f)；按审计集求和得到模型级统计量 Λ(f)；采用留一法校准，计算 p 值并以 α 为阈值做出判定。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（教师）和 Llama-3.2-3B（嫌疑基础模型）的设置下，使用 N=500 审计实例、M=50 影子模型：单实例成员推断 AUC 仅 0.64–0.67，TPR@0%FPR≈0；而聚合后的模型级统计量 AUC、TPR、FPR 均达到 1.000。p 值下限 1/(M+1)=0.020，留一法 FPR≈1/M=0.020。同族（Qwen→Qwen）分离更大；改用改写 CoT 训练的嫌疑仍被标记（α=0.05）。影子数量 M 增大时 p 值下限与 FPR 同步收敛，检测能力保持完美。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了对特定教师–嫌疑对给出有界 FPR 统计保证的蒸馏审计是可行的，为执法场景提供了可操作的检测手段。局限性：(1) 训练影子模型池成本高，对前沿 LLM 不易扩展；(2) 假设审计集是嫌疑训练数据的子集，实践中难以确认；(3) 假设嫌疑与影子采用相同的训练流程。放松后两项假设是未来重要方向。

title: Instruction-Conditioned Electromagnetic Spectrum Understanding via Budget-Adaptive Signal Tokenization
summary: Electromagnetic spectrum monitoring increasingly requires flexible analysis beyond task-specific recognition and detection. Multimodal large language models offer a unified interface, but extending vision-language models (VLMs) to raw I/Q signals requires tokenization that balances fidelity against a strict budget. For signals, dense encoding causes token costs to grow with observation length, whereas fixed-resolution compression may discard short-duration or localized signal evidence. Thus, we propose \textbf{BATok}, a budget-adaptive signal tokenizer that adjusts token capacity to the input length while allocating that capacity according to the signal content. BATok constructs candidate representations from signal-derived features using lightweight multi-resolution branches, then combines a local energy prior with learnable queries to resample these representations into compact signal tokens. The number of tokens adapts to the input length while remaining strictly bounded. The resulting tokens are projected into the language embedding space of VLMs. We further introduce \textbf{EMSpec-Instruct}, a multimodal instruction dataset aligning raw I/Q signals, waterfall images, and language supervision for modulation recognition, structured detection, and language-conditioned signal grounding. Experiments show that BATok learns effective signal representations and achieves competitive performance across all tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BATok（预算自适应信号分词器）和 EMSpec-Instruct 数据集，用于将原始 I/Q 信号集成到多模态大语言模型中以实现电磁频谱理解。BATok 通过多分辨率编码、能量先验与可学习查询相结合，将变长 I/Q 观测压缩为有界且内容自适应的紧凑标记，并投影到 VLM 的语言嵌入空间。
AI.motivation: 现有电磁频谱分析依赖任务特定模型或检测器+LLM 级联，前者缺乏统一接口，后者受限于上游输出。将 VLM 扩展到原始 I/Q 信号时，密集编码导致 token 成本随观测长度增长，固定分辨率压缩可能丢失短时或局部信号证据，因此需要一种兼顾保真度与严格预算的自适应分词方案。
AI.method: 1. 信号派生特征增强：I/Q 分量叠加瞬时幅度、功率、相位差，形成5通道输入。2. 多分辨率时间编码：三条并行分支（小/中/大），采用深度可分离卷积与 LiteMixer 块。3. 自适应预算与重采样：单调分段常数函数 K(T) 控制总 token 数上限；能量偏置与可学习相关性分数调制分支特征，再用可学习查询进行交叉注意力重采样。4. 多分辨率标记聚合：添加可学习尺度编码，拼接后经残差投影，统一投影至 VLM 语言嵌入空间。支持图像-文本、信号-文本、图像-信号-文本三种配置。配套构建 EMSpec-Instruct 数据集（40万训练指令），含调制识别、结构化检测、语言条件信号定位三类任务。
AI.result: BATok 在 HisarMod2019 与 EMSpec-Sim 独立基准上取得平均 58.64% Acc / 58.54% Macro-F1，超过 MAMC、SiT、DNCNet。集成至 Qwen3-VL-2B 和 LLaVA-1.5-7B 后，调制识别 OA 分别提升 7.01 和 18.56 点；检测/定位 F1@0.5 也有改善，表明原始 I/Q 与瀑布图提供互补证据。消融实验验证长度自适应预算、信号派生特征、三分辨率编码与能量-相关性融合重采样的有效性。
AI.conclusion: BATok 提供了一个轻量、VLM-无关的接口，将混合长度的原始 I/Q 观测映射为有界且内容感知的连续标记，证明了波形级证据可补充基于图像的瀑布图表示用于统一频谱理解。局限在于开放集与跨域泛化尚未验证，且多分辨率重采样导致独立推理延迟高于紧凑分类器。

title: Language-Specific Effects of Tokenizer Choice in Multilingual Language Models
summary: Tokenizer choice affects multilingual language modeling, but vocabulary capacity is finite and vocabulary size is often constrained: improving representation for some languages often comes at the expense of others. We therefore ask whether tokenizer choice matters equally across languages, a question that the current literature leave unanswered. To this end, we train 123 language models spanning 54 tokenizers. In the main comparison, architecture, training corpus, training-token budget, and optimization are held fixed, so the models differ only in their tokenizer. We find that tokenizer choice matters more for languages with less language-model training data: across the 54 tokenizers, the standard deviation of a language's bits-per-byte (BPB) increases as its model training-data share decreases (Spearman rho = -0.52 over the 31 trained languages and -0.69 over the 28 written with word boundaries). Leaving a language out of tokenizer training raises its BPB in every language we study, and the penalty tends to be larger for languages with less language-model training data. Giving lower-resource languages a larger share of tokenizer-training data, however, does not unconditionally help those languages: both equal weighting and an allocation inverting the shares with respect to the language model training data increase their BPB, particularly when language-model training repeats data. Finally, which intrinsic tokenizer properties are associated with better BPB differs across languages, providing further evidence that what makes a good tokenizer depends on the language. We find that the metrics quantifying these properties can be successfully used to predict downstream models' pairwise BPB rankings, suggesting a practical strategy for screening tokenizer candidates before training language models.

AI.tldr: 本文训练了123个语言模型（涵盖54种分词器），系统研究了分词器选择在多语言语言模型中对不同语言的差异化影响。研究发现低资源语言对分词器选择最敏感；为低资源语言增加分词器训练数据份额并不一定能改善其性能；按语言测量的内禀指标可在训练前有效筛选分词器候选。
AI.motivation: 多语言语言模型中词汇表容量是有限的，一个分词器的改变可能有利于某些语言却损害其他语言。现有研究缺乏对每个语言层面的系统分析：分词器选择对单一语言影响多大、哪些语言受影响最深、什么分词器属性决定这些差异。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 训练123个1.27B参数的decoder-only Transformer模型（nanochat d24架构），对应54种不同的分词器。控制架构、训练语料、token预算和优化不变，仅改变分词器。分词器涵盖四种设计维度：预分词规则、分词算法、词汇编码和分词器训练数据。在FLORES+上以每语言bits-per-byte（BPB）为主要评测指标，使用混合效应模型和族聚类标准误进行统计分析。
AI.result: （1）改变分词器会改变每种语言的BPB，且排名一致性低（平均Kendallτ=0.418）；（2）语言模型训练数据越少的语言对分词器选择越敏感（Spearman ρ=-0.52）；（3）将一种语言排除在分词器训练数据之外会提高其BPB，且语言模型训练数据份额越少的语言惩罚越大；（4）将分词器训练数据重新分配给低资源语言并不一定降低其BPB，反而可能升高，尤其在训练数据重复的情况下；（6）按语言测量的九种内禀指标（熵、压缩率、生育率等）可以在不训练模型的情况下以0.89-0.91的成对准确率预测BPB排序。
AI.conclusion: 分词器选择对低资源语言影响最大；按语言计算的内禀指标可有效筛选分词器候选；在多语言分词器设计中应进行逐语言评估，谨慎对待向低资源语言重新分配词汇表容量的做法，并将按比例分配分词器训练数据权重作为合理起点。

title: Large-Scale Benchmarking of Quantum Neural Network Configurations for Financial Time Series Forecasting
summary: Quantum machine learning, and quantum neural networks (QNNs) in particular, are advancing fields with growing potential. Although systematic comparisons of QNN configurations have been explored primarily for classification tasks, comparatively little attention has been given to regression problems, particularly financial time series forecasting. This study presents a large-scale systematic comparative evaluation of QNN component configurations for financial time series forecasting, using the GBP/USD spot exchange rate as a case study. A grid search across encoding methods, ansatz designs, qubit counts, layer depths, and cost functions yields 1,368 distinct model configurations, each evaluated in terms of prediction accuracy, computational cost, and convergence behaviour. The results reveal unique insights into how the choice of methods influences performance, such as that gate selection and arrangement are more critical to model success than raw parameter count, and that entanglement is a system-level property of the full circuit rather than solely at the ansatz level. The best-performing QNN configuration achieves an $R^2$ score of 0.985, outperforming a classical BiLSTM baseline. Additionally, the impact of real quantum hardware noise is assessed through execution on the IQM Emerald device, revealing that gate errors and decoherence represent a significant barrier to practical deployment, with gate selection and circuit depth identified as key determinants of hardware noise resilience. Overall, the findings provide practical architectural guidance for QNN design and establish a baseline characterisation of QNN noise sensitivity on near-term quantum devices.

AI.tldr: 本文对1368种QNN配置进行了大规模系统性基准测试，用于GBP/USD汇率预测这一金融时间序列回归任务。研究涵盖编码方法、ansatz设计、量子比特数、层深度和成本函数等5个维度的网格搜索，并评估了模拟器和真实量子硬件（IQM Emerald）上的性能。最佳配置达到R²=0.985，超越BiLSTM基线，并揭示了门选择、纠缠的复杂性与硬件噪声对QNN性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有QNN配置的系统性比较主要集中在分类任务上，对回归问题（尤其是金融时间序列预测）的关注不足。此外，量子硬件相关因素在配置选择中常被忽视。因此，本文旨在通过大规模基准测试填补这一空白，为金融领域的QNN设计提供架构指导。
AI.method: 基于PennyLane框架，对1368种QNN配置进行了系统性评估，涵盖：(1)3种编码方法（振幅、角度、电路编码）；(2)12种ansatz设计；(3)量子比特数4-12；(4)层数1-8；(5)经典MSE和量子保真度两种成本函数。训练使用Adam优化器，学习率0.1，共300个epochs。数据集为GBP/USD即期汇率（5000个样本，2005-2025年），按60/10/30划分训练/验证/测试集。基线为受约束和无约束的BiLSTM模型。在模拟器、SV1（含读出噪声）和IQM Emerald真实设备上评估硬件噪声影响。
AI.result: 1. 最佳单模型：角度编码+ansatz(j)+4量子比特+8层+经典MSE成本函数，达到R²=0.985，超越无约束BiLSTM（R²=0.9805）；2. 振幅编码平均性能最佳；3. 门的选取与排列比参数数量对模型成功更关键；4. 纠缠是整个电路的全局属性而非仅限ansatz；5. IQM Emerald硬件上6量子比特配置表现最差；6. ansatz(k)硬件抗噪性最佳（无双量子比特门），但预测性能最差；7. Ansatz(j)在1-2层时硬件上仍可达R²=0.77；8. 12种ansatz中有10种优于受约束BiLSTM，8种优于无约束BiLSTM。
AI.conclusion: 研究为金融时间序列预测的QNN架构选择提供了实用指导，强调了门选择、纠缠的全局特性和硬件感知设计的重要性。硬件噪声仍是实际应用的重要障碍，仅少数浅层配置在真实硬件上保持有效预测能力。最佳模拟配置未必在硬件上表现最优，ansatz选择必须考虑目标设备的本征门兼容性。QNN在金融预测领域展现潜力，特别是在受限数据场景下。未来工作应探索在QCNNs、QLSTMs等更复杂架构中验证这些发现，并随着硬件保真度的提高进一步推进。

title: Reliability Characterization for N-version Object Detection
summary: N-version object detection (OD) is an approach to diversifying detection results using multiple models or input frames and reducing detection errors by aggregating individual results. Diversity and consistency across multiple detection results are critical information for characterizing the reliability of possible configurations of N-version OD systems. However, existing performance metrics such as mAP and Accuracy fail to capture these factors, as they are defined solely on the final outcome after aggregation. To overcome this limitation, we propose two reliability metrics particularly defined for N-version OD, namely coverage of errors in OD (Cov_OD) and certainty of accurate prediction in OD (Cer_OD), which can be computed from individual detection results without relying on voting strategies. We empirically demonstrate the unique features of the proposed metrics through a case study of N-version OD for a vehicle in an autonomous-driving simulator. We show that the proposed metrics can be used for 1) selecting version combinations with complementary error characteristics, 2) choosing an effective voting strategy based on diversity and consistency profiles, and 3) guiding incremental construction of N-version OD systems via pairwise two-version analysis. These results highlight the importance of the metrics that can guide the design of reliable N-version OD applications.

AI.tldr: 本文针对N版本目标检测系统提出两个新的可靠性度量指标——Cov_OD（错误覆盖率）和Cer_OD（正确预测确定性度），在目标级粒度上量化多版本检测结果的多样性与一致性，无需依赖投票策略即可表征系统的内在可靠性边界，并提供版本组合选择、投票策略选取及增量构建的实用设计指导。
AI.motivation: 现有的目标检测性能度量（如mAP、Accuracy）仅在投票聚合后的最终输出上定义，无法刻画N版本系统中各版本间的多样性与一致性；传统的N版本ML可靠性度量Cov和Cer又仅适用于分类任务，在一帧多目标的场景下会因少数共同不可检测对象而低估覆盖率，亟需面向目标检测的、与投票策略无关的细粒度可靠性度量。
AI.method: 1）将Cov和Cer从图像级（逐帧统计错误交集/并集）扩展到目标级：对每张图像统计所有N个检测模块错误集合的交集IoE(x)与并集UoE(x)，并将其归一化为该帧检测对象总数|O(x)|的比例，再对整个数据集取均值；2）在Carla仿真器数据集上构建输入多样化（5个不同位置相机+YOLOv8n）和模型多样化（YOLOv8n、RT-DETR、RetinaNet、FCOS、SSD等共7个模型）两种N版本配置，穷举评估所有两版本和三版本组合（共21+35种），并与三种投票策略（affirmative、consensus、unanimous）下的mAP进行对比和Pearson相关性分析。
AI.result: Cov_OD与Cer_OD始终高于对应的Cov与Cer（例如5模型时模型多样化场景下Cov_OD=0.956 vs. Cov=0.771；Cer_OD=0.628 vs. Cer=0.532），且呈现单调趋势，与投票策略无关；架构异构组合（如FCOS+SSD、RT-DETR+FCOS+SSD）获得最高Cov_OD，架构同构组合（尤其YOLO家族内部）获得最高Cer_OD；Cov_OD与affirmative/consensus下mAP呈强正相关（r=0.719/0.608），Cer_OD与unanimous下mAP呈中等正相关（r=0.472）；增量构建三版本系统时，选取与现有两版本均具有低Cer_OD的第三版本（如RT-DETR）比单纯高Cov_OD的版本（如YOLOv11n）能获得更高的三版本Cov_OD（0.947 vs. 0.941）。
AI.conclusion: 提出的Cov_OD和Cer_OD填补了N版本目标检测中与投票策略无关的目标级可靠性度量的空白，二者的差值界定了任意投票策略下系统可达可靠性的范围；二者联合可指导版本组合选择（互补错误特征）、投票策略选择（高Cov_OD/差距大时选覆盖导向，低Cer_OD选一致性导向）以及通过两版本配对分析实现增量构建；局限性在于实验仅在Carla仿真器数据集上进行，模型组合数量有限，且未考虑WBF等高级投票策略。

title: Bayesian Optimisation under State-Preservation Constraints
summary: In many engineering design problems, the objective and constraints depend on the state: the solution of a PDE determined by the design parameters. We consider improving a design while holding selected state observables near trusted values, which we call state preservation constraints. Constrained Bayesian optimisation handles these with a learnt feasibility model, but struggles with this problem's highly anisotropic feasible set. Our central idea is to pre-compute the set of controls whose linearised constraint response stays within tolerance, thereby pulling back the state-space constraint into design space. This linearisation defines an ellipsoid from which we can efficiently draw a large number of well-spread candidates. The underlying linear response map is refined online, and the ellipsoid is rebuilt accordingly. We demonstrate the method end-to-end on our key application - Tokamak divertor optimisation under plasma-boundary preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种针对状态保持型约束的贝叶斯优化方法，核心思想是利用约束响应的一阶线性化预先计算设计空间中的可行域（椭球），并以此作为候选提议几何结构；在贝叶斯优化循环中在线更新该线性响应映射。该方法在托卡马克偏滤器优化问题（保持等离子体边界的同时改善偏滤器热负荷性能）上取得了显著的样本效率提升。
AI.motivation: 在工程设计中，目标函数和约束函数常常依赖于系统状态（由偏微分方程PDE求解得到）。状态保持约束（State-Preservation Constraints）要求在优化过程中使某些状态观测量保持在基准值附近。这类约束对应的可行集在设计空间中极为细长且各向异性，传统的约束贝叶斯优化通过学习可行性代理模型来处理，但需要大量昂贵评估才能捕捉到可行集的几何结构，导致样本效率极低。
AI.method:
核心方法是在贝叶斯优化循环中引入基于线性化的提议几何结构：
1. **线性化可行域**：在基准设计 $x_0$ 处对约束函数 $C(\psi(x))$ 做一阶Taylor展开，得到雅可比矩阵 $J$，从而将状态空间的约束"拉回"到设计空间，形成椭球 $E = \{x_0 + \delta x : \delta x^\top M \delta x \leq \tau^2\}$，其中 $M = J^\top G J$。
2. **射线采样与最大最小过滤**：从 $E \cap B$（椭球与信任域的交集）中高效生成大量分布良好的候选点。
3. **在线更新**：每次评估后，利用观测数据通过最小二乘重新拟合线性响应映射 $\hat{J}$，并相应地重建椭球 $E$。
4. **场模型（Field Model）**：处理线性化误差超出椭球边界的情况。用POD基函数表示观测量的非线性残差，高斯过程学习各模式系数，通过广义 $\chi^2$ 分布近似获得可行性概率。
5. 整合到信任区域贝叶斯优化（TuRBO）框架中。
AI.result:
在MAST-U型托卡马克偏滤器优化问题上验证方法：
- **电流优化（d=10）**：达到中位杂质分数阈值 $c_Z = 0.012$，比最佳基线方法好 **5.2倍**，同时保持约89.5%的评估满足边界公差（0.5 cm）。
- **联合电流-位置优化（d=30）**：比基线方法好 **2.1倍**。在线更新线性映射对于处理更强的非线性至关重要（将预测误差从1.07 cm降至0.031 cm）。
- **消融实验**：表明提议几何结构是性能提升的主要原因——即使不使用任何代理模型仅随机从 $E \cap B$ 采样（A3），也能比最佳基线好3.6倍。
- 成功扩展到多目标优化（同时优化连接长度和总通量膨胀）。
AI.conclusion: 状态保持约束对应的可行集虽然昂贵学习但易于计算（一阶近似仅需 $2d$ 次有限差分求解）。通过预先计算并在线更新该线性化可行域，将几何结构直接融入贝叶斯优化的提议机制，避免了纯数据驱动方法需要大量评估来学习可行集形状的问题。该框架对托卡马克偏滤器优化中精密保持等离子体边界的问题特别有效，展现了5-7倍的样本效率提升。作为一个自洽的BO模块，可与其他BO进展（如批量、多保真度、多任务、高维和风险规避BO）灵活集成。

title: Toward Optimal Regret in Adversarial MDPs with Stochastic Hard Constraints
summary: We study episodic constrained Markov decision processes with adversarial losses under stochastic hard constraints. Specifically, starting from a known strictly feasible policy with margin $d$, we seek to obtain optimal regret while satisfying the expected cost constraints in every episode. In this setting, Stradi et al. (2025) show that a carefully designed mixing rule attains regret of order $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T}/\min\{d,d^2\})$. Interestingly, they also provide a lower bound of order $\Omega(\sqrt{T}/\rho)$ for the same setting, where $\rho$ is the Slater margin of the offline problem and can be much larger than $d$. In this work, we build on their approach to obtain optimal regret dependence on these margins. Specifically, we propose MA-OPS, an algorithm that combines an optimistic search for the Slater margin with a pessimistic evaluation of the selected policies to safely learn a policy with a large feasibility margin. This policy is then used to minimize regret while satisfying the constraints at every episode. In particular, we show that MA-OPS attains regret $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T}/\rho + 1/(d\rho))$. Finally, we provide a matching lower bound, showing that the dependence on $T$, $d$, $\rho$ in the regret bound is optimal up to logarithmic factors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究具有随机硬约束的对抗性MDP中的在线学习问题，提出MA-OPS算法，通过乐观搜索Slater margin与悲观评估的结合，实现了关于初始边界d和Slater margin ρ的最优遗憾界Õ(√T/ρ + 1/(dρ))，并给出了匹配的下界。
AI.motivation: 现有CMDP硬约束算法的遗憾依赖于初始可行策略的边界d，但CMDP中可达的最大边界（Slater margin ρ）通常远大于d。Stradi等人(2025)给出Õ(√T/min{d,d²})的上界和Ω(√T/ρ)的下界，遗留了关于d和ρ联合依赖最优性的开放问题。
AI.method: 提出MA-OPS（Margin-Adaptive Optimistic Policy Search）算法，包含两个阶段：(1) 安全基线搜索阶段，通过求解乐观最大最小问题估计Slater margin ρ，结合悲观策略评估验证候选策略边界，确保搜索阶段每轮可行；(2) 损失最小化阶段，使用学习到的ρ/2边界基线调用改进的S-OPS算法。同时改进了S-OPS分析，将遗憾对1/d的依赖从二次降为线性。
AI.result: MA-OPS以高概率保证每轮可行性，遗憾界为Õ(L²|X|√(|A|T)/ρ + L²|X|³|A|/(dρ))。证明了匹配的下界Ω(√T/ρ + 1/(dρ))，表明在T、d、ρ上最优（至多log因素）。同时独立证明了S-OPS的Õ(√T/d)遗憾界，将依赖从1/d²改进为1/d。
AI.conclusion: 本文解决了对抗性CMDP硬约束设置中关于初始边界d和未知Slater margin ρ的最优联合依赖问题。MA-OPS是首个在每轮保持可行性的同时能在常数时间内学习到ρ量级边界的算法，遗憾关于T、d、ρ是最优的。

title: When KL Regularization Misfires in Group Policy Optimization
summary: Why does removing reference-policy KL regularization sometimes improve group policy optimization? This motivates studying how reference-policy information should enter group-relative updates. We analyze seven potential failure modes in the interactions between KL and rewards: residual KL updates after reward clipping, after gradient cancellation, and in groups with identical rewards; KL growth with response length and an imbalance in its relative contribution; KL concentration on a small number of tokens; and sampling noise when k1 is incorporated into rewards. We propose Zero-Sum Calibrated Policy Optimization (ZCPO), which uses relative drift measured by conditional KL to calibrate within-group reward coefficients and integrates them into the base surrogate. Mathematical reasoning experiments and ablations support this design's effectiveness in our settings.

AI.tldr: 本文针对GRPO及其变体中独立KL正则化与组相对奖励更新之间的交互问题，系统分析了七种潜在失败模式，并提出了一种新的方法ZCPO（Zero-Sum Calibrated Policy Optimization），利用条件KL在组内校准零和奖励系数，在数学推理任务上取得了优于DAPO等基线的效果。
AI.motivation: 近期工作（如DAPO、GMPO、PAPO）发现移除参考策略的KL正则化有时反而能提升组策略优化（如GRPO）的性能。这一反直觉现象引出了核心问题：参考策略信息应当如何融入组相对优化中？论文旨在系统分析独立KL项与奖励更新之间的冲突机制，并设计更合理的KL信息利用方式。
AI.method: 论文提出ZCPO方法，核心设计包括：(1) 分析七种KL-奖励交互失败模式（F1-F7），涵盖奖励裁剪后残留KL、组内奖励相同时KL残留、KL随响应长度积累、KL信号集中于少数token、k1系数的条件采样噪声等；(2) 利用条件KL（conditional KL）计算每个响应的平均KL漂移，并在组内做中心化（centering）处理以消除共享KL偏移分量；(3) 构造联合系数C_i = A_i/s_q - β·K_i，将KL校准融入基础代理目标的奖励系数中，其中K_i为组内中心化的长度归一化条件KL；(4) 使用最大绝对优势（而非标准差）进行奖励归一化；(5) 证明该联合系数是固定输入下零和二次校准问题的唯一最优解。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-32B数学推理实验中，ZCPO在AIME24和AIME25上分别达到56.8%和48.5%（avg@32），显著优于DAPO无KL（47.3%/37.1%）和DAPO+标准KL（44.5%/34.7% at β=0.001）。关键消融实验表明：移除KL中心化导致最大性能下降（AIME24: 56.8%→45.6%）；移除长度归一化、替换为k1系数、使用标准差归一化均导致性能下降。诊断分析显示：vanilla方法在裁剪token处保留约51%的KL梯度贡献；ZCPO在奖励梯度高/低抵消组间的KL贡献差异仅3.45倍（vs vanilla的524倍）。在Qwen3-4B长上下文实验中，ZCPO在6个基准上均优于GRPO+标准KL和GRPO无KL。在GLM-4-9B非Qwen模型上也验证了跨模型泛化性（AIME24: 24.5%→36.2%）。
AI.conclusion: ZCPO通过将参考策略信息从独立的KL惩罚项转化为组内零和系数校准工具，有效解决了独立KL与组相对奖励更新之间的七种交互失败模式。条件KL的组内中心化消除了共享漂移分量和条件采样噪声，长度归一化缓解了KL随长度的积累效应。理论分析证明了系数构造的最优性，数学推理和长上下文实验均验证了该方法在所测试设置中的有效性。局限性在于：评估覆盖多个模型规模和任务但仍需更多模型家族的验证；最优性结果针对固定输入，训练中不能保证每步奖励增加或KL减少。

title: Scalable Hierarchical Graph Generation via Soft Community Structure
summary: Generating large attributed graphs requires reproducing the topology, generating attributes jointly with the structure, and remaining scalable. Many real-world graphs exist as a single large graph, so a generative model has to generalize from the one graph it is fit on, without independent samples. We present Schema, which recursively decomposes a reference graph into a hierarchy of soft communities, assigning each node a membership distribution. Generation is then split into three stages, each trained independently: (1) synthesizing node attributes conditioned on soft memberships, (2) generating intra-community edges from local structural context, and (3) modeling inter-community connections over bridge nodes whose membership mass is distributed across several communities. No stage forms the full adjacency matrix, and each stage operates on a subgraph bounded by the community size. We also introduce an evaluation protocol that covers structural fidelity, memorization, downstream utility, and scalability. On four real-world attributed graphs, Schema recovers the balance between local and long-range structure more closely than any other model that generates attributes, while reproducing only a small fraction of the reference edges. It retains the downstream accuracy of the reference graph without raising it artificially above that level. Baselines that match its structural fidelity memorize the reference, while those with higher downstream accuracy either exceed the reference accuracy or fail to complete on the larger graphs. We measure scalability on six additional graphs with up to 10 million nodes.

AI.tldr: Schema是一种针对单个大型属性图的可扩展分层生成模型，通过递归地将参考图分解为软社区层次结构，将生成过程分解为三个独立阶段（节点属性、社区内边、社区间边），在保持低记忆化的同时能有效恢复局部与全局结构。
AI.motivation: 现有针对单个大型属性图的生成方法面临三大局限：(1) 可扩展性差，自回归方法成本随节点数二次增长；(2) 难以同时兼顾多种结构尺度（密集社区、稀疏社区间连接、全局拓扑）；(3) 多数方法仅生成拓扑而不生成节点属性，限制了下游应用。因此需要一种能够联合生成属性与结构、并保持可扩展性的方法。
AI.method: Schema采用分层软社区分解与三阶段独立生成框架：(1) 分层分解模块通过Leiden算法递归将参考图分解为簇树，每个内部簇通过迭代标签传播获得软分配矩阵S，识别连接多个社区的桥接节点；(2) Stage 1使用Transformer以软分配和池化表示为条件生成叶节点属性；(3) Stage 2使用基于FiLM条件化的变分图自编码器在每个社区内生成社区内边；(4) Stage 3通过双线性评分加层次驱动的簇亲和力项，在桥接节点上生成社区间边。所有阶段独立训练，互不依赖，内存由最大社区规模界定，不形成完整邻接矩阵。
AI.result: 在四个真实属性图（Citeseer、Cora ML、Amazon Photo、Amazon Computers）上的实验表明：Schema在生成属性的模型中是结构性Inter/Intra比最接近参考的，且边缘重叠（EO）保持在0.003-0.102之间，自重叠不高于边缘重叠，表明无明显记忆化；下游节点分类效用比（TSTR/TRTR）在0.771-0.861之间，且未通过提升同质性或特征可分性来虚增精度。可扩展性测试在六个附加图（含最多1000万节点的IGB Medium）上完成，单GPU即可运行，生成时间随训练时间占比仅为0.5%-2%。在九个基线方法中，Schema是唯一同时满足结构保真、低记忆化、保持下游精度、且能在大图上完整运行的方法。
AI.conclusion: Schema通过软社区层次结构和三阶段分解生成实现了大规模属性图的生成，在结构保真、记忆化控制和下游实用性之间取得了平衡，但仍存在三角形密度低于参考（因边阶段采用成对独立评分）和在超大规模图上需要限制叶社区大小等局限性。未来的工作方向包括引入三角形条件生成、扩展到异质图和动态图等。

title: Mole: Tier-Specific Hotness Profiling Driven Memory Tiering for Multi-Tiered Memory Systems
summary: Multi-tiered memory systems combine fast, small upper tiers with slow, large lower tiers to improve performance and cost efficiency. Existing designs, such as AutoTiering and MTM, rely on greedy promotion and stepwise demotion, which can intensify contention for limited capacity in faster tiers. We observe that promotions directly improve performance, whereas demotions primarily reclaim space. Based on this asymmetry, we propose Mole, a memory tiering system that separates promotion and demotion destinations. Mole employs staging demotion to move cold pages directly to the lowest tier, bypassing intermediate tiers, and targeted promotion to place hot pages in tiers that match their current hotness. The lowest tier serves as a staging area from which pages can be promoted when they become hot again. This separation preserves intermediate-tier capacity for promotions, reducing tier contention and migration failures. However, staging demotion requires timely identification of pages that become hot after demotion. To meet this requirement with low profiling overhead, Mole uses tier-specific profiling: it profiles the lowest tier at high frequency to detect reactivated hot pages, while profiling upper tiers at lower frequency to identify cold pages. Experimental results show that Mole reduces migration failures and improves performance under dynamic access patterns.

AI.tldr: Mole提出了一种面向多层内存系统的内存分层管理机制,通过将降级目的地与升级目的地分离(暂存降级到最底层、目标化升级到与热度匹配的层级),并采用按层级区分采样频率的冷热度剖析策略,在降低层间争用与剖析开销的同时,提升动态访问场景下的迁移成功率与性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多层内存方案(AutoTiering、MTM)采用贪心升级和逐级降级,在快层级容量有限时易引发层间争用,导致迁移失败率极高(升级失败率可达97%以上,降级失败率可达48.2%);同时现有热度剖析机制在所有层级使用相同频率,无法兼顾上层的剖析开销与下层的及时热度检测需求。
AI.method: 设计Mole系统,包含四个模块:① 基于物理地址的热度剖析(PAP),通过Linux LRU列表直接扫描物理页并用PageUnmap标志位避免冗余页表遍历;② 差异化剖析频率控制(DPF),下层高频unmap、上层低频unmap,所有层级扫描频率相同;③ 基于再访问间隔与未访问时长的统一热度直方图,采用分段对数-线性表示并导出动态层级阈值;④ 分级降级(staging demotion,冷页直达最底层)与目标化升级(targeted promotion,按动态阈值放置)相结合的迁移管理,降级与升级目的地分离。
AI.result: 在Intel四层内存系统(Local DRAM/Remote DRAM/Local PM/Remote PM)上,使用SPECaccel、Graph500、Silo、Liblinear、GUPS、PageRank等负载,在1:1:2:2配置下性能领先次优基线70.2%,在1:1:8:8配置下领先20.6%;升级失败率从基线的90%以上降至31.2%~39.5%;剖析CPU开销比AutoNUMA降低11%,平均每次剖析操作时间从271.0 ns降至246.7 ns。
AI.conclusion: Mole证明了"分离升级与降级目的地+按层级差异化剖析"是缓解多层内存层间争用的有效路径;基于间隔的统一热度度量同时支持冷热页识别,在动态访问模式下显著降低迁移失败率并提升端到端性能,且剖析机制开销低、平台无关,适用于CXL等多层异构内存。

title: Is Real-World Training Data Necessary for Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection?
summary: Generalist graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to build a foundation model that detects anomalies on arbitrary unseen graphs without retraining or fine-tuning. Sufficient data are essential for foundation model training, yet generalist GAD still faces a data shortage, as real-world anomalous graphs are scarce and costly to collect and annotate. To fill this gap, we propose AG-FORGE, an Anomalous Graph generation Forge for automatic synthesis of anomalous graphs, exploring the feasibility of synthetic data-driven training for generalist GAD. Empirically, we find that synthetic data can achieve performance comparable to real-world training, but fail to push the performance boundary further due to the limited capacity of existing methods. To further unlock model capacity as training data scale up, we develop TS-GGAD, a Topology-Semantic coordinated Generalist GAD that captures complementary topological and semantic anomaly evidence, together with a curriculum learning strategy tailored to large-scale synthetic training. Extensive experiments on 14 real-world datasets demonstrate that TS-GGAD, trained on data generated by AG-FORGE, significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对通用图异常检测（Generalist GAD）面临真实异常图数据稀缺的核心瓶颈，提出无需真实数据训练的可行性方案：1）设计AG-Forge三阶段级联合成框架自动生成大规模多样化的异常图；2）提出TS-GGAD拓扑-语义协同模型配合课程学习策略以充分释放合成数据的潜力。
AI.motivation: 通用图异常检测（GAD）旨在构建可在任意未见图上直接检测异常的"基础模型"，但与语言/图像领域不同，GAD的真实训练数据极为稀缺（现有方法仅使用约90k节点），成为扩展模型规模与跨域泛化能力的关键瓶颈。受TabPFN等PFN系列模型成功验证合成数据可行性的启发，本文探索"真实数据是否必需"这一核心问题。
AI.method: 方法包含两个核心组件：(1) AG-Forge——通过"结构生成（4种拓扑：社区结构SBM、无标度、投影二部图、小世界）→特征生成（稠密/稀疏/二值）→异常注入（局部致密化、链接集中、属性抑制、社群分散、混合5类，可控难度δ）"的三阶段级联管线，可生成近乎无限的异常图；(2) TS-GGAD——通过5维异常感知拓扑统计量+Transformer目标域感知编码、PCA+地标散射+MLP语义编码、样本级门控网络动态融合两路证据，并配合难度递进+EMA损失感知采样+节点级Focal Loss的课程学习策略。
AI.result: 在14个真实世界数据集（涵盖引文、社交、电商、行为四类网络）上的实验表明：(1) 现有通用GAD方法在AG-Forge合成数据上训练能达到与真实数据训练相当甚至略优的性能，验证了合成训练可行性；(2) TS-GGAD在14个数据集上均取得最优AUROC，平均较最优基线ReFi-GAD提升5.39%；(3) 模型与数据均展现出明确的scaling规律——数据从5k扩展至1M节点、参数从10^4扩展至1.5×10^6时性能持续提升，且"大数据+大模型"区域AUROC超过86%；(4) 消融实验证实拓扑流贡献最大（去掉下降20.48%），课程学习（-5.43%）与语义流（-4.58%）均为关键组件。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了通用图异常检测无需真实训练数据：合成数据既能突破数据瓶颈，又能为大模型训练提供充足监督；通过更强的拓扑-语义协同架构与课程学习，可充分释放合成数据的潜力。主要局限在于缺乏系统化的合成数据质量评估方法，未来工作将致力于建立合成数据评估与选择准则。

title: Learning to Plan by Looking Back: Hindsight Hierarchies for Training Reasoning Models
summary: We introduce a self-improvement loop for reasoning models based on the following observation: Even when the difficulty of a problem exceeds the model's current solving abilities, an additionally supplied solution might enable the model to extract useful solution ideas in hindsight. We operationalize this by jointly training the same model to exhibit the following three capabilities: predicting solution ideas from problems alone, reverse-engineering ideas from problems and known solutions, and solving problems using provided ideas. The loop alternates between reverse engineering such ideas from problems with supplied solutions and using these ideas as additional supervision for joint training of all three capabilities. We give a formal specification of our method and a concrete instantiation for interactive theorem proving in the Lean theorem prover; empirical evaluation remains future work.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于推理模型的自改进训练方法，核心思路是：即使问题难度超出模型当前能力，给定已知解答后模型可在"事后"反向工程出有用的解题思路。同一模型被联合训练以执行三个能力——先预测思路（foresight）、从解答反向重建思路（hindsight）、以及依据思路求解（solver），并通过交替循环不断迭代。论文给出了形式化规范以及在 Lean 定理证明器中的具体实现，但明确指出实验评估留作未来工作。
AI.motivation: 问题解决中存在一种不对称性：从零发现解法通常比在已知解法的基础上逆向推出其核心思路更困难。当问题难度超过模型当前能力时，仅靠模型自身难以生成新的训练监督信号；但如果提供已知的解答，模型却能够从中提取出"事后看来有用"的解题思路。利用这种"事后"能力，可以为模型提供一个低成本的额外监督来源，帮助其学习独立生成解题思路，进而提升求解能力。
AI.method:
方法由三个共享骨干网络的组件组成：
• Hindsight（事后组件）$H_\theta$：给定问题 $x$ 和已知参考解答 $y$，从详细到粗粒度反向工程出一个分层思路 $z=(z_0,\dots,z_n)$。
• Foresight（先见组件）$F_\theta$：仅给定问题 $x$，从粗粒度到细粒度预测分层思路 $\hat z$。
• Solver（求解组件）$S_\theta$：给定问题 $x$ 和思路 $z$，生成解决方案候选 $\hat y$。
训练采用交替循环 Algorithm 1：每轮迭代（1）取一批问题-解答对；（2）用当前 hindsight 组件生成思路，构造训练三元组 $(x,y,z)$；（3）联合训练三个组件（共享参数），使 foresight 学会从 $x$ 预测 $z$、hindsight 学会从 $(x,y)$ 预测 $z$、solver 学会从 $(x,z)$ 预测 $y$。
并提供在可验证问题域（如 Lean 定理证明）的可选增强版本 Algorithm 2：为每个 (x,y) 采样 $K$ 个 hindsight 思路，由 solver 在受验证器 Verify 评估的情况下尝试各思路，按成功率等指标打分，选取得分最高者用于训练，从而引入类似 expert iteration 的额外训练信号。
具体到 Lean 实例化：使用单语言模型（internlm2-math-plus-7b）作为三个组件共享骨干，通过 prompt 模板和特殊角色标记区分组件；三个组件的提示-响应对在训练时被混合采样（$b_S=8, b_F=b_H=2$），并按加权交叉熵损失联合优化；推理时采用顺序多 arm 策略，每个 arm 先生成思路再以最佳优先证明搜索求解。论文给出了完整的种子数据构造、提示模板、证明搜索配置、训练超参数等实现细节。
AI.result: 论文未呈现任何实验结果。作者明确指出"empirical evaluation remains future work"，但提供了形式化方法规范、完整的 Lean 实例化方案及配套软件项目实现，供后续评估使用。所提出的训练循环设计、ConstructTriple 算法、最佳优先证明搜索配置、联合优化目标等均仅作为"待评估的具体起点"被提出。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了一个面向推理模型的自改进训练范式——先从已知解答反向工程解题思路，再将这些思路作为额外监督用于联合训练同一模型的"预测思路、反推思路、利用思路求解"三个能力。该方法形式上清晰、通用，并在 Lean 4 定理证明场景中给出了完整具体的实例化（含模型、数据、提示模板、训练超参数、证明搜索策略等）。然而作者反复强调：是否真的有效、hindsight 思路是否真的能被 foresight 学会、验证器引导的思路选择是否带来增益，都取决于尚未完成的实验评估。因此本文的核心贡献在于方法的形式化定义与可复现的工程原型，而非已证实的实证效果。

title: Unifying Policy Learning and State Prediction through Spatial Language Modeling
summary: Learning how actions change scene geometry can provide complementary supervision for goal-directed manipulation. We introduce Spatial Language Modeling, which represents scene contours, goals, action targets, and future states with a shared vocabulary of discrete coordinates and semantic tokens. A task-specific grammar organizes these elements into spatial sequences, allowing one autoregressive Transformer to learn action generation and action-conditioned state prediction through a common next-token objective. We train the model from scratch using random-play transition pretraining followed by joint action and state training on expert demonstrations. During pretraining, recorded action coordinates condition subsequent state predictions and are excluded from the prediction loss. During control, the model decodes only executable action targets and updates its history with newly observed states. We evaluate the approach on Push-T in simulation and on a real robot. The model achieves competitive simulation performance and higher task success and target coverage than the evaluated real-robot policy baselines. Training ablations show improved control with joint action and state sequences, with further gains from random-play pretraining. Given supplied action trajectories, the same model also predicts successive scene states, capturing the geometric effects of pushing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"空间语言建模"(Spatial Language Modeling),将场景几何、目标、动作目标和未来状态统一表示为离散的坐标与语义令牌序列,通过单一自回归Transformer在共同的下一令牌预测目标下同时学习动作生成和动作条件状态预测。
AI.motivation: 机器人操控中,模仿学习策略(如ACT、Diffusion Policy)仅从专家示教中学习动作,缺乏对动作如何改变场景几何的显式建模;世界模型虽能预测未来状态,但通常作为独立模块。两者若能共享预测接口,即可利用非专家交互数据,并使几何变化的预测为策略学习提供互补监督信号。
AI.method: 将平面工作空间离散为128×128网格,每个网格单元对应一个坐标令牌,辅以语义令牌(state、pusher、tblock、goal、move-to)标识实体类型与动作命令;采用上下文无关语法CFG将观察、动作、目标、可选未来状态组织为"空间语言句子"(SLS)。模型采用462M参数的Qwen2架构Transformer,训练分两阶段:(1)随机交互预训练——用随机推杆运动条件化状态预测,动作坐标令牌参与上下文但屏蔽其预测损失;(2)专家示教联合训练——同时监督动作坐标和保留的未来状态。控制时采用三帧历史前缀,通过语法状态机排除未来状态块,仅自回归解码动作坐标。
AI.result: 在Push-T仿真中,Max覆盖率达到0.95(与DP-C、DP-T持平),Avg覆盖率达0.93(最优);真实机器人实验中,成功率0.80(显著优于DP-Coord 0.45、DP-Tag 0.50、ACT 0.65),平均最大覆盖率达0.95。消融实验显示:加入未来状态监督使成功率从0.05提升至0.65,随机预训练进一步将成功率提升至0.80。给定动作轨迹,同一模型可自回归预测未来场景状态,10步内T-block覆盖率从0.98降至0.92,IoU从0.96降至0.85,保持显著几何重叠。
AI.conclusion: 空间语言建模通过统一的坐标-语义令牌词汇表和语法结构,使单一自回归模型能够同时完成动作生成与动作条件状态预测,共享参数与训练目标;联合动作-状态训练与随机交互预训练带来互补增益,验证了将动作条件转移动力学监督与目标导向策略学习统一在同一空间表示中的可行性,为操控任务中策略学习与几何预测的整合提供了实用框架。

title: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of a model on non-verifiable tasks, such as open-ended research, faces a supervision bottleneck when its outputs exceed what even human experts can reliably assess, leaving the model itself (optimizee) as the best available optimizer and evaluator. However, a single model instance struggles to critique and improve its own complex reasoning under this homogeneous loop. To address this, we propose Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS), an RSI method that alternates between evolutionary workflow optimization and supervised fine-tuning on self-generated trajectories. Guided by early findings that multi-agent topologies excel at complex reasoning, MASS prompts a single base model to iteratively propose, execute, and self-evaluate multi-agent workflows. Through an evolutionary search constrained by structural guardrails, the model optimizes these computational-graph-like orchestrations, discovering the most effective distinct roles and information routing for a given task. Over two MASS cycles with Qwen3.6-27B, the model achieves 1.2-1.6x higher performance per output tokens on four open-ended public benchmarks. Because the improved model subsequently acts as a better optimizer and evaluator, this alternating framework enables a continuous, recursive bootstrapping of the model's capabilities. Moreover, multi-agent traces are also more training-efficient: a student trained on them outperforms a single-agent student trained on 1.4x more training tokens. These findings suggest that jointly learning orchestration and bounded subagent execution from multi-agent trajectories can provide an effective signal for RSI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS) 方法，用于在非可验证任务（如开放式研究）上实现递归自我改进（RSI）。MASS交替进行多智能体工作流的进化搜索与监督微调，让单一基础模型同时充当执行者、评估者和工作流优化器，通过协调多个自身副本来突破同质化自监督的瓶颈。在Qwen3.6-27B上进行两个MASS循环后，在四个开放式基准上实现了1.2-1.6倍每输出token的性能提升，验证了多智能体轨迹作为更高效的监督信号。
AI.motivation: 在开放式研究等非可验证任务中，递归自我改进面临监督瓶颈：当模型输出超出人类专家可靠评估能力时，模型自身成为最优优化器和评估器，但单一模型实例在同质化循环中难以有效批评和改进自身复杂推理，导致自反馈可能强化错误而非纠正错误。
AI.method: 1）多智能体工作流优化（Algorithm 2）：将多智能体工作流编码为文本提示（含编排器调用顺序hop、子智能体角色/指令/输出契约contract），通过进化搜索（配对评估+迭代修订）优化任务特定的信息路由；2）工作流内化（Algorithm 3）：在优化后的工作流上执行M次采样，经Bradley-Truy配对排序选出top-K轨迹，去除工作流prompt后联合对编排器和子智能体对话进行SFT，使用subagent:orchestrator=2:1的采样比例；3）递归循环：更新后的模型在新一代中重新担任三种角色。
AI.result: 基于Qwen3.6-27B-FP8，在8个训练任务和6个公开基准上：1）两轮MASS后，测试任务胜率从53.9%升至69.9%；2）四个研究基准上每输出token得分提升1.2-1.6倍；3）评估准确率从73%提升到93%；4）多智能体学生以28.82M token的训练量达到68.3%胜率，超过用1.4倍token训练的单智能体学生（64.0%）；5）工作流分析显示contract和hop组件趋向任务特化，role和instruction趋于泛化；6）行为内化：协调行为（delegation从1/110增至87/110）在无工作流prompt的bare prompt下涌现。
AI.conclusion: MASS证明通过将单一模型组织成多智能体系统并将其协作轨迹蒸馏回共享权重，可以在非可验证任务上实现有效的递归自我改进。核心发现是：1）优化智能体间的信息流（而非仅增加智能体数量）可提供有意义的自监督信号；2）联合学习编排与有界子智能体执行比单智能体长轨迹训练更token高效；3）工作流优化的优化器能力是RSI的主要瓶颈而非评估器能力。

title: AI-Based On-Board Maritime Object Detection for Earth Observation Payload Data Reduction on Versal Embedded Hardware
comment: 8 pages. Accepted at the 10th On-Board Payload Data Compression Workshop (OBPDC 2026), Barcelona, Spain, 12-14 October 2026
summary: Very-high-resolution Earth-observation satellites acquire more data than they can store and downlink, while in maritime surveillance the vessels cover a tiny fraction of each scene. We study onboard vessel detection as a way to select what is downlinked, which reduces the data according to its content rather than coding every pixel; it is complementary to conventional onboard compression. The work follows three axes. (i) Data and algorithm: a controlled dataset is generated from 68 annotated Maxar scenes with 43 vessel classes, and a YOLOX-S detector is trained on it. (ii) Embedded deployment: the detector is quantized and deployed on the DPU of a Versal VC1902, with a limited loss of detection quality and a processing time of a few seconds per scene. (iii) Data reduction: we propose several downlink modes, from metadata only (box, class and score of each detection) to image crops around vessels, tiles holding detections, or the whole scene with a degraded background, and estimate from the measured detection errors the trade-off each offers between the vessels kept and the volume downlinked. On our dense harbor and coastal scenes, tiles keep 98% of the vessels with 29% of the scene volume, and crops 83% with 3%.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在星载 Versal VC1902 嵌入式硬件上部署 YOLOX-S 船舶检测模型，通过四种下行模式（元数据/裁剪/瓦片/选择性编码）实现对地观测海量数据的按内容压缩，量化后检测性能小幅下降（AP 86→81%），单场景处理仅需数秒，在密集港口场景中瓦片模式保留 98% 船舶而仅需 29% 数据量。
AI.motivation: 甚高分辨率对地观测卫星的数据生成速度远超存储与下传带宽，而海面监视场景中船只仅占极小像素比例。传统压缩（如 CCSDS 122/123）对所有像素一视同仁，未利用内容冗余。因此需要一种基于内容感知的星载数据缩减方法，在压缩前选择性地剔除无任务价值的区域。
AI.method: 三大轴线：(1) 数据与算法——基于 68 幅 Maxar 标注场景（43 类船舶）经受控切片生成 13967 块 1024×1024 瓦片数据集（控制空瓦片比例、类别平衡、空间划分与溯源），训练 YOLOX-S 浮点模型 100 轮；(2) 嵌入式部署——经 Vitis AI 后训练量化（int8），以验证集校准，编译至 Versal VC1902 的 DPUCVDX8G（C32B6 配置，6 tile 批）；(3) 数据缩减——将量化检测器在测试瓦片上测得的误检/漏检率外推至 68 幅完整场景，评估元数据/裁剪/瓦片/选择性编码四种下行模式的体积-召回权衡，使用阈值 0.10 优先保召回。
AI.result: 浮点模型 AP=86.1%，F1=84.6%；量化后 AP 降至 81.4%，F1 降至 80.9%，召回率降约 8 点（精度反升 1 点），置信度整体下移，可通过降阈值补偿。硬件层面每瓦片约 17 ms（CPU 预处理与 DPU 推理各占一半），每场景约 5.6 s，板卡静态功耗 26.6 W 主导整体能耗。数据缩减方面（阈值 0.10）：元数据模式仅 0.0003%；裁剪模式保留 83% 船舶、占 2.8% 体积（压缩约 35 倍）；瓦片模式保留 98% 船舶、占 28.7% 体积（压缩约 3.5 倍）；选择性编码 CR=20 时占 7.7% 且无信息丢失。误检占前三种模式体积的 21–28%。
AI.conclusion: 首次将星载量化检测器的实测误差与各下行模式的体积-召回权衡定量关联，证明在密集港口/海岸场景中基于内容的选择性下行可实现 3.5–35 倍体积缩减而几乎不丢失目标。核心贡献在于方法论：星载数据缩减应基于部署后模型的真实误差及不同模式对这些误差的吸收能力来评估，而非仅看检测分数。未来工作包括：接入原始数据与完整片上链路（复原/配准/分块/编码）、开放海域场景、阈值随场景密度自适应、分类可靠性提升后的优先级调度，以及用开放词汇检测器实现用户驱动的选择。

title: A Closer Look at Agentic BBO: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Black-Box Optimization
summary: Black-box optimization (BBO) arises in many scientific and engineering problems where objective evaluations are expensive and limited. Recent large language model (LLM) agents offer a new way to approach BBO by combining task semantics, computation, optimization tools, and feedback-driven decision making, showing great potential due to the integration with mathematically rigorous tools. However, existing agentic BBO studies use different task domains and system configurations, making their results difficult to compare and the effects of individual design choices hard to isolate. We therefore introduce AgenticBBO-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for agentic BBO spanning synthetic functions, hyperparameter optimization, database tuning, chip design, and molecular design under a unified finite-budget evaluation protocol. In our experiments, agentic BBO achieves higher family-averaged scores than direct LLM-based methods in all five domains and outperforms the best numerical optimizers in four. We further study three factors shaping agent performance: optimization tools, task information and prior knowledge, and the role of the LLM during search. Our results show that additional numerical tools do not consistently improve performance, task semantics are broadly useful while more specific priors are less reliable, and numerical optimizers can effectively absorb gains from search trajectories established by the agent. Finally, we introduce a five-task frontier challenge within AgenticBBO-Bench and evaluate seven LLMs under the Codex agent harness, where GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash lie on the Pareto frontier of performance and cost among the evaluated models. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgenticBBO-Bench，一个跨领域的智能体黑盒优化基准，涵盖合成函数、超参优化、数据库调参、芯片设计和分子设计五个领域，并在此基础上系统分析了LLM智能体在黑盒优化中的性能影响因素。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM智能体的黑盒优化研究使用不同的任务领域和系统配置，导致结果难以比较，单一设计选择的影响难以隔离，亟需一个统一基准和分析框架。
AI.method: 构建统一有限预算评估协议下的跨领域基准（AgenticBBO-Bench），通过控制变量实验研究三个关键因素：优化工具、任务信息与先验知识、LLM在优化环路中的参与程度，并以DeepSeek V4.1 Flash为默认骨干、Codex为智能体框架进行测试。
AI.result: 智能体BBO在五个领域的族平均得分均优于直接LLM方法，并在四个领域超越最佳数值优化器；额外数值工具未必一致提升性能，任务语义普遍有用但特定先验可靠性较低，数值优化器可有效接续智能体建立的搜索轨迹；在五任务前沿挑战中GPT-6 Astra与DeepSeek V4.1 Flash位于性能与成本帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: AgenticBBO-Bench为评估LLM智能体黑盒优化提供了跨领域标准化基准和实证基础，揭示了智能体设计选择、任务信息形式与LLM参与程度对性能的影响模式，为未来通用优化智能体的研究指明了方向。

title: Just Weather Scoring: Efficient End-to-end Nowcasting with Distributional Diffusion
summary: Generative diffusion models are well-suited for probabilistic precipitation nowcasting, but existing approaches often rely on separately trained compression or deterministic forecasting components and remain costly at inference due to iterative denoising. We introduce Just Weather Scoring (JWS), a single-stage, end-to-end diffusion model which addresses both issues by forecasting directly in radar space and enabling few-step generation. Radar-space modeling greatly simplifies training and inference and eliminates uncertainty arising from lossy compression. JWS combines Masked Asynchronous Diffusion, a timestep-sampling scheme that preserves clean context while adapting diffusion training to high-dimensional spatio-temporal data, with a simple scoring-rule objective that aligns training with probabilistic forecasting and unlocks few-step generation. On the SEVIR and MeteoNet benchmarks, JWS achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting performance at reduced training and inference cost. Even our smallest model remains competitive using substantially fewer parameters and more than 17x faster inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Just Weather Scoring (JWS)，一种用于降水临近预报的概率生成扩散模型。该方法直接在雷达数据空间进行单阶段端到端建模，消除了传统多阶段流程中的压缩损失和不确定性。通过结合掩码异步扩散(MAD)时间步采样方案和简单的分布式扩散模型(sDDM)训练目标，JWS在SEVIR和MeteoNet基准上实现了最优的概率预报性能，同时大幅降低了训练和推理成本（最小模型推理速度提升超17倍）。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散模型临近预报方法存在两个核心瓶颈：1）依赖多阶段训练流程（压缩模型、确定性预报等），压缩损失引入额外不确定性，确定性先验会限制分布覆盖；2）迭代去噪推理成本高。生成式扩散模型天然适合概率临近预报，但如何在保留扩散模型分布覆盖能力的同时简化流程、降低推理延迟仍是未解决的中心挑战。
AI.method: JWS包含三大核心组件：(1)像素空间端到端建模：直接对未压缩雷达数据做时空扩散，采用HDiT分层Transformer骨干网络，预测干净数据而非速度场；(2)掩码异步扩散(MAD)：在序列级中心τ̄附近采样帧间相关的时间步，保留干净上下文帧，灵活支持条件生成、填充和确定性先验条件；(3)简单分布式扩散模型(sDDM)：用CRPS与MSE的时间步依赖线性插值作为超参数无关的训练目标，替代iDDM中需调参的λ/β调度，实现少步生成且在高NFE下仍保持优异性能。
AI.result: 在SEVIR和MeteoNet两个基准上，JWS在CRPS、SSIM和RI等关键指标上均达到最优概率预报性能，训练成本比FREUD低44倍。最小模型JWS-T（9M参数）性能仍具竞争力，推理速度比FlowCast快17倍以上。JWS在零样本序列长度外推（12→36帧）和校准性（秩直方图更平、可靠性更优）方面也显著超越FlowCast、CasCast和FREUD等前作。sDDM在5/10/50 NFE下均优于MSE、纯CRPS和iDDM目标。
AI.conclusion: JWS通过端到端的像素空间扩散建模，结合任务特定的MAD时间步采样与超参数无关的分布式sDDM训练目标，极大简化了训练和推理流程，同时保持并超越了最先进概率临近预报性能。该方法无需压缩模型或确定性先验，将推理预算完全用于集成预报，能在少步推理下提供校准良好的不确定性量化，为气象从业者的实际部署提供了简单高效的解决方案。

title: DataSense-Bench: The First Step Toward an AI Scientist
comment: 25 pages. Project page: this https URL . Code: this https URL
summary: As claims about recursive self-improvement (RSI) and artificial general intelligence (AGI) proliferate, we ask a simple question: do frontier AI models have a sense of data, i.e., can they reliably select the right data for training? We introduce DataSense-Bench to study this capability through the fundamental problem of data selection and performance forecasting in machine learning. We ask AI agents to select and rank candidate training subsets that can be used to fine-tune a small LLM model. Agents are allowed to inspect the data, write and execute analysis code, and run model forward passes, but can not train the model or access the actual evaluation tasks. We then fine-tune the base model on each selected subset and evaluate its post-training performance under a standardized protocol. We instantiate the benchmark in terminal problem solving and tool use, selecting trajectories from OpenThoughts-Agent and EnvScaler and evaluating on TBLite and BFCL, respectively. We then evaluate the agents along two complementary dimensions: the post-training performance of the top-ranked subset, reflecting the ability to identify high-value training data, and ranking accuracy, reflecting the ability to predict the relative performance of the selected subsets. In our experiments, selection gains over random selection are limited; agents do not reliably rank their selected groups, and ranking ability does not hold consistently across tasks: Astra identifies the best group in all three tool-use runs but in only one of three terminal runs. Analysis of execution traces on both tasks shows that agents often use similar data signals while interpreting their training value differently.

AI.tldr: DataSense-Bench 提出首个用于评估前沿 AI 智能体"数据感"(data sense)的基准测试,要求智能体在无法实际训练或接触评估任务的情况下,选择并排序用于微调小 LLM 的训练数据子集,结果发现当前智能体的选择增益有限且排序能力不可靠。
AI.motivation: 随着递归自我改进(RSI)和通用人工智能(AGI)声称的增多,论文质疑前沿 AI 是否真正具备"数据感",即能否在训练前预判数据的训练价值。现有基准多评估端到端研究能力,缺乏对"在观察训练结果前判断实验选择价值"这一更基础能力的隔离评估。
AI.method: 构建 DataSense-Bench:CLI 智能体接收候选数据池、基础模型的推理访问权限和固定微调流程,从中选择 5 组互不相交等大小的子集并按预期训练价值排序。智能体可检查数据、执行分析代码、运行前向传播,但禁止训练或访问评估任务。提交后,基准在 Qwen3-4B 上对每组执行监督微调(SFT),并在两个下游任务上评估——终端问题解决(TBLite,使用 OpenThoughts-Agent 数据)和多轮工具使用(BFCL V3,使用 EnvScaler 数据)。通过两个互补维度评估:Top-1 子集的后训练性能(s₁)与相对随机选择的增益(Δ_random);排序准确性,包括最佳组识别准确率(A_best)和 Spearman 相关系数(S_rank)。共评估 10 个(TBLite)/6 个(BFCL)CLI 智能体,每个智能体独立运行 3 次,使用 4 小时 H100 GPU 时间预算。
AI.result: BFCL 上,所有 6 个智能体的 top-1 子集均超过随机选择(34.75%),增益仅 0.35–1.78 个百分点;DeepSeek V4 Pro 最佳(36.53%)。TBLite 上,top-1 奖励范围 11.00%–12.54%,随机选择为 11.55%,2/10 智能体低于随机基线,DeepSeek V4 Pro 最高仅领先 0.99 分。排序能力普遍较差:BFCL Spearman 系数从 -0.27 到 0.83,Astra 三次运行均识别最佳组但 TBLite 仅 1/3 成功;TBLite 相关系数更低(-0.50 到 0.30)。同一智能体的三次独立运行选择策略差异显著(例如 Kimi 在 BFCL 从拒绝损失离群值转为偏好中等损失再到偏好低损失),且智能体常使用相似数据信号但解读方式不同。
AI.conclusion: 当前前沿 AI 智能体虽能产出看似合理、数据特异的选择方案,但选择增益有限且无法可靠排序所选子集,排序能力也无法跨任务一致保持。这揭示了"产生令人信服的数据分析"与"对训练价值做出可靠判断"之间存在显著差距,表明数据感是评估 AI 科学家进展和递归自我改进能力的关键维度。论文将该差距作为未来研究的重要方向,建议扩展至 RL 后训练和新训练数据生成场景。

title: Improved Approximations for Vehicle Routing with Nonuniform Speeds
summary: We study vehicle routing with vehicles of different speeds on a complete undirected graph whose vertex set consists of a depot and a set of clients, where the distances satisfy the triangle inequality. Each vehicle has a specified speed, and if the total length traveled by a vehicle of speed $s$ is $L$, its completion time is $L/s$. In the heterogeneous traveling salesman problem (HetTSP), each vehicle executes one tour starting and ending at the depot, and the tours collectively visit all clients. The objective is to minimize the maximum completion time among the vehicles. We give a $6$-approximation algorithm for HetTSP, improving the previous $90(1+\delta)$-approximation for any fixed $\delta>0$. We also consider two versions of the heterogeneous capacitated vehicle routing problem (HetCVRP). Each client has a demand, and the vehicles have identical capacities. A vehicle may execute several tours, each starting and ending at the depot, and reload at the depot between consecutive tours; the total demand delivered on each tour cannot exceed the vehicle capacity. In the split-delivery version of HetCVRP, the demand of a client may be divided among multiple visits, possibly by different vehicles. We give a $\frac92+2\sqrt3<7.965$-approximation algorithm for this problem. In the unsplit-delivery version of HetCVRP, the entire demand of each client must be delivered in a single visit. We give a $\frac{11}{2}+3\sqrt2<9.743$-approximation algorithm, improving the previous $450(1+\delta)$-approximation for any fixed $\delta>0$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究异构车辆路径问题（车辆速度不同），针对HetTSP和HetCVRP的两种版本（拆分/非拆分配送）给出了多项式时间近似算法，显著改进了此前Gørtz等人(2016)的结果。
AI.motivation: 现实中车辆速度往往不同，但Gørtz等人(2016)给出的近似比非常高（HetTSP为90(1+δ)，HetCVRP为450(1+δ)），且即使优化其参数也仅能降至约89.43，迫切需要大幅改进这些近似保证。
AI.method: 统一算法框架：(1)按速度降序排列车辆并枚举候选makespan；(2)根据"最慢可达车辆"将客户划分为不相交的层客户集；(3)对每层用Christofides-Serdjukov算法构造回路（最小生成树+最小权完美匹配）；(4)对容量问题应用经典toursplitting方法获得可行tour；(5)拼接各层闭行走W并按服务事件顺序贪心分配给车辆。分析中利用"仓库节省"（depot saving）来平衡直接连接的代价。
AI.result: HetTSP的6-近似算法（改进自90(1+δ)）；分割配送HetCVRP的(9/2+2√3)≈7.965-近似；非分割配送HetCVRP的(11/2+3√2)≈9.743-近似（改进自450(1+δ)）。运行时间为O(n⁴k³+nk⁴)。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于"最慢可达车辆"划分客户的层结构以及Christofides-Serdjukov回路构造获得的仓库节省，本文将异构车辆路径问题的三个核心变体的近似比从数量级为几百的常数大幅降至个位数常数，是该领域的重要进展。

title: Quickest Change Detection with Diffusion-Integrated Scores
summary: Classical CUSUM relies on the log-likelihood ratio of the underlying distributions, which cannot generally be computed from finite pre- and post-change samples alone. We propose diffusion-integrated score CUSUM (DI-SCUSUM), a training-free detector. We add Gaussian noise to the samples to form two smooth density estimates and calculate their Hyvärinen scores exactly, without training a score network. For each incoming observation, we sample a diffusion time, perturb the observation, and use the importance-weighted score difference as an increment in the DI-SCUSUM recursion. Under the assumption that observations follow the fixed empirical distributions, the post-change mean increment is proportional to the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence from the smoothed post-change to the smoothed pre-change empirical distribution. We establish exponential false-alarm scaling and a first-order delay bound that, for a fixed threshold and increment scaling, is inversely proportional to the KL divergence. In the calibrated anisotropic Gaussian simulation, DI-SCUSUM nearly matches likelihood-ratio CUSUM and reduces the measured detection delay by about 91% relative to score-based CUSUM. On MNIST and Oxford-IIIT Pet, DI-SCUSUM also has lower empirical conditional detection delay than SCUSUM at comparable false-alarm levels.

AI.tldr: DI-SCUSUM 提出一种无需训练的序贯变点检测方法，通过对样本加高斯噪声形成平滑密度估计，利用 Hyvärinen 分数在扩散时间上积分，将 CUSUM 的均值增量与平滑后经验分布间的 KL 散度联系起来。在各项异性高斯仿真中几乎匹配似然比 CUSUM，相对 SCUSUM 降低约 91% 检测延迟；在 MNIST 和 Oxford-IIIT Pet 上也优于 SCUSUM。
AI.motivation: 经典 CUSUM 需要已知先验/后验分布的对数似然比，但实际场景中仅有有限样本而无法计算；现有的 SCUSUM 仅在单一扩散时间使用分数差异，导致对协方差方向加权不当，信息量低于似然比 CUSUM。因此需要一种无需训练样本、能恢复似然比信息、并提供理论保证的快速变点检测方法。
AI.method: 对预变化/后验样本加 Gaussian 噪声形成两个有限高斯混合密度，其 Hyvärinen 分数有闭式表达式。对每个新观测采样扩散时间，加噪后计算分数差，再用重要性加权 2λ/f(tₙ) 得到 zₙ^DI；通过反射 CUSUM 递归累积。在固定经验分布假设下，相对 de Bruijn 恒等式将均值增量与 KL 散度联系起来。提供指数虚警标度定理（Theorem 1）和一阶延迟界（Theorem 2）。还用 Rao-Blackwell 化和数值积分去除噪声采样方差。
AI.result: 在各项异性高斯仿真中，DI-SCUSUM 几乎匹配似然比 CUSUM（最大绝对延迟差 0.028–0.054），相对 SCUSUM 减少约 91% 的固定变化延迟；在 MNIST（3→5）和 Oxford-IIIT Pet（猫→狗）上，DI-SCUSUM 在相近虚警水平下经验条件检测延迟均低于 SCUSUM。理论分析表明，SCUSUM 在各项异性协方差下严格损失信息，而 DI-SCUSUM 通过积分恢复似然比的逆方差几何。
AI.conclusion: 扩散积分能够恢复单尺度 SCUSUM 在各项异性场景中丢失的信息，使 DI-SCUSUM 在无需训练分数网络的情况下接近似然比 CUSUM 的性能。该方法提供了基于 KL 散度的虚警和延迟理论保证，适用于基于样本的序贯变点检测。

title: SteerablePlex: Can We Steer Full-Duplex Models?
summary: Full-duplex speech models can listen and speak simultaneously, enabling natural interaction, but become increasingly difficult to control as the conversation history grows. When used as user simulators, this lack of control can cause them to deviate from prescribed scenarios and produce unreliable evaluation outcomes. We introduce SimIF-Bench (Simulator Instruction-Following Benchmark), which evaluates whether a conversational model stays within a prescribed scenario and completes multiple goals in the required order. The benchmark reveals that current open-source full-duplex models struggle to follow such constraints. We then introduce a Group Reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO)-based training recipe that enables a full-duplex model to follow textual instructions during an ongoing conversation while maintaining its turn-taking ability. By connecting the resulting SteerablePlex to an asynchronous backend language model that monitors the conversation and provides instructions when needed, we build a more controllable full-duplex user simulator that follows multi-stage constraints more reliably than existing open-source models and GPT-Realtime.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何在对话过程中对全双工（full-duplex）语音模型进行实时指令引导（在线指令跟随），以构建更可控的用户模拟器。提出 SimIF-Bench 基准、基于 GDPO 训练的 SteerablePlex 模型，以及由异步后端 LLM 监督的 Actor-Director 架构。在多阶段指令跟随、对话自然度和轮流交互方面均优于现有开源模型及 GPT-Realtime。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音模型虽然能够同时听与说、模拟真实交互，但随着对话进行会逐渐偏离预设场景，难以可靠地作为用户模拟器使用，导致评估结果不可靠。论文旨在解决全双工模型在长对话中对场景脚本指令跟随能力不足的问题。
AI.method: 1. SimIF-Bench 基准：复用 Full-Duplex-Bench v2 的 200 个分阶段场景，从话题保持、自然度、目标完成度、目标完成顺序四个维度评估用户模拟器；2. Actor-Director 架构：SteerablePlex 作为前端的 Actor 持续听与说，后端异步文本 LLM Director 基于流式 ASR 与模型文本流每 2 秒生成指令（send/wait/none）；3. 指令注入接口：通过特殊 token 将文本指令拼接进 PersonaPlex 的模型文本流；4. 基于 GDPO 的训练：联合优化目标完成、自然度、轮流交互（重叠率、接话延迟、让拍、Backchannel F1）多维奖励，使用 LoRA 在 Fisher 数据集和 2000 条合成多目标对话上进行训练。
AI.result: 1. SimIF-Bench 200 场景结果：域内训练的 SteerablePlex 在目标完成率和精确顺序完成率上均超越 GPT-Realtime 与其他开源模型（如 KAME、Raon-SpeechChat-9B），同时保持较高自然度；2. Full-Duplex-Bench 轮流交互指标：SteerablePlex 在 10 项中有 6 项优于基座 PersonaPlex，包括暂停处理、Backchannel TOR、平滑轮换 TOR、打断 TOR 等；3. 显示持续频繁的 steering 会削弱前端模型原生轮流策略（KAME 的证据），而 SteerablePlex 因显式轮流奖励缓解此问题。
AI.conclusion: 论文证实了在全双工模型运行期间通过文本指令进行"在线指令跟随"的可行性，提出了一种结合异步导演模型的可控用户模拟器框架 SteerablePlex。匹配多指令结构的域内训练对长时程、多阶段的场景控制至关重要。未来方向可包括进一步提升多指令协同、增强自然度与指令跟随的平衡。

title: SciTBERT: A family of chronologically consistent language models for scientific and technological language processing
summary: Pre-trained transformer models are increasingly being used to study scientific and technological progress. Encoders tuned to paper or patent text outperform general-purpose models on downstream classification, regression, and proximity tasks within science and technology. However, the applicability of these models for studying time-dependent or archival properties of science, technology, and their interface is limited due to lookahead and domain biases inherent to these pre-trained models. These limitations arise from training on corpora with unconstrained chronological and text source distributions. We introduce SciTBERT: a family of chronologically consistent BERT-derived language models trained on text from scientific papers, patents, and high-quality educational web text with training data cutoff dates spanning each year between 2013 and 2025. We also post-train these models in a chronologically-consistent manner using paper and patent citations, creating SciTBERT-CI model family. We find that these models generally outperform predecessor domain-specific encoder models even when training data is limited by early year restrictions in the corpus. To further investigate the extent to which this class of models can learn representations that bridge science and technology, we introduce the PatRepEval benchmark, a suite of patent-related text embedding tasks at the science-technology interface. Performance in a variety of classification, regression, and retrieval tasks spanning papers and patents highlights the importance of aligning encoder model representations with the domain distributions of their downstream tasks, and chronologically consistent encoders can match or exceed models trained without temporal constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了SciTBERT，一个由13个按年份截止（2013-2025）训练的ModernBERT衍生编码器模型组成的家族，专为科学和技术文本的时序一致表示学习而设计，并配套了引用感知的SciTBERT-CI后训练模型和新的PatRepEval基准测试。
AI.motivation: 现有的科学和技术领域预训练语言模型（如SciBERT、SPECTER2、PaECTER）在跨时间训练数据上存在"前瞻偏差"（lookahead bias）和领域偏差问题，其分词器、预训练语料和对比学习目标中可能编码了未来的语言学、科学技术信息，这使得它们不适用于研究科学技术的历史性、预测性和政策导向性问题。
AI.method: 1. 预训练：从S2ORC论文全文、Semantic Scholar摘要、USPTO专利预授权长文本和FineWeb-Edu教育网页文本中按年份截止构建语料；每个年份y∈{2013,...,2025}独立训练一个ModernBERT-base模型（149M参数），使用30%掩码率的MLM任务，并为每个年份训练独立的BPE分词器以避免未来词汇信息泄露。2. 对比后训练：在按年份截止的论文-专利联合引用图上（仅包含y年底前可观测的引用边）进行SciNCL式的邻域对比学习（InfoNCE损失，τ=0.01），得到SciTBERT-CI家族。3. PatRepEval基准：构建了27个任务的评测集，涵盖专利与论文的分类（12个）、回归（4个）和检索邻近性（11个），包含跨论文-专利边界的检索任务。
AI.result: SciTBERT-CI家族的每个年份版本在邻近性任务上的平均表现均优于所有基线模型（SPECTER2、SciBERT、SciNCL、PaECTER、ChronoBERT）；即使是最早的SciTBERT-2013-CI（仅用2013年前的文本和引用训练）也超过了所有基线在邻近性任务上的平均表现；SciTBERT-CI在SciRepEval上与最佳论文专用模型相当，在PatRepEval上匹配或超过更大的专利专用基线；分类任务的提升主要来自CPC技术分类，回归性能主要由预训练驱动；SciTBERT-2020等少数版本因分词器与数据分布的交互出现异常，但后训练可恢复性能；领域专用基线模型在跨域任务上性能显著下降（如PaECTER在SciRepEval回归任务上仅为22.1，比最佳SciTBERT低21%）。
AI.conclusion: 强制执行时序一致性几乎不带来性能损失——SciTBERT-CI家族在邻近性任务上全面超越基线，在分类和回归任务上与最佳专用模型相当；论文-专利联合预训练产生了强大的跨域表示，而领域专用模型在其非专业领域表现退化；引用感知的后训练主要改善邻近性和技术分类，回归性能主要由预训练驱动；这些模型使历史性、预测性和政策导向性的科学技术研究能够使用反映文档产出时知识分布的"时间点"表示；模型和PatRepEval基准已公开发布（PatRepEval采用CC BY-NC 4.0许可证）。

title: Verification with Transfer: Exact Information Frontiers and Their Price in Calls
comment: 46 pages, of which 8 pages main text. The Lean 4 formalization is in the ancillary files
summary: A verifier that accepts or rejects whole answers reveals little: under a flat prior over $k$-bit answers, zero error needs $2^k-1$ verifications. The usual remedy is to solve related source tasks, either all first, as a curriculum does, or interleaved with verification. We price this remedy in information and in calls. With an exact verifier, the least causal information that any interleaving of source calls and $n$ verifications needs to succeed with probability $s$ is a list rate-distortion function, attained by one observation before any verification. It lower-bounds the expected number of binary source calls, which designed sources meet within $1+\log_25$ calls for unique answers and within a logarithmic term in general, where no additive constant suffices. With an exact verifier and fixed sources, moving every call before the first verification preserves all hard caps on calls, although interleaving can save unboundedly many expected calls; under a noisy verifier, source-first protocols can lose unbounded factors in information and in error. For linear banks over $\mathbb{F}_2$, optimal accuracy has a closed form, and after a polynomial-time reduction the budget profile is computable in time $2^{O(h^2)}\operatorname{poly}(J,k+h)$ for $J$ sources and nuisance dimension $h$. In these banks, for zero error under a hard cap, the calls beyond the rounded-up information price are exactly those spent on nuisance. Every numbered result apart from two clauses about the planner is machine-checked in Lean 4, assuming two published results. Used as a ruler, the frontier shows a small transformer using all delivered bits at latent dimension $5$ and none at $11$ within fixed training budgets; in a test with predictions recorded before training, low XOR degree of the target bits did not suffice for their use.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究验证学习（verification learning）中"迁移"（transfer）的精确信息论前沿：当学习者可以通过求解相关源任务来辅助目标验证时，定价所需的信息与调用次数。核心结论是：交错执行源调用与验证时所需的因果辅助信息等于列表率失真函数（list rate–distortion function），且仅需在验证前进行一次观察即可达到；在精确验证下，源优先（source-first）协议在硬调用上限下不损失性能，但在期望调用次数或噪声验证器下可能损失任意多。论文还为线性源任务库提供了闭式最优精度和可计算预算配置算法，并利用此框架作为"标尺"衡量小型Transformer实际利用了多少交付的信息。
AI.motivation: 验证器（如RLVR中的奖励模型）仅接受或拒绝完整答案，揭示的信息极少：在平坦先验下，对k位答案实现零错误需要2^k−1次验证。解决方法是引入相关源任务（curriculum/autocurricula），但何时调用源任务、以何种顺序与验证交错仍是未决问题。本文旨在为这一"验证+迁移"问题建立精确的信息论与调用复杂度理论。
AI.method: 论文采用信息论框架建模学习者面对潜在世界Θ、先验q、目标验证器f_θ和可选辅助源调用K_t的过程。核心工具：(1) 定义因果辅助信息B_aux（带验证反馈的directed information）；(2) 通过选择性信道换测（selective-channel change of measure）建立反定理——精确验证下反向证明中验证项相消，故不被计入；(3) 列表率失真函数ℛ_n(q,s)刻画最优信息代价，单次前置观察即可达到；(4) 对线性任务库建立相对广义Hamming权重层级关系，给出闭式最优精度定理9和商空间规划器（QSP）定理10，可在2^{O(h²)}poly(J,k+h)时间内计算预算配置；(5) 用两作者实现+Lean 4机器验证保证形式化正确性；(6) 神经实验以小型Transformer作为"被测解码器"，用理论前沿作为标尺衡量其利用交付信息的效率。
AI.result: (1) 信息前沿：交错协议的最少因果辅助信息等于列表率失真函数ℛ_n(q,s)（定理2）；(2) 调用前沿：对唯一答案，期望二元调用数≤ℛ_n(q,s)+1+log₂5（定理4），且不存在更小的加性常数；对一般接受集，调用数与信息价格之差可为Θ(log H_K)（命题5）；(3) 源优先充分性：固定源+精确验证下，将所有源调用移到首次验证前不改变硬上限性能（定理7）；(4) 噪声验证器下源优先可损失任意因子信息/误差（命题8，定理13）；(5) 线性库闭式：最优精度=min{1,(n+1)2^{-k+ρ_b}}（定理9），零错误硬上限下超出舍入信息价格的开销恰等于优化子集在nuisance方向上的调用（推论11）；(6) 神经测量：在d=5时小型Transformer完全在信息前沿上，d=6时84%，d=7时49%，d=8时14%，d=11时0%；XOR degree不能完全解释这一下降。
