AI.conclusion: 论文为"验证+迁移"学习建立了精确的信息论与调用复杂度框架。核心启示：(1) 在精确验证+硬上限+固定源条件下，curriculum（源优先）不损失性能，交错执行的收益仅在期望值或噪声情形出现；(2) 信息价格（率失真函数）几乎紧致刻画所需调用数，唯一答案情形仅差O(1)；(3) 线性任务库中超出信息价格的调用恰为学习nuisance方向的成本；(4) 作为"标尺"，理论前沿揭示小型Transformer在d≥6后严重未利用源信息（d=11时为0），且不能用XOR degree单独解释——这为理解学习验证器的能力与局限提供了量化基准。所有编号结论（除两条planner子句外）均经Lean 4机器验证。

title: When Has a Bayesian Neural Network Sampled Enough? Adaptive Inference Time with Statistical Guarantees
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: E-Values: From Statistics to ML
summary: Bayesian neural network predictions are commonly approximated using a fixed number of Monte Carlo samples per input, without controlling the resulting error that comes from this finite sample. We propose the use of confidence sequences to dynamically determine how many samples are needed while maintaining statistical guarantees. We consider several ways in which predictive probabilities are used, including identifying the most likely class, approximating the full predictive distribution, and resolving probability-threshold decisions. Sampling stops once the corresponding decision can be made with the desired guarantee. Experiments show that the method allocates the computational budget efficiently, assigning more samples to ambiguous inputs than to easy inputs while preserving reliable decisions and reducing overall latency relative to a fixed Monte Carlo budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于置信序列（Confidence Sequences）的自适应贝叶斯神经网络推理方法，可在保证统计有效性的前提下动态决定每个输入所需的蒙特卡洛采样数量，从而提高计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有BNN推理对所有输入使用固定数量的MC采样，既无法控制估计误差，又对简单输入浪费算力、对困难输入采样不足。需要一种输入级、任务自适应的采样策略，同时提供统计保证。
AI.method: 1) 利用Denoodt et al. [4]的多变量置信序列（bounding-box CS，基于hedged capital）追踪预测概率向量；2) 对三种预测任务设计anytime-valid停止规则：类选择（τ_cls）、完整分布逼近（τ_dist）、阈值决策（τ_q）；3) 通过时间交叉和单纯形约束进一步收紧区间。
AI.result: 模拟三分类问题中，自适应规则在每个输入上都正确恢复最优类，约20%输入达到上限未解决。CIFAR-100+ResNet-18+全参数Laplace近似中，平均仅用48.6个样本即达到99.8%与参考BMA的一致性，比固定136样本快2.24×，比200样本快3.21×，且CS开销仅0.055s。
AI.conclusion: 置信序列为BNN推理提供了具有统计保证的自适应采样框架，能显著降低整体延迟同时保持决策可靠性，是anytime-valid推理的一种实用方案。

title: ISBO: Scalable Spatio-Temporal Bayesian Optimization with Log Gaussian Cox Process Models via the INLA-SPDE Approach
summary: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is a popular method for efficiently optimizing expensive black-box objectives. However, BO utilizing standard Gaussian Processes is ill-suited for doubly stochastic Cox Processes that are often used in spatio-temporal problem spaces. We introduce INLA-SPDE Spatio-Temporal Bayesian Optimization (ISBO): the first scalable BO framework for spatio-temporal data, that models the log-intensity with a Log-Gaussian Cox Process(LGCP) and performs inference via Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation and Stochastic Partial Differential Equations (INLA-SPDE) approach. Using a Matern field on meshes yields a sparse Gaussian Markov Random Field, where INLA provides fast and accurate posterior inference throughout sequential optimization. ISBO stably locates high-intensity regions and the peak of the latent intensity with minimal evaluations. A time-varying Upper Confidence Bound acquisition with masking avoids revisits, while penalized-complexity priors regularize early rounds. Experiments on synthetic and real-world spatio-temporal datasets show accurate peak discovery, intensity recovery, and substantial speedups over an RKHS-based baseline, positioning ISBO as a practical choice for BO with point-process data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ISBO框架，首次将INLA-SPDE方法与对数高斯Cox过程(LGCP)结合，实现可扩展的时空贝叶斯优化。核心创新包括：基于Matérn场和现代INLA推断的稀疏GMRF代理模型、隐尺度时变UCB采集函数、区域掩码避免重复查询以及惩罚复杂度(PC)先验正则化。在合成数据和华盛顿特区枪支犯罪、波尔图出租车轨迹等真实数据上验证了峰值发现、强度恢复的准确性和相对基线(RKHS方法)的显著加速。
AI.motivation: 标准贝叶斯优化采用高斯过程代理，但不适合双重随机的Cox过程（时空点过程数据），因为观测返回的是局部区域内的点事件而非标量函数值。现有的Cox过程BO方法（如RKHS方法）存在运行间不稳定、对初始化和超参数敏感、可扩展性差等问题，亟需一种可扩展且稳定的BO框架来处理时空点过程数据。
AI.method: 方法包含两大组件：(1) 可扩展LGCP代理——结合离格SPDE建模（保留精确事件位置）、现代INLA推断（线性预测器不再作为潜变量场的显式组件，维度固定为1+m+n_β，不随事件数增长）、PC先验正则化Matérn-SPDE超参数；(2) 隐尺度BO——在潜在高斯尺度上定义时变UCB采集函数（κ_t线性递减），采用区域掩码避免重复查询，定义基于区域的最优遗憾和简单遗憾度量。理论证明：(i) exp变换保持最大化点不变（Theorem 1），(ii) 在固定SPDE网格下，INLA重拟合时间恒定（Theorem 2）。
AI.result: 在一维合成数据上，ISBO在第14-15次迭代达到零简单遗憾，优于所有消融版本（标准先验、标准UCB）和RKHS基线。在华盛顿特区犯罪数据上，ISBO实现2.27秒的端到端拟合（基线35.74秒），简单遗憾更快收敛至零，累计遗憾更低且置信区间更窄。在波尔图出租车轨迹数据上，INLA-SPDE推理时间在200-55,000事件范围内几乎恒定，优于Nyström基线和SCAMPR的Laplace/变分近似方法。消融实验证实PC先验和时变UCB均对鲁棒性和峰值定位有贡献。
AI.conclusion: ISBO是首个可扩展的时空点过程贝叶斯优化框架，利用INLA-SPDE实现了：(1) 相对于观测事件数的恒定重拟合时间；(2) 在合成和真实数据上一致的峰值发现和强度恢复；(3) 相对现有RKHS基线在准确性和计算效率上的实质性提升。PC先验在数据稀缺的早期BO轮次中提供关键正则化，时变UCB调度促进稳定收敛。基于区域的查询和掩码机制自然适配点过程观测，使ISBO成为资源受限场景下点过程BO的实用选择。

title: DiffuPlex: Accelerating Full-Duplex Spoken Dialog Models via Rolling Masked Diffusion
comment: 41 pages, 11 figures, 18 tables. Preprint, under review. Project page: this https URL
summary: Recent full-duplex spoken dialog models enable simultaneous listening and speaking, but fine-grained models still advance their backbone autoregressively at every interaction frame. We introduce DiffuPlex, a rolling masked diffusion framework that reduces this sequential computation by predicting multiple future user and assistant frames in a single backbone wake. DiffuPlex consumes only a confident prefix of each predicted future while interaction continues at the original frame rate. As user speech arrives, it checks the corresponding user predictions and, when the interaction diverges, preserves already played assistant content while revising only the unplayed future. We consider two inference policies over the same predictor: DiffuPlex-LISTEN consumes multiple future frames when they predict assistant silence, whereas DiffuPlex-SPEAK can also consume predicted assistant speech. Across full-duplex interaction and spoken-language evaluations, DiffuPlex substantially reduces sequential backbone computation while largely preserving interaction behavior and general capability. DiffuPlex-LISTEN and DiffuPlex-SPEAK achieve $1.46\times$ and $1.59\times$ deployment-path wall-clock speedups and $1.61\times$ and $1.80\times$ Core LM speedups, with all measured backbone invocations completing within the 80ms interaction interval. Human evaluation shows that LISTEN preserves speech naturalness and conversational quality, while SPEAK retains conversational quality with some degradation in speech naturalness.

AI.tldr: DiffuPlex提出了一种基于滚动掩码扩散的框架，用于加速全双工语音对话模型的推理。通过单次主干前向传播预测多个未来用户和助手帧，仅消费置信前缀，并在新用户输入与预测不符时仅修订未播放的未来，从而将串行主干计算量减少1.46×–1.80×，同时保持交互行为和对话质量。
AI.motivation: 现有全双工语音对话模型（如Moshi、PersonaPlex）虽然支持同时听与说，但仍以自回归方式在每个80ms交互帧调用主干网络，导致顺序计算开销大。然而对话研究表明大多数时间是单方说话，且响应计划可提前进行，这表明多个未来帧可被并行预测。
AI.method: DiffuPlex的核心方法是"滚动掩码扩散"：(1) 掩码未来预测——每次主干唤醒时用学习的MASK令牌替换不可用的未来用户/助手流输入，预测未来W=16帧的块；(2) 滚动草稿生成——基于置信度阈值保留连续前缀，两种策略（Listen仅在PAD状态消费，Speak允许所有状态）；(3) 用户感知修订——通过比较存储的用户预测分布与实际到达的用户token，使用近似后验概率比对决定是否丢弃未播放的未来并重新唤醒主干。仅训练流特定MASK嵌入和未来门控LoRA适配器，主干冻结并通过自蒸馏训练。
AI.result: 在Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0/v1.5上，DiffuPlex-Listen和Speak分别将每次主干唤醒推进1.91和2.23帧，接近自回归主干行为。部署路径墙钟加速1.46×和1.59×，Core LM加速1.61×和1.80×，所有主干调用均在80ms内完成。Listen保留语音自然度（NMOS 3.92 vs 3.93）和对话质量（DMOS 4.08 vs 4.09），Speak保留对话质量但自然度略降（NMOS 3.54）。通用语音能力（VoiceBench、OpenAudioBench）大体保持不变。相比延迟执行基线（PAD/Silero/Smart Turn），DiffuPlex更好地保持了全双工交互行为。
AI.conclusion: DiffuPlex展示了通过预测多个未来帧来显著降低全双工语音对话中顺序计算开销的可行性，同时保留交互质量和响应能力。分析发现置信度保留和修订机制在控制未来消费方面起互补作用，并识别缺失的同帧语义条件（cb0）作为深层未来语音退化的原因。这为更计算高效的全双工实时生成提供了可行路径。未来工作包括联合学习预测、保留和修订机制，以及改进未来音频建模以支持更长助手语音段消费。

title: VibeEdit: Image Editing with Canvas Instructions
summary: In text-guided image editing, describing the desired change is often straightforward, but identifying the intended object or region can be cumbersome, especially when several objects look alike. We introduce a new image editing interface that lets users place spatial marks and optional short notes directly on the image. Together, these annotations form a canvas instruction that specifies where to edit and what to change. Our editor, VibeEdit, follows these instructions to perform object addition, removal, replacement, attribute modification, and movement without a separate text prompt. We construct 1.55 million source-target edit pairs with object masks and structured edit descriptions, from which we render canvas instructions during training. We adapt Qwen-Image-Edit with layer-decoupled conditioning that separately encodes source images and canvas instructions for image editing. We train the model with region-weighted supervised fine-tuning, followed by rubric-guided reinforcement learning to improve edit completion, local edit quality, and preservation of unedited regions. We evaluate VibeEdit on an independently constructed, human-curated benchmark of 419 cases emphasizing target selection among similar objects. VibeEdit achieves a VLM rubric score of 79.9 and an outside-region PSNR of 32.8 dB, compared with 67.4 and 24.0 dB for FireRed, the highest-scoring text-instructed baseline in our evaluation.

AI.tldr: VibeEdit是一个图像编辑框架，提出"画布指令"(canvas instruction)交互范式：用户直接在图像上标注空间标记（圆圈、涂鸦、箭头）和可选短文本注释，无需单独输入文本指令。模型基于Qwen-Image-Edit构建，采用分层解耦条件编码、区域加权监督微调和评分引导的强化学习，在419例人工基准上达到VLM评分79.9和区域外PSNR 32.8 dB，超越所有基线。
AI.motivation: 文本引导的图像编辑中，描述修改内容容易，但当场景中存在多个相似对象时，精确指明目标对象往往繁琐且依赖冗长的位置描述。需要一种更直观的空间定位方式将编辑意图与目标对象直接关联。
AI.method: 1）画布指令交互界面：圆圈指定编辑区域，箭头表示移动，涂鸦表示删除，附近附短文本说明期望内容；3）数据构建：1.55M源-目标编辑对，覆盖增加、删除、属性修改、替换、移动五种操作；4）模型架构：基于Qwen-Image-Edit+扩散因果连接；6）训练：先区域加权监督微调（λ=1.5，mask膨胀50像素）保留干净源参考，再用DiffusionNFT进行评分引导强化学习；5）奖励设计：编辑完成度、外部保持性、本地编辑质量三组评分+PSNR惩罚。
AI.result: VibeEdit在419例人工构建基准（强调相似对象目标选择）上：VLM评分79.9%，区域外PSNR 32.8 dB；视觉语言模型选择最优去除设计为"画圈+涂鸦+移除文本"；评分组成中编辑完成+外部保持+本地质量三者结合效果最佳；评分裁判与人类标注一致性93%，最优变体使用Attention+Modulation LoRA。VibeEdit在5种编辑类型上均超越所有基线。
AI.conclusion: 画布指令作为文本提示的互补交互范式，有效解决了相似对象场景下的目标选择歧义问题。分层解耦条件编码+区域加权监督+评分引导强化学习三阶段训练策略有效平衡了编辑完成度与源图像保持，为空间直观的图像编辑提供了新的解决方案。

title: From Prompting to Composing: A Spatial Canvas Interface for Poster Generation
comment: Project page: this https URL GitHub: this https URL
summary: Text prompting is an indirect interface for poster generation, requiring users to encode inherently two-dimensional composition intent into a one-dimensional sequence of words. We introduce a Spatial Canvas Interface that enables users to directly compose generation intent in space through four complementary binding types: semantic, identity, text, and pixel, together with Text Specifications for individual elements and global appearance. Based on this interface, we develop Compo, a poster generation model adapted from a pretrained image editing model to understand Spatial Canvas inputs and Text Specifications. Compo supports both direct inference, where users explicitly construct the canvas, and agentic mode, where a high-level request is automatically translated into a planned Spatial Canvas. To train Compo, we develop a scalable pipeline that automatically constructs supervision data for different binding types and their combinations, enabling efficient adaptation without training a specialized poster generator from scratch. We further introduce a benchmark that evaluates adherence to individual binding types and their joint composition. Experiments show that Compo achieves stronger compositional controllability than both general-purpose image generation models and dedicated poster generation systems while maintaining high visual quality. By decoupling intent specification from visual generation, our work shifts poster generation from prompting toward composing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Spatial Canvas Interface和Compo模型，将海报生成从文本提示（一维）转变为空间构图（二维），通过四种绑定类型（语义、身份、文本、像素）实现更精确的组合控制。
AI.motivation: 文本提示是一维序列，难以表达海报固有的二维组合意图（主体位置、文字布局、身份保持等），且现有方法在参考图驱动与布局控制结合上存在局限。
AI.method: 1) Spatial Canvas Interface：四种绑定类型（Semantic/Identity/Text/Pixel）+ Text Specifications；2) Compo模型：基于预训练图像编辑模型（LongCat/Qwen-Image-Edit），用LoRA适配MMDiT；3) Compo-200K数据生成管线：LLM规划+多模型渲染+SAM-3分割+OCR；4) 两阶段训练：监督训练+DiffusionNFT强化学习（三类奖励：文本、实例相似度、布局）；5) 两种推理模式：直接构图与Agent模式。
AI.result: Compo在四种绑定指标（Pixel/Identity/Semantic/Text Binding）上均优于通用文图生成模型（如Qwen-Image-Edit、HiDream）和专用海报生成模型（PosterMaker、CreatiDesign、PosterOmni），平均得分约0.75，文本渲染句子准确率达94%；RL后训练带来一致提升；500样本基准测试。
AI.conclusion: 将意图指定与视觉生成解耦，使海报生成从"提示"转向"构图"，在组合可控性上达到SOTA，同时保持高视觉质量。

title: Training on the Future: A Delay-Aware Audit of Test-Time Adaptation for Time-Series Forecasting
comment: 34 pages, 9 figures. Code and cached results: this https URL
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) methods for time-series forecasting update a deployed model, or a small adapter around it, from incoming ground truth. But the label of an $H$-step forecast exists only $H$ steps later, and real data pipelines add further delay. We build a leakage-free harness in which the label of forecast origin $s$ is released for updates only at step $s+d$ with $d \ge H$, and enforce this rule inside the released code of four recent TTA methods (TAFAS, COSA, PETSA and DynaTTA), run on their own backbones and checkpoints across five benchmarks (ETTm1, ETTh2, Weather, Electricity and Traffic). As references we add two closed-form correctors: a bank of recursive least squares (RLS) filters combined by a per-coordinate median, with no tunable hyperparameters and 56 microseconds per step on the 7-channel streams, and an ELF-style linear corrector. Under causal delayed labels the picture is asymmetric. On ETTm1 every audited method genuinely adapts, yet the RLS bank still beats three of the four at a fraction of their cost; only DynaTTA beats the bank, only at the minimum causal delay, and at roughly 2,500 times the per-update cost; the ELF-style corrector beats all four. On the other four datasets, the largest statistically significant improvement any published method achieves over its own frozen checkpoint is half a percent, on all four at least one published method is significantly worse than the frozen model at the minimum causal delay, and on drift-heavy ETTh2 longer label delays make every adapter that separates from the frozen model, ours included, significantly harmful. Leaky next-step updates inflate the apparent gains of simple adapters by up to 110%, and the backbone training recipe moves frozen online error by up to a factor of 25, more than any adaptation effect we measure. We release the harness, integration patches and all cached runs.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文对时间序列预测中的测试时适应（TTA）方法进行了延迟感知的审计研究。作者构建了一个无泄漏的评估框架，在因果延迟标签下测试了四种近期TTA方法（TAFAS、COSA、PETSA、DynaTTA），并提出了一种基于递归最小二乘（RLS）滤波器组的闭式校正器作为参考基线。研究发现闭式校正器在多数数据集上与这些方法持平或更优，且计算成本低2-4个数量级，仅在ETTm1上一个数据集DynaTTA有显著优势但代价高昂。
AI.motivation: 现有的TTA方法评估存在标签泄漏问题：H步预测的标签在H步后才可用，但许多方法在评估时使用了未来未成熟的窗口进行更新，相当于"在未来的数据上训练"。此外，真实数据流水线还存在额外的延迟（测量、验证、ETL等），这些延迟从未被作为实验变量纳入考量。作者旨在将这些延迟问题显式化，建立因果感知的评估协议。
AI.method: 方法包括三个核心组件：(1) 延迟参数化的标签释放协议——标签仅在s+d步释放，其中d≥H为最小因果延迟，d=1为泄漏协议；(2) RLS-Bank——由6个具有不同遗忘因子λ的递归最小二乘滤波器加一个直通专家组成，通过各维度坐标中位数合并，避免了反馈驱动选择器在延迟下的失败；(3) ELF风格闭式校正器作为第二参考。在5个标准基准（ETTm1、ETTh2、Weather、Electricity、Traffic）上审计了TAFAS、COSA、PETSA和DynaTTA四种TTA方法，使用circular moving-block bootstrap进行统计显著性检验。
AI.result: 主要结果呈现四个关键发现：(1) 在因果延迟下评估结果极不对称——仅在ETTm1上所有审计方法真正适应，RLS-Bank击败其中三种方法且成本仅为其一小部分；仅DynaTTA在最小因果延迟下击败RLS-Bank，但每次更新成本约高2500倍。(2) 在其余四个数据集上，任何已发布方法对自身冻结检查点的最大显著改进仅为0.5%，且在所有四个数据集上至少有一种已发布方法在最小因果延迟下显著劣于冻结模型。(3) 泄漏的下一阶段更新可使简单适配器的表面增益膨胀高达110%；骨干网络训练方案本身可使冻结在线错误变化达25倍，超过任何适应效应。(4) ELF风格校正器在大多数情况下优于RLS-Bank，但仅限于窄通道流。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出结论：在因果、延迟感知评估下，正确配置的闭式校正器为已发布的TTA方法设定了一个标准，在五个数据集中仅在一个数据集（ETTm1上的DynaTTA在最小因果延迟下）被超过，且即便如此其成本约高2500倍，ELF风格校正器仍领先。论文提出了五项评估TTA的实践规则，包括从不更新未成熟窗口、报告持久性和冻结模型基线、包含闭式校正器作为强制基线、报告适应成本以及报告骨干网络训练方案。最终结论是：需要重新校准的不是方法本身，而是评估实践。

title: ReSI: Recursive Safety Improvement toward Resistant and Resilient AI
summary: Recursive self-improvement, the participation of AI systems in improving their own capabilities, is beginning to move from theoretical prospect to practice, posing both challenges and opportunities for safety alignment. Models evolve through frequent updates, and their safety alignment requires continual adaptation to each new checkpoint. Meanwhile, with evolving red-teaming methods exposing new vulnerabilities, safety improvement for each checkpoint needs to mitigate exposed vulnerabilities and generalize to risks not yet revealed. Following R$^2$AI, we term these goals resistance to known threats and resilience to unforeseen risks. Recursive self-improvement, in turn, inspires an approach to both goals: safety alignment could likewise advance through successive rounds of evaluation and update. We therefore introduce ReSI, a recursive safety improvement framework that implements this approach through automated research. In each round, ReSI applies diverse red-teaming methods to identify vulnerabilities in the current target model, develops training recipes, and promotes the update with the largest safety gain among those passing a Pareto gate on capability retention as the next target model. Across four dense and mixture-of-experts models, ReSI matches or exceeds evaluated frontier models on in-distribution and out-of-distribution safety benchmarks, and outperforms alignment baselines on nearly all safety evaluations while largely preserving general capabilities. In particular, ReSI reduces the mean X-Teaming attack success rate across the four models from 86.01% to 31.45%, well below GPT-5.6-Luna's leading frontier result of 56.69%, indicating stronger resilience to attacks unseen during training. These findings support recursive safety improvement as a practical path toward resistant and resilient AI.

AI.tldr: ReSI提出一种递归式安全改进框架，通过自动化研究在每一轮中应用多样化红队攻击识别漏洞、开发训练配方，并依据帕累托门控选择安全增益最大的更新作为下一轮目标模型。在四种密集与混合专家模型上，该方法在分布内与分布外安全基准上均匹配或超越前沿模型，并在几乎所有安全评估中优于对齐基线，同时大幅保留通用能力。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统递归自改进从理论走向实践，模型频繁更新且红队方法持续暴露新漏洞，传统静态安全对齐难以应对。需要一种能够同时实现对已知威胁的抗性（resistance）与对未知风险的韧性（resilience）的持续安全改进机制。
AI.method: ReSI是一个三阶段递归框架：(1) 红队评估——使用DARWIN、JailbreakSkill、MAGIC等多样化方法探测当前目标模型M_t的漏洞，收集成功攻击作为训练信号；(2) 试点筛选——在低预算试验中评估攻击源与对齐方法（SInternal批评SFT、A3风格响应SFT、AlphaAlign安全GRPO）的组合，通过条件扩展探测筛选至多K个候选配方；(3) 全规模精炼——对筛选配方执行完整训练，依据反馈触发S1-S4精炼技能（攻击源组合、有害-良性配对、效用保留、SFT后安全GRPO），并通过帕累托门控（要求安全增益>0、良性合规与指令跟随相对M_0下降不超过ε）选择合格更新作为下一轮目标。搜索空间Ω_t联合涵盖攻击数据α、对齐方法m、数据混合λ与超参数h四个维度。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.6-27B、Ministral-3-14B-Reasoning-2512（密集模型）及DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731、Safin-1 (35B-A3B)（MoE模型）四个模型上：分布内安全方面，WildJailbreak与HarmBench ASR均落入或低于前沿模型范围，几乎在所有比较中优于A3并匹配或超越MAGIC；分布外韧性方面，H-CoT ASR从72-100%降至0-18%，X-Teaming四个模型平均ASR从86.01%降至31.45%，低于GPT-5.6-Luna的56.69%，优于所有评估的前沿模型；通用能力方面，GPQA-Diamond、MMLU-Pro、IFEval及XS-Test良性合规率大体保留。
AI.conclusion: 递归安全改进作为实现抗性与韧性AI的实用路径得到验证。ReSI通过自动化研究在每个模型检查点上选择、组合并精炼对齐策略，从已发现漏洞中学习的同时检查既有行为回归。安全性向未见攻击策略的泛化支持了该方法的价值。未来工作可扩展至更新精炼技能本身，将递归从目标模型延伸至改进过程。

title: Language Models as AI Research World Models
summary: AI research agents automate the cycle of proposing, implementing, and evaluating experiments, opening a path toward recursive self-improvement. Yet their ability to propose experiments outpaces their capacity to execute them in real environments, making outcome prediction a key capability for sustained self-improvement under limited experimental budgets. We investigate language models as Research World Models (RWMs), which predict the outcomes of candidate interventions across research environments. Our evaluation draws on over 2,600 experimental records from nine research environments spanning pretraining, post-training, and inference, representing more than 171,000 H100 GPU-hours of experimentation. Research knowledge acquired from real experimental experience improves RWM predictions of unseen interventions within the same environment (Spearman +0.27), and can be reused across environments. For example, using only pretraining experience from OLMo3, Marin, and Nanochat, an RWM reduces selection regret in the Qwen3 environment by 78% compared with zero-experience setting. These benefits extend to multi-round Autoresearch under a fixed selection budget: RWMs with in-env and cross-env research knowledge increase the best gain achieved by 15.8% and 11.6%, respectively. Ablations across 13 language models used as RWMs show that adding research knowledge can improve intervention ranking more than changing models or increasing reasoning effort alone. These findings support language models as RWMs and motivate accumulating experimental data for future RWM training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并系统验证了"研究世界模型"（Research World Model, RWM）的概念，即将大语言模型用于预测AI研究中候选实验干预的执行结果。基于9个研究环境、2,653条实验记录（共17.1万H100 GPU小时）的实证，证明了真实实验经验不仅可以提升同环境内的预测能力，还可跨环境迁移，显著提升实验选择与多轮自主研究的效率。
AI.motivation: AI研究代理（research agents）虽能快速生成大量候选实验方案，但在有限计算预算下，无法逐一执行。预测实验结果的能力成为在有限预算下实现递归自我提升的关键瓶颈。因此需要一种能在执行前预测干预效果的模型，以辅助资源分配。
AI.method: 1) 形式化RWM：定义环境E_τ（参考模型、数据、配置、预算、评估协议）、干预a（相对参考的代码/配置变更），RWM预测执行后的增益g。2) 利用LLM作为RWM：冻结参数，通过上下文学习（in-context learning）将序列化后的环境描述、干预及历史实验记录作为输入，要求模型输出增益中位数。3) 评估设置：区分无历史（W_0）、同环境历史（W_in-env）、跨环境历史（W_cross-env）三种条件。4) 评估指标：MAE、Spearman秩相关、Regret@3、NDCG@3、nAULC。5) 与kNN回归、岭回归基线对比。6) 对13种LLM backbone和5种推理强度进行消融。7) 多轮Autoresearch评估（OLMo3-100M，8轮，128个候选，预算24次选择）。
AI.result: 1) 同环境预测：5个环境平均Spearman从0.506提升至0.774（+0.27），RWM在所有环境均优于kNN和岭回归。2) 跨环境预测：5个自回归预训练目标环境平均Spearman从0.628提升至0.729；仅用OLMo3、Marin、Nanochat的预训练经验，可使Qwen3环境的选择遗憾减少78%。3) 实验选择：同环境知识平均减少Regret@3达58.2%；跨环境知识宏平均减少Regret@3达52.2%；NDCG@3在所有环境均提升。4) 多轮Autoresearch：同环境与跨环境知识分别使最终最佳增益提升15.8%和11.6%。5) 消融研究：13个LLM backbone的Spearman无知识时为[-0.362, 0.621]，加入知识后为[0.638, 0.896]——最弱模型加知识也超过最强模型无知识；推理强度从LOW升至MAX仅使Spearman从0.609升至0.648，而加入知识（LOW）可提升至0.892。6) 预测成本：评分16个候选约$6.3，仅为一次典型实验成本（$127）的约5%。
AI.conclusion: 1) 大语言模型可作为有效的RWM，预测实验干预的增益。2) 真实实验经验不仅服务于其产生的环境，还可通过上下文学习跨环境迁移，形成可复用的研究知识。3) 研究知识对预测的提升作用超过更换模型或提升推理强度，说明当前RWM的瓶颈在于缺乏相关实验数据，而非模型能力或推理深度。4) 这些结果支持积累大规模多样化实验数据以训练专用RWM，使研究代理能在有限预算下更高效地推进AI研究。5) 未来工作包括：训练基于多样化实验记录的RWM、平衡即时改进与知识获取、评估研究系统的总成本（含数据获取与推理）。

title: La-Ribo: RNA Co-Design via Geometry-Latent Flow Matching
summary: RNA function arises from the coupling of nucleotide sequence and three-dimensional structure, motivating their joint design. Coordinating global folding with nucleotide-level detail remains challenging under limited structural supervision. We introduce La-Ribo, a generative framework for RNA sequence-structure co-design via geometry-latent flow matching. La-Ribo retains a sparse phosphate-sugar--base scaffold and encodes nucleotide identity and local conformation in residue-wise latents. A shared flow network generates both jointly, and an RNA-specific decoder then reconstructs all heavy atoms. To expand supervision, we construct a quality-controlled corpus of 168,561 RNA structures, integrating experimental data with predictions from three folding models, including 10,631 MSA-supported structures generated in this work. La-Ribo improves designability and codesignability over the evaluated baselines across sampling budgets and two refolding models, and the same prior supports scaffold-conditioned inverse folding without additional training.

AI.tldr: La-Ribo 提出了一种用于 RNA 序列-结构协同设计的几何-潜在流匹配生成框架，采用稀疏磷酸-糖-碱基锚点与残基潜变量相结合的表示，并构建了包含 168,561 个 RNA 结构的质量控制语料库，在多种评估指标上优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: RNA 功能取决于核苷酸序列与三维结构的耦合，但现有方法难以在有限结构监督条件下协调全局折叠与核苷酸级别细节的联合设计。传统方法将序列生成与结构生成分开处理，而 RNA 实验结构数量远少于蛋白质，需要补充预测结构但缺乏统一的质量控制。
AI.method: La-Ribo 采用几何-潜在流匹配框架：(1) 保留 P/C4'/糖苷 N 三个稀疏几何锚点作为骨架，用残基级 16 维潜变量编码核苷酸身份和局部构象；(2) 通过结构化自编码器学习骨架到糖环帧的变换以重建重原子；(3) 共享流网络以模态独立的时间调度联合生成骨架与潜变量；(4) 构建了 168,561 个结构的质量控制语料库（含 10,631 个新生成的 MSA 支持结构）；(5) 同一训练先验可直接用于骨架条件逆折叠而无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在无条件生成任务上，La-Ribo-Tri 在 200 步时严格可设计性达到 39.11±2.12%，超过最强基线 RiboFlow-Mix (27.61%) 超过 11 个百分点；严格协同设计性达到 32.06±0.75%。在骨架条件逆折叠任务上，La-Ribo-Tri 在 1,002 个实验验证目标上取得最高的 best-of-eight 严格成功率 (14.84%) 和 scTM (0.313)，无需任何条件训练。使用 OpenDDE 替代 RhoFold 评估时优势依然存在。局部几何分布与实验结构高度一致（C4' 距离、角度、二面角的 JSD ≤0.008 比特）。
AI.conclusion: La-Ribo 通过稀疏骨架与残基潜变量的耦合以及共享几何-潜在流，有效实现了 RNA 序列-结构联合设计，并在数据扩展和表示改进上均带来显著提升。同一先验可零成本复用于逆折叠场景，但受限于高质量长链训练结构的稀缺，长 RNA 设计仍是开放挑战。未来工作将聚焦功能条件生成、实验验证以及更长 RNA 的扩展。

title: AdaCast: Conditional Parameter Generation for Adaptive Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) have achieved strong forecasting performance across domains. However, most adaptation methods remain static. Existing all-in-one methods learn a single set of dataset-level parameter updates and apply the same adapted model to every input. As a result, they cannot adapt the model parameters to the temporal patterns, seasonality and dynamics of each input time series. This limits their ability to produce forecasts that are tailored to heterogeneous inputs. To address this limitation, we propose AdaCast, a conditional parameter generation framework for time-series forecasting. AdaCast uses a generator to produce input-specific low-rank parameter updates for a frozen pretrained TSFM. These updates adapt the model to each input during both training and inference. Across six public benchmarks, AdaCast consistently outperforms static adaptation baseline in in-domain forecasting and improves zero-shot generalization to held-out datasets across domains. These results demonstrate that conditional parameter generation provides an effective approach for adaptive forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaCast框架，通过条件参数生成机制为每个输入时间序列生成专属的LoRA低秩参数更新，以解决现有时序基础模型(TSFM)静态适配方法在处理异构输入时的局限性。该方法在保持预训练主干网络冻结的同时，由参数生成器根据输入特性产生输入特定的参数更新，在六个公开基准上同时提升了域内预测精度和跨域零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的"一刀切"型时序基础模型适配方法（如全微调或数据集级LoRA）只能学习一套共享的参数更新，并将同一适配模型应用于所有输入。然而，同一数据集内不同时间序列在采样频率、季节性、动态特性上存在显著差异，共享适配只能产生"折中式"的更新，无法针对每个输入序列的时序特征、季节性和动态变化进行个性化调整，这一问题在分布偏移下尤为严重，限制了模型对异构输入的适应性预测能力。
AI.method: AdaCast的核心架构包含冻结的预训练TSFM主干（基于Chronos-Bolt的T5编解码器）和一个轻量级Transformer参数生成器𝒢_φ。具体流程为：(1) 将每个单变量输入序列x_{b,v}通过冻结的编码器Enc_θ获得条件表示Z_{b,v}；(2) 参数生成器以Z_{b,v}为条件，通过可学习的参数token（parameter tokens）和跨注意力机制，为解码器每个目标模块生成输入特定的低秩LoRA更新Δθ_{b,v} = 𝒢_φ(Z_{b,v})；(3) 将生成的LoRA矩阵ΔW = (α/r)·B·A以加法形式注入到冻结的解码器权重中。生成器内部采用因子化自注意力（层内+层间）建模参数依赖关系，B的输出头初始化为零以保证初始更新为零从而保持预训练行为不变。训练时仅优化生成器参数φ，主干网络参数θ保持冻结。损失函数为多分位数预测的Quantile Loss。
AI.result: 在六个公开基准（ETTh1/h2、ETTm1/m2、Weather、Exchange）上的实验表明：(1) 零样本评估中，AdaCast在6个数据集中的5个上取得最低MSE和MAE，平均MSE从0.2155降至0.2105（相对冻结主干降低2.3%，相对静态LoRA降低1.0%）；(2) 域内评估中，AdaCast在所有六个数据集上均优于静态LoRA，平均MSE降低3.4%、MAE降低2.0%，其中ETTm1的MSE降幅最大达8.3%；(3) 打乱实验（将一个输入的LoRA更新替换为另一个输入的生成更新）导致域内平均MSE从0.1936上升至0.1977，证实了输入-更新配对的重要性；(4) 消融实验表明所有解码器段（前/中/后）均对适配增益有贡献，但SAE敏感性与适配效用之间存在错位；(5) 该框架可迁移至TimesFM 2.5解码器架构，零样本和域内设置下均降低MSE。
AI.conclusion: AdaCast通过将TSFM适配问题重新定义为输入条件化的参数生成问题，证明了为每个输入序列动态生成专属低秩参数更新比学习单一共享适配更能有效处理异构时间序列数据。该条件参数生成范式在域内预测和跨域零样本泛化两方面均带来了持续改进，为将超网络（hypernetwork）方法从小型任务特定模型扩展到大规模跨域TSFM适配提供了有效路径。然而，该方法在计算效率上存在权衡（单个序列推理时间从0.21ms增加至2.60ms，吞吐量从4680 series/s降至384 series/s，显存从1.49GB增至21.6GB），且SAE特征敏感性与参数生成效用之间缺乏对应关系，表明参数生成的有效位置需通过经验分析而非单一扰动敏感性指标来确定。

title: TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing
summary: Large language model (LLM) routing distributes inference work across different models, advancing the cost-quality Pareto frontier of LLM serving. While coarse-grained routing at the session or query level has been widely adopted in production systems, recent algorithmic work shows that fine-grained token-level routing can yield substantial efficiency and quality gains. However, efficiently serving token-level routed inference poses significant challenges to existing systems. Built on single-LLM assumptions, current systems suffer from severe step desynchronization and frequent batch admission delays under token-level routing, and they also impose high implementation complexity on developers. To address these challenges, we design TokenRouter, an efficient and developer-friendly serving system for token-level routed LLM inference. TokenRouter follows the principle of request-centric programming, model-centric execution: developers describe routing logic from the perspective of a single request, while the runtime launches a subserver for each LLM and dispatches requests asynchronously. Each subserver employs a delayed-batching scheduler, whose optimal hyperparameters are derived from a mathematical throughput model of the system. Across diverse routing algorithms, workloads, and model pairs, TokenRouter achieves 2.01-64.15x higher decoding throughput than existing systems, substantially advancing the serving efficiency of token-level LLM routing. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: TokenRouter 是一个面向 token 级 LLM 路由的高效服务系统。它通过"请求中心编程、模型中心执行"的抽象，将每个 LLM 部署为独立子服务器，并采用解耦三循环异步执行、交接-恢复机制以及基于 DTMC 吞吐量模型推导最优超参数的延迟批处理调度器，解决了现有单 LLM 服务系统在 token 级路由下出现的步长失同步与批处理准入延迟问题。在多种路由算法（CITER、R2R、R-Stitch、Co-LLM、ME）、不同工作负载与模型对上的实验显示，TokenRouter 较现有实现获得了 2.01–64.15× 的解码吞吐加速。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 服务系统（SGLang、vLLM 等）基于单 LLM 同步解码假设构建。而 token 级路由算法（R2R、CITER、R-Stitch 等）允许每个 token 动态选择模型，破坏了系统的同步假设，导致：(1) 不同模型每步延迟差异引起的步长失同步，使快模型空闲；(2) 路由请求频繁切换目标模型，引发批处理准入延迟与批碎片化；(3) 现系统缺乏路由编程接口，开发者必须深度修改庞大代码库。因此需要专门为 token 级路由设计的、对开发者友好且高效的服务系统。
AI.method: 核心设计原则为"请求中心编程、模型中心执行"：(1) 编程接口——开发者只需实现 route、send、receive 三个函数，描述单个请求如何在协作 LLM 间流转，无需关心调度与异步。(2) 系统架构——每个 LLM 由一个独立子服务器承载（拥有私有调度器、Runner、KV-cache 池），通过统一的 Server Interface 对外暴露，可替代单 LLM 服务器。(3) 异步执行——在标准客户端-服务端循环、解码循环之外新增解耦的模型间循环；引入 "pending" 中间状态实现交接-恢复机制，避免前缀匹配与 KV-cache 重复分配。(4) 延迟批处理调度器——子服务器累积请求到阈值 B_i 再启动批处理；通过将路由过程建模为 DTMC，推导稳态吞吐解析表达式 T(B)，在此基础上搜索使吞吐量最大化的最优阈值向量 B*。(5) 路由专用工程优化——自动 KV-cache 联合分配、extend 模式 CUDA graph 捕获、进程内路由、全局状态跟踪。TokenRouter 基于 SGLang 0.5.1 实现。
AI.result: 在 8×A100-80G 服务器上，跨 5 种路由算法（双模型与三模型）、3 种工作负载（低强度推理、高强度推理、Agentic 任务）、多种模型对（Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B/8B/32B、LLaMA2、DeepSeek-R1-Distill、QwQ 等）的 15 种组合下，TokenRouter 较两种基线（官方实现 LLM-only、官方代码、Std. Serving）均取得吞吐领先，整体达到 2.01–64.15× 加速。端到端延迟降低 2.03–63.64×。消融表明工程优化（CUDA graph）带来 1.71× 提升，异步执行 +1.12×，延迟批处理再 +1.31×，总计 2.76×。跨节点部署（RoCE 3.7 GB/s）与单节点吞吐量相当。在并发度 16 严格 SLO 下吞吐仍达 18.58× 优势。DTMC 模型预测的最优阈值与实验测量最优完全吻合。吞吐量-精度曲线显示 TokenRouter 推进了细粒度路由的 Pareto 前沿。
AI.conclusion: TokenRouter 首次为 token 级 LLM 路由提供了一个高效、对开发者友好的服务框架，将路由算法与系统优化解耦：通过 route-send-receive 接口表达语义，通过异步子服务器执行和基于数学模型的延迟批处理解决失同步与批碎片两大核心挑战。实验与消融一致表明其在吞吐、延迟、并发扩展性、模型对泛化、跨节点部署等方面全面优于现有实现。该工作将 token 级路由的理论收益转化为实际系统加速，为后续 token 级路由研究提供了基础。论文也指出当前模型基于连续路由间令牌数服从几何分布的假设，对违反此假设的边界情况留作未来工作。

title: NativeScope: Relation-Localized Retrieval over Native Topology with a Correct Anchor
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, and 6 tables. Includes an appendix with reproduction information and an evidence inventory
summary: Dense retrieval usually ranks text chunks by their semantic similarity to a question. This ignores structure that many data systems already store, including section membership, session boundaries, and native order. We propose NativeScope, a scope-then-rank method for queries with a known anchor and relation. It represents a query as q -> (A, r, B). The anchor A and relation r select native units through belonging, before, or after operators, and the target term B ranks only chunks that overlap the selected scope. An internal variant, NS-FullQ, ranks the same candidates with the full question. We evaluate both methods on 200 controlled document and memory records derived from QASPER and LongMemEval under a 1,024-token budget. NativeScope attains native-unit recall of 89.28 percent for documents and 72.50 percent for memories, improving over instance-wide Dense RAG by 42.75 and 22.00 percentage points. NS-FullQ reaches 87.78 percent and 68.50 percent; its differences from NativeScope are inconclusive, locating the primary gain in relational scoping rather than the shorter ranking query. With automatic Top-1 anchors, memory recall falls to 35.50 percent. NativeScope is therefore effective when anchor coordinates and native relations are reliable, but hard scoping inherits errors from the localization interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NativeScope，一种基于原生拓扑结构的关系定位检索方法。通过将查询分解为(q → (A, r, B))格式，先利用锚点A和关系r通过belonging/before/after操作符选择原生单元，再对范围内的文本块进行语义排序。在200条受控记录上的实验表明：在正确锚点条件下，文档领域Recall@1024达89.28%，记忆领域达72.50%，显著优于Dense RAG；但自动锚点定位时性能急剧下降，表明方法对锚点可靠性存在硬性依赖。
AI.motivation: 传统密集检索仅基于查询与文本块的语义相似度排序，忽略了数据系统中已存储的结构信息（如段落归属、会话边界、原生顺序）。当查询涉及位置与内容的双重约束时（如"在某段落中"或"在某对话轮次之前"），扁平化处理会丢失可直接限制搜索空间的关键线索。
AI.method: 提出scope-then-rank框架NativeScope。核心设计：(1) 查询表示为q→(A,r,B)，A为锚点坐标，r为关系操作符，B为目标词；(2) 三种原生关系操作符——belonging选择同容器单元，before/after基于全局单元顺序选择最多8个方向单元；(3) 通过字符区间重叠将选中单元映射到候选块；(4) 仅对范围内候选块进行语义排序（用B或完整问题q）。引入内部变体NS-FullQ（在相同范围内使用完整问题排序）以隔离关系作用域与排序输入的贡献。
AI.result: 在200条受控记录（100文档+100记忆，各含50 belonging/25 before/25 after）上：正确锚点条件下NativeScope文档Recall@1024为89.28%，记忆为72.50%，分别比Dense RAG提升42.75和22.00个百分点；NS-FullQ为87.78%和68.50%，与NativeScope差异在统计上不确定；自动Top-1锚点条件下记忆Recall降至35.50%（低于Dense RAG的50.50%），错误定位成为硬性排除错误源；Anchor Window基线在记忆域仅2.00%，突显关系感知作用域的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 原生拓扑中的关系可作为候选域约束以显著改善固定预算下的检索完整性。主要增益来源于关系作用域执行，而非短查询词排序。方法在锚点坐标可靠且原生关系可用的条件下有效，但硬作用域会继承上游定位接口的错误，需配合校准、验证或回退机制以应对不可靠锚点。

title: RIFT: Relative Isolation From Trees For Anomaly Detection
summary: Isolation Forest (IF) is a widely used baseline for unsupervised anomaly detection. Recent studies provide a closed-form expression for the infinite-forest limit for one-dimensional data. Inspired by the geometric interpretation of this formula, we introduce RIFT (Relative Isolation From Trees), a deterministic anomaly detection method that generates the minimum spanning tree and scores each point by the sum of the apparent sizes of tree edges as viewed from that point. For one-dimensional data, the RIFT score recovers the closed-form IF limit exactly. In higher dimensions, it provides a parameter-free generalization that is deterministic, robust to varying density and clustered anomalies and avoids the axis-parallel artifacts of IF. We further propose an ensemble variant for large datasets. Experiments on synthetic data and the ADBench benchmark demonstrate that the accuracy is comparable to IF, while the ensemble variant exhibits significantly lower variance across random seeds.

AI.tldr: 提出RIFT框架，一种基于最小生成树（MST）的无监督异常检测方法，通过几何视角推广一维隔离森林（Isolation Forest, IF）的精确闭式解，并提供确定性的精确版与可扩展的集成变体。
AI.motivation: 一维数据的隔离森林存在精确的闭式渐近解，但难以直接推广到高维。现有的高维扩展仍依赖随机轴平行划分，存在伪影、不可复现和对密度变化敏感等问题。作者希望通过几何解释（视觉张角的求和）把一维结果自然推广到任意维度，同时保持确定性。
AI.method: （1）基于欧氏距离构造全局MST；对每个目标点做BFS遍历，将其视为树根，将每个子节点入边的长度作为分子d_k，到该子节点的欧氏距离作为分母ℓ_k，求和得到隔离分数；分数取负作为异常分数；（2）精确方法通过kNN图近似MST以加速；（3）集成变体RIFT-ensemble结合子采样与特征袋装（feature bagging），将每个新样本“嫁接”到最近的锚点再求总分。
AI.result: 在合成数据（不同密度、聚类异常）上，RIFT在Blob/变化密度/聚类异常数据集上ROC-AUC分别达到0.999/0.982/0.993，优于IF、LOF、KNN、HBOS、ECOD；在ADBench基准上，RIFT集成版在完整数据集上以0.7634略胜IF（0.7632），在小数据集上与IF持平（0.7561 vs 0.7518）。最显著的优势是集成版相对标准差仅为0.0010–0.0014，比IF（0.0212–0.0220）低约一个数量级；代价是运行时间在高位数据上比IF慢10–30倍。
AI.conclusion: RIFT作为基于MST几何结构的无监督异常检测方法，在一维情形下可精确恢复IF的闭式解，在高维下提供无超参、密度不变、不产生轴平行伪影且确定性强的评分；通过kNN近似与子采样特征袋装集成实现可扩展性，在ADBench上精度与IF相当，但分数方差大幅降低，提供了IF之外一种具有独特优势的新选择。

title: Batch Before You Lift: Scalable Topological Deep Learning on Large Graphs
summary: Topological Deep Learning extends graph-based learning to higher-order domains, such as hypergraphs, cellular, and simplicial complexes. These domains are typically constructed from patterns in an input graph through a process of graph lifting. Full-domain training constructs and stores the complete lifted representation before model execution. On large and dense datasets like Reddit (233k nodes and 57.3M edges), this global materialization becomes a severe computational bottleneck, often rendering training infeasible. To address this limitation, we introduce Cluster-TNN, a domain-agnostic framework that avoids this bottleneck by lifting locally instead. After partitioning the input graph during preprocessing, at runtime Cluster-TNN dynamically samples groups of node clusters, reconstructs their induced subgraphs to form mini-batches, and applies the chosen lifting within each mini-batch. Retaining all edges among sampled nodes preserves the connectivity needed to construct higher-order structures across clusters, producing topological mini-batches that existing Topological Neural Networks can process directly. Across 21 matched comparisons with full-graph execution, Cluster-TNN reduces peak GPU memory in every configuration, by 83.2% on average while maintaining competitive predictive performance. Notably, such a reduction enables, to our knowledge, the first training of multiple different higher-order Topological Neural Networks on large datasets such as Reddit and OGBN Products. These results establish Cluster-TNN as a general strategy for scaling Topological Deep Learning beyond the limitations of global domain construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Cluster-TNN，一个面向大规模图的"批前提升"框架，通过在图分区上局部执行图到高阶域的提升（如单纯复形、细胞复形、超图），避免在训练前物化完整提升域。在21组匹配对比中，峰值GPU显存平均降低83.2%，并在Reddit和OGBN Products上首次实现了高阶TNN的内存高效训练。
AI.motivation: 拓扑深度学习（TDL）将图学习扩展到超图、单纯复形、细胞复形等高阶域，但全域提升在大型密集图（如Reddit：233k节点、5730万边）上产生过大的高阶结构（如约83.6亿个单纯2-胞），导致物化瓶颈使训练不可行。现有"提升后批处理"策略仍需先构造完整高阶域，无法解决构造阶段瓶颈。
AI.method: Cluster-TNN采用"批前提升"策略：预处理时将输入图划分为K个不相交的节点簇（使用METIS或随机分区），固定后不变；运行时每个训练步采样至多q个簇，合并其诱导子图保留所有跨簇边，然后仅在该小子图上应用所选提升（如k-跳邻域超图、圈基细胞复形、团单纯复形），生成可直接被现有TNN处理的拓扑小批量。从基于Cluster-GCN的多簇批处理方案扩展，并提供单遍、集成（多次独立重组）和全图三种推理模式。
AI.result: 在Cora Full、Amazon Ratings、Questions三个受控基准上进行21组匹配对比：所有配置中峰值GPU显存降低，平均降低83.2%（中位86.7%），降幅46.4%-98.7%；13组预测性能优于全图训练；预处理时间16组降低（平均-53.9%），4组增加；首次实现Reddit（232965节点）和OGBN Products（约245万节点）上六种高阶TNN的训练，OGBN Products上SCCNN准确率达88.63%，超过GCN的85.81%。理论证明q-可观察结构的累积恢复概率随T→∞趋于1。消融显示跨簇边保留在19/21组中提升预测性能，集成推理在所有21组中优于单遍推理。
AI.conclusion: Cluster-TNN是跨高阶域（超图、细胞复形、单纯复形）扩展TDL的通用策略，无需架构特定修改即可复用现有可能提升和模型。局限性：剩余端到端运行时间有时增加（10/21组），集成推理带来额外开销，与全域预测/梯度的等效性尚未建立。未来工作包括支持原生高阶数据、选择性缓存、联合提升与批处理设计。

title: EgoVoice: Proactive Spoken Assistance from Egocentric Multimodal Streams
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 25 pages, 12 figures, 11 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Wearable augmented reality (AR) assistants are moving toward continuous real-world interaction, where they perceive the user's activity through first-person video and audio and provide timely spoken guidance without being explicitly asked. While proactive video assistants, spoken dialog systems, and egocentric task understanding have each advanced rapidly, existing systems do not address the joint problem of deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous first-person streams. We introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. From HoloAssist video recordings of real human instructors, we construct clean audio streams through source separation and speech resynthesis, and convert each video session into a format where the model must decide at each moment whether to remain silent or provide spoken guidance. We fine-tune an omni-modal LLM with our data, and further improve its proactive intervention behavior with direct preference optimization. Experiments across closed and open-source models show that existing systems rarely produce well-timed, meaningful proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields clear improvements in intervention timing, content relevance, and human preference over the zero-shot backbone.

AI.tldr: EgoVoice 是首个面向可穿戴AR设备的主动式（proactive）第一人称语音助手框架。它基于 HoloAssist 真实教学数据，通过音源分离和语音再合成构建干净的训练数据集，并在 MiniCPM-o 4.5 全双工多模态大模型上依次进行监督微调（SFT）和直接偏好优化（DPO），使模型能从连续的自我中心视频与音频流中自主决定何时开口以及说什么。
AI.motivation: 现有的语音助手多为反应式（用户提问后回答），但在实际操作场景（如组装家具、烹饪）中，用户可能无法暂停并主动求助，需要助手在恰当的时机主动提供口头指导。已有研究分别探索了主动视频助手、语音对话系统和自我中心任务理解，但尚无工作将"何时说话"与"说什么"在连续第一人称流中进行联合建模。
AI.method: 1. 数据构建：基于 HoloAssist（真实教学视频），使用 SAM-Audio 进行音源分离去除人声保留环境音，再用 IndexTTS2 重新合成自然语音，并通过 WER 筛选保证质量；最终得到 1,249 训练段（91.7 小时）和 170 评估段（12.9 小时）。2. 评估协议：包括起始时机匹配（匈牙利算法）、端对动作时间差、内容余弦相似度、LLM 评判（正确性/及时性/效率/总体）和人类评估。3. 训练：在 MiniCPM-o 4.5 上使用 LoRA 进行 SFT（Listen/Speak 决策 + BPE 文本 + S3 语音 token），再通过 F1 分数构建偏好对进行 DPO 微调以优化介入时机。
AI.result: EgoVoice-SFT 和 EgoVoice-DPO 在所有基线（Gemini Live、gpt-realtime、ProAssist、MiniCPM-o 4.5）上均显著提升了主动介入的 F1 分数（从 0.022 提升至 0.324）、内容相关性（余弦相似度从 0.448 提升至 0.684）以及端对动作时间差（接近人类指导者的 +1.69s）。其中 SFT 在内容相关性上略优，DPO 在介入时机上更佳，两者互补。人类偏好评估也证实其优于零样本基线。
AI.conclusion: EgoVoice 框架、数据集与评测协议为构建"始终在线"的主动式语音助手奠定了基础，展示了从第一人称多模态流中进行端到端语音指导的可行性；但仍存在任务领域局限（仅限装配类任务）、与人类指导者之间存在差距、以及隐私风险等局限，呼吁未来在更多样化的数据和交互式评估上进一步探索。

title: Real-Time Motion Planning with Dynamic Hazards: Classical vs. Learning-Based Methods
comment: This paper is scheduled to be presented at the 2027 International Symposium on Artificial Life and Robotics (AROB 2027)
summary: We study real-time motion planning in dynamic hazard fields through a controlled comparison between classical planning and learning-based methods. Rather than introducing a new planner, we construct a unified benchmark in which representative classical and learning-based methods face the same environments, motion constraints, information assumptions, and evaluation metrics. The test environment consists of planar domains populated with rotating sprinkler-like hazards that generate time-varying forbidden regions via sweeping angular sectors. Our results show a clear regime shift. In deterministic environments, classical planners achieve near-perfect success and higher-quality paths, though sometimes at the cost of substantial planning or replanning time. Under stochastic obstacle dynamics, however, online search becomes strongly budget-sensitive: low budgets lead to frequent failure, while high budgets improve success at the cost of latency and longer trajectories. PPO-based policies, trained under the same scenario distribution, consistently outperform in latency, success rate, and path quality in these stochastic regimes. Overall, the results indicate that uncertainty in obstacle evolution, more than partial observability, is the dominant factor determining which planning paradigm is practically effective for the problem at hand.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个统一的2D运动规划基准测试平台，在四种世界模型（由能见度与障碍物动力学两个维度交叉构成）下，对经典规划方法（A*、GBFS、UCT等）与基于PPO的强化学习方法进行了受控比较，而非提出新算法。核心结论是：不确定性在障碍演化中的主导作用，部分可观测性的主导作用则较小。
AI.motivation: 现有研究中，经典方法与基于强化学习的方法各自发展迅速，但很少有工作在一致建模假设和评估标准下进行受控的并列比较。该工作的目的在于隔离实际驱动逻辑差异（由问题结构而非算法创新引起），并提供实际指导，说明在何种情况下应优先选择哪种范式。
AI.method: 构建统一的2D运动规划基准测试平台，环境为具有旋转水阀状危险物的矩形区域。定义了四组世界模型（由能见度与障碍物动力学两个维度交叉构成）。在能见度轴上区分完全能见度与有限能见度；在动力学轴上区分确定性恒定角速度与随机变化角速度。评估方法包括：经典规划方法（A*、GBFS及基于D*的有限能见度在线重规划框架用于确定性设置；UCT用于随机设置）以及基于PPO的强化学习方法（采用多尺度ego-centric观察和离散转向动作空间）。所有方法均按顺序在相同场景、相同评价指标下进行测试（共1000次运行）。
AI.result: 在确定性环境中（见表1），经典规划方法（特别是A*）表现优于强化学习方法：在完全能见度下达到100%成功率，A*生成近优路径（长度114.38），而强化学习仅近似85%成功率（路径长度137）。在有限能见度下经典方法保持稳健（成功率近似96%）。A*的离线计算时间呈重尾分布。在随机障碍物动力学环境中（见表2），经典UCT方法表现出强烈计数值敏感性：0.002秒预算下成功率仅为近似4%，而1秒预算下达到近似76%，但路径长度从137增加到199。强化学习方法在此环境下表现稳定，成功率近似76%，路径长度近似152，延迟极低。这些结果充分说明，障碍演化的不确定性而非部分可观测性是决定规划范式有效性的主要因素。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持一个核心论点：障碍动力学的确定性结构有利于经典规划，而不确定性则将优势转向基于学习的方法。强化学习方法提供了更优的延迟-成功率-路径质量权衡，尤其在不确定性环境中表现更佳。基准测试虽限于2D结构化环境与简化水阀动力学，但提供了针对不同方法在不同任务环境下的实用性指导原则。

title: How Much Audio Is Left In An Embedding? An Inversion Audit Of Audio Encoders
summary: Pretrained audio encoders are reused for downstream tasks that are often unknown when the encoder is trained, so their usefulness depends partly on which signal properties survive the pretext objective. We study this retained information through paired source reconstruction. Using a shared Stable Audio Open latent diffusion decoder, we reconstruct five-second, 44.1-kHz stereo music from frozen representations produced by supervised classifiers (VGGish, ConvNeXt), an audio-text contrastive model (CLAP), and a waveform-reconstruction model (EnCodec). These objectives impose different pressures to preserve source detail, while their exposed interfaces vary substantially in temporal and spectral resolution. Evaluating on the Million Song Dataset (MSD), we find clear differences in reconstructability across encoder families, while within encoder comparisons show improved recovery when finer temporal or spectral structure is exposed. Even compressed task oriented embeddings support reconstructions that preserve measurable source specificity and high level musical content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种标准化的"嵌入反转审计"框架,通过共享的Stable Audio Open潜在扩散解码器,从冻结的预训练音频编码器嵌入中重建5秒44.1kHz立体声音乐,系统性地审计了四类编码器(VGGish、ConvNeXt、CLAP、EnCodec)保留的源信号信息量。在百万歌曲数据集(MSD)上的实验揭示了不同训练目标下重建能力的显著差异,并发现更精细的时频分辨率能改善重建效果,即便是压缩的任务导向嵌入也保留了可测量的源特异性和高层音乐信息。
AI.motivation: 预训练音频编码器常被用于训练时未知的下游任务,其有用性部分取决于哪些信号特性在代理任务目标中得以保留。然而,不同训练目标(分类、对比、重建)对源细节施加的压力不同,且暴露的接口在时频分辨率上差异很大,这使得跨编码器的源信息保留量难以评估。此外,在隐私和版权敏感场景中,共享衍生表示而非原始音频的动机也凸显了理解嵌入可重建性的重要性。
AI.method: 采用"配对源重建"审计框架:固定编码器Φ,训练条件生成解码器G_Φ(e,ε|θ)从嵌入e=Φ(x)重建配对源x。使用统一的VAE目标、Transformer架构(24层,宽度1536)和训练协议,仅改变条件接口。具体改造包括:(1)将T5文本条件接口替换为各编码器的冻结音频表示;(2)用线性层投影到768维条件空间,权重初始化为N(0,10⁻³);(3)在交叉注意力中加入时序局部偏置b_h(bucket(|t_i-s_j|))和硬掩码|t_i-s_j|≤0.2;(4)使用v预测目标、零条件丢弃、w=1的引导权重及150步确定性DDIM采样。评估指标包括多分辨率STFT距离(MR-STFT)、SAO-VAE空间余弦相似度、配对源检索(R@1/R@10)及MusicNN标签重叠度。实验在Million Song Dataset上进行,使用Demucs去除人声以匹配Stable Audio Open的训练域。
AI.result: 在MSD测试集上,重建质量呈现清晰排序:VGGish (STFT=.21, R@1=.004) < CLAP 5s (.20, .006) ≈ CLAP 1s (.19, .024) < ConvNeXt pooled (.18, .094) < ConvNeXt flattened (.18, .352) < EnCodec (.13, .894)。EnCodec原生解码器提供上界参考(.10, 1.000)。关键发现:(1)同一编码器内,更细的时频分辨率显著改善重建(CLAP 1s优于5s,ConvNeXt flattened优于pooled);(2)MR-STFT与VAE相似度相关性弱(|r|=0.02-0.17),说明二者捕获不同重建维度;(3)MusicNN标签一致性(.733-.847)远强于声学重建,表明压缩嵌入仍保留高层音乐内容(音色、乐器组合)而非精确音高/时序;(4)大多数源-重建对的VAE相似度高于随机源-源分布,证实重建系统性地更接近配对源。
AI.conclusion: 音频嵌入是有用的抽象,但下游实用性并不能反映源细节的可重建性。本文将反转框定为受控审计,使用共享预训练扩散探针在监督、对比和重建训练表示之间比较保留的源信号信息。未来工作应将此分析扩展到音乐以外的领域、更广泛的编码器家族及更直接的隐私泄露度量。该研究为在隐私/版权敏感场景中分发衍生表示提供了重要警示:即使是任务导向的压缩嵌入也可能支持保留源特异性和高层音乐内容的重建。

title: Syn-Omni: Structured Specialization and Progressive Collaboration for Omnimodal Embeddings
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Long, Findings). Code: this https URL
summary: Omnimodal embeddings naturally involve both shared representations and modality-specific features across heterogeneous inputs. However, existing omnimodal embedding methods often rely on a single shared parameter space over mixed-modality data, limiting structural separation between universal and modality-specific representations. To address this, we propose Syn-Omni, a unified framework for structured omnimodal adaptation with modality specialization and controlled cross-modal collaboration. Specifically, we introduce Orthogonal Modality-Expert LoRA (OME-LoRA), which decomposes adaptation into a shared LoRA path for universal semantics and modality-expert LoRA paths for modality-aware specialization. Furthermore, Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR) enables experts to first establish modality-specific priors, then gradually interact with other modality-experts for cross-modal synergy. Evaluated across 81 diverse tasks spanning image, video, audio, and audiovisual modalities, Syn-Omni consistently outperforms omnimodal baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured specialization and cross-modal progressive collaboration.

AI.tldr: Syn-Omni提出了一种结构化的全模态嵌入适配框架，通过正交模态专家LoRA（OME-LoRA）解耦共享语义与模态专精参数，并结合渐进协同路由（PSR）从隔离训练逐步过渡到跨模态协作，在81个跨图像、视频、音频及音视频任务上一致超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态嵌入方法普遍依赖单一共享参数空间在混合模态数据上进行适配，难以在通用语义和模态专精特征之间进行结构性分离，限制了模态感知专精化的建模能力。模态独立模型虽能保留模态特性但缺乏跨模态交互，而完全共享的适配策略又无法有效建模模态特有结构。
AI.method: 框架包含两大核心组件：(1) OME-LoRA将适配分解为一条共享LoRA路径（捕获通用语义）和多条模态专家LoRA路径（建模模态专精特征），并通过正交惩罚约束共享与专家权重方向的冗余；(2) 渐进协同路由（PSR）采用三阶段课程——Warmup阶段使用硬路由实现专家隔离，Blending阶段通过余弦调度逐步混合硬路由与软路由权重，Synergy阶段启用完全的软路由进行跨模态协作；同时引入Synergy Margin Loss（SML）替代BCE，避免对缺席模态专家的过度抑制，保留跨模态协同所需的专家激活。整体训练目标结合InfoNCE对比损失、正交惩罚和SML。
AI.result: 在81个任务（36图像+23视频+12音频+10音视频）上，Syn-Omni在3B和7B规模分别取得49.4%和51.6%的Hit@1总分，均超越Uni-Omni基线及Omni-Embed-Nemotron、LCO-Emb、e5-omni、WAVE等先进方法，统计显著性通过配对t检验验证（p<0.05）。消融实验证实OME-LoRA和PSR各自贡献显著，在相同参数量下结构化分解优于单纯扩大共享LoRA秩。音频和音视频任务增益最大（3B规模分别+2.5%和+3.0%）。代价为推理延迟增加17-18%，GPU内存增加不足1%。
AI.conclusion: Syn-Omni通过结构化分解共享与模态专精适配路径，结合渐进式跨模态协作机制，在统一全模态表示学习中实现了更好的平衡性和全面性能，验证了"先专精后协作"课程策略对全模态嵌入的有效性，为统一多模态表示学习提供了新的架构设计范式。

title: AdaptLSTM: Efficient Adaptive Online Learning for Cloud Workload Forecasting under Distribution Drift
summary: Accurate workload forecasting is critical for elastic resource provisioning in web-scale cloud services, where distribution shifts driven by viral content, product launches, and user behavior degrade offline-trained models rapidly. Naive online learning recovers accuracy but incurs prohibitive per-step compute cost. We propose AdaptLSTM, an adaptive online framework that detects drift via validation-calibrated thresholds and applies selective, targeted updates. On the Alibaba Machine Trace, AdaptLSTM recovers 54\% of Naive Online's improvement at 20\% cost ($2.7\times$ efficiency, $p=0.002$ over 10 seeds). On the more volatile Container Trace, it achieves 96\% at 20\% cost ($4.8\times$ efficiency, $+75\%$ MAE reduction over Static). Unlike classical drift detectors (ADWIN, DDM, Page-Hinkley) which fail to trigger on regression-scale error streams, AdaptLSTM fires 42 times over 301 steps and outperforms matched-budget baselines. Wall-clock profiling shows $1.33\times$ throughput gain and 45\% update-time reduction. The framework is model-agnostic: identical Pareto patterns hold for LSTM, GRU, and Transformer backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaptLSTM，一种用于云工作负载预测的自适应在线学习框架。它通过验证集校准的阈值检测漂移，并在漂移触发时进行选择性更新。在Alibaba Machine和Container Trace上的实验表明，AdaptLSTM仅以20%的计算成本就能分别恢复Naive Online 54%和96%的精度提升，分别达到2.7倍和4.8倍的效率提升。该框架是模型无关的，适用于LSTM、GRU和Transformer。
AI.motivation: 云服务工作负载预测面临由病毒内容、产品发布和用户行为驱动的分布漂移，使得离线训练的模型快速退化。朴素的在线学习虽能恢复精度，但每步计算成本过高。需要在静态模型（零成本但精度差）和朴素在线学习（高精度但100%成本）之间找到帕累托前沿。
AI.method: AdaptLSTM框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 验证集校准的漂移检测器——在验证集上预计算参考误差μ_ref，在线监测最近w步误差的均值，当超过α·μ_ref时触发漂移检测；(2) 选择性更新策略——基于节点优先级p_n = ẽ_n/(1+βu_n)选择top-ρN个节点，并执行单步Adam梯度更新；(3) 模型无关设计——同一AdaptWrapper模块可应用于LSTM、GRU和Transformer等不同骨干网络。
AI.result: 在Alibaba Machine Trace上，AdaptLSTM以20%成本恢复Naive Online 54%的精度改进（2.7倍效率，p=0.002）；在更剧烈的Container Trace上，恢复96%的改进（4.8倍效率，MAE相对Static降低75%）。框架在301步中触发42次，优于经典漂移检测器（ADWIN、DDM、Page-Hinkley在回归误差流上均无法触发）。Wall-clock测试显示1.33倍吞吐量提升和45%更新时间减少。在LSTM、GRU和Transformer三种骨干网络上均保持Static > Adapt > Naive的稳定排序。
AI.conclusion: AdaptLSTM通过验证集校准的漂移检测与单步梯度更新的结合，在静态模型与朴素在线学习之间占据了帕累托前沿。该框架以五分之一的计算成本捕获了超过一半的精度改进，且适用于多种骨干网络和漂移场景。在漂移更剧烈的场景中（如Container Trace），其Pareto位置几乎达到最优，体现了在大规模云部署中的实用价值。

title: DVD: Dynamic Vector Decoding for Efficient MLLM-based Perception
summary: Multimodal large language models have made remarkable progress in bridging vision and language, facilitating various perception tasks essential for human-machine interaction, robotics, and autonomous driving. However, existing MLLM-based perception methods predominantly rely on text-based coordinate representation, which suffers from excessive token overhead, or fixed-range quantization, which suffers from range and precision constraints, especially for 3D domains with unbounded spatial range and high localization accuracy requirements. To address these challenges, we propose a dynamic vector decoding method named DVD, which unifies the representation of 2D and 3D perception tasks. Specifically, we first transform diverse perceptual representation (i.e., 2D bounding boxes, 2D masks, and 3D bounding boxes) into 1D vector sequences, which are then mapped to compact discrete tokens in the high-dimensional space. Then, a lightweight de-tokenizer enables seamless integration with MLLMs by decoding output tokens back to original 2D and 3D perceptual representations. Extensive experiments on 2D and 3D perception benchmarks including RefCOCO series, SUN-RGBD, KITTI, Hypersim, nuScenes demonstrate that DVD achieves superior performance in 2D and 3D tasks and reduces significantly the token overhead and inference latency. DVD provides an efficient and general framework for integrating perception capabilities into MLLMs, overcoming the inherent limitations of existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出DVD（动态向量解码）方法，将2D框、2D掩码和3D框统一表示为1D向量序列，通过高维码本映射为紧凑离散token，解决MLLM感知中文本坐标表示token开销过大、固定范围量化精度受限的问题，显著提升2D/3D感知效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于MLLM的感知方法存在两大瓶颈：1）基于文本的坐标表示产生过多token（如mask需512个token），导致推理延迟高；2）固定范围量化在3D无界空间中受范围与精度限制。核心问题是：能否用少量token实现2D/3D感知表示的无界范围与高精度。
AI.method: 1) 统一感知表示：2D框用角点、2D掩码用边缘采样点、3D框用(中心+尺寸+旋转)展平为1D向量序列；2) 1D编解码器+可学习码本（4096 entries，潜空间维度16）将向量序列映射为高维离散token；3) 引入基于双向倒角距离的task-agnostic几何损失，监督几何结构而非序列参数化；4) 码本token扩展MLLM词表，推理时用轻量de-tokenizer还原原始2D/3D表示。
AI.result: 在2D grounding（RefCOCO系列）、2D RES及3D grounding（SUN-RGBD/Hypersim/KITTI/nuScenes/ARKitScenes）任务上一致超越SOTA：DVD-8B在SUN-RGBD达40.3% AP3D，RefCOCOg test达90.0% Precision。token数从文本方法的74（3D框）/512（mask）降至8/64，推理延迟降低约8×。码本利用率达99.98%，无坍缩。
AI.conclusion: DVD通过高维空间的统一向量量化，首次实现了2D/3D异构感知表示在MLLM中的统一编码，在保持性能的同时大幅降低token开销与推理延迟，为MLLM感知提供高效通用框架。未来工作包括优化重建质量、实现端到端联合训练及扩展至更多任务。

title: Cadence: Strategic Guidance for Coding Agents
summary: Runtime monitors are increasingly used to improve the reliability of LLM-based coding agents by inspecting execution trajectories and delivering corrective guidance upon detecting misbehavior. However, their effectiveness remains limited by static guidance triggering schemes. Existing monitors rely either on fixed inspection intervals, missing timely guidance during severe misbehaviors while incurring unnecessary overhead during healthy execution, or on rigid heuristic rules, failing to detect complex reasoning errors. To address these limitations, we propose Cadence, a dynamic monitoring framework that adaptively schedules inspections and delivers guidance according to the agent's real-time execution health. Cadence consists of two core modules: a two-tier intervention module and an inspection scheduler. The intervention module delivers advisory-level guidance for normal executions and minor lapses, while providing replacement-level guidance for severe misbehaviors. Driven by the intervention level, the scheduler adjusts the inspection frequency by tightening supervision after replacement-level guidance and relaxing it after advisory-level guidance. Evaluated on 300 SWE-bench Lite tasks across two distinct agents, mini-swe-agent and Moatless, Cadence achieves the highest resolve rate among all evaluated monitors. Specifically, Cadence outperforms vanilla agents by 25.33\% (+76 resolved tasks) on mini-swe-agent and 15.67\% (+47 resolved tasks) on Moatless, while maintaining competitive token efficiency compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: Cadence是一个用于LLM编码代理的动态运行时监控框架，通过双层干预模块（advisory/replacement）和自适应检测调度器，根据代理的实时执行健康状况动态调整检测频率和干预策略，在SWE-bench Lite上显著提升了任务解决率。
AI.motivation: 现有运行时监控器的引导触发机制存在两大局限：周期性引导（固定检测间隔）导致健康执行时过度引导、严重错误时引导不足；基于规则的引导依赖预定义启发式规则，无法检测复杂的推理错误（如错误修复目标、错误修复逻辑、不完整修复等）。这些静态触发机制无法根据代理的实时执行健康状况自适应调整。
AI.method: Cadence框架包含两个核心模块：(1) 两层干预模块——利用LLM语义推理评估执行健康状况，对正常/轻微偏差执行advisory级干预（允许当前步骤执行并附加引导），对严重错误行为执行replacement级干预（丢弃当前步骤并促使重新生成）；(2) 检测调度器——根据干预级别动态调整检测间隔，advisory时扩展间隔（I += δ），replacement时重置为基准值（I = I_base），实现健康执行时减少监控开销、严重失败时加强监督。算法采用任务分解策略将长轨迹转化为局部执行健康评估，缩小上下文窗口并利用LLM在调试推理方面的先验知识。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Lite（300任务）上评估：mini-swe-agent上Cadence达到42.33%解决率（+25.33%/+76任务），Moatless上达到39.67%（+15.67%/+47任务），均优于所有基线（Fixed-Interval、LivePlan、Static Rule-Based、Vanilla）。同时保持最佳token效率，mini-swe-agent上每任务仅消耗1.03M tokens，token杠杆率达0.41（+243.3%）。在多种LLM骨干（Qwen3-Coder、Gemini 2.5 Flash、GPT-5-mini等）和调度参数下均表现稳健。消融实验证明动态调度和双层干预各自贡献关键性能（替换为固定间隔k=7时下降9.00%，单一干预策略时下降最多7.33%）。
AI.conclusion: Cadence是首个将战略检测与引导统一起来的运行时监控器，通过自适应检测调度和上下文感知的两层干预机制，有效解决了现有静态触发机制中过度引导与引导不足的矛盾。实验证明该框架在多种编码代理和LLM骨干上均具有鲁棒性，为LLM编码代理的可靠性提升提供了有效方案。失败案例分析表明未来可通过引入工具调用计数、深化根因推理、显式跟踪问题清单来进一步改进。

title: HarnessSQL: Harness-Native Training for SQL Agents in Realistic Database Environments
summary: Text-to-SQL models are commonly trained to map questions directly to static queries, whereas real-world database agents operate through stateful, multi-turn interaction with live databases -- inspecting schemas, executing probe queries, diagnosing errors, and revising hypotheses. This creates a critical train-deploy mismatch, as the execution harness that mediates this interaction is introduced only at inference time. To bridge this gap, we propose HarnessSQL, a harness-native post-training framework that preserves the full interaction structure throughout both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. HarnessSQL builds isolated, executable database environments paired with hidden execution oracles, rolls out teachers directly inside the target SQL harness, and retains only verified trajectories for full-sequence SFT, followed by execution-reward RL. Across Spider 2.0-SQLite, HarnessSQL dramatically boosts the execution accuracy of compact models, raising Qwen3-8B from 15.5% to 45.2% and Qwen3-14B from 22.2% to 54.8%, while transferring effectively to out-of-distribution interactive benchmarks such as BIRD-Interact and LiveSQLBench. Our findings demonstrate that training database agents directly within their execution harness is essential for mastering complex, long-horizon database workflows.

AI.tldr: HarnessSQL提出了一种"工具原生（harness-native）"的后训练框架，将SQL智能体的训练过程直接对齐到部署时的执行交互环境，通过隔离沙箱环境、专用SQL交互协议（4个工具）、基于执行验证的完整轨迹SFT与执行奖励RL相结合，解决了Text-to-SQL模型在训练（单次静态映射）与部署（多轮交互式数据库代理）之间的关键错位问题。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL方法将任务建模为从自然语言到静态SQL查询的一次性映射（one-shot conditional generation），而现代真实数据库任务（如Spider 2.0）要求智能体通过多轮交互探索模式、执行中间查询、诊断错误并修订假设。关键问题在于：训练时未接触执行harness，部署时才引入harness，导致训练-部署错配（train-deploy mismatch），静态监督忽略了探索、错误恢复与终止等过程性策略。
AI.method: 三大核心组件：(1) 可执行SQL环境构建：基于79个数据库构建隔离容器化沙箱，封装真实执行引擎、隐藏oracle验证器，通过SQL优先合成（SQL-first blueprinting）生成任务；(2) SQL专用harness适配（DSH-SQL）：基于DSH定义四工具契约（列表表、查看模式、执行查询、提交），禁用无关的通用编程工具；(3) harness原生后训练：教师在harness中rollout，仅保留通过执行验证与协议检查的轨迹进行全轨迹SFT（损失掩蔽环境观察），再使用DAPO算法进行执行奖励RL，保持SFT与RL的harness完全一致。
AI.result: 在Spider 2.0-SQLite上，HarnessSQL将Qwen3-8B执行准确率从15.5%提升至45.2%（+29.7点），将Qwen3-14B从22.2%提升至54.8%（+32.6点），显著超越OmniSQL-32B（14.8%）、Arctic-Text2SQL-32B（16.3%）和MARS-SQL多智能体（12.6%）等基线。OOD迁移：BIRD-Interact Mini达9.0%/11.3%，LiveSQLBench Base-Lite达24.8%/28.5%，均显著优于32B基线。消融研究证实：(a) SFT对RL有3倍增益放大作用；(b) 全轨迹训练优于按轮次切分；(c) 32K上下文窗口显著优于8K；(d) 训练-推理harness对齐比单纯访问交互环境更重要；(e) 高能力教师与专用harness均对轨迹合成至关重要。交互行为分析显示，SFT+RL使无效调用从67.4%降至0.6%，协议违规从83.2%降至11.5%。
AI.conclusion: 训练数据库智能体必须直接在其执行harness内部进行，以掌握复杂、长周期的数据库工作流。HarnessSQL证明了harness不仅是推理时的封装层，更是训练应当再现的行为分布的一部分。框架在三个层面（可执行环境、任务特定交互协议、轨迹级监督）实现了训练-部署对齐，提供了将紧凑模型转化为经过验证的交互策略型数据库代理的具体方法。当前局限在于主要聚焦SQLite方言，PostgreSQL/Snowflake/BigQuery等方言扩展是未来工作。

title: Unlocking the Regulatory Genome by ARGUS: An Evidence-Constrained Agentic Framework for Interpreting Single Nucleotide Variants
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS). Code: this https URL
summary: Over 90% of disease-associated variants from genome-wide association studies fall in noncoding regulatory regions, yet their functional interpretation remains a central open problem in genomic medicine. Large language models prompted to interpret such variants routinely hallucinate transcription factor (TF) binding changes, fabricate experimental support, and assign biological significance to statistically negligible signals. We present ARGUS (Agentic Regulatory Genomics for an Uncertainty-aware Scientist), which strictly separates deterministic biological computation from LLM-mediated reasoning. ARGUS wraps 458 DNABERT-based TF binding models in a hypothesis-directed investigation loop where a planner selects evidence sources based on current uncertainty, a verifier deterministically interprets each observation, and intermediate results change the investigation path. On variant rs6983267 at the 8q24 cancer risk locus, the same planner produces four divergent trajectories for four TFs. FOXA1 is rescued in 3 steps when real ADASTRA allele-specific binding data (15 experiments, FDR = 0.030) reveals a model false negative masked by saturation. KLF6 traverses 8 steps across ADASTRA, JASPAR motif analysis, and ENCODE cCRE regulatory annotation before abstaining due to mixed indirect evidence. RAD21 abstains in 8 steps after ADASTRA returns a coverage-qualified but nonsignificant allelic test (5 experiments, FDR = 0.65), and SP1, which shares FOXA1's saturated retained prediction, abstains because no direct experimental evidence exists at this locus. All observations come from real ADASTRA, JASPAR, and ENCODE cCRE queries; none are simulated. A comparison of fixed-priority and LLM-mediated planning shows that the LLM planner reaches identical verdicts with fewer tool calls by declining evidence that cannot resolve the claim under test.

AI.tldr: ARGUS是一个用于解读非编码区单核苷酸变异（SNV）功能的智能体框架，通过将确定性生物计算与LLM推理严格分离，解决LLM在基因组解读中产生幻觉的问题。系统封装458个基于DNABERT的TF结合模型，采用假设驱动的调查循环——规划器基于当前不确定性选择证据来源，验证器以确定性方式解读观察结果。在8q24癌症风险位点rs6983267上，同一规划器针对四个TF产生四条不同轨迹。
AI.motivation: 基因组关联研究中超过90%的疾病相关变异位于非编码调控区，但对其功能解读仍是基因组医学的核心难题。直接用LLM解读此类变异会产生三种典型幻觉：编造TF结合变化、伪造实验支持、将统计上可忽略的信号赋予生物学意义。现有工具（包括AlphaGenome Atlas）区分了"模型预测有影响"与"独立证据支持该影响"，但这是预测与解读之间尚未解决的根本问题。本文核心动机是架构性地解决LLM幻觉问题，而非仅靠提示工程。
AI.method: ARGUS采用"确定性科学、代理推理"的设计原则。预测阶段使用458个DNABERT-based TF结合模型，以0.5为活性结合阈值进行确定性分类（LOF/GOF、增强/减弱、保留、无显著结合），并标记饱和态（两等位概率均>0.95）。调查阶段为假设驱动的智能体循环：状态对象追踪假设TF-变异身份、DVR预测、认知状态（active/supported/contradicted/rescued/abstained/partially_supported）；规划器按优先级查询证据源（ADASTRA→JASPAR→ENCODE cCRE）；验证器采用10分支决策树确定性解读ADASTRA结果；停止规则决定最终状态。LLM仅在报告阶段和可选的LLM规划器中使用，且无法覆盖任何已分类的事实或裁定。所有ADASTRA、JASPAR、ENCODE cCRE查询均为真实本地数据，未使用模拟结果。
AI.result: 在rs6983267位点上，FOXA1在三步内被"拯救"（rescued）：尽管DVR因饱和预测为保留结合，但真实ADASTRA数据（15个实验、FDR=0.030）显示显著的等位特异性结合，揭示了模型假阴性。KLF6经过8步跨越三种证据源后弃权——ADASTRA无数据、JASPAR基序与DVR相反（Δ=-0.147）、cCRE仅提供支持性上下文，证据混合。RAD21在8步后弃权：ADASTRA返回检验力充分但不显著的结果（FDR=0.65）。SP1同样8步弃权：无直接实验证据。LLM规划器与固定优先级规划器达成相同裁定，但用9次工具调用替代13次，通过拒绝使用无法解决当前声明的证据（cCRE）来节省预算。AlphaGenome交叉引用显示FOXA1最大|Δ|=0.463与ADASTRA一致，KLF6负Δ=-0.240与JASPAR基序差异方向一致。
AI.conclusion: ARGUS证明基因组解读中的幻觉问题并非使用LLM的必然代价。通过架构性地分离确定性科学与代理推理、将可证伪性作为一等公民组件、并使每个裁定可追溯到具体证据观察，系统产生的是经过主动测试的结论。rs6983267上四条发散轨迹展示了在原则化、可审计框架内实现观察依赖型调查的可行性。核心教训是LLM的"边界"必须通过架构而非提示工程来强制执行。ARGUS与预测模型互补而非竞争，专注于预测之后的解读问题，可与DeepVRegulome、AlphaGenome、Enformer等任意上游预测源配合。限制包括：评估仅覆盖两个位点的五个TF假设、规划器策略固定、证据来源仅三种、DNABERT模型存在饱和等已知盲点、SCREEN API在计算环境中不可达。未来工作方向包括自适应规划、信息增益驱动的停止标准、eQTL/ATAC-seq/文献证据扩展。

title: TestPrism: Rethinking Test Evaluation Beyond a Single Reference
summary: Large language model (LLM) coding agents have advanced test generation across diverse programming tasks. However, the common practice of evaluating tests against a single reference solution overlooks alternative valid implementations and can overstate test quality. We introduce TestPrism, comprising 300 test tasks from 17 sources and 3000 candidate implementations, evenly split between valid and invalid solutions. Its primary metric, Joint Success Function, requires the generated tests to fail on the initial program state, accept every valid candidate, and reject every invalid candidate. Across fourteen baseline coding agent configurations, Joint Success Function reaches only 28.00%, whereas single reference success reaches 59.67%. Our analysis reveals missed behaviors, unsupported assertions, and faulty test construction. To address these weaknesses, we introduce TestHelix, which combines heterogeneous synthesis of test and repair pairs with peer cross validation and recursive self improvement (RSI). Across two models, TestHelix improves Joint Success Function by 8.67 to 9.00 percentage points over the native harness comparators in the TestHelix evaluation

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TestPrism 基准和 TestHelix 方法，旨在解决基于单一参考解评估测试生成质量的局限性。TestPrism 包含 300 个测试任务和 3000 个候选实现，其核心指标 Joint Success Function (JSF) 要求测试在初始程序上失败、接受所有有效实现、拒绝所有无效实现。实验显示 14 种基线配置的 JSF 最高仅 28.00%，而单一参考成功率可达 59.67%。TestHelix 通过异构合成、同行交叉验证和递归自我改进，将 JSF 提升了 8.67–9.00 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有测试生成评估普遍采用单一参考解标准，忽略了同一需求可能有多种有效实现的事实，导致测试质量被高估：测试可能在参考解上通过，却遗漏关键行为或接受错误的替代实现。论文旨在揭示这一评估盲点并提出改进方法。
AI.method: （1）TestPrism 基准构建：四步流程——任务筛选与适配、任务选择、补丁生成与验证、多样性过滤与任务转换。每个测试任务配有 1 个参考解、4 个有效替代实现和 5 个无效实现，通过 AST Jaccard 距离和失败检查集控制多样性。（2）Joint Success Function 指标：联合要求初始失败、接受所有有效候选、拒绝所有无效候选；单一参考成功率是其最弱特例。（3）TestHelix 方法：包含异构合成（生成多个测试-修复对）、同行交叉验证（跨执行、语义审查、纠正反馈、套件合并）和递归自我改进（RSI，基于 AutoSaddler 优化测试生成策略）。
AI.result: （1）14 种基线配置中，Claude Fable 5.1 取得最高 JSF 28.00%，对应单一参考成功率为 59.67%；5/6 配置的有效接受率低于无效拒绝率，表明接受合法实现更难。（2）覆盖指标与 JSF 强相关：Change Coverage 和 Entry Coverage 的 Pearson r 分别为 0.91 和 0.96。（3）失败分析（286 条轨迹）：覆盖率缺失 34.6%、错误检查 50.0%、执行逻辑错误 15.4%。（4）扩大候选集降低 JSF：从 49.33% 降至交替扩展后的 24.33%。（5）TestHelix 在 GPT 5.6 sol 和 Kimi K3 上将 JSF 提升 8.67–9.00 个百分点，PCV 贡献约 6 点，RSI 额外贡献约 4.33–4.67 点。
AI.conclusion: 可靠测试生成远未解决：前沿模型在 JSF 上仅 28.00%。单一参考评估会高估测试质量并掩盖三类失败（覆盖缺失、错误检查、执行错误）。TestHelix 通过利用多种修复假设进行交叉验证和 RSI 策略优化，在固定推理预算下显著提升跨实现的测试可靠性，证明生成工作流是改进可靠性的有效目标。

title: One Word Opens the Gate: The Option-Channel Attack on Typed Decision Models as Agent Guardrails
summary: A typed decision model reads a piece of text and returns a probability over caller-defined options, each with a short written definition, generating no text. Recent work places these models in agent systems as guardrails: the component that reads a proposed tool call or incoming message and decides whether to allow it. We evaluate seven open-weight models in that role and report the two error directions separately: a fail-open error allows a prohibited action and is a vulnerability; a fail-closed error blocks a permitted one and is only a cost. On prompt-injection, jailbreak and toxic-content screening, accuracy at the allow-or-block decision ranges from 36% to 72% against a chance level of 50%. A low error rate in one direction only reflects which answer a model defaults to: one allows nearly everything, another blocks nearly everything. On a synthetic suite of agent tool calls, six lines of server log text that say nothing about the policy raise a gate's fail-open rate from 0% to 63% on a policy it otherwise decides correctly. Giving the permissive option a misleading name, with its definition and the judged text untouched, raises that rate to between 93% and 100% on the four models that place the label in their input. Every defense we tested is defeated, either by an attacker who targets its mechanism or by attacker-controlled text. Escalating the least confident decisions does not help either: a decision an attack has reversed is no less confident than the one it replaced. Parsing each policy field into a typed value does eliminate one attack, but it also makes the model unnecessary: a deterministic rule over those values reaches 100% accuracy on all six policies. These models can reduce how many cases reach a reviewer, but on this evidence they should not be the component that decides. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了类型化决策模型（typed decision models）作为智能体安全护栏（guardrail）的可靠性。作者发现：七个开源模型在三个公开筛查数据集上准确率仅36%–72%；无政策信息的附加文本可使失效率从0%升至63%–88%；仅修改选项标签（option-channel attack）即可使四个模型的失效率达到93%–100%；五种防御全部被自适应攻击攻破。研究结论是：此类模型不应承担最终的安全决策角色。
AI.motivation: 近期多项研究将类型化决策模型部署为智能体系统的安全护栏，负责决定是否允许工具调用或消息。但现有安全性文献存在两个关键缺陷：（1）未区分fail-open（允许了应阻止的操作，漏洞）和fail-closed（阻止了应允许的操作，仅为成本）两种错误方向；（2）未将模型视为安全控制进行评估。本文的动机在于填补这些空白。
AI.method: 作者构建了GuardBench合成基准（含六条安全策略），结合三个公开筛查数据集（提示注入、越狱、有毒内容），评估了七个开源模型（五个类型化决策模型加Qwen2.5-Instruct两个尺寸）。核心方法包括：（1）分离报告fail-open与fail-closed率；（2）仅评估模型原本正确决策的攻击成功率（asr_open）；（3）设计两类攻击——与策略无关的文本追加和option-channel攻击；（4）测试五种防御并实施自适应攻击；（5）分析决策置信度（margin）与攻击效果的关系。
AI.result: 主要结果：（1）在公开任务上准确率仅36%–72%；（2）六行普通服务器日志文本可使某策略的fail-open率从0%升至63%；（3）仅将允许选项重命名为escalate等，可使laya-td的fail-open率达100%，laya-ml达93%，laya-en达100%，Qwen2.5-7B达100%（对secret策略）；（4）正确阻止决策的中位P(block)仅0.57，置信度极低；（5）五个防御中D5（结构化字段）表现最好但仍被自适应攻击攻破；D8（提示open率0%–99%）未能阻止通过无关词汇（如harpsichord）的攻击；（6）置信度升级策略无效——被反转的决策与原决策同样自信；（7）确定性的解析规则可达100%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 类型化决策模型不应作为安全决策的最终组件。它们：（1）在不安全方向失败；（2）正确阻止决策的置信度低；（3）可通过先前工作未充分重视的选项标签通道被控制。唯一的有效防御（字段解析）同时也使模型变得不必要，因为确定性规则更准确且不可攻击。这些模型仅适合减少送审案件量，不能用于最终决策。

title: Machine Learning Meets High-Energy Nuclear Physics: From Pattern Recognition to Physics-Integrated Discovery
summary: Machine learning (ML) in high-energy nuclear physics (HENP) is entering a new stage in which physical knowledge is incorporated more directly into data analysis, simulation, and physics inference. This mini-review focuses on developments that have matured in the past several years. Whereas earlier applications emphasized event classification, pattern recognition, and surrogate models for selected observables, recent work has moved toward physics-integrated workflows: calibrated Bayesian extraction of QCD matter properties, dense-matter equation-of-state inference from heavy-ion and neutron-star data, generative event modeling, neural unfolding of weak physical signals, differentiable inverse solvers, gauge-equivariant and diffusion-based lattice-field samplers, and neural reconstruction of model functions in holographic QCD. We survey recent applications of ML in heavy-ion collisions, neutron-star physics, lattice QFT, and holographic or continuum QCD. The emphasis is not on ML architectures alone, but on how they enter concrete physics workflows, how physical constraints such as symmetries, conservation laws, causality, thermodynamic stability, and topology are imposed, and how uncertainty quantification and validation determine whether an AI-assisted result can support a reliable physics conclusion.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于机器学习在高能核物理（HENP）应用的综述，重点介绍了ML如何从早期的模式识别转向物理集成的工作流程，包括重离子碰撞、中子星物理、格点QFT和全息QCD等领域。文章强调将物理约束（如对称性、守恒律、因果性、热力学稳定性）和不确定性量化融入ML框架的必要性。
AI.motivation: 高能核物理的核心挑战是从实验观测中推断QCD物质的性质，而前向模型计算昂贵且反演问题常涉及高维观测数据。早期ML应用多局限于分类和代理模型，近年来已发展为包含物理约束、可微分推断和不确定性量化的完整物理工作流程，亟需系统性综述来评估标准和方法论进展。
AI.method: 方法涵盖七大主题——现象学工作流、贝叶斯推断、实验应用、致密物质推断、格点QFT、全息/有效描述以及新兴基础（基础模型、AI智能体、量子ML和基准设施）。技术层面包括生成式事件模拟（如DiffHIC、HEIDi扩散模型）、物理信息神经网络（PINN）、规范等变架构、神经符号回归、可微分TOV求解器、归一化流以及模拟基推断（SBI）。重点强调GP仿真器+PCA+MCMC框架、因果性约束、模型偏差建模和信息场方法。
AI.result: （1）重离子：贝叶斯提取高密度核物质EoS（如$\Delta r_{np}(^{208}\text{Pb})=0.217\pm0.058$ fm），约束$\hat{q}(T)$的温度依赖，发现剪切黏滞随$\mu_B$增加；（2）中子星：神经EoS重建结合可微分TOV求解器，实现不确定性量化的后验推断；（3）格点QFT：扩散模型和随机规范化流在SU(3)规范理论取得进展，物理条件扩散模型实现参数插值；（4）全息QCD：Neural ODE和KAN网络实现从格点数据重建EMD背景和胶子谱；（6）实验：ALICE首次部署TPC实时神经网络簇重建，sPHENIX开发GNN在线触发器；（8）智能体：CLVisc Agent和LQCDMaster展示了LLM驱动的自主科研工作流。
AI.conclusion: ML在HENP中正从模式识别转向科学工作流设计，核心进展包括学习表征、概率ML/可微分编程和物理约束生成模型。关键未来方向是构建跨领域的"封闭QCD推断回路"，统一格点、连续、EFT、扰动和全息约束。提出四类社区基准（格点、重离子、中子星、功能/全息），强调负控制、独立数据保持和模型偏差测试的重要性。AI不能解决符号问题或唯一确定QCP，但能通过物理约束嵌入、不确定性传播和可解释验证，使先前难以处理的工作流变得可行。

title: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction
summary: Egocentric world models predict first-person observations conditioned on an agent's actions, but most focus on a single agent. Real embodied settings often involve multiple agents that act and interact within a shared environment. Existing multi-agent world models rely on coarse actions like locomotion, camera control, or discrete commands, leaving fine-grained embodied interactions underexplored. We formulate multi-agent egocentric world modeling as synchronized ego-stream generation for multiple agents interacting through fine-grained actions in a shared world. This requires cross-view action consistency, shared-environment consistency, and consistent propagation of interaction-induced state updates. We propose Multi-agent Egocentric World Model (ME-World), which jointly denoises multiple ego streams in a shared token sequence, conditions each stream on all agents' target-view poses, and grounds generation with shared environment memory. We train and evaluate on real and synthetic multi-agent data and introduce shared-world consistency metrics for environment, update, and identity consistency. Experiments show ME-World improves shared-world consistency, action control, identity preservation, and video quality over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ME-World，一种多智能体自我中心世界模型，通过联合多智能体生成、共享动作条件和共享环境记忆，在共享世界中同步生成多个智能体的第一视角视频流，解决跨视角动作一致性、共享环境一致性和交互状态传播一致性三大挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有自我中心世界模型主要针对单一智能体，而现实场景中多个智能体在共享环境中交互时，现有方法依赖粗粒度动作（运动控制、相机控制、离散指令），无法处理精细的具身交互。需要解决三个关键挑战：跨视角动作同步、共享环境一致性、交互引发的状态变化在所有视角中一致传播。
AI.method: ME-World包含三大核心组件：(1)联合多智能体生成——在共享token序列中联合去噪多个自我中心流，通过自注意力实现跨流信息交换；(2)共享动作条件——为每个流提供所有智能体的目标视角位姿，将其他智能体的3D位姿投影到目标相机坐标；(3)共享环境记忆——包括流对齐几何记忆（将历史观测扭曲到目标视角）和跨流锚定记忆（保留干净的参考观测作为共享锚点）。模型基于Cosmos-Predict2.5 2B多视角扩散Transformer，使用整流流目标进行微调。
AI.result: 在真实和合成基准测试上，ME-World在共享世界一致性（S_env、S_update、S_id）、相机控制（Trans/Rot Error）、自动作控制（Hand-F1、Hand-mIoU）、他智能体动作控制（Full-Body-F1、PCK@10）和视频质量（PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS、FVD）指标上均优于现有方法（包括GEN3C、EgoSim、MetaWorld等）。消融实验验证了三个核心组件的必要性。方法可自然扩展到三智能体场景和自回归长视频生成（221帧）。
AI.conclusion: ME-World通过将多个自我中心流建模为单一共享世界的耦合观测，在共享世界一致性和精细动作控制方面取得显著提升，同时保持强视频质量。该框架为多智能体具身世界建模开辟了新方向，未来可扩展至行为规划、高效跨智能体通信及实时交互式多智能体世界模拟。

title: Compact and Efficient Indexes for Learned Sparse Retrieval
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering 2027 (IEEE ICDE 2027)
summary: This paper investigates how to substantially reduce the memory footprint of learned sparse retrieval indexes without sacrificing the efficiency of state-of-the-art retrieval data structures. Building on SEISMIC, we revisit both levels of its design: the inverted index used to select candidates and the forward index used to score them. For the inverted index, we replace costly per-block summaries with medoids, namely existing documents elected as block representatives, collapsing the per-block metadata from a sparse vector to a single document identifier. For the forward index, we compress both components and values. We reorder the vocabulary to place co-occurring components closer together and encode the resulting $\Delta$-gaps with DOTPACKING8, a SIMD-friendly bit-packing scheme that fuses decompression with dot-product evaluation; values are quantized with compact per-component 4-bit codebooks fitted to each component's distribution. We further introduce JUMPDOT, a blocked dot-product kernel tailored for queries that contain only a few non-zero entries. Our forward-index compression is independent of SEISMIC and can be plugged into any system relying on forward-index-based scoring, as we demonstrate by integrating it into KANNOLO. A comprehensive evaluation on MS MARCO with three state-of-the-art learned sparse encoders shows that our solutions markedly improve the speed-space trade-off of learned sparse retrieval: at equal accuracy, our indexes answer queries up to 5.3x faster than the best competitor while using about 3x less memory, and in the most memory-constrained regime, they remain up to 1.9x faster while using up to 3.9x less memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一系列针对学习稀疏检索（LSR）索引的压缩技术，基于SEISMIC框架，分别在选择器索引（用medoid替代昂贵的per-block summary向量）和前向索引（通过DotPacking8/DotPackingDp压缩组件标识符，以及4-bit per-component量化压缩权重值）两个层面进行优化，并设计了JumpDot点积核以及支持medoid的SEISMIC和新版本kANNolo，在MS MARCO上取得了显著的时空权衡改进。
AI.motivation: 学习稀疏检索（LSR）虽然效果优异，但其索引（如SEISMIC约7 GiB）内存占用过大，已经成为主要瓶颈。当检索延迟进入微秒级后，内存取代延迟成为首要挑战，因此急需在不牺牲查询效率的前提下大幅压缩索引体积。
AI.method: 本文方法在SEISMIC双层索引结构上提出四项关键技术：(1) Selector侧用medoid（块内最接近质心的真实文档）替代per-block summary向量，将元数据从稀疏向量压缩为单个文档ID；(2) 设计JumpDot分块点积算法，结合SIMD比较实现查询驱动的文档块跳过，专为查询极稀疏的inference-free场景；(3) 前向索引组件压缩：基于递归图二分（RGB）重排词汇表以缩短Δ-gap，并提出SIMD融合的DotPacking8/DotPackingDp位打包方案，将解码与点积计算融合；以及扩展到reference-based压缩的CDotPacking8/CDotPackingDp；(4) 前向索引权重压缩：每个component单独拟合4-bit标量或k-means码本做per-component量化。
AI.result: 在MS MARCO数据集上，使用SPLADE、LiLSR、SPLADE-v3三种编码器评估，相比最佳基线SINDI，在同等精度下查询速度最高提升5.3倍且内存减少约3倍；在最严格的内存受限设置下（MB<1）仍可保持最高1.9倍加速和最高3.9倍内存节省。压缩后的前向索引也可嵌入kANNolo，使其内存占用近乎减半（如SPLADE-v3从6.4降至3.4 GiB）而不损失效率。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的medoid selector、JumpDot点积核、DotPacking8组件压缩以及per-component 4-bit值量化，显著改善了学习稀疏检索的速度–内存权衡，证明了在保留SEISMIC查询效率的同时可大幅缩小索引体积，且前向索引压缩方案具有通用性，可被任何基于前向索引打分（如kANNolo）的系统复用。未来的研究方向包括使用多个或可学习的块代表以恢复更紧的剪枝信号。

title: Learning Probabilistic Logic Programs with Functional Gradient Guided Language Models
summary: Declarative logic programs offer a powerful and interpretable abstraction for encoding relational structure and neurosymbolic reasoning, by expressing dependencies as weighted compositional rules. However, inducing them from data remains fundamentally hard, bottlenecked by the combinatorial explosion of symbolic search spaces. LLMs have recently emerged as powerful hypothesis generators, but when used in isolation, they lack the capacity to do systematic inductive reasoning needed to reliably synthesize valid programs that fit complex relational distributions. We introduce grasp (Gradient-boosted Synthesis of Probabilistic logic programs), a neurosymbolic framework that casts relational structure learning as functional gradient boosting in which the weak learner is a first-order rule and the intractable inner search is delegated to an LLM proposal oracle. We evaluate grasp on four relational benchmarks spanning molecular toxicity prediction (Tox21), mutagenesis, and citation matching (Cora), and show that it improves over purely symbolic, neural, and LLM-based baselines, while producing interpretable weighted rule ensembles. By replacing combinatorial search with gradient-guided LLM hypothesis generation, grasp retains boosting guarantees without sacrificing the transparency of symbolic outputs.

AI.tldr: GRASP 是一个神经符号框架,将关系结构学习建模为函数梯度提升过程,其中弱学习器为一阶规则,而难以处理的内部搜索被委托给大语言模型作为提议预言机。它在多个关系基准上优于纯符号、神经和LLM基线,同时产生可解释的加权规则集合。
AI.motivation: 概率逻辑程序(PLP)为关系数据提供可解释的表示,但从数据中诱导其结构受到组合爆炸的瓶颈限制。传统ILP和SRL方法在关系假设空间上进行符号搜索,随着关系深度和谓词元数的增加而变得难以处理。功能梯度提升通过将结构学习分解为一系列回归问题来缓解这一问题,但每个步骤中弱学习器的诱导仍然需要符号搜索。LLM作为假设生成器虽然强大,但单独使用缺乏系统归纳推理能力,生成的规则往往语义合理但不准确。该研究旨在结合LLM的语义知识和梯度提升的原理性分解,弥合强大但无依据的提议者与原理性但搜索受限的学习者之间的差距。
AI.method: GRASP框架通过三个阶段运作:(1)关系抽象与聚合——一次性阶段,通过LLM生成高阶聚合谓词并构建子句模板,丰富背景知识;(2)关系上下文构建——在每次提升迭代中计算伪残差,选择残差最大的k个示例,并为每个示例构建基于子句模板的局部关系描述;(3)规则提议与评估——LLM根据当前集合、残差信息和示例的局部关系描述提出候选规则,每个候选规则被符号化求值为双叶评分函数,通过最小化平方残差误差来学习叶权重,只有减少损失的规则才会被加入集合。该框架用LLM提议分布取代了组合符号搜索,同时保留了功能梯度提升的收敛保证。
AI.result: 在Cora、Mutagenesis和Tox21(12个目标)共14个数据集上的实验表明:GRASP变体在10个数据集上获得最佳AUC-ROC,在12个数据集上获得最佳AUC-PR。它优于NeuralLP(几乎所有领域),在大多数Tox21核受体和引用目标上匹配或超过BoostedRDN。一次性LLM基线始终是最弱的方法,有时无法生成有效规则,且方差大得多(标准差高达21.6个AUC-ROC百分点)。插入和删除曲线分析表明,GRASP准确地将最高权重分配给最具判别力的规则,且2-4个高权重规则的紧凑子集足以解释大多数关系方差。诱导出的顶级规则与既定领域知识一致——例如,致突变性规则识别出具有低电子亲和力的大型分子,与已建立的构效关系一致。
AI.conclusion: GRASP是学习关系数据中可解释概率逻辑程序的有效神经符号框架。通过将迭代LLM提议与功能梯度提升相结合,它在共享可解释性约束下优于经典符号和神经基线,并表明梯度引导的引导对于可靠规则合成至关重要。GRASP恢复的规则与既定领域知识一致,产生基于已知生化关系的可解释输出。未来的方向包括支持神经谓词以处理非结构化输入、人类协同学习(允许领域专家检查和完善诱导规则),以及微调LLM以提高提议规则的质量和有效性。

title: Looking Inside LLMs: Small-World Connectivity as a Signature of Reasoning Performance
summary: Understanding large language model (LLM) reasoning requires looking beyond behavioral performance to examine how reasoning ability is reflected in internal organization. Inspired by neuroscience findings linking higher intelligence to stronger small-world organization in functional brain networks, we investigate small-world connectivity as a structural signature of LLM reasoning. We construct functional graphs from attention-head activation similarities and find that a higher small-world index (SWI), capturing local clustering and short global paths, consistently correlates with better fluid reasoning performance across models and training checkpoints. Since local clustering is central to small-world organization, we further examine how heads important for model performance connect within and across communities. We find that these heads tend to have a larger share of connection weight within their own communities (high core scores) and a more concentrated weight distribution across communities (low bridge scores). These observations motivate the hypothesis that high core and low bridge scores serve as structural indicators of head importance for reasoning capability. We validate this hypothesis through pruning, introducing Small-World Allocation (SWA), a hierarchical sparsity allocation method guided by these scores. Across six LLMs, SWA better preserves small-world organization and model performance than competing allocation strategies, reducing WikiText perplexity by up to 20%. Together, these findings identify small-world functional connectivity as a measurable signature of LLM reasoning performance, offering a structural perspective that complements behavioral evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文受神经科学启发，提出将"小世界功能连接"作为LLM推理能力的可测量结构签名：构建基于注意力头激活相似性的功能图，发现小世界指数(SWI)与流质推理性能正相关；进而提出Small-World Allocation (SWA)剪枝方法，利用稀疏高斯引导的层次化稀疏分配，在6个LLM上显著优于现有方法，WikiText困惑度最多降低20%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理能力评估主要依赖行为基准（如数学、逻辑、代码任务），但缺乏对模型内部组织结构的理解。神经科学研究表明人类高智商与脑功能网络的小世界组织（高局部聚类+短全局路径）正相关，启发作者探究LLM内部是否存在类似的功能组织作为推理能力的结构签名。
AI.method: 1) 构建注意力头功能图：以注意力头为节点，基于SVCCA（奇异向量典型相关分析）的Fisher z变换变体计算头激活相似性作为边权重；2) 计算小世界指数(SWI)：与度保留随机图比较的聚类系数与全局效率比值；3) 头重要性分析：通过Louvain社区检测计算核心分数（社区内连接权重占比）和桥接分数（加权参与系数），识别重要头的连接模式；4) 提出Small-World Allocation (SWA)：结合核心和桥接分数的层次化稀疏分配剪枝方法，在层和头两个粒度上分配稀疏度。
